postings.title: AI Engineer, Design
postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an outstanding AI Engineer with both a passion for design and experience architecting modern AI implementations.

Nu's design and research function is roughly 260 people. Over the past year they have been building their own tooling: something like 100 AI-assisted solutions and 30+ local knowledge repositories, each built inside a business unit to solve that unit's problem. Most of them work. None of them talk to each other.

The Design Center of Excellence exists to turn that kind of local invention into systems the whole function can build on. It has design ops and research ops. It does not have an engineer — which means the CoE can identify a need, specify a tool, and then has no one to build it.

This is that hire: the first engineer in the CoE, and the person who architects the systems that let design at Nu scale. You'll work directly with the designers and researchers who use what you build, and the person who scopes a system is the person who builds it.




WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

NuBrain — the first priority. A global knowledge system for the design and research function, consolidating the 30+ local repositories that already exist. The hard part is not merging content; it's the context architecture — how retrieval is structured, how token consumption stays sane, and how content reaches people and agents at the moment it's useful.

New tools that enable superlative creative marketing and brand expressions at scale. As Nu scales globally, we are inventing new ways to express our brand in the product and through our marketing. Instead of hiring fleets of marketing designers in every country, we aim to build tools that enable consistent high quality creative expression to be driven centrally.

Canonicalizing what already exists. Roughly 100 AI solutions have been built locally by designers and researchers. Someone needs to understand what they are, decide what becomes standard for the function, and retire the rest before the duplication compounds.

Deciding the shape of the answer. Plugin, MCP server, agent, Claude skill, or a full platform — that call is yours to make and defend. Part of the job is telling the CoE that the tool they asked for should be something else.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Architect and build the systems design at Nu runs on — increasingly agentic ones.

- Sit with designers and researchers, understand the need underneath the request, and turn it into something scoped and buildable.

- Stand up or reuse the infrastructure, write the code, and ship it to the function.

- Instrument what you build. Metrics and observability are part of the deliverable, not a follow-up.

- Own the roadmap for CoE tooling: prioritize, sequence, say no, and keep things moving without a PM behind you.

- Be the technical voice in a design organization — make trade-offs legible to people who don't read code.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

An outstanding, deeply experienced AI engineer. This is an engineering hire first. You've spent years building systems other people build on, and recent years working with AI models on things like token consumption, rate limiting, response latency, MCP servers, and other modern AI engineering challenges.

A track record architecting UX systems. Before AI, you designed and built the foundations of user experience at scale — design systems, component platforms, UI frameworks, front-end infrastructure used by many teams.

A love for design that shows up in your work. Since AI, you've used it to build compelling examples and more sophisticated systems than were possible before. We'd like to see them.

Agentic systems that help design scale. Ideally you've built them — agents, tooling, or infrastructure that let designers do more, faster, and better. This is the strongest signal for the role.

A protagonist. You'll serve a 260-person function as a centralized hub. That means navigating stakeholders, leading projects, and pushing work through an organization that doesn't report to you. You drive the work yourself rather than relying on someone else to run the project.

Evidence you've shipped. Send us GitHub, live tools, demos, and systems you can walk us through. We are not asking for a design portfolio.




BACKGROUNDS THAT TEND TO FIT

- Design systems and UI platform engineers at design-led product companies.

- Engineers at design tooling companies.

- Engineers who have been building AI and agentic tools for designers — in their day job, in open source, or in public.

- Founders and technical leads who were the engineer behind a design-led product.




WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

- Not a designer who codes. The engineering bar is the bar.

- Not a generalist backend or infrastructure role. UX systems experience is core.

- Not customer-facing mobile product work. This is internal systems and tooling for the design function.

- Not a research or modeling role. (The "design modeling" profile — building the models AI consumes — is a different conversation, later.)

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here https://script.google.com/a/macros/nubank.com.br/s/AKfycbwvrewE58oGSbRWIVv8CyCWN68GLxpPVsfYYXv-ZHg94QFsTJmi82rF1x0yt-OTs2W0DQ/exec

postings.title: Performance Video Editor & Designer
postings.descriptionText:
This role is open to candidates based in LATAM, Africa, and Eastern Europe. Please note that as this role supports U.S.-based clients, candidates must be available to work during U.S. business hours aligned with the client’s time zone.

 

Our client is a marketing company specializing in helping home services businesses generate and convert leads through digital advertising, creative campaigns, and marketing technology. The company creates performance-focused advertising and digital assets for its clients, with an emphasis on driving measurable results.




ROLE OVERVIEW

The Performance Video Editor & Designer will be responsible for producing engaging, performance-driven creative assets primarily for paid digital advertising campaigns. This role will focus heavily on short-form video editing while also supporting static ad creative, landing page graphics, and other digital design needs.

The ideal candidate combines strong video editing capabilities with a solid graphic design foundation and understands how paid social creative differs from traditional or organic content. This person will work from established creative direction and collaborate with the marketing team to transform concepts, footage, and brand assets into polished advertisements designed to capture attention and drive action.




LOCATION

Fully Remote | 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM PST | LATAM only.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITING

 - Edit short-form video advertisements for paid social and digital advertising campaigns.

 - Transform raw footage, existing assets, and creative direction into polished, engaging advertisements.

 - Incorporate strong pacing, text overlays, captions, graphics, transitions, and other elements appropriate for short-form advertising.

 - Adapt creative assets into different formats and variations for campaign testing.
   
   


PAID SOCIAL CREATIVE

 - Create video assets with an understanding of what captures attention and performs effectively across social media platforms.

 - Apply best practices around hooks, pacing, messaging, and visual presentation when producing advertising creative.

 - Collaborate with the marketing team to execute new creative concepts and iterations based on campaign needs.

 - Produce creative specifically designed for paid advertising environments rather than relying solely on organic social conventions.
   
   


GRAPHIC DESIGN & STATIC CREATIVE

 - Design static advertisements and supporting campaign graphics.

 - Create visual assets that maintain consistency with established client branding and creative direction.

 - Apply strong typography, composition, hierarchy, and branding principles across digital assets.

 - Support additional graphic design needs across multiple client accounts as required.
   
   


LANDING PAGE & DIGITAL ASSETS

 - Create and update graphics used across landing pages and other marketing materials.

 - Produce supporting visual assets that complement advertising campaigns.

 - Maintain visual consistency throughout advertising and landing page experiences.
   
   


CREATIVE COLLABORATION & ORGANIZATION

 - Work closely with the marketing team to understand creative briefs, feedback, and campaign objectives.

 - Execute within established creative direction while applying strong creative judgment.

 - Manage creative requests across multiple client accounts while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.

 - Incorporate feedback efficiently and produce new creative variations when needed.

 - Organize project files and creative assets to support an efficient production process.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS


EXPERIENCE

 - 1–2+ years of professional experience in video editing, creative design, or a similar role.

 - Demonstrated experience producing short-form advertising or paid social creative.

 - Experience creating both video and static digital marketing assets.

 - Experience producing creative for social media and digital advertising environments.

 - Agency or multi-client experience is a plus.

 - Experience using CapCut.
   
   


SKILLS

 - Strong proficiency with professional video editing tools.

 - Strong video editing capabilities for short-form advertising content.

 - Strong graphic design fundamentals, including typography, composition, hierarchy, and branding.

 - Ability to create compelling short-form videos from provided footage and creative direction.

 - Understanding of social media platforms and the creative conventions that drive engagement and performance.

 - Understanding of hooks, pacing, messaging, and visual presentation for paid advertising.

 - Ability to create static advertising creative and supporting campaign graphics.

 - Ability to produce landing page graphics and other supporting digital assets.

 - Ability to adapt creative into multiple formats and variations for testing.

 - Strong portfolio demonstrating both video editing and graphic design capabilities.
   
   




PORTFOLIO REQUIREMENTS

 - We’re looking for clear, attention-grabbing home-service ads with strong hooks, purposeful pacing, readable text, and prominent calls to action. We recommend sharing short-form paid video ads and static designs that demonstrate your ability to follow brand direction and create variations for testing. Landing page graphics are also welcome.
   


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Polished and engaging short-form advertising creative is consistently produced on schedule.

 - Creative is visually strong while being designed specifically for paid advertising environments.

 - Video and static design needs are successfully supported across client campaigns.

 - Creative briefs and established direction are translated into high-quality finished assets.

 - Feedback is incorporated quickly and effectively.

 - New creative variations can be produced efficiently to support campaign testing.

 - Multiple client accounts are supported while maintaining organization, consistency, and quality.

 - The marketing team has a dependable creative resource for paid social, static advertising, and supporting digital assets.
   
   


OPPORTUNITY

This is an opportunity to join a growing marketing company and work directly on creative that supports client acquisition campaigns. As the Performance Video Editor & Designer, you will produce a variety of paid social advertisements and digital assets, collaborate with an experienced marketing team, and build creative across multiple brands and campaigns.


APPLICATION PROCESS:


TO BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS ROLE THESE STEPS NEED TO BE FOLLOWED:

 - Fill in the application form

 - Record a video showcasing your skill sets

postings.title: Product Designer SR - Merchants
postings.descriptionText:
#SomosNaranjaX y nos une el propósito de trabajar por la inclusión y la educación financiera de millones de personas. Más de 9.5 millones de clientes nos eligen cada día porque confían en Naranja X para alcanzar sus sueños.

Estamos creando un ecosistema de soluciones tecnológicas financieras que se diferencia por ofrecer la mejor experiencia y facilidad en el acceso.
¿Querés ser protagonista de esta historia e impulsar la transformación financiera de millones de personas? ¡Súmate!

¡Te contamos sobre el puesto!
Buscamos una persona altamente talentosa y motivada para unirse a nuestro equipo multidisciplinario de desarrollo de productos. En este rol, vas a ser responsable de liderar y contribuir activamente al diseño de experiencias excepcionales y soluciones innovadoras que impactarán directamente tanto en la calidad y éxito de nuestros productos como en la vida financiera de millones de personas.
Si te gusta resolver problemas complejos, tenés gran capacidad para bajar una idea a una visión de producto y podes manejarte en un ambiente donde el foco evoluciona de forma constante, este equipo es para vos.

¿Qué desafíos vas a encontrar en esta posición?
1- Diseño de Experiencia de Usuario (UX):

• Guiar el proceso de diseño desde la investigación de usuarios hasta la entrega final del producto, asegurando experiencias intuitivas y centradas en las personas.

• Crear wireframes, prototipos y flujos de trabajo detallados para comunicar eficazmente las soluciones de diseño propuestas.

2- Colaboración Interdisciplinaria:

• Trabajar estrechamente con equipos de desarrollo, producto, negocios y otras partes interesadas para comprender los objetivos del producto, traducirlos en soluciones de diseño efectivas y factibles, y mantener los estándares propuestos durante el desarrollo y futuras iteraciones.

• Proponer activamente nuevas ideas, realizar revisiones de diseño para fomentar la innovación y la mejora continua, y analizar métricas del producto para tomar decisiones.

3- Investigación:

• Trabajar en conjunto con el equipo de research, service y mediciones para realizar investigaciones para comprender las necesidades, comportamientos y expectativas de los usuarios finales.

• Integrar hallazgos de investigación en el diseño de soluciones centradas en el usuario.

4- Prototipado y Pruebas:

• Generar propuestas de diseño en diversos niveles de fidelidad: diagramas de flujo, wireframes en baja, wireflows y prototipos en alta calidad.

• Generar prototipos interactivos para validar conceptos de diseño, realizar pruebas de usabilidad para iterar y mejorar las soluciones propuestas.

5- Estándares de Diseño y Consistencia:

• Establecer y mantener estándares de diseño coherentes en todos los productos y colaborar en la creación de un sistema de diseño.

• Colaborar con desarrolladores para garantizar la implementación fiel de los diseños.

¿Qué buscamos?

• Experiencia comprobada como Product Designer o en un rol similar.

• Portfolio sólido que demuestre habilidades en diseño de interfaz, prototipado y solución de problemas.

• Conocimiento de herramientas actuales del mercado. Ej: Marvel/Invision, Adobe Suite, Figma, Sketch, Zeplin, Maze, etc.

• Habilidades de comunicación excepcionales y capacidad para presentar y defender decisiones de diseño de manera efectiva.

• Capacidad para trabajar en un entorno ágil y adaptarse a cambios rápidos.

• Experiencia planificando, ejecutando y/o dirigiendo investigaciones en campo y tests de usabilidad, incluyendo: reclutamiento, creación de prototipos, scripts para tests, facilitación de las sesiones, reporte de resultados y rediseño basados en los insights.

• Conocimiento y uso de herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial (IA) en la rutina diaria para optimizar flujos de trabajo y procesos de diseño.

• Experiencia previa en industrias fintech o relacionadas es un plus.

• Disfrutar de resolver problemas y ser desafiado.

• Ser un aprendiz constante. Estar creciendo, tanto personalmente como con el equipo de forma constante.

Sumarte a la Experiencia NX es:
📍 Modo Flex: Creemos en la presencia más que en la presencialidad. Trabajá de manera híbrida y flexible: desde casa, oficina o mixto.
🌍 #WorkFromAnywhere: desde cualquier parte del país o el mundo.
🌴 Más días de descanso: Además de vacaciones, tenés días libres NX desde el inicio para elegir cuando quieras.
💸 Ajustes de sueldo periódicos que acompañan el contexto económico.
💻 Reintegros por gastos de internet y servicios.
🍔 Reintegro en compras de supermercado y restaurantes
🤩 Programas de capacitación constante y plataformas de E-learning (Udemy) para potenciar tu desarrollo.
👶 Licencia extendida y flexibilidad al regreso para gestantes y no gestantes. + Licencias especiales para el cuidado de tu familia.
🥰Y una propuesta de valor mucho más amplia pensada para acompañarte en cada momento y desarrollar todo tu potencial.

En Naranja X promovemos un espacio de trabajo seguro e inclusivo, donde podés desplegar tu talento, tus ideas y tu magia.
Nuestras búsquedas son abiertas y equitativas para todas las personas: teniendo en cuenta diversidad de género, etaria, de religiones, ideas y opiniones, nacionalidad, personas con discapacidad, LGBTIQ+. ¡Mientras más diversos sean nuestros equipos, mayor será nuestra capacidad de agregar valor a las finanzas de las personas!

postings.descriptionText:
About EY

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. Join EY and help build a better working world. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.


The Opportunity

Global Operations Support plays a key role in supporting operational excellence across the Clients & Industries (C&I) organization. This role focuses on enabling strategic priorities, optimizing processes, and facilitating collaboration across domains, functions, and pods to deliver agility and impact.

The C&I organization has six Domains, each with individual needs and differing maturity: Insights, Industry, Demand Generation, Client Excellence, Sales & Commercial Excellence, and Enablement & Technology.

This position sits within the Business Enablement – Business Management Office which supports the C&I organization through three key functions: Strategic Operations, Core Services, and Performance & Data Insights. Strategic Operations works through pods aligned to each of the six domains, working alongside Core Services and Performance & Data Insights to deliver seamless operational support and strategic execution.

Success in this model depends on agility — the ability to learn quickly, adapt as priorities change, and drive execution while staying responsive to evolving demands.

The primary stakeholder is the Domain Strategy Execution Leader, although this role will work with the rest of the Domain team. This position works directly with the Operations Senior Specialist or Operations Specialist.


Key Responsibilities


Strategic Operations



• Manage and execute domain initiatives and projects by working closely with senior stakeholders, applying strong project management discipline.


• Maintain project plans, timelines, documentation, and next steps, ensuring accuracy and timely updates.


• Drive project meetings, coordinate actions across contributors, advance activity as appropriate and track progress against milestones.


• Support preparation of leadership‑ready materials (presentations, updates, trackers), ensuring they meet EY standards and are ready for circulation.


• Identify project risks, dependencies, and opportunities to improve processes, escalating issues as appropriate.


• Act as a single point of coordination with relevant C&I domains and CBS Functions (e.g., BMC, Finance, Technology, AWS) to support delivery of project outcomes.




Operational Excellence



• Support consistent execution of operational processes by maintaining clear documentation, governance artifacts, and reporting.


• Proactively identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and enhance ways of working within the domain.


• Maintain and manage knowledge repositories, databases, SharePoint sites, and content libraries, including regular review and validation of materials.


• Share knowledge, insights, and updates with stakeholders using agreed communication channels.


• Support preparation of status reporting and dashboards, ensuring clarity in coordination with Performance & Data Insights where applicable.


• Assist the triage of requests for ad‑hoc analysis, reporting, and information, helping to embed new ways of working and reinforcing self‑service where possible.




Stakeholder Engagement



• Develop strong working relationships across domains, functions, and pods, anticipating needs and supporting broader team objectives.


• Manage stakeholder communications and expectations, providing clear, timely updates on progress, risks, and next steps.


• Act as a trusted delivery partner to leadership by ensuring follow‑through on actions and high‑quality execution.


• Participate actively in regular update calls and forums, contributing insights and supporting other team members as needed.


• Facilitate coordination across geographically dispersed teams to enable smooth execution and alignment.




Skills & Attributes for Success



• Good analytical and problem‑solving skills, with attention to detail.


• Experience supporting operational process design, improvement, and handoff.


• Competence in reporting, data visualization, and storyboarding, with the ability to translate data into clear insights.


• Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders, delivering high‑quality outputs under tight timelines.


• A client‑focused mindset, with the ability to respond to changing needs and redirect effort as required.


• Clear, confident communicator with the ability to engage senior stakeholders effectively.


• Resilient, adaptable, and comfortable working in a global, matrixed environment with evolving priorities.


• Familiarity with AI/other automation to enhance processes, project outcomes and personal deliverables




What we offer you

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.


EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society, and the planet, while building trust in capital markets. Enabled by data, AI, and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow. EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy, and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network, and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries

postings.descriptionText:
Job Summary:



About the EY Mercury Support Team (MST)

As an organization jointly owned by Finance and Enterprise Technology, the MST is a centralized and global organization that provides strategic deployment, adoption, and operational support for an integrated, SAP-centric platform (Mercury) and manages and supports the Mercury user community. The MST plays an integral governance role in the global Mercury solution and works closely with the business to enable the benefit and value to be realized from the investment in Mercury and to set the future direction and technology road map.



Responsibilities:



The Business and Technical Communications Analyst maintains and administers the Global Operations Communications Tool (GOCT), helps ensure the platform remains reliable and fit for purpose, and uses it to support planned and unplanned technology communications.



The role administers GOCT configuration, templates, access, audience targeting, monitoring, and documentation. It also partners with Product Management, Development, and communications stakeholders to support tool enhancements, releases, operational maintenance, service disruptions, and P1–P3 incidents.



Key responsibilities include:





• Creates and maintains clear, accurate, and brand-compliant operational communications, templates, guidance, and supporting materials for GOCT and related digital channels


• Administers GOCT configuration, communications templates, shared mailboxes, OneAccess groups, audience targeting, and supporting documentation in accordance with brand and governance standards.


• Monitors GOCT dashboards and the administration mailbox, triages user queries and communication failures, and resolves or escalates issues within required timelines.


• Supports planned maintenance, service disruptions, and P1–P3 incidents by drafting, coordinating, targeting, and releasing timely operational communications through GOCT.


• Coordinates GOCT enhancements and releases by documenting requirements, supporting user acceptance testing, preparing release communications, and validating production updates in partnership with Product Management and Development teams.


• Collaborates with global and regional stakeholders to coordinate contributors, incorporate local requirements, and ensure accurate audience targeting.


• Supports contingency procedures for issuing critical communications when GOCT or dependent services are unavailable.


• Develops a working understanding of GOCT dependencies, integrations, data sources, access groups, and downstream communication channels to support issue diagnosis and release validation.


• Assesses communication needs, tracks issues and risks, identifies competing priorities, and escalates decisions when required.


• Maintains configuration records, operating procedures, support documentation, known-error guidance, release notes, and knowledge articles.


• Tracks GOCT usage, communication failures, incidents, service requests, and recurring issues; identifies trends and recommends operational improvements.





Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:



Senior communication capability required with MST leadership. The role also requires relationship management skills to influence and motivate resources from other ET organizations that leverage our communications tool.



Knowledge and Skills Requirements:





• Excellent English writing, editing, proofreading, verbal communication, and active-listening skills, with strong attention to detail.


• Demonstrated ability to understand technology-related information and translate it into clear, relevant communications for business users, with awareness of operational impacts.


• Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to manage changing priorities and deliver accurate work within compressed timelines.


• Ability to assess requests, identify conflicts, communicate effectively with stakeholders, and escalate decisions, risks, or issues when needed.


• Ability to work independently and collaboratively across functions, regions, and time zones in a virtual, global environment.


• Strong issue-triage, problem-solving, and root-cause analysis skills, with responsiveness to user needs and adherence to firm policies.


• Proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.


• Experience creating and managing SharePoint content is preferred.


• Familiarity with IT service management practices, including incident, problem, change, and release management.







Supervision Responsibilities:



The role will not have any direct reports.



Other Requirements:





• Occasional “off-shift” hours will be required to support communications and will be balanced with local HR laws.





Job Requirements:



To qualify, candidates must have:





• Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Information Systems, Business Administration, Technology Management, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.


• Five to seven years of experience supporting internal corporate or technology operations communications.


• Experience supporting operational communications for planned technology events, service disruptions, critical incidents, or large-scale system implementations.


• Experience using IT service-management or work-tracking platforms, such as ServiceNow to document requirements, manage incidents, and track enhancements.


• Experience administering or supporting an enterprise communications platform, including templates, audience targeting, user access, issue monitoring, testing, or release validation.


• Experience applying change management principles, methodologies, or tools is preferred.


• Experience in the accounting or finance industry is helpful but not required.





What we offer you



At EY, we’ll fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.



• Career development: At EY, your career is yours to shape! We’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences

You will define customer outcomes, prioritize the backlog, align investment to enterprise risk and cloud strategy, and partner with engineering and operations teams to deliver secure, reliable and easy-to-consume capabilities across multi-cloud environments. At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. Join EY and help build a better working world. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

This role focuses on enabling strategic priorities, optimizing processes, and facilitating collaboration across domains, functions, and pods to deliver agility and impact.

The C&I organization has six Domains, each with individual needs and differing maturity: Insights, Industry, Demand Generation, Client Excellence, Sales & Commercial Excellence, and Enablement & Technology.

This position sits within the Business Enablement – Business Management Office and supports the C&I organization through three key functions: Strategic Operations, Core Services, and Performance & Data Insights. Strategic Operations works through pods aligned to each of the six domains, working alongside Core Services and Performance & Data Insights to deliver seamless operational support and strategic execution.

Success in this model depends on agility—the ability to learn quickly, adapt as priorities change, and drive execution while staying responsive to evolving demands.

The primary stakeholder is the Domain Strategy Execution Leader, although this role will work with the Domain Leader and the rest of the Domain team.

• Partner with leadership to help translate strategic objectives into actionable operational plans within the aligned domain.


• Support the design and implementation of short- and long-term initiatives/projects that deliver on strategic priorities, monitoring progress against milestones.


• Oversee domain-specific processes, driving clarity, consistency, and timely execution across stakeholders.


• Prepare strategic inputs for leadership (e.g., decks), synthesizing content into clear narratives and recommendations to support decision-making.


• Collaborate with the Strategic Operations Team Lead and counterparts, plus other Domain teams, to coordinate cross-domain priorities, ensuring operational delivery supports strategic impact.


• Support performance monitoring and governance alongside Core Services.


• Leverage Performance & Data Insights for analytics and intelligence to guide decisions and monitor impact.




Operational Excellence



• Identify and drive efficiencies in relevant areas through automation, standardization, and best practices.


• Assess emerging technologies and tools to enhance operational agility and responsiveness.


• Promote a culture of continuous improvement within the Strategic Operations team.


• Support governance forums and prepare executive-ready updates leveraging data analytics and reporting tools (e.g., Essentials, Dynamics, etc.) in coordination with Performance & Data Insights.


• Drive quality and alignment with Core Services and Performance & Data Insights across domain processes, ensuring clarity in roles, handoffs, and workflows.


• Assist with additional reporting and analysis requests, help manage stakeholder expectations, and reinforce self-service options.




Stakeholder Engagement



• Build strong relationships across domains, functions, and pods to foster collaboration and alignment.


• Act as a trusted advisor to leadership, providing recommendations based on operational insights.


• Facilitate communication and coordination across domains, functions, and pods for smooth execution of initiatives.




Skills & Attributes for Success



• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.


• Experience in operational process creation, improvement, and handoff.


• Proficiency in reporting tools, data visualization, and storyboarding to create impactful prompts for decision-making.


• Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities, delivering high-quality outputs under tight timelines.


• A client-focused mindset, with the ability to manage expectations and redirect activity as required.


• Credible, with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills at Global/Area leadership level.


• Resilient, embraces ambiguity, and comfortable working in a global, matrixed environment with evolving priorities.




What we offer you

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.


EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society, and the planet, while building trust in capital markets. Enabled by data, AI, and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow. EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy, and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network, and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

postings.descriptionText:
Desde la Unidad de Negocios de Consumo Masivo de Newsan que lidera las marcas Pampers, Pantene, Head & Shoulders, Gillette, Always, Downy, Vick y Cebión, llevamos adelante la búsqueda de una persona para ocupar el rol de Jefe/a de ventas para el Canal Farmacias, para trabajar en nuestras oficinas ubicadas en Munro, Prov. de Buenos Aires.

Tu objetivo será diseñar, ejecutar y optimizar la estrategia comercial y de Go-to-Market de la compañía para el canal de farmacias directas, impulsando el crecimiento en volumen, facturación y participación de mercado de las categorías de OTC, Personal Care e Higiene. Garantizar la óptima distribución, visibilidad en el punto de venta y rentabilidad comercial, manteniendo relaciones estratégicas con las principales cadenas del sector.

Tus principales desafíos y responsabilidades serán:

• Negociación Estratégica: Definir y liderar las negociaciones comerciales anuales (JBP - Joint Business Planning) con grandes cadenas de farmacias. Desarrollar la relación a largo plazo.

• Planes de Sell Out y Sell-In: Diseñar y liderar los los planes comerciales: descuentos, acuerdos de volumen, rentabilidad, visibilidad en el punto de venta, etc.

• Estrategia de Distribución e Inclusión de SKUs: Asegurar el listado y presencia de nuevos lanzamientos en los catálogos y plataformas de compra de las cadenas.

• Control de Budget Comercial: Administrar y auditar el presupuesto comercial (Trade Spend), optimizando el retorno de inversión (ROI) de las promociones y acuerdos.

• Análisis de Indicadores (KPIs): Monitorear de forma continua métricas de Sell In, Sell-Out, niveles de inventario (out-of-stock) y cobertura de canal.

• Monitoreo de Competencia y Auditorías: Analizar reportes de auditoría de mercado (Scentia / Nielsen / Close-Up / IQVIA) para detectar tendencias, variaciones de Market Share y movimientos de competidores en OTC y Consumo Masivo.

• Planes de carrera y capacitación: Diseñar e implementar planes de desarrollo individual, identificando fortalezas y áreas de mejora para potenciar el rendimiento y el crecimiento profesional dentro de la organización.

• Alineación de objetivos: Establecer metas claras (KPIs), supervisar su cumplimiento mediante revisiones periódicas y fomentar un clima de trabajo colaborativo, de alto desempeño y orientado a resultados.

En Newsan nos encontramos en la búsqueda de Vendedores/as Franqueros/as para sumarse a nuestro equipo de la Tienda Oficial Motorola en el Abasto Shopping .

Tu objetivo principal será brindar soporte operativo y comercial, asegurando una atención al cliente de excelencia y el cumplimiento de los estándares de la marca.

Principales Desafíos:

•
Atención y Asesoramiento Premier: Ser el embajador/a de la marca, dando la bienvenida y guiando a los clientes a través del catálogo de smartphones y accesorios.

•
Gestión Comercial: Cumplir y superar los objetivos de ventas individuales y grupales de la tienda.

•
Resolución Multicanal: Ofrecer soluciones efectivas y soporte a clientes, inclusive a quienes provengan de compras online (E-commerce) o de otras sucursales.

•
Merchandising y Visual: Mantener la exhibición de productos alineada a las guías de la marca, asegurando que los equipos de muestra funcionen correctamente.

•
Postventa y Garantías: Gestionar de manera ágil los cambios, devoluciones y soporte técnico inicial, validando la documentación y el estado de los equipos.

•
Cobertura de Francos: Cubrir los esquemas de descanso del personal de la tienda, adaptándote con flexibilidad a los turnos requeridos.

•
Experiencia previa en ventas de salón o atención al cliente (muy valorado si proviene del rubro tecnología o telefonía).

•
Pasión por la tecnología y excelente manejo de relaciones interpersonales.

•
Orientación a resultados, proactividad y dinamismo.

•
Secundario completo (excluyente).

•
Flexibilidad horaria indispensable para cubrir francos, fines de semana y turnos rotativos.

•
Disponibilidad para rotar por diferentes puntos de venta / shoppings de CABA y Gran Buenos Aires según las necesidades del negocio.

•
Residir en zonas cercanas al Abasto Shopping.

• Remuneración y beneficios bajo Convenio de Empleados de Comercio

postings.title: Analista SR de producto
postings.descriptionText:
Desde la Unidad de Negocios de Electrónica de consumo y electrodomésticos que lidera las marcas NOBLEX, PHILCO, ATMA y SIAM, llevamos adelante la búsqueda de una persona para ocupar el rol de Analista SR de producto

En este rol, serás el nexo fundamental entre los datos analíticos y la toma de decisiones estratégicas del equipo de Producto como asi también un puente clave entre la estrategia comercial, marketing y las operaciones. Tu objetivo principal será ayudar a identificar y oportunidades de crecimiento y mejora en el diseño de portafolio de productos y marcas, optimizar procesos existentes, evaluar la viabilidad financiera de nuevas iniciativas y transformar datos operativos y de mercado en decisiones ejecutivas de alto impacto.

Tus principales desafíos y responsabilidades serán :

• Análisis estratégico y financiero: Evaluar el rendimiento del negocio, construir modelos financieros (P&L, unit economics, ROI, Payback) y realizar análisis de sensibilidad para respaldar decisiones de inversión o expansión.

• Optimización y reingeniería de procesos: Analizar y gestionar sobre los flujos de trabajo e hitos operativos actuales, identificar ineficiencias o cuellos de botella y proponer mejoras que optimicen costos y tiempos de ejecución.

• Toma de requerimientos e interlocución técnica: Colaborar con los líderes de área para entender las necesidades del negocio, traducirlas en requerimientos funcionales y trabajar junto a los equipos de tecnología o BI para implementar soluciones.

• Monitoreo de KPIs de negocio: Definir, auditar y dar seguimiento a los indicadores clave de rendimiento corporativos, desarrollando tableros e informes estratégicos para la alta dirección.

• Análisis de mercado y competencia: Realizar benchmarking, investigaciones de mercado y análisis de tendencias de la industria para anticipar riesgos y detectar nuevas oportunidades de negocio.

• Gestión de proyectos (Project Management): Liderar o acompañar iniciativas transversales (cross-functional), asegurando el cumplimiento de tiempos, alcance y presupuesto previstos.

• Modelado y visualización de datos: Diseñar y mantener tableros de control (dashboards) dinámicos e interactivos para el equipo de producto y stakeholders ejecutivos.

• Colaboración estratégica dentro del equipo de producto/negocio y áreas de soporte (Oficina en China, Ingenieria, Calidad, Marketing, Comex, Ventas y Experiencia al Cliente) para identificar oportunidades de mejora, cuellos de botella y en especial contribuir en la gestión de ellos.

¿Qué buscamos en aquella persona que se sume al equipo de trabajo?:

• Formación académica: Licenciatura o Grado en Administración de Empresas, Marketing/Comercialización, Economía, Ingeniería Industrial o Finanzas.

• Experiencia laboral: 5+ años de experiencia en roles de análisis de negocio, consultoría estratégica, Business Intelligence o planeamiento financiero, preferentemente en entornos corporativos o de tecnología de alto crecimiento.

• Modelado de datos y financiero: Dominio avanzado de Excel / Google Sheets para modelado financiero avanzado y estructuración de escenarios.

• Visualización de datos (BI): Experiencia en el desarrollo y mantenimiento de tableros de control en herramientas como Power BI. (Deseable)

• Experiencia previa en gestión de productos/negocio B2C o B2B de escala global.

• Idioma: Ingles (Nivel First Certificate o simil) – escrito/habla

postings.title: Gerente de Seguridad Corporativa
postings.descriptionText:
Desde la Unidad de Negocios de Electrónica de consumo y electrodomésticos que lidera las marcas NOBLEX, PHILCO, ATMA y SIAM, llevamos adelante la búsqueda de una persona para ocupar el rol de Gerente de Seguridad Corporativa.

Tus principales desafíos y responsabilidades serán :

• Liderar el equipo de la gerencia integrando las funciones de seguridad patrimonial, custodia de mercadería en tránsito y prevención de pérdidas. (Supply Chain Protection) y asesoramiento en programas de seguridad VIP.

• Realizar análisis de riesgo para identificar los activos a proteger, las amenazas, vulnerabilidades y niveles de riesgo que tienen impacto sobre las operaciones de todas las empresas del grupo newsan (ISO 31.000)

• Diseñar e implementar el programa de seguridad de las Plantas, Centros de Distribución y Oficinas comerciales de la Compañía integrando personas, tecnología y procesos.

• Diseñar e implementar el programa de custodia de mercadería en tránsito para todas las operaciones de transporte de la compañía.

• Seguimiento de los KPI de cumplimiento de las medidas de seguridad por parte de proveedores y empleados de la compañía.

• Diseñar los niveles de servicio aceptables para las beses contractuales de los proveedores de seguridad y las medidas de seguridad obligatorias para proveedores de transporte.

• Establecer los KPI y controlar el cumplimiento de contrato de los proveedores de seguridad humana y electrónica de la compañía.

• Gestionar 360 y articular sus acciones con las Áreas de Seguros, Logística, Supply Chain, Distribución, Trafico, Legales, Compras y los diferentes negocios de la compañía.

• Liderar los procesos de innovación, incorporando agentes de IA para la optimización de procesos operativos y de gestión de presupuestos.

• Interactuar en la gestión de los programa de seguros de Todo Riesgo Operativo y Transporte (Medidas de Mitigación del Riesgo) junto con el área de Seguros, Safety, el Bróker y la Compañía de Seguros.

• Realizar las inspecciones de seguridad en depósitos y playas de contenedores de terceros para controlar el estándar de seguridad requerido contractualmente para las operaciones de la compañía.

• Planificar, Controlar y Generar reportes de la gestión del Presupuesto en línea con los objetivos de gestión de la compañía.

• Planificar, controlar y generar reportes de prevención de pérdidas.

• Desarrollar relaciones a largo plazo con proveedores de seguridad y con todos los proveedores de otras áreas que tengan relación directa o indirecta con el programa de Supply Chain Protection.

• Desarrollar el Capital humano de la gerencia.

¿Qué buscamos en aquella persona que se sume al equipo de trabajo?:

• Profesional con título de grado, preferentemente Licenciado en Seguridad.

• Experiencia previa en la gestión y liderazgo de equipos de seguridad corporativa (5 años)

• experiencia en gestión de proyectos y presupuestos

• Proactividad, capacidad de análisis crítico, foco en resultados y manejo de crisis.

• Medicina prepaga para vos y tu grupo familiar directo.

• Comedor en la oficina, frutas y bebidas calientes a disposición.

• Licencia extendida por maternidad y para personas no gestantes.

• Día de cumpleaños.

• Acceso a descuentos en productos de la compañía.

• … ¡Y más que nos encantará comentarte durante el proceso de selección!

postings.title: Key Account Manager (Motos)
postings.descriptionText:
En la Unidad de Negocios de Movilidad Urbana nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Key Account Manager de Motos para sumarse al equipo comercial.

El objetivo principal de la posición será liderar la estrategia de ventas del negocio de motos para las marcas Siam y Liffan , impulsando tanto la fidelización de clientes actuales como la expansión de la red comercial.

Principales desafíos y responsabilidades:

•
Liderar la gestión de cuentas estratégicas , fortaleciendo el vínculo comercial y garantizando la satisfacción y crecimiento de los clientes clave.

•
Desarrollar nuevas cuentas y oportunidades de negocio , identificando clientes potenciales para ampliar la cobertura de mercado.

•
Gestionar el ciclo completo de ventas , administrando listas de precios, negociación de condiciones comerciales, pedidos, bonificaciones y esquemas de crédito.

•
Administrar el flujo de venta en sistema , realizando el seguimiento de saldos de cuenta, límites de crédito, pagos y aspectos impositivos asociados.

•
Colaborar en acciones de Marketing y TRADE , impulsando iniciativas de promoción, eventos y activaciones en los puntos de venta.

¿Qué buscamos?

•
Experiencia laboral: Mínimo 3 años en posiciones comerciales de gestión de cuentas (KAM, Ejecutivo de Cuentas Senior o similar).

•
Conocimientos técnicos: Manejo intermedio/avanzado de Excel para el análisis de datos y seguimiento de gestión.

•
Especialización comercial: Sólido dominio de variables financieras e impositivas aplicadas a la venta (impacto impositivo, márgenes, métodos de pago, descuentos y bonificaciones).

•
Competencias clave: Proactividad, visión de negocio, capacidad de negociación y excelentes habilidades de comunicación interpersonal.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?:

• Medicina prepaga para vos y tu grupo familiar directo.

• Comedor en la oficina, frutas y bebidas calientes a disposición.

• Descuentos en productos

• Día de cumpleaños libre y jornada de trabajo flexible

• … ¡Y más que nos encantará comentarte durante el proceso de reclutamiento!

¿Querés conocer más acerca de Newsan? ¡Te contamos!

En Newsan tenemos todo lo que se necesita para acercarle a la comunidad los mejores productos y servicios de electrónica de consumo. Disponemos de la mejor tecnología con una amplia red logística, un gran talento humano y la representación de más de 20 marcas nacionales e internacionales (propias, licenciadas y acuerdos comerciales). Entre las propias tenemos a NOBLEX, PHILCO, ATMA y SIAM. Gracias a la eficiencia y compromiso, somos un partner elegido por las principales compañías tecnológicas del mundo como LG, MOTOROLA, HISENSE Y BOSCH. 

Recientemente incorporamos la Unidad de Negocios de Consumo Masivo para las marcas de Pampers, Pantene, Head & Shoulders, Gillette, Always, Downy, Vick, Cebión, que se suman a los negocios existentes de Electrónica y Electrodomésticos, Movilidad Urbana y Exportación de Alimentos. Somos más de 9.000 colaboradores, en oficinas centrales, 7 plantas productivas, 3 centros logísticos y una vasta operación pesquera en toda la Argentina, quienes hacemos de NEWSAN una de las compañías más relevantes de los sectores en los que participamos.

Experiencia de Cliente: Resolver dudas e inquietudes de forma eficiente, incluso para compras realizadas en otras sucursales o a través de nuestra tienda E-commerce.

•
Experiencia: Entre 2 y 3 años de experiencia previa en ventas de salón, retail o atención al cliente.

•
Conocimientos Técnicos: Interés y sólidos conocimientos en tecnología y telefonía celular.

•
Herramientas Informáticas: Manejo de Paquete Office y agilidad en el uso de sistemas de facturación / Puntos de Venta.

•
Competencias clave:

•
Fuerte orientación a resultados.

•
Capacidad de gestión 360° y proactividad.

•
Empatía y agilidad en la atención.

•
Vocación de aprendizaje continuo sobre nuevos productos tecnológicos.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

• Posición Dentro de Convenio.

•
Formar parte de una empresa líder en el rubro de tecnología y electrónica de consumo.

•
Un entorno dinámico, colaborativo y con oportunidades constantes de desarrollo y aprendizaje.

Formación continua en las últimas novedades tecnológicas del mercado.

postings.descriptionText:

📍 Salta Capital | Modalidad presencial

En Grupo Cenoa nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Gerente Administrativo Contable para liderar la gestión administrativa y contable del Grupo, asegurando la eficiencia de los procesos, la calidad de la información y el cumplimiento de las políticas y procedimientos establecidos.

Liderar, organizar y supervisar los procesos administrativos y contables del Grupo.

Coordinar y supervisar los equipos de Administración, Contabilidad, Impuestos y las jefaturas administrativas de las distintas unidades.

Planificar, implementar y mejorar procedimientos y sistemas administrativos, buscando eficiencia y optimización continua.

•
Participar en la definición y seguimiento de políticas, procedimientos y controles internos.

•
Detectar oportunidades de mejora y promover la estandarización y automatización de procesos.

•
Brindar soporte administrativo y contable a las diferentes áreas y unidades del Grupo.

•
Liderar, desarrollar y capacitar al equipo a cargo, promoviendo autonomía, colaboración y orientación a resultados.

💡 Nos orientamos a personas con:

•
Capacidad de liderazgo y conducción de equipos.

•
Visión integral del negocio.

•
Capacidad analítica y orientación a la toma de decisiones basada en información.

•
Organización y capacidad para establecer prioridades.

•
Proactividad y orientación a la mejora continua.

•
Capacidad para trabajar transversalmente con diferentes áreas.

•
Autonomía y criterio para resolver situaciones complejas.

•
Orientación al cliente interno y foco en resultados.

La persona seleccionada tendrá un rol estratégico en la gestión administrativa del Grupo, con autonomía y responsabilidad sobre los procesos de su área, reportando a la Dirección Administrativa.

📍 Lugar de trabajo: Salta Capital

🕐 Jornada: Horario corrido

Si buscás un desafío donde puedas combinar liderazgo, gestión y conocimiento técnico contable, ¡queremos conocerte!

Postulate y sumate a Grupo Cenoa.

📊 Requisitos

•
Contador/a Público/a. Se valorarán profesionales de carreras afines con sólida experiencia en posiciones de gestión administrativo-contable.

•
Experiencia previa de 5 años o más en posiciones de responsabilidad dentro de áreas administrativas y/o contables.

•
Experiencia liderando equipos.

•
Sólidos conocimientos de contabilidad general y análisis de cuentas.

•
Experiencia en cierres contables y elaboración/análisis de estados contables.

•
Conocimientos de impuestos y normativa fiscal vigente.

•
Experiencia en conciliaciones bancarias y control de cuentas corrientes.

•
Conocimientos de procesos de facturación, cobranzas, pagos y tesorería.

•
Experiencia en diseño y seguimiento de indicadores de gestión.

Manejo avanzado de Excel.

Se valorará experiencia en sistemas de gestión/ERP y en organizaciones con múltiples unidades de negocio.

• Direct experience processing money movements (ACH, wires, checks, journals, RTP preferred)

Lead Qualification

Dialer & Workflow Execution

Adaptability & Process Alignment

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

 - Experience working with auto-dialers or predictive dialer systems preferred

Skills

 - Comfortable handling high call volume with speed and consistency

 - Strong listening skills and ability to follow structured scripts naturally

 - Process-driven and execution-focused mindset rather than sales-driven

 - Comfortable working within structured systems and clear KPIs

 - Resilient, consistent, and able to manage repetitive tasks effectively

 - Coachable, adaptable, and responsive to feedback and change




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Consistently handling high daily call volumes (175+ calls/day)

 - Strong and consistent appointment booking rates

 - High accuracy in CRM updates and lead tracking

 - Ability to remain focused, efficient, and consistent throughout the workday




OPPORTUNITY

This is an opportunity to join a well-established and growing company with a proven sales process and strong lead flow. This role has fast, profitable deal approvals from quote to cash.

 - Structure and approve non-standard deals (discounts, usage commits, per-minute pricing, payment terms) in hours, not days

 - Build the discount approval matrix and pricing guardrails, and model deal margin before every approval

 - Report weekly on cycle time, discount levels, and win rate, and automate approvals where possible




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Must have:

 - 4+ years in deal desk, pricing, or sales/revenue operations at a B2B SaaS company

 - Experience owning an end-to-end enterprise process for deals

 - Hands-on experience with Salesforce or HubSpot and a CPQ tool

 - Experience at a VC-backed SaaS/AI company or a big tech/large SaaS company

 - Availability for overlapping hours with our Pacific Time team and customers

Nice to have:

 - Experience with usage-based or consumption pricing

 - Built a deal desk function from scratch

 - SQL or scripting skills to automate reporting and approvals


HOW WE EVALUATE

We care less about checkboxes and more about:

 - Commercial judgment on real deal scenarios

 - Accuracy in pricing and margin models

 - Calm, clear decisions under end-of-quarter pressure

 - Ability to influence Sales, Finance, and Legal


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IF

 - You’d rather say “here’s how we can do it” than “no”

 - You enjoy a spreadsheet model as much as a live deal call

 - You want to build the playbook, not follow one




JOB DETAILS

 - Employment Type: Full-Time 1099 Contractor

 - Compensation: $4,200 USD monthly, based on experience

 - Location: Remote

 - Hours: Must be open to working some overlapping hours with our Pacific Time team and customers.

postings.descriptionText:
Descripción breve

La tecnología es la esencia de nuestro producto. Nuestros equipos de desarrollo, arquitectura, experiencia de usuario, seguridad y data co-crean soluciones para una de las plataformas de e-commerce y servicios financieros más grandes de América Latina.
GenAI Agents construye capacidades y productos que permiten a Mercado Libre crear, operar y mejorar agentes de inteligencia artificial. Trabajamos para que la IA resuelva problemas reales de negocio y mejore la experiencia de las personas que usan nuestros productos. Como Technical Leader Frontend vas a liderar la construcción de experiencias de IA en la web, definiendo la arquitectura, los patrones y las integraciones que hacen que los agentes sean claros, útiles y habiliten experiencias extraordinarias. También vas a articular a los equipos y acompañar la evolución técnica del área.
El equipo está liderado por Tomas Canusso (Argentina) y la posición se encuentra en Argentina.

¿Cuáles son los desafíos del rol?
• Liderar la visión técnica y el delivery del frontend de productos y experiencias de AI Agents, conectando necesidades de negocio, producto y tecnología.
• Diseñar experiencias conversacionales y de producto que ayuden a las personas a entender, destrabar y completar tareas complejas con agentes de IA.
• Traducir problemas abiertos en propuestas concretas, priorizar oportunidades y empujar iniciativas de punta a punta con autonomía. Definir patrones y componentes reutilizables para estados de conversación, streaming, errores, recuperación, feedback y observabilidad de cliente.
• Construir y evolucionar la infraestructura frontend necesaria para operar a escala: performance web, bundling, caching, CDN y optimización de imágenes, estrategias de renderizado, resiliencia de red y telemetría.
• Elevar la calidad de ingeniería mediante arquitectura, code reviews, testing, accesibilidad, seguridad, documentación y acompañamiento técnico al equipo. Trabajar con producto, diseño, backend y otras plataformas para definir contratos claros, reducir fricción de integración y entregar resultados medibles.
• Investigar de forma continua el ecosistema de agentes, modelos y herramientas de IA, incorporando lo que aporte valor real al producto y al equipo.

¿Cuáles son los requisitos?
• Experiencia comprobable liderando técnicamente productos o plataformas frontend de complejidad relevante, con impacto en otros engineers y equipos.
• Dominio de JavaScript y TypeScript, React y prácticas modernas de desarrollo frontend. Conocimiento profundo de la plataforma web: navegadores, rendering, networking, performance, accesibilidad, seguridad y observabilidad.
• Experiencia tomando decisiones sobre bundling, caching, CDN, optimización de imágenes, estrategia de carga y métricas de experiencia.
• Criterio de arquitectura para componentes, design systems, contratos de integración y evolución de aplicaciones sin romper a sus consumidores.
• Capacidad de comunicar trade-offs, generar acuerdos técnicos y navegar conversaciones complejas con iniciativa y claridad. Curiosidad, autonomía y mentalidad de producto para identificar problemas, proponer soluciones y llevarlas a producción.
• Familiaridad con LLMs, agentes o experiencias conversacionales. Se valora haber construido productos de IA, chat, voz, streaming o sistemas de evaluación.
Tené en cuenta que el seniority es referencial. Para conocer más sobre Oportunidades en MELI, compartimos la guía .

Esta posición desempeña un papel clave en el monitoreo de entregas, la coordinación con operadores logísticos y la colaboración con equipos internos para garantizar una experiencia excepcional para nuestros clientes.

postings.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
JOIN OUR TEAM
BetWarrior is a next-generation digital gaming company with a bold mission: to redefine the way people experience sports betting and casino entertainment across Latin America.
With a dynamic and diverse team, deep market insights, and cutting-edge technology, we're creating an experience that is personalized, responsible, and always player-first.
Great people, bold ideas, and a sharp focus on user experience set us apart.

Purpose
We are looking for a Backend Software Engineer with strong analytical skills and a product-oriented mindset to join our multidisciplinary teams. At BetWarrior , we are evolving toward a Spec-Driven Development (SDD) and Given-When-Then / Behavior-Driven Development (GDD/BDD) approach.
In this model, without traditional Business Analysts, the Backend team plays a key role: leading the initial technical analysis based on Product requirements, establishing the conversation with the Frontend team, and defining contracts, models, and interactions before writing a single line of code.

In this role, you'll

• Lead Technical analysis and SDD. Take the lead in defining functional and technical specifications (OpenAPI/Swagger, data models, sequence/state diagrams). Produce clear documentation both for Product stakeholders and for the technical team to operate and maintain the solution.

• Act as a communication bridge within the team. Work in small, autonomous squads, actively collaborating with Product, UX, and Frontend to align on endpoints and integration contracts.

• Design and develop resilient, low-latency, highly concurrent backend architectures, with a strong focus on event-driven architectures.

• Understand that quality goes beyond code: incorporate metrics, structured logging, and tracing from the design stage to ensure effective production monitoring.

• Translate complex business scenarios into structured acceptance criteria (Given-When-Then / Gherkin), working closely with the Automation QA team.

What we look for in an exceptional candidate

• 5+ years of experience in software engineering background in highly complex and scalable backend environments.

• Solid experience with Java and modern frameworks (Spring Boot), which are the core technical foundation of our platforms.

• Experience with distributed systems, asynchronous processing, and messaging/event-driven tools (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.).

• Demonstrated ability to lead upfront technical design through comprehensive specifications, technical diagrams, and API definitions.

• Strong interest in system telemetry (metrics, logging, tracing) and troubleshooting production bottlenecks.

• Ability to articulate technical decisions, communicate architecture to non-technical stakeholders, and design maintainable, long-term solutions.

Bonus points if you also have

• Hands-on experience with Cloud infrastructure (AWS) and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).

• Previous experience managing critical incidents and conducting post-mortems, using those learnings to anticipate potential failures during the design stage.

• Familiarity with reactive programming principles or advanced concurrency patterns.

How we do things
BetWarrior is a company in expansion. The team is fast-moving, collaborative, and demanding — with high standards for quality and a genuine commitment to building something that lasts. We are not looking for someone to fill a seat. We are looking for people who want to grow with the company, take ownership of their work, and be part of building a regional team that operates at a high level across multiple markets.
For the right person, this is an opportunity to join at a stage where your contribution is visible, your growth is real, and the path forward is defined by what you deliver — not by time in role.
We expect every team member to live our values
Accountability & Ownership –Take charge, own your craft
Reliability –Deliver with quality and consistency
Teamwork –Collaborate, challenge, and grow together
Winner Spirit –Compete with purpose and grit
Wellbeing –Build a career that energizes you
Curiosity & Innovation –Keep questioning. Keep improving

postings.company: Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime
postings.descriptionText:
Application Deadline : 6 November - 17:00 CET

Contract Duration
One-year fixed term with possibility of extension or renewal

Language Proficiency
Fluency in spoken and written English. Working knowledge of French, Spanish or Portuguese would be an asset.

Location

Global, remote

Background
The Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime (GI-TOC) is an independent civil society organization headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, with a globally dispersed Secretariat working across 43 countries. Founded in 2013, GI-TOC brings together a global network of more than 810 independent experts and a team of over 150 staff dedicated to understanding and responding to organized crime. Through research, analysis, policy engagement and support to civil society actors, GI-TOC works to deepen understanding of organized crime and strengthen effective, rights-based responses.

The GI-TOC works to:

• Identify, analyse and map criminal trends and patterns of regional instability, and their impact on illicit flows, governance, development, security, conflict and the rule of law.

• Connect and support civil society actors working on organized crime and corruption, and on their links to instability and conflict.

• Strengthen local monitoring and analysis of national, regional and international organized crime and insecurity trends.

Job Summary
GI-TOC is looking for an Monitoring Evaluation and Communications Officer to work across its two flagship environmental crime programmes. The role sits between programme administration and research, and needs both skill sets.
You will set up M&E systems across major projects in Latin America, Asia and Africa, working with environmental defenders, civil society organisations, law enforcement and the private sector. You will help build a body of practice on measuring the disruption of environmental crime networks and illicit economies, a field where good methods are still scarce. And you will make sure the impact of GI-TOC’s and its partners’ work reaches key audiences.
This is a growth role. Extensive M&E experience is not required, but you will be expected to upskill quickly and with dedication.

Main Responsibilities and Specific Tasks

• Monitoring, evaluation and learning: set up M&E systems across projects; collect information to set and track baselines, targets and indicators across both programmes; review and evaluate narrative reports from partners, grantees and country teams; gather and write up stories of impact; and contribute to learning and impact reporting.

• Measuring disruption: help build a body of practice on measuring the disruption of environmental crime networks and illicit economies.

• Donor relations: support donor reporting and correspondence, and help keep commitments, deadlines and deliverables on track.

• International coordination: support coordination across country teams, observatories and partners in Europe, Latin America, Africa and Asia.

• Communications: make sure the impact of GI-TOC’s and partners’ work reaches key audiences, preparing summaries, impact stories, newsletters and briefing materials in liaison with GI-TOC’s communications team.

• Bridging teams: act as a connector between programme, research, data and communications colleagues, and with close GI-TOC partners, so information flows and work is coherent across projects.

Required Skills and Experience

Essential

• University degree in a relevant field.

• Some professional experience in programme support, research, M&E or communications.

• Familiarity with M&E concepts, practices and approaches, such as results frameworks, theories of change, indicators and outcome harvesting.

• Excellent written English and the ability to turn complex information into clear material.

• Highly organised, careful with detail, and able to manage several workstreams at once.

• Strong interpersonal skills, and able to build relationships across teams and organisations

Desirable

• Formal M&E training or experience on donor-funded programmes, especially EU or Norad.

• Knowledge of environmental crime, organised crime or natural resource governance.

• Experience producing communications content.

• Working knowledge of French, Spanish or Portuguese.

Personal Attributes
We work best with people who take initiative, are creative but careful with detail, and have a strong drive to bring organisation and coherence to our projects and to pursue impact. You will need to be internally well networked, and comfortable working across teams, time zones and partners.
GI-TOC operates a flexible working environment and encourages staff to achieve a suitable work-life balance and supports professional development and learning.
Only short-listed candidates will be contacted.
The Global Initiatives makes use of BambooHR's ATS system to receive and review your application. All correspondence related to your application will be sent via our domain globalinitiative.bamboohr.com.

postings.descriptionText:
About HumanSignal

Real-world data is the competitive edge in AI.

HumanSignal is a human data partner for companies building AI models and products. Our customers ship better AI, faster, because we partner with their researchers from real-world data creation to annotation to delivery.

We design and create datasets from scratch, recruit and manage the domain experts who evaluate model output, and run everything through our own platform, Label Studio, the open-source standard for data labeling and evaluation, used by over 1 million practitioners worldwide.

We specialize in the operationally complex: real-world data collection, multimodal pipelines, and multi-step workflows. Advanced ML and AI teams use our enterprise platform to run their own data factories, and our services team to extend their reach where in-house capacity runs out.

If you want to do work that materially shapes how the next generation of AI products gets built, we'd love to talk.

Audio Editor – Multitrack Dialogue

•
Location: Remote

•
Type: Contract (20 to 35 hours per week, 2 to 4 weeks initially with potential to extend)

•
Duration: Immediate start; group training on Monday, October 27

You’ll master multitrack recordings from our production studio and deliver them to spec through our platform. Each session captures a user mic, an assistant mic and four channels from a Zoom field recorder. The four-channel portion is where most of the work lives: each channel needs individual leveling, noise reduction and timing alignment so the mix stays even across the stereo field. You’ll work from a rubric, hand off to QA, and flag recording issues (camera movement during dialogue, sync problems) back to the production team.
This is a hands-on editing role. We’re looking for people who can work channel by channel in a DAW, not people who rely on one-click AI cleanup tools.

What you’ll do

• Master roughly one file per 3 hours: clean, denoise, level and align six tracks per session

About the Role
The Groove is building out a formal finance and accounting function to match its growth — moving from a founder-run, FreshBooks-era setup to a clean, accrual-basis close on Workday. What You'll Do

• Perform monthly and quarterly bank reconciliations in Workday, including clearing out a backlog of unapplied deposits and cash.

• Reconcile balance sheet accounts on an accrual basis each quarter, researching and correcting unnatural or stale balances.

• Support the transition to accrual-basis accounting: prepaid amortization, depreciation, accrual entries for payroll/PTO/bonus/commission, and other standard month-end adjustments, under the Controller Consultant's direction.

• Assist with accounts payable: invoice coding, cost-center/worktag completion, and 1099 vendor tracking alongside the AP/payroll lead.

• Support payroll-related reconciliations, including matching payroll journal entries to ADP settlement detail and reviewing benefits deductions for accuracy.

• Help build and maintain a documented monthly close checklist as the function matures.

• Take on increasing responsibility for recurring, process-driven accounting work as Workday automation (bank-rec, AP workflow, revenue-recognition) comes online, freeing up senior team members for review and exception-handling rather than data entry.

What We're Looking For

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting required.

• 3–5 years of general ledger / staff accounting experience: journal entries, account reconciliations, AP/AR, and month-end close support.

• Solid working knowledge of GAAP and double-entry accounting fundamentals.

• Comfort with Excel for reconciliation and analysis work (lookups, pivot tables).

• Workday Financials experience is a strong plus — this role will work inside Workday daily, including during an active configuration and clean-up project.

• High attention to detail and comfort working through unresolved or messy data to find the right answer, rather than needing a fully built-out process to follow.

• Self-starter who's comfortable in a lean, fast-moving environment — this is our first dedicated staff accounting hire, so some ambiguity comes with the territory.

Interest in growing into a senior accountant or assistant controller role as the function matures.

postings.descriptionText:
Overview: Quality and Test Automation
The Automation QA Engineer is vital for ensuring the reliability, performance, and correctness of our entire supply chain e-commerce platform. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining comprehensive automated test suites across the e-commerce user interface, complex internal business workflows (MES, WMS, OMS), and the logic governing our next-generation AI agents.

Internship Details
Duration: 3 months

Start Date: Immediate

Location: Remote
Stipend: None initially. Based on your first-quarter performance, you may be offered a paid full-time opportunity, or even be absorbed directly by the client as an FTE.

Key Responsibilities & Core Projects
You will embed quality assurance directly into the development and deployment lifecycle, serving as the gatekeeper for production releases.

• Test Suite Development: Develop and maintain robust, end-to-end automated test suites covering critical e-commerce flows (catalog navigation, checkout, payments, invoicing) and complex internal tool workflows (OMS/WMS operations).

• Quality Gates (CI/CD): Integrate automated test suites into the CI/CD pipeline (managed via Makefile) to enforce quality gates, ensuring no regressions are introduced and the platform adheres to performance standards before deployment.

• Performance & Load Testing: Implement and execute performance testing and load testing protocols to validate the scalability and resilience of the NestJS modular monolith, especially for high-traffic scenarios and intensive SCM transactions.

• API Integration Testing: Design and execute automated tests for API integrations between the core supply chain modules (e.g., testing the data contract integrity between WMS and OMS) and external payment services.

• Test Data Management: Create and maintain reliable test data factories to simulate complex multi-tenant and domain-specific scenarios (e.g., various HS codes, tenant feature flags).

• Regression Management: Continuously maintain and optimize the regression test suite to provide fast, reliable feedback to development teams operating within the Monorepo structure.

Required Technologies & Tools
Candidates must possess strong expertise in automated testing frameworks, CI/CD integration, and performance validation:

• Automation Frameworks: Experience selecting, building, and maintaining E2E (e.g., Playwright, Cypress) and API testing frameworks.

• Programming: Strong proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js for writing high-quality, maintainable test code.

• Performance/Load: Experience with tools for performance and load testing (e.g., JMeter, K6).

• CI/CD: Practical experience integrating tests into automated pipelines and working within a Monorepo environment.

• Data & Database: Ability to query PostgreSQL 15 directly to validate data integrity.

AI Agent Focus
You will be responsible for validating the behavior and accuracy of our AI systems.

• Agent Behavior Testing: Develop tests to validate the deterministic and non-deterministic behaviors of AI agents, ensuring they accurately process inputs, access data securely, and perform their intended functions (e.g., workflow optimization, customer support responses).

• Integration Validation: Verify the quality of data retrieval and the security of the API layers connecting AI agents (using LangChain/LlamaIndex) to the core WMS/OMS data.

Success Metrics & Career Path

Performance will be measured by:

• Test Coverage: Measurable increase in automated functional and regression test coverage across critical application paths.

• Defect Escape Rate: Reduction in the number of critical and high-severity defects escaping to production.

• Pipeline Reliability: Maintenance of stable, non-flaky test runs within the CI/CD pipeline.

Mentorship Structure: Reports to the Technical Architect or Engineering Lead, working directly with development teams across the Catalog, OMS, and WMS modules.

• MLOps Tools: Experience with model registries, experiment tracking, and serving platforms (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, Sagemaker).

• Methodology: Deep understanding of MLOps best practices, responsible AI principles, and monitoring concepts.

AI Agent Focus
You will ensure the reliability and continuous improvement of the core AI layer.

• LLM Operationalization: Implement specific pipelines for the fine-tuning, validation, and deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) used in our AI agents.

• Agent Performance Tracking: Develop metrics and tracking systems to measure the business impact and operational efficiency of multi-agent systems and recommendation engines.

• Framework Integration: Operationalize models built using frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex, ensuring they are secure, versioned, and scalable in a production environment.

Success Metrics & Career Path

Performance will be measured by:

• Deployment Velocity: Speed and reliability of deploying new or retrained models to production.

• Model Performance: Maintaining model accuracy and minimizing performance drift in production.

• Pipeline Automation: Percentage of the ML lifecycle (training, validation, deployment) that is fully automated.
