• Infrastructure Security: Enforce secure Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) practices using Terraform for provisioning and managing our Oracle Cloud Free VMs. Continuously monitor the cloud infrastructure for vulnerabilities and misconfigurations.

Required Technologies & Tools

AI Agent Focus
You will ensure the secure deployment and operation of our AI layer.

• Secure Deployment: Implement dedicated, hardened deployment pipelines for AI agents (built on LangChain/LlamaIndex), isolating them and controlling their access to core supply chain data (MES, WMS, OMS).

Senior Data Engineer (AI-Native) — Data Layer

About Us
Proton is building the AI operating system for wholesale distribution, embedded in the workflows that move nearly every physical product on the planet. Distribution is a $9 trillion industry, and the software that runs it has been stuck in the past for decades — most tools create more work than they eliminate. We unify CRM, PIM, eCommerce AI, and Order & Quote Entry AI into one platform with one data layer and one AI brain, so reps spend their time deepening customer relationships, not entering data.
We hire people with high agency and high urgency. At Proton , everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and ships AI-native software faster than anyone else in the category.
The median Proton customer reports 3x profit return per dollar spent, an extra day of sales per rep per month, and “the best ROI of any tech investment in 30 years.” Hundreds of leading distributors — from family-owned shops to publicly-traded enterprises across, industrial, HVAC, electrical — run on Proton . We’re backed by Felicis Ventures (Twitch, Shopify, Opendoor) and Battery Ventures.
If you want to build the systems that shape how trillions of dollars of physical goods move through the economy, Proton is the place to do it.

The Role
We're hiring a Senior Data Engineer to own and grow our Data Layer — the unified foundation that every Proton product and our AI brain are built on. You'll own the pipelines and architecture end to end: the medallion-style layers (raw → refined → curated), ingestion from a wide range of systems, and the serving the whole company depends on. We're investing heavily to make the Data Layer bigger and better, and this role is for someone who wants to do the hands-on building and shape where it goes next.
Two things make this role different from a standard data engineering opening:

•
You're an AI-native operator, not a pipeline author. Every engineer at Proton uses Claude Code and other agentic tools as first-class collaborators. We expect pipelines, models, and migrations to be built and shipped with heavy AI leverage — you guide the agents, validate the output, and make the judgment calls they can't.

•
You own the layer everything runs on. When the AI gives a wrong answer or a number doesn't match the source, the trail leads back to the data. You own correctness end to end — ingestion, modeling, reconciliation, and the contracts other teams depend on.

Location: Europe, remote. Meaningful daytime overlap with our Boston (EST) team required.

What You'll Do

• Own the Data Layer end to end: ingestion from file-, event-, and API-based sources; the medallion-style model (raw → refined → curated); and the serving layer that powers the product and the AI brain.

• Build and operate the ingestion and transformation pipelines that power the Data Layer, using a modern orchestration framework and cloud data warehouse.

• Ingest and reconcile large, messy, real-world data across many source types and shapes — batch files, streaming events, and APIs.

• Model data across medallion layers so it's trustworthy, queryable, and stable for downstream teams and the AI.

• Help take the Data Layer to the next level — better architecture, better tooling, more scale, more sources — and have a real say in what that looks like.

• Operate AI coding agents (Claude Code and similar) at a high level: scope work, structure context, run agents in parallel where it makes sense, and ship reviewed, production-quality output.

• Build the systems that make data trustworthy — validation, reconciliation, lineage, backfills, idempotent and incremental loads — so downstream teams and the AI don't inherit silent errors.

• Partner with backend, AI, and product engineers (and occasionally customers' IT teams) to define the data contracts they build on.

Requirements

• 7+ years hands-on as a data engineer with real, demonstrable production ownership — pipelines and data models serving real users at scale.

• Strong fundamentals. You understand what your code and your queries are doing and why. You can read a query plan, reason about a slow or expensive pipeline, and debug a data-correctness bug to its root.

• Strong programming and SQL skills. You build efficient pipelines, schemas, and queries, and can model data for both transactional and analytical access patterns.

• Hands-on orchestration experience, building reliable ingestion/ELT pipelines against messy upstream sources.

• Experience with a cloud data warehouse and a major cloud platform.

• Experience ingesting from multiple source types: file-based, event/streaming, and API-based .

• Solid grasp of data-consistency failure modes — partial loads, late or out-of-order data, idempotency, backfills, schema drift.

• Daily, hands-on use of agentic dev tools (Claude Code, Cursor agent mode, Codex, or equivalent) to ship real work. You can talk concretely about how you structure prompts, manage context, parallelize agents, and verify their output.

• Ownership and judgment. You take data systems from idea to production and exercise good taste on what to build and what to cut.

• Startup mindset and strong communication — pragmatic, fast, biased to ship, and able to explain data decisions to engineers, PMs, and customers in writing.

• English at C1 or above.

Big Plus

• Deep cloud data warehouse experience and modern transformation tooling.

• Streaming / event ingestion at scale.

• Medallion or lakehouse architecture experience on large, multi-source data.

• Experience integrating enterprise sources such as ERP (Epicor Eclipse, Prophet 21) or ecommerce systems, and reconciling messy transactional data.

• Building data systems that feed AI/ML or agentic products — serving/feature layers, retrieval, or data contracts for model inputs.

• Prior experience at an early-stage SaaS startup.

A unified authorization model. Extend a centralized, fine-grained, relationship-based model across the platform, replacing feature-specific permission checks with consistent, reusable primitives.

Production-grade operations. Harden the authorization layer for the scale, reliability, and security that enterprise and public-sector customers expect.

A thoughtful migration path. Make the sequencing and design calls that let us retire legacy access checks without disrupting customers along the way.

Groups and organizations that mirror real customers. Rethink how we model groups and organizational hierarchies so large enterprises can represent their teams the way they actually work.

Cloud-native identity. Deepen integration with cloud workload identity, starting with AWS IRSA and extending to Azure and GCP equivalents.

Foundations other teams build on. Design core identity and access capabilities, with clean interfaces and flexible abstractions, that engineers across the company can adopt with confidence.

A stronger way of building. Set the patterns for how the team uses AI-assisted development to ship high-quality features faster, without compromising security or code quality.

Bring clarity to complex decisions. Articulate the architecture clearly enough that the rest of Engineering can rally around it.

Be the go-to authority. Engineers and teams building on IDSM will bring their auth questions to you, and your technical judgment will carry real influence.

Raise the engineering bar. Lead design reviews, unblock engineers facing ambiguity, and champion flexible abstractions and well-thought-out interfaces.

Shape how we build with AI. Establish patterns for using AI-assisted development to deliver high-quality features faster without compromising security or rigor.

•
Foster ownership and urgency. Help the team know what to build and value both quality and speed of iteration and contribute to experiences that make identity and user management easier for the enterprises we serve.

What we look for in this role

postings.title: Senior Voice Routing Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
The Challenge
We connect over 500’000 callers in 190 countries: that represents 36,000 calling corridors and over 100 million calling minutes. We work with various global suppliers optimising for call quality. It’s complex. Each calling corridor has its own quality quirks and legal and regulatory rules to work within. We want someone to own call quality and routing holistically across all of it: routing daily to optimize what's happening right now, while watching the data for the long-term trends that tell us where to fix things next.
A failed call is not a metric to us. It's someone not hearing their mother's voice or its an important business call that fails. We also have real ambitions to scale calling well beyond where we are today, so this complexity isn't going anywhere. It's only going to grow.
Talk360 has been profitable since 2025, expanding beyond our core calling app into embedded, B2B2C calling for partners. We are lean, around 30 people globally, spread across the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine, and beyond. That means this role has real scope from day one: no layers between you and the decisions that matter, and no shortage of things worth tackling.

This is a remote opportunity.

What You'll Do

• Own call quality holistically : hold the full picture of call quality end to end, working with the team on both the daily grind and the long-term view, moving fluidly between quick fixes and structured experiments.

• Manage zones, codes, and origins : own and continuously refine our zone, dialing code, and call origin management, keeping the underlying structure clean and accurate across all 900 zones.

• Update routing continuously : change routing several times a day, from immediate fixes to longer-running tests of new suppliers.

• Work cross-functionally by design : partner daily with Ozcan, who owns supplier account management and deal creation, and Mahmoud, who runs hourly monitoring and support-team escalations to suppliers. Work with Ewan on automating the processes behind routing, and with Product and CRM to improve the experience for our end users.

• Move routing toward automation : work toward (semi) automated routing and pricing, reducing how much of this still runs on manual, single-person work.

Requirements

What You'll Bring

• Hands-on experience with international A-Z calling and telco routing: zones, codes, LCR, and SIP response codes, built at a telco, carrier, or comms platform with real cross-border calling experience.

• NOC or technical support background: comfortable troubleshooting live voice traffic and reading call detail records and quality metrics like ASR and ACD.

• Exposure to a routing/testing platform such as iTest or an equivalent tool. Familiarity with Digitalk Cloud Carrier (DCC), our current routing platform, is a plus.

• Nice to have: working technical literacy in SIP signalling and SBC concepts

Who You Are

• Process driven and meticulous: you build the audit trail as you go, not after something goes wrong. You are methodical and analytical by nature, and you would rather have a clean, repeatable process than a clever one-off fix.

• Hands-on: you do the routing work yourself, day to day, not just direct others to do it.

• A strong communicator: equally at ease explaining a routing issue to Product or Marketing as debating a fix with a supplier's NOC team.

• Ownership without a script: you see a bottleneck and you fix it rather than wait to be asked.

• Genuinely commercial: you understand a dropped call or a bad route costs Talk360 real money and a real user's trust, not just an SLA breach.

Recruitment Process

•
Recruiter screening

•
Hiring manager screening with COO

•
Technical interview

•
Case study

What you get

Learning and growth

• €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving.

Time to recharge

•
25 vacation days

• Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs

• Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we'll tell you more during the interview)

Work from anywhere

• As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas.

A team you'll actually want to be part of

•
Weekly team lunch every Thursday

•
Regular team moments and outings

• An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond

Set up for success

• Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work

• Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance

An environment to grow and make impact

• A collaborative environment where you can learn from others, take ownership, and contribute to a meaningful mission

About Talk360

Talk360 was founded with a clear purpose: to become the most accessible and reliable calling app for African diaspora communities, both within Africa and abroad. For our users, calls are not transactional, they are emotional lifelines to family, friends, and essential support networks. When service quality drops, they feel it immediately. That responsibility drives everything we build.
Over the past years, Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide last year. We successfully spun off our payments arm into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by the discontinuation of Skype, and achieved profitable growth from 2025 onwards, marking our transition from early-stage scale-up to a disciplined, sustainable business.
As we continue to grow, we are expanding beyond our own B2C app. We are now launching our first embedded calling products within partner platforms, bringing Talk360 ’s technology into new ecosystems and enabling partners to offer international calling directly within their own products.
Our ambition is bold: to become the world’s most trusted way to call any real phone number — connecting migrants, travellers, professionals, and businesses across the globe.

Here’s what our users say:
“I like Talk360 because it saves me a lot of money. I used to call from Zimbabwe for 15 rands a minute. Talk360 came to the rescue. Now I can call my mother for hours.” — Google Play, South Africa ★★★★★

At Muttdata, we build innovative Data Products and Machine Learning solutions that help companies solve complex business challenges. As a fast-growing, remote-first startup, we're passionate about technology, collaboration, and continuous learning.

This opportunity is with a leading multinational beverage company based in Mexico City.

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our team 🐶🚀. You'll be responsible for designing, developing, and enhancing advanced Pricing and Revenue Growth Management (RGM) models , turning data on demand, pricing, product portfolios, sales channels, and consumer behavior into actionable insights that drive strategic business decisions.

In this role, you'll combine Machine Learning, statistics, econometrics, and business expertise to build predictive models, analyze price-demand relationships, estimate price elasticities, and optimize pricing strategies.

You'll work closely with business stakeholders, Data Engineers, and Machine Learning Engineers to develop scalable, statistically robust solutions that support commercial decision-making. Strong analytical thinking, business understanding, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations are essential to succeed in this collaborative environment.

🚀 What We Do

• Leveraging our expertise, we build modern Machine Learning systems for demand planning and budget forecasting.

• Developing scalable data infrastructures, we enhance high-level decision-making, tailored to each client.

• Offering comprehensive Data Engineering and custom AI solutions, we optimize cloud-based systems.

• Using Generative AI, we help e-commerce platforms and retailers create higher-quality ads, faster.

• Building deep learning models, we enhance visual recognition and automation for various industries, improving product categorization, quality control, and information retrieval.

• Developing recommendation models, we personalize user experiences in e-commerce, streaming, and digital platforms, driving engagement and conversions.

🌟 Our Partnerships

• Amazon Web Services

• Astronomer

• Databricks

🌟 Our Values

• 📊 We are Data Nerds

• 🤗 We are Open Team Players

• 🚀 We Take Ownership

🔍 Curious about what we’re up to? Check out our case studies and dive into our blog post to learn more about our culture and the exciting projects we’re working on! 🚀

Responsibilities 🤓

• Design, develop, and optimize advanced Pricing and Revenue Growth Management (RGM) models to support strategic business decisions.

• Build and validate price-demand elasticity models, including own-price and cross-price elasticities.

• Develop predictive models using Machine Learning, statistical methods, and econometric techniques to analyze demand, pricing, and consumer behavior.

• Perform time series analysis, demand forecasting, and mathematical optimization to identify business opportunities.

• Conduct feature engineering using pricing, sales volume, seasonality, product, channel, and market data.

• Design and execute experiments, backtesting, sensitivity analyses, and statistical validations to ensure model reliability.

• Evaluate model robustness, temporal stability, potential biases, and underlying statistical assumptions.

• Develop pricing scenarios and simulations to assess the impact of commercial strategies.

• Collaborate with business stakeholders, Data Engineers, and Machine Learning Engineers to translate business challenges into data-driven solutions.

• Communicate complex analytical findings and actionable recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Required Skills 🚀

• 4+ years of experience as a Data Scientist, ideally working on Pricing, Revenue Growth Management (RGM), demand modeling, forecasting, or optimization.

• Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL.

• Strong knowledge of applied statistics, econometrics, and supervised Machine Learning.

• Hands-on experience with price elasticity modeling, demand modeling, price-response curves, or equivalent approaches.

• Solid understanding of own-price and cross-price elasticity.

• Experience with regression models, regularization techniques, and statistical inference.

• Strong background in time series analysis and forecasting.

• Experience with mathematical optimization, scenario modeling, and sensitivity analysis.

• Proficiency in feature engineering using pricing, volume, seasonality, and commercial variables.

• Experience designing experiments, performing backtesting, and conducting statistical validation.

• Hands-on experience with Databricks, Spark/PySpark, and MLflow.

• Experience developing and validating statistical and Machine Learning models that support business decision-making.

• Experience working with sales datasets involving pricing, volume, products, channels, geographies, and time dimensions.

• Ability to build models across multiple levels of granularity and assess their statistical robustness and stability over time.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business challenges into mathematical and predictive models.

• Excellent communication and data storytelling skills, with experience presenting insights to technical and business stakeholders.

• Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams, including business stakeholders, Data Engineers, and Machine Learning Engineers.

Nice to Have 😉

• Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs).

• Knowledge of AI agents and agentic systems.

• Familiarity with MLOps practices and tools.

• Experience deploying and maintaining Data Science and AI solutions in production environments.

• Knowledge of job orchestration, computing infrastructure, deployments, monitoring, and maintenance.

postings.descriptionText:
PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH
Location: Remote, Latin America (LATAM)
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time
Openings: 2
Industry: Real Estate Finance / Private Lending
Compensation: $1,700 to $2,300 USD/month
Experience: 1.5+ years at a U.S. hard money or private real estate lender
Schedule: Monday to Friday | 8:45 AM to 5:45 PM U.S. Eastern Time (ET)
English Proficiency: Advanced written and spoken English required
Start Date: As soon as possible (early November 2026)

About the Company
Our client is a U.S.-based private real estate lender that provides short-term, business-purpose loans to real estate investors.
The company finances Fix & Flip, Bridge, DSCR rental and Ground-Up Construction projects, working closely with borrowers, brokers, originators and capital partners to deliver fast, reliable funding.
As its loan volume grows, the company is building out its remote operations team to keep every loan file accurate, complete and moving on time.

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Loan Processor & Underwriter to own underwriting, loan file completeness and follow-up on every file through the satisfaction of underwriting conditions.
You will analyze borrower, property and deal risk, collect and verify documentation, manage appraisals, and keep borrowers, brokers and originators informed until each loan is ready to close.
This is not a data entry or conventional mortgage processing role. We are looking for someone with real underwriting and processing experience at a hard money or private lender, who brings strong judgment, persistence and excellent borrower service.

What You'll Do

Underwriting

• Underwrite business-purpose Fix & Flip, Bridge, DSCR and Ground-Up Construction loans.

• Analyze credit, borrower experience, liquidity, LTV/LTC, as-is value, ARV, DSCR, construction budgets and exit strategy.

• Approve loans within delegated guidelines and escalate exceptions.

Loan File Management

• Collect, verify and organize borrower, guarantor, entity and property documents.

• Maintain accurate conditions and loan files in the company's loan portal and CRM.

Appraisal Review

• Order, track and review appraisals, including comparable sales and values.

• Work with the appraisal management company on corrections or reconsiderations.

• Promptly advise the originator of any material changes in value or risk.

Follow-Up & Communication

• Proactively follow up with borrowers, brokers, originators and vendors until all outstanding documents and conditions are resolved.

• Respond promptly and deliver outstanding service to borrowers, brokers and partners.

Closing Support

• Coordinate with the closer on underwriting-related items through funding.

• Correct any underwriting deficiencies identified after closing.

Qualifications

Required

• At least 1.5 years of hands-on experience at a U.S. hard money or private real estate lender, originating or servicing business-purpose investment property loans (Fix & Flip, Bridge, DSCR and/or Ground-Up Construction).

• Practical underwriting and loan processing experience at a comparable lender.

• Advanced written and spoken English.

• High attention to detail and strong analytical skills.

• Ability to work in Gmail, GoHighLevel (GHL) or a similar CRM, and an online loan portal for documents, files and workflow.

• Hardworking, dependable, proactive and accountable. You take ownership and follow up without reminders.

• Comfortable in a fast-paced lending business, handling urgent requests and meeting deadlines without compromising accuracy or controls.

• Availability to work 8:45 AM to 5:45 PM U.S. Eastern Time.

Please note: conventional consumer mortgage experience alone (FHA, VA, Fannie Mae or Freddie Mac loans) does not meet the experience requirement.

How Success Is Measured

• Loan files are complete, accurate and organized at every stage.

• Underwriting decisions are well supported and stay within guidelines.

• Outstanding conditions are cleared quickly, with minimal reminders.

• Appraisal issues and material changes are flagged early.

• Borrowers, brokers and originators receive timely, professional updates.

Why Join Us?

•
Fully Remote Opportunity: Work from anywhere in Latin America with a U.S.-based lender.

•
Competitive Compensation: Earn $1,700 to $2,300 USD per month.

•
Meaningful Responsibility: Own loan files from underwriting through clear to close.

•
Professional Growth: Deepen your experience in U.S. private real estate lending.

Important Notes

• Candidates must reside in Latin America.

• Direct experience at a U.S. hard money or private real estate lender is required.

• Availability to work U.S. Eastern Time business hours is required.

• Excellent English communication skills are essential.

• Please submit your CV in English and include the lender(s) you worked for, your dates of employment and the loan types you handled.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
This role is part of our ScraperAPI team, one of our growing brands at saas.group .
ScraperAPI is an enterprise-scale web scraping solution, trusted by businesses across a wide range of industries to extract crucial data at scale. From e-commerce, travel to real estate and market research, we support companies in turning the web into actionable insights. We're currently on an exciting growth journey, scaling rapidly as demand for reliable, high-performance web scraping and data keeps rising.

Profile Overview
This is the hard end of web scraping. The sites we rely on, Google, Amazon, Walmart and many others, actively work to block us, and they change the rules without warning. We're looking for a senior engineer who can go deep on why we're being blocked, work out how the detection actually functions, and design repeatable ways around it. You'll be joining a self-driven, high-autonomy team to take on our most involved problems, with the room and the trust to build something from close to a blank page: an environment that turns one-off breakthroughs into a methodical, repeatable way of defeating anti-bot systems. If you like confronting problems that genuinely resist you, and you work methodically rather than by trial and error, this is an unusually open brief.

Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:

• Getting a full local environment running and becoming fluent in our systems and how they operate, in the first few weeks.

• Contributing to a proposal on the design for a repeatable environment we can pose anti-bot problems to and get reliable analysis out of.

• Building that environment out over the following months so that, by month six, we can point it at a target or provider and have it reliably tell us how we're being blocked and what is and isn't being used against us.

Your responsibilities

• Analyse how specific anti-bot and bot-mitigation systems (the likes of DataDome, Cloudflare Turnstile, Kasada, PerimeterX and Akamai) detect and block us, and design systems to work around them.

• Turn isolated breakthroughs into durable, repeatable processes: hypothesis, test, discard what's wrong, move on.

• In collaboration with other senior team members, design and build a greenfield agentic environment that can propose and run tests on anti-bot behaviour and bypass approaches, and do it in a way that's well understood and repeatable.

• Work largely independently on deep, concentrated problems, while actively pulling in knowledge from across the wider engineering team.

• Communicate clearly what you plan to do, and step into major incidents when the team needs your depth.

What you bring to the table

• Deep, genuine understanding of how the internet works underneath: HTTP, TLS and fingerprinting, proxies, headers, cookies, and browser behaviour. This is the core of the role and it isn't something we can shortcut.

• Excellent problem-solving built on a scientific, methodical approach: you form a hypothesis, design a test, read the result honestly, and iterate. Trying things at random is the opposite of what this role needs.

• Strong hands-on skills in our stack, Node.js and TypeScript with solid Python, and comfort across backend systems at scale (Postgres, Redis/Valkey, MongoDB, Puppeteer/Camoufox, Kubernetes).

• Real skill at directing AI coding agents with precision, and the judgement to tell strong output from weak. The specific tool doesn't matter (Claude, Codex or similar); knowing how to steer it well is what counts.

• A background that has given you this kind of depth and rigour. That might be scraping, anti-bot or web-security work, reverse engineering, or a research or academic path where you built your own tooling and lived by the scientific method. Direct scraping experience is a strong plus rather than a strict requirement.

• Independence and strong communication: you're comfortable owning hard problems in a remote-first team with little hand-holding, and you keep the team in the loop on your thinking as you go.

What's in it for you

• Ultimate flexibility: We're 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.

• Freedom and autonomy: We're a high-trust team, and you'll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way, with plenty of help from the team when you need it.

• Minimum bureaucracy: We don't like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.

• Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.

• Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally.

• Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.

ScraperAPI is part of saas.group and we have a shared goal of succeeding together.

What is saas.group ?
Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group , established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 400 colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.
We don't just simply offer you to "take a job with us" but rather to "join us on this journey" to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.
Sounds like something you're up for? Feel free to apply even if you don't check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!

—

saas.group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply.

We believe in fair and transparent pay. Salary ranges at saas.group are location-adjusted, targeting local market medians for a remote-first environment, and will be shared with our potential future employees in writing before your first interview - so you have everything you need to evaluate the opportunity.

postings.title: Senior Voice Routing Manager
postings.descriptionText:
The Challenge
We connect over 500’000 callers in 190 countries: that represents 36,000 calling corridors and over 100 million calling minutes. We work with various global suppliers optimising for call quality. It’s complex. Each calling corridor has its own quality quirks and legal and regulatory rules to work within. We want someone to own call quality and routing holistically across all of it: routing daily to optimize what's happening right now, while watching the data for the long-term trends that tell us where to fix things next.
A failed call is not a metric to us. It's someone not hearing their mother's voice or its an important business call that fails. We also have real ambitions to scale calling well beyond where we are today, so this complexity isn't going anywhere. It's only going to grow.
Talk360 has been profitable since 2025, expanding beyond our core calling app into embedded, B2B2C calling for partners. We are lean, around 30 people globally, spread across the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine, and beyond. That means this role has real scope from day one: no layers between you and the decisions that matter, and no shortage of things worth tackling.

What You'll Do

• Own call quality holistically : hold the full picture of call quality end to end, working with the team on both the daily grind and the long-term view, moving fluidly between quick fixes and structured experiments.

• Manage zones, codes, and origins : own and continuously refine our zone, dialing code, and call origin management, keeping the underlying structure clean and accurate across all 900 zones.

• Update routing continuously : change routing several times a day, from immediate fixes to longer-running tests of new suppliers.

• Work cross-functionally by design : partner daily with Ozcan, who owns supplier account management and deal creation, and Mahmoud, who runs hourly monitoring and support-team escalations to suppliers. Work with Ewan on automating the processes behind routing, and with Product and CRM to improve the experience for our end users.

• Move routing toward automation : work toward (semi) automated routing and pricing, reducing how much of this still runs on manual, single-person work.

Requirements

What You'll Bring

• Hands-on experience with international A-Z calling and telco routing: zones, codes, LCR, and SIP response codes, built at a telco, carrier, or comms platform with real cross-border calling experience.

• NOC or technical support background: comfortable troubleshooting live voice traffic and reading call detail records and quality metrics like ASR and ACD.

• Exposure to a routing/testing platform such as iTest or an equivalent tool. Familiarity with Digitalk Cloud Carrier (DCC), our current routing platform, is a plus.

• Nice to have: working technical literacy in SIP signalling and SBC concepts

Who You Are

• Process driven and meticulous: you build the audit trail as you go, not after something goes wrong. You are methodical and analytical by nature, and you would rather have a clean, repeatable process than a clever one-off fix.

• Hands-on: you do the routing work yourself, day to day, not just direct others to do it.

• A strong communicator: equally at ease explaining a routing issue to Product or Marketing as debating a fix with a supplier's NOC team.

• Ownership without a script: you see a bottleneck and you fix it rather than wait to be asked.

• Genuinely commercial: you understand a dropped call or a bad route costs Talk360 real money and a real user's trust, not just an SLA breach.

Recruitment Process

•
Recruiter screening

•
Hiring manager screening with COO

•
Technical interview

•
Case study

•
Final interview. with CEO

What you get

Learning and growth

• €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving.

Time to recharge

•
25 vacation days

• Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs

• Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we'll tell you more during the interview)

Work from anywhere

• As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas.

A team you'll actually want to be part of

•
Weekly team lunch every Thursday

•
Regular team moments and outings

• An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond

Set up for success

• Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work

• Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance

An environment to grow and make impact

• A collaborative environment where you can learn from others, take ownership, and contribute to a meaningful mission

About Talk360

Talk360 was founded with a clear purpose: to become the most accessible and reliable calling app for African diaspora communities, both within Africa and abroad. For our users, calls are not transactional, they are emotional lifelines to family, friends, and essential support networks. When service quality drops, they feel it immediately. That responsibility drives everything we build.
Over the past years, Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide last year. We successfully spun off our payments arm into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by the discontinuation of Skype, and achieved profitable growth from 2025 onwards, marking our transition from early-stage scale-up to a disciplined, sustainable business.
As we continue to grow, we are expanding beyond our own B2C app. We are now launching our first embedded calling products within partner platforms, bringing Talk360 ’s technology into new ecosystems and enabling partners to offer international calling directly within their own products.
Our ambition is bold: to become the world’s most trusted way to call any real phone number — connecting migrants, travellers, professionals, and businesses across the globe.

Here’s what our users say:
“I like Talk360 because it saves me a lot of money. I used to call from Zimbabwe for 15 rands a minute. Talk360 came to the rescue. Now I can call my mother for hours.” — Google Play, South Africa ★★★★★
“ Talk360 is a simple and reliable app for cheap international calls. It works even if the receiver has no internet, offers good call quality, and has transparent pricing.” — Google Play, United States ★★★★★
“It is a flawless experience with no hustles at all and the tariffs are more than just fair.” — Trustpilot, United Kingdom ★★★★★

Perena is a decentralized financial protocol on Solana that offers USD STAR (USD*), a yield-bearing asset. Its value grows automatically, making it a simple, secure way to save on-chain.
USD* is fully collateralized by a diversified portfolio of yield-generating assets and positions, including:
Delta-neutral hedged positions on centralized and decentralized exchanges (e.g., BTC, ETH, SOL)
Secured borrow-lend market positions involving on-chain stablecoins
Real-world assets , such as the reinsurance fund by OnRe
Perena actively manages asset allocation and diversifies across multiple strategies to reduce single points of failure and optimize for sustainable, consistent yield performance.
Built on Solana’s high-performance blockchain, Perena is creating a liquid, yield-bearing digital dollar that anyone can access with a sustainable, risk-managed approach.
Looking ahead, Perena is building a full suite of on-chain stablebanking products to expand access to real yield across crypto and traditional finance. The goal is a sustainable financial experience for anyone to transact, save, and invest on-chain.
Perena is founded by a team of builders from the Solana ecosystem with backgrounds in TradFi and DeFi. We believe deeply in pushing financial architecture forward — and in doing it with transparency, resilience, and speed.

• Solana co-founders Anatoly Yakovenko and Raj Gokal

• Investors from Citadel, Jane Street, IMC, and Susquehanna

• Borderless Capital, Binance Labs, Primitive Ventures, Maelstrom, Anagram, Breed, and others

Perena was a sponsor of the Colosseum Hackathon Stablecoin Track , helping fund the next generation of stablecoin projects on Solana. Our growing community spans over 20,000 developers, users, and builders aligned around one goal: reinventing how money works.

What You’ll do

• Turn ambiguous product ideas into well-designed, production-ready systems. This person should be able to challenge requirements, make sound architectural decisions, write the technical plan, and deliver quickly with limited supervision.

• Design flow-of-funds orchestration across venues and chains — bridging, routing, rebalancing between custodial and non-custodial systems — with reliable settlement, reconciliation, and failure handling as first-class concerns

• Develop custody and key management patterns that meet institutional-grade security requirements across custodial and non-custodial environments

• Build on-chain settlement and payment flows, including integrations with DEXs, lending markets, custodians, and bridge infrastructure — starting on Solana (Rust) and extending across EVM and other chains as we scale

• Build and maintain the systems that move Perena 's money: minting/redeeming USD*, allocating collateral, and routing capital between on-chain protocols, centralized custodians/exchanges, and partner bank rails

What We’re Looking ForDefining characteristics

• 3+ years building financial systems where correctness and settlement guarantees are non-negotiable — payment rails, custody/settlement infrastructure, or trading systems

• Built and shipped a DeFi, fintech, trading, or infrastructure product in a small team.

• Has owned meaningful systems from design through production.

• Strong smart-contract and backend/infrastructure fundamentals.

• Experience with EVM; Solana experience is valuable.

• Understands vaults, asset management, yield products, or onchain financial primitives.

• Familiar with institutional concerns such as custody, permissions, compliance integrations, accounting, and operational controls.

• Ideally a former founder or early engineer—even if the company or protocol ultimately failed.

• Constructively challenging: Pushes back when requirements are unclear, risky, or cannot meet a proposed timeframe.

• Clear communicator: Produces concise technical specifications before significant implementation

Earlier in your career? Apply anyway if you can show real campaign ownership, sharp writing, and a clear point of view on the market.

Stablecoins are transforming how the world stores, moves, and grows value — and we’re still early. This is a once-in-a-generation shift: from legacy money to programmable, accessible, internet-native finance. Building here isn’t just technically interesting — it’s globally meaningful.

We treat our work as craft — thoughtful, opinionated, and precise.Many of us come from design, art, or cultural backgrounds.

Concierge Manager | Remote | Luxury Travel Leadership

About Ascend
Ascend helps founders, investors, and executives book international business and first-class flights at rates that are typically 30-80% below what you would find on a regular booking site. We combine smart, proprietary booking methods with round-the-clock personal service delivered over WhatsApp.
We have grown from 12 to 60+ people in just over a year, backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, and 5x'd our revenue year-over-year. We are at $22M+ ARR and growing fast. Our mission is to make first-class travel accessible to the people who are shaping the world.
Our clients are founders, investors, and senior executives who expect fast, accurate, and polished service. They do not chase confirmations. They trust us to get it right every time.

The Role
We are looking for an experienced luxury service leader who wants to build world-class operations and grow their impact at a fast-moving company.
As Concierge Manager, you own shift-level operations across three core functions: Client Service, Ticketing, Trip Fulfillment. You lead Team Leads who manage specialists across each function. You are responsible for making sure every client receives a five-star experience, every shift runs smoothly, and every team member is growing under your leadership.
This is a role for someone who thinks in systems but leads with people. Process without empathy is just bureaucracy. You bring both.

What You'll Do

Lead and Develop Your Team

• Manage 3 Team Leads across Client Service, Ticketing and Trip Fulfillment,

• Coach Team Leads daily with direct, specific feedback that builds their judgment and confidence as leaders

• Build a shift culture where ownership, accuracy, and client empathy are the baseline, not the exception

• Conduct regular performance reviews that give team members clarity on where they stand and what comes next

Own Shift Operations

• Direct all client-facing operations during your shift with real-time decisions and clear priorities

• Allocate team resources, manage escalations from Team Leads, and resolve complex situations before they reach the client

• Ensure clean, complete handovers between shifts so the incoming manager has everything they need

• Maintain 95%+ SLA adherence and 98%+ data accuracy through effective team management and systems

Deliver Exceptional Client Experiences

• Own the end-to-end client experience for your shift: every request, every quote, every booking, and every follow-up

• Personally handle VIP clients and high-complexity situations that require senior judgment

• Ensure clients receive proactive updates, creative solutions, and service that consistently exceeds their expectations

• Turn service recovery moments into opportunities to deepen client relationships

Drive Process Excellence

• Submit at least two documented process improvements per month that increase efficiency or quality for the team

• Spot patterns across client feedback, system performance, and team errors, and address them systematically rather than reactively

• Partner with the Process Management team and other functions to streamline workflows across the operation

• Use data to make decisions, validate improvements, and demonstrate impact

Collaborate Across Ascend

• Work closely with Product, Operations, and Leadership to implement new systems and maintain consistency as we scale

• Represent the voice of both your clients and your team in strategic conversations

• Contribute insights that shape how Ascend grows globally while maintaining the quality standard clients expect

What You Bring

Must Have

• 4+ years in luxury travel, hospitality, or high-touch service operations. Apply even if you do not have every year listed but are confident in your skillset

• 2+ years in a leadership or management role where you coached and developed a team, not just managed tasks and deadlines

• Strong Sabre GDS proficiency: you are comfortable with fare rules, complex routing, and ticketing at a level that lets you support and QA your team's work

• A data-driven approach to leadership: you use metrics to spot trends, validate changes, and hold the team to clear standards

• Excellent written and verbal communication: you can coach with clarity, write polished client messages, and present confidently to leadership

• Composure under pressure: when everything is happening at once, you are the calm and steady presence the team needs

Nice to Have

• Experience with international business class or first-class bookings, or award travel programs

• Familiarity with tools like Asana, Periskope, Stripe, or similar workflow and CRM platforms

• A track record of building or improving operational processes, SOPs, or training programs

• Experience managing remote, global teams across time zones

• Background in luxury hospitality brands such as premium hotels or high-end concierge services

You do not need to check every box. If you have 80% of the skills and the drive to learn, we want to hear from you.

What Makes You Stand Out
We are especially interested in candidates who:

• Have turned around an underperforming team or operation and can speak to the specific changes they made and the results they drove

• Are known as the manager people want to work for because they genuinely develop the people around them

• Have a reputation for spotting problems early and solving them before they reach the client

• Think in systems but are not rigid: you improve processes without losing the human element that makes a service feel premium

• Are comfortable being hands-on when the situation calls for it while consistently pushing ownership down to the team

Why Ascend

Clear Growth Path
The progression here is: Concierge Manager to Senior Concierge Manager to Associate Director to Director. We promote from within based on demonstrated performance and impact, not politics or tenure.

Build, Don't Just Maintain
We are implementing our concierge framework and career systems right now. You are not inheriting a rigid legacy structure. You are helping build how Ascend's operations scale globally. Your insights will have a direct and visible effect on how we work.

Real Support

• We hire proficient people: you will not be carrying underperformers

• Regular performance reviews with clear metrics and honest feedback

• A Head of People who understands operations and partners with you

• A Process Management team dedicated to making your job easier

Work-Life Balance

• Predictable scheduling: you will know your shift in advance

• Structured handovers so the incoming manager receives everything they need without you staying late

• A global team with talented colleagues across continents

• Merit-based performance incentives

Learn While You Lead

• Advanced travel optimization strategies used by elite professionals in the industry

• How to lead global teams using shared metrics and real-time decision-making

• Cross-functional collaboration with Product, Engineering, and Operations

• Operational leadership at a venture-backed company growing 5x year-over-year

What Success Looks Like
First 90 days: You have learned our core systems and tools, including Sabre, Asana, and our booking platforms. You are leading shifts independently with 95%+ SLA adherence. You are coaching your Team Leads with specific, useful feedback and you have identified your first improvement opportunity.
Within 6-12 months: You are consistently delivering 95%+ SLA and 98%+ accuracy. Your team sentiment scores are at 8/10 or above. You have led at least one initiative that measurably improved client satisfaction or team efficiency. Your Team Leads are stronger leaders because of your coaching.

Our Values

• Customer Obsession: We win when our customers win

• Urgency with Impact: Clients expect answers in minutes, not hours

• Radical Candor: Honest, direct, respectful feedback builds trust

• Ownership: If something breaks, we fix it

• Relentless Excellence: Good enough is never enough

Should You Apply?
If you are thinking that you may not have all the experience listed, apply anyway. We are looking for people with 80% of the skills and 100% of the drive to learn. What we care about most:

• Have you led teams or operations in a high-touch service environment?

• Do you have a track record of meeting or exceeding operational targets?

• Can you coach, give feedback, and genuinely develop other people?

• Are you excited about building something excellent rather than maintaining something average?

If the answer to these questions is yes, we want to hear from you.

Why You'll Love This Role

This is perfect for someone who:

• Wants to work directly with founders, investors, and global business leaders

• Sees themselves at Ascend for years, building toward senior leadership

• Takes genuine pride in building something excellent and watching their team grow

• Values both high performance and sustainable, respectful working practices

• Wants to lead a high-performing team that holds itself to a standard most operations never reach

Ascend is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.
Engagement Structure, Compensation, Shifts, and Benefits
Ascend is a remote-first, global team. This role is structured as a direct independent contractor engagement, with compensation being stated in USD and be paid in your local currency
As this is an independent contractor engagement, the compensation will not follow a traditional local payroll structure or salary breakup. This means statutory deductions or components or other local payroll-linked benefits are not applicable unless specifically required under the terms of engagement or communicated in writing by Ascend. Contractors are responsible for managing any applicable taxes, filings, and compliance requirements in their own location.
This role is part of Ascend's 24/7 client service operations and involves rotating shifts to support clients across different time zones. This may include overnight shifts, weekends, or public holidays depending on business and team scheduling needs. Weekly offs and shift schedules are planned in advance wherever possible and managed fairly across the team.
The consolidated monthly compensation is designed to account for the nature of the role, including rotating shifts and operational coverage requirements. Separate allowances for night shifts, weekends, holidays, overtime, or additional hours are not applicable unless specifically communicated otherwise for a particular role.
At this stage, Ascend does not provide medical insurance, mediclaim, or similar statutory benefits for this role. Further details on leaves, schedules, contractor terms, and applicable policies will be shared during the offer and onboarding process.
Ascend values work-life balance and aims to distribute schedules thoughtfully. At the same time, because this is a client-facing operational role, some flexibility and responsiveness may be required from time to time.

IOMETE is the sovereign data platform for the AI era. Enterprises run our data lakehouse, built on Apache Spark and Apache Iceberg, in their own trusted environment: on-premises, in their own cloud, or hybrid. It is built for regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare and government. Customer data never leaves the customer's trust perimeter, and the AI we build on it stays inside that perimeter too.

Position overview
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated AI Software Engineer to join our team. We tackle a variety of exciting challenges, from connecting AI tools and models to the lakehouse to diagnosing Spark applications and troubleshooting failures. You'll build agents that run inside the customer's environment, on LLMs the customer provides or, later, on custom models we train for Spark tuning and troubleshooting. You'll also build the framework that defines those agents and the harness that runs, limits, traces and evaluates them.

The AI team
We are building the AI platform for the lakehouse — Lakehouse Intelligence. The team's roadmap includes, but is not limited to, the MCP Server for AI Agents, which lets AI tools query the lakehouse; the Model Gateway, through which IOMETE 's AI features call models; agents for Spark application diagnosis, troubleshooting and onboarding; and SQL AI Functions, which run language models from inside a query. Down the road, you'll also get to fine-tune and build custom models for our platform's specific needs, small enough to run inside a customer's deployment.

What you'll do

• Contribute to and maintain IOMETE 's AI services, including the MCP Server for AI Agents, the Model Gateway, SQL AI Functions, and lakehouse-specific agents (such as Spark Application Diagnosis) and their harness.

• Build AI enablers: extend the IOMETE lakehouse and platform to support more AI-powered features, for example by making Spark job logs, query history and table metadata available to them.

• Be hands-on with Kubernetes, including the Helm charts that ship our AI services into each customer's deployment.

• Collaborate closely with external customer engineering teams to support integrations, troubleshoot complex issues and provide guidance for successful adoption of our platform.

• Participate in design discussions about agents, model access, evaluation, and overall systems architecture.

• Write the tests, docs and release notes for what you build. A feature is done when it has shipped with all of them.

• Review your teammates' work and provide feedback.

What we're looking for

• 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering (we’re open to exceptional candidates with less experience who demonstrate deep systems knowledge and impact).

• Deep understanding of LLM-based systems in production – tool calling, structured output, retrieval, evaluation, and how they fail.

• Our AI features are written mostly in Python and Go. The data platform is built on the JVM, in Kotlin and Java, and new platform features are being built in Go. Production experience with any of these languages is a big plus, but we know strong engineers learn a new language fast.

• Familiarity with distributed systems and their challenges (e.g., data consistency, fault tolerance, scheduling).

• Fluency in English, both written and verbal — this role involves working with international customers and partners.

• Based in a time zone that overlaps Amsterdam working hours (CET/CEST).

Preferred qualifications

About The Role
**We are currently recruiting for this role in Argentina and Brazil only. We will not be considering US based candidates at this time. All interviews are being held remotely. If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.**
**Only applications/resumes written in English will be accepted.**
Niche 's product teams make dozens of decisions each quarter about what to build. We are looking for an analytically rigorous, product-minded Senior Product Analyst to help Niche decide what to build and know whether it worked. This is a senior individual contributor role on the Analytics team, embedded with our product teams and reporting to the Director of Product Analytics.
You will own how we measure key product areas across our family-facing and school-facing experiences, such as rankings, scholarships, registration, and new products. You will be a strategic partner to product leadership, not a request queue. That means shaping questions before work starts, running the experiments that answer them, and staying with the work through the decision.
Our analytics team works Claude-first: you will use Claude and Claude Code every day and help shape how the team and its partners use them.

What You Will Do

Product Strategy & Insight

• Embed with product teams as their analytics partner. Join planning and roadmap conversations and help identify and size opportunities before work is prioritized

• Define the metrics that matter for each product area and keep definitions consistent across dashboards and the semantic layer

• Own the measurement of product funnels, feature adoption, engagement, and retention for both families and school partners

• Run deep-dive analyses on user behavior and segments, and pair every finding with a recommendation and a clear next step

• Identify where users struggle or drop off and bring those opportunities to product managers proactively. Partner with Design and UX Research to pair behavioral data with qualitative insight

Experimentation

• Own A/B tests with product teams end to end: design and sizing based on product requirements, guardrails and duration, tracking setup in GTM and GA4, and interpreting results with honest calls on signal versus noise

• Contribute to experimentation standards and apply them across your teams so tests are tied to business outcomes, not just clicks

• Measure launches that can't be randomized, using appropriate causal methods and clear statements of confidence

Measurement Partnership

• Write clear measurement requirements and GA4 event specs for new features before launch, build and test the GTM tags, and partner with Data Engineering on server-side and pipeline needs

• QA product data after launch, review GTM changes from partner teams, account for consent and tracking gaps, and flag quality issues early

• Build and maintain the dashboards and self-serve views (Streamlit) that let product managers answer their own recurring questions.

• Contribute to dbt models and the self-serve semantic layer with Data Engineering

• Support new data systems and tracking changes, such as consent management, with reporting requirements, GA4 reconciliation, and launch measurement

Claude-Powered Analytics

• Use Claude and Claude Code as core daily tools: writing and reviewing SQL, exploring data, drafting readouts, and building Streamlit apps

• Build and maintain the semantic layer, Claude skills, and context (metric definitions, table guides, experiment standards) that make Claude reliable on Niche 's data

• Automate recurring work, such as test readouts, KPI monitoring, and launch reviews, with Claude-driven workflows

• Keep pace with AI-assisted product development by using Claude to spot launches that need measurement

• Help product managers self-serve with Claude: maintain the skills and sanctioned definitions they rely on, coach them on reading data, and review findings before they drive decisions

• Help analysts and product partners adopt Claude, and help define the team's standards for validating its output

Analytical Rigor & Influence

• Model rigor in product data: reproducible SQL, documented methods, validated results, and a clear line between correlation and causation

• Hold AI-assisted work to the same bar as your own: check the queries, numbers, and logic before anything ships

• Mentor analysts informally, and review and pressure-test analyses from the team and from product partners, including AI-assisted work

• Present findings to product and company leadership with a clear "so what"

During the First Month:

• Meet stakeholders across Product, Analytics, and Data Engineering to learn team goals, roadmaps, and workflows

• Get set up with Claude, Claude Code, and the team's existing skills. Learn our stack (Snowflake, dbt, Streamlit, GA4 data) and how product events are defined and captured

• Review existing product dashboards and reports to build a baseline view of core product KPIs

Within 3 Months:

• Act as analytics partner to your assigned product teams, including defining metrics and reading out launches and tests

• Write measurement requirements for upcoming launches with Data Engineering

• Learn the boundaries and collaborations between Product Analytics and Data Engineering so ownership of shared data is clear

Within 6 Months:

• Apply and help evolve experimentation standards across your teams

• Become the go-to expert on product behavior data, presenting findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams

• Ship at least one self-directed deep dive that influences a product decision, and build or improve one Claude skill or workflow the team reuses

Within 12 Months:

• Use deep product and user knowledge to inform roadmap prioritization

• Build a scalable measurement framework for your product areas that helps teams make data-informed decisions on their own

• Contribute to the Analytics roadmap with new methods, tools, or process improvements

What We Are Looking For

Experience

• 5+ years in product analytics, data analytics, or a closely related data role

• Demonstrated experience designing and analyzing A/B tests and owning product measurement end to end

• Hands-on experience analyzing web or app behavioral data (GA4, GTM, PostHog, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar), including its limitations

• Hands-on experience using Claude, Claude Code, or similar AI tools in analytics work, with examples of workflows you built or automated

• Track record of influencing product decisions and roadmaps with data

• Proven ability to turn complex findings into clear recommendations for non-technical partners, and to say plainly when the data won't support the question

• Experience in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with shifting priorities

Skills

• Senior SQL proficiency; comfortable writing, reviewing, and debugging complex queries independently

• Strong grounding in statistics and experimentation, with Python or R for analysis

• Experience with Snowflake, dbt, and version-controlled analytics work

• Strong dashboarding skills in Streamlit, Looker, or similar

• Fluency with Claude or similar AI tools: prompting well, giving models the right context, and checking every query and number they produce

• Comfort operating as a senior IC: influencing without authority and working self-directed on ambiguous problems

Education

• Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. A Master's degree is a plus

Nice to Have

• Experience building Claude skills, MCP connectors, or agent workflows for a team

• Understanding of K-12 or college admissions processes

• Experience with causal inference methods beyond A/B tests

• Experience contributing to a semantic layer or self-serve metrics layer

• Background in marketplace, consumer internet, SaaS, or education technology

Interview Process
Candidate experience is a top priority for our talent and hiring teams. We believe in providing a transparent, authentic and comprehensive interview process where you have the opportunity to learn about us while we get to know you and your experience. The interview process is outlined here:

• Video Interview with Talent Acquisition Partner - 30 Minutes

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at .

The Opportunity 🚀

Carrot is looking for a Director, Information Security to lead the security program that protects the highly sensitive fertility and family-building data of members around the world. You will set the security strategy, own both corporate security (GRC, incident response, security awareness, vendor risk) and product security (application, cloud and infrastructure security, secure development lifecycle), and serve as the trusted voice on Carrot's security posture with executives, auditors, and enterprise customers.
Day to day, you will balance setting direction with staying close to the work: prioritizing risk with Engineering and IT, guiding audit and certification cycles, coaching a small and talented team, and joining customer conversations where security is part of the buying decision. Carrot has already earned SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, HITRUST, and PCI DSS compliance, so this role is about taking a strong foundation to the next level of maturity, not starting from scratch.
What makes this role different is the combination of stakes and influence. Few security leaders get to protect data this personal, at global scale, while working directly with executive leadership and shaping how a health platform is built, sold, and trusted.

What You’ll Own 💼

In this role, you will:

• Lead Carrot's security strategy and roadmap, using a recognized maturity model (such as C2M2 or NIST CSF) to prioritize investments and report progress to executive leadership

• Own the full security program across corporate security (GRC, incident management, security awareness, third-party risk) and product security (application security, cloud and infrastructure security, secure SDLC)

• Partner with Engineering, especially the Internal Platform team, to build security into how Carrot designs, ships, and operates its systems, going beyond compliance

• Lead internal risk assessments across application, cloud, and corporate environments and turn the results into prioritized technical safeguards

• Own the compliance portfolio, including SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST, PCI DSS, and HIPAA, and prepare Carrot for additional frameworks such as ISO 27001 as the business requires

• Direct incident response readiness, including playbooks, tabletop exercises, executive communication, and post-incident learning

• Represent Carrot's security posture to employers, health plans, and health systems through security reviews, questionnaires, and strategic sales conversations

• Work with Legal and Privacy to meet global data protection requirements (HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA/CPRA) for member health data

• Build, coach, and grow the security team, balancing hands-on execution with delegation as the team scales

• Manage the security budget, tooling, and vendor relationships, and tailor security guidance for a remote-first workforce and physical offices

What Success Looks Like 📈

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

• A documented, executive-endorsed security strategy and multi-year roadmap with clear priorities, owners, and measures of progress

• Clean outcomes on recurring audits and certifications (SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST, PCI DSS), with remediation items closed on schedule

• A tested incident response program, with regular tabletop exercises completed and lessons learned built back into the program

• A measurable reduction in high-risk vulnerabilities and open security findings, with remediation timelines agreed on with Engineering

• A living risk register and vendor security review process that leaders rely on to make decisions

• A security team with defined roles, clear growth paths, and the right capacity for Carrot's growth, including key hires made

• Faster, more consistent security reviews for Sales and Customer Success, with fewer escalations from enterprise customers

• A clear plan, and visible progress, on any additional frameworks the business prioritizes, such as ISO 27001

About You ✨

You likely have:

• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

• 10+ years of experience in technology, including 5+ years in information security and at least 3 years leading security teams

• A security certification such as CISSP or CISM

• Experience leading the security function at a late-stage startup, scale-up, or public company

• Working depth in healthcare data protection and privacy frameworks, including HIPAA, GDPR, and CCPA/CPRA

• Experience overseeing enterprise frameworks and audits such as SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST, PCI DSS, and ISO 27001

• Strong knowledge of application, network, and cloud security (AWS and Azure) and frameworks such as NIST CSF and OWASP

• Experience running core security programs, including incident response, risk management, vulnerability management, penetration testing, and security awareness

• Executive-level communication skills and confidence engaging customers and sales teams on security requirements

• Experience managing budget and allocating resources across people, tools, and vendors

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

• Experience leading security through a major company event such as an IPO, acquisition, or large-scale audit cycle

• A background in healthcare, digital health, or another highly regulated, high-trust environment

• Experience leading security in a remote-first, globally distributed company

• Familiarity with compliance automation platforms such as Drata

• Experience building a security engineering practice alongside platform and infrastructure teams

Why This Role Matters 🧡

Members trust Carrot with some of the most personal information a person can share, often during some of the most meaningful moments of their lives. Protecting that trust is not a back-office function. It is what allows employers, health plans, and health systems to bring Carrot to millions of people worldwide.
As Carrot grows, security leadership shapes how we build, how we sell, and how we show up for customers. In this role, you will make security a strength that members and customers can see and rely on, and build a team that keeps raising the bar as the business scales.

Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍
Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

• A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.

• A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.

• Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

• Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.

• Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.

• A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.

• The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation:
Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their lives inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $188,000.00 - $245,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.
Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to:

A Note on AI
At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.
For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.
