postings.title: Senior PRO/COA Strategy Consultant
postings.descriptionText:
The Senior PRO/COA Strategy Consultant supports a growing portfolio of development programs by contributing specialized patient-centered measurement expertise to broader asset evidence strategies. Several programs are in early development, where foundational decisions regarding concepts of interest, measurement strategy, instrument selection, and endpoint planning need to be established before study designs are finalized.
This person will supplement internal capacity and help ensure timely, technically rigorous PRO/COA support across early-stage, cross-functional, and co-development activities. Program-specific and confidential information will be shared only as appropriate following completion of applicable contracting and confidentiality requirements.

What You’ll Do

• Develop and maintain the PRO/COA components of asset evidence strategies in partnership with asset leads.

• Conduct disease, patient-experience, competitive, regulatory, and endpoint landscape reviews.

• Lead fit-for-purpose PRO/COA evidence-generation studies from concept through completion, including study design, protocol development, vendor oversight, scientific interpretation, and dissemination of findings

• Develop or refine conceptual models and identify and prioritize concepts of interest.

• Assess existing PRO/COA instruments for fitness for purpose and identify evidence gaps.

• Support endpoint strategy development and COA evidence-generation planning.

• Provide technical review and input for protocols, endpoint sections, statistical analysis plans, and related study documents.

• Prepare clear recommendations, decision-support materials, and documentation for cross-functional review.

• Participate as the PRO/COA subject matter expert in relevant internal and partner-facing working sessions, coordinated with the asset lead.

• Support vendor engagement and oversight for discrete COA evidence-generation activities, as needed.

The final assignment mix and priorities will be confirmed with the selected resource. The role is expected to be strategic and scientific, rather than primarily administrative or project-management focused.

What You’ll Need

• Advanced degree in a relevant field such as outcomes research, psychometrics, epidemiology, psychology, public health, or a related discipline.

• Approximately 8 or more years of relevant PRO/COA experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, consulting, or regulatory settings.

• Demonstrated experience developing PRO/COA strategies for clinical development programs, preferably including early development.

• Strong knowledge of patient-focused drug development, instrument selection, content validity, psychometric evidence, meaningful-change interpretation, and endpoint positioning.

• Experience reviewing clinical protocols, statistical analysis plans, and regulatory or evidence-planning documents.

• Ability to synthesize complex evidence and communicate clear recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and operate effectively in a matrixed and co-development environment.

• Experience in immunology, dermatology, gastroenterology, or neurology is desirable but not required.

Is accountable for their assigned clinical team members' understanding, ongoing compliance and delivery according to the stated monitoring strategy, CMP/SMP, and risk plans.

Provides status updates on the clinical deliverables and risks to clients, project management and leadership as per departmental or study agreements. Provides solutions for obstacles in protocol execution and site management.

postings.title: Healthcare Integration Architect
postings.descriptionText:
The Integration Architect is responsible for designing, developing and governing integrations between Affidea’s clinical and business applications, with a primary focus on healthcare interoperability and the Group’s central integration platform.
A key responsibility of the role is the technical ownership, development and continuous improvement of Affidea’s Central Mirth integration platform, which provides standardized integration capabilities between country-level and Group-level clinical systems.
The Integration Architect combines solution architecture with hands-on integration development. The role is expected not only to define integration designs and standards, but also to develop, configure, test, troubleshoot and optimize interfaces and integration components.
The role works closely with Group and Country IT teams, application owners, clinical IT teams, project teams and external vendors to ensure reliable, secure and scalable exchange of healthcare information between systems such as HIS, RIS, PACS, LIS and other clinical and operational platforms.
The Integration Architect also drives the standardization of healthcare integrations across Affidea, reducing unnecessary point-to-point integrations and establishing reusable integration services and patterns.

Healthcare Integration Architecture

• Design end-to-end integrations between healthcare applications including HIS, RIS, PACS, LIS and other clinical systems.

• Define integration architecture and data flows between local country systems and central Group platforms.

• Design and maintain integration solutions using healthcare interoperability standards including HL7 v2, FHIR and DICOM.

• Define standardized integration patterns for patient, appointment, order, result and other clinical information exchange.

• Analyze existing healthcare workflows and interfaces and propose improved or standardized integration solutions.

• Support the transition from country-specific and point-to-point interfaces towards reusable Group integration services.

• Produce and maintain integration architecture diagrams, interface specifications, message flows and technical documentation.

• Ensure appropriate consideration of patient safety, data integrity, availability and traceability when designing healthcare integrations.

Central Mirth Platform

• Take technical ownership of Affidea’s Central Mirth integration platform and its integration architecture.

• Configure and maintain Mirth source and destination connectors, transformers, filters and routing logic.

• Develop custom scripts and components where required to support complex integration requirements.

• Design reliable message processing including acknowledgement handling, retries, queues, error handling and message recovery.

• Monitor and optimize integration performance and message processing.

• Troubleshoot complex integration problems including connectivity, message format, transformation, routing and application-level issues.

• Analyze failed, delayed or duplicate messages and perform root-cause analysis.

• Define monitoring, alerting and logging requirements for the central integration platform.

• Support high availability, scalability and business continuity requirements of the Central Mirth environment.

• Establish development, testing and deployment standards for Mirth channels and integration components.

• Maintain appropriate version control and release management for integration developments.

Integration Development

• Develop and maintain interfaces, APIs, integration services, scripts and message transformations.

• Develop integration logic using technologies such as JavaScript, Java, C#, SQL or other relevant technologies.

• Work with XML, JSON, HL7 and other structured message formats.

• Develop database integration components and queries where required.

• Implement appropriate validation, error handling, logging and reconciliation mechanisms.

• Create reusable integration components and libraries to accelerate future integration development.

• Perform unit and integration testing of developed interfaces.

• Support UAT and production deployments.

• Investigate and resolve production integration incidents where development-level expertise is required.

Healthcare Interoperability

• Define and maintain Affidea standards for healthcare interoperability.

• Work extensively with HL7 v2 messages, including common ADT, ORM, ORU and SIU workflows.

• Design and support FHIR-based integrations where appropriate.

• Understand and support DICOM-related workflows and integration with medical imaging environments.

• Work with clinical and technical stakeholders to understand healthcare workflows and translate them into integration requirements.

• Ensure correct patient identification and appropriate handling of patient and clinical data across integrated systems.

• Support integration between scheduling, patient administration, clinical reporting and medical imaging systems.

• Work with vendors to understand and validate their healthcare integration capabilities and interface specifications.

API and Application Integration

• Design and develop integrations using REST APIs, web services, messaging and other integration technologies.

• Define standards for API-based communication and reusable integration services.

• Design synchronous and asynchronous integration patterns according to business and technical requirements.

• Support integration with cloud-based and on-premise applications.

• Define common approaches for authentication, authorization, error handling, retry mechanisms and API versioning.

• Work with external vendors to design and implement interfaces between vendor solutions and the Affidea environment.

Integration Monitoring & Operations

• Ensure integrations can be effectively monitored and supported in production.

• Define end-to-end monitoring and alerting for critical healthcare interfaces.

• Implement appropriate logging and technical traceability.

• Establish processes for identifying failed, delayed or duplicate messages.

• Support root-cause analysis of integration incidents.

• Work with support teams to establish appropriate operational procedures and escalation paths.

• Identify recurring incidents and implement permanent technical improvements rather than relying on manual operational workarounds.

• Continuously improve integration reliability, performance and maintainability.

Architecture & Technical Governance

• Act as the technical authority for healthcare integration solutions.

• Define and maintain Affidea integration architecture standards and development guidelines.

• Review integration designs proposed by internal teams and external vendors.

• Ensure new integrations follow agreed architecture and interoperability standards.

• Promote reusable integration components and standardized interfaces across Affidea countries.

• Reduce unnecessary direct system-to-system integrations where centralized or reusable integration services provide a more sustainable solution.

Projects & Stakeholder Management

Experience

postings.descriptionText:
WHY XOGENE?
At Xogene, we’re revolutionizing the future of clinical trial transparency through AI-powered solutions. Join our team of experts who are transforming how leading pharmaceutical and life sciences companies navigate regulatory compliance. If you're driven by solving complex problems in a professional environment focused on meaningful and rewarding work, we want to hear from you.

POSITION OVERVIEW
Xogene combines regulatory expertise with advanced technology to automate complex processes in clinical trial transparency. Our software streamlines workflows through AI and agentic networking capabilities, improving data transformation and regulatory compliance for leading pharmaceutical and life sciences companies. We're committed to advancing technological solutions in clinical trial transparency. 
As we continue to expand, we are seeking an experienced QA Tech Lead to drive our test automation initiatives and strengthen our testing strategy. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, the QA Tech Lead will own test automation strategy and execution.
This is a hands-on technical role: you will write and maintain automated tests while guiding the team's automation direction.

KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Lead and mentor automation engineers, provide technical guidance to the wider testing team, and foster a culture of quality excellence and continuous improvement.

• Support skill development across the team, including cross-training manual testers in automation (e.g., Playwright Codegen, low-code contributions, and AI-assisted scripting with tools such as Claude) and ensuring automation engineers understand product domain and end-user workflows.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Development, Customer Success, Product Management, Design and Product Support across multiple time zones.

• Define the overall risk-based test strategy, focusing testing effort where regulatory and customer risk is highest, with clear criteria for which tests are automated, which remain manual, and what doesn't need a test at all. Own automation test plans and standards across all Xogene product releases.

• Create and maintain quality metrics, KPIs, and dashboards on testing progress and potential blockers, and provide regular updates to the Director of Engineering.

• Define test scope, objectives, success criteria, and time and resource estimates with stakeholders, and ensure comprehensive coverage through effective test case design and review.

• Identify, assess, and mitigate quality risks throughout each sprint cycle, including during pre-release dry runs.

• Architect, build, and maintain scalable automation testing frameworks, including our custom-built Playwright framework, enforcing code standards, and maximizing test reusability through the Page Object Model (POM).

• Develop and execute automated test scenarios, scripts, and procedures for system, integration, regression, and API testing, growing automated test coverage across all Xogene software products.

• Act as the technical point of contact and subject matter expert on the code and system architecture, diagnosing complex technical problems and designing solutions that reflect lessons learned.

• Identify manual test cases suitable for automation and work with the Test Lead to prioritize and transition them.

• Move automated suites from manual triggers to a tiered CI/CD strategy in GitHub Actions (Smoke, Sanity, and Nightly Regression) that serves as quality gates for developers, and maintain suite health, including resolving flaky tests and tracking automation coverage.

• Oversee the integration between Playwright and Zephyr Scale, reporting test results directly into Zephyr Scale through automated JUnit XML reporting pipelines and maintaining a single source of truth for QA metrics.

We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.
This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What this role actually is
You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:

• Whether the response makes sense

• Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful

• Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment

• Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.

What you'll be doing

• Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end

• Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think

• Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code

• Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading

• Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste"
We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

• Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?

• Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?

• Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?

• Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.

Someone with the competitive mindset of an athlete, the discipline of an exceptional sales manager, and the humility to keep learning.

Now we're building a dedicated B2B SDR organization in Latin America calling on global companies to expand those relationships and open doors to more of the world's largest enterprises.

And you'll build it from the ground up.
There are currently no SDRs at PlanITROI. You'll recruit your team, establish the coaching culture, develop the playbook, and create the operating discipline that turns prospecting into qualified enterprise opportunities.

You'll have direct access to our executive leadership, the tools to manage the operation, and the opportunity to earn greater responsibility as your team succeeds.

What Makes This Different?

You get to build your SDR organization, recruit A-players, establish standards, and create a culture where people genuinely want to win together.

• Work directly with the founder.

You'll collaborate with PlanITROI's CEO, Chief Strategy Officer, and VP of Marketing. You'll have access to decision-makers without unnecessary layers of management slowing things down.

Your SDRs will prospect into companies with more than 10,000 employees, building relationships with IT and Procurement leaders. These are complex, consultative sales cycles that can last 12 months or longer.

We're digital-first and AI-driven. You'll use Salesforce, Apollo, AI tools, and sales intelligence technology to improve research, productivity, execution, and accountability.

Your Mission
Build and lead an elite B2B SDR organization that consistently creates qualified enterprise sales opportunities.

You'll be accountable for developing your people and delivering measurable results.

What You'll Own

Recruit, Build & Coach Your Team

• Recruit, select, hire, onboard, and develop elite SDR talent across Latin America.

• Build a high-performance culture around optimism, discipline, humility, teamwork, and accountability.

• Establish clear daily, weekly, monthly, and annual expectations.

Own Prospecting & Enterprise Pipeline Development

• Assign target accounts and contacts with clear individual ownership.

• Build strategies for engaging decision-makers at U.S. and global enterprises.

• Train SDRs to manage multichannel outreach across phone, email, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels.

• Coach persistence, relationship development, and professional follow-through across sales cycles lasting 12 months or longer.

• Improve qualified discovery meeting production and pipeline contribution.

Build the Systems That Drive Accountability

• Own Salesforce lead management, activity tracking, dashboards, data integrity, and follow-up accountability.

• Manage Apollo sequences, contact lists, campaigns, and outreach performance.

• Establish a practical SDR operating playbook during your first 30 days.

• Use reporting to identify coaching needs and improve team effectiveness.

• Introduce AI and automation where they measurably help SDRs perform better.

Partner Directly With Executive Leadership

• Work closely with the CEO, Chief Strategy Officer, and VP of Marketing on enterprise growth.

• Report on team activity, qualified meetings, pipeline contribution, and individual performance.

• Bring solutions, recommendations, and accountability to leadership discussions.

Who Will Excel Here?

You are a coach first and a manager second.
You genuinely enjoy watching other people succeed. You're energized by finding raw talent, developing skills, and creating high-performing teams.
You bring an athlete's approach to sales: preparation, practice, resilience, coachability, and the determination to keep improving. You believe success comes from consistent execution, especially when results take time.
You have five qualities that cannot be taught overnight:

•
Optimism: You bring positive energy and confidence to difficult challenges.

•
Discipline: You do what needs to be done, consistently.

•
Humility: You welcome feedback and never stop learning.

•
Accountability: You own your commitments and expect the same from your team.

•
Team-first mentality: Your greatest satisfaction comes from helping others win.

Required Experience
We're looking for a proven leader, not someone learning how to manage SDRs for the first time.

You must have:

• 5+ years directly leading B2B SDR/BDR teams of 10 or more, with references who can verify your results.

• Proven experience hiring, training, coaching, and managing remote SDR teams.

• A record of success prospecting into large U.S. enterprises with 10,000+ employees.

• Recent and strong B2B management and sales experience in IT hardware, technology services, or comparable industries selling to enterprise IT and Procurement personas.

• Experience developing opportunities in complex, consultative B2B sales cycles lasting 12 months or longer.

• Advanced hands-on expertise with Salesforce and Apollo, including reporting, dashboards, prospecting campaigns, sequences, and performance management.

• Proven ability to recruit and develop high-performing SDR talent.

• C1-level professional English communication, written and spoken.

A background in competitive athletics or a similar performance-driven environment is highly valued.

What Winning Looks Like
Your SDR organization has clear account ownership, disciplined follow-up, accurate CRM data, and measurable results. Your team is well-trained, confident, accountable, and improving every week. Leadership can see how prospecting activity translates into qualified meetings and enterprise pipeline. Most importantly, your SDRs are growing into better sales professionals because of your leadership.

Why PlanITROI?
PlanITROI has spent more than 25 years helping enterprise organizations extend the useful life of technology, maximize financial recovery, and give computing devices another productive life.

We're a founder-led, digital-first, AI-driven organization that believes in developing people, investing in technology, and rewarding performance with opportunity.
If you want to work where you can make decisions, build something you own, receive direct feedback, and see the results of your leadership, this may be the opportunity you've been looking for.

Ready to Build a Winning Team?
We're looking for the coach who can build an elite SDR organization from zero and take pride in every teammate they help succeed.

If that's you, let's talk.
Apply and tell us about the best SDR team you've ever built, how you developed your people, and what you'd do in your first 30 days at PlanITROI.

• Evaluation of motion capture output and developing compensatory algorithms and techniques to handle camera /vision failure modes.

• Build training and evaluation pipelines from camera and optical motion capture recordings. Use synthetic data where real data is insufficient.

Requirements

• Familiarity with the output representations of common pose models, such as keypoint sets and SMPL-family parameters.

• Experience with tools in markerless eco-system such as OpenCV, Sapiens, and SAM3D.

• Proficiency in Python. Working knowledge of C++ for integrating models into an existing C++ codebase.

Preferred

• Experience optimizing models for real-time deployment, for example with ONNX, TensorRT or quantization.

You will take ownership of our network-policy program — default-deny micro-segmentation across our Kubernetes clusters — and carry the rest of the pillar forward with it: identity-aware service-to-service transport, per-application private access, flow-level visibility, and network configuration managed as reviewed code.

• Contain: build the levers that let us isolate a workload or segment quickly when detection flags lateral movement, and take part in incident response when the network is in play.

What We Look For:

• 6+ years of experience in security, network, platform, or infrastructure engineering, with hands-on ownership of network controls in cloud production environments.

• Deep, practical Kubernetes networking knowledge: CNI, NetworkPolicy semantics, DNS, ingress/egress — and experience rolling segmentation out on live clusters without outages.

• Strong AWS networking: VPCs, subnets, security groups, peering and Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, load balancers, flow logs.

• Hands-on experience with mTLS and service-to-service authentication (service mesh, proxies, or CNI-level encryption).

• Infrastructure as code as your default way of working — Terraform and Helm or equivalents, through merge requests and CI, across repositories you don't own.

Website optimization and conversion

Analytics and measurement

Product and messaging input

postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are
Heritage is building the Modern Investment Office, supporting some of the most prominent families globally to achieve their capital enhancement and preservation goals.
Our vision is to help clients build enduring wealth across generations by combining institutional-grade investment sourcing with personalized portfolio construction, cutting-edge technology, and deep sector expertise. We aim to make sophisticated private market opportunities and modern wealth solutions more transparent, connected, and actionable.
Our team comprises a diverse international group of individuals from leading organizations and with diverse backgrounds, including private equity, venture capital, banking, software development, law, and entrepreneurship. We are committed to attracting top-notch talent and providing opportunities for growth and development based on their individual strengths and interests.

Your Role
Your role as Portfolio Manager is part of our Portfolio Management team. The mission of the role is to ensure that the portfolios of our UHNW clients are actively monitored, well-constructed and aligned with their objectives.
The Associate is allocated to a defined group of European client relationships, covering OCIO and portfolio advisory mandates. Portfolios are multi-asset, spanning liquid and semi-liquid investments, often across multiple banks and counterparties. The role carries direct ownership of portfolio oversight, from asset allocation, fees, liquidity and risk to the quality of the investments proposed to clients.
The role reports to Head of Portfolio Management, and cross-reports to the Relationship Managers. It works in close collaboration with both, providing RMs with timely, high-quality investment input and the confidence that their clients are being taken care of even when they are not looking.

Key Responsibilities

• Oversee client portfolios for OCIO and portfolio advisory clients, playing an active role in shaping clients’ portfolios across a range of asset classes (fixed income, public equity, alternative assets...)

• Maintain clear visibility on asset allocation, fees, liquidity and risk across client portfolios

• Monitor performance, attribution and risk metrics, identifying portfolio drift, concentration risks and misalignment with client objectives

• Assess investments and opportunities proposed by banks and other counterparties (funds, structured products, discretionary mandates, alternatives), forming clear and well-reasoned views

• Identify sub-optimal products (fees, quality, overlap) and propose better alternatives

• Support Relationship Managers with timely, high-quality investment input ahead of and following client discussions

• Track transactions, changes and next steps, so that monitoring and follow-up actions are not missed

• Support business development meetings with prospective clients

• Work closely with the Portfolio Management team on portfolio construction and investment decisions, with a view to contributing to the continuous improvement of our investment process

What We Are Looking For

• Outstanding academic background with a master's degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering or related disciplines

• Solid experience in portfolio management or advisory, ideally for UHNW individuals, within a Multi-Family Office, OCIO, Private Bank or Wealth Manager

• Strong grasp of portfolio construction and asset allocation, including strategic vs tactical allocation and diversification principles, and the ability to assess multi-asset portfolios (liquid and semi-liquid)

• Ability to analyze investment products proposed by banks and asset managers, with a solid understanding of fees (explicit and implicit), liquidity terms and risk drivers

• Experience monitoring portfolio performance, attribution and risk metrics

• Comfortable interacting with sophisticated UHNW clients and Relationship Managers, and able to explain investment concepts clearly and credibly, both verbally and in writing

• Strong attention to detail in portfolio reviews, transaction monitoring and documentation, and ability to work in a structured, process-driven environment

• Experience in manager selection or due diligence is a plus

• Basic financial modelling and portfolio analytics skills are a plus

• International exposure or experience working with non-Italian institutions is a plus

• Tech-savvy, with experience in a portfolio analytics or wealth reporting platform (Addepar is a plus)

• Effective communicator with a collaborative and multicultural mindset

• Highly motivated and proactive, with a hands-on and flexible attitude

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic and fast-growing environment

• Fluent in English. Other languages constitute a plus

Location: Remote work is fine, but being based at a Heritage office is a plus.

What We Offer

•
An exceptional team and environment: You will work alongside highly talented professionals from leading global institutions such as Carlyle, CD&R, McKinsey, Bain, Goldman Sachs, and top technology companies. We operate with a high talent bar, intellectual rigor, and a strong focus on excellence.

•
High ownership and client-facing scope: You will take ownership of the oversight of UHNW client portfolios, working closely with senior stakeholders, Relationship Managers and clients. You will have significant responsibility in assessing investment opportunities and shaping the quality of the portfolios we manage and advise on.

•
Exposure to the intersection of wealth management and technology: You will work on complex multi-asset portfolios and sophisticated wealth structures, using Heritage's proprietary platform to consolidate and analyze portfolio data, and contribute to the continuous evolution of a technology-driven wealth management offering.

•
International scope and strong culture: You will operate in a diverse, international team representing 15+ nationalities, with hiring across multiple geographies. We foster a collaborative and ambitious culture, supported by regular team offsites and opportunities to build strong relationships.

At Heritage, we are proud to have a diverse team representing over 15 nationalities, with all communication conducted in English. We are deeply committed to providing equal opportunities and work actively to remove potential biases in our hiring process by involving a Hiring Committee in all decision-making.

In this role, you will develop and maintain Keet Mobile, our peer-to-peer chat and calling app for iOS and Android. You will:
- Build and polish features across chat, voice and video calls, media sharing, device pairing and identity backup
- Integrate native platform capabilities such as push notifications, camera, bio-metrics and background tasks on both iOS and Android
- Profile and optimise performance on real devices, including startup time, long chats, media handling, battery and network use
- Write unit and end-to-end tests, and help keep releases stable through CI and crash reporting
- Work closely with the core P2P, design and product teams, and review code with a high bar for quality

•
Experience working with a remote team

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

C - Customer Obsessed

Role Overview
As Senior Product Manager for our Core Experience , you'll own the essential workflows hosts and service providers use every day to run short-term rental operations. This includes how work gets planned, scheduled, communicated, completed, verified, and resolved across features such as task management, checklists, problem reporting, notifications, and operational workflows.
You'll spend time understanding how hosts and service providers actually work, identifying friction in their day-to-day routines, and turning those problems into intuitive product experiences.
This is a customer-facing product role. You should be comfortable working with technical systems and integrations, but your primary focus will be owning and improving the product experiences our customers depend on to get work done.
You'll work daily with Engineering, Design, Operations, Support, and other Product teams, and you'll be accountable for customer and business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Own the core operational experience

• Own critical host and service provider workflows end to end. Set the strategy, roadmap, and execution for the experiences hosts and contractors use to manage work across their properties and projects.

• Make daily operations simpler. Simplify multi-step and exception-heavy workflows without losing the flexibility customers need to operate their businesses.

• Balance supply and demand. Make trade-offs that keep the marketplace healthy for everyone. A win for hosts that hurts cleaner retention (or the reverse) is not a win.

• Design for the edge case as if it were the happy path. Substitutions, late arrivals, no-shows, damage reports, and engagement notifications get the same rigor as the primary flow, with workflows Operations can actually run.

• Create consistency across the product. Help ensure Turno feels like one coherent system as we add new products, services, and markets.

Product strategy, discovery & execution

• Lead continuous discovery. Translate customer behavior, qualitative research, support insights, and product data into clear problem statements, hypotheses, and opportunities.

• Prioritize based on customer and business impact . Balance usability improvements, product growth, operational efficiency, reliability, and longer-term platform needs.

• Define meaningful product outcomes. Establish metrics for adoption, engagement, task completion, reliability, satisfaction, and operational efficiency.

• Ship with Engineering and Design. Partner daily to define solutions, prioritize ruthlessly, and release high-quality work on a steady cadence.

• Drive alignment. Communicate clearly, make decisions in a structured way, and bring stakeholders and leadership along.

Systems & technical fluency

• Think in connected systems. Understand how shared concepts such as properties, projects, users, schedules, tasks, payments, and communications interact across Turno .

Must-have qualifications

• Systems thinking: Ability to understand how multiple product areas and workflows interact while keeping the customer experience coherent.

• Data fluency: Experience defining KPIs, building instrumentation, and using BI tools to make decisions.

• AI experience: You leverage AI throughout your entire product tasks and planning.

• Communication: Ability to explain complex customer, technical, and operational problems clearly and make thoughtful trade-offs visible.

• Hands-on experience implementing customer engagement solutions such as Braze or Iterable, including lifecycle messaging, push, in-app, and email journeys tied to product events.

• A track record of leading a migration from a legacy tech stack to a modern one, paired with a UX redesign, across both web and mobile apps. You know how to sequence the move, protect existing users, and measure the impact.

At Nuitée , we are building the API backbone for the global travel industry. Founded in 2017, Nuitée is on a mission to transform a fragmented travel ecosystem with simple, scalable, and API-first infrastructure—think “Stripe for Travel.”

By enabling seamless connectivity between hotels, OTAs, fintechs, super-apps, and businesses, some of which are entering the travel market for the first time, Nuitée empowers companies to deliver reliable travel products effortlessly. Nuitée is at the forefront of a revolution—delivering AI-powered, smarter, and more personalized travel experiences for a new era.

About the role
Remote in EMEA, or hybrid in Barcelona.
You'll decide how a category-defining travel company tells its story.
Nuitée powers hotel booking for some of the biggest names in travel and fintech. The product and our partnerships have driven that growth, and the next step is telling the story at the scale the business has reached.
You'll own Nuitée 's external voice end to end: brand, PR, events, and social. It starts with one story that works for both sides of our marketplace: the travel and fintech companies that distribute hotels, and the hotels themselves. Then you get that story in front of the right people, consistently.
Marketing at Nuitée is a growth engine. Every story, announcement, and event should help open doors and drive revenue. You'll set the direction and get hands-on with the work, seeing your ideas through from first draft to launch.

What you'll own:

Brand & Creative Direction

• Own Nuitée 's positioning, narrative, and visual identity, and make sure the brand feels consistent and distinctive at every touchpoint.

• Build one story that resonates with travel platforms, fintechs, and hotels alike, and strengthen Nuitée 's reputation with hotels and supply partners.

• Set the creative direction for launches, campaigns, events, and presentations, and shape design work directly.

PR & Communications

• Own PR end to end, from partner announcements and press releases to executive talking points and thought leadership.

Events & Experiences

• Build the events calendar with Sales: where Nuitée shows up across travel, tech, fintech, and AI, and how.

Content & Social

• Build an editorial point of view for Nuitée across LinkedIn, the website, and other owned channels.

• Turn product launches, partnerships, and company milestones into stories, and help leaders and teams share them.

• Make complex infrastructure, APIs, and AI innovation simple and memorable.

Digital Brand

• Own the brand experience across the website and key digital surfaces, working with Product and Growth.

• Build pages, assets, and content yourself, using AI tools to move fast.

Building the Function

• Set up brand guidelines, templates, and processes so everyone at Nuitée tells the same story.

• Work with freelancers and partners where needed, and grow the function as it proves its impact

Nuitée has grown 10x since 2022, was profitable before raising a $48M Series A led by Accel, and works with companies such as Revolut, Grab, Hopper, and Priceline. Telling that story well, to the right audiences, is now a priority for the business.

This role fits if you:

• Have 6–8+ years across marketing, PR, communications, or events, building the brand of a fast-growing tech, SaaS, fintech, or travel-tech company.

• Can turn complex technical products into simple, compelling stories, and take them all the way to high-quality execution.

• Have led PR and media relations, including sensitive partner announcements, and are comfortable representing a company externally alongside senior leaders.

• Have created and delivered industry events, launches, or brand activations.

• Have a strong eye for design. You can direct creative work and build assets, pages, and content yourself, using AI tools to move faster.

• Are equally comfortable setting strategy and executing hands-on in a fast-moving environment.

Bonus if you have travel industry experience, especially with hotels, hotel tech, or distribution, or an existing network across travel media and industry events.
Nuitée moves quickly, keeps things simple, and gives people a lot of ownership. You’ll do well here if you’re comfortable making decisions, prefer shipping and learning over long planning cycles, and enjoy seeing your ideas go live within days.
If this sounds like your kind of role, we'd love to hear from you. You can apply with your LinkedIn profile or CV. The process is straightforward and typically takes 2–3 weeks.

Why Nuitee?

At Nuitée , we’re not just reimagining travel—we’re building the infrastructure to power it.

• Bootstrapped Resilience, Startup Agility: Having grown profitably for years without external funding, we combine operational discipline with the speed and innovation of a scaling startup.

• Global Impact: Our infrastructure supports partners like Google, Grab, worldwide fintechs, superapps, travel companies and others

• AI-Driven Innovation: Nuitée is uniquely positioned to power the future of travel in the AI era—enabling seamless, intelligent, and hyper-personalized travel interactions.

By joining Nuitée , you’ll be part of a team that’s building a category-defining platform. You’ll work on a global scale, innovate alongside industry leaders, and help drive the next phase of travel technology. If you’re excited to push boundaries, redefine a multi-trillion-dollar industry, and grow with us— Nuitée is the place for you.

postings.title: Senior Product Manager, Messaging Platform & AI Services
postings.descriptionText:
At ASAPP , our mission is simple: deliver the best AI-powered customer experience—faster than anyone else. To achieve that, we’re guided by principles that shape how we think, build, and execute. We value customer obsession, purposeful speed, ownership, and a relentless focus on outcomes. We work in tight, skilled teams, prioritize clarity over complexity, and continuously evolve through curiosity, data, and craftsmanship. We’re seeking technologists and problem solvers who thrive in fast-paced environments, love collaborating with great talent, and approach every day like it’s Day 1.
We're a globally diverse team with hubs in New York City, Mountain View, Latin America, and India. If you're driven by continuous learning, rapid pivots, and the challenges of building in a high-growth startup, we’d love to talk. This is more than a job—it’s a journey.
You will own the surface where humans and AI work together to serve customers — the messaging platform, the Virtual Agent and the channels it runs on, and the AI Services that make every human agent faster and every automated conversation better. This is one of the largest product surfaces at ASAPP , and it is where the promise of AI-native customer experience is proven or lost.
You will set and execute the strategy for a product surface that spans the Messaging Platform, Virtual Agent, the messaging and voice channels (Web, iOS, Android, Apple Messages for Business, RCS etc), and the AI Services that sit underneath them — AI-assisted human augmentation tools. You will become the go-to expert on this domain, internally and externally, and will be the PM voice in conversations with customers, account teams, and executive stakeholders.
The scope will evolve as our AI architecture evolves — as automation absorbs more of the conversation and the line between human and AI work keeps moving. The strongest candidates will be comfortable shaping a moving target, and will bring the technical and customer depth to anticipate what the right target is as AI develops in the space.

What You Will Do

You will own a set of interconnected product areas and be accountable for their strategy, roadmap, and outcomes. Below is what that looks like concretely.

• Own the Messaging Platform — the application where live agents handle concurrent conversations, access customer context and knowledge, and collaborate with AI. Own the roadmap for agent productivity and the human side of every AI-assisted interaction.

• Define and execute the Virtual Agent and channels roadmap. Own how customers deploy automated conversations across Web, mobile SDKs, Apple Messages for Business, WhatsApp, RCS and voice, and how those channels stay coherent as the platform grows.

• Lead the AI Services that power the surface — such as automatic conversation summary, voice-to-text transcription and AI-augmented response generation. Own how these services improve agent handle time, quality, and compliance, and decide where to invest as model capabilities change. Reason directly about accuracy, latency, and trust tradeoffs rather than treating them as engineering-only concerns.

• Be the go-to expert on Human + AI collaboration. Represent this surface to customers and account teams, translate their pain into a prioritized roadmap, and be the internal source of truth on how these products work and where they are going.

• Own the external documentation for this surface as part of the product. Drive a docs-first approach where documentation ships with features, not after them.

Across all of these areas:

• Set strategy and own the roadmap — balancing active customer commitments, tech debt, and platform bets.

• Work directly with customers and account teams to prioritize and sequence delivery.

• Maintain ruthless prioritization: actively manage customer asks with product evolution bets; say no with clarity and evidence.

• Establish metrics and telemetry for each product area so outcomes are measurable and decisions are data-driven. You can answer “why?” for everything on your roadmap.

Who You Are

•
Rapid, Practical Learning: You can drop into an unfamiliar domain and get to working expertise fast, teaching yourself what you need rather than waiting to be onboarded. You pair that with a practical approach to innovation — you know the difference between a novel idea and a useful one, and you ship the version that moves the business rather than the version that is merely clever.

•
Extreme Ownership: You take responsibility to deliver. You do not wait to be asked — you identify the gap and close it. You are the final owner; the outcome is yours.

•
High-Velocity Outcomes: You measure yourself by outcomes, not output. You distinguish between shipping a feature and moving a metric. You can answer “what changed for the customer?” for everything on your roadmap.

•
Effective Communication, Collaboration, and Trust: You influence without authority across engineering, design, sales, and customer success. You overcommunicate to keep stakeholders aligned. You know when to drive consensus and when to make a call. You are highly organized to keep everyone aligned.

•
Real-Time Feedback: You give and receive feedback continuously. You do not save it for quarterly reviews. When something is wrong, you say so directly and constructively.

What You Will Need

• 5+ years of product management experience ideally in enterprise B2B SaaS and/or native AI platforms.

• Technical depth to engage credibly with engineers on model behavior, conversation design, channel architecture, and AI/ML tradeoffs — you can reason about accuracy, latency, and trust requirements, not just consume them.

• Demonstrated ability to own a complex, multi-surface product area with minimal oversight.

• Experience working directly with enterprise customers and delivery teams to translate pain into a prioritized roadmap.

• Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving to clarity — you can structure an undefined problem before engineering has to.

• Track record of shipping: you have owned features from discovery through delivery, including the parts that are not exciting.

What We Would Like to See

• Experience with human AI workflows or platforms and bonus points for products that are agent-facing or contact center products — agent desktops, workforce productivity tooling, or conversational AI platforms.

• Experience with AI-powered productivity features and a point of view on where they create real operating leverage.

• Experience with channels, CCaaS platforms, and multi-channel deployments.

• Comfort navigating AI/ML systems — not just as a user but as someone who can reason about model behavior, latency tradeoffs, and accuracy/trust requirements.

• Prior experience in a startup or fast-scaling environment where the role definition evolved as the company did. Experience owning a product end-to-end.

• Comfortable approaching product development, ideation and management in a AI native workflow approach

Benefits

• Stock options

• Healthcare for the family group

• Mac equipment

• USD 150 per month in flexible benefits

• 3 weeks of vacation

• English lessons

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or veteran status. postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca 's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

About the Role
We are seeking a Staff Full Stack Engineer to lead the technical direction of the team that builds Alpaca 's Trading API product. Trading API serves developers, traders, and institutions who trade directly with Alpaca . The team owns that customer experience end to end: how customers access the platform, how their accounts are structured and secured, and the applications they use to trade.
The work spans the stack: customer-facing trading applications, the identity, account, and permission systems behind them, and integrations for partner apps and AI agents. The team also builds customer-facing trading features end to end, across our API.
This is a high-trust domain. These systems decide who can act on an account and what they are allowed to do. A defect can expose customer data, let the wrong person place a trade or move money, or lock a customer out at the moment they need to trade. The customer-facing surfaces also carry real-time trading: an order ticket or positions view that shows stale or wrong data can lead to a bad trade. We are looking for an engineer who has built and owned systems like this — identity and authorization, account models, and trading or financial applications — and who is as comfortable designing an authorization model as shipping the interface built on top of it.
You will not manage people directly. You will lead through architecture, code, design reviews, and mentorship, and you will remain a principal contributor. You will be the senior technical anchor for the team, partnering with the engineering manager, Product, and Design, and working closely with the trading, margin and risk, and platform teams behind the API.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the architecture and technical roadmap for how customers access and use Trading API: identity and authentication, authorization and permissions, account and sub-account models, partner OAuth, and customer-facing trading and account-management applications.

• Design the access model for increasingly complex account structures — multiple users per account, sub-accounts, entity and advisor accounts, and delegated API and agent access — so that permissions are explicit, auditable, and enforced on the server.

• Lead technical delivery of next-generation Trading API customer applications, including real-time market data, order entry, and positions and order views, as the product expands to new customer surfaces.

• Drive the move from legacy monolith endpoints to a dedicated application backend, with clear API contracts between customer applications and platform services such as trading, accounts, transfers, ledger, and market data.

• Set the security bar for customer-facing systems: session and credential handling, MFA and passkeys, OAuth flows, rate limiting, input validation, and fast, durable responses to security findings.

• Set the standard for safe delivery: feature flags, staged rollouts, preview environments, testing strategy, and production observability.

• Partner with Product, Design, Compliance, Security, Brokerage Operations, and adjacent engineering teams to define behaviour and integration boundaries.

• Lead design reviews, mentor senior and mid-level engineers, and raise the engineering bar as the team grows.

• Act as a technical point of escalation for production issues on customer-facing Trading API systems, and drive durable prevention after incidents.

Qualifications

• 8+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time on both backend services and customer-facing applications. Evidence of scope and ownership matters more than a strict year count.

• Proven ownership of a production system where a defect could expose customer data, grant the wrong access, or cause financial loss.

• Deep experience with authentication and authorization: OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, session and token management, MFA, and role- or attribute-based permission models.

• Strong backend expertise in Go, or deep experience in Java, Kotlin, C#, or Rust and a clear willingness to work primarily in Go.

• Strong frontend experience with TypeScript and React, including complex, state-heavy applications. Experience with real-time data over WebSockets or other streaming protocols is strongly preferred.

• Solid knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred), API design (REST and gRPC), and service-oriented systems running on Kubernetes.

• Demonstrated care for correctness and security: threat modelling, testing strategy, edge-case analysis, and safe production rollout.

• Clear communication with engineers, designers, product managers, and compliance and security partners, including when requirements are ambiguous or still being defined.

• Track record of technical leadership and mentorship across teams. Product-minded: you care what the customer sees and why, and you are effective as a teammate.

Preferred Skills

• Experience building trading, brokerage, or other financial applications: order entry, positions and P&L, charting, or real-time market data.

• Experience with identity platforms or building identity in-house (for example, Amazon Cognito, Keycloak, or Auth0), passkeys and WebAuthn, or delegated access for third-party applications.

• Experience with API platforms and developer products: API keys, scopes, rate limits, SDKs, or developer dashboards.

• Experience with agentic AI integrations, such as MCP servers or tooling that lets AI agents act safely on a user's behalf.

• Familiarity with FIX or institutional trading workflows.

• Experience leading migrations off a legacy monolith in production-critical environments.

How We Take Care of You:

• Competitive Salary & Stock Options

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Our Values

•
Take thoughtful risk: We solve for today while being considerate of tomorrow—creatively leveraging our tools and abilities to hit ambitious goals.

Win together: Compliance is a team sport. We proactively engage with one another and check our egos at the door in search of the best ideas.

•
Move the needle: Our goals are lofty for a reason. We set clear expectations, give direct feedback, and challenge ourselves to close the gap between those goals and results.

What We Do
Thoropass is transforming the landscape of security compliance and audits. As the only all-in-one platform that combines compliance automation software with a tech-enabled audit firm and pentest services, we offer a modern approach to information security compliance and audit. Our AI-powered solutions, such as First Pass AI, are designed to streamline compliance and accelerate audits for frameworks like SOC, PCI, ISO, HITRUST, HIPAA, and more. Thousands of companies trust Thoropass for high-quality audit and assessment services, delighting in a truly differentiated experience.

Morgan, PayPal Ventures, Fin Capital, Centana, Canapi, and Bain Capital. We operate as a virtual, global company with a presence in over 18 countries. With substantial growth in both customers and revenue, we are strategically positioned for continued expansion in 2025 and beyond.

About the Role
Forget everything you think you know about information security auditing. We’re on a mission to reinvent the outdated, clunky audit process—and we’re doing it with cutting-edge AI, automation, and a relentless commitment to customer success.
At Thoropass , auditing isn’t about manually sifting through endless evidence or checking boxes—it’s about solving complex security problems for our customers in smarter, faster, and more innovative ways. If you’re an experienced, customer-centric auditor who’s tired of the grind and ready to help disrupt the industry, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Do
You’ll be the driving force behind a seamless ISO audit experience for our customers. With the help of your team and our powerful tech, you’ll transform audits from a chore into a strategic advantage.

Here’s what your day will look like:

•
Lead with Confidence: You’ll serve as the trusted advisor and main point of contact for your assigned customers, owning the ISO audit lifecycle from start to finish.

•
Review, Guide, Elevate: Analyze audit evidence requests submitted by customers, provide expert feedback, and guide them toward best practices.

•
Collaborate with AI: Partner with our advanced AI engine and auditor team to validate evidence, streamlining the process for maximum efficiency.

•
Deliver Excellence: Generate high-quality ISO audit reports that reflect accuracy, precision, and your professional expertise.

•
Problem-Solve Creatively: Use your curiosity and analytical skills to solve unique challenges, ensuring every customer has an exceptional experience.

What You’ll Bring
We’re looking for innovators, problem solvers, and tech enthusiasts with the following experience and skills:

•
ISO Expertise: At least 3+ years of ISO 27001 audit experience, including leading audit interviews.

•
Cloud Savvy: Familiarity with advanced cloud technologies (AWS, GCP, Azure).

•
Customer-First Attitude: Comfort working directly with customers and a knack for building relationships.

•

postings.title: Supply Chain Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

About the role
Grüns is scaling fast, and our supply chain has to move faster than the demand. As our Supply Chain Specialist, you'll be the execution engine behind it: owning purchase orders from creation to receipt, keeping inventory and inbound data airtight, and catching risk before it ever reaches a customer. You'll work side by side with our Director of Supply Chain and directly with our suppliers, co-manufacturers, and 3PLs. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role, and the work you do will protect product availability as we grow.
This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.

In this role, you will:

• Own day-to-day purchase order execution, moving every PO through production, shipment, receipt, and exception resolution without dropped follow-up

• Run the operating cadence with suppliers, co-manufacturers, and 3PLs, so every confirmation, delay, decision, and committed date has one clear owner: you

• Maintain the source of truth for available, inbound, and at-risk inventory, so the team always knows what we have, what's coming, and what's in trouble

• Spot shortages, production delays, material constraints, freight risk, and inventory imbalances early, and escalate with a recommended action, not just a flag

• Build Claude-powered workflows that turn raw PO, inventory, production, and freight data into exception lists, supplier communications, meeting recaps, and decision-ready summaries

• Standardize reporting, documentation, and recurring workflows (and write the SOPs) so the team can handle higher volume with fewer manual errors

We're looking for someone who:

• Has 1-3 years in supply chain, operations, procurement, production planning, logistics, or inventory management, working close to the physical flow of product rather than only reporting on it

• Has worked in or around a fast-paced CPG, food/beverage, supplements, wellness, beauty, or other physical-product business (strongly preferred)

• Has coordinated directly with external suppliers, manufacturers, or logistics partners, whether in a full-time role or internship, and held them to deadlines across multiple workstreams at once

• Has hands-on experience with an ERP, inventory, or order management system (NetSuite-style) and can pull and organize clean source data without help

• Uses Claude or other AI tools daily for real operational work: writes strong prompts, builds reusable workflows, and validates outputs against source data before acting on them

• Can point to real examples of catching a problem early and driving it to resolution

Approach to the role:

• Highly organized and detail-oriented, without losing sight of what matters most to the business

• Proactive: follows up before the deadline, not after something is already late

• Comfortable in ambiguity, and builds structure where processes are still taking shape

• Takes extreme ownership: closes loops and communicates risk early

• Collaborative and low-ego, while still holding internal teams and external partners accountable

• Treats AI as a force multiplier on the work, never a substitute for judgment

Compensation & Benefits:
At Grüns , we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package—grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is between $80,000 – $85,000 plus bonus depending on experience.

A bit about us...

At Grüns , we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns , and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

postings.title: Security Engineer (m/w/d)
postings.descriptionText:
Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System , das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Einzelhändlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt.
Hilf dabei, Shopware-Produkte sicherer zu machen, indem du während der gesamten Produktentwicklung Sicherheitsrisiken aufdeckst und reduzierst. Du arbeitest mit den Produktentwicklungsteams daran, Schwachstellen zu untersuchen, sichere Konzepte und Tests zu verbessern und praxisnahe Maßnahmen aufzubauen, die wiederkehrende Probleme in Commerce Core, Services und angrenzenden Produktbereichen verhindern.
Product Security Engineering ist eine Engineering-Funktion . Die Produktteams bleiben dafür verantwortlich, ihren eigenen Code zu korrigieren und zu testen. Dieses Team bringt gezielte Sicherheitsexpertise, eine gemeinsame Roadmap zur Prävention und eine klare Koordination für produktübergreifende Sicherheitsarbeit ein.

Requirements

• Untersuche Schwachstellenmeldungen, Sicherheitswarnungen, interne Findings und Nacharbeiten zu Sicherheitsvorfällen . Bewerte die technischen Auswirkungen und unterstütze dabei, bestätigte Aufgaben an die zuständigen Product Owner weiterzuleiten.

• Arbeite direkt mit Entwicklerinnen und Entwicklern an sicherem Design, Threat Models, Code Reviews, Ursachenanalysen, Fixes und Regressionstests für besonders risikoreiche Produktbereiche.

• Entwickle und verbessere wiederverwendbare Sicherheitskontrollen , Leitfäden für Entwicklerinnen und Entwickler, Tests für Missbrauchsszenarien und praxisnahe Automatisierung zur Erkennung und Behebung von Schwachstellen.

• Unterstütze dabei, für Product-Security-Findings klare Verantwortlichkeiten, Schweregrade, Reaktionsziele, betroffene Versionen und Nachweise zum Abschluss festzuhalten.

• Arbeite mit den Engineering-Teams von Commerce Core und Services an Sicherheitsaufgaben über verschiedene Repositories, unterstützte Versionen, APIs, Integrationen und das Extension-Ökosystem hinweg .

• Unterstütze koordinierte Sicherheits-Releases : Ermittle betroffene Bereiche, prüfe technische Behebungen und stimme dich mit Engineering, Product Operations, Quality, InfoSec und DevRel ab.

• Überführe Erkenntnisse aus Sicherheitsvorfällen und Releases in konkrete Änderungen am Engineering, Tests oder Tools. Verfolge anschließend nach, ob diese Maßnahmen übernommen werden.

• Kommuniziere bei zeitkritischen Aufgaben klar und dokumentiere Entscheidungen in den vereinbarten GitHub- und Confluence-Einträgen, damit Teams den Status nicht aus Slack-Verläufen rekonstruieren müssen.

• Wirke an gemeinsamen Teampraktiken mit und vertrete bei Bedarf den anderen Produktbereich.

Das bringst du mit:

• Fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und Interesse an Produkt- oder Anwendungssicherheit.

• Praktische Kenntnisse typischer Risiken in der Anwendungssicherheit , etwa Schwachstellen bei Authentifizierung und Autorisierung, Zugriffskontrolle, Datentrennung, API-Sicherheit, Umgang mit Zugangsdaten, Injection und Abhängigkeiten.

• Die Fähigkeit, produktiven Code und Tests zu lesen und zu ändern , Risiken für Entwicklerinnen und Entwickler verständlich zu erklären und wartbare Fixes mit umzusetzen.

• Erfahrung mit Threat Modeling, Sicherheitstests, Schwachstellenanalysen oder Secure Code Reviews ; in einigen Bereichen bringst du fundiertes Wissen mit, in anderen möchtest du dich weiterentwickeln.

• Gutes Urteilsvermögen bei der Einschätzung von Schweregrad, Auswirkungen auf Kundinnen und Kunden und Ausnutzbarkeit sowie bei der Frage, wann ein Problem sofort eskaliert werden muss.

• Klare schriftliche Kommunikation und die Fähigkeit, bei unklaren oder dringenden Aufgaben teamübergreifend zusammenzuarbeiten.

• Kenntnisse von PHP sowie mit Shopwares Produkten, Services oder dem Extension-Ökosystem sind hilfreich.

• Erfahrung mit Sicherheitsautomatisierung , etwa Dependency Scanning, SAST, Fuzzing oder Tests für Missbrauchsszenarien, ist ein Plus.

Woran du deinen Erfolg erkennst:

• Findings werden einheitlich bewertet , schnell an die zuständigen Verantwortlichen weitergeleitet und mit einem sichtbaren Reaktionsziel und Abschlussnachweis versehen.

• Produktteams erhalten zeitnah praxisnahe Unterstützung bei Sicherheitsthemen und behalten zugleich die Verantwortung für die Umsetzung.

• Sicherheitsprüfungen und Tests erkennen relevante Risiken vor dem Release . Wo sinnvoll, enthalten Fixes passende Regressionstests.

• Aus Nacharbeiten zu Sicherheitsvorfällen und Releases entstehen konkrete, verantwortete Präventionsmaßnahmen statt ausschließlich einmaliger Patches.

• Umfang von Sicherheits-Releases, betroffene Versionen, technische Verantwortliche und Validierungsbedarf sind für Engineering, Product Operations, Quality, InfoSec und DevRel klar dokumentiert .

• Im primären Produktbereich des Engineers wächst die Sicherheitsexpertise . Gleichzeitig teilt das Team Standards und unterstützt sich bei Bedarf über Produktgrenzen hinweg.

Das bieten wir dir:

• Unternehmenskultur: Offene Kultur, flache Hierarchien, Eigeninitiative wird gefördert.

• Arbeitsverträge: Unbefristete Anstellungen bieten langfristige Sicherheit.

• Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für mobiles Arbeiten und Full-Remote-Verträge.

• Ausstattung: Freie Wahl der Arbeits-Hardware.

• Onboarding: Gut strukturiertes Onboarding mit Unterstützung durch einen persönlichen "Buddy".

• Arbeitsumfeld: Inspirierendes Umfeld mit engagierten Kollegen und einer dynamischen Gemeinschaft.

• Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Vielfältige Chancen für persönliches Wachstum und Entwicklung.

• Zusatzleistungen: Attraktive Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitsprogramme und regelmäßige Teamevents.

... und vieles mehr!
Einen detaillierten Einblick bekommst du auf unserer Karriereseite.
Deine Ansprechperson für diese Stelle ist Josephine Scheffler und steht dir bei Fragen gerne zur Verfügung!
Der Schutz deiner persönlichen Daten hat für uns oberste Priorität. Unsere Bewerberinformationen findest du hier.

postings.title: Deployable Child Protection in Emergencies Specialist - Roster Recruitment (Glob
postings.descriptionText:
The Organisation
Plan International is an independent development and humanitarian organisation that advances children’s rights and equality for girls. We believe in the power and potential of every child but know this is often suppressed by poverty, violence, exclusion and discrimination. And it is girls who are most affected.
Working together with children, young people, supporters and partners, we strive for a just world, tackling the root causes of the challenges girls and vulnerable children face. We support children’s rights from birth until they reach adulthood and we enable children to prepare for and respond to crises and adversity. We drive changes in practice and policy at local, national and global levels using our reach, experience and knowledge.
For over 85 years, we have rallied other determined optimists to transform the lives of all children in more than 80 countries.

We won’t stop until we are all equal.
Plan International ’s Child Protection in Humanitarian Action (CPHA) Roster
As Plan International scales up its humanitarian impact, we are committed to becoming a leading global organisation for girls affected by crisis and disaster. Our humanitarian roster plays a critical role in delivering this ambition and we are seeking to further strengthen our roster of experienced Humanitarian Child Protection specialists who can be deployed globally to support humanitarian responses, typically for deployments lasting between two and six months.
Successful applicants will be added to our roster for Child Protection in Humanitarian Action and contacted for deployment opportunities as they arise. Whilst being a member of the roster is not paid, once you are deployed you will receive a salary as well as per diem, accommodation and travel insurance.
We maintain a close relationship with our Roster Members through regular engagement and access to online humanitarian learning, ensuring they benefit from being part of the roster both when deployed and when not deployed.

About You
The Child Protection in Emergencies specialist provides oversight and leadership to Plan International 's child protection response in a specific crisis. You will be responsible for assessment, response analysis, design, coordination, capacity strengthening, implementation and monitoring and evaluation of child protection in emergency programmes as part of our broader emergency response. You will ensure that gender equality is core to our child protection in emergencies response and that our intervention meets the child protection and gender-based violence minimum standards.

Successful applicants require:

• Solid work experience in international humanitarian settings with progressively responsible roles in designing, leading and/or coordinating Child Protection in Humanitarian Action programme responses.

• Expertise in working with child survivors of sexual and gender based violence (SGBV).

• Alongside proficiency in English, we require that you can comfortably work in Spanish to be considered for the roster at this time.

• Commitment to ensuring safeguarding and Prevention of Sexual Exploitation, Abuse and Harassment. (PSEAH) is core to our ways of working.

Closing Date: Saturday 31st October
Equality, diversity and inclusion is at the very heart of everything that Plan International stands for.
We want Plan International to reflect the diversity of the communities we work with, offering equal opportunities to everyone regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation.
Plan International is based on a culture of inclusivity and we strive to create a workplace environment that ensures every team, in every office, in every country, is rich in diverse people, thoughts, and ideas.
We foster an organisational culture that embraces our commitment to racial justice, gender equality, girls’ rights and inclusion.
Plan International believes that in a world where children face so many threats of harm, it is our duty to ensure that we, as an organisation, do everything we can to keep children safe. This means that we have particular responsibilities to children that we come into contact with and we must not contribute in any way to harming or placing children at risk.
A range of pre-employment checks will be undertaken in conformity with Plan International 's Safeguarding Children and Young People policy. Plan International also participates in the Inter Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme. In line with this scheme we will request information from applicants previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse and/or sexual harassment during employment, or incidents under investigation when the applicant left employment. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms their understanding of these recruitment procedures.
Please note that Plan International will never send unsolicited emails requesting payment from candidates.

Requirements:

• Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign), with working knowledge of Canva and the Affinity Suite (Vector, Pixel, and Layout).

• Ability to transition seamlessly between Adobe, Affinity, and Canva workflows based on client needs and project requirements.

Bonus Feel free to browse our work samples on our website and review the comprehensive scope of work before applying for this position. You will join the team that runs our SIEM and detection capability — from log ingestion and audit coverage to detection rules, alert tuning, and investigation workflows — so that access to sensitive systems is attributable and suspicious activity is caught and attributed by our own detections. You will operate the vulnerability-management loop end-to-end, and when incidents happen, you will lead the investigation and see the long-term fix through. You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own the security platform and network and zero trust — your detection and response work is what proves their controls hold. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and wants to work on real-world security problems at scale. In this role you will use and build agentic workflows for alert triage, investigation, and threat hunting that multiply what the team can cover.

What You’ll Do:

• Extend audit and attribution coverage across the estate — Kubernetes audit logs, database audit logging, SSO and access-path telemetry — so access to sensitive data is attributable to a person or workload, with retention aligned to compliance requirements
