• Support and implement security controls aligned with PCI DSS, SOC 2, and other compliance requirements — with your logging and detection work producing the audit evidence as a by-product

• Develop and implement automation (including AI) to improve efficiency in security operations, detection, and response

• Participate in the on-call rotation for detection and response and the services you own

What We Look For:

•
6+ years of experience in security, software, or infrastructure engineering, with hands-on experience securing cloud-based production systems and working with real-world security challenges

• Experience working with SIEM platforms (e.g., Wazuh, Splunk, ELK) for detection engineering, monitoring, and incident response

• Experience designing and tuning detection rules, reducing alert noise, and improving investigation workflows

• Strong hands-on experience in vulnerability management — scanning, triage and validation of scanner and bug-bounty findings, remediation coordination, and verification

• Strong knowledge of AWS, Linux, and Kubernetes infrastructure, including security architecture and operational best practices

• Ability to investigate issues directly using logs, cloud tooling, and system-level data

• Experience assessing the detection and logging implications of new systems in design reviews

• Knowledge of common security vulnerabilities and mitigation strategies (OWASP, SANS, etc.)

• Working knowledge of compliance frameworks such as PCI DSS and SOC 2, particularly logging, monitoring, and evidence expectations

• Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your work today, and have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

• You have built AI-assisted workflows that others adopted — triage, enrichment, or hunting

• Familiarity with log-based detection, telemetry pipelines, and security analytics use cases

• Experience with internal penetration testing or adversarial exercises, and translating results into detection and remediation work

• Strong understanding of cloud-native security controls, including IAM, network segmentation, and container security

• Experience with container and dependency security tools (e.g., Snyk, Trivy, Grype) as an operator of their findings

• Experience aligning technical security work with regulatory and compliance expectations

• Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated environments

About You:

•
You think like an investigator - you turn telemetry into detections and detections into answers, and you are not done until the root cause is fixed.

•
You treat attribution as an engineering deliverable - every access to sensitive data has a name on it, and every finding has an owner and a date.

• You are excited to use automation and emerging technologies (including AI) to take repetitive security work off the team's plate

• You balance strong security standards with business needs and can support privacy and compliance requirements in a practical, scalable way

•
You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

•
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

•
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

•
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

•
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

•
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

postings.title: Head of Revenue Operations
postings.descriptionText:
About Tiugo
Tiugo is the company behind CKEditor, TinyMCE, Uploadcare and ButterCMS, developer tools that power rich content creation inside thousands of applications and across the Fortune 1000. Formed in 2021 and backed by PSG, we have grown through acquisition into a ~$60M ARR business with strong gross and net retention and Rule of 60 performance.
We run two motions at once: a developer-led, product-led motion at high volume, and sales-led motion with a growing enterprise model built around our AI content platform. Our next chapter depends on running both well, across multiple brands, with one set of numbers everybody trusts.

Why this role exists now
Over the next eighteen months we are layering an enterprise, AI-led motion on top of an inbound Sales Assist motion and a product-led engine, across four brands with four histories and four stacks. That demands a revenue operations function that designs the engine rather than maintains it. One that owns how a customer moves from first touch through renewal, how we measure it, how we equip the field to run it, and how we automate the parts that should not need a human. The clearest example is renewals: moving the long tail to a tech-touch motion where people manage by exception, designed hand in hand with our Customer Success leaders. We are deliberately not backfilling the role as it existed. This is a bigger job, and we are hiring for the version of it we need in FY27.
In place today: a RevOps team; standardized stage and data definitions across instances; a weekly forecast cadence; a self-service channel; a central data warehouse.
What you'll build: field enablement, a deal desk, GTM engineering, a scaled tech-touch renewal motion, and real business analysis.

What you will own

• The revenue engine's architecture. In close collaboration with the CRO and Sales & CS leaders, design the end-to-end customer journey across self-service and sales-assisted motions: segmentation, coverage, routing, lifecycle stages, and the handoffs between marketing, sales, customer success and partners.

• Sales, customer success and partner operations. A single operations function serving the whole revenue motion. One funnel, one definition set, one system of record. This covers every Tiugo brand, and you decide where standardization pays off and where a lighter touch is right. Marketing operations sits today within Growth Marketing and works closely with this role on the shared funnel. As the function matures, bringing the two closer together is a path we'll consider.

• Planning and performance cadence. Territory and coverage design, quota setting, capacity and productivity modeling, and the forecast process and its discipline. You design the incentive plans; Finance administers and pays them.

• Deal desk. A function that works inside the deal cycle alongside our sellers, helping shape deal structure and pricing approach on enterprise and AI deals, and moving those deals through legal, finance and security review without losing momentum. It also brings together the sales support work that keeps deals moving, such as quoting. Finance and Legal keep their approval authority; this role owns the path to it. You will define how the function operates as part of building it.

• Field enablement. Onboarding and ramp, sales methodology, and product and AI fluency across the field. This is a build rather than a maintain, and you will hire the leader for it.

• GTM engineering and applied AI. In collaboration with a central AI team, own Revenue Organization automation across the revenue lifecycle and internal AI applications pointed at go-to-market work.

• Business analysis for the revenue engine. Not report production, but interpretation. Monitoring what the business is actually doing, diagnosing what changed and why, and turning that into recommendations the revenue leadership team acts on. You will partner closely with our central data and analytics group, who own metric definitions, pipelines, governed dashboards and data quality. They own what is true. You own what it means and what we do about it.

Your first twelve months
By the end of year one, we should be able to say:

• The revenue leadership team is making decisions from analysis you surfaced before anyone asked for it

• Coverage, segmentation and routing are designed, documented and actually followed across brands

• Forecast accuracy is materially better, and the process is trusted enough that it is not relitigated every month

• Deal desk is a competitive advantage on enterprise deals rather than a bottleneck

• An enablement function exists, is staffed, and the field can carry a credible AI conversation without escalating

• Meaningful, measurable revenue work is automated, returning hours to sellers rather than producing slideware

Who you are

• 10+ years in revenue or go-to-market operations, with 5+ leading the function at a B2B SaaS company between roughly $30M and $150M ARR

• You have run operations for a business with both a product-led and a sales-assisted motion, and you understand why the two rarely share definitions cleanly

• Deep Salesforce fluency, plus real command of the surrounding stack: forecasting, quote-to-cash, marketing automation, BI and billing

• Genuinely technical with data. Opinionated about data models, and able to hold your own with a data engineering team

• You have deployed AI operationally inside a go-to-market org and can tell the difference between what worked and what demoed well

• You have built functions rather than inherited them, and hired people better than you into them

• Comfortable in a globally distributed, multi-brand business where standardization is a negotiation rather than a mandate

How we will know it is working
Forecast accuracy. Pipeline coverage and conversion by stage and motion. Sales cycle and time to first value. Rep productivity and ramp time. Quote turnaround and deal desk cycle time. Time from question to trustworthy answer. Hours of manual revenue work eliminated.

postings.title: Renewals Manager
postings.descriptionText:
About Doppel
Doppel is building the future of social engineering defense. Our AI-native platform uses agentic AI to protect executives, employees, customers, and brands from phishing, impersonation, fraud, and other AI-powered threats across digital channels. Backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz and Bessemer Venture Partners, Doppel is a rapidly growing Series C company helping customers stay ahead of modern digital threats.

The Role
We are hiring our first dedicated Renewals Manager to build and run the renewals function at Doppel .
This is a builder role and a hands-on commercial role. You will not inherit a finished renewals organization or simply administer contracts. You will design the operating model while personally owning renewal execution across our customer base.
You will establish the systems, processes, forecasting discipline, commercial guardrails, segmentation, and cross-functional handoffs required to make renewals predictable and scalable. At the same time, you will be directly responsible for moving renewals from early planning through commercial negotiation, procurement, signature, and close.
You will partner closely with Customer Success Managers, Account Executives, CS Operations / RevOps, Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, and channel partners. Customer Success will continue to own customer value, adoption, health, and risk-recovery plans. You will own the commercial renewal motion and renewable ARR.
This is initially an individual-contributor role, with the opportunity to help define how the renewals organization should evolve as Doppel scales.

What You Will Do

Build the Renewals Function

• Design and implement Doppel 's scalable renewals operating model, including lifecycle stages, ownership, exit criteria, escalation paths, and rules of engagement.

• Establish renewal motions for strategic, core, scaled, direct, channel, and auto-renewal customers.

• Build a forward-looking renewal forecasting and inspection cadence that gives leadership reliable visibility into renewable ARR, expected renewals, churn, contraction, timing risk, and commercial blockers.

• Define clear renewal stages, forecast categories, risk definitions, and Salesforce data requirements so the renewal book can be inspected consistently.

• Develop playbooks, templates, customer and partner cadences, dashboards, reporting, and repeatable commercial workflows.

• Partner with Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, Sales, and CS leadership to define commercial guardrails for standard uplifts, multi-year agreements, co-terming, concessions, downsells, payment terms, and non-standard exceptions.

• Establish consistent churn and contraction reason codes and use renewal data to identify systemic retention risks and improvement opportunities.

• Identify opportunities to automate renewal opportunity creation, reminders, quoting, risk detection, reporting, and administrative work using Salesforce, customer-success tooling, and AI.

• Continuously refine the model as renewal volume and complexity grow, including recommending when additional renewal capacity or specialized coverage is required.

Run the Renewal Business

• Personally own the end-to-end commercial renewal lifecycle across Doppel 's customer base, from early planning through quote, negotiation, procurement, signature, and close.

• Maintain a forward-looking view of the renewal book and ensure upcoming renewals are identified, validated, and actively managed well in advance of expiration.

• Lead customer-facing renewal conversations covering pricing, uplift, term, multi-year options, scope changes, downsell, procurement, and contract execution.

• Own standard renewal quotes and commercial execution, routing non-standard pricing or terms through DealHub and the appropriate approval process.

• Maintain an accurate renewal forecast and provide evidence-based visibility into expected outcomes, churn and contraction exposure, timing risk, and blockers.

• Partner with CSMs to translate account health, adoption, business outcomes, support history, stakeholder changes, and competitive signals into the renewal strategy.

• Identify renewal risk early and drive the commercial components of mitigation plans alongside the CSM, AE, leadership, and executive sponsor.

• Coordinate partner-led renewals and ensure Doppel , the partner, CSM, and AE are aligned on timing, pricing, scope, customer communication, and remaining steps to close.

• Partner with AEs on combined renewal-and-expansion motions. Renewals remains accountable for the existing renewable ARR and renewal execution; the AE owns incremental expansion ARR. Together, you will create one coordinated customer-facing commercial strategy.

• Manage complex renewal structures including multi-year terms, co-terming, product changes, pricing adjustments, and approved commercial exceptions.

• Keep Salesforce accurate and current as the single source of truth for renewal amount, forecast category, risks, next steps, owners, commercial status, and expected close timing.

• Ensure signed renewals become clean, billable transactions by coordinating PO requirements, billing contacts, subscription dates, payment terms, invoice schedules, and other required information with Finance.

• Analyze churn, contraction, uplift realization, multi-year adoption, late renewals, forecast variance, and other renewal patterns and turn those insights into improvements to the operating model.

What We Are Looking For

• 5+ years of experience in SaaS renewals, account management, customer success, or another commercial post-sale role, with meaningful direct ownership of renewals.

• Demonstrated experience owning a renewal target or book of business and delivering strong retention outcomes with disciplined forecasting.

• Experience building or materially improving a renewals process, operating model, playbook, forecast methodology, or commercial cadence—not simply operating within an established one.

• Experience in cybersecurity or another complex B2B SaaS environment involving enterprise customers, channel partners, procurement, and legal stakeholders.

• Strong commercial judgment and negotiation skills across pricing, term, uplift, concessions, multi-year agreements, procurement, and contract execution.

• Ability to operate both strategically and tactically: you can design the process, build the dashboard, negotiate with a customer, inspect a forecast, and chase a signature when needed.

• Ability to distinguish customer-value risk from commercial or transaction risk and mobilize the right cross-functional team for each.

• Strong executive communication skills: concise, credible, comfortable with senior customer stakeholders, and effective in high-pressure commercial situations.

• Strong analytical skills and operational rigor, with the ability to manage a large number of concurrent renewal dates without losing the strategic context of the account.

• Strong Salesforce fluency; experience with CPQ / DealHub-style quoting, forecasting tools, customer-success platforms, and contract workflows is highly valuable.

• Comfort operating in a fast-growing environment where roles and processes are evolving and you are expected to create structure rather than wait for it.

Why Join Doppel

• Competitive compensation and meaningful equity; $120,000 - $130,000 OTE

• Flexible work environment.

• Comprehensive health benefits, PTO, and parental leave.

• Opportunity to build a critical recurring-revenue function from the ground up and have a direct impact on how Doppel scales.

Success Measures

• Strong Gross Revenue Retention and achievement of Doppel 's renewable ARR target.

• High percentage of renewals completed on or before the contractual renewal date.

• Reliable renewal forecast accuracy with risks identified early enough for the business to act.

• Consistent realization of approved renewal uplifts and increased adoption of multi-year agreements where appropriate.

• Reduced late-stage surprises, emergency extensions, and renewals entering the final 30 days without a clear path to close.

• Clear visibility into churn and contraction drivers with measurable improvements based on those insights.

• Consistent execution of direct, channel, and auto-renewal motions with clean ownership and handoffs.

• A scalable, documented renewals operating model that reduces administrative burden on CSMs and allows them to spend more time driving customer value.

• Clean handoffs from signed renewal to Finance, with accurate contracts, dates, PO information, billing contacts, and payment terms.

• A clear recommendation for how the Renewals function should scale as Doppel 's customer base and renewable ARR grow.

Salary Range

$120,000—$130,000 USD

• Report weekly on what was published and what performed, with organic and paid separate, tracked clicks and inquiries handed to Sales.

What you bring

• Excellent written English: clear, warm, persuasive copy with a natural tone for U.S. homeowners. This is the most important skill for the role.

• Proven community management: you have grown engagement and kept a busy inbox of comments and DMs under control.

• Organized and self-directed: you close the loop on your own work and escalate early, with a recommendation.

Nice to have

Experience with GoHighLevel

•
Experience writing ad copy for Meta

•
UGC and creator-style content

•
experience with pet-owner audiences

What success looks like in the first 90 days

• Days 1–30 : access to every channel and tool confirmed; baseline set for each channel and for rating, review volume and response rate by location; review queue at zero with the 48-hour response time running; first draft of the review response guidelines.

• Days 31–60 : the agreed weekly cadence published on time for four consecutive weeks; review response guidelines approved; first weekly listening digest and reputation report by location delivered; review generation routine agreed with Customer Service.

• Days 61–90 : AI drafting workflow running for calendar, captions and review replies, with your approval on every item; at least two copy or format tests completed with findings; every inquiry from social and reviews handed to Sales with confirmation.

Selection process: written test

The test is about writing and judgment, not design. Using sample photos, clips and brand templates that we provide, you will:

How to apply

postings.title: [REMOTE] Senior LiveOps Developer - Mobile Games
postings.descriptionText:
Senior LiveOps Developer - Mobile Games

Remote - Full Time
CrazyGames , one of the world's largest browser game platforms with over 60 million monthly active users, is doubling down on its IP portfolio. We own the games we publish, and we treat each one as a live product rather than a finished project.
We're looking for a Senior LiveOps Developer who has already done this on mobile. Someone who has taken a title through soft launch and global launch, knows which live systems need to exist before you scale UA behind a game, and can build them.
This is a hands-on development role. You'll write the code for the events, the progression systems, the offers, the economy and the remote config that keep a game growing. You'll also be the person who looks at a game's numbers and says what should ship next and why, because you've run this playbook before at a mobile publisher.
What this role is not: greenfield game development, or working through a feature backlog someone else wrote. You'll be inside existing codebases almost all of the time, on games that already have players, and you'll be the one deciding what those games need.

Key outcomes for the role

• Within 1 month , you've onboarded to one of our live published titles, gotten comfortable in its codebase, shipped your first live update to production on web and mobile, and given us your first read on what that game's LiveOps setup is missing.

• Within 3 months , you own the LiveOps roadmap for at least one title. You've set an update cadence, shipped a meaningful live system (event framework, progression, offers, remote config, economy tuning), and we can see the effect in retention or monetization.

• Within 6 months , you've taken a title through the run-up to global launch. The live systems, the event calendar, the balancing and the tooling are in place before UA scales behind it, and you decided what belonged there.

• Within 12 months , LiveOps is a repeatable system across our IP portfolio rather than something that depends on you personally. Multiple live titles run in parallel on the cadence, tooling and playbook you put in place.

On a typical day you might

• Look at retention, session length, ARPDAU and conversion for a live title, and decide what to build next.

• Ship a seasonal event, content drop or offer to one of our live IP games on web and mobile.

• Build the live system behind it: event framework, remote config, A/B test, progression or economy change.

• Dive into an unfamiliar codebase to plan how a new system slots in without breaking what's already there.

• Tell us a game is not ready for global launch yet, and what has to exist first.

• Design and implement a new game mode, progression system or monetization hook tailored to the genre.

• Align with the Publishing team on the LiveOps roadmap and prioritization across titles.

• Maintain clean Git history, write down what you did, and make sure the next update is easier than the last.

What we offer

• Join a rapidly growing publishing team at a company with 50M+ monthly users and proven platform reach.

• Make a real impact by directly shaping the games millions of people actually play, week after week.

• A lot of responsibility and freedom. We hire only experts and trust them to deliver excellent results.

• Flexible working hours and location. The results are what counts!

• 1 to 2 team weeks per year. We pay for flights and accommodation so you can have fun with the team.

• The opportunity to play games and claim it's work.

Requirements

You're a great fit if you

• Have 2+ years running LiveOps on shipped mobile titles. Update cadence, events, progression, economy, offers, and the reasoning behind each of them. This is the requirement we weigh most heavily. If your experience is game development without live ownership, this is not the role.

• Have been through a mobile soft launch and a global launch , and know what has to be in place before UA scales behind a game.

• Bring a playbook, not just execution. You've seen how strong mobile publishers run live titles, and you can apply that here instead of waiting for someone to hand you a backlog.

• Have 3+ years of professional game development experience with shipped titles, and are still hands-on. You build the live systems yourself rather than specifying them for someone else.

• Read metrics as a developer, not just as a consumer of dashboards. Retention, session length, ARPDAU, conversion and cohort behaviour drive what you build next.

• Have strong mobile game development experience (iOS and Android), and understand the differences in performance, input and UX across platforms.

• Work with analytics, A/B testing, remote config and live tooling as part of your normal workflow, not as something a separate team owns.

Location: Remote.Candidates must be available during U.S. Pacific business hours and possess excellent spoken and written English.

Employment Type: Initial 90-Day Performance Engagement (Contract), with the opportunity to transition into a long-term role based on results.

Help Great Salespeople Become Elite

About TurFresh

TurFresh is the original and most established artificial turf cleaning and maintenance company, serving homeowners and businesses across multiple states.

For over 26 years, we’ve focused on creating cleaner, safer, more enjoyable outdoor spaces while building lasting customer relationships. Every interaction, from the first call to ongoing service, is designed to earn trust and deliver long-term value.

We continuously improve how we sell, coach, operate, and serve by embracing AI, testing new ideas, and holding ourselves accountable. We value curiosity and a commitment to getting better every week.

Through our TurfRescue initiative, we make regular donations to animal shelters and rescues, supporting the care of dogs and helping the organizations that protect and rehome them.

Our sales team isn’t broken.

They’re successful, highly coachable, and committed to continuous improvement. They voluntarily attend weekly training, embrace feedback, and actively seek coaching because they want to become exceptional at their craft.

We’re looking for someone who shares that mindset.

Your Mission

Improve our inbound sales team’s conversion rate.

Everything else, including coaching, accountability, role-playing, call reviews, AI insights, training reinforcement, and performance management, exists to accomplish that goal.

About the Opportunity

This role begins as an Initial 90-Day Performance Engagement because we believe leadership should be demonstrated through results, not resumes or titles.

At the end of the engagement, the question should be simple:

Did our sales team improve because you were here?

If the answer is yes, we’ll want to continue building together in a long-term leadership role.

Our Sales Model

Our business is different from most home service companies.

• Every customer begins as an inbound inquiry.

• Customers have already expressed interest before speaking with our team.

• Sales consultants educate, qualify, quote, and close customers entirely over the phone.

• Field technicians verify measurements and perform the work. They do not sell.

• Marketing generates demand. Sales converts demand.

We are not trying to generate more leads.

We are focused on converting more of the opportunities we already earn.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

TurFresh has been in business for more than 26 years, but we don’t operate like a company that’s satisfied with the status quo.

We’re constantly refining how we sell through AI, call analysis, operational feedback, experimentation, evolving sales playbooks, and continuous learning.

You’ll join a company that already has a strong operating foundation, including:

•
AI-assisted call analysis

•
Weekly coaching reports

•
CRM dashboards

•
Sales scorecards

•
Standard operating procedures

•
Structured onboarding

•
Weekly sales workshops

•
KPI reporting

We don’t expect you to arrive with a canned methodology.

We expect you to learn our business quickly, contribute ideas, reinforce what works, challenge what doesn’t, and help us continuously improve how we coach and how we sell.

What You’ll Do

You will:

• Own the daily performance of our inbound sales team.

• Coach sales consultants through structured one-on-one coaching.

• Reinforce and expand on concepts taught during weekly sales workshops.

• Review recorded sales conversations and AI-generated coaching insights.

• Conduct role-play sessions using real customer scenarios.

• Inspect execution to ensure coaching becomes a daily habit.

• Hold salespeople accountable for consistently executing our sales methodology.

• Improve discovery, qualification, objection handling, follow-up, and closing.

•
Accelerate new hire development.

• Reduce sales-created operational issues through better qualification and documentation.

• Partner with Sales Operations, Marketing, and Operations to improve the customer experience.

• Identify opportunities to improve both individual performance and our overall sales process.

How You’ll Be Measured

Success is measured by results, not activity.

Primary KPI

•
Team Conversion Rate

Supporting KPIs

•
Revenue per Quote

•
Maintenance Plan Attachment Rate

•
Sales-Created Operational Errors

•
New Hire Ramp Time

•
CRM Hygiene

•
Sales Quality and Consistency

Who Will Thrive Here

This role is for someone who enjoys owning performance.

You believe great coaching includes reinforcement, inspection, accountability, and follow-through, not just delivering advice.

You know how to earn the respect of talented salespeople while challenging them to continually improve.

You’re comfortable having difficult conversations, coaching through resistance, and ensuring that training becomes consistent execution.

You thrive in organizations that are constantly learning, testing, and improving.

Most importantly, you measure your success by one thing:

The measurable improvement of the people you lead.

Experience We’re Looking For

We’re far more interested in how you’ve improved sales performance than where you’ve worked.

The ideal candidate has successfully improved the performance of an inbound sales team by coaching better customer conversations, reinforcing consistent execution, and holding people accountable for improvement.

You should have experience:

• Improving conversion rates through coaching and accountability.

• Reviewing recorded sales calls and identifying coaching opportunities.

• Conducting one-on-one coaching and structured role-playing.

• Reinforcing training through consistent follow-up.

postings.descriptionText:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato .

Auto insurance on paid social is one of our highest-potential channels and you would own it end to end taking it to the next level.
This is a hands-on seat. You are in Ads Manager daily, pulling your own numbers, setting the testing agenda with the creative team, and staying with a test through launch, read, and post-mortem. If you are looking to hand a strategy deck to someone else to execute, this is not it.
The honest trade: the channel has proven scale and a real ceiling. Creative fatigues fast, attribution is noisy, and regulation reshapes what you can say and where you can send traffic. Those problems are yours. Nobody is going to solve them above you.

Why This Seat
You own a vertical, not a slice. Meta and TikTok spend for auto insurance, end to end, from budget and bid strategy to the creative roadmap to live margin performance. One owner, and it is you.
Margin is the metric. Not impressions, not a ROAS number handed down without context. You decide when to push into a lower ROAS for contribution dollars and when to pull back, and you are trusted to make that call.
The mandate is scale, not maintenance. The plan is to grow this channel to roughly 2.5x its current monthly spend without giving up margin. That is the job. If you want a channel that is already solved, this is the wrong one.
The interesting part is unsolved. Creative fatigue cycles, attribution noise, and compliance constraints on a vertical with real headroom. You will not be maintaining someone else's playbook. You will be writing the one the rest of the team runs.
Short line to the people who decide. You work directly with the Senior Director who owns paid marketing, the GM of Auto Insurance, compliance, and product. No layers to route a recommendation through.
Profitable and bootstrapped. Spend decisions here get made on margin, not against a burn plan set by someone else's timeline.

What You'll Bring

• Paid social bought at scale in performance marketing, affiliate, or leadgen. Not brand work and not agency-of-record media planning.

• Deep hands-on Meta expertise: campaign structure, bid and budget strategy, audience and placement testing, and diagnosing a performance shift caused by a platform or attribution change rather than by your campaigns.

• Real TikTok scale, not test budgets. You have managed meaningful spend through allowlisting, vertical restrictions, and landing page requirements.

• Direct accountability for CPA, ROAS, or contribution margin on monthly spend of $250,000 or more.

• Experience in a compliance-heavy vertical such as insurance, lending, credit, or health, where creative and landing page claims are constrained.

• Fluency with tracking and attribution: pixel and server-side event setup, postbacks, conversion QA, and the judgment to spot when the data is lying to you.

• Four or more years in a hands-on, in-the-weeds buying role with direct margin accountability.

How we work, and what we look for in how you work:

•
Focus and Win. You start from the P&L and the metric, not the tactic, and you are relentless about why performance moved. You do not stop at the first explanation.

•
Better Every Day. You seek feedback and turn it into visible change, and you write down what you learn so the next buyer does not relearn it.

•
Stronger Together. You brief the creative team clearly, give specific feedback, and treat them as partners in the testing agenda rather than a request queue. You surface a problem early with a recommendation attached instead of waiting to be asked.

•
Embrace Change. When a platform policy or a compliance constraint moves, you find the compliant path to scale rather than stopping at no.

Nice to Have

• Auto insurance, or another regulated leadgen domain

• Advertorial or direct-response landing page funnels and conversion rate testing

• Working knowledge of AI creative generation tooling

• Familiarity with Looker

What You'll Own

• Meta and TikTok spend for auto insurance, end to end, with measurable margin impact. You have a teammate on the buying team who can support execution when volume calls for it, and the ownership stays with you.

• Pacing and margin targets, including the judgment call on when lower ROAS is the right trade for contribution dollars.

• The creative testing roadmap, built with the Creative Strategist and the creative team and turned into shipped concepts at high velocity.

• A documented, repeatable playbook other buyers on the team can run.

• Direct relationships with Meta and TikTok reps, and the allowlisting, beta access, and escalation paths a restricted vertical depends on.

• The working partnership with the GM of Auto Insurance, compliance, and product on funnel, landing page, and offer strategy.

What Great Looks Like

By the end of your first year:

• Auto insurance paid social hits its margin and pacing targets consistently, and you can explain every miss without being asked.

• Monthly spend is materially higher than when you started, and margin held.

• Creative test velocity is up and the win rate is better, because the roadmap is deliberate instead of reactive.

• Your testing playbook is in use by other buyers on the team.

• Meta and TikTok reps take your call, and you have unlocked at least one thing for this vertical that the team did not have access to before.

• Compliance and product treat you as a partner on funnel and offer strategy rather than as a request coming in.

This Isn't the Right Seat If You

• Have only bought inside an agency with no accountability for margin or profit.

• Need a stable platform environment. Policy, creative fatigue, and attribution all shift here, sometimes in the same week.

About Radian Arc .

What impact you will have
We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to own complex, multi-stakeholder GPUaaS and AI infrastructure deployments from planning through production handover. You will set the plan, critical path, and delivery governance for each deployment. You will coordinate Solutions Architecture, Engineering, Product, Procurement, Data Center Operations, Service Delivery, Sales, customers, vendors, and strategic partners, and keep delivery aligned with customer expectations and commercial commitments.
You will also play a key role in building Radian Arc 's Project Management Office (PMO). That means designing and standardizing how we deploy, and applying automation and AI-assisted development tools to turn those processes into repeatable workflows and live dashboards, with less manual coordination as deployment volume grows.
This is a highly autonomous role for someone who enjoys creating structure in a fast-growing company. You will work with teams across the USA, Europe, Asia, and Australia, so you will regularly need to collaborate outside standard business hours.

What you’ll do:

Deployment Delivery

• Own end-to-end delivery of GPUaaS, AI infrastructure, hardware, and new data center / PoP deployments, from initial planning through production handover.

• Build and maintain the integrated deployment plan and critical path across all workstreams: scope, timelines, milestones, dependencies, owners, risks, decisions, and completion criteria.

• Coordinate hardware procurement, site readiness, installation, networking, storage, compute, platform deployment, and customer onboarding across internal teams and external partners.

• Keep solution and engineering requirements, hardware delivery, site and operational readiness, customer commitments, and target production dates aligned.

• Lead deployment acceptance, go-live readiness, stabilization, and formal handover into Service Delivery and Operations.

• Manage multiple deployments in parallel, balancing shared resources, dependencies, and competing priorities.

Deployment Process Design and Governance

• Define Radian Arc 's standard deployment lifecycle, including stages, owners, required inputs, approval gates, and entry/exit criteria for each phase.

• Establish delivery governance, including project kickoffs, readiness reviews, change control, decision logs, and escalation paths.

• Create practical templates, checklists, and runbooks so new deployments start quickly and run consistently.

• Help build Radian Arc 's PMO by setting project-management standards and delivery disciplines that scale across customers, regions, and data center environments.

• Run post-deployment reviews and feed lessons learned back into the standard process.

Automation, Dashboards, and Reporting

• Use AI-assisted development and automation tools, such as Claude Code, to build, document, and continuously improve deployment workflows and project-management processes.

• Work with Engineering to connect deployment workflows to Radian Arc systems, tools, and data sources, and automate routine coordination, tracking, reporting, and data updates wherever practical.

• Build a standardized, shareable dashboard for each deployment, generated directly from workflow data so status is never maintained twice.

• Provide executive and working-level views of scope, procurement status, milestones, dependencies, blockers, decisions, owners, and next actions, as a single source of truth throughout the project lifecycle.

Risk, Issues, and Stakeholder Communication

• Identify risks, blockers, resource constraints, and dependency conflicts early, and drive mitigation, escalation, and cross-team resolution.

• Provide clear, consistent status reporting to internal leadership, customers, vendors, and partners, and run regular project reviews, readiness reviews, and executive updates.

• Translate complex technical, operational, procurement, and delivery issues into concise updates, clear decisions, and actionable next steps.

• Build trusted relationships with customer, partner, and vendor stakeholders at both working and executive levels.

What success looks like:

In your first 90 days, you will:

• Own active deployments, with an integrated plan, critical path, and risk register in place for each.

• Document version 1 of Radian Arc 's standard deployment lifecycle, including stages, owners, gates, and completion criteria.

• Stand up a live dashboard for each active deployment that updates from workflow data rather than by hand.

Within six months, you will:

• Have the standard deployment process in use across all new deployments.

• Have measurably reduced the manual effort spent on coordination, tracking, and status reporting

What you'll need

• 7+ years in project management, program management, technical delivery, or infrastructure deployment roles, including 5+ years managing complex infrastructure deployments involving multiple internal teams, vendors, partners, and customers.

• 3+ years working with AI infrastructure, GPU platforms, cloud infrastructure, data centers, hardware deployments, telecommunications operators, or managed infrastructure services.

• A track record of owning deployments end to end, with direct responsibility for timelines, dependencies, and delivery outcomes, from hardware procurement and site readiness through go-live and handover to operations.

• Experience building or improving PMO processes, project governance, reporting frameworks, dashboards, and standardized delivery processes.

• Demonstrated ability to design and improve integrated project workflows, with a practical understanding of how automation, APIs, workflow tools, and AI-assisted development tools can reduce manual coordination and reporting.

• Technical fluency across compute, networking, storage, data center, platform, and operational workstreams: enough to challenge a plan, spot a missing dependency, and earn engineers' trust.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, including with customers and executives.

• Experience working with distributed teams across multiple countries and time zones.

Nice to have:

• Hands-on experience building workflow automation, integrations, or AI-assisted tooling using scripting, APIs, workflow platforms, Claude Code, or similar tools.

• Direct experience deploying GPU clusters or other high-performance compute environments.

• Experience with telecommunications operators, or with government or sovereign AI programs.

• Experience at a fast-growing company where you built delivery processes from scratch.

• PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum certification

What we offer
• Attractive compensation package reflecting your expertise and experience.
• A great work environment characterised by friendliness, international diversity, flexibility, and a hybrid-friendly approach.
• You'll be part of a fast-growing scale-up with a mission to make a positive impact, offering an exciting career evolution.
Our job titles may span more than one job level. The actual base pay is dependent on a number of factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands.

Our inclusive responsibility
Radian Arc is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected category under applicable law.

postings.title: SEO/AEO Manager (Internal)
postings.descriptionText:
About Discovered Labs
Discovered Labs is an SEO and answer engine optimisation (AEO) agency built by a Stanford rocket scientist turned AI researcher (Ben Moore) and a demand gen marketer with experience scaling B2B SaaS companies to 8-figures in ARR (Liam Dunne).
We're a team of ML engineers, data scientists and senior marketers trusted by companies including Instantly, Granola, Composio and other Series A+ B2B SaaS businesses to help generate leads and customers through Google and AI assistants like ChatGPT.
We do this through content marketing, technical optimisations and off-site brand amplification, including PR, backlinks and Reddit marketing.
View recent case studies at .

High-level overview of our approach:

• AI-powered operations: Our ML team builds internal tools that remove repetitive work and give marketers more time for judgement and execution.

• Senior judgement: Experienced marketers set the strategy and quality bar, and remain responsible for the work our tools help produce.

• Full-stack execution: We work across content, technical SEO/AEO and off-site amplification to give clients better outcomes.

Note: If you want to stand out, please include a Loom video showing a tool, system or deliverable you've produced and are proud of. We'd love to see it!

This role
SEO/AEO is already Discovered Labs' top pipeline driver. We're hiring an experienced SEO/AEO Manager who can work confidently with data, run our content workflows, off-page programs and personally ship website improvements (using coding agents like Codex or Claude Code) to grow the qualified opportunities it generates.
You'll report to Liam and agree commercial goals and quarterly direction with him. You'll own day-to-day prioritisation, delivery and reporting. Using and improving our existing methodology, proprietary tools and workflows, you'll diagnose performance, choose priorities and carry work through implementation and measurement.
Your primary outcome is qualified inbound pipeline: relevant buyers discovering us through search and becoming sales opportunities. Keyword positions, relevant organic traffic and AI visibility help you understand whether the work is moving in the right direction.
This is a full-time individual contributor role with no direct reports. The role is fully remote, ideally within ±4 hours of GMT.
Everyone on the Discovered Labs team is tech savvy and data-driven, even if they didn’t start that way. If you have curiosity and the willingness to learn, you’ll thrive here.

What you'll do
You'll run our SEO/AEO programme to generate qualified inbound pipeline, with new content, refreshes and off-page campaigns tied to our pillar and cluster strategy.

• Develop our pillar and cluster strategy: Maintain our money-keyword universe, group queries by search intent and map priority clusters to target pages, using semantic clustering where useful.

• Close topic gaps with new content: Run the weekly content loop through our proprietary tools, keeping at least two weeks of approved assignments scheduled against editorial capacity and resolving SEO issues in briefs and drafts. Editors handle QA and publishing.

• Manage content refreshes: Diagnose content decay, underperformance and cannibalisation. Prepare blog refresh briefs covering keyword targeting, topic coverage and internal linking, then verify the changes and measure results.

• Build and optimise landing pages: Personally create and improve pages using coding agents and our GitHub repository. Submit tested pull requests and verify live changes.

• Fix technical SEO issues: Diagnose and fix issues with crawlability, indexation, internal linking, metadata and structured data. Test changes, verify live results and escalate complex engineering work.

• Own our off-page strategy: Define how targeted link building, Reddit and YouTube support our priority topics and objectives. Brief the specialists who produce the deliverables, review their work and use results to refine the strategy.

• Close AI visibility and citation gaps: Use embeddings and entity analysis where useful to investigate how AI answers represent and cite Discovered Labs. Test changes against the gaps you find.

• Build tools that improve delivery: Create and validate scripts, automations and AI workflows for recurring research, analysis and measurement.

• Connect every action to an objective: Tie each tactic to an overarching strategy and a clear objective: improving performance on commercial keywords, earning AI Overview placements, strengthening brand positioning or generating qualified pipeline. Measure progress against those objectives and use results to decide what to prioritise next.

The ideal person for this role

• You make commercial SEO decisions. You can choose whether to create, refresh or consolidate content by weighing search intent, existing performance and relevance to the buyers we want to reach.

• You investigate before concluding. When performance changes, you check competing explanations across content, technical and off-page factors, and distinguish evidence from a plausible story.

• You turn investigation into implementation. You can take an SEO problem through analysis, a tested website change or a completed content workflow, and measurement of the result. You know which work needs editorial QA or engineering support and arrive with the work ready for that handoff.

• You enjoy the technical detail. You're curious about embeddings, entities and how content relates semantically. You explore the data, build small tools to test ideas and judge the work by whether it improves a useful decision or outcome.

Requirements

• Demonstrated SEO execution, with examples of work you personally diagnosed, prioritised and implemented, the results and how you measured them.

• Experience independently translating business goals into search strategy and a practical delivery plan.

• Working fluency in Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or an equivalent research tool, and a crawler such as Screaming Frog. You use them to investigate performance and check figures at source.

• Practical ability to build and improve website pages and make technical SEO changes using coding agents and GitHub, demonstrated through previous work or an exercise.

• An AI-assisted tool, script or workflow you've built or materially adapted to solve a real problem. Explain the decisions you made, what AI contributed, how you verified the code, data or output, and what improved.

• Evidence of rigorous SEO analysis that led to an implemented change: explain the data you used, the competing explanations you checked, your decision and how you measured the result.

• Reliable delivery tracking in a project management tool such as ClickUp, with clear actions, complete handoffs and documentation others can use.

•
Excellent verbal and written English.

Nice-to-haves (not required)

• Familiarity with B2B or B2B SaaS. Strong candidates from other SEO backgrounds are welcome.

• Agency experience or experience coordinating editors and specialist contributors.

• Deeper Python, SQL, statistics or applied machine-learning skills.

• Experience measuring AI visibility, analysing citations or running link-building and Reddit programmes.

This role is not for you if…

• Your work ends with an audit or plan. We need someone who implements changes, resolves blockers and checks what happened afterwards.

• You treat traffic or citation counts as the final result. We expect you to connect search performance to relevant buyers and qualified opportunities.

• You ship AI output you cannot explain or verify. You remain responsible for the analysis, recommendations and code you use.

Culture fit

You'll thrive here if:

• You like small teams, direct feedback and a high degree of autonomy.

• You're curious about how search is changing and willing to test ideas against evidence.

• You communicate risks early and welcome a clear challenge to your recommendation.

You won't thrive here if:

• You need heavy management or wait for perfect instructions before acting.

• You protect a perfect plan instead of delivering, learning and improving.

• You need a large team around you before you can produce useful work.

What's in it for you

• Compensation: $30K - $75K USD (or EUR/GBP equivalent), DOE

• Fully remote: Work from where you do your best work, ideally within ±4 hours of GMT.

• Real autonomy: Make daily prioritisation and execution decisions, with direct access to Liam for strategic direction.

• Our in-house tools and methodology: Learn the proprietary SEO/AEO systems built by our engineers, apply them to our own growth and help improve them. We'll teach you our systems.

• Depth and visible impact: Build expertise across organic growth, technical SEO and applied analysis through sustained ownership of a programme whose results you can follow over time.

•
Paid leave holidays

Interview process

•
Async assessment (15 minutes)

•
30 minute call with founder

• 90 minute deep-dive into career history and work

•
3 hour paid assessment

• Reference checks with former peers and managers.

To apply
Please complete the short form on the platform where you see this job ad. Be specific as possible when answering questions - we love detail.
Please do not use sloppy AI to auto-apply for this role. It’s obvious and will result in us not progressing with your application for this role and future roles.

• Seguridad de Red: Configuración avanzada de AWS WAF (reglas administradas y custom), AWS Network Firewall y manejo de Security Groups/NACLs con enfoque de segmentación estricta.

About Loop

Loop is an agentic restaurant intelligence software that augments the back office of restaurant chains by automating workflows and delivering intelligence across the finance, operations and marketing functions. Loop deploys AI agents built by our in-house team of AI engineers, strategists and subject matter experts into restaurant brands - bringing industry best practices in handling complex internal functions. Loop is one of the fastest growing restaurant technology companies powering a few billion dollars in revenue and growing to serve 10K+ restaurants within 3 years across some of the most recognizable brands of the USA, helping them grow their topline & bottomline.

Loop has built by a world class team of entrepreneurs, operators, leaders and AI engineers from different industries, ranging from cutting edge big-tech, management consulting, investment banking among others across companies like Uber, Google, Amazon, McKinsey and others.

What you will do

This is a post-sale ownership role. You carry a book of multi-unit restaurant and franchise accounts and you are accountable for their adoption, results, retention, and growth.

• Own a portfolio of accounts from go-live onward. Run implementation and onboarding, get each product configured against the customer's channels and bank feeds, and confirm the numbers reconcile before you call it live.

• Turn messy operational and financial data into decisions an operator will act on. Build the recurring business reviews, quantify dollars saved and recovered, and walk owners and CFOs through where they are leaking revenue and what to do about it.

• Monitor account health continuously. Catch risk early from usage, escalations, and renewal timing, then run the save motion: diagnose the real issue, coordinate the fix across product and engineering, and rebuild the value case with the customer.

• Drive renewals and expansion alongside Customer Success, Sales and Revenue Operations. Know each account's contract terms, product entitlements, and renewal dates, and land the renewal and any upsell.

• Triage customer escalations. Reproduce the problem, pull the evidence across billing, Salesforce, call history, and product data, and drive it to resolution with clear written updates to the customer.

• Partner with product and engineering as the voice of the account. Translate recurring customer pain into prioritized, well-documented product feedback.

Who you are

• 2–5 years at Bain, McKinsey, BCG (Boston Consulting Group), or a comparable top-tier strategy firm. This is a hard requirement.

• You are comfortable owning a customer relationship end to end, not just producing analysis. You like being accountable for an outcome a customer can measure.

• Strong quantitative and analytical skills. You can build a clean model or reconciliation in a spreadsheet, structure an ambiguous problem, and defend the numbers to a skeptical operator.

• Excellent written and spoken English. You can run an executive review and write a crisp customer update without hand-holding.

• Structured, self-directed, and fast. You manage a portfolio, prioritize across competing fires, and follow through without being chased.

• Bonus: experience in restaurants, retail, franchising, finance operations, or another multi-location, multi-channel business; comfort with SQL, Salesforce, or BI tools.

Why this role

You get the ownership and customer exposure of an engagement manager without the travel and staffing churn of consulting. You work directly with restaurant and franchise operators, tie your work to real dollars in their P&L, and see the impact within weeks rather than at the end of a project. Loop is scaling fast across verticals, and this team is where the customer relationship and the company's growth are decided.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are always made by people. Questions about how your data is processed? Reach out directly.

Accessibility & Reasonable Accommodations
Loop AI is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require a reasonable accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we'll work with you to provide appropriate support.

postings.title: Head of IT & Security
postings.descriptionText:
About us

OpenZeppelin is the security standard onchain finance is built on. Founded in 2015, our mission is to accelerate the world's transition to an open financial system, built on open standards and secured by rigorous research.

Our open-source Contract Libraries have facilitated over $35 trillion in onchain value and are used by 10 of the top 10 tokenized money market funds and 9 of the top 10 stablecoins by market cap.

We combine AI-native security tooling with deep research and a decade of audit expertise to support leading institutions and crypto-native teams shaping the next generation of digital assets like DTCC, Fidelity, Coinbase, Uniswap, Aave, the Ethereum Foundation, and many more across the full secure development lifecycle.

Please note: Always refer to OpenZeppelin 's official job page for the most accurate information about our open roles, as we have seen multiple third party job sites posting inaccurate information.

The IT & Security Team
The Information Security function operates independently under our Legal team and owns everything that keeps the OpenZeppelin organization secure. That means managing our Security, Privacy & IT Program end-to-end: our SOC 2 and ISO 27001 posture, vendor and privacy risk, incident response, our bug bounty programs, and the identity, endpoint, and access systems the whole company depends on. It is also the team our customers meet during security diligence. As our enterprise relationships deepen, increasingly with banks and other regulated institutions, our own program must be as credible as the security we deliver to customers.
Today that program is established and audit-ready. The next chapter is turning it into an enterprise-grade security function that stands up to the scrutiny of the most demanding enterprise customers, partners, and regulators, while safely accelerating our adoption of AI across the company.

What you'll be doing
You will own the strategy, design, and continuous maturation of OpenZeppelin 's Information Security Program, and be accountable for managing the team executing it. You can issue-spot security and privacy risks before they materialize, explain the principles behind security and compliance controls to auditors and enterprise security teams, and calibrate our security program proportionate to risk.

• IT and infrastructure: Oversee identity and access management, provisioning and onboarding/offboarding, end-user security (MDM, endpoint protection, security training), physical security, disaster recovery, business continuity, and data backup, using automation and AI-powered workflows to make IT and security operations scale faster than headcount.

• Strategy, governance and budget: Set the strategic direction, multi-year roadmap, and risk posture of the Information Security Program; deliver on department OKRs; and own the IT and technology budget, with ultimate responsibility for technology procurement.

• AI security and governance: Own the secure adoption of AI across the company: evolve our AI governance framework, review and approve AI tools and agentic workflows, and secure our agentic infrastructure (identity, least-privilege tool and data access, secrets handling, monitoring, auditability). Manage frontier model providers as critical vendors, covering security and data-handling diligence, retention and training-use commitments, DPAs and subprocessor flow-downs. Meet emerging obligations such as the EU AI Act, so we can make transparent, defensible commitments to enterprise customers about how our products and internal AI usage handle their data.

• Compliance, audit and enterprise trust: Own our audit, certification, and attestation strategy and execution (penetration testing, SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001, successor frameworks) alongside internal security audits; run a third-party and vendor risk management program; and serve as the external face of our security program with customer security teams, regulated financial institutions, and auditors.

• Privacy and data governance: Maintain a comprehensive data map of how data flows into, through, and out of the organization, including flows to model providers and through agentic workflows, with data classification, records of processing, and a vendor/subprocessor inventory. Own privacy compliance in partnership with Legal: GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, DPAs and contractual security commitments, and privacy-by-design reviews of new products and features.

• Security operations and incident response: Own the incident response program end-to-end, including playbooks, tabletop exercises, post-incident reviews, and breach-notification obligations in partnership with Legal. Manage our bug bounty programs, and partner with development teams to embed security best practices in the SDLC and our software offerings.

You have

• 10+ years of Security and IT experience, including 3+ years leading a IT Security and GRC function (not solely IT operations) in a high-growth tech company, with demonstrated ownership of strategy, not just execution.

• A demonstrated trajectory toward CISO: you have owned a security program end-to-end, presented to executives or boards, and can articulate the "why" behind every control you have implemented.

• Experience securing or governing AI/LLM-enabled products or enterprise AI adoption including agentic systems and third-party model-provider risk, with an ability to apply privacy and data-protection laws and practices (e.g., GDPR, CCPA/CPRA) in the AI context.

Nice to have

• 5+ years working in blockchain or a FinTech with an enterprise client base (e.g., financial services), including navigating rigorous third-party security diligence.

This includes but is not limited to gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, national origin and other characteristics that make each one of us unique. In this uniqueness, we find the most value. Come join us!

postings.descriptionText:
Kargo creates powerful moments of connection between brands and consumers to build businesses. Every day, our dynamic teams work to radically raise the bar on what agentic AI, CTV, eCommerce, social, and mobile can do to deliver unique ad experiences across the world’s most premium platforms. Taking a Creative Science approach to all we do, we continuously innovate solutions that outperform industry benchmarks and client expectations. Kargo is growing rapidly and currently has offices in NYC, Chicago, LA, Dallas, Sydney, Auckland, London and Waterford, Ireland.

Who We Hire

Techies who want to build the future. Creatives who want to design it better. Communicators to win business. Collaborators to build it. Data pros who turn numbers into insights. Product builders who turn ideas into innovations. Anyone eager to be on a team that doesn’t stop to ask what’s next, because they’re already building it.

The Opportunity
Kargo is building toward a unified platform where advertisers run campaigns across CTV, web, mobile apps, and social entirely self-serve. This is the first time that capability goes directly into clients' hands. Clients will pull their own reports, debug their own setups, and ask why a campaign isn't pacing, so the data behind them must be quick to extend, stable enough to trust, and structured for automated triage. Our pipelines already run at that scale, but each demand is met one team at a time: reporting is bespoke, stability rests on each team's own practice and monitors, and triage depends on whoever knows the pipeline.
We're standing up a Data Platform team to solve these problems once for the whole company, and you'll be its founding engineer. Working directly with the Sr. Director of Data Engineering, you'll shape the standards and build the software that enables and enforces them, open the platform up to contributors across Kargo , and grow the team as its scope expands. You'll own it as a long-term product: modular tools and paved roads that let any team publish data and have it arrive discoverable, reliable, and observable enough to triage without tribal knowledge.

The Daily To-Do

•
Build the data control plane. One place to see and govern what data products exist: schemas, lineage, ownership, freshness commitments, quality, access. Built for people browsing and agents querying.

•
Build the paved road for standing up a data product. Libraries, SDKs, templates, and data-specific CI/CD on Kargo 's engineering platform, plus a supported near-real-time pattern. Following the standard should be easier than bypassing it.

•
Build the enforcement layer for the data standards. Schema registry, the contract validator and the CI step that runs it, automated certification.

•
Make every data product observable by default. Freshness, volume, schema conformance, and quality instrumented by the paved road rather than hand-built per team, emitting into Kargo 's existing monitoring with the ownership and lineage metadata that makes AI-assisted triage possible.

•
Set the platform's technical direction. Architecture, roadmap, and build-versus-buy calls, informed by what the teams who produce and consume data actually need. Run the design reviews where they weigh in, and keep the platform modular enough that they contribute capabilities back.

Qualifications:

• You’ve built loosely coupled production services, APIs and SDKs in Python that multiple teams depend on.

• You've built metadata-driven platforms that integrate with catalogs and check lineage, contracts and quality automatically.

• You've built observability other teams depend on, and can tell a signal from noise.

• You get tools adopted by teams that don't report to you through architecture reviews, mentorship, and clear communication.

• Strong AWS, Terraform and Kubernetes experience.

Strongly Preferred

• Experience moving from batch to streaming; understanding of cost tradeoffs.

• Spark and Iceberg at significant scale, and Snowflake in production.

• Ad tech, or another domain with high-volume event data and multiple consumers.

• Experience building tooling and data structures that AI agents operate against.

Nice to have:

• Experience standing up a platform team's first generation of capabilities.

• Data catalog, semantic layer, or governance tooling.

Role Summary
As an Enterprise Sales Manager, your mandate is to close deals and generate revenue to contribute to our organisation's financial sustainability. In this role, you will be responsible for hands-on sales activity, building and converting a strong sales pipeline, and establishing revenue-generating partnerships. You will report to the VP, ALX Enterprise.

Beyond corporate training, you will also identify and close additional revenue-generating partnerships and commercial collaborations that contribute directly to the sustainability of ALX’s mission.

• Close new and expansion revenue against a quarterly and annual target.

• Build and work target account lists by market and sector.

Partnerships

Sales infrastructure and team

• Improve the sales playbook, collateral and process as you learn what wins.

• Coach the current sellers, run the sales rhythm, support our sales boot camps, and hire and onboard the next seller when the numbers justify it.

• Bring win/loss patterns, pricing signals and offer gaps back to the VP and delivery leads.

Client success

• Define the client success scorecard: retention, expansion, satisfaction and on-time renewals.

• Own a clean sales-to-delivery handover and an account-planning rhythm for top clients.

Skill Requirements - Essential

• 8+ years of B2B sales or consulting in enterprise services: L&D, consulting, HR or ed-tech, professional services, or similar, with 3+ years leading people or a commercial function.

• Experience selling services, learning, consulting or HR solutions to senior HR and business leaders.

• Experience building sales pipelines from scratch, with forecasting discipline

• Evidence of creating and converting demand through multiple sales channels, including events, partnerships, outbound or thought leadership.

• Strong network or experience selling into large companies within Africa and beyond, and comfort working across multiple markets

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.
Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.

About The Role
**We are currently recruiting for this role in Argentina and Brazil only. We will not be considering US based candidates at this time. All interviews are being held remotely. If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.**
