We are looking for an experienced, analytically rigorous, and collaborative Senior Marketing Analyst to own how Niche measures and improves the performance of its marketing engine, on both sides of the marketplace. This is a senior individual contributor role on the Analytics team, embedded day to day with the marketing and growth teams and reporting to the Manager of Operational Analytics.
The Senior Marketing Analyst is the analytical owner of two connected domains:

•
B2B marketing and pipeline analytics: how marketing-sourced demand becomes qualified leads, opportunities, and closed business.

•
B2C growth and registration analytics: how students and parents find Niche across acquisition channels, register, and convert into engaged users.

This is a deeply embedded role. You will sit in marketing, B2B, SEO, and lifecycle meetings and workflows, develop first-hand awareness of how data is actually being used, where the gaps are, and what's needed before it becomes a problem. You will be a strategic partner to marketing leadership rather than a reporting function: proactively surfacing insights, pairing them with recommendations and clear next steps, and staying with the work through the decision it informs.

What You Will Do

B2B Marketing & Pipeine Analytics

• Build the measurement foundation for how Niche markets to schools and districts: define which metrics matter, how they are calculated, and where the reporting lives, so the business can see what is actually working

• Bring rigor to questions such as which channels and campaigns produce pipeline that closes, what a marketing-sourced lead is actually worth, and where demand generation investment should go next

• Develop leading-indicator reporting that gives marketing and sales leadership early signal on pipeline health rather than a retrospective read

• Own the B2B attribution model in Marketo Measure, including touchpoint and channel definitions and the data flow between Marketo, Salesforce, and Snowflake. Partner with Marketing and Sales to keep campaign tracking and lead and opportunity attribution reliable over time

• Support new business forecasting and pipeline reviews with clear, documented methodology and honest confidence levels

B2C Growth & Registration Analytics

• Own registration and acquisition measurement end to end: registration funnel performance, campaign and channel attribution, and the connection between how a user arrived and what they went on to do on the platform

• Measure paid acquisition efficiency: cost per registration, cost per qualified lead, and how spend translates into users who actually convert. Partner with Growth Marketing on media mix and budget decisions, and build the forecasts behind them

• Serve as the analytical partner to Growth Marketing and Lifecycle: size opportunities, design and read out growth tests, troubleshoot tracking, and maintain the reporting the team runs on day to day

• Build and maintain the marketing dashboards and self-serve views that let growth, lifecycle, and leadership answer their own recurring questions

• Own organic search analytics: measure performance by page type, path, and traffic source (profiles, rankings, entity search), and quantify the impact of product decisions and algorithm updates

• Build the monitoring and daily reporting that surfaces organic traffic shifts before they become surprises, and keep traffic definitions consistent across dashboards and the semantic layer

• Partner with Product and Data Engineering to define the event tracking and data models this measurement depends on

Analytical Rigor & Influence

• Model analytical rigor on marketing data: reproducible SQL, documented methodology, validated results, and a clear line between correlation and causation

• Review and pressure-test analyses from across the analytics team and from business partners, and sharpen how findings are framed and communicated

• Act as the subject matter expert on acquisition-funnel data sources and methodology: when analyses from Business or Product Analytics start at the top of the funnel, make sure they start from the right source, the right definition, and a method that will hold

• Mentor analysts informally and share techniques across the analytics team

• Partner with Data Engineering as the voice of the business: write clear measurement requirements, contribute directly to dbt models and the company-wide self-serve semantic layer, and QA what gets shipped

• Champion AI-assisted analytics in your own work and help colleagues adopt it by building and maintaining the skills, workflows, and context that make these tools reliable on Niche 's data

• Present findings and recommendations to senior leadership with clear insight and a clear "so what"

What We Are Looking For

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Marketing, or a related field. A Master's degree is a plus

• 5+ years of experience in marketing analytics, growth analytics, data analytics, or a closely related data function.

• Demonstrated experience owning marketing measurement end to end, from tracking implementation through to reporting and recommendation.

• Hands-on experience with consumer acquisition data: web analytics and paid media platforms (GA4, Meta, Google Ads, or equivalent), including campaign and channel attribution and its limitations.

• Direct experience with B2B marketing and pipeline analytics: lead and MQL lifecycle, multi-touch attribution, campaign and channel contribution to pipeline, and conversion through to closed business.

• Experience working with marketing automation, CRM, and attribution data (e.g., Marketo, Marketo Measure, Salesforce) and diagnosing problems in how they connect.

• Proven ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insight for non-technical stakeholders, and to say plainly when the data won't support the question.

• Experience in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with shifting priorities, and resilience in the face of ambiguity and change.

• Senior proficiency in SQL; comfortable writing, reviewing, and troubleshooting complex queries independently.

• Strong proficiency in data visualization and dashboarding platforms such as Streamlit, Tableau, Looker, or similar.

• Working knowledge of a modern data stack: Snowflake, dbt, and version-controlled analytics work.

• Comfortable with experimentation and quantitative methods: designing and reading out A/B and growth tests, sizing effects honestly, and knowing when a result is signal and when it isn't.

• A genuine practitioner of AI-assisted analytics: comfortable using tools like Claude Code in your own work, and rigorous about validating what comes back.

• Comfort operating as a senior IC: influencing without authority, working self-directed on complex and ambiguous problems, and mentoring peers.

Nice to Have

• Direct experience with SEO analytics: indexation, page-level organic performance, and technical SEO measurement.

• Experience contributing to a semantic layer or self-serve metrics layer.

• Background in SaaS, education technology, or marketplace analytics environments.

• Experience in the education sector or working with schools and colleges.

Interview Process

postings.title: Senior Product Data Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
About CookUnity :

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About the Role
As a Senior Product Data Analyst , you will be an analytical partner to Product, Design, Engineering, and User Research. You will help teams understand both sides of CookUnity 's marketplace: how customers find meals that fit their lives and how chef supply, variety, and merchandising shape that experience. You will own measurement and analysis for a product area, turn ambiguous questions into testable hypotheses, and use evidence to guide product decisions.
Our teams operate through clear success metrics, rapid learning, and controlled experiments. You will help them distinguish meaningful customer and business outcomes from activity, evaluate tradeoffs across the funnel and customer lifecycle, and make insights accessible in day-to-day decisions. This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role with meaningful autonomy and close cross-functional partnership.

What You'll Do in 12 Months

•
Make the marketplace easier to discover and more relevant: Study how customers browse chefs, meals, cuisines, dietary options, and price points. Analyze the relationship between local assortment, variety, personalization, and ordering behavior. Help Product identify where better discovery or merchandising can improve repeat ordering and retention.

•
Improve the journey from first visit to lasting habit: Map the customer funnel from acquisition through first order, early repeat orders, and longer-term retention. Find friction in onboarding, menu exploration, checkout, and weekly ordering. Segment customers thoughtfully so teams can improve conversion and retention without hiding weak experiences behind averages.

•
Measure product bets with credible experiments: Partner with Product and Engineering to define hypotheses, primary metrics, guardrails, sample sizes, and holdouts for changes to the funnel, personalization, loyalty, and in-product interventions. Analyze heterogeneous effects and uncertainty, and recommend whether to launch, iterate, or stop. When a randomized test is impractical, use the strongest available observational approach and explain its limits.

•
Connect customer value to marketplace economics: Help teams evaluate how product changes affect order rate, churn, revenue per customer, discounts, chef engagement, and unit economics together. For new categories and ordering formats, define the measures that show whether customers find value and whether the model can scale.

•
Reduce the work and stress of ordering: Combine behavioral data with research and customer feedback to understand where subscriptions, delivery information, account management, or support journeys create friction. Measure whether self-service and product improvements solve the underlying problem, not just move contacts to another channel.

•
Build a trusted measurement foundation: Define and document product metrics, cohorts, event tracking, and dashboards. Work with Engineering and Data partners to validate instrumentation and maintain reliable behavioral data. Create compelling dashboards that let product teams explore results, spot meaningful patterns, and monitor outcomes after launch.

•
Shape a focused learning agenda: Work with Product, Design, and User Research to prioritize the most consequential unknowns, design analyses and tests, and tell a clear story about what the team learned. Share methods and review work with other analysts to raise the quality of product analytics across the team.

What Success Looks Like

• Product teams use clear metrics and guardrails to make decisions about discovery, conversion, ordering, and retention.

• Major launches are supported by credible tests or well-explained evidence, including their impact on different customer segments.

• Insights lead to measurable improvements in customer experience and repeat ordering while accounting for marketplace and financial tradeoffs.

• Stakeholders trust and regularly use self-service reporting, and core behavioral data is sufficiently complete to diagnose product performance.

Core Competences/Requirements

• Approximately 5–7 years in product analytics or a closely related analytical role, with demonstrated ownership of complex analyses and influence on product decisions. Equivalent experience and evidence of impact are welcome.

• Practical fluency with AI tools for accelerating analysis, coding, research synthesis, documentation, and repeatable workflows; able to verify outputs and handle company and customer data responsibly.

• Strong SQL and hands-on experience analyzing large, complex behavioral datasets; ability to validate data and write clear, reusable analyses.

• Practical command of product metrics, funnel and cohort analysis, segmentation, and marketplace or subscription dynamics.

• Experience designing and interpreting A/B tests, including holdouts, guardrails, uncertainty, and tradeoffs; sound judgment about causal claims.

• Ability to turn an ambiguous product problem into a focused learning plan, work independently, and communicate an actionable recommendation.

• Clear data storytelling and constructive partnership with Product, Design, Engineering, User Research, and business teams.

• Ability to build powerful, intuitive dashboards in any tool that answer important product questions, reveal actionable insights, and enable trustworthy self-service analysis.

• Ability to evaluate AI-enabled product experiences through clear success metrics, experiments, user feedback, and appropriate quality and safety checks.

• Curiosity about food, chefs, customer behavior, and the practical constraints of operating a local marketplace.

Benefits

💸 Get paid in USD.
🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want.
⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date.

🎄 16 fully paid Argentinean holidays.
🩺 Healthcare Benefit: Monthly stipend to use in your preferred healthcare provider.
🗓️ 5- year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity , you get a 4-week paid sabbatical.

🐣 Paid family leave.
🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises.
🧘🏽‍♀️ Flexible benefits, your way: a prepaid card you can use on wellness, learning, food, and more.
🤖 AI-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster.

🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach.

If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time!

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer . We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates
We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity . We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us:

• Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

• Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page.

• We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.

• We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away.

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

B2B & Lead Gen Vertical Client Delivery:

- Produce pre-sales data profiles that set accurate expectations for what onboarding will require and what measurement programs are viable
Measurement & Meridian Support:
- Support the Measurement team's data readiness requirements for MMM programs, with specific focus on B2B and Lead Gen clients where offline conversion data and long sales cycles create unique modeling challenges
- Own data input preparation for pipeline-focused measurement models — ensuring lead volume, qualified pipeline, and closed revenue data are reconciled, validated, and delivered to spec
- Serve as the B2B and Lead Gen data subject matter expert for incrementality and attribution programs that require clean mapping of marketing touchpoints to pipeline and revenue outcomes
- Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
- Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Role Requirements:

postings.title: General Counsel
postings.descriptionText:
ID5 enables addressable and measurable advertising to support the growth of the digital economy and provide free and safe access to content and services. Technical changes, signal loss, and increasingly more stringent data protection regulations require new, advanced technologies that enable audience addressability while respecting people’s privacy preferences.

ID5 has risen to this challenge and developed solutions that support publishers’ and marketers’ need for better addressability. Its laser focus on Identity sets it apart from competitive solutions and enables the company to offer the most advanced and sophisticated identity services to over 100,000 media properties, and hundreds of technology platforms and advertisers, making it the most adopted identity solution in the market.

About ID5
ID5 delivers Adaptive Identity for omnichannel advertising. We provide intelligent, privacy-first identity infrastructure that turns fragmented signals into scalable and measurable identity solutions across devices and channels. Our technology is trusted across the digital advertising ecosystem, empowering publishers, platforms, and brands to connect with audiences effectively, responsibly, and at scale.

The Opportunity
ID5 is entering an important new phase. Following the acquisition of TrueData, we now operate across three entities in the UK and US with approximately 85 people in 15 countries. We sit at the intersection of digital identity, data protection, software and advertising regulation, so legal judgment is embedded in our products, partnerships and revenue model rather than sitting at the edge of the business.
This is ID5's senior-most legal role and a genuine executive seat. Reporting directly to the CEO & Co-Founder, you will set legal and enterprise-risk strategy, hold final legal sign-off and give the CEO, founders and board clear, decision-ready advice. You will lead a capable in-house team and specialist outside counsel, while remaining close enough to the business to make commercially pragmatic decisions at speed.
Alongside day-to-day legal leadership, you will strengthen the corporate foundations behind ID5's next phase of growth: clear governance, well-managed entities, robust contracts and IP and data rights, and reliable information and decision-making. You will also lead the legal work on strategic partnerships, corporate development and any transactions that arise.

What You'll Do

•
Enable revenue through better contracting. Own the commercial contract architecture across customer and partner agreements, product modules, order forms, DPAs and NDAs; improve templates, playbooks, delegation rules and tooling so routine deals move quickly without the top legal seat becoming a bottleneck.

•
Set ID5's legal and risk strategy. Act as the accountable legal adviser to the CEO, founders and board; surface material risk early, frame the available choices clearly and own final legal sign-off.

•
Lead corporate development and strategic projects. Advise on partnerships, investments, acquisitions, integrations and other strategic initiatives, and ensure ID5's governance, contracts and records allow the company to act quickly and confidently when opportunities arise.

•
Provide the senior legal view on privacy and data protection. Work alongside Product and Engineering, and specialist external counsel, on positions across GDPR, UK GDPR, US state privacy laws, consent frameworks, controller/processor analysis, data transfers and retention, so that privacy by design is built into product and technical decisions and ID5's positions are defensible and commercially workable.

•
Oversee disputes and intellectual-property exposure. Provide the senior legal view on material contentious matters, work with specialist outside counsel on strategy, preservation, discovery and resolution, keep IP and indemnity exposure managed, and make sure the CEO and board have a clear picture of where risk sits and what it may cost.

•
Maintain strong corporate governance. Oversee the group's entities, board materials, delegated authorities, insurance and cross-border structure, while supporting employment, marketing and other enterprise matters where senior legal judgment is required.

•
Build a scalable legal function. Develop the in-house team, set clear ownership between Legal and the business, manage the legal budget and outside-counsel panel, and use process and technology to create a function that scales with ID5.

What We're Looking For

•
You are ready to carry General Counsel-level accountability. You have operated as the senior legal decision-maker in-house, or immediately beneath one with clear ownership of enterprise-critical matters, and are comfortable advising founders, executives and boards.

•
You understand data-intensive technology. You bring strong commercial and regulatory judgment from adtech, digital identity, data infrastructure, privacy technology or a similarly complex B2B software environment.

•
You combine privacy fluency with commercial instinct. You can form defensible positions on novel data-protection questions, or pressure-test positions formed by specialists, and translate them into practical product and contracting decisions rather than defaulting to theoretical or overly cautious advice.

•
You are a proactive, collaborative business partner. Commercial, Product, Engineering and People leaders involve you early because you understand their goals, communicate plainly and help them find a responsible way forward.

•
You know how to direct specialists without outsourcing judgment. You can hold the senior view on material disputes, privacy, IP and corporate matters, use outside counsel selectively and make the final recommendation internally.

•
You build leverage through people and systems. You develop strong lawyers, delegate intelligently, establish useful guardrails and improve how legal work is prioritised, measured and delivered across a fully distributed organisation.

•
You are a qualified lawyer in a relevant jurisdiction. You are admitted and in good standing in the US, UK or another jurisdiction appropriate to advising a UK-parented global technology group with significant US exposure.

Nice To Have

• Direct adtech and identity ecosystem experience, including IAB consent frameworks, digital advertising standards, data marketplaces or data-broker regulation.

• Experience integrating an acquisition across jurisdictions, including entity governance, data integration, commercial migration and employment structures such as EORs or PEOs.

Why You'll Love Working Here

•
A true seat at the table. You will report directly to the CEO & Co-Founder, hold standing access to the board and shape decisions rather than review them after they have already been made.

•
A business where legal judgment genuinely matters. Identity, privacy and responsible data use sit at the centre of ID5's product and strategy, giving Legal a rare opportunity to influence both the company and the wider market.

•
A pivotal corporate chapter. You will strengthen the legal and governance foundations for ID5's next stage of growth and influence the strategic decisions that shape it.

•
Meaningful scope without unnecessary hierarchy. You will lead a focused team, work directly with senior decision-makers and see the impact of your judgment across product, revenue, risk and corporate strategy.

•
The opportunity to build something durable. You will inherit a broad mandate and have the authority to clarify ownership, improve systems and create a legal function that serves ID5 well through its next phase and beyond.

What we offer to our talent

• Remote-first working policy

• A competitive compensation package, including stock options in ID5

• WeWork membership and option to work from different WeWork locations

• Regular offsites to enjoy face-to-face time and to bond further with your colleagues

• A dynamic environment that offers room for growth and development to all employees

• A friendly, international, and multicultural team

• We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are passionate about creating an inclusive environment in which all employees can thrive

More about ID5

Launched in September 2017, ID5 currently employs 80 people and works with premium publishers, ad tech platforms, and advertisers globally. Built to improve addressability across all digital advertising environments, ID5 has rapidly established itself as the most adopted identity solution in the market, prevailing over larger and more established companies thanks to its unique position and focus on providing the best identification and data protection technology.

The company is backed by financial and strategic industry investors who believe in ID5’s vision and plan. This investment has allowed ID5 to expand the business, increase its footprint globally, and hire the best talent to support its ambitious growth plans.

Recognized as one of the most outstanding employers by Digiday’s WorkLife Awards 2023, ID5 is a remote-first company, allowing employees to work from different locations and time zones indefinitely. We equip our team with all the tools needed to perform their work remotely, and we ensure people bond and stay connected thanks to regular all-hands meetings, communication tools such as Slack and Zoom, and by organizing regular offsites around the world. We also offer WeWork membership for those who prefer not to work from home, and allow individuals to move across different WeWork locations. Full Stack Ownership

• Develop and maintain responsive web applications, APIs, databases, and cloud services end to end.

• Ensure application security, performance, and reliability despite the compressed build timeline.

Collaboration & Support

• Mentor other volunteers on AI-assisted development practices.

Required

• Solid full-stack fundamentals (front end: React, Vue, or similar; back end: Node.js, Python, or similar) — enough to review, debug, and correct AI-generated code, not necessarily to write everything by hand.

Skills

Application requirement

postings.title: Staff Network Engineer (AI Fabric, Datacenter and Edge Networking) - Radian Arc
postings.descriptionText:
Location & work modality: Remote
Type of Contract: Full time or Contract

About Radian Arc

We’re specialists in outcome-optimized AI infrastructure - deploying, orchestrating and monetizing GPU compute where data, users and demand actually meet: inside telco networks, at the edge, and in core data centers.Not a generic AI platform. Not a consultancy. We’re the bridge between raw silicon and real-world results.

What impact you will have
Design, implement, and operate the network infrastructure powering the GPU cloud platform, including high-performance AI fabrics as well as classical datacenter networking components such as routing, security, and external connectivity. This role spans both high-performance east-west networking for distributed AI workloads and north-south connectivity, security, and inter-datacenter transport.
As the first dedicated networking role in the organization, the Staff Network Engineer combines Staff-level architectural ownership, technical direction, and cross-functional influence with hands-on execution across design, deployment, troubleshooting, automation, and operational improvement.
The Staff Network Engineer owns the long-term technical direction and operational strategy for Radian Arc ’s AI interconnect networks, designing scalable GPU fabrics and ensuring predictable low-latency performance across distributed training and inference workloads. The role includes designing large-scale RoCE and Ethernet fabrics, guiding architecture decisions, and ensuring operational excellence across global deployments, from hyperscale datacenters to smaller edge locations.
You will collaborate closely with platform, compute, storage, observability, and operations teams to ensure networking is deeply integrated into the overall infrastructure architecture. This role also acts as the senior escalation point for complex networking incidents, driving deep technical investigations and systemic improvements that increase reliability, latency consistency, and operational maturity across the platform.
Because this is currently the primary networking role in the company, the position is intentionally hybrid: you are expected to operate at L6 / Staff in terms of technical direction, standards, cross-team influence, and long-term design, while also directly executing critical networking work that, in a larger organization, would be distributed across multiple engineers.

We expect to hire more than one person for this role so providing you have experience in designing AI Infrastructure networking solutions at scale please do not hesitate to apply if your experience does not match the full scope of the position.

What you’ll do

AI Fabric & HPC Networking

• Design and operate high-performance GPU networking fabrics supporting distributed AI workloads.

• Architect large-scale RoCE fabrics optimized for distributed training and inference.

• Optimize network performance for GPU communication patterns and east-west traffic.

• Design fabric topologies such as:

○ Leaf-spine

○ Fat-Tree

○ Rail architectures

○ Multi-plane

•
• Implement high-performance networking technologies including:

○ RDMA

○ RoCE

○ High-bandwidth east-west fabrics

○ Spectrum-X

• Collaborate with compute teams to support distributed training frameworks and GPU communication libraries.

• Define reference architectures and design principles for AI fabrics so future deployments follow reusable standards rather than one-off implementations.

• Evaluate architectural trade-offs across performance, resilience, cost, operability, and deployment speed, and make clear recommendations to stakeholders.

Datacenter Networking

• Design and operate Layer-2 and Layer-3 datacenter networks.

• Implement scalable routing architectures based on BGP and ECMP.

• Design tenant network isolation mechanisms across multi-tenant environments.

• Implement and maintain:

○ Network bridges

○ Routing stacks

○ Overlay networking systems

• Maintain north-south ingress/egress routing and traffic management.

• Define standards and reusable patterns for segmentation, routing, and overlay integration across platform deployments.

Technologies include:

• VyOS routers

• Linux networking stacks

• OVS / OVN

• BGP / ECMP

• VLAN / VRF segmentation

Security & Edge Connectivity

• Deploy and maintain north-south security infrastructure

• Implement WAF and application-layer protections

• Integrate security controls with platform services

Technologies include:

• Citrix NetScaler / Citrix WAF

• TLS termination

• DDoS mitigation

• API and proxy gateway protection

Inter-Datacenter Networking

• Design and operate private interconnects between datacenters

• Implement and maintain dark fiber ring architectures

• Operate high-capacity WAN connectivity between regions

• Integrate datacenter fabrics into a global backbone network

• Define scalable design principles for backbone evolution, inter-site routing, redundancy, and failure-domain isolation

Technologies include:

• DWDM / dark fiber transport

• BGP inter-site routing

• Redundant fiber ring architectures

• 100–400G optical transport

• Spectrum-XGS

Engineering Execution & Delivery

• Lead end-to-end engineering delivery of networking infrastructure, from design and labvalidation to production deployment

• Validate network BOMs together with procurement and deployment teams

• Provide detailed input into datacenter layouts and rack elevations

• Drive capacity planning, performance modeling, and scaling strategies

• Ensure network changes are executed safely with minimal customer impact

• Act as both the architectural owner and the practical execution lead for critical network initiatives during the build-out phase of the networking function

• Establish deployment standards, validation criteria, rollback approaches, and acceptance patterns that future engineers and teams can reuse

Operational Excellence & Reliability

• Own operational performance and reliability of networking infrastructure

• Drive automation for:

○ Provisioning

○ Configuration management

○ Monitoring

○ Lifecycle management

• Improve day-2 operations through automation and operational tooling

• Lead incident response and root-cause analysis for major network events

• Define and track SLAs, SLOs, and reliability metrics

• Translate major incidents and operational pain points into durable standards, design changes, and long-term architectural improvements

• Establish measurable benchmarks for reliability, latency consistency, operability, and recovery behavior across network deployments.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with infrastructure, platform, SRE, compute, storage, observability, and datacenter operations teams.

• Provide technical leadership across infrastructure initiatives.

• Communicate architectural decisions, trade-offs, and risks clearly to stakeholders.

• Influence the long-term platform networking roadmap and architecture.

• Act as the primary networking design authority across the organization, guiding adjacent teams on how networking constraints and capabilities should shape platform decisions.

• Raise the technical bar by mentoring engineers in adjacent domains and helping build the future networking function.

Technical Stack

Datacenter Networking

• BGP

• EVPN / VXLAN

• ECMP

• VLAN / VRF

• OVS / OVN

• Linux networking

• BlueField DPU

Routing & Control Plane

• VyOS

• BGP-based routing architectures

• ECMP fabrics

Security

• Citrix NetScaler / WAF

• DDoS protection

Transport & Backbone

• Dark fiber

• Metro fiber rings

• DWDM transport

• 100–1600G optical networking

AI Networking

• RDMA

• RoCE

• GPU fabrics

• Large-scale east-west compute networking

• Congestion control

What you'll need

Core Experience

• Strong hands-on experience designing and operating large-scale datacenter networks

• Expert knowledge of modern networking protocols including:

○ BGP

○ OSPF

○ ECMP

○ EVPN / VXLAN

• Proven experience operating high-speed Ethernet networks in production environments

• Experience operating NVIDIA / Mellanox networking platforms

• Experience owning both architecture and direct implementation in lean or fast-scaling environments is strongly preferred

Advanced AI Fabric Networking Expertise
The candidate should have deep expertise in designing and operating networking fabrics optimized for large-scale GPU clusters and distributed AI workloads.
This includes a strong understanding of GPU communication patterns and the networking requirements of distributed training and inference systems.

Relevant expertise includes:

○ NCCL stalls

○ RDMA congestion

○ Fabric hotspots

The candidate should also be able to collaborate closely with compute platform teams to ensure that networking infrastructure is optimized for distributed training, distributed inference, andhigh-throughput AI workloads.

Systems & Troubleshooting

• Ability to debug complex cross-layer issues spanning:

○ Hardware

○ Firmware

○ Distributed application communication layers

• Strong knowledge of networking hardware, optics, and high-speed interconnects.

• Experience designing network observability systems.

• Strong ability to act as the senior escalation point for ambiguous, high-impact, and multi-domain technical issues.

Automation

• Experience applying software engineering practices to infrastructure automation.

• Experience building reusable tooling, standards, or validation approaches that increase leverage across teams.

Leadership

• Proven ability to lead complex technical initiatives across teams.

• Comfortable collaborating across engineering, operations, and vendors.

• Strong systems-level thinking balancing performance, reliability, scalability, and operational cost.

• Demonstrated ability to set architectural direction and drive adoption of engineering standards across an organization.

• Proven ability to lead through technical influence across multiple teams and domains, without relying on formal people management authority.

• Strong mentoring capability and ability to raise the technical level of adjacent engineering teams.

• Able to balance short-term execution needs with long-term platform design, operational sustainability, and cost efficiency.

What we offer

• A great work environment characterised by friendliness, international diversity, flexibility, and a hybrid-friendly approach.

You should be comfortable working across these moving parts while maintaining a high level of accuracy and confidentiality.
You will also have the opportunity to improve existing processes by building smarter spreadsheets, dashboards, templates, and automation that reduce manual work and prevent errors.

Key Responsibilities

Reconciliation & Financial Accuracy

• Perform monthly and quarterly reconciliations across 10+ bank, credit card, HubSpot, and accounting accounts.

• Use Xero to review, categorize, and reconcile business transactions.

• Maintain consistent chart-of-accounts and expense-coding practices.

• Identify duplicate payments, missing transactions, unusual charges, and other discrepancies.

• Ensure supporting documentation is properly maintained and financial records remain complete and accurate.

Aviation Payments & Vendor Management

• Track vendor and customer balances, payment status, invoices, and supporting documentation.

• Manage payments to aircraft operators, vendors, and service providers worldwide.

• Coordinate domestic and international payments, including foreign currency transactions.

• Work with platforms such as Convera to create, track, and reconcile payment orders.

• Monitor recurring vendors and fixed expenses for changes in spending.

• Work with internal teams, vendors, and aircraft operators to resolve payment issues and discrepancies.

• Handle time-sensitive financial issues that may affect active or upcoming flights.

Booking & Financial Operations

• Keep booking and deal records aligned between HubSpot and Xero.

• Update HubSpot deal stages as bookings move from quote to confirmed, invoiced, paid, and completed.

• Maintain booking details including trip dates, routing, aircraft, operator, pricing, and payment status.

• Match bookings to revenue and reconcile HubSpot deal and payment data against accounting records.

• Ensure financial information accurately reflects changes to trips and bookings.

Trip Profitability & Financial Reporting

• Track gross and net margins by trip or flight.

• Monitor trip-related expenses including aircraft charter costs, catering, ground transportation, and other operational expenses.

• Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual expense reports.

• Maintain consolidated financial reporting for leadership.

• Build fixed-cost and vendor variance reports to identify changes in spending.

• Prepare management reports covering expenses, margins, vendor payments, and operational costs.

• Provide leadership with clear financial data to support pricing, vendor, and spending decisions.

Systems & Process Improvement

• Build and maintain Excel and Google Sheets templates, dashboards, and reporting tools.

• Use advanced formulas such as XLOOKUP, VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, and SUMIFS.

• Create pivot tables, data validation rules, conditional formatting, and reporting dashboards.

• Clean and combine data exported from multiple systems.

• Identify opportunities to automate repetitive accounting and reporting processes.

• Improve workflows to reduce manual work, prevent errors, and make financial information easier to access.

• Maintain organized accounting records, supporting documents, and shared folders.

Required Experience & Skills

• 3+ years of professional experience in bookkeeping, accounting operations, or financial analysis.

• Direct professional experience in private aviation, aircraft charter, aviation operations, luxury travel, or a closely related industry.

• Strong hands-on experience with Xero , including:

• Bank feeds, bank rules, and reconciliations.

• Expense coding and chart-of-accounts management.

• Bills, invoices, payments, and supporting documentation.

• Tracking categories for trip- or flight-level reporting.

• Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, Aged Payables, and Aged Receivables reporting.

• Proven experience reconciling 10+ accounts on a monthly and quarterly basis.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets .

• Experience with international payments and foreign currency transactions.

• Strong experience tracking expenses, payments, margins, and financial performance.

• Experience working with CRM or booking systems and keeping operational and financial records aligned.

• Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Exceptional attention to detail and sound judgment when handling confidential financial information.

• Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a remote environment.

• Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated, secure workspace.

Preferred Experience

• Hands-on experience with Convera GlobalPay , including beneficiaries, payment orders, foreign currency payments, approval workflows, and payment confirmations.

• Experience with HubSpot , including deal stages, booking information, contacts, companies, and data exports.

• Experience supporting U.S.-based companies and working with USD accounting.

• Experience building automated financial reports, dashboards, or workflows.

• Xero Advisor Certification.

• Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

Perfect Fit / Culture

• You have genuine experience working within private aviation or aircraft charter operations and understand the financial complexity behind each flight.

• You take full ownership of financial accuracy and do not wait to be told when something looks wrong.

• You notice duplicate charges, missing documentation, unusual transactions, and discrepancies before they become larger problems.

• You are highly organized and can keep multiple accounts, vendors, payments, and flight-related expenses moving simultaneously.

• You communicate proactively with leadership, vendors, operators, and internal teams.

• You look for ways to replace repetitive manual work with better systems, templates, dashboards, and automation.

• You are comfortable working independently while maintaining a high standard of confidentiality and accountability.

Typical Day
You may begin the day reviewing bank and corporate card activity, checking reconciliations, and following up on outstanding vendor or operator payments. You could then update HubSpot booking records, match payment information against Xero, or investigate a discrepancy between a trip's expected and actual costs.
Throughout the day, you may work on trip-level profitability, prepare management reports, reconcile international payments, coordinate with vendors or aircraft operators, and update financial documentation.
You will also spend time improving spreadsheets, dashboards, and accounting workflows so the team can access accurate information faster and reduce manual work.
Because this is a private aviation operation, urgent payment or vendor issues can occasionally arise outside normal business hours. You must be comfortable providing responsive support when a time-sensitive financial issue could affect a client's flight.

postings.title: Director of Technology Operations
postings.descriptionText:
Coinspaid Dev is the engineering brand behind the technology, infrastructure, and R&D expertise built within Coinspaid. With more than 120 engineersand over 11 years of industry experience, Coinspaid Dev brings together software engineering, infrastructure, security and R&D teams with experience building distributed systems and blockchain infrastructure operating across more than 20 blockchain networks.

Coinspaid Dev emerges as an independent engineering brand with a straightforward mission: to advance blockchain infrastructure engineering and contribute practical expertise back to the industry. The structure is new. The experience behind it is not.

Director of Technology Operations

We are building the next operating model for a ~150-person technology organization behind production-critical financial infrastructure.

We are looking for a Director of Technology Operations to lead that transformation.

This is not a traditional infrastructure or IT operations role. The mandate is to evolve Technology Operations from a primarily reactive model toward a scalable organization built around clear ownership, platform engineering, automation, self-service, operational excellence, resilience and measurable outcomes .

You will initially lead several established technology functions through their existing Heads and Leads, with approximately 25 people across Platform/DevOps, Corporate IT and Operational Excellence . The mandate is broader than the initial team size: you will help shape the operating model of a ~150-person technology organization and build capabilities designed to scale significantly beyond today's structure.

Your responsibility will go beyond managing these teams. You will help shape how the broader technology organization operates: how production services are owned, how incidents and changes are managed, how engineers consume infrastructure capabilities, how operational risks are identified, and how recurring manual work is systematically eliminated.

A major part of the role is organizational transformation. We expect you to assess the current model, challenge it where necessary, define the target state, develop the leaders underneath you, and deliver measurable improvements rather than simply introduce new processes.

The goal is straightforward: as the company grows, Technology Operations should become more reliable, resilient and scalable while requiring less manual coordination, less operational toil and less executive intervention .

What you will do

•
Lead the transformation of Technology Operations across Platform/DevOps, Corporate IT and Operational Excellence, moving the organization from reactive operations toward ownership, automation, self-service and measurable outcomes.

• Define the Technology Operations strategy, target operating model, organizational structure, responsibilities, priorities and transformation roadmap.

• Lead multiple established technology functions through Heads, Leads and other managers, creating clear accountability and developing leaders who can operate with increasing autonomy.

•
Lead the evolution of DevOps toward a Platform Engineering model that reduces operational toil, increases self-service and improves developer productivity while maintaining reliability and security.

•
Partner with Engineering to establish a "you build it, you own it" model , where product teams retain ownership of their services in production while Technology Operations provides the platform, standards, tooling and operational framework that enable them to operate reliably.

•
Develop Service Management toward Operational Excellence: strengthen service ownership, incident and problem management, introduce risk-based change governance, reduce unnecessary manual controls, and use operational data to eliminate systemic causes of failures.

•
Transform Corporate IT toward a secure, automated employee technology model , with strong identity and access lifecycle management, device management, governance and employee self-service.

• Continuously assess the current organization, technology landscape and operating model, identify structural and operational gaps, and turn them into concrete improvement initiatives.

• Improve the maturity, reliability, scalability and efficiency of technology operations supporting production-critical systems.

• Define meaningful operational metrics and use them to identify systemic problems, measure transformation outcomes and drive improvements rather than simply report performance.

•
Own the Technology Operations contribution to digital operational resilience , including ICT business continuity, disaster recovery, backup and restoration, resilience testing, recovery objectives, crisis readiness, and remediation of findings from incidents and resilience exercises.

•
Partner with Security, Risk and Compliance to maintain an effective ICT risk management and control environment , including technology risk identification, critical service dependencies, ICT third-party risk, resilience testing, audit readiness and regulatory remediation.

• Ensure operational and technology risks are identified early, understood, prioritized and addressed appropriately.

• Support the company through audits, certifications, regulatory requirements and other controls relevant to financial and technology organizations.

• Own and optimize budgets, technology vendors, infrastructure investments and external partnerships within the function.

• Partner closely with Engineering, Security, Risk, Compliance, Product, Finance and other business functions.

• Represent Technology Operations in cross-functional and executive discussions and communicate complex technology and operational topics clearly to different audiences.

• Help prepare the technology organization for the next stage of the company's growth, including increasingly complex enterprise customers, new products and a larger engineering organization.

What we are looking for

• Significant leadership experience in Technology Operations, IT Operations, Infrastructure & Operations, Platform/Production Operations, Platform Engineering or a comparable technology function.

• Experience as a manager of managers , with responsibility for several teams or functions through Heads, Engineering Managers, Team Leads or equivalent leadership roles.

• Previous experience as a Technology Director, VP/Head of Technology Operations, Platform/Infrastructure leader or in a comparable senior role within a product engineering organization is highly relevant.

• Proven examples of significant organizational or technology transformation: changing operating models, building or restructuring functions, introducing new capabilities, increasing operational maturity, scaling teams or materially changing how technology organizations operate.

• Experience leading or evolving DevOps, SRE or infrastructure capabilities toward Platform Engineering , including developer self-service, automation and reduction of operational toil.

• Strong understanding of modern production ownership models and the relationship between Platform Engineering and product engineering teams.

• Experience with production-critical systems where availability, reliability, security and operational failures have direct business impact.

• Experience with IT and Service Management in modern product/engineering environments, including incident, problem and change management.

• Experience transforming Corporate IT or employee technology environments, including identity/access lifecycle, endpoint/device management, automation, governance and employee self-service.

•
Practical experience with business continuity, disaster recovery and operational resilience in production-critical environments , including BIA, RTO/RPO, backup and restoration, resilience testing and remediation.

• Experience working with Security, Risk and Compliance teams and managing technology and operational risks.

• Exposure to audits, certifications, regulatory requirements and operational controls relevant to financial institutions or other regulated environments.

• Working knowledge of regulatory frameworks relevant to technology operations in financial services, such as DORA, and the ability to translate regulatory requirements into pragmatic engineering and operational controls, is a plus.

• Experience managing budgets, vendors, contracts and technology investments.

• Ability to operate effectively when requirements, organizational boundaries or the final solution are not yet fully defined.

• Track record of developing leaders and building teams that can operate without constant escalation or executive intervention.

• Ability to move between strategic topics and operational problems: understand what requires executive attention, delegate what should be owned by your leaders, and personally step in when the situation requires it.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with technical teams, senior business stakeholders and executive leadership.

Experience in fintech, payments, banking, financial infrastructure or another regulated and production-critical technology environment would be highly valuable.

How we think about this role

We are not looking for a traditional IT or infrastructure leader whose primary focus is maintaining existing systems and following established processes.

We need someone who is comfortable entering an environment where not everything has already been defined — and who sees that ambiguity as part of the mandate.

You should be able to understand how the organization actually operates today, distinguish symptoms from systemic problems, bring the right people together, make decisions with incomplete information, and turn those decisions into measurable organizational and technology improvements.

You will not be expected to solve every problem personally. A major part of your role will be to build strong Heads and Leads who can own their areas independently, while you focus on the most important organizational, strategic and cross-functional challenges.

At the same time, limited resources, legacy approaches or imperfect processes should be constraints to work with — not reasons why progress cannot happen.

What success looks like

Within the first 6–12 months , we expect to see measurable movement in addition to plans:

• reduced recurring operational toil;

• increasing developer and employee self-service;

• stronger and clearer service ownership;

• fewer repeated incidents and systemic operational failures;

• more risk-based and automated change management;

• improved developer and employee experience;

• clearer operational and resilience metrics;

• measurable progress toward a Platform Engineering model;

• stronger operational resilience and risk management;

• and Heads and Leads operating with greater autonomy.

You will have established a clear target operating model and transformation roadmap, but success will not be measured by the existence of the roadmap itself. It will be visible in how the organization operates.

Success means the organization requires less manual coordination and executive intervention while becoming more reliable, resilient, faster and more scalable.

Why join CryptoProcessing by Coinspaid

You’ll be joining a company that is actively shaping its space – with enough scale to matter and enough room to make an impact.

You are the single point of accountability for a clean, on-time go-live: the plan is built correctly, eligibility flows, ID cards and welcome kits land, the member app is configured, and the client knows exactly where things stand at every step.
This is a hands-on, build-the-playbook role. You will run implementations yourself while standardizing how XO does them, so that each one is faster and cleaner than the last. You will work across Commercial, Plan Operations, Claims, Network, IT, and Compliance, and you will be the person clients, brokers, and TPAs trust to get them live.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Client and TPA Onboarding:

• Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new employer groups and TPA partners, from kickoff through effective date and post-go-live stabilization.

• Build and maintain the implementation plan for each client: benefit design and plan documents, group structure, eligibility and enrollment setup, stop-loss coordination, vendor and partner integrations, member communications, and compliance requirements.

• Own the accurate setup of each group across XO’s systems and partner platforms, including benefit configuration, eligibility file testing, ID card and welcome kit production, member app configuration, and any SSO or portal integrations.

• Translate client-specific requirements into clear instructions for internal teams and confirm they are executed correctly before go-live.

Project Management:

• Run the cross-functional implementation team and ensure critical milestones are completed. Surface risks early, resolve blockers, and escalate with a recommendation when needed.

• Coordinate with Claims, Plan Operations, Network, IT, Compliance, and Finance to ensure ownership is properly assigned and dates are adhered to .

• Maintain a regular reporting cadence with leadership and flag anything that puts a go-live at risk.

Client Communication:

• Serve as the primary contact for the client, broker, and TPA throughout implementation. Lead recurring status meetings and keep a clear record of open items and decisions.

• Prepare client-facing implementation documentation, checklists, and readiness sign-offs.

• Hand off cleanly to the ongoing account owner at the end of the stabilization period, with full documentation of the group’s setup and any open items.

Playbook and Continuous Improvement:

• Own XO’s implementation playbook: standard timelines, checklists, templates, and data requirements for employer and TPA onboarding.

• Identify manual steps and failure points in the process and work with Operations and Product to automate or remove them.

• Turn lessons from each implementation into playbook improvements that strengthen the process and enable scale ahead of growth.

EXPERIENCE and EDUCATION:

Required:

• 5+ years in implementation, client onboarding, or project management within self-funded health benefits, TPA operations, or a health plan.

• Working knowledge of self-funded medical and pharmacy plan design, and the compliance landscape that comes with it (ERISA, ACA, CAA, Mental Health Parity).

• Direct experience running complex, multi-party healthcare implementations on a fixed effective date.

• Fluency in the employer and TPA distribution channel, including how brokers, consultants, benefits administrators, and stop-loss carriers fit together.

• Comfort with eligibility files, enrollment data, and system configuration. You do not need to be technical, but you need to be precise and unafraid of the details.

• Clear, concise communicator who can confidently lead client discussions and provide leadership with direct, well-informed answers.

• Establish quality standards: Set evaluation guidelines, documentation, and review practices.

• Mentor and align: Foster evaluation best practices and build a culture of measurable AI quality across the team.

• Track record of quantitative measurement rigor (e.g., LLM/model evaluation, metric validation, or experimentation).

• Strong statistical and ML foundation—you treat evaluations as experiments (sample sizing, confidence intervals, significance, handling non-determinism) and validate automated graders against human ground truth.

• Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience evaluating models in production environments.

• Strong judgment in defining quality metrics and ground truth for ambiguous outputs.

• Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills to align technical teams and leadership.

• Strong problem-solving ability in fast-paced, greenfield environments.

• 6–10 years in quantitative data science or ML, with focused experience in measurement or evaluation. A quantitative degree is a plus; equivalent industry experience is equally welcome.

Nice to Have

• Hands-on LLM/agent evaluation in production, including eval harnesses, LLM-as-judge calibration, and CI regression gates.

• Experience evaluating text-to-SQL, analytics agents, or other systems where correctness is verifiable against data.

• Background in fintech, brokerage, or other domains where a wrong answer has real business or risk consequences.

• Fluency with AI tools in research and engineering workflows.

Leadership & Influence: Proven capability to guide cross-functional technical teams, establish engineering baselines, and drive architectural adoption without direct management authority.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

postings.title: Software Engineer - Platform [IC3]
postings.descriptionText:
Who we are

Our mission is to bring clarity and control to the world's most complex codebases. AI is accelerating code creation, but the infrastructure to understand, oversee, and evolve that code hasn't kept pace. Sourcegraph gives engineering organizations full visibility across their systems, precise context for their agents, and the ability to execute coordinated code changes at scale. As agentic development becomes the dominant engineering paradigm, we provide the context layer teams need to take control of their codebase.

With Code Search, Deep Search, MCP, and Agentic Batch Changes, we deliver on that mission today - giving engineering teams and their AI tools the cross-repo context to navigate massive codebases with confidence, and the ability to make changes across hundreds of repositories at once.

Companies like Stripe, Reddit, and Leidos rely on Sourcegraph to ship faster and with higher quality. We're backed by a16z, Sequoia, and Redpoint, and proud to operate as a globally distributed team that values high agency, direct communication, and customer love.

If you want to build the infrastructure that lets every engineering team - and every agent they deploy - operate on their codebase with confidence, join us.

Hours & location
🌎 While we hire almost anywhere in the world, we have a preference for someone to reside in the following locations for this role. However, if you feel qualified, we welcome you to apply regardless of location. No matter what, working hours must overlap with EST for at least 20 hours/week.

Preferred locations:

• EST

• Europe

Why this job is exciting
Source code is at the heart of Sourcegraph . We support multiple code hosts and retrieve, store, index, and serve source code - to end users, admins, and other internal services.
This role gives you the opportunity to solve complex, challenging, and highly technical problems for our customers, both internally and externally, help unleash the potential and productivity of our Engineering teams, and delight our customers with industry-leading quality software.
The Platform team primarily focuses on building a fully managed platform for using Sourcegraph , Sourcegraph Cloud, our SaaS offering. As a member of the Platform team, you will work closely with both external customers and internal stakeholders to meet their needs. You will:

• Develop inter-cloud connectivity solutions to support enterprise customers from highly regulated industries to use Sourcegraph Cloud.

• Build a control plane to orchestrate a fleet of single-tenant Sourcegraph Cloud instances.

• Expose complex infrastructure as API to support internal customers to iterate faster.

• Dive into upstream dependencies (e.g., CDK for Terraform, Terraform providers for GCP) to debug and patch non-trivial problems.

• Be an advocate for building reliable services and work with leadership to help product teams achieve operational excellence.

• Participate in on-call rotation to uphold our contractual SLA commitments.

📅 Within one month, you will…

• Onboard onto the Sourcegraph architecture, tooling, and development workflow.

• Build a solid understanding of the team’s areas of ownership, technical challenges, and problems the team solves for our customers, and know how all of these align with the top-level company goals.

• Actively participate in team meetings, sharing ideas and insights to contribute to the overall team goals.

• Start contributing to the team goals and deliverables by shipping new features, debugging issues, and fixing bugs.

📅 Within three months, you will…

• Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of the Cloud infrastructure, its underlying technologies, and its integration within the Sourcegraph ecosystem.

• Lead initiatives contributing to team goals through both discovery and delivery phases, collaborating directly with product and design partners, other engineering teams, and non-technical stakeholders from different departments.

• Contribute to the architectural design and implementation of new features or improvements, actively shaping the future direction of Cloud infrastructure based on customer needs.

• Lead initiatives contributing to team goals on the roadmap by going through the entire product development lifecycle discovery, design, implementation, and delivery.

• Participate in our on-call rotation.

📅 Within six months, you will…

• Be defining long-term technical vision and strategies for new product development, scaling existing services, and managing technical debt. These plans will consist of multiple smaller milestones that you will deliver iteratively with the team.

• Collaborate with the Engineering Manager on defining the team’s growth strategy based on the long-term product vision, the technical vision, and the team’s needs.

• Seek feedback from customers and stakeholders to identify opportunities for further improvements or new features, actively iterating on the Cloud infrastructure to ensure it continues to meet our high bar.

About you
You bring a product mindset in balancing architectural flexibility and philosophy with meeting immediate customer demand. You are an experienced software engineer who seeks to solve problems by writing code rather than through one-off operations. You are passionate about user experience and self-service. You balance maintaining and designing high-impact systems with a pragmatic understanding of how to make appropriate tradeoffs (e.g., cut scope, low-tech vs. custom complex solutions) to ship quickly and iterate when necessary.

Qualifications:

• Proficiency in Go, or other strongly typed languages.

• Knowledge in one of the public cloud platform providers (GCP, AWS, Azure)

• Experience with Terraform (or similar IaC solutions) and Kubernetes to build tooling and automation.

• Skilled at debugging distributed systems, followed by designing and implementing solutions to those problems. This means you should know your way around various OS-level primitives, e.g., network, CPU, and memory.

• Ability to communicate clearly and empathetically, especially in writing and documentation.

• Preferred time zone between UTC-8 and UTC+2

Nice to haves:

• Built services and exposed them as API for external consumption (e.g., gRPC).

• Comfortable implementing system-level software (e.g., custom transport protocol) if needed or has contributed to Kubernetes controllers/operators.

• Published blog posts and/or tech talks about your work.

• Experience working on small high-performing teams, preferably tech startups.

Level
📊 This job is an IC3. You can read more about our job leveling philosophy in our Handbook.

Compensation
💸 We pay above-market salaries because we want to hire exceptional people who can focus on building great products, not worrying about paying bills. As an open and transparent company, our compensation philosophy and pay bands are visible to every Sourcegraph teammate, and we strive to make our approach equitable, explainable, and competitive.

Your base salary is determined by the IC3 pay band for your location zone (1-4). Our pay bands are informed by market data and designed to ensure competitive compensation wherever you live. During the recruiting process, we'll discuss the range applicable to you based on job level, relevant skills, experience, qualifications, and location zone.
💰The starting salary for the IC3 pay band in each zone is:

• Zone 2: $148,000 USD

• Zone 3: $111,000 USD

• Zone 4: $74,000 USD

📈 In addition to competitive cash compensation, we offer meaningful equity (because when Sourcegraph succeeds, we want you to succeed, too) and generous perks & benefits.

Interview process
Below is the interview process you can expect for this role (you can read more about the types of interviews in our Handbook). It may look like a lot of steps, but rest assured that we move quickly and the steps are designed to help you get the information needed to determine if we’re the right fit for you… Interviewing is a two-way street, after all!
We expect the interview process to take 4.75 hours in total.
👋 Introduction Stage - we have initial conversations to get to know you better…

• [30m] Recruiter Screen

• [30m] Hiring Manager Screen

🧑‍💻 Team Interview Stage - we then delve into your experience in more depth and introduce you to members of the team, including cross-functional partners…

• [Async] Take-home exercise

• [60m] Take-home exercise walkthrough + System Design

• [60m] Pairing Exercise

• [60m] Resume Deep Dive

• [60m] Cross-functional Team Collaboration Interview / Values Interview

🎉 Final Interview Stage - we move you to our final round, where you gain a better understanding of our business and values holistically…

• [30m] Leadership

• We check references and conduct your background check

Please note - you are welcome to request additional conversations with anyone you would like to meet, but didn’t get to meet during the interview process.

Learn more about us

You can learn more about what it is like to work at Sourcegraph by reading our handbook.

We are an ambitious team who are collectively working hard to build the most influential company in the world. You can read more about our culture, competitive compensation and benefits here.

Sourcegraph is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds.

Sourcegraph participates in E-Verify for U.S. Employees.

The Role

The Maintenance Specialist is a senior member of Doorstead 's Maintenance Operations Team, responsible for resolving our most sensitive, complex, and costly maintenance situations while guiding and supporting Maintenance Coordinators. You will own high-stakes escalations, including habitability issues and time-sensitive or high-cost repairs, and ensure they are handled with urgency, sound judgment, and care for tenants and owners. You will manage vendor relationships, apply strong cost awareness to protect owner value, and turn what you learn into SOPs and best practices that raise the standard for the whole team.

How the Work Flows

• Escalation Intake and Assessment: Take on escalated cases from Coordinators and Tenant and Owner Support Teams. Assess urgency, habitability risk, financial exposure, and the needs of each party before acting.

• Scoping and Cost Review: Evaluate repair scope, compare estimates, and challenge inflated or out-of-scope quotes. Recommend cost-effective solutions and prepare clear, well-supported approval requests for owners.

• Vendor Selection and Management: Assign and direct qualified vendors for complex or urgent work, set expectations on timeline and quality, and escalate or replace vendors who fall short.

• Stakeholder Communication: Lead communication with tenants, owners, and internal teams on sensitive cases, providing clear updates at defined touchpoints and de-escalating where needed.

• Resolution and Quality Assurance: Verify completion through inspection, photos, invoices, and feedback. Confirm the underlying issue is resolved, and close out only when documentation is complete.

• Documentation and Improvement: Analyze escalation trends, vendor performance, and cost patterns. Turn lessons learned into new or updated SOPs, checklists, and best practices, and roll them out to the team.

Responsibilities

• Own and resolve sensitive escalations, including habitability issues, complex repairs, and time-sensitive or costly work, in line with SLAs and compliance requirements.

• Manage communication with escalated tenants and owners, de-escalating tense situations while protecting the relationship and Doorstead 's standards.

• Draft, maintain, and continuously improve SOPs, playbooks, templates, and best practices for maintenance workflows, escalation handling, vendor management, and cost review.

• Identify process gaps and recurring issues, and translate them into clear, actionable documentation that Coordinators can follow consistently.

• Provide day-to-day guidance, coaching, and oversight to Maintenance Coordinators, including case consultation, workload support, and quality reviews of work orders and communications.

• Train and onboard new Coordinators, using SOPs and best practices as the foundation, and gather feedback to keep documentation current.

• Review and approve repair scopes and estimates within defined authority, and recommend cost-saving alternatives without compromising quality or safety.

• Build and maintain strong vendor relationships, including onboarding, performance tracking, rate negotiation, and accountability to quality and timeline standards.

• Track CSAT, SLA adherence, repair costs, and escalation volume, and report on trends and risks to leadership.

• Partner with the Support Teams on complex cases and cross-functional initiatives.

• Embody Doorstead 's values and team culture (Athlete, Lifelong Learner, Troupe, Pioneer).

Requirements

• 2+ years of experience in property management, maintenance coordination, or a similar operations role, including time handling escalations.

• Proven experience managing sensitive or high-pressure situations, including habitability issues and upset parties.

• Strong cost awareness, with the ability to evaluate estimates, spot out-of-scope or inflated quotes, and make sound financial recommendations.

• Demonstrated vendor management skills, including relationship building, negotiation, and performance accountability.

• Experience mentoring, coaching, or informally leading team members.

• Experience writing or improving SOPs, process documentation, or training materials, with the ability to make complex workflows clear and easy to follow.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

• Process-oriented, with excellent attention to detail and documentation.

• Decisive, proactive, and comfortable making judgment calls under time pressure.

• Prior experience as a virtual assistant or remote worker.

• Reliable internet connection.

• Flexible schedule.

Nice to Have

• Experience with work order or property management software.

• Familiarity with SLAs, CSAT, and ticketing systems.

• Working knowledge of habitability standards and landlord-tenant requirements.

• Basic knowledge of building systems and repair trades.

• Experience building process documentation in tools like Notion, Miro, or Google Workspace.

Our Values

• An owner mentality with high empathy and customer obsession

• An athlete mindset focused on deliberate practice and building momentum

• A lifelong learner who has an internal compass and believes in radical candor

• A member of a troupe that believes we’re better together and it is important to be on time, every time

• A pioneer who fearlessly breaks through challenges and believes in working hard, smart, and being disciplined.

Benefits

• Flexibility: We believe in a flexible work-life balance and offer the option to work remotely from anywhere with an internet connection.

• Wellness Leave: International Coordinators will earn eight (8) hours of bonus pay per calendar month to support their ability to take time off for well-being purposes, family-related reasons, sick leave, etc. This wellness bonus will be distributed as four (4) hours of pay included in each of their bi-monthly paychecks, totaling eight (8) hours of bonus pay each calendar month.

• New Parent Leave: As part of Doorstead 's commitment to supporting family formation, we offer ten (10) days of New Parent Bonus for new parent leave. This leave is available to contractors who become parents through adoption or childbirth, providing them with the necessary time off.

Your Role at Cabot
Provides commercial leadership for large, complex accounts of Cabot’s inkjet colorants business in EMEA. Plans and implements sales to major global accounts, developing and maintaining relationships, identifying opportunities, and managing overall account activities. This includes aligning customer needs with the company’s inkjet technology offerings and capabilities, ensuring long-term value creation. The Account Manager will work closely with the Sales Administration and Technical Service Manager in their region while reporting directly to the global Director of Business Development and Key Accounts.
This is a remote position, and we are open to candidates based at one of Cabot's European locations.

How You Will Make an Impact

• Develop and implement regional account strategies using a broad understanding of Cabot’s services and technologies for the inkjet printing industry. Negotiates and administers customer contracts to maximize profitability. Provides commercial leadership for global accounts and strategic customers and coordinates specific marketing, manufacturing, capital investments and quality actions related to these accounts to meet customer’s needs.

• Expand Cabot's market presence by proactively pursuing new business opportunities and converting prospects into long-term customer partnerships.

• Identify emerging market trends and customer needs, translating them into actionable business opportunities for Cabot's inkjet colorant portfolio

• Develops broad contacts throughout the customer’s organization. Maintains customer profiles for competitive analysis. Represents accounts internally and externally to the highest professional standards.
