• Communicates customer goals and objectives with other businesses and plants. Facilitates, coordinates and manages Cabot communications with the customer. Collaborate with technical, marketing, and product development teams to create compelling value propositions that win new business and strengthen customer loyalty

• Monitors competitive activity in each account and ensures that appropriate response strategies are formulated

• Monitors accounts receivable to meet corporate initiatives and handles occasional account escalations.

• Assists in developing the business case for key customer programs such as continuous improvement, quality, new product service initiatives and capital investments.

• Provides business perspective to management of accounts via weekly reports, volume reports and price index.

• Consistent use of Salesforce.com for maintaining up to date “living documents” and contain the ComStrat, Balance of Power and ENS negotiations preparation documents.

What You Will Bring to Cabot

• Technical Excellence. Knowledgeable about Cabot’s technical capabilities in the inkjet market, the applications in which they perform and how they complement performance in the customers’ applications. Strong knowledge of the inkjet value chain, including printhead technologies, ink manufacturers and OEMs.

• Commercial Skills . Knowledgeable of the inkjet markets and applications in which our products add value, and able to effectively capture the value. Proven ability to identify and convert new business opportunities while expanding existing customer relationships.

• Communications & Presentation Skills . Ability to effectively engage in verbal and written communications and presentation that are timely, direct, concise, clear and relevant and delivered with appropriate style and tone and influencing skills at executive, commercial, and technical levels.

• Customer Relationship Management. Establishes and maintains appropriate relationships with customers to enable execution of Cabot’s strategic goals; sees the management of the overall customer relationship as a key component of the role.

• Results Driven . Takes ownership and responsibility for achieving a desired result. Planning, organizing, prioritizing and monitoring to ensure the attainment of business objectives.

• Business Savvy . Knowledgeable about all functional elements that are important for business profitability. Strong financial and business acumen, including forecasting, implementing pricing strategy, and contract management.

• New Opportunity Advancement . Ability to utilize knowledge of Cabot’s capabilities to develop, recognize and advance opportunities where Cabot can provide solutions to customer needs and obtain new business. Experience supporting strategic customers through qualification, commercialization, and scale-up of new inkjet products and platforms.

• Creative Problem Solving. Apply analytical thinking to identify potential solutions to problems; is able to be innovative in identifying new solutions.

• Travel. Willingness to travel internationally as required (50%+).

Education/Experience

• Bachelor/University degree in a Technical field or Business.

• Strong understanding of all aspects of the inkjet printing industry with a solid track record of successfully selling consumables into this industry or similar

• Technical and commercial experience with water-based inkjet colorant dispersions and ink formulation is preferred

• Minimum seven years experience in complex customer account management.

At Cabot, we bring the power of innovative chemistry and a spirit of partnership with our customers to advance solutions that will enable a sustainable future. Our strength in research and development is a major reason why we have been an industry leader for more than 135 years in products such as reinforcing and specialty carbons, battery materials, aerogel, fumed metal oxides, inkjet colorants, masterbatches and conductive compounds.

Our employees around the world are united by our shared purpose: Creating materials that improve daily life and enable a more sustainable future. Through our corporate strategy, “Creating for Tomorrow,” we are focused on our core strengths to lead in performance and sustainability – today and into the future.

Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.
We're taking Keet to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. Product sets the direction. We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up at global scale.
You lead the teams that build Keet's features: the API team, which adds feature-focused APIs to Keet's core, and the frontend team, which builds the React app on top, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar. The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product.
You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for distributed, local-first systems, so you can work fluently on top of a P2P engine without needing to build it yourself.

Responsabilities

Engineering

• Run the API and frontend teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.

• Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.

• Own the technical design of features and the API surface between Keet's core and the app.

• Make sure the API team works closely with our deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches the engine.

• Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially where P2P opens doors that centralized apps can't.

• Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them.

Leadership

• Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.

• Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.

• Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.

Requirements

• Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally in chat, calling, or social apps.

• Strong product sense: you can tell a good feature from a busy one.

• Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. Offline-first and eventual consistency should feel natural. You don't need P2P protocol expertise, because our core abstracts it away.

•
Deep JavaScript and React.

• Initiative, curiosity, resilience, and the ability to give and receive direct critique.

• Bonus: experience with local-first apps, CRDTs or sync engines, offline-capable mobile or desktop apps, or open source.

postings.title: Financial Controller (Director)
postings.descriptionText:
Namecheap is in the business of opening doors to online success. We make it easy for anyone to build a winning web presence — with simple domain registration, affordable hosting, trusted security and privacy products, and an award-winning customer service team available 24/7. As proud advocates for online privacy and net neutrality, we put clients first — which is why we're one of the web's largest registrars, with millions of happy customers and over 32 million domains under management (and counting).

About the role
Now, as we enter an ambitious new stage of growth, we're looking for a Financial Controller to own the integrity of our financial reporting and transform how it's produced. This is a hands-on build-and-lead role: modernizing our systems, bringing the accounting function to full US GAAP rigor, and building a leaner, more automated finance organization, reporting directly to the CFO.

Why this role
Most Controller roles are about keeping the financial engine running. This one is about rebuilding and fine-tuning that engine so we're ready to scale commercially.
You will rebuild our accounting function from first principles, with the resources of a profitable, PE-backed company behind you. For a finance leader who would rather design the system than inherit it, that combination is rare:

• A genuine greenfield build: Rebuild the accounting function from the chart of accounts up — systems, close, controls, and reporting — and bring it to full US GAAP rigor as we scale.

• Own the technology: Move us off legacy tooling onto a modern, AI-native ERP, and design an operating model built around automation from day one.

• AI-native by design. Build a lean, senior team modeled on the most automated finance orgs in tech — where expert people focus on judgment and impact, and AI handles manual work.

• Real ownership, and a career-defining role: Own the accounting function end to end, lead an established team, and partner with the CFO as they focus on strategic finance and treasury—building the experience that prepares you for your next leadership role.

• Startup-like canvas, scale-up rewards: The build-from-scratch experience of an early-stage company, with compensation set well above typical early-stage benchmarks, plus potential equity in a business entering its next growth phase.

What you’ll own

Accounting & Close

• Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close, delivering accurate, timely consolidated financials.

• Own the general ledger, technical accounting, and financial reporting — including revenue recognition across domains, renewals, hosting subscriptions, and marketplace/auction transactions; deferred revenue; and multi-currency and intercompany accounting.

• Oversee accounting across diverse payment rails (cards, PayPal, crypto, bank transfer) and reconcile high-volume, low-value transaction flows.

• Design and run an internal controls framework across multiple entities, currencies, and jurisdictions — right-sized to our stage.

• Prepare board- and sponsor-ready reporting, partner with FP&A on variance analysis, and manage relationships with external auditors, tax advisors, and banking partners.

Rebuild & Transformation

• Re-architect the accounting foundations from first principles and bring the function to full US GAAP rigor.

• Partner with the CFO to select a modern, AI-native ERP, then lead the end-to-end implementation — design, data migration, testing, and go-live — moving us off legacy tooling.

• Re-engineer close, reporting, and controls to be scalable, automated, and audit-ready as the business grows.

• Lead change management across finance and adjacent functions (revenue operations, billing, product) and manage the transformation to measurable outcomes.

An AI-First Operating Model

• Build accounting operations around automation from the ground up — close automation, reconciliation, anomaly detection, and AI-assisted reporting and analysis.

• Design a lean, high-seniority team where experts focus on judgment and impact while AI handles the manual work, moving beyond a traditional monthly-close cadence.

• Evaluate and adopt emerging finance-AI tooling, consistent with the AI-embedded philosophy already built into our own products.

Team Leadership

• Lead and develop an established accounting team, reshaping structure and ownership as the operating model evolves.

• Set the standard for a build-first culture — clear processes, strong documentation, and continuous improvement over legacy manual habits.

What you’ll bring

• Big Four foundations: You trained at a top-tier global accounting firm, ideally with multi-entity consolidations and multi-currency environments and US GAAP exposure.

• CPA, or an equivalent international qualification (e.g., ACCA, CA).

• 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including time as a Controller or Assistant Controller.

• Deep technical accounting expertise: ASC 606 (multi-element, marketplace, and subscription revenue), ASC 350 (goodwill, intangibles, and capitalized software), ASC 830 (multi-currency operations), and ASC 805 (business combinations) — with the judgment to handle what's not in the textbook (e.g., crypto payment accounting under ASU 2023-08).

• Hands-on ERP implementation experience : You’ve led or heavily contributed to a major ERP rollout, not just operated within one.

• Experience in high-volume, low-ACV transaction flows (e-commerce, subscription, SaaS, or marketplace) is a strong plus.

• A first-principles builder : You’d rather design systems than maintain them, and you’re energized by ambiguity and a blank canvas.

• A proven transformation and change leader with specific processes you’ve rebuilt, systems you’ve implemented, and teams you’ve upskilled.

• A genuine AI-native mindset : Real experience automating finance workflows, and a clear point of view on where AI creates leverage in close, reporting, and controls.

• Comfort with the control and audit rigor of a larger or public company — and the judgment to right-size it for our stage.

What success looks like in year one

• A new or significantly re-architected ERP live and stable, with the accounting team fully transitioned onto it

• A documented finance transformation roadmap with clear milestones beyond year one

• Close is faster and materially less manual, with automation embedded across reconciliation and reporting.

• A strengthened internal controls framework appropriate to our scale and transaction complexity

• The accounting foundations are rebuilt to full US GAAP rigor, from the chart of accounts up.

• The team is reshaped into a leaner, more senior structure with clear ownership.

• You’ve built a trusted partnership with the CFO, executive leadership, and CVC.

Highlights
100% remote Financial Controller modernizing systems, strengthening US GAAP rigor, and reporting to the CFO. Working hours: overlap between US Eastern Time and EU business hours.

Jeeves is the stablecoin-native banking platform for global enterprises. Thousands of companies across 35 countries run their corporate cards, payments, treasury and spend on one platform, with more than $5B in annualized volume, payouts to 190 countries, and one of the fastest-growing stablecoin payment networks in the world. BMW, H&M, Lululemon, Burger King, Kavak and XP are among them, and more than 80% of customers use multiple Jeeves products.

We chose hard problems on purpose.
We hire for one thing: relentlessness. A strong motor that keeps going when the problem has no playbook. You'll know in your first week if Jeeves is right for you. For the right people, it's the steepest learning curve of your career.
Jeeves has raised more than $400 million in equity funding from Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Coinbase Ventures, GIC, AllianceBernstein, CoinFund and others.
If you want to rebuild how money moves across borders, come build it with us.

Jeeves extends credit to thousands of businesses across Latin America and beyond, and the quality of those decisions depends on the quality of our data. Our Credit & Analytics team has a clear roadmap: reliable portfolio monitoring, better risk models, and more automated credit decisioning. All of it depends on first getting our data foundation right — connecting and maintaining external data sources and cleaning up customer data consents — and today that work competes with day-to-day execution for the same few people.

We're looking for a hands-on Senior Business Analyst to own that foundation and build on it. In your first months you'll lead the work to connect and validate external data (bureau, banking, open finance and tax data), clean up consent records so we can use that data reliably, and turn manual processes into repeatable ones. From there you'll use that data to shape credit policy: underwriting criteria, credit limit strategies, portfolio monitoring and early-warning signals that help us catch losses before they happen.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who likes to get into the data themselves. You'll partner closely with data science, engineering, product, collections and sales, and your work will directly shape how Jeeves makes credit decisions as we scale. It is not a people-management role today.

Location : This is a full-time remote position.

What You'll Do:

Data Foundation

• Lead the integration and validation of external data sources — credit bureaus, bank and open finance data, tax and financial data — partnering with engineering on pipelines and data quality

• Own the cleanup of customer data consents and connections so external data can be pulled and refreshed reliably and in line with local requirements

• Replace manual credit and portfolio processes with repeatable, documented SQL/Python workflows

• Define data quality checks and documentation so the team can trust what it's looking at

Credit Policy & Strategy

• Use internal performance and external data to develop and refine underwriting criteria and credit limit strategies

• Design customer management strategies, including credit line increases, decreases and reinstatements

• Identify high-risk customers early and build processes to mitigate losses

• Partner with Sales and Business Development so growth strategies stay consistent with Jeeves 's credit policy

Portfolio Monitoring & Collections Support

• Define portfolio KPIs and build dashboards to track portfolio health and strategy performance

• Build early-warning signals and monitoring routines that flag deteriorating accounts

• Give Collections the segmentation and prioritization insights they need to improve recovery

• Contribute to loss forecasting and risk-adjusted return analysis with Finance

Models & Automation

• Apply statistical methods (logistic regression, segmentation, clustering) to uncover risk drivers and inform strategy

• Develop, validate and monitor credit risk models

• Help define the rules and data requirements for automated credit decisioning with Product and Engineering

• Translate model results into clear recommendations for credit leadership and business partners

Working With AI

• Use AI tools to support your analysis, and verify their outputs against source data

• Suggest and help build improvements to our AI workflows as you see what works and what doesn't

Minimum Requirements:

• 3–7 years of analytics experience in credit risk, with hands-on work on commercial or SMB credit in cards, payments, lending or a related industry

• Advanced SQL — you write your own queries against large, messy datasets and are comfortable validating data quality

• Working proficiency in Python for analysis and statistical modeling (regression, segmentation, clustering)

• Experience with version control (e.g., GitHub) for sharing and maintaining code is a plus

• Able to work independently and take ownership

• Direct experience working with external or alternative data sources (bureau, banking, open finance, tax or similar), ideally including integrating or cleaning them

What is the purpose of this role?

We're looking for a Visual Designer to bring DOOR 's brand to life across marketing, sales, and product touch points. You'll own a wide range of creative projects, from marketing campaigns and trade show materials to product packaging and our website, while building tools and templates that empower teams across the company to create consistent, on-brand materials.

What is the role?

The Visual Designer is responsible for creating and maintaining engaging, on-brand visual content across digital, print, and physical channels. This role partners closely with Marketing, Sales, and Product teams to develop creative assets, support company initiatives, and ensure brand consistency. The position also focuses on improving design efficiency through scalable templates, self-service tools, and creative solutions.

Reporting Structure: Reports to the Director of Product Design

Who is DOOR ?

DOOR (formerly Latch) is unlocking the next era of Building Intelligence. We combine premium hardware, intuitive software, and automated operations into one seamless platform—helping multifamily properties run more efficiently, grow revenue, and deliver smarter, more connected living experiences. From smart access and in-unit automation to building-wide controls, DOOR empowers owners, operators, and property teams to reduce overhead, protect asset value, and stand out in a competitive market.

We believe smarter buildings make life simpler. At DOOR , you’ll help shape a future where buildings anticipate needs, operate effortlessly, and quietly improve life for everyone inside.

What will you do?

• Design marketing emails, campaigns, and landing pages

• Create trade show booths, signage, and event collateral

• Design packaging and instructional materials for hardware products

• Produce sales materials: decks, one-pagers, case studies

• Support the product design team with illustrations, graphics, and Lottie motion assets

• Design, build, and maintain the corporate site and landing pages in Webflow

• Build and maintain self-service creative tools (deck builders, social asset generators, templates) so teams can create on-brand assets on their own

• Help evolve and enforce brand guidelines across all output

What do you bring to DOOR ?

• 3+ years in visual, brand, or marketing design (in-house or agency)

• A portfolio showing range across digital, print, and physical

• Expert in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite

• Creativity and fluency in building with AI

• Motion design skills, ideally After Effects to Lottie

• Experience designing print production files (packaging, large format)

• Comfortable juggling multiple deadlines and stakeholders

• Systems thinking: you build templates and tools, not just one-off assets

DOOR understands that job requirements sometimes exclude people who identify with historically marginalized groups from applying to jobs for which they are qualified. Even if you don’t meet 100% of the requirements listed, or if you achieved these requirements through unconventional channels, we encourage you to apply.

What is required?

•
Location: Fully remote, home-based position in SA. Confirm whether we should exclusively target and post solely in SA.

•
Working Hours: Must align with the U.S. Eastern/Central business hours.

•
English Proficiency: Fluent written and spoken English required.

• Contractor Responsibilities: Candidates will be responsible for managing their own taxes in their country of residence

•
Employment Arrangement: Independent contractor (1099) arrangement.

Joining us means:

• Having teammates all over the world in the US, Argentina, Spain and Romania.

• Collaborating in a fast-paced environment where you can apply what you have learned in new challenges, and, more importantly, grow your career.

• Being encouraged to invent and innovate within your role and working in a company where calculated risk-taking is highly encouraged and thinking outside the box is a must.

Attention Job Seekers: Beware of job scams!

Job scams are on the rise, and you should take steps to protect yourself in your job search. Here are some guidelines to help you stay safe if you are applying for a job with Latch or DOOR :

• Communications from Latch or DOOR will always come from @ or @. Do not accept a job interview invitation with Latch or DOOR from anyone who does not contact you through an email that comes from @ or @.

• Latch never interviews candidates via Skype or in writing where you do not see the interviewer. All of our interviews happen either by video or in person.

• We will never offer you a job based on a single conversation with someone claiming to be from our People organization. In all of our job interviews, you will always speak, by video or in person, with the hiring manager for the position.

• Do not share your sensitive personal information with anyone who purports to offer you a job at Latch or DOOR unless you verified that the offer is from Latch or DOOR (check email senders addresses). We will never ask you for your bank account information or your mother’s maiden name during the interview process.

• We will never ask you to purchase any equipment with a promise that we will reimburse you after you begin working for us.

• If you believe you were a victim of a job scam, you may report it to the FBI:.

RTS is seeking an organized, proactive, and results-driven Project Manager to lead projects from planning through successful completion. The Project Manager will be responsible for coordinating project activities, managing timelines and deliverables, engaging stakeholders, identifying and resolving risks, and ensuring projects are delivered on time and in alignment with business objectives.

postings.title: Senior Geospatial Software Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
RYZ Labs is seeking a Senior Geospatial Software Engineer to help build and evolve a platform that works with complex construction and location-based data.
This role combines strong software engineering skills with practical experience handling maps, coordinates, geometry, and geospatial information . You will be involved in building the systems that transform information from construction documents into accurate, usable geographic data that can support real-world field operations.

What You'll Do

• Design, develop, and maintain production systems while contributing to technical architecture and engineering decisions.

• Build functionality around maps, geographic coordinates, spatial relationships, and geometric data.

• Develop solutions that can extract, process, validate, and transform geometry from unstructured or semi-structured documents.

• Work on functionality involving geographic measurements, distances, routing, asset locations, and other location-based calculations.

• Translate real-world geographic information into reliable data that can be visualized, measured, and used in the field.

• Handle imperfect data sources, including inconsistent formats, incomplete information, and ambiguous inputs.

• Establish approaches that prioritize data accuracy and clearly identify cases where a reliable result cannot be produced.

• Contribute to code reviews, engineering standards, testing, and continuous integration practices.

• Help improve system reliability through monitoring, observability, and safe failure mechanisms.

• Take increasing ownership of technical decisions and architectural areas as the product and engineering team grow.

What We're Looking For

•
5+ years of professional software engineering experience , with a track record of taking ownership of technical decisions and production systems.

• Strong hands-on experience with TypeScript and Node.js .

• Previous experience developing software involving GIS, mapping, coordinates, geometry, or other geospatial data .

• Practical knowledge of one or more areas such as GeoJSON, KML, GIS platforms, routing, mapping systems, fleet tracking, logistics, agriculture, drones, or location-based applications .

• Experience processing data that may be incomplete, inconsistent, noisy, or difficult to interpret.

• Strong attention to accuracy, data integrity, and system correctness , particularly when software outputs impact real-world decisions.

• Ability to reason about edge cases and design systems that behave safely when information is insufficient or uncertain.

• Strong written and spoken English communication skills .

• Comfortable working independently in a remote and distributed engineering environment.

Nice to Have

• Experience or education related to civil engineering, surveying, construction, asphalt, or estimating .

• Familiarity with construction concepts such as plans, alignments, stationing, quantities, and pay items .

• Experience working with routing, logistics, hauling, or distance calculations .

• Exposure to DOT bid packages or construction documentation .

• Familiarity with construction estimating platforms such as Bluebeam, B2W, HeavyBid, or HardDollar .

• Experience with 3D geospatial information , including terrain models, surface models, point clouds, or cut-and-fill calculations.

• Experience with technologies such as Turf.js, proj4js, PostGIS , or similar spatial libraries and databases.

What You'll Own
As you grow into the role, you will take ownership of important areas of the platform, including:

•
Geospatial capabilities: how the product represents, processes, measures, and exports geographic information.

•
Map and geometry workflows: transforming information extracted from documents into accurate real-world coordinates and usable geometry.

•
Distance and routing functionality: supporting location-based calculations and hauling-related use cases.

•
Core engineering: production code, technical design, architecture, and key engineering decisions.

•
Reliability and quality: code reviews, testing, observability, monitoring, and engineering standards.

•
Data correctness: ensuring the platform can distinguish between reliable results and situations where available information is insufficient.

About RYZ Labs
RYZ Labs is a startup studio founded in 2021 by two lifelong entrepreneurs with extensive experience across technology and consumer businesses. The company brings together talented professionals across the US and Latin America to build and scale technology companies.
Our teams are remote and distributed across the US and Latam, working with modern technologies to develop scalable, resilient products across different industries.
At RYZ Labs, you'll have the opportunity to work with a high degree of autonomy, take ownership of meaningful projects, and collaborate with experienced professionals. You'll be exposed to challenging technical problems while continuing to develop your skills in a fast-moving startup environment.

• Flat-rate pricing

Their customers expect polish, and so does the owner. This role is for someone who wants to own the office, not just support it.

What you’ll own

The phones. You are the first voice customers hear. You answer and book calls for service, emergencies (no heat, active leaks, no hot water) and estimates, calmly and professionally.

Scheduling and dispatch. Build and manage the technicians’ daily schedules, re-route them when emergencies come in, and keep customers updated on arrival times. The owner should not have to step in.

Job tracking. Track every job from booking through completion and invoicing, and flag any job that’s stuck, on hold or at risk of slipping.

Compliance and admin. Handle permits, certificates of insurance (COIs), licenses and technician paperwork accurately and on time.

Payroll. Prepare accurate payroll every pay period.

Reporting. Send the owner a weekly report covering calls, booking rate, job completion, backlog, AR aging and memberships.

Systems and team. Keep the field service software (Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan or similar) clean and accurate. Support hiring and onboarding, and manage any office staff added as the company grows.

How you’ll be measured

• 95%+ of calls answered

• Every new lead contacted within 5 minutes

• 75%+ of qualified leads booked

• Every open estimate followed up on time, per the SOP

• Membership sign-ups and renewals on target

• AR kept within target, with nothing aging without action

• A weekly list of stuck or on-hold jobs, sent with zero surprises

• Payroll, permits and paperwork done right and on time, every time

You’ll succeed here if you have

• 2+ years in office management, dispatch, customer service or operations coordination, ideally in plumbing, HVAC or other home services

• Hands-on experience with Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, Jobber or a similar platform

• Excellent spoken English and a confident, warm phone presence

• High drive and high attention to detail. You follow through without being chased.

• The ability to juggle phones, schedules and follow-ups at the same time without dropping anything

• Availability to work US Eastern business hours

Nice to have

• Direct plumbing or HVAC experience, especially with emergency dispatch or maintenance memberships

• Experience with payroll, AR or basic job costing

• Experience managing a small remote team

• Up to $1600/mo depending on experience

• Guaranteed annual bonus of one month's salary

• Performance-based annual bonus up to 1.5x one month's salary contingent on quarterly performance scores

• Comprehensive health benefits, including dependents: health, life, vision and dental insurance.

• 16 days PTO

Note:
The Client is not involved in compensation or benefits. As an employee of Offshore Launch , all compensation and benefits are to be provided by the Agency.

postings.title: B2B Lead Generation Specialist (Staffing & BPO)
postings.descriptionText:
About Bamboo Works
Bamboo Works helps growing companies and ambitious entrepreneurs build global teams without handling recruitment themselves. We place vetted, English-fluent professionals, from service and support staff to accountants, engineers, and marketers, who work as part of our clients' onshore teams. Our services range from single specialist placements to fully managed offshore departments and recruitment-as-a-service. We've served 200+ clients so far and invest in our people through our own AI Academy. We were built remotely on purpose, and we care about the quality of each hire more than the number of hires.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for an exceptional Lead Generation Specialist to fuel our growth by connecting us with the companies that need great offshore teams the most.

If you're passionate about finding opportunities others miss, starting meaningful conversations, and helping businesses grow through great people, we'd love to hear from you.

The Role
As a Lead Generation Specialist , you'll own the top of our sales funnel, from identifying the right companies through booking qualified meetings for our sales team. You'll build a predictable pipeline from scratch, targeting companies that could realistically hire offshore staff, and find the buying signals that show when a business is ready to build a remote team.

This is a highly autonomous role where you'll work closely with our sales team and internal leadership to test new channels, refine our ideal customer profile, and hand over opportunities that are warm, qualified, and ready to close.

Your success will be measured not only by the number of qualified meetings you generate, but also by the quality of those opportunities, your creativity in finding new ways to reach prospects, and the long-term clients they turn into.

Role Details
Commitment: Part-Time/Full-Time
Working Hours: Flexible with overlap across international clients
Location: Fully Remote
Engagement: Independent Contractor
Start Date: ASAP
Monthly Rate: Competitive rate based on experience, consisting of base pay + high incentives
What You'll Do

• Build a steady flow of qualified meetings with companies looking to hire offshore staff.

• Define and refine the ideal customer profile. Spot buying signals (hiring activity, growth triggers, operational strain) that show when a company is ready to offshore.

• Run outreach across email, LinkedIn, phone, and less conventional channels. Test, measure, and double down on what converts.

• Qualify and warm up prospects so our sales team receives opportunities that are ready to close.

• Keep our CRM clean and accurate. Report full-funnel metrics from first touch through closed client, and use them to improve results month over month.

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

• At least 3 years in B2B lead generation, with a proven record of generating clients for a staffing, recruitment, outsourcing, or BPO firm itself (not for one of its clients).

• You can share real funnel numbers, including outreach volume, reply rates, meetings booked, show-up rates, and closed clients, as well as the KPIs you were held to.

• You can build targeted lead lists and find buying signals on your own. You're creative with outreach and don't depend on an expensive stack of paid tools.

• You have hands-on experience with at least one CRM (e.g., GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce, Zoho) and keep detailed, up-to-date prospect and opportunity records.

• You write and speak English excellently, and you're comfortable owning targets independently in a fully remote setup.

Nice-to-Haves

• Experience running qualification or discovery calls before handing prospects over to sales

• Familiarity with the Western SMB market (US, UK, EU, AU) and its offshore hiring needs

• Experience with cold calling or appointment-setting software

• Experience with corporate markets, such as accounting

• Uses AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Clay, etc.) to speed up research and personalization

• Experience with outreach beyond cold email and LinkedIn, such as partnerships, referrals, events, communities, or content-led prospecting

Ideal Candidate Profile

This role is ideal for someone who:

• Is driven by targets and motivated by seeing the pipeline grow.

• Takes ownership of results rather than waiting for leads to come to them.

• Spots opportunities and buying signals that others miss.

• Thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where you're building from scratch.

• Handles rejection with resilience and keeps outreach consistent day after day.

• Gets creative with outreach instead of relying on expensive tools or one-size-fits-all templates.

• Balances high activity with high-quality, well-qualified opportunities.

• Is data-driven, tracking every number in the funnel and using it to improve.

• Enjoys starting conversations with business owners and understands how great offshore talent helps companies grow.

Why Join Bamboo Works ?

• Join a growing international company with ambitious expansion plans.

• Work directly with businesses across multiple industries and countries.

• Build meaningful, long-term client relationships where your work has visible impact.

• Collaborate with a supportive, high-performing remote team.

• Enjoy a high degree of autonomy, trust, and ownership in your role.

• Benefit from a competitive base salary plus high incentives.

• Work directly with company founders

Recruitment Process

• Initial Interview

• Interview with the Founders

• Offer & Onboarding

We are moving beyond send and receive. On our new app infrastructure, MoneyGram is becoming a multi-product financial super-app – bringing together money transfer, balance, bill pay, mobile top-up, and marketplace offers into a single, seamless digital experience. Balance is the newest of those products, the least proven, and the one we most need to get right.

The Opportunity
Millions of customers use MoneyGram Online to send money. Now they can use MoneyGram for so much more – including Balance, our stored-value account, which is live, early and not yet adopted at the rate it should be.
The Director of Balance & Emerging Products owns the business side of everything MoneyGram Online does that is not money transfer: Balance, Domestic and International Bill Pay, and Mobile Top-Up. Balance is the priority. Your first job is to work out who it is for, why they are not using it, and what has to change — then prove it with a cohort that repeats and build the go-to-market motion that scales it.
This is not a product role. Product leads own the roadmaps. This is the commercial seat: market selection, pricing, adoption and the cohort economics that tell us whether growth compounds. If you think in LTV and stacked cohorts, and you have taken a consumer financial product from early to working, this is an opportunity to launch something zero to one on top of a customer base most fintechs spend years trying to build.

What You Will Do

Cross-Product Growth

• Own the business strategy for Balance, Domestic Bill Pay, International Bill Pay and Mobile Top-Up, partnering with each product lead.

• Identify where customers are dropping off or not adopting additional products, and work with product and CRM to address friction.

• Represent the customer perspective in product prioritization discussions — connecting roadmap decisions to retention and ARPU outcomes.

• Partner with the Global CRM and Marketing leads to design lifecycle journeys, cross-sell campaigns, and re-engagement programs.

• Primary early focus will be launching our new flagship product Balance – defining the business model, diagnosing current adoption challenges, and building the first cohorts of customers.

30/60/90-day success milestones

Success in This Role

ABOUT THE ROLE
Rootstock Capital is building a BTC capital markets business, and we're hiring a small, senior team of two to three people to shape, grow and deliver it. As Director of Risk Management , you'll build and lead Rootstock Capital's risk function. You'll own the risk framework across market, credit, counterparty, liquidity, operational and protocol risk, spanning BTC, digital assets and traditional finance, and covering OTC, bilateral and exchange-traded activity. You'll be a founding member of the team, working alongside the VP Fund Management.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Risk framework and governance

• Design and own Rootstock Capital's risk framework: risk appetite; exposure, concentration and leverage limits; liquidity buckets; collateral haircuts; margin and drawdown triggers; and escalation procedures.

• Give independent risk sign-off on new strategies, products, venues and counterparties before launch.

Risk modelling and analysis

• Build the models and analytics that measure market, credit, counterparty, liquidity and protocol risk across traditional and digital positions, including VaR, scenario analysis and stress testing.

• Stress-test the portfolio against BTC price shocks, liquidity crises, venue or counterparty failure, depeg events, protocol exploits and liquidation cascades.

• Model and evaluate complex transactions (secured lending, repo, basis and derivatives, structured products) and assess how risks interact and compound across on-chain and off-chain components.

• Monitor positions and exposures daily, and flag early when outcomes drift from limits or assumptions.

Counterparty and credit risk

• Lead counterparty, venue and protocol due diligence: creditworthiness, custody arrangements, and smart-contract, bridge, oracle and governance risk.

• Set and monitor counterparty limits, collateral eligibility and margin terms.

Legal and transaction documentation

• Review and negotiate the risk terms in fund, OTC and bilateral documents (ISDA/CSA, lending and repo agreements, collateral and margin terms, termination events and close-out provisions) with the Fund Asset Manager and legal counsel.

Operational risk, controls and compliance

• Design operational risk controls across the trade lifecycle, settlement, reconciliation, custody and treasury that scale with both traditional and digital asset activity.

• Shape the processes that connect risk, execution and finance across digital and traditional OTC, bilateral and exchange-traded transactions.

• Work with compliance, legal, the fund administrator and auditors on regulatory obligations, audits and reporting.

Product delivery

• Work with the Fund Asset Manager and commercial, technology, legal and compliance teams to take new products from idea to launch, making sure they are investable and structurally sound.

WHAT YOU BRING

• Postgraduate degree in Finance, Computer Science or Mathematical Finance, plus a professional qualification in finance or risk (CFA, FRM, PRM or equivalent).

• 10+ years in risk management at asset managers, funds, banks, trading firms or digital asset businesses, including several years leading a risk function.

• Deep capital, asset and risk management experience across BTC, digital assets and traditional finance, including DeFi protocol risk.

• Strong financial modelling and risk analysis skills (stress testing, scenario analysis, VaR) across traditional and digital instruments, with hands-on Python, R or SQL.

• Hands-on experience designing operational risk controls across the trade lifecycle, custody and treasury for OTC, bilateral and exchange-traded activity.

• Experience reviewing and negotiating risk terms in fund, OTC and bilateral documents, and working within fund regulatory and compliance requirements.

• Proven leadership of high-performing teams, and the ability to explain complex risk clearly to boards, investors and regulators.

Competitive compensation package and unique benefits designed to support your growth and well-being.

ABOUT ROOTSTOCKLABS

We’re a fast-growing, US-based direct-to-consumer telehealth company in the men’s health and weight loss space. We’re a small, nimble team that competes with much bigger players by moving fast, testing constantly and staying close to the numbers.

The Role
We're hiring a hands-on Paid Media Specialist to run our day-to-day ad operations on Meta, TikTok and Snapchat. Meta is our main channel today, and TikTok and Snapchat are growing fast.
This is not a content creation role. Our in-house creator produces the videos; you'll prepare them for each platform, launch them, track them and help us find the winners. What you'll do
You'll start with launches and operations, then take on optimization, and over time grow into cross-platform tracking.

Launch and operations

• Load 10–12 new video ads per week into test campaigns across Meta, TikTok and Snapchat, working toward two or three launches a week.

• Adapt each asset per platform: aspect ratios, crops, links and safe zones, so nothing gets covered by the app's interface.

• Write ad copy for every launch: primary text, headlines and descriptions.

• Track ad approvals, submit and follow up on appeals, and report which content gets rejected on which platform. Our category is regulated, so this is a big part of the job.

Optimization

• Read test results against our internal playbook and identify winners and losers.

• Move winners into scaling campaigns and adjust budgets.

• Retest underperformers with new combinations of videos and copy.

Tracking and attribution

• Work with attribution events, Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics.

• Compare performance across platforms and flag what works where.

What we're looking for

We care more about how you think and work than about years on your CV.

Must-haves

• Recent, hands-on experience launching ads yourself in Meta Ads Manager. A few months is enough.

• Solid grasp of core metrics such as CTR, CPC and CPA, and what a campaign is optimizing for.

• Strong organization and attention to detail when handling high volumes of assets.

• Self-managed and proactive: you work from one daily check-in and come with your own proposals, not just questions.

• Professional English, written and spoken.

postings.title: Integrations Support Engineer [Remote | EMEA]
postings.descriptionText:
About MoneyHash

MoneyHash is building the future of API-based payment infrastructure. Our easy-install APIs consolidate the revenue cycle across geographies, functions, and use cases. We're saving our clients time and money, boosting product performance, unlocking new business opportunities, and reducing tech debt.

We're one of the fastest-growing payment infrastructure companies in emerging markets, and we know that building the right team is crucial to realizing our potential. At MoneyHash , we champion human empathy as well as work excellence. Join us and let's explore this journey together!

Your Team

Integrations is where MoneyHash 's core promise actually gets built. Every merchant who connects once and reaches dozens of providers is standing on a connection that somebody scoped, briefed, tested and shipped. We add providers and payment methods continuously across MENA and beyond (cards, KNET, Mada, STC Pay, Fawry, wallets, BNPL), and each one is its own small project with its own documentation, quirks, sandbox and failure modes.

You'll own that pipeline. Requests arrive from sales, customer success and merchants: a new provider, a new payment method on a provider we already support, or a new capability on a method that's already live. You work out what each one actually involves, write it down precisely enough that other people can build it, and carry it through to go-live.

You will not write code. You will read a great deal of API documentation.

What You'll Be Doing

• Own the intake. Every connection request lands with you. Work out whether it's a new provider, a new method, or a capability extension, and check what we've already built before anything starts.

• Scope at the method level. A provider doesn't "support KWD". It supports KWD on KNET via redirection, with a specific set of operations and no tokenization. Read the provider's documentation and produce that matrix: integration types, currencies, schemes, operations, tokenization, 3DS, webhooks. Mark clearly what the docs don't answer.

• Find what's missing before engineering does. Which merchant requirements the provider genuinely cannot meet, which features the provider has to switch on for our account, what the sandbox won't let us test.

• Write the tickets. A self-contained build brief for the external developer, an engineering story with a QA checklist as its acceptance criteria, an error-code mapping table. Short, specific and correct. Our engineers have built dozens of connections and don't need the basics explained back to them.

• Manage the external developers. Brief them, keep them unblocked, review what comes back, and say no when it isn't right.

• Run the integrations backlog for a dedicated squad. Sequence the work, keep the pipeline moving, and tell the people waiting where their connection stands.

• Get it live. Credentials, testing data, QA, launch.

You’ll Be Great for This Role If You

• Have hands-on experience scoping or delivering payment provider integrations. You've worked through a PSP's API documentation and turned it into something a team could build. This one isn't negotiable.

• Can read API documentation, JSON payloads and webhook specifications and state precisely what a provider does and does not support (you won't write code)

• Write short. Much of this job is compressing a 200-page provider doc into a one-page brief somebody can build from without asking you five follow-up questions.

• Know the difference between authorize, capture, purchase, void and refund, what a webhook can and cannot be trusted for, and why tokenization and recurring are not the same thing

• Are organized under load, with several connections in flight at once, each waiting on a different person

• Have worked with external contractors or vendors and can hold them to a specification

Bonus points:

• MENA/GCC payment methods and local acquiringn

• Payment orchestration, routing, or failover

• Error-code mapping, reconciliation, or QA of payment flows

• Linear, Notion, and writing for engineering audiences

Your First 90 Days

Onboarding here is a designed program, not a stack of documents: structured sessions on how our platform and payments actually work, hands-on sandbox access from day one, and real connections to scope in your first weeks. By the end of it you'll be running the integration pipeline for real.

How We Work at MoneyHash

Beyond your functional responsibilities, everyone at MoneyHash plays a part in shaping our culture and values:

•
Respect . We’re a global team and value diversity, empathy, and honest dialogue.

•
Humility. We give and receive feedback with openness, leaving egos at the door.

•
Flexibility. We adapt quickly, learn constantly, and step up where needed.

•
Willingness to Learn. We embrace growth, celebrate iteration, and treat every mistake as a step forward.

Where we work: Remote-first across EMEA time zones, with an annual in-person retreat to bring the team together.

Compensation Package

Competitive salary - stock options - health insurance - professional development stipend - wellness stipend - tech allowance - equipment financing program - annual in-person retreat - team engagement initiatives

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.
We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role. You will define where Keet goes, convince the board and the team that it is the right direction, and then drive the execution that gets it there.
You are a rare combination of three things. You are a product visionary who has shipped consumer chat or calling apps at scale. You are a technologist who can go deep on P2P architecture and the Pear / Holepunch stack (docs.pears.com). And you are a hands-on builder who uses AI tools to prototype and prove concepts in days, not months. You set the bar high, move at incredible speed, and lead from the front.
You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.
If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Vision & Strategy

• Own and articulate the long-term product vision for Keet as the world's leading private, peer-to-peer communication app, with a clear path to 1 billion users.

• Analyze WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, LINE, WeChat and emerging competitors to identify where P2P gives Keet an unfair advantage, and build the roadmap around it.

• Present product vision, strategy, metrics and progress to the board and executive leadership with clarity and conviction.

Define a growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention and virality, with measurable targets at every stage.

Technical Product Leadership

• Develop a deep working understanding of the Holepunch P2P stack (Pear runtime, Bare, Hypercore, Hyperswarm, HyperDHT, Autobase, Hyperbee) and translate its capabilities and constraints into product decisions.

• Partner with core engineering on hard P2P problems at scale, including NAT traversal, offline sync, multi-device support, large groups, push notifications, and battery and data efficiency on mobile.

• Own the real-time calling experience (1:1 and group voice and video, plus screen sharing) to a quality bar that matches or beats Google Meet and Zoom.

• Define clear feature tiers with explicit labels for stable versus experimental functionality.

Rapid Prototyping with AI

• Use AI coding and design tools to build working prototypes and demos that prove concepts before committing engineering resources.

• Turn ideas into something the team, users and the board can see and touch within days.

Execution & Team Leadership

• Lead the product team and run the sprint cadence end to end, covering planning, prioritization, standups, reviews and retrospectives.

• Own deliverables from conception through release, testing and post-launch iteration, ensuring core functionality works reliably every time.

• Maintain issue trackers and roadmaps that accurately reflect priorities and sprint commitments.

• Coordinate across engineering, QA, design, marketing and business stakeholders, and manage cross-team dependencies across the Holepunch and Tether ecosystem.

• Provide transparent updates on status, risks and timeline changes, and hold direct conversations about accountability when needed.

Mobile & Distribution

• Own the mobile release process across iOS and Android. This includes App Store and Google Play submissions, review guidelines, compliance, store listings, ratings and release management.

• Oversee desktop distribution and installers across macOS, Windows and Linux.

• Build crash reporting, debugging and analytics systems, privacy-preserving by design, that turn user reports into actionable engineering data.

Requirements

Mandatory:

• 8+ years of product management experience, including significant time in a senior or lead role owning a consumer product end to end.

• Strong product sense, with a proven track record of setting product vision and driving it to measurable outcomes at scale (tens of millions of users or more).

• Experience leading engineers who ship products, including running sprint cadences with predictable delivery across cross-functional teams.

• Deep JavaScript and React skills. You can read and write production code, review pull requests, and build working prototypes yourself.

• Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. You don't need P2P expertise, because our core abstracts it away, but you should be able to reason about sync, offline behavior and consistency trade-offs.

• Hands-on experience shipping and scaling mobile apps on iOS and Android, with deep familiarity with App Store and Google Play logistics, review processes and release management.

• Experience with real-time voice and video calling products (such as Google Meet, Zoom, FaceTime or WhatsApp calls) and the quality, latency and reliability trade-offs involved.

• Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to rapidly prototype and demonstrate product concepts.

• Exceptional communication skills, with experience presenting vision and strategy to boards, executives and investors.

• A strong understanding of urgency versus importance, and the judgment to make fast, high-quality decisions with incomplete information.

• You thrive in a high-intensity, fast-moving environment, set an exceptionally high bar, and are willing to go above and beyond, including extended hours, when the mission demands it.

•
Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to have:

• Product leadership experience at a major messaging app such as WhatsApp, Telegram, LINE, WeChat, Signal, Viber or KakaoTalk.

• Experience with peer-to-peer technologies, distributed systems or decentralized protocols. Prior exposure to Holepunch, Pear or Hypercore is a strong plus.

• Experience growing a product in emerging markets or across multiple regions and languages.

• A background in privacy, encryption or security-focused products.

• Familiarity with Electron, React Native or similar cross-platform frameworks, as well as installer systems, boot performance and Linux packaging (Snap, AppImage, Flatpak).

• A solid understanding of testing approaches (unit, integration, end-to-end), test automation and performance testing.

• An engineering background or computer science degree.

• Experience with Git, issue trackers and modern collaboration tools.

Why this role:
The next billion-user communication app will not run on someone else's servers. If you want to be the person who defines it, presents it to the board, prototypes it yourself, and then leads the team that ships it, we want to hear from you.
In your application, include a link to a product you have shipped or a prototype you have built, along with a few sentences on how you would take Keet to 1 billion users.
Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

• Implement asynchronous integrations and event flows (e.g. Azure Service Bus, Kafka), including retries, idempotency, and error handling.

Requirements

• Strong programming skills in Java (5+) , Spring Boot , and the Spring ecosystem (Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Integration a plus).

postings.title: Growth Product Manager
postings.descriptionText:
⌘Role Overview
The Growth Product Manager at Timeleft owns the acquisition-to-purchase funnel: everything a new user encounters between first landing screen (on mobile app or mobile web) and a paid, booked seat.
Timeleft connects strangers in real life — thousands of people every week, in more than 60 countries, around 10,000 bookings a day across different experiences from Dinners to Coffee and Drinks and more. Timeleft is a mobile-first subscription business: growth depends on flows that converts intent into a booked seat, and on a subscription that users continue to renew.
This role owns onboarding and activation, paywall strategy, pricing and packaging across 3 platforms (iOS, Android, Web), and the experimentation programme that drives all of them. The role works closely with Marketing, Data and Engineering. It is accountable for revenue from new subscribers, and for the two components that determine it: conversion to purchase and lifetime value per subscriber.

You will report to the VP of Product.

⌘Key Responsibilities

1. Conversion to Purchase

• Own conversion to purchase and lifetime value per subscriber across the full path from first screen to completed payment. Neither is a target on its own — improving one at the expense of the other is not a gain; total revenue from new subscribers is the measure.

• Map that path end to end across mobile app and mobile web, identify where intent is lost, and prioritise fixes by revenue impact.

• Own continuity between web and app: the handover from a web landing or checkout into the application, and the differences in payment, billing and refund behaviour between store and web purchase.

• Account for acquisition channel in funnel design: paid, organic and referral users arrive with different intent and require different flows.

2. Onboarding & Activation

• Own the onboarding flow: what is asked of new users, in what order, and how the answers are used.

• Define activation for Timeleft , instrument it, and maintain it as the company-wide definition.

• Reduce time and friction to the first booked seat while preserving the information that matching requires.

3. Paywalls, Pricing & Packaging

• Own paywall strategy: placement, timing, design and what is gated.

• Own pricing and packaging across markets and currencies, including trials, offers, upsells and win-back, and own ARPU as a result.

• Balance first-purchase conversion against renewal quality and attendance.

4. Experimentation

• Run a continuous experimentation programme across onboarding, paywalls and pricing.

• Apply consistent statistical standards: pre-registered hypotheses, adequate power, and decision criteria set before launch.

• Evaluate every experiment against downstream behaviour — attendance, renewal and LTV — in addition to its primary metric.

5. Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Marketing on channel mix, creative strategy and continuity between advertising and the first in-app/landing screen.

• Partner with Data on instrumentation, attribution and experiment design.

• Coordinate the handover of activated users into the wider product experience, and define with the Core team what onboarding must collect.

⌘Expected Outcomes

• Revenue from new subscribers grows. Pricing and paywall changes are evaluated on total revenue, not on conversion rate alone.

• Conversion to purchase and activation are instrumented, trusted metrics that improve quarter over quarter.

• Onboarding is differentiated by acquisition channel and user intent rather than uniform.

• Paywall and pricing decisions are based on measured elasticity.

• Lifetime value per subscriber is held or improved as acquisition volume grows, without degradation in renewal quality or attendance.

• Experiment throughput is high and every result is readable against downstream retention.

⌘Skills & Competencies (Must Have & Nice to have)

•
B2C mobile product depth: has owned a consumer mobile application where the application is the primary business surface, with practical knowledge of how iOS and Android and Mobile Web differ.

•
Subscription monetization: experienced in paywalls, trials, pricing elasticity, tiering, upsells and win-back, and in the distinction between acquiring a subscriber and retaining one.

•
Subscription economics: reads conversion and lifetime value together, distinguishes a conversion gain from a revenue gain, and recognises when a pricing change has increased volume at the expense of value.

•
Funnel analytics: builds behavioural funnels and growth models, works directly with behavioural and payment data, and identifies conversion blockers from evidence.

•
Experimentation rigour: sustains high experiment velocity alongside disciplined interpretation, including discontinuing tests that improve first purchase at the expense of retention.

•
Conversion craft: understands the mechanics of a first purchase — framing, social proof, personalisation and timing — and applies them accurately.

•
Cross-functional influence: operates effectively across Marketing, Data and Engineering without line authority; direct, structured, comfortable operating with founders and challenging decisions with evidence.

⌘ Required experience

• 5+ years in product management, growth or lifecycle roles, including direct ownership of a consumer subscription funnel.

• Demonstrable conversion-rate and revenue improvements in a consumer mobile product.

• Hands-on ownership of paywall and pricing experimentation.

• Proficient in analytics tooling and able to query data independently.

• Fluent English required

Nice to have

• Marketplace or supply-constrained business experience.

• Experience with a product whose value is delivered offline.

• Experience operating across multiple markets and currencies.

postings.title: Applied AI Enablement Lead
postings.descriptionText:
Liminal is the way regulated enterprises securely leverage generative AI. Liminal ’s AI security, governance, and enablement platform gives customers the powerful workflow productivity tools they want to safely maximize the value of generative AI anywhere they work, while providing unparalleled data protection, administration, and observability capabilities. Visit our website at www.liminal.ai to hear from our customers Delta Dental and Northern Arizona Healthcare.

Liminal is looking for a founding Applied AI Enablement Lead to turn secure AI access into everyday business value for our customers. Our platform gives regulated enterprises secure, governed access to leading AI models. But buying a platform and changing how people work are two very different things. This role exists to close that gap.

You will build and lead our customer enablement function, serving as our primary AI cheerleader, educator, and trusted advisor. You will be the person who turns a skeptical compliance officer or hesitant knowledge worker into an enthusiastic AI advocate. You will teach non-technical employees how to use AI in their daily work, guide technical teams through essential integrations (like data source connections and SSO), and establish the playbooks and partner certification programs that allow Liminal to scale.

This is a high-impact, customer-facing founding leadership role that sits within Customer Success. You will work weekly with our Chief Business Officer, VP of Sales, and Account Executives to drive account adoption, retention, and expansion.

What You'll Do:

1. Drive Account Adoption & Growth
Execute account enablement plans that take enterprise customers from initial rollout to broad usage, aiming for concrete outcomes, such as, driving weekly active usage from 20% to 70%+ within 90 days.

Track user activation, feature adoption, and retention across assigned accounts to ensure deep, sustained product value.

2. Educate & Empower Users

Lead engaging workshops, interactive lunch-and-learns, and targeted 1:1 sessions for knowledge workers who are new to generative AI, making concepts practical, safe, and approachable.

Partner with business teams to identify high-value use cases and guide users in building custom AI assistants tailored to their daily workflows.

3. Guide Technical Setup & Integrations

Walk customer IT and security stakeholders through connecting internal data sources, configuring SSO, and setting up custom assistants.

Maintain a clear boundary: provide technical guidance and hands-on setup support to non-technical and IT users without acting as a Sales Engineer or technical architect.

4. Build & Scale the Enablement Function

Establish foundational enablement playbooks, training collateral, and best practices that set the standard for customer success as Liminal grows.

Design the vetting, training, and certification criteria for third-party partners to deliver Liminal enablement at scale while maintaining high adoption standards.

Hire and mentor future enablement team members as customer demand scales.

5. Voice of the Customer & Expansion Partnership

Work alongside Account Executives to identify expansion signals, grow usage within key accounts, and support renewal discussions.

Synthesize user feedback and field insights to influence Product and Go-To-Market roadmaps.

Requirements

• 6+ years in customer success, solutions consulting, technical enablement, or customer-facing GTM roles within B2B SaaS.

• Hands-on experience using AI tools, designing prompts, and building AI assistants in real-world workflows.

• Proven experience guiding customer IT and security teams through basic technical setups, such as data source connections and SSO integrations.

• Demonstrated ability to build, launch, or scale customer enablement, training, or partner certification programs.

• Exceptional communication and facilitation skills, with a track record of building enthusiasm and explaining emerging technology to non-technical audiences.

• Strong business acumen and experience owning outcomes tied to account adoption, retention, and revenue expansion in enterprise or mid-market segments.

• Entrepreneurial mindset with comfort building processes from scratch in a fast-paced startup environment.

Nice to Have

• Background working in regulated industries (e.g., financial services, healthcare, insurance).

• Experience establishing partner or channel enablement programs.

Compensation

Base salary: $125,000 - $140,000, depending on experience.

Variable compensation: 30% of target total compensation, yielding an estimated On-Target Earnings (OTE) range of $162,500 - $182,000, plus equity participation.

How the variable plan works:

• Payout is based on performance against three primary metrics across your assigned book of accounts:

• Net Revenue Retention (NRR): Retention and growth of recurring revenue net of churn/contraction.

• Expansion ARR: New annual recurring revenue generated from upsells and cross-sells.

• Product Adoption & Engagement: Achievement of target user penetration metrics (e.g., reaching 60%+ Weekly Active Usage across key accounts).

Our Values:

• We are kind. We assume positive intent, celebrate co-workers' success, avoid toxic behaviors, and call out bad acting when we see it.

• We earn trust by being authentic, humble, and empathetic. Empathy is the cornerstone of building trust, and trust is a requirement in a world that is certain to be full of change.

• We are fearless, bold, honest, direct, and candid. We dare to challenge assumptions and push boundaries, and are not afraid when someone challenges us. If we make mistakes, which we will, they are unique and good opportunities to learn.

• We value discourse, not dissonance. Constructive discourse is exceptionally healthy and desirable. Expect to be challenged and rise to the occasion! Create space for the best ideas to rise to the top and let data be the ultimate decision-maker, not emotion.

• We seek understanding, not consensus. As leaders, we stand firm in our informed convictions until data overturns them. It’s healthy to disagree, but we commit to the outcome.

• We are owners. We empower each other to solve problems and take the initiative to meet our goals. We are purposeful and intentional in our thinking and know that we are individually accountable for our impacts on the company's results.

• We are curious and passionate about learning and constantly seek opportunities to grow and develop. Our space changes daily, and we adapt and mature with it.

Liminal is an equal-opportunity employer, and we value diversity at our company. We don’t discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

postings.descriptionText:
was bieten wir?

Bei DACHS IT sollst du nicht einfach nur „eine Stelle“ haben, sondern ein Arbeitsumfeld, das zu deinem Leben, deinen Stärken und deinen Zielen passt. Deshalb bieten wir dir:

Remote-First als gelebtes Modell
Wir arbeiten seit Jahren konsequent remote. Du entscheidest, von wo du am produktivsten bist – Homeoffice, Shared Office oder eine Mischung aus beidem.

Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Eigenverantwortung
Du kannst dir deine Arbeit im Rahmen der Projekte zeitlich flexibel über die Woche einteilen. Uns sind Verlässlichkeit im Team und transparente Kommunikation wichtiger als Präsenz am Schreibtisch.

Spannende Projekte statt Routine-Tickets
Gemeinsam finden wir Projekte, die zu deinem Profil und deiner Entwicklung passen – z. B. Plattformaufbau, Cloud-Migration, Automatisierung, Operations oder technische Schulungen bei Kund:innen.

Weiterbildung, Zertifizierungen & Wissensaustausch
Regelmäßige Schulungen und Zertifizierungen sind fest eingeplant – mit Kostenübernahme und Freistellung. Dazu kommen interner Wissensaustausch, Sparrings auf Augenhöhe und Raum, dich fachlich wie methodisch weiterzuentwickeln.

Moderne Ausstattung & Arbeitsumgebung
Du erhältst moderne Hardware, die passende Software sowie das benötigte Equipment, damit du effizient und komfortabel arbeiten kannst.

Attraktive Rahmenbedingungen
Neben einem fairen Festgehalt bekommst du eine jährliche Beteiligung am Unternehmensgewinn. Je nach Rolle besteht zudem die Option auf einen Firmenwagen.

Transparente Feedbackkultur & Entwicklung
Wir setzen nicht auf jährliche Pflichttermine, sondern auf regelmäßige, ehrliche Gespräche auf Augenhöhe – du gibst uns Feedback, wir dir. So wissen wir alle, woran wir sind, und können unsere gemeinsamen nächsten Entwicklungsschritte gezielt unterstützen.

Gesundheit, Freizeit & Sicherheit
Du erhältst 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr, die nicht verfallen, sowie zusätzliche Absicherung, zum Beispiel durch eine Gruppen-Unfallversicherung. So bist du nicht nur beruflich, sondern auch privat gut aufgestellt.

Teamkultur & gemeinsame Erlebnisse
Trotz Remote-First ist uns persönlicher Austausch wichtig: Wir treffen uns regelmäßig zu gemeinsamen Aktivitäten – mal locker bei einem Get-together, mal zum gemeinsamen Workshop, mal aktiv bei Ausflügen – und sorgen so für echten Zusammenhalt abseits des Bildschirms.

wen suchen wir?
Als erfahrener Professional überzeugst du unsere Kunden durch ein souveränes Auftreten und fundiertes Wissen in Cloud- sowie Container-Technologien.
Mit deinem empirisch-agilen Mindset entwickelst du passgenaue Lösungen und begleitest deren Umsetzung engagiert vor Ort oder remote.
Dabei schätzen wir deine Eigeninitiative ebenso wie deine Teamfähigkeit und deine ausgeprägte Leidenschaft für die direkte Kundenberatung, bei Bedarf auch als Rufbereitschaft oder direkt vor Ort.

was machst du bei uns?
Als Senior DevOps Engineer betreust und berätst du unsere Kunden in allen technischen Fragen rund um die Themen Infrastruktur-Architektur, -Operations und -integration:

• Du trägst fundierte Empfehlungen zu Design- / Architektur-Entscheidungen bei.

• Du kümmerst dich um den Aufbau und die Integration von Plattformen, Pipelines und anderen Komponenten.

• Du erklärst Best Practices und vermittelst sie didaktisch.

• Du betreibst Fehlersuche/Debugging effizient und gibst die Erkenntnisse weiter.

• Du stellst Dokumentationen, Gits und andere Quellen zusammen, um tiefergehende Fragen zu beantworten.

• Du gibst technische Schulungen.

• Du berätst und vermittelst beim Umgang mit Drittanbietern / dem Herstellersupport.

was bringst du mit?

• Kubernetes

• mindestens auf CKA/CKS-Level

• Alternativ OCP/OpenShift Kenntnisse mit Zertifizierung(en) oberhalb von EX180

• mit mindestens LPIC 1 (besser LPI-304/-305 oder gar „DevOps Tools Engineer“)
