wie sieht der bewerbungsprozess bei uns aus?

Wenn du dich bei uns bewirbst, begleiten wir dich transparent durch mehrere klar strukturierte Schritte. Uns ist wichtig, dass du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst – deshalb erhältst du in jeder Phase zeitnah Rückmeldung und alle nötigen Infos zum weiteren Ablauf. In der Regel durchläufst du dabei folgende Schritte:

Screening
Wir sichten deine Unterlagen sorgfältig und bewerten, ob deine Erfahrungen, Kompetenzen und Ziele zu der ausgeschriebenen Rolle und zu DACHS IT passen – auf dieser Basis entscheiden wir über eine Einladung zum Kennenlernen.

Kennenlerngespräch
In einem 30–45-minütigen Videocall lernst du ein Mitglied unseres Teams kennen. Ihr sprecht über deinen Hintergrund, unsere Kultur, Erwartungen beider Seiten und habt Raum für Fragen.

Technisches Interview

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About the Team:
You’ll be part of a supportive and collaborative Accounting & Finance team that truly partners with Operations and Supply Chain. We value curiosity, ownership, and teamwork, and we believe the best results come from people who aren’t afraid to ask questions, dig deeper, and help each other out. As we continue to grow, the team plays a key role in building scalable processes while staying close to the day-to-day realities of the business.

The Role
We’re looking for a Sr. Accounting Analyst to own prepaid expense reconciliations, lease accounting, and expense analysis across software, insurance, utilities, and general operating expenses.
This role plays a key part in the monthly close, ensuring accurate accounting records, complete supporting documentation, and clear explanations of account variances. The ideal candidate combines strong technical accounting knowledge with curiosity, attention to detail, is adept at balance sheet account reconciliations and the ability to independently manage assigned processes.
The position reports directly to the Sr. Accounting Manager and is a full-time role.

Responsibilities

• Own the monthly close for assigned accounts, preparing journal entries, accruals, and adjustments within established deadlines.

• Prepares and maintains clear and well documented account reconciliations for their area of responsibility.

• Maintain lease accounting under ASC 842, including lease schedules, monthly entries, and reconciliations of right-of-use assets and lease liabilities using 3rd part lease accounting software.

• Review lease agreements, amendments, renewals, and terminations, identifying accounting implications and coordinating the appropriate treatment with the Accounting Manager.

• Ensure proper classification and recording of rent, utilities, and other occupancy-related expenses based on contract terms and applicable accounting policies.

• Own prepaid expense reconciliations and amortization schedules, ensuring expenses are recognized in the appropriate periods.

• Perform monthly variance analysis for software, insurance, utilities, rent, and general operating expenses, investigating movements and providing clear, supported explanations.

• Review invoices, contracts, and account activity to identify missing accruals, coding errors, and timing differences.

• Reconcile assigned balance sheet accounts and proactively resolve outstanding items.

• Collaborate with Accounts Payable, FP&A, Legal, Operations, and other stakeholders to obtain timely information and ensure accurate expense recognition.

• Maintain process documentation and support internal controls across assigned areas.

• Prepare schedules and supporting documentation for external audits.

• Contribute to process improvements and automation initiatives, reviewing outputs critically to ensure accuracy.

• Support ad hoc accounting projects as needed.

Qualifications

• 3–4 years of relevant experience in accounting or audit roles.

• Advanced English skills, with the ability to communicate accounting matters clearly in writing and verbally.

• Experience with month-end close, journal entries, accruals, and balance sheet reconciliations.

• Experience preparing prepaid expense reconciliations and amortization schedules.

• Degree in Accounting or a related field.

• Strong understanding of expense recognition and the distinction between rent, utilities, and other occupancy-related charges.

• Experience performing account variance analysis and explaining the underlying business drivers.

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills.

• Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and sound accounting judgment.

• Ability to independently manage assigned responsibilities, meet deadlines, and proactively communicate issues or roadblocks.

• Collaborative mindset and strong communication skills across teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• Hands-on experience with LeaseQuery .

• US GAAP knowledge, including ASC 842 lease accounting .

• Experience with NetSuite .

• Experience with multi-currency entities.

• Experience improving accounting processes through automation or AI tools, including validating the accuracy of their outputs.

We believe great leadership starts with alignment on vision, values, and ways of working. To give you deeper insight into who we are and what we’re looking for, we invite you to explore: CookUnity 's Leadership Principles – The values and behaviors that guide how we operate, collaborate, and scale.

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer . We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates
We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity . We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us:

• Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

• Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page.

• We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.

• We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away.

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We are working to create the world's best open source data platform, covering traditional SQL databases and today's NoSQL data stores, as well as the machinery which turns data into insights and executable models.
The people who love this role are MLOps engineers who enjoy customer conversations and solving customer problems during the presales cycle. Training LLMs on multiple Kubernetes clusters deployed on a hybrid cloud infrastructure with GPU sharing across multiple teams? Processing 10M events in real time for financial transactions? What you’ll learn

What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. postings.descriptionText:

Hard Rock Digital is a fiercely focused team working to become the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. What's the position?
We are looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead our Sportsbook Experience backend team within the Sportsbook unit at Hard Rock Digital . You will own people leadership, team health, and engineering excellence for the pod that builds and operates the Java/Spring services behind Hard Rock Bet — event and market data, pricing and odds delivery, betslip and bet placement, cash out, and the high-throughput APIs and streaming feeds that power our web, native, and retail clients.
You will partner closely with Product Owners, the Director of Sportsbook, Technical Delivery Leads and other Engineering Managers to deliver high-quality software in alignment with product priorities, while fostering a culture where engineers do their best work. You will also be a key voice in our push to become an AI-first organization: we expect you to champion the use of AI-augmented development, responsible AI practices, and continuous learning so your team and our products benefit from AI-led innovation.
This is an opportunity to have real impact on how we work, how we build, and how we leverage AI—every day.

How we work at HRD

• Product-driven: Product sets the north star; Engineering Managers ensure their teams can execute with clarity and quality. We balance delivery with technical health and support Technical Leads on cross-pod coordination and delivery.

• Clear roles: EMs own people (performance, career growth, hiring), team health, and working with the team on technology decisions. Technical Leads own delivery across pods, project coordination, and vendor/architecture alignment. You will work in lockstep with your TL and Product Owner.

• Collaboration: We work across pods and with Product, Design, QA, and Platform. We value transparency, backlog refinement, and early alignment so we can deliver predictably and improve continuously.

• Excellence and ownership: We hold ourselves to high standards. Compliance, security, and documentation are part of how we design and build—especially in a real-money, in-play sportsbook, where reliability, latency, and regulation matter every day.

AI-first organization
Hard Rock Digital is committed to becoming an AI-first organization. Our AI Center of Excellence (AI CoE) exists to empower AI-led innovation by orchestrating partnerships, democratizing knowledge and tools, and building capabilities that deliver value through safe and responsible use of AI.

What this means for you and your team

• AI-augmented development is essential. We allow and support AI-generated code from approved tools (e.g. Cody, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude). All such code must be understood, reviewed, and tested before merge—you own what you check in. We have clear AI Code Check-In Best Practices and expect EMs to reinforce them.

• We invest in AI across the stack. Tech is actively deploying AI in requirements gathering and planning, PR/code review (e.g. Derpbot), alert investigation (e.g. Alerti), API and E2E testing acceleration, and exploration of agentic workflows and MCPs. We want leaders who will adopt these tools and advocate for their responsible use.

• We build and govern responsibly. We have an AI Charter, Policy, and governance so we innovate with appropriate guardrails. Your role includes helping your team use AI effectively while adhering to our standards and compliance expectations—especially in a regulated domain like sports betting.

• We learn and share. We have an AI focus group, recommended learning paths, and initiatives that span from code to operations to product. We are looking for an EM who will keep the Sportsbook Experience pod engaged with AI initiatives and who sees AI as a force multiplier for the team and the product.

• We want a leader who is excited to operate in this environment and to help shape how Sportsbook and HRD work in an AI-first way.

• People & team: Run regular 1:1s, stand-ups, and ad-hoc support. Address impediments, clarify priorities, and ensure the team has the resources and context to deliver. Own performance feedback, career development, and workforce planning so the team stays motivated and high-performing.

• Delivery & process: Monitor sprint progress, adjust priorities when needed, and keep work well scoped and estimated. Work with Product to break down requirements into clear features and user stories. Use backlog grooming, sprint planning, and retrospectives to improve predictability and quality.

• Stakeholder alignment: Partner with Product Owners, Technical Leads, other EMs, and leadership to align on objectives, dependencies, and risks. Represent the team in cross-team and Sportsbook-wide discussions.

• Technical partnership (hands-on): Stay close to the code. Review pull requests on merit, contribute to design and architecture for our Java/Spring services, help debug production issues, and prototype where it unblocks the team. Ensure solutions follow our standards and best practices, and support the TL on vendor and technical stakeholder management where it affects your team.

• Platform health & operations: Own the reliability, latency, and correctness of the services your team runs. Support in-play peaks and major sporting events with strong observability, sensible on-call practices, and genuine learning from incidents.

• Hiring & composition: Assess workload and skills, identify hiring needs, and participate in recruiting and hiring. Help shape a team that can meet delivery commitments and grow over time.

• Culture & AI: Foster an inclusive, collaborative environment. Champion our values and our AI-first direction: encourage use of approved AI tools, reinforce "you own what you check in," and keep the team connected to AI initiatives and learning.

Requirements

What are we looking for?

• Leadership experience: Several years in technology with a meaningful portion in leadership or management—driving technical excellence, mentoring engineers, and delivering through others.

• Backend engineering background (essential): You come from backend engineering and have built and run production systems in Java with Spring / Spring Boot. Strong grounding in microservices, REST APIs, event-driven architecture (e.g. Kafka), relational and NoSQL data stores, and operating services on AWS/Kubernetes.

• Hands-on capability: You still read and write code. You can assess a pull request on its merits, reason about a thread dump, a slow query, or a latency spike, and pair with an engineer on a hard problem. This is not a purely process-focused management role.

• Self-motivated and autonomous: You set your own agenda, spot problems before they are escalated to you, and drive them to resolution without being asked. You are comfortable with ambiguity and ownership, and you set the same expectation for your team.

• Sportsbook domain fit: Experience or strong interest in sportsbook, trading, real-time/high-throughput systems, or other low-latency regulated platforms. Comfort with compliance, security, and operational rigour is important.

• AI mindset: Curiosity and openness to AI-augmented development and AI initiatives. You don't need to be an AI expert, but you should be eager to learn, to adopt approved tools, and to help your team work in an AI-first way responsibly.

• Collaboration and communication: Strong communication (written and verbal), experience working with Product and other engineering leaders, and a track record of building trust and resolving ambiguity.

• Values alignment: You champion inclusion, growth, and a culture where people take ownership and learn from setbacks. You're comfortable promoting both delivery and technical excellence within a product-driven framework.

Qualifications

• Proven ability to foster innovation, continuous improvement, and collaboration within a team or technology line.

• Experience with agile development and with managing or contributing to backlogs, planning, and delivery metrics.

• Demonstrable production experience with Java (17+) and the Spring ecosystem at scale.

What’s in it for you?

postings.descriptionText:
About Defuse Labs

Defuse Labs builds NEAR Intents, the universal transaction layer for the AI economy — intent-based infrastructure that enables people, agents, and applications to move value across chains and assets without bridges, fragmented liquidity, or manual routing.
At the center of our product ecosystem is near.com .
near.com is building a permissionless financial account: one place to hold, grow, invest, trade and use assets across blockchains, with privacy and control at its core. Our ambition is to make sophisticated financial capabilities feel like parts of one coherent product, increasingly accessible through conversation and trusted agents.
Our initial customers are comfortable with crypto and value their time, privacy and independence. They want access to what financial technology makes possible without having to manage its complexity.
We also build NEAR Intents , the universal transaction layer for the AI economy — intent-based infrastructure that enables people, agents, and applications to move value across chains and assets without bridges, fragmented liquidity, or manual routing. Instead of specifying a transaction path, users simply express what they want to achieve, and a competitive network of solvers fulfills the intent with competitive execution across available liquidity.
We operate in startup mode: high ownership, fast execution, and high standards. We’re a small, globally distributed team that moves quickly, takes initiative, and adapts as the product and market evolve.

About the Role
We’re hiring a Head of Product Marketing & Growth (Lead) with a primary focus on near.com — owning how the product is positioned, understood, launched, and adopted by users.
This is a foundational, highly product-oriented role responsible for how near.com is understood, brought to market, and adopted by users . You’ll develop a deep understanding of our users and market, define the product’s positioning, target audiences and core use cases, and own go-to-market across launches and the broader product lifecycle.
You’ll work closely with Product and Growth to turn that understanding into adoption — shaping onboarding, messaging, distribution and product education, and identifying the barriers that prevent users from discovering value and coming back. You’ll combine qualitative customer insight with product data to understand what resonates, where users drop off, and what could improve acquisition, activation, engagement and retention.
This is not a role that simply markets what Product has already built. You’ll bring the market and user perspective into product decisions, helping us determine who we are building for, which use cases matter most, how the product should evolve, and how we take it to market .
You’ll also support product marketing for NEAR Intents , particularly around partner positioning, integrations, and launches with CEXs, wallets, fintech platforms, and other distribution partners.
You’ll be particularly effective in this role if you’ve worked and grew the consumer product organization at a CEX, fintech company, neo-banks, wallet, trading platform, payments product, or another digital-asset business. You understand how users discover and evaluate financial or crypto products, what creates trust and friction, and how product experience, positioning, onboarding and distribution work together to drive adoption.

Key Responsibilities

• Own end-to-end product marketing for near.com — positioning, messaging, go-to-market, launches, and adoption.

• Define and continuously refine target audiences, core use cases, value proposition, and competitive positioning based on user, product, and market insights.

• Act as the voice of the user , translating research, feedback, and behavioral data into actionable Product and UX recommendations.

• Partner with Product and Growth to improve acquisition, onboarding, activation, engagement, and retention , identifying and addressing key adoption barriers.

• Lead go-to-market for new features and releases, including launch strategy, messaging, distribution, and success metrics.

• Own product-facing communications and enablement, including website messaging, onboarding, launch materials, FAQs, decks, and product education.

• Support NEAR Intents product marketing and partner launches , working with BD on positioning, partner materials, co-marketing, and post-launch adoption.

• Build repeatable product marketing processes and playbooks that make launches, experimentation, and adoption initiatives more scalable.

Requirements

• 4–7 years of experience in product marketing or a closely related product role, ideally with meaningful experience at a centralized exchange, fintech company, crypto wallet, or another trading, payments, or digital-asset product.

• A proven track record of owning go-to-market for product features or integrations end-to-end — from positioning and launch through to adoption and performance tracking, not just creative execution.

• Strong understanding of exchange, wallet, or fintech users and product teams — you understand how they evaluate infrastructure, what creates friction or drives adoption, and how to translate those insights into better product and messaging decisions.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn technical or ambiguous concepts into clear, compelling narratives for both partner teams and end users.

• Comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast-moving, resource-lean environment — able to build processes as needed rather than relying on established structures.

• Experience working effectively in remote, globally distributed teams.

• A solid working understanding of crypto fundamentals, including wallets, custody, swaps, and cross-chain transfers. Deep protocol-level expertise isn’t required, but you should be comfortable working closely with technical and engineering teams.

kurzbeschreibung
Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft – Willkommen in unserem Talentpool bei PROLOGA

deine aufgaben
Was bietet dir unser Talentpool?
Wenn du dich initiativ bei uns bewirbst, wirst du Teil unseres Talentpools – einer exklusiven Gruppe von Talenten, die wir bei passenden neuen Positionen direkt ansprechen. So verpasst du keine Chance, dein Know-how bei PROLOGA einzubringen. Sobald sich eine Möglichkeit ergibt, die zu deinen Fähigkeiten und Interessen passt, wirst du von uns als Erste/r kontaktiert.
Du hast aber nicht nur die Möglichkeit, auf zukünftige Stellenangebote zu warten: Wir schätzen den offenen Austausch und freuen uns auf inspirierende Gespräche, die vielleicht ganz neue Wege eröffnen – denn oft entstehen die besten Ideen, wenn man gemeinsam nach vorn blickt.
Bist du bereit für deine nächste Herausforderung?
Wir sind immer neugierig auf Menschen, die die Zukunft der IT aktiv mitgestalten wollen. Wenn du glaubst, dass du gut zu uns passt, dann werde Teil unseres Talentpools. Erzähle uns mehr über dich und deine Talente – wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören!

dein profil
Was du mitbringen solltest?
Leidenschaft für das, was du tust: Egal, ob du ein Technik-Experte, kreativer Kopf oder strategischer Denker bist – was zählt, ist dein Antrieb, etwas zu bewegen.

Eigeninitiative: Selbst wenn es noch keine konkrete Stelle gibt, weißt du, was du kannst und möchtest das bei uns einbringen.
Teamgeist: Bei PROLOGA arbeiten wir zusammen – denn die besten Ergebnisse erreichen wir als Team.

warum wir?
Unsere Arbeit ist weit mehr als nur das Entwickeln von Software oder das Lösen technischer Probleme. Bei PROLOGA glauben wir daran, dass Technologie echte Veränderungen bewirken kann – in Unternehmen, in Prozessen und im Leben der Menschen. Ob in der Anwendungsentwicklung, im IT-Consulting, im Vertrieb oder Marketing: Wir suchen kreative Köpfe, die über den Tellerrand hinausblicken und die digitale Zukunft mitgestalten wollen.
Bei uns erwartet dich eine dynamische Arbeitsumgebung, in der du wachsen und deine Fähigkeiten stetig weiterentwickeln kannst. Wir legen großen Wert darauf, dass sich jeder bei uns wohlfühlt und sich einbringen kann – egal ob im operativen Tagesgeschäft, bei spannenden Projekten oder durch kreative Lösungen für komplexe Herausforderungen.
Zusammen schaffen wir Lösungen, die Unternehmen effizienter machen und Menschen in ihrer Arbeit unterstützen. Ob in der Entwicklung, IT-Beratung oder anderen Bereichen – bei PROLOGA bist du nicht nur Teil eines Unternehmens, sondern Teil eines Teams, das an einem gemeinsamen Ziel arbeitet.

postings.title: Medical Monitor
postings.descriptionText:
Job Description Summary
The Medical Monitor, Clinical Development is responsible for providing day‑to‑day medical oversight for one or more clinical trials to ensure patient safety, data integrity, and protocol compliance throughout trial execution. This role serves as the primary medical point of contact for study teams and clinical sites, supporting safe and compliant study conduct in alignment with Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and regulatory requirements.

Operating within defined protocols and development strategies, the Medical Monitor provides medical judgment during trial execution, including safety signal evaluation, eligibility assessments, dose modifications, and risk mitigation. The role works closely with Clinical Operations, Pharmacovigilance, Data Management, Biostatistics, and Regulatory Affairs to support operational excellence, timely issue resolution, and high‑quality clinical data.

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

Le Médecin Moniteur (Medical Monitor), Développement Clinique est responsable de la supervision médicale quotidienne d’un ou de plusieurs essais cliniques afin de garantir la sécurité des patients, l’intégrité des données et la conformité au protocole tout au long de l’exécution de l’étude. Ce poste constitue le principal point de contact médical pour les équipes de l’étude et les sites cliniques, en veillant à ce que les études soient menées de manière sûre et conforme aux Bonnes Pratiques Cliniques (BPC/GCP) ainsi qu’aux exigences réglementaires.

Dans le cadre de protocoles définis et de stratégies de développement établies, le Médecin Moniteur apporte son jugement médical durant l’exécution des essais, notamment pour l’évaluation des signaux de sécurité, l’examen de l’éligibilité des participants, les ajustements de doses et les mesures d’atténuation des risques. Le titulaire du poste travaille en étroite collaboration avec les équipes des Opérations Cliniques, de Pharmacovigilance, de Gestion des Données, de Biostatistiques et des Affaires Réglementaires afin de soutenir l’excellence opérationnelle, la résolution rapide des problèmes et la production de données cliniques de haute qualité.

GE HealthCare est un leader mondial des technologies médicales et des solutions numériques innovantes. Notre mission est de créer un monde où les soins de santé n’ont aucune limite. Libérez votre ambition, transformez vos idées en réalités capables de changer le monde et rejoignez une organisation où chaque voix compte et où chaque contribution participe à bâtir un monde en meilleure santé.
Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Trial Medical Oversight

• Provide medical oversight for one or more assigned clinical trials within a program or portfolio.

• Ensure patient safety and protocol‑compliant execution throughout trial conduct.

• Apply medical judgment to eligibility questions, protocol deviations, dosing decisions, and participant risk mitigation.

Safety Monitoring & Signal Detection

• Review and assess AEs and SAEs, including causality and severity evaluations.

• Participate in ongoing safety reviews, internal safety committees, and Data Safety Monitoring Boards (DSMBs) as required.

• Collaborate closely with Pharmacovigilance to support safety signal detection, escalation, and risk‑management actions.

• Support development and implementation of protocol amendments or safety measures when indicated.

Site & Investigator Support

• Serve as a key medical contact for investigators, responding to protocol‑specific medical questions and eligibility clarifications.

• Support investigator meetings and site engagement activities with study‑specific medical input.

• Provide medical oversight and guidance when studies are conducted with CRO medical monitors, ensuring consistency with GE HealthCare expectations.

Cross‑Functional Study Team Collaboration

• Work closely with Clinical Trial Leads (CTLs), Clinical Project Managers (CPMs), CRAs, Data Management, and Biostatistics to support smooth trial execution.

• Participate in operational safety and study management meetings, contributing medical perspective to study‑level decisions.

• Support timely identification and resolution of safety or operational risks impacting study conduct.

Regulatory & Documentation Support

• Contribute to clinical study reports (CSRs), safety narratives, and regulatory submission documents.

• Ensure accuracy and consistency of medical data in study documentation and regulatory deliverables.

• Support regulatory interactions by addressing detailed clinical execution and safety questions as required.

• Ensure appropriate SAE reconciliation and alignment between clinical, safety, and regulatory datasets.

Required Qualifications:

•
MD or equivalent medical degree.

• 3–7 years of experience in clinical trial execution, medical monitoring, or related roles.

• Strong knowledge of GCP, clinical trial conduct, and safety reporting requirements.

• Experience reviewing AEs/SAEs and participating in safety oversight activities.

• Ability to work within protocol and regulatory frameworks while applying sound medical judgment.

Desired Characteristics

• Strong clinical judgment with attention to patient safety and data quality.

• Solid understanding of clinical trial methodology and operational execution.

• Ability to collaborate effectively within cross‑functional and matrixed teams.

• Clear and professional communication with investigators and study stakeholders.

• Detail‑oriented, with strong documentation and compliance mindset.

Principales responsabilités

Supervision médicale des essais cliniques

• Assurer la supervision médicale d’un ou de plusieurs essais cliniques attribués au sein d’un programme ou d’un portefeuille d’études.

• Garantir la sécurité des patients et une exécution conforme au protocole tout au long de la conduite des essais.

• Appliquer son jugement médical aux questions d’éligibilité, aux écarts de protocole, aux décisions de dosage et aux mesures de réduction des risques pour les participants.

Surveillance de la sécurité et détection des signaux

• Examiner et évaluer les événements indésirables (AE) et les événements indésirables graves (SAE), y compris les analyses de causalité et de gravité.

• Participer aux revues de sécurité continues, aux comités internes de sécurité et aux Comités de Surveillance de la Sécurité des Données (Data Safety Monitoring Boards - DSMB), selon les besoins.

• Collaborer étroitement avec la Pharmacovigilance pour soutenir la détection des signaux de sécurité, leur escalade et les actions de gestion des risques.

• Soutenir l’élaboration et la mise en œuvre d’amendements au protocole ou de mesures de sécurité lorsque cela est nécessaire.

Support aux sites et aux investigateurs

• Servir de contact médical principal pour les investigateurs, en répondant aux questions médicales spécifiques au protocole et en apportant des clarifications sur l’éligibilité des participants.

• Contribuer aux réunions d’investigateurs et aux activités d’engagement des sites en fournissant une expertise médicale liée à l’étude.

• Assurer une supervision et des conseils médicaux lorsque les études sont menées avec des médecins moniteurs de CRO, afin de garantir l’alignement avec les attentes de GE HealthCare .

Collaboration avec les équipes d’étude multidisciplinaires

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les responsables d’essais cliniques (Clinical Trial Leads - CTL), les chefs de projet clinique (Clinical Project Managers - CPM), les Attachés de Recherche Clinique (CRA), les équipes de Gestion des Données et de Biostatistiques afin d’assurer une exécution fluide des essais.

• Participer aux réunions opérationnelles de sécurité et de gestion des études, en apportant une perspective médicale aux décisions prises au niveau de l’étude.

• Soutenir l’identification et la résolution rapides des risques de sécurité ou des risques opérationnels susceptibles d’affecter la conduite des études.

​

Support réflementaire et documentaire

• Contribuer à la rédaction des rapports d’étude clinique (Clinical Study Reports - CSR), des récits de sécurité et des documents destinés aux soumissions réglementaires.

• Garantir l’exactitude et la cohérence des données médicales figurant dans la documentation des études et les livrables réglementaires.

• Participer aux interactions avec les autorités réglementaires en répondant, si nécessaire, à des questions détaillées relatives à l’exécution clinique et à la sécurité.

• Veiller à une réconciliation appropriée des SAE et à l’alignement des données entre les bases cliniques, de sécurité et réglementaires.

Qualifications requises:

• Doctorat en médecine (MD) ou diplôme médical équivalent.

• Entre 3 et 7 ans d’expérience dans l’exécution d’essais cliniques, la surveillance médicale ou des fonctions similaires.

• Solide connaissance des Bonnes Pratiques Cliniques (BPC/GCP), de la conduite des essais cliniques et des exigences en matière de déclaration de sécurité.

• Expérience dans l’examen des événements indésirables (AE/SAE) et la participation aux activités de supervision de la sécurité.

• Capacité à travailler dans le respect des protocoles et des cadres réglementaires tout en faisant preuve d’un jugement médical rigoureux.

Profil Recherché

• Excellent jugement clinique avec une forte sensibilité à la sécurité des patients et à la qualité des données.

• Bonne compréhension des méthodologies des essais cliniques et de leur exécution opérationnelle.

• Capacité à collaborer efficacement au sein d’équipes multidisciplinaires et matricielles.

• Communication claire et professionnelle avec les investigateurs et les différentes parties prenantes des études.

• Grand souci du détail, associé à une forte culture de la documentation et de la conformité.

Additional Information
Relocation Assistance Provided: No

postings.title: Detection Engineering & Response Lead
postings.descriptionText:
About Nebius :

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Detection and Response

The Detection and Response team is responsible for detection engineering, threat intelligence, and incident response across Nebius Cloud. Its goal is to improve and maintain Nebius 's security monitoring capabilities, as well as to build and maintain an end-to-end Security Incident Response program - people, processes, and tools.

The Role

We're hiring a Detection & Response Engineer to build and run our D&R capability from the ground up. You'll work on detection engineering, threat intelligence, and incident response functions across Nebius Cloud.

You'll be responsible for detection development, handling complex security incidents, forensics, and shaping the D&R strategy.

What you’ll do

• Detection development: maintain low false-positive and false-negative rates. Work closely with alerts consumers (20+ teams) to keep noise low and signal high, ensuring they can act quickly without missing genuine threats.

• Architect and operate detection coverage across our cloud and bare-metal environments

• Build and extend our internal D&R tools and pipelines - onboard new logs, build and automate response runbooks.

• Integrate threat intelligence into detection logic and IR playbooks, tracking adversary TTPs relevant to Cloud infrastructure

• Lead incident response end-to-end: scoping, containment, root cause analysis, post-incident reviews and controlling critical action items are closed to prevent future possible incidents.

• Partner with Compliance and Engineering teams to detect real threats while meeting the needs of both engineers and regulators.

• Define and report on D&R metrics: MTTD, MTTR, detection coverage, false positive rates, etc.

• Build and maintain Security Incident Response program: people, processes, tools.

• Build tools, runbooks, and on-call processes that scale as the company grows.

What we look for

• 6+ years in security operations, detection engineering, or incident response.

• Deep hands-on experience with cloud-native environments (Kubernetes, Linux workloads, container-based infrastructure).

• Strong detection engineering skills: writing and tuning rules/detections in SIEM platforms (e.g., Chronicle, Splunk, Elastic) and SQL.

• Experience building or operating SOAR workflows and automating response at scale (ideally with Golang and Temporal).

postings.descriptionText:
CIQ OVERVIEW

CIQ builds the enterprise infrastructure that powers the world's most demanding workloads. From the operating system layer through AI infrastructure, high-performance computing, and cloud-native orchestration, CIQ delivers the speed, security, scalability, and sovereignty that major enterprises, government agencies, and research institutions depend on.

CIQ is the founding support and services partner of Rocky Linux and the developer of the RLC Pro family of Enterprise Linux distributions, Fuzzball workload orchestration, Warewulf Pro cluster provisioning, and Ascender Pro automation. Our customers include some of the largest and most technically sophisticated organizations in the world, working across HPC, AI/ML, defense, and regulated industries.

We are a company of builders, operators, and open source practitioners. If you want to do work that matters, at a company that is genuinely changing how enterprise infrastructure gets built and run, we want to talk.

POSITION SUMMARY
This isn't a traditional job description. It describes the specific person we're looking for: an engineer who understands the Linux operating system from a security perspective.
What does that mean in practice? Here is what we need from this role:

• How security errata works in an operating system (CSAF, VEX, Advisories) and how to create them and use them in various aspects of the systems, from updateinfo in repos to a security feed for security scanners to ingest.

• Compliance on an operating system - Building out STIG and DIS profiles. Understanding how to improve OpenSCAP and building Ansible scripts to apply the security profiles, not just applying scripts that someone else built.

• Proactive security in an operating system, like build flags, LKRG, SELinux. How to really secure the OS in a way that also allows it to be usable. Not hooking it up to the internet is not an acceptable security answer.

• How to build tools to make the above happen faster and interact with AI to speed up development, testing, and release.

• CVE scoring - How they are scored and what that means. It doesn’t mean that you know how to look up a score in NIST, but it means you have used the CVSS calculator and you know why it is scored a 7.8 vs. a 5.5

• CVE affectedness - You understand how to determine if a piece of software is affected by a CVE and how different aspects of build and configuration change the affectedness.

Is This Role Right for You?
If the requirements above don't resonate with your experience, this position is likely not the right fit. If you meet most of them, we'd like to hear from you. We're looking for candidates who are genuinely engaged with this work, so we ask that automated or mass applications be avoided.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

• Proven work experience in Security and/or Linux Engineering with a focus on the Linux OS.

• At least 4 years of experience doing security in Linux and at least 2 years of experience building Linux Packages

BENEFITS

•
Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

Flexible paid time off.

•
Employee stock options.

• Remote work; no travel required for most positions.

postings.descriptionText:
About Nebius :

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Offensive security
The internal offensive security team is responsible for the penetration testing program, red team engagements, and offensive research aimed at uncovering sophisticated attack scenarios targeting high-value assets across the Nebius Cloud stack.

The Role
We're hiring an Offensive Security Engineer to join us at Nebius . You'll design and execute adversarial simulation across our cloud platform - attacking the same infrastructure our customers depend on - and translate findings into measurable security improvements.
This is a hands-on engineering role within Product Security Team. You will be part of an internal red team, establish a penetration testing program, and conduct research to uncover sophisticated attack scenarios targeting high-value assets across the Nebius tech stack.

What you’ll do

• Validate and extend early-stage Secure SDLC threat models via continuous penetration testing , assessing threat severity and mitigation status while challenging assumptions made during threat modeling and system development. Automate routine validations to keep pace with increasing feature flow, reserving manual analysis for genuinely complex cases.

• Plan and execute full-scoped red team engagements against Nebius cloud platform - including compute, storage, inference, networking, orchestration layers, and internal tooling. Identify threats, which are able to impact an organization's operations. Work closely with Detection & Response and other security engineering teams to run purple team exercises, validate detection coverage, and close gaps collaboratively.

•
Research novel attacks against GPU infrastructure (e.g., closed-source firmware and vendor driver binaries, device passthrough exploits, SR-IOV/IOMMU misconfigurations, RDMA/InfiniBand fabric attacks, etc.), the inference stack (e.g., vLLM, TRT-LLM), and AI platform managed services (e.g., managed Slurm). Assess tenant-isolation boundaries and how they can be broken at the low-level stack

• Conduct targeted assessments of new products and infrastructure changes before they ship.

• Deliver clear, actionable reports for both technical audiences and leadership - with prioritized findings and remediation guidance.

• Establish red team processes, tooling, and a methodology that scales as the platform grows.

What we’re looking for

• 6+ years in offensive security - penetration testing, red teaming, or adversary simulation

• Deep experience attacking cloud-native environments: Kubernetes privilege escalation, cloud IAM abuse, virtualization and container escapes.

• Strong fundamentals across the attack lifecycle: initial access, persistence, lateral movement, data exfiltration.

• Proficiency developing custom tooling and post-exploitation capabilities (Python, Go, or similar).

• Experience running purple team exercises and working constructively with blue teams.

• Ability to write clear, senior-level reports with business-contextualized risk (not just raw findings) that engineers can easily use.

Nice to have

• Experience attacking ML infrastructure, model serving pipelines, or GPU clusters.

• Reverse engineering and exploits development experience

• Application security experience

• Familiarity with eBPF bypass techniques or kernel-level exploitation.

• Background in vulnerability research or CVE discovery.

• Experience with cloud provider internals (hypervisor/networking layers).

• Presenting your security research at conferences like BlackHat/DefCon, etc.

Why this role at Nebius

• Attack surface that's genuinely novel - GPU clusters, AI platforms, multi-tenant cloud at scale.

• Work alongside world-class engineers on infrastructure that powers frontier AI.

• Competitive compensation with equity upside in a Nasdaq-listed, high-growth company.

• Flexible, remote-first culture

Hiring process

• Recruiter's chat (30mins)

• Live-coding interview (60mins) to asses basic coding skills

• Security interview (60mins) to asses domain expertise

• Security System Design interview (90mins) to assess practical experience

• (Optional) Technical deep dive (90mins) to present a complex and impact project.

• Final interview to close the hiring process (45mins)

Benefits & Perks:

• Competitive compensation

• Career growth and learning opportunities

• Flexibility and ownership

• Collaborative and innovative culture

• Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

• International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius :

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

postings.title: Senior Product Manager, Mapping & Content
postings.descriptionText:
About the company

At Nuitée , we are building the API backbone for the global travel industry. Founded in 2017, Nuitée is on a mission to transform a fragmented travel ecosystem with simple, scalable, and API-first infrastructure—think “Stripe for Travel.”

By enabling seamless connectivity between hotels, OTAs, fintechs, super-apps, and businesses, some of which are entering the travel market for the first time, Nuitée empowers companies to deliver reliable travel products effortlessly. Our robust platform simplifies complex supplier networks, offering direct access to hotel inventory with better pricing, coverage, and technology.

With teams across the globe, including hubs in London, New York, San Francisco, Palma de Mallorca and Casablanca, Nuitée has grown into a global infrastructure provider trusted by industry leaders like Hopper, Priceline, Google, and Uber.

Now backed by leading VCs and world-class investors including leaders from , Stripe, and Shopify, Nuitée is positioned to redefine the B2B travel market, streamline operations for hotels, and enable new applications through cutting-edge APIs.

Nuitée is at the forefront of a revolution—delivering AI-powered, smarter, and more personalized travel experiences for a new era.

About the job
Remote in EU, or hybrid in Barcelona, Palma, Dublin, or Casablanca.
This is a product role where a good idea in the morning can be in the product by the evening.
You'll own Mapping & Content: the layer that decides whether a room one supplier calls "Deluxe Double" and another calls "Habitación Deluxe" are recognized as the same physical room, at a precision and coverage the rest of the industry hasn't matched.
You’ll run it as a full business and product domain. You’re accountable for the outcomes, economics, priorities, and product decisions. You’ll help define what success looks like, then decide with your team what to prioritise, what to test, what to build, and where to make trade-offs.
The problem underneath is unusually complex. A single physical hotel room can be described in 500 to 1,000 different ways across suppliers, languages, and content formats. How do you resolve that ambiguity at scale, and keep improving coverage without degrading accuracy?

What makes it interesting for you

• You can move extremely fast. There's very little red tape, teams make their own product decisions, and the culture is much closer to ask for forgiveness than wait for permission. If something makes sense, you can test it quickly instead of spending weeks getting alignment.

• You own the path to the outcome. You'll agree what success looks like, then decide with your team how to get there.

• You get a genuinely hard, industry-wide problem. Room and hotel mapping has resisted easy solutions across travel, and you're inheriting one of the strongest systems in the market: roughly 99.5% accuracy at 85% coverage, validated by customers like EasyJet who chose Nuitée over the alternatives.

• You'll help build Nuitee's product organisation. We got to roughly €1B in booking value without a proper product org. Now we're building one, and you'll help shape it as we push toward €10B.

Nuitée has grown 10x since 2022, was profitable before raising a $48M Series A led by Accel, and works with companies such as Revolut, Grab, Hopper, Priceline, and Sabre. This role comes with meaningful equity, so when we hit our next growth milestones, you get real upside in the company you’re helping build.

The kind of problems you’ll work on

• How do you map the same physical room across hundreds of differently worded supplier descriptions, in different languages, with extremely high confidence?

• When should the system prioritize coverage versus precision, and how do you increase coverage without degrading accuracy?

• How do you identify the highest-value mapping failures and focus the team where better mapping creates the biggest customer or commercial impact?

This role fits if you

• Have owned a product or business area end to end for several years and can show the outcomes you drove.

• Understand entity resolution and can go deep into data or ML product problems: search, matching, catalogues, identity, recommendations, knowledge graphs, or content quality.

• Can go deep into data and technical mechanics and turn that into product decisions, without needing to be the person building the algorithm.

• Are comfortable working closely with engineering and data science on technically complex products.

• Have worked in a high-pressure environment where you were expected to drive the outcome yourself.

• Are willing to go deep into ambiguous, probabilistic problems rather than staying at surface-level product management.

Data and platform depth matters more to us than travel experience.
Nuitée moves quickly, has little process, and gives people a lot of room to make decisions. You’ll do well here if ambiguity does not slow you down, you like going deep into difficult problems, and you want to be accountable for what your product actually delivers.
If this sounds like your kind of product role, we’d love to hear from you. You can apply with your LinkedIn profile or CV. The process is straightforward and typically takes 2–3 weeks.

Why Nuitee?

At Nuitée , we’re not just reimagining travel—we’re building the infrastructure to power it.

• Massive Market Opportunity: We are tackling the $9.9tn travel industry, starting with the $75 billion B2B hotel market, a fragmented space filled with outdated systems, gatekeepers, and inefficiencies. Nuitée ’s API-first platform is solving this, enabling businesses to access hotel inventory seamlessly and at scale.

• World-Class Backing: Backed by Accel and visionary leaders across tech and travel—including Booking.com, Stripe, and Shopify—we’re equipped to scale our ambition globally.

• Bootstrapped Resilience, Startup Agility: Having grown profitably for years without external funding, we combine operational discipline with the speed and innovation of a scaling startup.

• Global Impact: Our infrastructure supports partners like Google, Grab, worldwide fintechs, superapps, travel companies and others

• AI-Driven Innovation: Nuitée is uniquely positioned to power the future of travel in the AI era—enabling seamless, intelligent, and hyper-personalized travel interactions.

By joining Nuitée , you’ll be part of a team that’s building a category-defining platform. You’ll work on a global scale, innovate alongside industry leaders, and help drive the next phase of travel technology. If you’re excited to push boundaries, redefine a multi-trillion-dollar industry, and grow with us— Nuitée is the place for you.

By submitting your application, you consent to Nuitée processing your personal data for the purposes of assessing your suitability for employment. Your information will be stored securely and will only be retained for as long as necessary for the recruitment process, or up to 6 months afterward, in accordance with our data protection policy and applicable laws. You have the right to request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us at . For more details, please see our Privacy Policy: Nuitée Privacy Notice 2026.

POSITION OVERVIEW
The Lien Resolution Team Lead runs the function that determines how much of every settlement actually reaches our clients. You will supervise a team of reductions and lien resolution specialists, personally handle the largest and most complex lien files, and own the metrics that measure our performance — aggregate reduction rate, net-to-client percentage, and time from settlement to disbursement.
This is a negotiation role with a management layer on top. Every dollar your team takes off a medical balance, a hospital lien, or a health plan’s subrogation claim is a dollar that goes to an injured client instead. You will set the standard for how hard those negotiations are pushed, hold the team to it, and step in personally when a provider or plan will not move.

Post-settlement medical bill and liens

Lead the team. Supervise, train, and evaluate a team of reductions and lien resolution specialists. Assign files, manage workload distribution, run regular file reviews, and develop the team’s negotiation skills.

Own the numbers. Track and report aggregate reduction percentage, dollars saved, aging, and settlement-to-disbursement turnaround. Identify where the team is leaving money on the table and fix it.

Negotiate the hard files. Personally handle high-balance, high-complexity, and escalated reductions where the provider or plan has refused to move at the specialist level.

•
Resolve statutory and plan liens. Direct the resolution of Medicare conditional payments and Medicare Secondary Payer obligations, Florida Medicaid (AHCA) claims under Fla. Stat. § 409.910 including the administrative challenge process, ERISA and self-funded plan reimbursement claims, TRICARE and VA claims, and hospital and provider liens under applicable county ordinances.

Manage letter of protection balances. Negotiate LOP balances with treating providers and maintain documentation consistent with Fla. Stat. § 768.0427 disclosure requirements.

Apply the collateral source framework. Analyze health insurance payments, PIP benefits, and other collateral sources under Fla. Stat. § 768.76 to establish the correct reimbursement exposure before negotiating.

Build provider relationships. Establish and maintain working relationships and, where appropriate, standing reduction arrangements with high-volume providers, facilities, and lien resolution vendors.

Improve the process. Standardize templates, escalation paths, and negotiation playbooks; recommend and help implement case management system and workflow improvements.

• Working knowledge of Medicare Secondary Payer rules and conditional payment resolution.

Build and lead Wavelength’s licensing business in your market
Location: Worldwide - priority markets across North America, Europe, Middle East, Asia Pacific and Latin America

Compensation: Partnership based on standard Licensing gross revenue share

About Wavelength
At Wavelength we are building a global social media, marketing and creator agency built around the power of talent, content and communities . Founded by the team behind the Extreme Sports Channel , we bring 30+ years of media and entertainment experience together with a global network of leading creators (Super Car Blondie), athletes and social publishing pages. Our network has 300 million+ followers and reaches 950 million+ views every month across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Snapchat and Facebook.
We create high impact marketing campaigns that connect brands with engaged audiences through creator partnerships, social storytelling, content production and live experiences across adventure, action sports, travel, automotive, fitness, wellness, beauty, technology, sustainability and entertainment.

The Opportunity
We are putting together a network of territory focused licensing agents around the world and looking for highly connected, commercially driven, deeply experienced brand licensing specialists who understand their local market and have the relationships, credibility and entrepreneurial drive to build a licensing business with us around some of the world's leading social media talent and social brands.
As a Country Licensing Agent , you will effectively become our partner and licensing representative in your territory. You will identify where our talent, brands, content and intellectual property can create commercial value and then find, pitch and develop the partners capable of bringing those opportunities to market.

Here is what you will be doing

Creator and brand

• Map the local licensing ecosystem, including manufacturers, retailers, distributors, brands and potential licensees

Business Development & Sales

• Conduct targeted outreach and business development.

•
Generate new licensing opportunities

• Present Wavelength's talent, properties and licensing opportunities to prospective partners

• Lead commercial discussions and negotiations alongside Wavelength

• Develop opportunities from initial conversation through to signed agreement

•
Collectibles

Digital products

Brand collaborations

Co-branded products and experiences

This includes:

• Maintaining relationships with licensees and commercial partners

• Coordinating with Wavelength on negotiations and agreements

•
Supporting partner onboarding

•
Managing the local licensing pipeline

• Monitoring opportunities and deal progress

• Supporting product and campaign development where required

• Identifying additional commercial opportunities within existing partnerships

• Reporting market intelligence and pipeline development to Wavelength

• Helping grow successful partnerships over the long term

You will own the market relationship , while Wavelength provides the wider network, talent relationships, commercial infrastructure and central support.

What Wavelength Brings
We will provide access to a growing international network of creators, athletes, publishers and talent , giving you a portfolio of properties and personalities that can be taken to market.

We provide:

• Access to Wavelength's global talent network

•
Creator and athlete relationships

• Licensing opportunities and intellectual property

• Central commercial and management support

•
International market knowledge

•
Pitch materials and commercial assets

• Support with negotiations and deal structures

• Global relationships with brands and agencies

•
Cross market opportunities

• The ability to build international licensing programmes around successful properties

As The Country Licensing Agent, you will bring the local knowledge, relationships, commercial instinct and execution .

Who We Are Looking For
This opportunity is suited to someone who already has a strong network and understands how business is conducted in their respective market.
Desired professional background and industry experience

•
Licensing

•
Sports marketing

•
Brand partnerships

•
Media

•
Entertainment

•
Consumer products

•
Advertising

•
Sponsorship

•
Athlete or creator representation

•
IP development

•
Agency business development

•
Fashion

•
Gaming

•
Publishing

We are particularly interested in individuals who can demonstrate:

• A strong network of senior commercial contacts

• Excellent business development and sales skills

•
Knowledge of their local market

• Experience negotiating commercial partnerships

•
An entrepreneurial mindset

•
Ability to work independently

• Strong communication and presentation skills

• Ability to identify opportunities rather than simply respond to them

• Persistence and the ability to develop relationships over time

• Genuine interest in creators, talent, media, brands and intellectual property

Applying
We are looking for entrepreneurs and agents and not employees . You should already know your market. You should already know who the major players are. If you can open doors, develop relationships and turn opportunities into revenue, we want to hear from you. Apply through the portal or send your resume and cover letter to Thando () with the following:

• A summary of your relevant experience in licensing, IP commercialization, or media partnerships, including a link to your LinkedIn profile.

• Overview of your active industry network, key local market relationships,

• Examples of high-impact partnerships, licensing agreements, or commercial deals you have personally developed and closed.

Why Wavelength?
The creator economy has created an enormous amount of valuable intellectual property, audiences and cultural influence. Much of that value remains underdeveloped commercially.
Wavelength sits at the intersection of creators, audiences, brands, media and commercial partnerships . We are building a global network that can identify that value and turn it into scalable commercial opportunities. For the right licensing agent, this represents an opportunity to build a significant licensing business in their market without having to build the underlying talent network themselves.

Who You Are
We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who thrives in high-ownership environments and knows what it takes to build, ship, and operate distributed systems at scale, not just design them.
You’ll help build and scale a product that relies on reliable, high-throughput backend services

You're someone who has seen production fail, learned from it, and built better systems because of it. You care about observability, reliability, and code quality not as checkboxes but as craft. You're comfortable with ambiguity, collaborative by nature, and you raise the bar for the engineers around you.

What you’ll do

• Design and implement distributed backend systems : services that are resilient,
observable, and scalable (latency, throughput, reliability).

background workers, and idempotent processing.

(if applicable), and systematic improvements (SLOs, error budgets, runbooks).

• Raise the engineering bar : lead by example in code quality, API design, testing
strategy, and operational best practices.

• Deeply instrument services with logs, metrics, and traces; help standardize
observability patterns across the platform.

•
Partner with Product and other engineers to define success metrics, measure impact,

and iterate quickly based on real usage.

•
Mentor and guide : review designs and PRs, support other engineers, and shape

long-term technical direction.

Specifically, we’re looking for

•
Senior experience (typically 8+ years) building and operating backend systems in

production.

• Strong coding skills in Go (production-grade, not scripting).

• Distributed systems fundamentals : concurrency, backpressure, retries, idempotency,
consistency tradeoffs, schema evolution, failure modes.

• Cloud and infrastructure maturity (AWS preferred): designing services with managed
cloud components, scaling patterns, cost awareness.

•
Kubernetes and Docker experience: containerized services, deployments, operational

workflows.

• Observability expertise : traces, metrics, logs, dashboards, alerting, incident analysis
(Datadog and/or OpenTelemetry experience is a plus).

• Databases : strong PostgreSQL skills (schema design, indexing, query tuning) plus
comfort working with OpenSearch and modern data stores.

• Engineering rigor : testing strategies (unit, integration, contract), CI/CD hygiene, safe
rollout patterns (feature flags, canaries, gradual releases).

Bonus

•
Experience with queueing and streaming systems (SQS, SNS, Kafka, Kinesis,

RabbitMQ, Pub/Sub).

•
Vector databases and retrieval patterns (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Qdrant,

OpenSearch vector).

• Redis, MongoDB (only if truly used and not just “resume keywords”).

• Terraform (or equivalent IaC), GitHub Actions (or similar CI/CD).

•
Security basics for backend systems (authn/authz, secrets management, least privilege,

threat-aware design).

What success looks like

• Services that are easier to operate: clear SLOs, better alerts, faster incident resolution.

• Higher throughput and lower latency as usage grows.

•
Stronger platform foundations: repeatable patterns for async processing, observability,

and safe deployments.

• A team that levels up through your mentorship and technical leadership.

Ideally, you are someone that

•
Has previously worked in startups - comfortable navigating some uncertainty and high

energy environments

•
Enjoys the collaborative process with different roles to design, implement and iterate on

possible ideas and solutions

•
Is not a perfectionist but has a mindset of continuous, incremental improvements

towards top-quality work

• Is great at communicating with engineers, product managers, and other team members

•

Bonus:

•
Worked in the SalesTech space

Our Process
We want to be mindful of your time while finding the right candidate for our team. No homework to do, only human interactions ! Our typical recruitment timelines looks like this:

• Screening call with Talent Acquisition (30 minutes) - to know more about you and go deeper about the role

• Technical fit call with CTO (30 minutes) - to get to know each other, know about your technical depth.

•

Virtual Onsite Session :

• Coding Session (1 hour) : In this hands-on session, you'll pair with our engineers to solve a real-world problem, focusing on clean logic, maintainability, and how you think through edge cases in real-time.

If all goes well, we’ll then make you an offer !

Literary Content Specialist (Remote, Project-based)

Role Summary

The Literary Content Specialist is responsible for reviewing, editing, and enhancing passage-based test questions and solutions across standardized exams. This project-based role focuses on ensuring clarity, accuracy, and pedagogical effectiveness of literary analysis and reading comprehension content for LSAT, SAT, ACT, and other standardized testing platforms. The Literary Content Specialist works independently and collaboratively to maintain Jack Westin 's quality standards while contributing to the development and refinement of test preparation materials.

Compensation Terms:

• $60 per passage review and solution rewriting (3-5 questions included)

• $20 per passage review of another writer's edits

• $20 per hour for meetings, admin, and training time

• Payment on the 10th and 26th of each month for work completed and accepted within 6 business days prior

• Project-based, flexible commitment

• Work remotely with flexible scheduling

Primary Responsibilities

Content Review & Editing

• Review and assess passage-based test questions for clarity, accuracy, and test-readiness

• Make CARS Passage amendments by changing

• Edit existing passage reviews and solutions written by other contributors

• Provide substantive feedback on question structure, stem clarity, and distractor quality

• Ensure consistency with test format standards and Jack Westin quality guidelines

• Identify gaps in question coverage and suggest improvements

Solution Development & Refinement

• Rewrite and refine solutions to test questions for clarity and pedagogical effectiveness

• Develop comprehensive explanations for correct answers and distractors

• Create background context and explanatory material for challenging passages

• Ensure reasoning is transparent and accessible to test-takers

• Align solutions with established Jack Westin CARS Section pedagogy and learning objectives

Quality Assurance

• Ensure content meets Jack Westin quality standards for standardized test preparation

• Maintain consistency in explanation depth, vocabulary level, and pedagogical approach

• Self-evaluate work against established quality standards before submission

• Participate in revision rounds to achieve quality benchmarks

• Identify patterns in quality issues and suggest systemic improvements

Collaboration & Communication

• Collaborate with content leads and other specialists to maintain content consistency

• Communicate clearly about editorial decisions and quality concerns

• Participate in feedback cycles and implement revisions efficiently

• Support the development of style guides and quality standards

• Maintain organized documentation of work completed

Qualifications

Education & Credentials

• Required Bachelor's degree in English, Literature, Communications, or related field (Master's preferred)

• Deep expertise in LSAT reading comprehension and logical reasoning (preferred)

• Strong knowledge of literary analysis, critical reading, and test-taking strategies

• Familiarity with SAT, ACT, GRE, or other standardized exams involving reading comprehension (preferred)

• Understanding of item writing and assessment design principles

Experience

• 3+ years of experience in standardized test preparation or educational content development

• Proven track record in the testing industry (SAT, ACT, MCAT, LSAT, GRE)

• Experience writing or editing test questions and solutions for standardized exams

• Background in higher education test preparation or tutoring

• Demonstrated ability to assess and improve written content for clarity and pedagogy

• Experience working with multiple standardized exam formats

Skills & Competencies

• Expert-level writing and editing skills with attention to precision and clarity

2+ years of professional experience building Shopify stores using theme-store themes.

How Success Is Measured
Success in this role will be measured by your ability to:

• Create polished, conversion-focused Shopify storefront experiences.

• Combine strong UX thinking with practical hands-on Shopify execution.

• Use Shopify's Theme Customizer effectively rather than unnecessarily relying on custom development.

About Playbypoint

We're a rapidly expanding startup at the forefront of the racquet sports industry. At Playbypoint , we specialize in providing innovative enterprise software solutions that empower clubs, players, and coaches to streamline their operations and enhance their game. We're backed by top investors, trusted by leading clubs, and scaling fast – and we're looking for passionate individuals to join us in revolutionizing the racquet sports world with cutting-edge software.

The Role
We're building the platform that lets the world build on top of Playbypoint — and we're looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to be part of it. This goes beyond a traditional external API: you'll design and deliver the full stack of surfaces that enable developers, partners, and AI agents to integrate with us — REST APIs, MCP servers, skills, webhooks, and the developer experience layer that ties it all together.
This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role at the intersection of platform engineering and the emerging ecosystem of AI-powered builders.
Our stack: Ruby on Rails (backend), React + TypeScript (frontend), GraphQL and REST APIs, MySQL / Redis / Sidekiq, cloud-native infrastructure on AWS.

What You'll Do

• Design and build Playbypoint 's external API — versioned, stable, and built to scale with a growing ecosystem of integrators and partners.

• Develop and maintain MCP servers and skills that expose Playbypoint capabilities to AI agents and developer tools.

• Own the developer experience end to end: API documentation, developer portal, onboarding flows, SDKs, and sandbox environments.

• Define API governance practices: versioning strategy, deprecation policies, backward compatibility, and breaking change management.

• Build the infrastructure that makes our external surfaces observable and reliable — rate limiting, auth, throttling, usage analytics.

• Partner with product and internal engineering teams to expose platform capabilities through well-designed, consistent integration contracts.

• Track and shape how the ecosystem of builders — human and AI — integrates with Playbypoint .

You Might Thrive in This Role If You

• Have 7+ years of software engineering experience, with significant focus on API design, platform development, or developer tooling.

• Are comfortable across the full stack — backend API design and frontend developer portal/documentation surfaces.

• Have designed and shipped public or partner-facing APIs at scale — versioning, auth models, rate limiting, and the full lifecycle of an external API are familiar territory.

• Have hands-on experience building for AI-era integration surfaces — MCP servers, agent skills, LLM tool definitions, or similar patterns.

• Care deeply about developer experience: you've built or contributed to developer portals, SDKs, or documentation systems that builders actually love.

• Understand the difference between an internal API and an external one — backward compatibility, contract stability, and the cost of breaking changes are not abstract concepts.

• Are comfortable working across teams to define integration contracts that balance internal velocity with external stability.

• Communicate clearly and default to async. Strong written and spoken English is a must — we work closely with US-based stakeholders and partners, and our developer-facing surfaces are products in themselves.

Engineering in the AI Era
We expect every engineer at Playbypoint to work with AI as a core part of their craft — not as a novelty, but as a force multiplier across the entire SDLC. That means:

• Actively using AI tools throughout the development lifecycle — design, coding, code review, testing, debugging, and incident analysis.

• Having built AI-powered tooling or agents — whether internal automation, LLM-integrated features, or workflow improvements that shipped to production.

• Knowing when AI adds real value and when it doesn't — judgment matters more than enthusiasm.

We don't expect everyone to be an AI researcher. We do expect you to be fluent in the tools and patterns of the moment, and curious about what's next.

Bonus

• Experience building API gateways, developer portals, or API management platforms.

• Deep familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol), agent skill frameworks, or AI-native integration patterns.

• Background in vertical SaaS, marketplaces, or fintech — where API reliability directly impacts partner revenue.

• Familiarity with OpenAPI/Swagger, webhook infrastructure, or event-driven integration patterns.

•
Experience with Ruby on Rails at scale.
