postings.title: Infrastructure / Systems Operations Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
At ZIGChain , we're designing the next generation of blockchain infrastructure, leveraging decentralized technologies for enhanced security, scalability and interoperability. Our mission is to empower people everywhere through transparent, decentralized systems that drive financial freedom. ZIGChain is a Layer 1 blockchain focused on unlocking financial opportunities for everyone, regardless of their income, location or level of knowledge.
We're looking for a junior-to-mid systems and infrastructure engineer to take on the day-to-day operation of our Linux, AWS, and blockchain-node infrastructure. You'll start by owning routine administration and monitoring, and grow into more of our infrastructure-as-code and node-operations work over time. This is a hands-on operations role with a clear path to broader responsibility, and a great fit for someone with solid fundamentals who wants to deepen their cloud and infrastructure skills in a real production environment.

Requirements

What You'll Do

• Operate and maintain our Linux, AWS, and blockchain-node infrastructure on a day-to-day basis.

• Own routine administration, monitoring, and troubleshooting of services and networking.

• Contribute to our infrastructure-as-code work with Terraform, growing your ownership over time.

• Support blockchain node operations across our ecosystem.

• Automate recurring tasks and diagnostics through scripting.

• Help keep our systems secure, patched, and running smoothly.

Requirements

Must-Haves:

• Linux administration: CLI fluency, systemd, package management, log analysis, and troubleshooting of services and networking.

• Shell scripting (Bash) for automation and diagnostics.

• Working knowledge of core AWS services: EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudWatch, and load balancers (ELB/ALB). You should be able to operate and debug them, not necessarily architect them.

• Terraform at a working level: you have authored and applied configurations and understand state and the plan/apply cycle. Prior Terraform experience on any cloud is fine, it doesn't need to be AWS.

• Networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, SSH, firewalls and security groups.

• Git: comfortable with the everyday branch/commit/PR workflow.

• Sound credential and access hygiene: proper SSH key handling, least-privilege IAM, keeping secrets out of code and repositories, and keeping systems patched.

Cool-to-Haves:

• Terraform beyond the basics: modules, remote state, multi-environment setups.

• Blockchain node experience, whether with Cosmos specifically or another chain.

•
Docker; Kubernetes exposure is a plus.

• Monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana).

•
Python for tooling beyond Bash.

•
CI/CD exposure.

Soft Skills

• Accountability: you own your work and communicate openly when something goes wrong, focusing on fixing it rather than explaining it away.

• Honesty and candor: you speak up for what's good for the team, even when it's not the easiest thing to say.

• A self-taught instinct: you're comfortable figuring things out on your own and genuinely enjoy learning, since much of this role is grown into rather than known on day one.

• Collaborative team player, self-directed and comfortable working autonomously in remote environments.

What We Offer

• Competitive annual salary ranging from $40,000.00 to $50,000.00 (USD) depending on seniority.

• 15% extra to the salary in ZIGs tokens as part of the compensation package.

•
Fully remote work environment.

• Opportunity to work in a cutting-edge industry.

• Collaborative and inclusive work culture.

• Professional growth and development opportunities.

Why Join ZIGChain ?

• Impact, help operate and strengthen the core infrastructure that powers a decentralised, interoperable financial future,

• Innovation, work with a cutting-edge tech stack in a space that rewards experimentation and creativity,

• Ownership, take real responsibility for systems that matter from your first weeks, with a clear path to more,

• Growth, join a team that values learning, autonomy and technical excellence at every level.

Our Core Values
At ZIGChain we don't just build blockchain technology, we build a culture rooted in five values that shape how we work every day.

• Extreme Ownership: we close the loop. Work ends shipped, killed, or explicitly handed off, and we escalate when blocked instead of going silent,

• Heroes Don't Scale: we step up when the moment demands it, then build the processes, workflows and agents that prevent the next crisis,

• Excellence: excellence is what ships. Quality and time are fixed, scope flexes, and we aim to deliver work that becomes the reference others measure against,

• Strategic Intelligence: we think in second and third orders, naming downstream consequences before committing and choosing speed or depth as the moment requires,

• The Org Is AI: AI executes work and holds the system while we give it direction. Building and orchestrating agents is basic literacy here.

These values drive how we work, grow and make an impact, and we're inviting you to be part of it. Apply now!

Highlights
Own the day-to-day of ZIGChain 's Linux, AWS and node infrastructure, and grow into IaC and node operations. Fully remote, real production environment, real responsibility.

postings.title: Senior Business Analyst (Discovery&Delivery)
postings.descriptionText:
About the role
You will own the entire requirements process on our client projects, and you will be the bridge between the client, the product and the engineering team.

This is not a BA role whose main job is documentation. We expect you to run the client communication yourself, lead discovery, shape and challenge requirements, and help design the solution together with the technical team — especially on our AI and fintech projects. You need to be technical enough to speak the same language as developers and architects, and to turn the client’s business need into something the team can actually build.

We enter projects two different ways. Often from scratch: no written product definition exists yet, and we author it with the client. Just as often by joining something already in flight: an existing backlog, someone else’s conventions, a deadline already running. Both ask the same thing of you — build the structure where there is none, and take the requirements to the point where a developer can build without guessing.

Requirements

What you will do:

• Drive the client communication — you don’t just take part in the meetings, you drive the discussion.

• Lead discovery and refinement sessions with clients in English — you run them, you don’t take notes at them.

• Shape and challenge requirements, and help design the solution together with the technical team.

• Join running projects, map what already exists, and bring the documentation to a consistent, testable state.

• Write specifications developers can build from: concise, testable acceptance criteria, no duplication, no invented facts.

• Turn unknowns into open questions with named owners, and chase them down the cheapest route that can answer them.

• Support scope and ROM estimation with explicit assumptions, dependencies and confidence levels.

• Use AI as a full working instrument in your analysis, and take part in building AI-enabled solutions — verifying everything it produces before it reaches a client or a developer.

What we are looking for:

• Strong client-facing experience — you have been the person the client talks to, not the person briefed afterwards.

• Strong fintech / banking expertise — a deep understanding of financial products and processes, integrations and data flows: enough to ask the right questions, spot the risks and challenge what the client asks for.

• An AI background — experience on projects where AI is part of the product, plus daily use of AI tools in your own analysis work, including a concrete example of catching a wrong AI output.

• Technical enough to speak the same language as developers and architects.

• 5+ years as a Business Analyst / Systems Analyst in custom software development, including at least 2 years as the only analyst on a project.

• Experience of both entries : starting a product from scratch, where the requirements had to be created rather than collected, and joining a project already in flight with documentation you did not write.

• English B2+ (C1 preferred) — enough to facilitate a workshop with a client, not only to attend one.

• Discipline in written specifications : testable acceptance criteria, and the judgement to cut what does not belong.

• Confident daily use of Jira and Confluence ; able to read designs in Figma.

• The habit of asking the uncomfortable question a second time when the first one was brushed off.

Nice to have:

• Pre-sale experience: scope shaping, assumptions, ROM estimates, proposal input.

• Domains beyond fintech: healthcare, logistics, renewable energy.

• BPMN / UML / ERD used as a means of agreement, not as a deliverable for its own sake.

• Experience mentoring analysts or reviewing other people’s specifications.

How we work:

• One department standard and one quality rubric — your work is measured against the same instrument as everyone else’s, and so is everyone else’s.

• Decisions have named gates: AI drafts, a human decides, and it is written down who decided.

• We fight documentation overload as a matter of policy. Shorter and testable beats longer and thorough.

What we offer:

• Long team focus: we create an environment of transparent communication, and minimal bureaucracy, which leads to long-term relationships.

• Development of niche expertise: we are working in several niches, such as FinTech, healthcare, and logistics. Therefore, our employees can develop their own expertise in these domains.

• Continuous learning: we create employee development plans / personal roadmaps /quick promotion processes.

• Internal career development: 80% of our current executives were promoted to those positions within S-PRO . We encourage initiative. If a person wants to set new challenges and grow, we will definitely support them.

Benefits and perks:

•
Flexible schedule.

•
Remote work model.

•
Paid vacations.

•
Paid Sick-leaves.

•
Paid State holidays.

• Keep it coherent - make sure socials, blogs, product communication, community interaction and larger content all fit the same wider narrative, adapted appropriately for different audiences.

• Execute - work directly with our existing designers/editors and bring in copywriters, creators or production teams on a contractor basis when needed. Brief them, direct them, critique the work and own the final output.

• Stay close to the community - we don't want to only appear when we have an announcement. Communication should feel human, authentic and actually engaged with what's happening.

Requirements

• Extremelyhigh agency and doesn't wait to be prompted.

• Creative and a genuinely good storyteller.

• Hands-on - can deliver value without needing a team underneath them.

• High EQ with a strong understanding of psychology and perception.

• Curious and willing to actually research what people are saying.

•

• Commercially sensible with production/collaboration costs.

What this isn't
Not performance marketing, affiliate management or someone whose job is negotiating influencer deals.
We're also not looking for a corporate PR person or someone who produces strategies for other people to execute.
They need to understand the current narrative, decide what story we should be telling, and actually make that story happen.

Responsibilities

• Analyse source data, data flows, business requirements, and downstream consumption needs.

• Work with business stakeholders, domains, engineers, testers, delivery leads, and peer architects to resolve queries and align on solution direction.

• Produce and maintain architecture artefacts: High Level Designs, Architecture Design Decisions, solution options, design rationale, assumptions, risks, and governance-ready packs.

• Present designs and recommendations to Architecture Boards and governance forums to secure alignment and approval.

• Embed data governance, metadata, lineage, controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy, and regulatory compliance into solution design, including metadata-driven delivery frameworks.

• Support delivery teams through build, testing, implementation, and issue resolution.

Work Conditions

• Start Date : October

• Location : Remote in the EU

• Long-term contract-based role: PO till December 2026 with extension to 2027

Requirements

• 8+ years' experience in data engineering and architecture, including 5+ years in data architecture (as a Data Architect, or as a senior Data Engineering Lead with demonstrable architecture ownership).

• Strong hands-on Teradata experience in an on-premises EDW environment: SQL querying, data investigation, issue analysis, and technical validation.

• Practical experience with the Teradata Financial Services Data Model or an equivalent financial services data model.

• Strong understanding of EDW design, data marts, data integration patterns, and large-scale data platform delivery.

• Experience in banking, financial services, or regulatory data environments.

• Knowledge of regulatory data requirements, including BCBS 239, RDARR, regulatory reporting, data traceability, auditability, and evidence-based control design.

• Strong data analysis and data modelling skills: source data analysis, relationship mapping, and structure definition.

• Proven ability to produce governance-ready artefacts (HLDs, ADDs) and to present them to Architecture Boards.

• Strong stakeholder management, independent ownership, and the ability to challenge constructively and drive decisions to resolution.

Technical Requirements

Mandatory

•
Teradata (on-prem EDW), advanced SQL

• Teradata FSDM or an equivalent financial services data model

•
Inmon-style integrated EDW architecture

• ETL delivery processes and tools, ideally Informatica and/or DataStage

• Metadata-driven ingestion, transformation, control, and reconciliation frameworks

• Control-M or comparable batch scheduling and orchestration tools

Nice to have

• Teradata Global Control Framework (GCFR) or a similar control framework

• Cloudera or comparable big data platforms, especially integration with EDW or lake environments

• Modern hybrid warehouse/lake architecture patterns

• Data observability, operational resilience, and production support experience

• Broader hands-on data engineering background

Highlights

Resumen del rol
El IAM Engineer es responsable de diseñar, implementar y mantener los procesos de gestión de identidades y accesos en la organización. Su objetivo principal es garantizar que cada usuario tenga los permisos adecuados en el momento justo, automatizando los procesos de alta, baja y modificación de usuarios, y asegurando el cumplimiento de políticas de seguridad y auditoría.

Responsabilidades

• Integrar las aplicaciones internas de la compañía para automatizar la asignación y revocación de permisos.

• Implementar procesos de provisión automática de usuarios (alta, baja y cambios de rol).

• Diseñar y ejecutar controles de gestión de usuarios, incluyendo bajas automáticas y campañas periódicas de revalidación de accesos.

• Colaborar con equipos de IT y Seguridad en la definición de roles, grupos y privilegios según el principio de menor privilegio.

• Desarrollar y mantener scripts o flujos de automatización para mejorar la eficiencia operativa.

• Documentar procesos, procedimientos y políticas relacionadas con el ciclo de vida de las identidades.

• Participar en auditorías internas y externas, aportando evidencia y reportes de cumplimiento IAM.

Requisitos

• Experiencia con herramientas de IAM (ej. Okta, AD, JumpCloud).

• Conocimientos de LDAP, SSO, SCIM, API REST y automatización (Python, PowerShell o similar).

• Experiencia en ambientes cloud (Google Workspace, AWS, GCP).

• Buen entendimiento de controles de cumplimiento (ISO 27001, SOC 2, ITGC).

En Cashea tenemos una cultura de trabajo basada en la confianza y el propósito. Si quieres saber por qué somos el lugar ideal para ti, estos son nuestros valores fundamentales:

• Por último, pero no menos importante, nos enfocamos en el impacto real . Todo lo que hacemos está destinado a marcar la diferencia.

postings.title: Growth Marketing Manager (SaaS / Remote / EU)
postings.descriptionText:
Ready to own it, build it, and grow it?

The Mission
Publitas turns static, dead PDFs into interactive, shoppable digital content discovery experiences. Our Reach proposition — our consumer portals, including and in the Benelux and Promozilla portals across ~40 countries — connects millions of shoppers with localized retail deals, flyers, and promotions. It is a core traffic and engagement engine for the company.
Your mission as Growth Marketing Manager is to own consumer traffic growth across our portals end to end. You will protect and grow our largest market (Benelux), where the bulk of today's traffic sits, while building a repeatable acquisition playbook to scale our newer Promozilla portals from a standing start. You own every lever that moves consumers to our portals — organic/SEO, social, affiliates and partnerships, paid, and lifecycle/retention. We work ~80% asynchronously and judge you on traffic growth, audience retention, and channel efficiency — not hours on Zoom.

What Success Looks Like (Your First 90 Days)
We measure outcomes, not tenure. In your first three months:
Day 30: You've achieved full campaign continuity with zero disruption to active Benelux flows, and audited traffic sources across the portal network — establishing a clear baseline of what drives volume in each live market and a working relationship with product and development.
Day 60: You've identified the highest-yield channel per market and the friction points capping growth (technical, behavioral, or distributional), and shipped your first round of experiments — across organic, paid, social, partnerships, or lifecycle — with early measurable lift.
Day 90: Your highest-leverage channels are running predictably in Benelux, and you've drafted and aligned a scalable acquisition playbook to roll out to the nascent Promozilla markets — mapped to the development team's product and UX/UI ETAs for Q3/Q4.

Requirements

The DNA of a Growth Marketer at Publitas
Founder-Level Ownership : You treat the portal network like your own business. You don't wait for a roadmap to be handed to you — you read the data, uncover the insight, chase down the tracking gap, and make high-impact calls autonomously.
A Continuous Growth Mindset : Consumer behavior and search/distribution algorithms shift fast. You treat traffic as a system to be engineered — constantly testing unconventional loops, optimizing channel mix, and treating every performance drop as a data point to dissect and iterate on.
High Autonomy, Low Ego : In a remote-first, async environment, the work speaks for itself. You're motivated by solving hard distribution problems, not by synchronous cheerleading, and you're comfortable being judged on the real health of portal traffic and retention.

The Non-Negotiables
Multi-Channel Traffic Mastery : A proven track record driving consumer traffic at scale across the full mix — organic/SEO (including programmatic/technical SEO), paid social and search, affiliates and partnerships, and lifecycle/retention. You understand B2C shopper psychology and how audiences hunt for promotions.
High-Volume B2C / Platform Background : Experience in app-first consumer marketplaces, coupon/deal platforms, news/media publishers, or large-scale e-commerce/affiliate networks.
Programmatic & Multi-Market Scaling : You've scaled traffic across many markets or properties and understand how to standardize a playbook and localize it efficiently — rather than rebuilding from scratch per market.
AI-First Execution : We do not scale headcount to solve manual problems. A demonstrable track record of using generative AI and automation to scale campaign copy and localization, build programmatic reporting loops, and trigger automated workflows. We are not looking for "AI-curious" — we look for people already using AI to do better work, with tangible impact to show.
Flawless Professional English : You collaborate with the global Publitas team in English; your written communication must be exceptional for an async-first team.
Dutch — strong plus .

What We Offer You to Win

• Transparent Compensation: A competitive entry-level base salary of €40 000 - €60 000 (geo-bracketed to your location in the EU) with a clear, performance-based path for career progression.

• True Remote Autonomy: We work 80% asynchronously using Notion and Slack. We don't monitor your screen or count your hours—we trust you to own your delivery targets and manage your day.

• Global Team Retreats: Working remotely shouldn't mean working isolated. We gather the entire company in inspiring cities across the globe once a year to connect, strategize, and celebrate in person.

• Premium Workspace & Gear: A top-tier MacBook, high-end remote work accessories, and co-working allowance if you prefer an office environment.

• Personal Growth Budget: A monthly wellness allowance, an education/course budget to sharpen your SaaS skills, and free access to Kindle and Audible books.

• Time Off: 25 days of paid vacation plus your local national holidays.

At Publitas, we see AI as a core lever for performance, efficiency, and innovation. We expect all team members to actively use AI in their daily work to improve quality, speed, and output.
Depending on the role, this ranges from effectively using AI tools in day-to-day workflows to designing and scaling AI-driven systems. We are not looking for candidates who are “AI-curious”; we look for people who already use AI to do better work and can demonstrate tangible impact.

This role sits at the heart of that delivery.
As Senior Mobile Developer, you will be embedded in a high-stakes client engagement - building a greenfield mobile app for a premium international luxury retail brand, from the first architectural decision to launch.

The role and responsibilities:
We are building a brand-new iOS and Android app — from scratch — as part of a major digital transformation for a premium international luxury retail brand. The app will serve 250k+ daily active users across global markets from the moment it launches.
The product replaces static navigation with a dynamic, content-driven Feed ecosystem: personalised brand stories, exclusive offers, and live in-store updates, delivered with the engagement depth of social media. It is a greenfield project — no legacy code, no technical debt, full architectural ownership from day one. The app goes live in Q3.
As Senior Mobile Developer, you will own the architecture and delivery of the app end to end. You will write code every day — this is a pure hands-on engineering role, with no team management responsibility. The client expects senior autonomy from the start. You will work alongside a senior cross-functional team: backend engineers, frontend web developers, UI/UX designers, and a PM.

Architecture & technical leadership

• Architect from scratch: Design the React Native app structure, patterns, and coding standards that the entire project will build on.

• Define the content model: Work alongside FE Web developers to design the mobile content model powering dynamic, segmented delivery.

• Drive technical decisions: Own integration choices for CMS, DAM, and personalisation tooling — and be able to defend them.

Feature development & integrations

• Integrate CMS, DAM & personalisation: Connect the tooling that delivers the right content to the right user — context-aware, segmented, and real-time.

• Implement deep linking: Build campaign-tied navigation flows and personalised user journeys across iOS and Android.

• Ship push notifications: Design and implement the full push notification layer, including deep links and campaign landing flows.

• Collaborate on features: Build and maintain new features together with backend engineers; work with UI/UX designers to assess feasibility and deliver high-quality UX.

Performance & quality

• Optimise for scale: Own caching strategy, content-fetching architecture, and rendering performance for an app used by hundreds of thousands of people daily.

• Instrument analytics: Implement event tracking that supports personalisation decisions, A/B testing, and experimentation.

• Write quality code: Idiomatic, well-tested React Native — unit and component coverage as standard practice.

• Own distribution: Manage iOS and Android release cycles and store submissions.

Requirements

Must-have:

• React Native — 5+ years of professional experience building production iOS and Android apps from scratch.

• iOS and Android platforms — both, including distribution cycles, store submissions, and platform-specific behaviour.

• CMS & DAM integration — hands-on experience delivering dynamic, segmented content in mobile via headless CMS and DAM tooling.

• Personalisation & experimentation platforms — integrating decisioning tools, recommendation engines, or A/B testing systems into a live mobile product.

• Deep linking — production experience implementing campaign and personalised navigation flows.

• Push notifications — full implementation including deep links and campaign flows.

• REST API integration — connecting mobile apps to backend services at production scale.

• Performance optimisation — caching, content-fetching, and rendering strategies for personalised, high-traffic apps.

• Analytics & event tracking — instrumentation supporting personalisation and product experimentation.

• Testable code — appropriate unit and component test coverage as standard practice.

• English C1+ — written and spoken; direct communication with an international client team is a hard requirement.

Nice to have:

• Experience with streaming APIs or AI-assisted feature integration.

• App analytics platforms such as Firebase or Amplitude.

• Consent management and third-party privacy tooling (GDPR).

• Mapping SDKs — Google Maps, Mapbox, or similar.

• Automated testing beyond unit and component level (E2E, integration).

• Broader JS ecosystem: , React, .

• A/B testing, feature flagging, and mobile attribution.

• Headless CMS architectures in retail or e-commerce environments.

• Understanding of UI/UX design principles and ability to assess feasibility.

• Polish is a plus; all project communication is conducted in English.

Highlights
Build a brand-new mobile app for a premium luxury retail brand, used by 250k+ daily users.
Own the full architecture — React Native, CMS, DAM, personalisation — from day one.

postings.descriptionText:
Job Description:
B12 's engineering team views software as a craft, but improving the world as the reason to practice it. Our engineers are responsible for prioritizing, conceptualizing, co-designing, building, testing, and engaging users for any concept we are building out. We’re generalists in encouraging each other to experience the full stack, but we’re also aware of each other’s preferences in the stack. For this role in particular, we’re searching for a tenured full-stack engineer who brings strong backend/infrastructure skills (and an interest in using them) to the product. We mentor and teach where we can, both inside and outside of the company, and as a Staff Software Engineer, you will be responsible not only for your ownership of major projects, but also mentorship of the team members with whom you ship those projects.
We value sharing our work with the outside world. Our team has published papers on forming expert flash teams and machine-mediated worker hierarchies. We’ve baked our research into various open source tools in the space of creativity, expertise, and knowledge work.
We hope our engineers have more longevity than any one tool we use, but here is a sampling of our current thoughts about technology:

• We live on Python/Django and TypeScript/React.

• We store blobs in Amazon’s S3, munch on them in Amazon’s EC2, develop in Docker, and deploy containers to Amazon’s Elastic Beanstalk.

• We believe PostgreSQL should be the first system you consider when thinking about persisting structured data.

• We clean and centralize data in Amazon’s Redshift, and are able to answer almost any question in SQL.

• We leverage AI in our product and our internal tooling, and faced with a landscape in constant flux, try to pick the right model or agent on a task-by-task basis.

Every board number, retail report, and marketing decision at Grüns runs through our data platform. As Director of Data Engineering, you will own that platform and lead the team that builds it. This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.

We're looking for someone who:

• Has 8+ years in data architecture or data engineering, including 3+ years leading teams

• Has built and scaled cloud data platforms (BigQuery or similar)

• Is strong in SQL, Python, and dbt or a similar modeling framework

• Has deep data modeling experience and starts from business concepts before tables

• Has built data quality, governance, and monitoring practices that teams trust

• Is comfortable with ELT tools like Fivetran, Orbitrail and enterprise systems (ERP experience is a plus)

Approach to the role:

• Starts with the business question, then picks the simplest technology that answers it

• Gets fundamentals right first: integrity, governance, observability

• Treats a trust problem in the data as urgent

• Prioritizes ruthlessly against their own time and everyone else's

• Stays in the weeds when needed while leading the team

• Coaches engineers to grow into senior contributors and managers

• Uses AI agents daily and teaches the team to do the same

Compensation & Benefits:

For this role, the base salary is $200,000 plus bonus + incentive compensation depending on experience, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.

A bit about us...

At Grüns , we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns , and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

Conocimientos en python.

•
Experiencia en fintech, pagos o crédito.

Experiencia con Google Cloud Platform.

Conocimiento de Docker y Kubernetes.

Español e inglés.

postings.title: Manager, Data Quality Assurance
postings.descriptionText:
Do you have a passion for children and education? Would you like to positively impact families in need of help? We want to speak with you!
Step Up For Students empowers families to pursue and engage in the most appropriate learning options for their children.

JOB SUMMARY
As a member of the Internal Assurance team, you will play a critical role in translating data governance and controls standards into audit and consulting projects that improve data trust and usability across the enterprise. This role will help ensure that downstream business processes, analytics, reporting, and AI initiatives consume accurate, complete, consistent and valid data by implementing data quality controls, enabling Cloud Data Governance & Catalog (CDGC) capabilities, and driving visibility through data quality metrics and scorecards. This role is hands-on and execution-focused, requiring close collaboration with data stewards, governance leads, data engineers, and application teams to proactively identify, resolve, and prevent data quality issues at scale.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
◦ Team Translate business-defined data quality rules into technical implementations using techniques including, but not limited to, SQL validations, profiling rules, scorecards, and pipeline controls. ◦ Implement data validation, cleansing, and standardization across enterprise data domains to prevent invalid data from propagating downstream. ◦ Partner with functional teams to implement and monitor data quality controls across our master data domains. ◦ Execute enterprise data quality frameworks, including rule standardization, threshold management, and alignment to critical data elements (CDEs). ◦ Perform data profiling and validation activities, including completeness checks, duplicate analysis, pattern validation, referential integrity checks, and anomaly detection. ◦ Configure and support CDGC capabilities, including dataset onboarding, metadata ingestion, catalog enrichment, governed asset management, and business glossary mapping. ◦ Develop, enhance, and maintain data quality rule mapping, scorecards, dashboards, and data health visibility within CDGC and related reporting tools. ◦ Support CDE classification, governed data asset onboarding, and data product registration within CDGC and data marketplace. ◦ Support and validate technical and business data lineage across our master data, analytics, and downstream platforms for traceability and impact analysis. ◦ Perform root cause analysis (RCA) over data quality errors to identify if they stem from system bugs or user entries, validate fixes through regression testing, and recommend structural and upstream process improvements to prevent recurring issues.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

REQUIRED:
◦ A minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Statistics or a related field; or 6 years of related experience with a Master's degree; or 3 years of related experience with a PhD; or an equivalent combination of education and experience. ◦ Hands-on experience in data quality, metadata management, master data management, data engineering, or governance-focused technical roles. ◦ Strong hands-on experience with Informatica CDGC, including metadata curation, dataset onboarding, catalog management, data quality rule mapping, and data quality visibility. ◦ Hands-on experience with Purview, Alation, Collibra, CluedIn, or similar data quality solutions for profiling, validation, rule implementation, scorecards, and monitoring. ◦ Strong working knowledge of master data domains, including customer, supplier, and finance, with experience supporting data quality, governance, and lifecycle management processes across ERP environments. ◦ Solid experience with scripting languages (Python or R) for automation. ◦ Familiarity with ETL tools, data profiling software, or cloud data warehouses (e.g., Azure Data Stack, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks). ◦ Experience working with business glossaries, CDEs, data lineage, and governed metadata management. ◦ Strong SQL skills and experience querying databases, developing or supporting ETL, Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC), and SQL-based data pipelines. ◦ Experience performing data profiling, data validation, issue investigation, RCA, regression testing, and remediation tracking. ◦ Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder collaboration skills. ◦ Experience in translating complex, technical data errors into actionable insights for nontechnical stakeholders.

PREFERRED:

Our second clinical candidate, DNTH212 is a first and potentially best in class, bifunctional inhibitor that targets clinically validated and complementary disease modifying mechanisms, Type 1 IFN suppression and B cell modulation – enabling potential for improved clinical outcomes and patient friendly convenient, self-administered subcutaneous injections. Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Clinical and Translational Development, this individual will serve as the senior scientific authority for bioanalytical and biomarker assays and a key partner to program teams, senior leadership, Regulatory, Quality, Clinical Pharmacology, and external collaborators.

• Relevant experience designing, building, and operating distributed backend services in production, across coding standards, code review, build, automated testing, deployment, and operations.

• A track record of building features end-to-end and owning them in production.

• Relevant experience in software design for reliability and scale, on both new and existing systems.

• Setting the operating cadence of the function: intake and prioritization of legal work, service expectations with internal clients, and reporting on workload and risk to the leadership team.

• Owning the commercial contracting framework: standard templates, negotiating positions, and a deviation and escalation process that makes commitments visible before they are signed.

• Leading intellectual property and open source licensing strategy, including copyleft, trademark and the terms on which Ubuntu and our products are distributed.

• Owning the global compliance programme: data protection and privacy, export controls and trade compliance, anti-bribery and corruption, competition and AI regulation.

• Managing litigation, disputes and regulatory engagement, together with the external counsel panel, its budget and its quality.

What we are looking for in you

• An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.

postings.title: QA Tester
postings.descriptionText:
About Vantum
Vantum helps fractional operators win new clients while delivering for the clients they already have. When you are managing several engagements, client work can consume the week and leave little time to find the next one.
The product is a web app for planning, tasks, calendar, goals, and Ask Vantum, an AI chat that helps an operator decide what to do next.
We are a team of five, working toward product-market fit. We are looking for a QA tester to use the live product the way a customer would, and to write bugs we can reproduce.
You will work directly with the founders.

What you will own
Your job is to find what is broken, write it so someone else can reproduce it, and check that the fix actually holds.

• Walk the main flows. Sign-in, home, plan, tasks, calendar, goals, notes, and Ask Vantum.

• Write each bug so it can be reproduced. Steps, what you expected, and what actually happened. Include the page, the account state, and a screenshot when it helps.

• Recheck fixes. A bug is not done because someone said it was fixed. Confirm the original steps, and check that a nearby flow did not break.

• Notice gaps. If a button does nothing, a save does not stick, or the page says one thing and the data shows another, file it.

• Ask when a behavior might be intentional. Do not guess, and do not redesign the product.

You are not building features, and you are not writing production code. Clear written English is the job.

What we are looking for
You notice when software is wrong, and you can describe it without a developer sitting next to you.
You should be able to:

• Follow a flow from start to finish. Include empty states, errors, and the second time through.

• Write a bug report a stranger can follow. Steps, expected result, actual result.

• Tell a display problem from a data problem. The page looks saved, but a refresh brings the old value back.

• Show the evidence. Use a browser, screenshots, and a short screen recording when steps are hard to write.

• Communicate clearly in written English. We read your reports every day.

• Take ownership. Retest what you filed, and say when you cannot reproduce it.

Prior QA employment is useful. It is not required. Testing your own projects, a client product, or a careful write-up of bugs in software you use counts.
We do not need test automation, a computer science degree, or experience with our stack.

Why join
You will see real product decisions, talk to the founders, and watch your reports turn into fixes.
The work is part-time and remote. You set a steady weekly rhythm with us, and you tell us what you found in writing.

Compensation and working arrangements

• $500 to $1,000 USD per month, depending on hours and how clearly you report what you find.

• Part-time, remote.

• At least three hours of weekday overlap with Bangkok (GMT+7), so we can review bugs the same day.

• Hours are agreed on the call. This is not a full-time engineering role.

How we hire
1. Written application. We read how you describe a bug.
2. Screening call. We talk through a product you tested and a bug you filed.
3. A short look at the live app. You walk one flow and write up what you find.

Apply
Describe one bug you found that was easy to miss. Include the steps, what you expected, and what actually happened.
Tell us your timezone, your weekday overlap with Bangkok, when you can start, how many hours a week you can give, and your expected monthly pay.

postings.title: PR & Brand Manager (f/m/x) - remote
postings.descriptionText:
Founded in 2017, refurbed is Europe’s fastest-growing marketplace for refurbished products, active in 23 European countries and having surpassed €2Bn in GMV — all while being profitable. With beautiful headquarters in Vienna, we operate as a remote-first company and have been recognised as a Top DACH Employer by Kununu for four consecutive years.

Our mission is to make sustainable consumption the easy choice by enabling customers to buy products up to 40% cheaper while significantly reducing CO₂ emissions.

If you thrive in an environment that values momentum, ownership, and impact, you’ll feel at home here. We’re a fast-paced, high-performance team that works hard and challenges itself everyday. To enable this high-performance every team member enjoys full autonomy over their location (we’re remote-first).

As our PR & Brand Manager (Maternity Cover), you’ll own the day-to-day relationship with our PR agencies across six markets, drive pan-European PR coordination across all our markets, and lead our brand tracking and PR research initiatives. Reporting to our Lead Brand Communications, you’ll be the go-to person for PR excellence, working cross-functionally with Marketing, Supply, Data and other teams to bring refurbed ’s brand story to life across Europe.
This is a fixed-term, 18-month contract covering a maternity leave.

WHO YOU ARE:

• You have 2-4 years of experience in PR, communications or brand roles, including experience owning relationships with PR agencies or external partners across multiple markets.

• You have highly professional written and spoken English, plus fluency in another major European language (Swedish is a strong plus, given the content and market responsibilities of this role).

• You can be based remotely anywhere in Europe; occasional travel to our markets and events is part of the role. Our Vienna HQ is available if you’d prefer to be based there.

• You take ownership end-to-end: you’re used to running a project or subarea on your own, and you don’t wait to be told what’s next — you spot gaps, improve ways of working, and raise the quality of what’s around you.

• You build strong cross-functional relationships; people come to you for PR and brand input because they trust your judgment and expertise.

• You’re highly organized and comfortable juggling multiple markets, agencies and stakeholders without losing sight of deadlines.

• You have a strong feel for written language and tone, and experience translating data and company priorities into external-facing stories.

• You have experience working with AI tools and are open to learning more about implementing AI into your daily work

• You’re passionate about sustainability, innovation and creating real impact.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

PR Agency & Market Management:

• Own the day-to-day relationship with PR agencies across SE, DK, FI, IE, BE and NL, including briefing, approving PR materials, developing local angles and following up on performance/KPIs.

• Act as the main internal point of contact for these markets, ensuring agencies have the information, data and materials they need.

Pan-European PR Coordination:

• Own and host the monthly editorial meeting across 16 PR agencies/markets, including agenda, preparation, follow-up and continuous improvement of the format.

• Drive cross-market sharing of PR ideas, opportunities and best practices.

• Manage the press pages across all markets, ensuring the latest press releases and relevant content are published and kept up to date.

Data, Research & Brand Tracking:

• Source and analyse internal data for PR stories, identify relevant trends and coordinate internal data validation.

• Own the refurbed brand tracker, including planning waves, managing research, setting up surveys and reporting results.

• Manage PR consumer studies across markets, coordinating agency input, developing and delivering results and insights.

Content & Language Support:

• Proofread and adapt content for Performance Marketing, CRM and other teams.

• Review and approve UGC/performance content.

Events & Activations:

• Plan and manage PR and influencer events, including concept, budget, agency coordination, internal stakeholders, products and logistics.

• Represent refurbed at events, including presentations/keynotes, and manage post-event reporting.

PR Project & Stakeholder Management:

• Manage PR projects from idea to execution, translating company priorities, data and initiatives into relevant external communications.

• Coordinate across PR agencies and internal teams including Marketing, Supply, Data and other stakeholders to ensure effective execution.

WHY YOU WILL ENJOY WORKING WITH US:

Our Culture and Values:

• Decisions should be made based on facts and not by hierarchy levels? We sure think so!

• We embrace giving and receiving feedback, testing and welcoming new ideas, as well as sharing our knowledge across the company.

• You fail sometimes? Well, so do we! We’re all just human, let’s learn from our mistakes to improve in the future!

• No matter who you love, where you’re from, who you pray to, whether you pee sitting down or standing up – we are a bunch of talented people who enjoy spending our time making a difference!

Personal & Professional Development:

• You'll have access to a dedicated learning budget within your department to support your growth, whether it's courses, conferences, or other learning opportunities that matter to you.

• We partner with Likeminded, offering you private sessions with experts for your personal growth and mental health.

• We frequently host internal workshops, allowing our teams to further develop their skills in different areas and enhancing collaboration across departments.

Flexibility:

• We care about a healthy work/life balance. We not only function and support a fully remote setting but also offer the possibility to work from our beautiful office in the vibrant heart of Vienna – we love dogs, so feel free to bring your furry little buddy too 😊

• We trust you to do the best job, so we don't care so much when you do it – you are able to self-organize.

• You will also be invited to take part in our office weeks, happening three times a year, where you will have the chance to work side by side with your colleagues and enjoy the team-building events and on-site workshops

…and much more! See for further insights!

postings.title: Marketing Project Manager
postings.descriptionText:
About TurFresh

TurFresh is a growing artificial turf cleaning and maintenance company serving residential and commercial
customers across multiple U.S. markets. Our marketing team includes specialists in content, creative, paid media, SEO, local search, CRM, and automation.

We are hiring a Marketing Project Manager to connect those specialties and ensure approved marketing work is planned, completed, published, tracked, and reported accurately.

The Opportunity

Our marketing strategy and specialist capabilities are in place. The opportunity is to make execution more
consistent, visible, and accountable.

This role owns the delivery process that moves marketing initiatives from approved direction through verified completion. You will manage campaign and project schedules, coordinate contributors, resolve routine delivery issues, perform assigned publishing and quality assurance work, and maintain an accurate record of progress and results.

This is not a role for someone who only schedules meetings, sends reminders, or updates task lists. We need someone who takes ownership, recognizes incomplete work, resolves problems independently, and makes sure campaigns and projects reach the finish line correctly.

You will not replace our specialists or independently set marketing strategy. Specialists remain accountable for the quality, accuracy, and documentation of their craft. You will own the delivery system: handoffs, schedules, dependencies, readiness, assigned publishing, completion evidence, and reporting preparation.

What You Will Own

Campaign and Project Delivery

• Turn approved campaign or project direction into an actionable delivery plan with owners, deadlines, dependencies, approval points, and success measures.

• Manage campaigns and marketing projects from handoff through verified publication or completion and initial performance reporting.

• Identify missing assets, overdue reviews, conflicting priorities, and delivery risks before they affect launch dates or business outcomes.

• Resolve routine execution issues directly and escalate material risks with a concise explanation and recommended next step.

• Maintain clear visibility into what is complete, what remains open, what is blocked, and who owns the next action.

Production and Publishing

• Coordinate copy, design, video, landing pages, email, social content, tracking, and other campaign components without absorbing the specialists' craft responsibilities.

• Perform assigned routine publishing work across approved email, social media, website, CRM, and content platforms.

• Schedule approved content and campaigns accurately and on time.

• Make routine website or landing page updates using established templates.

• Confirm that the correct copy, creative, links, tracking, audiences, and approvals are in place before publication.

• Verify successful publication and document completion evidence.

Quality Assurance and Campaign Readiness

• Use established checklists and the approved brief to review customer-facing materials before launch.

• Confirm required business, creative, technical, legal, and tracking approvals.

• Return incomplete submissions for correction rather than moving them forward.

• Verify links, forms, phone numbers, tracking parameters, formatting, mobile presentation, audiences, and calls to action.

• Document errors, rework, and recurring breakdowns so the underlying process can be improved.

Marketing Operations

• Maintain the marketing calendar, production queue, campaign checklists, approval records, and recurring work schedule.

• Keep project management systems accurate and current so leadership does not need to reconstruct project status.

• Organize campaign assets, final versions, supporting documents, and completion evidence.

• Document repeatable workflows and maintain marketing standard operating procedures.

• Track vendor and specialist commitments, deadlines, dependencies, and unresolved items.

• Improve handoffs among marketing, sales, operations, vendors, and technical partners.

Reporting Preparation

• Collect required performance inputs from specialists and systems.

• Confirm that reporting periods, definitions, and data sources are consistent.

• Identify missing data, conflicting figures, unsupported conclusions, and unexplained changes before reporting reaches leadership.

• Separate completed activity from measurable business results.

• Verify that work described as complete has supporting evidence.

• Prepare clear weekly reporting materials for leadership review.

• Track commitments, owners, deadlines, overdue items, corrective actions, and final outcomes.

The Marketing Growth Manager will remain responsible for interpreting performance, setting priorities, recommending investments, managing resources, and making strategic recommendations. You will ensure the underlying operating and reporting information is complete, accurate, and decision-ready.

How You Will Work With the Team

You will coordinate with internal contributors and external partners across content and editorial, graphic design and video, social media, email marketing, paid media, SEO and local search, CRM and marketing automation, website management, sales, and operations.

Routine delivery issues should be resolved directly with the responsible contributor. Budget exceptions, major priority conflicts, significant customer or revenue risks, and repeated performance problems should be escalated to the Marketing Growth Manager with a concise explanation and recommended action

What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

• Learn TurFresh's marketing systems, contributors, vendors, workflows, and approval requirements.

• Take ownership of at least one recurring campaign process and one defined weekly reporting routine.

• Establish an accurate view of active projects, owners, deadlines, blockers, and dependencies.

• Begin documenting unclear or inconsistent workflows.

By 60 Days

• Independently manage the agreed marketing calendar and production queue.

• Manage approved campaigns and projects from handoff through verified publication or completion.

• Handle routine follow-up, access issues, missing inputs, and delivery problems without returning them to the Marketing Growth Manager.

• Prepare complete and reconciled weekly reporting materials.

• Escalate material exceptions with recommended solutions.

By 90 Days

• Achieve at least 90 percent on-time delivery for campaigns and recurring marketing commitments.

• Ensure at least 95 percent of published work has documented approvals, functioning links, correct tracking, and completion evidence.

• Maintain 100 percent on-time completion of assigned recurring reports.

• Eliminate overdue work that lacks a documented owner, next action, and escalation.

• Reduce preventable publishing errors and avoidable rework from the established baseline.

• Transfer the majority of routine production coordination, publishing administration, and reporting preparation away from the Marketing Growth Manager.

• Demonstrate measurable improvements in delivery reliability, visibility, and accountability.

Required Qualifications

• Strong project management and operational follow-through, including running multiple workstreams to a fixed date without losing track of dependencies.

• Demonstrated experience independently delivering marketing campaigns or projects from planning through publication or completion.

• Hands-on experience with email, social media, website, CMS, or CRM publishing.

• Practical understanding of campaign quality assurance and tracking requirements.

• Ability to coordinate multiple contributors, deadlines, and dependencies simultaneously.

• Strong written communication and professional, assertive follow-up skills.

• Comfort using spreadsheets and consolidating performance information.

• Ability to identify inconsistent, incomplete, or unsupported reporting.

• Sound judgment about what to resolve independently and what to escalate.

• Strong attention to detail without losing sight of deadlines and business priorities.

• Ability to work effectively in a remote, fast-moving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with service businesses, multi-location companies, or lead-generation marketing.

• Familiarity with platforms such as GoHighLevel, WordPress, Shopify, Google Analytics, Google Ads, Meta, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, or similar tools.

• Experience coordinating freelancers, agencies, technical vendors, or distributed teams.

• Familiarity with UTM tracking, forms, lead routing, landing pages, and basic marketing attribution.

• Experience creating or maintaining campaign checklists, standard operating procedures, and reporting systems.

• Basic ability to make routine website, email, or landing page changes within established templates.

Experience with every platform is not required. Strong execution, judgment, learning ability, and ownership are more important than familiarity with a specific set of tools.

The Right Person for This Role

• Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just assigned tasks.

• Notices missing information before it becomes a deadline problem.

• Follows up consistently without requiring reminders.

• Can distinguish between work in progress and work that is complete and verified.

• Is comfortable returning incomplete work for correction.

• Resolves ordinary problems independently.

• Escalates important issues early and brings a recommended next step.

• Keeps systems and reporting accurate enough that leadership can rely on them.

• Enjoys bringing structure and consistency to work involving multiple specialists.

What This Role Is Not

This is not primarily a brand strategy, copywriting, graphic design, or paid media specialist position. It is also not a purely administrative project coordination role. The title reflects ownership of campaign and project delivery, not calendar and task administration.

The central responsibility is to ensure approved marketing priorities become complete, accurate, published, and measurable work while craft ownership remains with the appropriate specialists.

Selection Process
Qualified candidates may complete a short live exercise involving a fixed launch date, missing inputs, an overdue review, and conflicting data. Candidates will explain how they would organize the work, resolve or escalate issues, verify completion, and report the result. We evaluate judgment, initiative, execution, communication, attention to detail, and problem-solving.

TurFresh shares a Lever recruiting platform with our sister company, Express Chipping . As a result, you may see the Express Chipping name in the application URL or automated communications. This position is exclusively with TurFresh.

postings.title: Director of ABM and Campaigns
postings.descriptionText:
About Doppel
Doppel is building the future of social engineering defense. Our AI-native platform uses agentic AI to protect executives, employees, customers, and brands from phishing, impersonation, fraud, and other AI-powered threats across digital channels. We help some of the world's most recognized brands detect and dismantle attacker infrastructure while strengthening employee resilience through threat-informed training and simulation. By unifying Digital Risk Protection, Human Risk Management, and Email Security, Doppel connects threats into a real-time intelligence graph to power faster disruption, smarter defense, and modern security awareness at scale.
Backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz and Bessemer Venture Partners, and trusted by leading enterprises, Doppel is a rapidly growing Series C startup building the future of social engineering defense. Our team combines deep cybersecurity expertise, operational rigor, and startup velocity to solve some of the internet's most urgent trust and safety challenges.

Tarteel was founded with one mission: to strengthen the relationship Muslims have with the Quran. Inspired by the Islamic Golden Age, we saw untapped potential in the area of religious technology. We built Tarteel to help Muslims improve their Quranic study using the best digital tools. The Quran is a journey, and Tarteel is your companion.

The Tarteel app has more than 20M downloads and is powered by our state of the art models. As a company we've established relationships with leading AI companies such as Nvidia, who has us as a featured customer: . We currently have a core team of 20 exceptionally talented individuals.

What we're looking for

Tarteel is looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to help us identify, design, and build the next generation of Quran experiences used by millions of Muslims around the world.

Our product sits at the intersection of AI, mobile technology, education, and the Quran. Many of the problems we work on don't have established playbooks: understanding a user's recitation in real time, intelligently adapting a memorization experience to an individual's performance, making sophisticated AI systems work reliably on-device and offline, and turning large amounts of user and recitation data into genuinely useful product experiences.

In this role, you will work closely with the founders, engineers, designers, researchers, and other members of the team to decide what we should build and help turn ambiguous ideas into exceptional products.

We're looking for someone who is unusually technical for a product manager. You don't need to be the engineer implementing every feature, but you should be comfortable understanding how the systems behind our products work, exploring data yourself, discussing architecture and technical tradeoffs with engineers, and rapidly prototyping ideas using modern AI and development tools.

You should be deeply curious about users, obsessive about product quality, comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, and capable of independently taking a problem from an unclear opportunity to a shipped product with measurable impact.

• Proactively identify problems and opportunities across the product rather than waiting for a roadmap or requirements to be handed to you.

• Help shape Tarteel's broader product strategy and determine where our technology can create experiences that were previously impossible.

Qualifications

• Experience owning meaningful product areas or products from discovery through launch and iteration.

• Strong technical fluency and the ability to work directly with engineers on technically complex products.

• Ability to understand APIs, databases, system architecture, AI systems, and other technical concepts well enough to independently reason about product possibilities and constraints.

• Strong analytical skills and experience using product data to investigate questions and make decisions.

• Strong product intuition and an exceptional attention to detail.

postings.title: Product Manager - ERP Platform

¡Hola! Somos Cashea 👋 y nuestra misión es devolverle a los venezolanos la oportunidad de acceder al crédito a través de un modelo de negocio BNPL (buy now, pay later).
Desde nuestro lanzamiento en 2022, nos hemos dedicado a promover la inclusión financiera . Hoy contamos con más de 9 millones de usuarios activos, tanto consumidores como comercios, y nos hemos convertido en una marca de confianza en Venezuela, ganándonos el corazón y la mente de las personas.

Sobre el rol
Cashea lleva su contabilidad, sus cuentas por pagar y sus cuentas por cobrar sobre Odoo, más las integraciones, la reportería operativa y las herramientas que cuelgan de ahí. Este rol se hace dueño de la plataforma y sus satélites acompañando al rol existente que esta en tracks criticos a integrar en el ERP.
Trabajaras en dupla con la PM de ERP, que lleva las iniciativas estratégicas: productos nuevos que aterrizan en contabilidad, expansión, proyectos de negocio. Vos llevás la plataforma: Odoo, sus módulos, sus integraciones, sus satélites y la demanda operativa del día a día.

Qué vas a hacer

• Ser owner de la plataforma: modelo de datos, módulos, versiones, permisos, upgrades y deuda funcional.

• Decidir nativo vs. módulo custom en cada pedido y sostener la decisión. Cada custom que aprobás se vuelve a pagar en el próximo upgrade.

• Diseñar y mantener la capa traductora entre los sistemas core (ledger, pagos, cobranzas) y Odoo: mapeo de eventos a asientos, idempotencia, reproceso y conciliación cuando un evento llega mal o llega dos veces.

• Hacerte cargo de los satélites: integraciones, reportería operativa, cargas manuales y las conciliaciones que hoy viven en planillas.

• Ser la puerta de entrada de la demanda de Contabilidad, Finanzas, Tesorería y Control: un solo backlog y criterios de priorización aclarados.

• Acortar el cierre mensual: menos pasos manuales, menos planillas por fuera del sistema, controles que corren solos.

• Bajar a plataforma lo que pidan las iniciativas estratégicas, con la capacidad comprometida por sprint.

Qué necesitamos que ya hayas hecho

• Liderar al menos una implementación de ERP de punta a punta: Odoo, SAP, Oracle, NetSuite o similar. Haber sido usuario del sistema no alcanza.

• Construir o mantener módulos traductores entre el ERP y sistemas transaccionales, con el detalle fino: mapeos, colas, reprocesos, cierres de brecha contra la fuente.

• Tomar decisiones de nativo vs. custom con la cuenta del mantenimiento hecha, y haber pasado un upgrade de versión con módulos custom encima.

• Hablar el idioma de Contabilidad y Finanzas: plan de cuentas, asientos, cierre, conciliación, impuestos, AP y AR.

• Servicios financieros regulados, donde trazabilidad y auditoría no son opcionales.

• Manejar demanda de varias áreas operativas a la vez, con dueños y fechas.

Deseables

• Odoo en particular: versiones, ORM, herencia de módulos, OCA.

• Contexto Venezuela: multimoneda, ajuste por inflación, reportes fiscales locales.

Por qué te encantará trabajar en Cashea

En Cashea tenemos una cultura de trabajo basada en la confianza y el propósito. Si quieres saber por qué somos el lugar ideal para ti, estos son nuestros valores fundamentales:

• No trabajamos en piloto automático. Todo lo que hacemos y compartimos —dentro y fuera— es intencional. Nos apasiona crear ideas siendo plenamente conscientes del impacto que tienen en nuestros usuarios.

• Tu creatividad y curiosidad son tus activos más importantes.

• Tu voz importa. Escuchamos y abrimos espacio para las ideas y el feedback. Aquí todos pertenecen; lo que es importante para ti, lo es para nosotros.

• Valoramos la transparencia. La claridad nos mantiene conectados y con los pies en la tierra.

• Por último, pero no menos importante, nos enfocamos en el impacto real . Todo lo que hacemos está destinado a marcar la diferencia.

Why Mozilla ? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we're shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we're doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren't beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role: Mozilla Finance is responsible for strategic resource allocation, overseeing day-to-day financial operations as we scale our mission impact with new and existing products, technology, and business models.

Core Services brings together the functions Mozilla runs on: Legal, People, Data Science, Trust & Safety / Customer Experience, Strategy, IT, Cloud Engineering & Ecosystems, and Security - teams supporting every part of the Company.

We are seeking a detail-driven Senior Financial Analyst, Core Services to execute the recurring planning, reporting, and analysis that supports this portfolio. This role will be responsible for preparing the forecast, reconciling actuals through close, maintaining headcount and vendor tracking, and producing the reporting that reaches budget owners and the COO. This role reports to the Finance Manager, Core Services, who leads business partnership with the functional leaders, and works closely with teams across the organization.

To succeed, you will need to work accurately across a broad portfolio, translate variances into explanations a non-finance audience can act on, and balance competing cycle deadlines with outstanding attention to detail. This position requires a resourceful self-starter who takes recurring processes from start to finish and improves them along the way.

What you'll do:

•
Prepare the Core Services forecast each cycle. Build and load cost center detail in Pigment, validate inputs, reconcile against the prior cycle, and document what moved along with the drivers behind it.

•
Assemble the monthly budget update. Prepare variance to plan, drivers, and open items for budget owners and the COO, ready for the Finance Manager to carry into leader conversations.

•
Partner with Accounting through monthly close. Tie out actuals, accruals, and forecast, and resolve coding and timing issues at the source rather than correcting for them downstream.

•
Maintain headcount tracking. Keep position-level tracking and the headcount-to-plan bridge current, coordinating with People and hiring managers on start dates and backfill assumptions.

•
Track vendor and cloud spend. Monitor POs, commitments, renewals, and run-rate changes across the group. Take in cloud cost information prepared by the Cloud Engineering team, carry it into Core Services and consolidated Company reporting, and review it for anomalies and initial questions.

•
Apply AI and automation to recurring work. Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort across the forecast, close, and reporting cycle, improving the speed and reliability of what the team produces. Experiment with tools and share what works.

•
Support Core Services teams day to day. Field data and reporting questions directly, escalating items that call for a partnership discussion.

What you'll bring:
Core Experience

• 5+ years of work experience in business unit FP&A, corporate FP&A, strategic finance, or a comparable analytical finance role, including hands-on work through a full budget and forecast cycle with close and variance analysis.

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience.

Technical Skills

• Advanced spreadsheet and financial modeling skills. You care about formula cleanliness, auditability, and accuracy.

• Experience with enterprise planning tools (Pigment, Adaptive, Workday, etc.) and accounting systems (NetSuite preferred).

• Grounding in accounting fundamentals, including accruals and the monthly close cycle.

• Enough familiarity with cloud cost or FinOps concepts to interpret reporting prepared by a technical team and question what looks off.

• Interest in applying AI, automation, and systems thinking to reduce manual effort in recurring finance work.

• Ability to balance multiple competing priorities and cycle deadlines without loss of accuracy.

Communication & Collaboration

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain a variance concisely to a non-finance audience.

• Ability to work across functions, distilling detail into structured summaries that leaders can act on.

• Positive attitude, intellectual curiosity, and ability to learn quickly.

Nice to have:

• Experience supporting technical or G&A functions in a shared-services finance environment, where the internal team is the customer.

• Experience building automations or AI-assisted workflows within a Finance context — or the drive and resourcefulness to learn.

• Experience with BI tools, SQL, Python, Power Query, or other data querying and programming languages.

Success Factors You will likely be happy and productive in this role if you…

• Possess an ownership mentality. You get things done accurately with minimal oversight, proactively flagging risks to timelines.

• Have low ego and high flexibility. You approach problems with your opinion on the best solution, but can accommodate and adjust to differing viewpoints.

• Are resourceful. You identify alternative solutions and resources to continue progress.

• Are looking to build depth across a complex portfolio before moving into a lead partnership seat.

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla , you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.
