postings.title: Senior Designer
postings.descriptionText:
Jeeves is a groundbreaking financial operating system built for global businesses that provides corporate cards, cross-border payments, and spend management software within one unified platform. The company operates across 20+ countries including Brazil, Canada, Colombia, Mexico, the United Kingdom, across Europe, and the United States, and serves over 5,000 clients ranging from venture-backed startups to SMBs around the world. With a mission to empower businesses with more efficient and cost-effective financial solutions worldwide, Jeeves combines cutting-edge financial technology with exceptional team expertise to transform the business financial landscape. Jeeves has been recognized as one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups in 2023, as well as a Y Combinator Top Company 2021-2023 and won “Fintech of the Year" at the European Fintech Awards.
Since graduating from Y Combinator in 2020, Jeeves has successfully raised over $380 million and is backed by top world-class investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Tencent, Stanford University, Clocktower Ventures, and founders of more than 15 unicorns including David Velez (Nubank), Carlos Garcia (Kavak) and Sebastián Mejía (Rappi).

Jeeves has grown fast, and our core product — cards, cross-border payments, and spend management — now serves thousands of businesses across three continents. That growth has outpaced the consistency and craft of our core user experience. We’re hiring a Senior Product Designer to change that: to raise the bar on quality, coherence, and usability across the flows our customers touch every day.

You’ll own design for our core product surfaces end to end — from discovery and research through shipped, measured outcomes — working directly with product leadership, PMs, and engineers. You’ll be the voice of the customer in a payments platform with real complexity: multiple currencies, multiple countries, and finance teams who depend on us to get it right. Our Design team’s mission is to provide a voice of empathy and develop the most engaging user experiences within the Jeeves product, and this role is at the center of that mission.

This is a hands-on senior IC role, not a management position. You’ll operate with high autonomy inside a globally distributed team — we’re looking for someone who moves work forward independently, not someone who needs a design manager to set direction. Jeeves is an AI-forward company, and we expect our designers to work that way too: using AI tools daily to explore more directions, prototype earlier, and synthesize research faster — and helping define what AI-assisted design looks like at Jeeves .

Location : This role is a full-time remote position.

What You’ll Do:

•

Product Design

• Design across the full Jeeves platform, from mobile to desktop, with a focus on our core card, payments, and spend management flows

• Own projects end to end: framing the problem, exploring solutions, shipping with engineering, and measuring outcomes

• Elevate the craft and consistency of the core product experience — identify UX debt and drive a plan to pay it down

• Promote the product vision through design exploration, documentation, and presentations to leadership

• Use AI tools throughout your workflow — generative exploration, AI prototyping, and LLM-assisted copy and documentation — to test more directions faster without sacrificing craft

• Apply payments and fintech domain expertise to design for real-world financial complexity, including AI-powered product experiences within Jeeves (intelligent expense review, automation, insights)

Design Systems

• Use and extend Jeeves ’s existing design system and standards

• Identify gaps and inconsistencies across product surfaces — using AI tooling to audit at scale — and drive systematic fixes

• Establish design principles and patterns that other designers and engineers can build on, including patterns for AI-driven features (confidence, explainability, human review)

Research & Validation

• Plan and run your own research — including personally recruiting participants when needed

• Use AI to accelerate research synthesis and analysis — while keeping human judgment on what customers actually need

• Validate design decisions with customers before and after shipping

• Advocate the customer perspective across Jeeves , grounded in evidence

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner daily with product managers, engineers, UX researchers, and product marketers

• Create and collaborate on the product vision with core product leadership, reporting directly into it

• Influence design practices and team operations within a distributed, global team — including how the design team adopts AI in its workflows

• Participate in cross-functional interviews and help raise the design bar in hiring

Minimum Requirements:

• 5+ years of professional product design experience, with senior-level scope on multiple high-impact projects you were directly responsible for

• Experience designing for fintech, payments, or financial services products

• A portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership: problem framing, exploration, shipped outcomes — not just final screens

• Demonstrated ability to drive projects forward independently in ambiguous environments, without heavy direction

• Working fluency with AI tools in your design process — demonstrated by how you actually use them today for exploration, prototyping, research synthesis, or documentation (be ready to show this, not just name tools)

• Experience working within and improving design systems at scale

• Hands-on research experience, including recruiting your own participants and synthesizing findings into design decisions

• Track record of close collaboration with PM and Engineering through to shipped product

•
Professional working proficiency in English

Preferred Qualifications:

• Deep knowledge of the payments ecosystem — networks, issuers, partners, and how platforms like Jeeves differentiate within it

• Experience designing for B2B or finance-team users (controllers, CFOs, ops teams)

• Experience designing AI-powered product experiences — copilots, agents, or intelligent automation — especially patterns for trust, explainability, and human oversight in financial products

• Experience working in a globally distributed product organization across time zones

• Experience mentoring other designers or shaping design team practices

• Native or professional English and Spanish, Portuguese ability preferred

Who We Are

At Yuno , we are building the payment infrastructure that allows all companies to participate in the global market. Founded by seasoned experts from the payments and tech industries, our technology provides access to leading payment capabilities, enabling companies to engage customers confidently and maintain global operations through seamless integrations.

We empower high-performing teams at brands like InDrive, McDonald’s, Rappi, and Viva Aerobus to integrate over 1,000 payment methods via a single API. By leveraging advanced AI and the latest technologies, we orchestrate smart routing and fraud prevention across 80+ countries.

About The Role

We are orchestrating the best high-performing team!

We're looking for an AI Frontend Developer to join our Artificial Intelligence team and build the interfaces through which Yuno 's merchants and internal teams interact with AI. From copilots and agent workflows to internal back-office tools, you will turn model outputs into fast, intuitive and reliable user experiences.

You will work closely with AI engineers, backend and data teams, owning the frontend end to end: design system and reusable components, integration of LLM APIs with streaming responses, and the quality, performance and accessibility of everything we ship. We build with AI every day, and we expect you to use AI tools as a default part of how you code, test and iterate.

If you enjoy shipping polished products at a fast pace, care about the details that make an interface feel great, and want to build at the intersection of payments and AI, this role is for you.

Your contribution will be

• Build and evolve user-facing AI products: copilot and agent style interfaces, conversational flows, streaming responses and human in the loop review screens.

• Design and maintain our design system and web components, used across Yuno 's applications and by third parties.

• Build and evolve internal back-office tools used across teams to drive operational efficiency.

• Integrate LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or similar) and backend services into the frontend, handling streaming, latency and error states gracefully.

• Write reusable, testable and efficient code, with unit and end to end tests and CI/CD as part of the workflow.

• Collaborate with AI, data, backend and product teams to translate complex AI capabilities (automation, recommendations, decision support) into simple and actionable UI components.

• Champion an AI-first engineering culture, using AI-assisted development, code generation and automated testing as a default in your daily work.

• Care for performance, accessibility and security in everything you ship.

Skills You Need

Minimum Qualifications

• 2+ years of professional experience building production web applications with React and TypeScript.

• Strong knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Node.js and modern tooling (Git, NPM or Yarn, Next.js, Storybook or similar).

• Experience integrating REST and streaming APIs, including LLM APIs, into frontend applications.

• Demonstrated experience with unit testing, end to end testing and CI/CD.

• Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot, and an understanding of prompt engineering and how to evaluate model outputs in the UI.

• Autonomy in task execution and comfort working in a fast-paced agile environment.

•
Professional proficiency in English.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience building interfaces for AI agents or copilot style features in production.

• Experience with Nest.js, Emotion, AWS services (S3, Amplify) and Docker.

• Experience in the payments industry or integrating Payment Service Providers.

• Knowledge of backend languages and willingness to work across the stack when needed.

Competitive Compensation

• Home Office Bonus – A one-time allowance to help you create your ideal home office.

•
Work Equipment

Stock Options

Health Plan wherever you are.

Flexible Days Off

postings.title: Software Engineer III, Applied Agentic AI
postings.descriptionText:
About Us:
Proofpoint is a global leader in human- and agent-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple: safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.

How We Work:
At Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values:
Bold in how we dream and innovate
Responsive to feedback, challenges and opportunities
Accountable for results and best in class outcomes
Visionary in future focused problem-solving
Exceptional in execution and impact

The Role

Proofpoint is hiring an Agentic AI Engineer on the team building our agentic AI platform — the agent runtimes, MCP access layer, and evaluation tooling that product teams across the company build on. You'll be building for other engineers: the people shipping agentic features into products that thousands of enterprises rely on around the clock.

This role sits at the frontier of agentic technology. New models, frameworks and protocols land faster than any single product team can absorb, and part of your job is to absorb them first: work out what actually holds up, establish the best practices, and prove them out in reference agentic applications that other teams can learn from and build on. You get first look at the new stuff, and the fun part of the job is showing engineers across the company what it can do.

What you’ll do

• Build reference agentic applications on our platform — end-to-end examples of how agents should be designed, evaluated, deployed and monitored at Proofpoint .

• Establish and document best practices: tool design and MCP integration, prompt and context management, memory and planning, cost/latency tradeoffs, failure recovery, and what "release-ready" means for a nondeterministic system.

• Design evaluation harnesses — task suites, baselines, and quality, cost and latency metrics — and use them to decide what ships.

• Turn ambiguous questions into working prototypes quickly, and present results to the teams who asked; recommend just as readily when an approach should be abandoned.

• Harden successful prototypes into reusable platform capabilities that product teams can adopt.

• Partner with experienced engineers, security researchers and product tech leads to go deep on the systems you build on.

• Socialize agentic patterns across the company through demos, design reviews, written guides, and pairing sessions.

• Communicate and understand stakeholders' requirements and participate in cross-team design discussions.

What we’re looking for

• Bachelors or Master's Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 3+ years of engineering experience, with recent hands-on work on LLM or agentic systems that went past the prototype stage.

• Good understanding of the agentic development lifecycle and its components - agent runtimes, tool and MCP integration, prompt and context management, memory, planning, orchestration, evals, tracing, guardrails, rollout and rollback.

• Solid Python; TypeScript/Node a plus.

• Experience working with globally distributed teams .

• Experience building and running services in a cloud microservices environment — containers, CI/CD, automated deployment; AWS a plus.

• Comfortable diagnosing distributed systems from traces and metrics; OpenTelemetry (including GenAI semantic conventions) a plus.

• An eval-first mindset: measurement comes with the build, not after it.

• Genuine enthusiasm for frontier AI — you already experiment with agent frameworks and LLM SDKs (LangGraph, Anthropic/OpenAI Agents SDK, MCP, LangChain or similar) and follow where the field is going.

• Initiative and a bias toward shipping — you pick up ambiguous problems, get a PoC working and presented in days rather than quarters, and keep moving when the path isn't mapped out.

• Fast learner with real curiosity — you want to know how the systems underneath you work, not just how to call them.

Preferred

• Use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex or similar) and familiarity with agent interoperability protocols such as MCP and A2A.

• Building eval harnesses, benchmarks or ground-truth datasets.

• Producing developer-facing reference implementations, SDK samples, or internal enablement material.

• AG and semantic retrieval (vector stores, hybrid search), and working with both hosted APIs and open-weight models.

Why Proofpoint ?
At Proofpoint , we believe that an exceptional career experience includes a comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Here are just a few reasons you’ll love working with us:

•
Competitive compensation

•
Comprehensive benefits

•
Career success on your terms

•
Flexible work environment

• Annual wellness and community outreach days

• Always on recognition for your contributions

• Global collaboration and networking opportunities

Our Culture:
Our culture is rooted in values that inspire belonging, empower purpose and drive success-every day, for everyone.
We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you need accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to .

How to Apply
Interested? Submit your application along with any supporting information- we can’t wait to hear from you!

postings.title: Growth Marketing Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
This role is part of our ScraperAPI team, one of our growing brands at saas.group .
ScraperAPI is an enterprise-scale web scraping solution, trusted by businesses across a wide range of industries to extract crucial data at scale. From e-commerce, travel to real estate and market research, we support companies in turning the web into actionable insights.
We’re currently on an exciting growth journey, scaling rapidly as demand for reliable, high-performance web scraping and data keeps rising.

Profile Overview
As our Growth Marketing Specialist, you'll be the hands-on engine behind our demand campaigns across every channel we run: paid search, paid social, email, webinars, events, community, and our website. Reporting into the Growth Marketing Manager, you'll own the build, launch, and daily optimisation of campaigns, and you'll partner closely with Marketing Operations to keep everything automated, accurately tracked, and performing. This is a genuinely multifaceted, execution-first role. One week your focus might be paid search performance, the next a webinar cadence or an email nurture flow. We're building the demand foundations from the ground up, so there's real space to bring ideas and leave your stamp on what we create.
Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:

• Take full operational ownership of day-to-day campaign execution across paid and email, driving performance forward without needing a playbook handed to you.

• Spot what's underperforming early, bring clear recommendations to the table, and run the tests and optimisations that move the needle.

Your responsibilities

• Execute demand campaigns end to end across paid search (Google, Microsoft), paid social (LinkedIn, with more channels on the way), email, webinars, events, and community channels like Reddit, owning build, launch, and daily management.

• Own campaign timelines, coordination, and smooth delivery in close collaboration with the Growth Marketing Manager and the wider marketing team.

• Monitor performance daily, dig into the data, and proactively flag risks and opportunities before they become problems.

• Build and iterate email campaigns and nurture sequences that turn event and webinar interest into real pipeline.

• Partner with Marketing Operations to make sure every campaign is correctly set up, automated, and tracked from end to end.

• Stay close to what's shifting in the industry and what competitors are doing, and translate that into how we sharpen our own campaigns.

What you bring to the table

• 3+ years hands-on running and optimising campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and similar, with real depth in paid.

• Genuine breadth beyond paid: practical experience across email marketing and sequences, plus exposure to webinars, events, or community channels, and the adaptability to switch focus as priorities shift.

• An execution-first mindset: you love being in the trenches daily, building and shipping, with sharp attention to detail.

• Strong analytical instincts: you spot patterns and performance issues quickly and act proactively rather than reactively.

• Clear, structured communication: you keep stakeholders informed on what's happening and what you're seeing in the data, with minimal back-and-forth.

• You use AI tools regularly to work smarter and can point to concrete examples of how they boost your output.

What’s in it for You

• Ultimate flexibility: We’re 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.

• Freedom and autonomy: We’re a high-trust team, and you’ll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way — with plenty of help from the team when you need it.

• Minimum bureaucracy: We don’t like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.

• Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.

• Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally.

• Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.

ScraperAPI is part of saas.group and we have a shared goal of succeeding together.

What is saas.group ?
Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group , established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 380+ colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.
Also, don’t forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company.
We don’t just simply offer you to “take a job with us” but rather to “join us on this journey” to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.
Sounds like something you’re up for? Feel free to apply even if you don’t check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. postings.descriptionText:
The Accounting Assistant / Accounts Payable Specialist supports the accounting team by handling day-to-day accounts payable operations and general accounting tasks. This role is responsible for accurate invoice processing, vendor and employee payments, reconciliations, and documentation, while assisting with month-end close, reporting, and payroll support. The position works closely with vendors and internal teams to resolve discrepancies and ensure timely, compliant payments. This role leans toward accounting support while maintaining strong operational ownership of the full accounts payable cycle.

Key Responsibilities

Accounts Payable & Payment Processing

• Receive, review, verify, and reconcile vendor invoices for accuracy and proper approval.

• Perform three-way matching between invoices, purchase orders, and receipts.

• Code invoices to the general ledger and appropriate cost centers.

• Prepare and process vendor and employee payments, including ACH, check, and wire payments.

• Calculate and process commissions as required.

• Assist with payment runs and post-payment review.

• Set up new vendors, utility accounts, and recurring payments.

Reconciliations & Accounting Support

• Reconcile vendor accounts, credit card statements, and expense reports on a monthly basis.

• Maintain accounting ledgers and verify account transactions.

• Assist with month-end closing activities, including accruals, reconciliations, and financial reporting.

• Research discrepancies and prepare adjusting entries as needed.

Payroll & Expense Support

• Support biweekly payroll processing.

• Review and reconcile employee expense reports and ensure proper documentation is maintained.

Vendor & Internal Communication

• Manage the accounts payable inbox, responding to inquiries in a timely and professional manner.

• Work directly with vendors and internal teams to resolve invoice discrepancies or payment issues.

Curiosity — The belief that a deep and fundamental curiosity (the "why") in our work is vital to company innovation and evolution.

Focus — The collective will to remain completely devoted and ultimately accountable to our deliverables.

The Role

Profitability and bootstrapping mean you'll work on real customer and business problems, not a search for product/market fit, with a direct line to an accessible leadership team. You'll use AI throughout your workflow to move faster and more effectively than a team our size normally could.

You’ll keep our orchestration and transformation layer scaling as we grow, with deep hands-on expertise across Cloud Composer (Airflow) , dbt , and BigQuery on GCP , and you’ll be the person who makes good data engineering practice the norm across teams.
We run a medallion lakehouse on GCP: Datastream CDC pipelines replicate dozens of PostgreSQL databases into BigQuery bronze datasets, and dbt on BigQuery transforms them through bronze, silver, and gold layers. Orchestration runs on Cloud Composer / Airflow . This role is part deep building and part enablement: you’ll scale Airflow, harden the platform, optimize cost and performance, and leave every team more capable of shipping reliable data than it was before.

Overall you will…

• Own the health, performance, and scalability of our Cloud Composer (Airflow) environments, including environment sizing, worker autoscaling, DAG parse performance, and orchestration reliability across staging and production.

• Design and extend our dbt on BigQuery transformation layer: incremental and CDC merge models, deduplication and SCD patterns, macros, tests, and source freshness across the bronze, silver, and gold layers.

• Own our Datastream CDC pipelines feeding BigQuery, keeping the PostgreSQL to BigQuery flow healthy across schemas, backfills, and replication.

• Build and improve our DataOps : CI/CD for DAGs and dbt with GitHub Actions and Workload Identity Federation, automated testing, deploy smoke tests, and safe promotion across environments.

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer — IDRE (Remote - LATAM-based)
postings.descriptionText:
About us
Orchid Software Solutions is the engineering group behind the SeedTrust / VeraTru family of companies. We build and operate software for healthcare and family-building services: escrow for surrogacy and egg donation, agency management for fertility clinics, medical records retrieval, insurance risk management, and IDRE.
IDRE is our platform for Independent Dispute Resolution under the federal No Surprises Act. When a healthcare provider and an insurer disagree on what an out-of-network service should be paid, the dispute goes through a federal arbitration process, and our platform manages those cases end to end for our clients — hundreds of new disputes a day, with core business logic in how we calculate settlements and track case state. It's a fast-growing, high-volume product, and the team is actively expanding to keep up.

The team you'd join
IDRE's engineering team is small and senior by design: an engineering manager, a handful of senior engineers, a senior QA, and a PM, working closely together rather than in isolated silos — no hand-off-and-forget here. You'd report to, and work daily alongside, engineers who care about the craft and about getting the domain right, not just shipping tickets. We're a genuinely multicultural, fully remote team spread across the US and LATAM, and we've been deliberate about building a culture where different technical opinions get heard and new ideas aren't shut down because "that's how it's always been done."

The role
This is an independent-contractor, full-stack Senior Software Engineer role, based in Latin America. You'll work across React/Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and SQL (MySQL/PostgreSQL), owning features end to end — from a product conversation through to what's running in production — rather than working in a narrow lane someone else defines for you. Hands-on experience with financial or transactional systems (payments, billing, claims, settlements) is directly relevant, since settlement calculation and case-state tracking sit at the core of what IDRE does; prior IDR/No Surprises Act knowledge is not required, that part is very learnable on the job.

Why this role, specifically

• Real ownership from day one — this isn't a maintenance seat on a mature product; IDRE is still being actively built out, and your technical decisions will shape how it works for years.

• A genuine domain to go deep in — healthcare dispute resolution and payments logic is a niche most engineers never get exposed to, and depth here is a real differentiator for your own career.

• A small, senior team means your voice actually carries weight in architecture and product conversations — not diluted across a 40-person org.

• Direct, daily collaboration with a US-based team, in English, on a product serving real clients — not a back-office ticket queue.

You must have

• 6+ years of professional software development experience, with real production depth in React/Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and SQL.

• Advanced/professional spoken and written English.

• Based in a Latin American country, able to work with substantial daily overlap with US Eastern Time.

• Ability to work and invoice as an independent contractor in your country of residence.

How to apply
Direct applicants only — no third-party agencies or recruiters.

Coordinate Finance, Operations, Systems, Data, Integration, and third-party partners to deliver complete solutions and drive issues through verified resolution.

Location

Remote (Latin America)

Job Overview:
You'll own quality end-to-end for ThriveCart 's e-commerce platform — test strategy, automation, defect prevention, and production health monitoring. This isn't a click-through-test-cases role: you own quality for your domain.
AI is a core part of the workflow here, not a bonus skill — for generating test cases, creating test data, drafting test plans, and accelerating automation. What we're hiring for is judgment: knowing which tests actually matter, understanding risk, and thinking critically about AI-generated output.
This description spans L1–L4. Interview depth and expectations scale with level — see Qualifications & Expectations by Level below.

What You'll Own:

Test Strategy & Planning

• Own the quality strategy for your features and domain: test plans, risk assessment, coverage decisions

• Flag ambiguities and testability gaps during requirements review, before code is written — shift-left quality

• Define acceptance criteria in partnership with Product

• Balance manual exploration with automated regression coverage

• Document test plans, coverage decisions, and known risk areas for async visibility across the team

Test Automation

• Write and maintain automated tests (API, integration, end-to-end) using the team's frameworks

• Keep automation suites fast, reliable, and maintainable — flaky tests are yours to fix, not ignore

• Maintain CI/CD integration for test execution

•
L3+: Design and evolve the overall test automation architecture

Production Quality & Incident Response

• Monitor features in production using observability tools — quality doesn't end at release

• Respond to dev-escalations and incidents with urgency: assess blast radius, run targeted regression testing, help isolate root cause, communicate findings clearly

•
L3+: Own incident response from the quality side — lead triage, coordinate regression testing, write post-mortems with defect analysis, drive preventive fixes

•
L4+: Coordinate all QA activity during major incidents, communicate to stakeholders, ensure systemic fixes are validated before release

AI-Augmented QA (Expected, Not Optional)

• Use AI tools daily: generating test cases and data, drafting test plans, analyzing bug patterns, accelerating automation writing

• AI will generate more test cases than you need — prioritize ruthlessly based on risk

• Review all AI-generated test output critically: AI has no product context, you do

•
L3+: Teach junior QAs effective AI workflows for testing; establish team AI quality standards

•
L4+: Set team standards for AI tool usage — evaluate tools, measure impact on coverage and velocity

Defect Advocacy & Communication

• Write clear, reproducible bug reports that developers can act on immediately

• Advocate for quality: flag risks before release, document known issues, be explicit about what is and isn't tested

•
L3+: Partner with Product and Engineering on quality metrics, track trends

Collaboration

• Work closely with developers to improve testability at the code level

• Help developers write better unit tests by identifying untested scenarios

•
L3+: Mentor L1/L2 QAs on testing mindset, automation skills, and risk thinking

What You Bring To This Role:

Technical Environment

• Testing: API testing (Postman/REST clients), browser automation (Playwright), unit/integration test frameworks

• CI/CD: GitHub Actions (tests run on every PR)

• Observability: AWS CloudWatch, application logs, metrics dashboards

• Platform stack: PHP/TypeScript, Ruby/TypeScript, MariaDB, Redis, AWS

• Playwright is our standard framework for browser automation — what matters most is strong testing fundamentals

Must-haves:

• Strong testing fundamentals — test strategy, test case design, risk-based prioritization

• Hands-on automation experience with Playwright

• Comfortable with API testing (Postman/REST clients) and reading application logs

• Already using — or genuinely motivated to use — AI tools in a QA workflow

• Clear written communication: bug reports and test plans others can act on without a meeting

Nice-to-haves:

• Experience testing an e-commerce, payments, or subscription platform

• Familiarity with PHP, TypeScript, or Ruby codebases

• AWS/CloudWatch or similar observability tooling

• GitHub Actions or another CI/CD pipeline

Qualifications & Expectations by Level

•
L1 (Junior QA) — 0–1 yrs: Executes test plans, writes simple automation with guidance, reports bugs clearly. Bootcamp, internship, or early professional QA experience is fine — we're hiring for rigor and curiosity over tenure. Uses AI to learn faster and generate test cases; validates all AI output.

•
L2 (QA Engineer 1) — 1–3 yrs: Has independently owned quality for a feature or product area — not just extended someone else's test plan or suite, but built one. Writes comprehensive test plans and automation, and responds to incidents with targeted testing.

•
L3 (Senior QA) — 3–6 yrs: Has led incident response from the QA side and mentored other QAs. Owns quality strategy for complex projects, improves automation architecture and infrastructure, and uses AI to multiply output rather than just speed up individual tasks.

•
L4 (Lead QA) — 6+ yrs: Has set QA standards or practices for a team, not just followed them. Serves as the quality authority for a domain, drives major incident response, and partners with leadership on quality metrics and AI tooling strategy.

Success Metrics

•
30 days: First test plan written and approved, first automated tests in CI pipeline, understands the most critical user journeys

•
60 days: Independently owning quality for a feature, automation suite stable, first incident response contribution

•
90 days: Contributing to test strategy discussions, handling dev-escalations independently in your area

On-Call

Shared rotation with engineering (~1 week/month after ramp-up). QA on-call focuses on blast radius assessment and regression testing during incidents.

postings.title: Senior Data Scientist
postings.descriptionText:
¡Hola! Somos Cashea 👋 y nuestra misión es devolverle a los venezolanos la oportunidad de acceder al crédito a través de un modelo de negocio BNPL (buy now, pay later).
Desde nuestro lanzamiento en 2022, nos hemos dedicado a promover la inclusión financiera. Hoy contamos con más de 10 millones de usuarios activos, tanto consumidores como comercios, y nos hemos convertido en una marca de confianza en Venezuela, ganándonos el corazón y la mente de las personas.

Resumen del rol
Buscamos un/a Data Scientist senior, con fuerte base matemática y estadística, para unirse al equipo de Data Science & Machine Learning de Cashea , la fintech BNPL líder en Venezuela. No buscamos solo alguien que entrene modelos: buscamos alguien que sepa traducir problemas de negocio reales en formulaciones cuantitativas rigurosas y llevarlas hasta soluciones en producción. El equipo es responsable del modelado de riesgo crediticio, crecimiento, segmentación y fraude, trabajando de punta a punta: desde el descubrimiento del problema de negocio hasta la entrega de modelos listos para producción en colaboración con el equipo de ML Platform / MLOps.
Reportarás al líder de Data Science y trabajarás de cerca con stakeholders de Risk, Growth, Collections y Analytics.

Responsabilidades

• Diseñar, entrenar y validar modelos de machine learning para casos de uso core del negocio: scoring de riesgo crediticio, predicción de NPL, forecast de crecimiento (MAPs, GMV), segmentación de clientes y detección de patrones de comportamiento.

• Trabajar con enfoques diversos según el problema: modelos bayesianos (ej. BG/BB para lifetime y supervivencia), gradient boosting (XGBoost), deep learning (pytorch), series temporales y modelos estadísticos clásicos.

• Gestionar tu trabajo como mini-proyectos con alcance definido dentro de un backlog priorizado: Discovery Brief, diseño técnico (TDD), experimentación, Model Card y handoff documentado a MLOps.

• Explorar y transformar datos en BigQuery (arquitectura de 3 capas), consumiendo datos certificados de la capa Gold.

• Registrar experimentos y versionar modelos en MLflow, siguiendo los estándares del equipo.

• Comunicar hallazgos y supuestos de modelado a stakeholders de negocio de forma clara, documentada y reproducible — nada de ajustes manuales sin documentar.

• Colaborar en code reviews dentro de los repositorios del equipo, manteniendo estándares de calidad y reutilizando componentes compartidos.

Qué NO harás

• Construir infraestructura de deployment ni mantener pipelines de producción (eso lo lidera ML Platform / MLOps; tú entregas modelos con handoff documentado).

• Definir métricas oficiales del negocio ni metas corporativas (responsabilidad del equipo de Analytics/BI).

Requisitos

• 7+ años de experiencia como Data Scientist con modelos que hayan llegado a producción y generado impacto medible en el negocio (no solo notebooks).

• Sólido background matemático, estadístico y actuarial (formación cuantitativa: matemáticas, estadística, física, ingeniería o afines): probabilidad, inferencia estadística, optimización y álgebra lineal aplicados con criterio, no solo como usuario de librerías.

• Trayectoria demostrable resolviendo problemas de negocio reales con modelos: capacidad de tomar un problema ambiguo (riesgo, crecimiento, comportamiento de clientes), formalizarlo matemáticamente, elegir el enfoque correcto y defender sus supuestos y limitaciones frente a stakeholders.

• Dominio de Python para ciencia de datos (pandas, scikit-learn) y SQL avanzado, idealmente en BigQuery u otro data warehouse columnar.

• Experiencia sólida en al menos dos familias de modelos: gradient boosting, modelos bayesianos/probabilísticos, series de tiempo o deep learning — entendiendo su fundamento matemático y cuándo aplicar cada una.

• Fundamentos rigurosos de estadística aplicada: validación, diseño de experimentos, calibración, análisis de supervivencia.

• Buenas prácticas de ingeniería: Git, ambientes reproducibles, código modular, documentación.

• Capacidad de traducir problemas ambiguos de negocio en problemas de modelado con alcance definido.

• Español fluido; inglés técnico de lectura.

Por qué te encantará trabajar en Cashea

En Cashea tenemos una cultura de trabajo basada en la confianza y el propósito. Si quieres saber por qué somos el lugar ideal para ti, estos son nuestros valores fundamentales:

• No trabajamos en piloto automático. Todo lo que hacemos y compartimos —dentro y fuera— es intencional. Nos apasiona crear ideas siendo plenamente conscientes del impacto que tienen en nuestros usuarios.

• Tu creatividad y curiosidad son tus activos más importantes.

• Tu voz importa. Escuchamos y abrimos espacio para las ideas y el feedback. Aquí todos pertenecen; lo que es importante para ti, lo es para nosotros.

• Valoramos la transparencia. La claridad nos mantiene conectados y con los pies en la tierra.

• Por último, pero no menos importante, nos enfocamos en el impacto real. Todo lo que hacemos está destinado a marcar la diferencia.

¡Hola! Somos Cashea 👋 y nuestra misión es devolverle a los venezolanos la oportunidad de acceder al crédito a través de un modelo de negocio BNPL (buy now, pay later).
Desde nuestro lanzamiento en 2022, nos hemos dedicado a promover la inclusión financiera . Hoy contamos con más de 9 millones de usuarios activos, tanto consumidores como comercios, y nos hemos convertido en una marca de confianza en Venezuela, ganándonos el corazón y la mente de las personas.

Responsabilidades

• Implementar retrieval de candidatos, ranking, reordenamiento por reglas de negocio y serving de baja latencia.

• Construir los pipelines de features y embeddings, batch y online, que alimentan a los modelos.

• Instrumentar el logging de impresiones, clicks y órdenes con las garantías necesarias para reentrenar sin sesgo de posición.

• Definir el protocolo de evaluación offline y los experimentos online (A/B, interleaving, bandits) que autorizan cada release del ranking.

• Implementar monitoreo y alertas sobre las fallas propias de un recomendador: cold start, cobertura de catálogo, sesgo de popularidad, caída de CTR y de conversión.

• Modelar los datos y las transformaciones en el warehouse (dbt sobre BigQuery) que alimentan el Feature Store.

• Realizar análisis ad hoc para el squad y coordinar con Data Engineering la calidad y disponibilidad de los datos.

¿Qué esperamos que ya sepas hacer?

• Haber puesto al menos dos sistemas de recomendación en producción, no en un notebook, y poder explicar qué métrica movieron y qué no.

• Filtrado colaborativo, modelos de grafos, factorización matricial y modelos secuenciales o basados en sesión, con criterio para decidir cuándo cada uno le gana a los otros y cuándo ninguno le gana a top-N por popularidad.

• Diseñar el protocolo de evaluación completo: partición temporal, líneas base no personalizadas, métricas de ranking e incertidumbre sobre el número reportado.

• Detectar y probar fuga temporal: joins point-in-time y tests que fallan antes de que el modelo llegue a producción.

• Resolver cold start en las dos puntas, usuario nuevo y producto nuevo.

• Trabajar con feedback implícito y catálogos incompletos, y medir cuánto se equivoca cada fuente de señal antes de meterla al modelo.

• Traducir la mecánica del negocio a la función objetivo. Cashea asume el riesgo de crédito y su margen varía por aliado, así que optimizar conversión sola es el objetivo equivocado.

Requisitos

• 6+ años en ML aplicado, con recomendación como especialidad y no como proyecto lateral.

• 2+ años con herramientas de MLOps en producción: registry, tracking, model serving, monitoreo, versionado.

• Python de producción: packaging, testing, procesos que corren solos.

• SQL avanzado y modelado analítico con dbt o equivalente.

• Estadística aplicada: incertidumbre, tamaño de muestra y criterio para distinguir una diferencia real del ruido.

• CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI o equivalente).

• Python avanzado (packaging, testing, documentation)

• Librerías de recomendación (implicit, LightFM, TensorFlow Recommenders, PyTorch o similar)

• Búsqueda vectorial y ANN (Vertex AI Vector Search, FAISS, ScaNN, pgvector)

• Feature stores para features online de baja latencia (Vertex AI Feature Store, Bigtable, Redis)

• MLflow (registry, tracking server, model serving, artifacts)

• dbt sobre BigQuery o warehouse equivalente

•
Docker y Kubernetes básico

•
Git y GitHub/GitLab workflows

• REST APIs design & development, con criterio de latencia (p95, p99)

• Cloud platforms (GCP preferible, AWS/Azure aceptable)

Deseable:

• Bandits contextuales y exploración en producción (Thompson sampling, epsilon-greedy).

• Modelos bayesianos (PyMC, Stan o similar) llevados a producción.

• OCR y extracción de información de documentos.

Soft Skills

• Mentalidad de "internal tooling" (diseñar para otros desarrolladores)

• Documentación clara y completa (technical writing)

• Comunicación efectiva con Data Scientists (entender sus pain points)

•
Ownership/Autonomía

• Criterio para decidir qué optimizar cuando la métrica offline y la del negocio no apuntan al mismo lado.

Resumen del rol
El DevSecOps Engineer (Application Security) es responsable de integrar la seguridad en todo el ciclo de vida de desarrollo de software (SDLC), promoviendo una cultura de shift-left junto a los equipos de ingeniería. Diseña e implementa pipelines seguros, integra herramientas de SAST, SCA y DAST, lidera iniciativas de gestión de vulnerabilidades y colabora en el modelado de amenazas de las aplicaciones y servicios de la compañía, con una mentalidad de purple team orientada a la colaboración constante entre defensa y ofensiva.

• Acompañar a los equipos en la adopción de contenedores y orquestadores (Docker, Kubernetes) con foco en buenas prácticas de seguridad.

• Colaborar con equipos de infraestructura y cloud para aplicar hardening y controles de seguridad en GCP y AWS.

Requisitos

• Experiencia previa en seguridad de aplicaciones y/o DevSecOps.

• Conocimientos y experiencia práctica con herramientas de SAST, SCA y DAST.

• Buen entendimiento de CI/CD y de cómo integrar controles de seguridad sin bloquear el flujo de desarrollo.

• Conocimientos sólidos de OWASP (Top 10, OWASP ASVS y/o guías relacionadas).

• Experiencia trabajando con Docker y Kubernetes (despliegue, configuración básica, buenas prácticas de seguridad).

• Capacidad para programar en Python o en al menos un lenguaje de programación utilizado en la compañía.

Valoramos

Define target schemas and work with engineers to implement common schemas design principles and conventions as needed to maintain data quality and integrity at source. postings.title: [8BE] Senior Data Scientist, Probabilistic Modeling (Architecture, Adjacent)
postings.descriptionText:
We're seeking a Senior Data Scientist with deep expertise in probabilistic AI and statistical machine learning to support a client's e-commerce platform. In this role, you'll design and validate probabilistic models — covering dynamic pricing, shipping cost estimation, recommendations, and segmentation — while working closely with our solution architect, the client's CTO, and the client's engineering team to shape how those models fit into the platform's architecture.
Project Length: 3 - 6 months.

Key Responsibilities

•
Bayesian modeling and inference: Design and implement Bayesian statistical models — priors, likelihoods, and posterior inference — to support decisioning under uncertainty across pricing, segmentation, and demand-related use cases.

•
Markov chains and Hidden Markov Models: Build Markov chain and Hidden Markov Model formulations for sequential and behavioral patterns (e.g., customer lifecycle stages, state transitions), producing outputs that downstream services can consume.

•
MCMC and Metropolis-Hastings sampling: Apply Markov Chain Monte Carlo methods, including Metropolis-Hastings sampling, to estimate posterior distributions for models without closed-form solutions, and validate convergence and sampling quality.

•
Mixture modeling: Develop mixture models — Gaussian Mixture Models in particular — to support segmentation use cases, identifying latent customer or product groupings from transactional and behavioral data.

•
Expectation-Maximization: Implement Expectation-Maximization for latent-variable estimation underlying mixture models and related unsupervised learning tasks.

•
Architecture collaboration: Work alongside our solution architect and the client's CTO to align model design with platform architecture. While this is not an architecture-ownership role, you should be able to reason about integration points, service boundaries, and technical tradeoffs well enough to operate with a reasonable degree of autonomy and reduce the support load on the architect.

•
Production translation: Guide backend engineering on how statistical models translate into production service architecture — informing API design, data contracts, and integration points within the platform's existing microservices and event-driven pipelines.

•
Model lifecycle management: Define the approach for model training, validation, versioning, monitoring/drift detection, and retraining cadence once models are in production.

•
Roadmap collaboration: Partner with delivery and engineering leads to size, sequence, and estimate probabilistic/statistical modeling initiatives on the product roadmap.

•
Documentation and handoff: Document modeling assumptions, methodology, and validation results, and provide clear hand-off guidance so models remain maintainable by the engineering team after the engagement.

• 90% English written and oral (at least B2 level) with excellent communication skills.

• Senior-level experience, with the ability to communicate confidently with both technical and business stakeholders, should be comfortable discussing business impact and tradeoffs directly with CTO.

• Strong, demonstrable background in designing Bayesian statistical models, Markov chains, Hidden Markov Models, MCMC methods (including Metropolis-Hastings sampling), mixture models (ideally Gaussian Mixture Models), and Expectation-Maximization — classical predictive modeling, not standard modern supervised/LLM-based ML.

• Experience designing statistical/ML models with production deployment in mind is strongly preferred; hands-on production implementation is a plus but not mandatory — the priority is the ability to architect the modeling approach and guide engineering through it.

• Proficiency in Python (or R) with standard probabilistic/statistical libraries (e.g., PyMC, Stan, scikit-learn, NumPy/SciPy) for model development and validation.

• Ability to reason about how statistical/mathematical models translate into service-oriented production architecture — understanding of APIs, data contracts, and how to work directly with backend engineers and architects to integrate models.

• Solid understanding of version control, testing practices, and CI/CD, sufficient to collaborate effectively with an engineering team on production delivery.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain model behavior, assumptions, and uncertainty to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications/Nice to have

• Experience in e-commerce or retail domains, particularly pricing optimization, customer segmentation, or demand forecasting.

• Familiarity with how ML models integrate into microservices architectures (REST/GraphQL) and event-driven systems (e.g., message queues/pub-sub) hands-on deployment experience is a plus but not expected.

• Familiarity with common backend service ecosystems (e.g., .NET, Java, or Node.js) even if modeling itself is done in Python — for a smoother handoff to the production engineering team.

• Exposure to MLOps concepts such as model registries, monitoring, or feature stores — helpful for handoff conversations, but not a core requirement.

• Background in pricing science, recommendation systems, or marketing analytics.

• Experience communicating modeling recommendations directly to business or executive stakeholders (e.g., CEO/CTO-level conversations).

• Experiencia con pruebas automatizadas (unitarias, integración) y flujos de CI/CD con Git.

• Nivel de inglés intermedio (B1-B2) para documentación técnica y comunicación ocasional.

Habilidades

Hard Skills

•
React y ecosistema moderno de front-end.

•
TypeScript

• SQL avanzado: Modelado de datos, optimización y migraciones.

Soft Skills

• Criterio para balancear velocidad de entrega y calidad técnica.

Orientación a resultados.

Nice to have

Our authority in the luxury travel industry is consistently affirmed through features in top media outlets, including The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, BBC, Forbes, CNN, and Condé Nast Traveler, to name a few. You will build trusted relationships with our travelers to understand their travel needs and ensure these needs are being met and their expectations exceeded. This position plays a key role towards driving loyalty and repeat bookings of our most valued travelers.
This is an international, fully remote, freelance contractor position , working from home with a 5-day workweek that includes rotating weekend shifts . Initial training (3 to 4 weeks) will take place Monday through Friday.

Job Title: Legal Assistant
Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. client business hours (with flexibility for filing deadlines and court calendars)

About the Role:
Our client is seeking a Legal Assistant to support attorneys with administrative and procedural tasks. This role is critical for ensuring that legal teams are well-organized, documents are properly prepared and filed, and clients receive timely communication. The Legal Assistant provides the foundation that allows attorneys and paralegals to focus on substantive legal work.

Responsibilities:

• Document Preparation: Draft routine legal correspondence, prepare templates, and proofread contracts, pleadings, and filings for accuracy and format compliance.

• Case & File Management: Organize case files in digital management systems (Clio, MyCase, PracticePanther). Ensure documents are current, labeled, and easily retrievable.

• Court Filing: Prepare and file electronic submissions with state and federal courts. Track filing confirmations and maintain compliance with deadlines.

• Scheduling: Manage attorney calendars, including hearings, depositions, client meetings, and filing deadlines. Send reminders and coordinate logistics.

• Client Communication: Draft and send client updates, reminders, and requests for documents. Ensure all communications are professional and documented.

• Research Support: Conduct preliminary legal research (statutes, case law, regulations) under attorney supervision. Summarize findings for attorney review.

• Billing & Timekeeping: Track attorney billable hours, prepare invoices, and update billing systems.

• Administrative Support: Coordinate notarizations, organize exhibits, and assist in trial preparation as needed.

What Makes You a Perfect Fit:

• Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented.

• Skilled multitasker, able to manage multiple cases simultaneously.

• Strong written and verbal communication.

• Comfortable with technology and legal practice software.

• Proactive in anticipating attorney and client needs.

Required Experience & Skills (Minimum):

• 2+ years administrative or legal support experience.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office/Google Workspace.

• Familiarity with at least one legal case/document management system (Clio, MyCase, PracticePanther).

• Strong typing, formatting, and proofreading skills

Ideal Experience & Skills:

• Knowledge of e-filing systems for state and federal courts.

• Exposure to litigation, corporate, or compliance practice areas.

• Experience tracking billable hours in legal billing software (Clio Manage, Timeslips, Bill4Time).

• Basic legal research experience using Westlaw, LexisNexis, or government databases.

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?
A Legal Assistant’s workday is centered on supporting attorneys with precision, organization, and timeliness. You will:

• Prepare and format documents — ensuring filings, contracts, and letters are accurate, compliant, and free of errors.

• Manage calendars and deadlines — scheduling hearings, depositions, and client meetings while ensuring no deadlines are missed.

• Coordinate case files — maintaining organized, up-to-date records in case/document management systems.

• Support filings and compliance — preparing e-filings, logging confirmations, and double-checking that statutory or procedural deadlines are met.

• Communicate with clients — drafting updates, collecting necessary documents, and maintaining a professional and responsive client experience.

• Assist with billing and reporting — tracking attorney hours, preparing invoices, and updating billing records.

In essence: Legal Assistants keep cases, schedules, and records running smoothly so attorneys can focus on legal strategy and client representation.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs):

• Zero missed court or filing deadlines.

• All client files current and audit-ready.

• 100% error-free document preparation.

• Attorney calendars consistently updated and conflicts avoided.

• Timely, professional client communication logged in case systems.

Interview Process:

• Initial Phone Screen

• Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter

• Practical Task (e.g., proofread/redline a legal document or prepare a mock filing packet)

• Client Interview

• Offer & Background Verification

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer - Email Channel
postings.descriptionText:
Hi, I'm Brian, Senior Director of Engineering at Customer.io . We're looking for experienced engineers who want to own a channel end to end — from the infrastructure that delivers billions of messages reliably, to the product surfaces our customers use to build, send, and analyze their campaigns. You'll work across the stack, bringing both systems thinking and product craft to one of the most technically rich problem spaces in the industry.
You don't need email experience to apply. We can teach you the email domain. The engineers who thrive here are the ones who love learning a deep problem space, not only the ones who arrive already knowing it.

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive.
We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. Under the hood: Go, React, Ember and AI help us ship fast and scale with confidence.

What We Value
Ownership You own problems end to end. You move fast, act like an owner, and thrive in ambiguity. You've led complex projects before, whether officially or not, and you're ready to do it again.
Engineers with product taste You think like a user, not just an engineer. You care how your systems power real customer value — and how to make them better.
A healthy skepticism for "the way things are done" You bring rigor and creativity. Best practices matter — but never more than forward motion.

What You'll Do

• Build and evolve the frontend experiences customers use to create, preview, and analyze campaigns — editors, configuration, and analytics dashboards

• Design and scale backend systems that process high volumes of messages and events: queue management, retry logic, rate limiting, and real-time event pipelines

• Build automated systems that respond intelligently to feedback signals from external providers — classification, suppression, throttling, and health scoring

• Partner with in-house domain experts to turn their knowledge into automated tooling — you bring the systems skills, they bring the email depth

• Instrument and monitor channel health end to end: signal detection, anomaly alerting, and observability

• Own problems end to end — from architecture and schema design to testing, deployment, and monitoring

• Share knowledge and raise the bar through short videos, thoughtful writing, and mentorship

• Use AI agents to make multi-file changes by scoping the work, writing the prompt, and verifying the output

What We're Looking For

• 7+ years of experience building scalable, distributed systems in Go (or similar statically typed languages)

• Experience building product-facing frontend features in React or similar frameworks, with attention to UX quality and polish

• Experience building or consuming APIs that handle high-throughput async workloads — event streams, queues, and systems that degrade gracefully under load

• Comfort integrating with external systems you don't control — third-party APIs, rate limits, opaque failure modes — and designing for resilience around them

• Comfort working in cloud-native environments (AWS, GCP)

• Familiarity with relational databases (we use MySQL primarily) and an understanding of performance tradeoffs

• Experience with observability tooling and operating production systems

• A bias for action over perfection, and pride in owning technical decisions

Nice to have: Familiarity with email infrastructure — deliverability, authentication standards (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), sender reputation, or high-volume sending

Compensation & Benefits
We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $150,000 - $200,000 USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment.
We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family . We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave , unlimited PTO , stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.
See full benefits here →

Our Process
No gotchas, no trick questions — just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

• Application — We review everyone with care. Tell us why you're interested.

• Recruiter Call (30 mins) — Let's chat about what you're looking for and how we work.

• Hiring Manager Interview (60 mins) - Talk with one of our hiring managers about your working style and a project you've owned end-to-end, plus a short AI-assisted coding exercise.

• Technical Interview (60 mins) — A collaborative system design conversation focused on scaling challenges.

• Take-Home Assignment — Complete a short, realistic task similar to what you'd work on here.

• Assignment Review Call (60 mins) — Walk us through your work and discuss tradeoffs, priorities, and how you'd iterate.

• Project Deep Dive (60 minutes: A focused conversation on a technical project you've owned end-to-end, and how you balance planned work against urgent, customer-impacting issues.

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.
Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.
Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact .

Join us!
We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you're excited by what you read and want to build software that makes communication better for everyone — apply now.

Preferred Qualifications

postings.title: AI-First Copy & Community Manager
postings.descriptionText:
💸 USD 24,000 - USD 28,000 per year, on a full-time, contractor contract

🌎 Fully remote working!
✨ Create sharp copy and meaningful community conversations for globally recognised brands in US TV and entertainment.
🔍 Work with AI agents, reusable skills and editorial context libraries at the centre of your craft.
💻 High-end, fast computer
💡 All the latest software and productivity tools you’ll need

About the Role
You write copy that sounds right for the brand and gives people a reason to care. You also know how to join a fan conversation: when a thoughtful reply adds something, when humour fits, and when an issue needs escalating. This is a hands-on role owning the relationship between a brand and its community through strong copy and thoughtful engagement.
Storm is an AI-native agency. AI tools and agentic workflows are central to how our teams work, and we hire people who want to work that way from day one.
AI-first doesn't mean AI-generated. The work itself is craft: finding the right angle, shaping a line and responding with judgment. You direct agents through Codex, using reusable skills and context libraries of brand voice, source material and editorial examples to produce copy variants, edit working documents and run structured checks. You catch the bland line, unsupported claim or reply that misses the mood, and make it better. Your editorial judgment stays in charge of every word.
You'll learn the ground first: what we make and the bar it has to hit. Social copy that earns attention. Community replies that make the brand feel like part of the fandom. Then you'll work from Storm's stack of AI and creative tools, and play a real part in improving how this work gets done.

About Storm Ideas
Founded in 2008, Storm Ideas is an international team working with globally recognised clients, particularly across the US TV and entertainment industry.
Storm brings together entertainment, fandom, creative production, community and technology. We help major brands build stronger relationships with their audiences, while using AI to improve how that work is created, checked and delivered.
We are a remote-first, fast-moving company with established clients, a growing team, and a strong appetite for better tools, better systems, and better ways of working. AI is central to how we operate — every team, every role, this one included.

What You Will Do

• Write engaging, on-brand social copy for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, YouTube and other relevant platforms, with AI tools and agentic workflows as your default way of working.

• Review and refine social copy for clarity, accuracy and audience fit, adapting each piece to its platform and purpose.

• Learn each brand's voice, audience and subject matter deeply enough to judge when AI output fits. Maintain and evolve tone-of-voice guidance, source context and examples that people and agents can use consistently.

• Fact-check against supplied sources and proofread everything you deliver, including anything AI touched. Check names, claims, grammar, punctuation, links, accessibility and platform-native formatting; treat rights and brand safety as fixed points.

• Pitch social content angles and approaches that improve engagement and visibility. Apply copywriting best practice, using performance signals and feedback to improve attention, reach and the quality of the writing.

• Engage communities day to day: respond to comments and join relevant conversations on fan, talent and partner content. Keep replies timely, appropriate and consistent with the brand's personality and engagement approach.

• Stay close to culture, fandom, trends and platform developments. Surface timely engagement opportunities that suit the audience, and feed what you learn from conversations back into copy and content ideas.

• Use agents for repeatable work such as preparing copy variants, checking against source material and summarising community themes. Review their work critically, make the editorial decisions and keep useful records for clear handovers.

• Prioritise deadlines and responsive community work, balance a shared workload with colleagues across time zones, and adapt constructively to feedback and changing priorities.

• Keep improving how the work gets done: encode your best methods into reusable skills and workflows that agents and teammates can pick up and run, and teach what works so the whole team levels up with you. Test new capabilities against real briefs, compare the results with your current approach, and update shared methods when they improve quality or reliability.

Success means distinctive, accurate copy; timely community responses that fit the conversation; and improvements that reduce avoidable revisions and help teammates deliver consistently. You can show what your methods changed, using examples, feedback and useful measures.

What We Are Looking For

• Excellent written English and a strong editorial ear. Your writing shows precision, range, personality and an ability to adapt tone without losing clarity.

• Community judgment: you understand fan behaviour, can write a natural response and recognise when to engage, pause or escalate. You bring a real interest in TV, film and online culture.

• Demonstrable, hands-on use of AI agents in work, study or personal projects. You can show how you build context, direct production and checks, reject weak output and improve the result. You have examples beyond asking a chatbot for ideas.

• Confidence working with editorial documents, social platforms and AI tools. You may bring a traditional copy background with a developed AI practice, or have built your craft using AI from the start. Either path works here.

• Sound fact-checking and accessibility knowledge, with the attention to detail to hold the quality bar at speed. You can explain the choices behind your copy and replies.

• A systems mindset and ownership: you spot repeatable work, improve it and follow through. You can demonstrate a reusable method and explain how you help someone else use it successfully.

• Clear communication, reliable organisation and thoughtful asynchronous handovers. You share work well, respond to feedback and learn new tools with an eye for what improves the result.

What It's Like To Work Here
Modern Tech Stack
You’ll work with a supported AI stack, shared context and reusable skills, backed by our AI Operations team. You’ll build on established tools and methods, contribute improvements, and help colleagues put them into practice.
Your Methods Can Become How The Team Works
We actively encourage people to bring forward better ways of working. When a method you develop proves itself, you won't just use it quietly: you'll encode it as a skill others can run, teach it to the team, and watch it become the new standard, with your name on it.
Team-based
Join an international, remote-first team of 175+ people who value skill, initiative and collaboration. You work closely with copy and account colleagues and contribute to a shared quality bar.
Flexibility
You work 37.5 hours per week within a 9am–5:30pm Pacific Time schedule, Monday–Friday, collaborating with colleagues across time zones.

Recruitment Process
Apply with your CV, a short note explaining your fit for the role, and writing samples or a portfolio. Samples are required; personal projects count. Social copy and community-response examples are especially useful.
Shortlisted applicants complete self-recorded video questions and a short, time-boxed copy and community practical task as one screening stage.
If successful, you'll meet Tania Pardisi, Senior Copy Manager, and Nicola Taghizadeh, Chief Creative Officer, together for an interview. We'll discuss your work, your approach to community relationships and your experience using AI, and answer your questions about the role and team.
Not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway if this sounds like how you already work. We are more interested in your operational judgement, reliability, follow-through, and ability to use modern tools well than in a perfect traditional CV.
Privacy Notice
We process your personal data for recruitment purposes in line with UK data protection law. AI tools may assist in reviewing applications, but decisions are made by our team. We retain data only as necessary for recruitment and compliance. You can request access or deletion of your data at any time by emailing .

PMI is looking for an Integrated Growth Marketing Strategist to own the end-to-end, cross-channel activation strategy, bringing email, web, social, paid media, and content together into one cohesive approach rather than separate channel plans. This role maintains a strong understanding of business performance, customer behavior, lifecycle trends, market dynamics, and seasonal opportunities to proactively identify and recommend initiatives that drive growth. The Strategist defines how audiences are reached and activated across the full channel mix, how channels and formats work together to achieve campaign objectives, and how performance is measured and optimized holistically. With a deep understanding of both B2B and B2C audiences, the Strategist translates business and growth objectives into integrated activation strategies and provides clear direction to channel owners and agency partners for execution. The Strategist works closely across Marketing and other key functions to connect campaign performance to measurable business outcomes across the full customer funnel.

What you’ll bring to the role:
Campaign Activation Strategy & Channel Design

• Own the end-to-end, cross-channel activation strategy for integrated campaigns — treating paid media, email, web, social, and content as one holistic system rather than separate channel plans.

• Direct channel owners and the agency in executing against the strategy; incorporate their channel-specific expertise and ideas into the strategy without ceding ownership of it.

• Identify opportunities for personalization, segmentation, and audience relevance across the full activation plan.

Paid Media Strategy & Agency Oversight

• Set paid media strategy and activation design — platform selection, format strategy, targeting approach — for campaigns executed by the agency.

Growth & Performance Goal Ownership

• Maintain a strong pulse on overall business performance, audience behavior, market dynamics, and seasonal or cultural moments to identify and recommend campaign initiatives and optimizations that can drive growth, engagement, conversion, or lifecycle impact.

• Set and own performance goals for campaign activation and growth marketing — conversion, funnel/pipeline impact, channel efficiency (e.g., CAC, ROAS, cost-per-conversion), and lifecycle impact.

• Proactively track and report on activation and growth performance; drive optimization recommendations rather than only summarizing results after the fact.

• Partner with Regional Marketing to align global and regional execution requirements.

• Define and evolve the operating model, templates, and workflows for activation strategy and growth performance — not only apply existing ones.

• Identify and lead process improvements that reduce friction between strategy, channel owners, and agency execution.

• Experience managing agency relationships at a strategic level — briefing, directing, and holding agencies accountable to performance — rather than coordinating deliverables and timelines.

• Comfortable working in a matrixed, cross-functional environment with senior stakeholder visibility.

• Familiarity with marketing automation platforms, CRM systems, analytics/performance dashboards, and project management tools.

• Activation Strategy Ownership: Designs channel-agnostic activation strategy — not just coordination — across paid, owned, and earned channels.

• Agency Strategic Management: Directs and holds agency partners accountable at a strategy level, not only an execution level.

• Analytics Literacy: Interprets performance dashboards and translates data into optimization decisions.

• Adaptability: Comfortable working in fast-paced, dynamic environments with shifting priorities.
