About Improvado
Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.
We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the role
Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies. You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured. That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from. You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change. You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do
Salesforce and GTM stack

• Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).

• Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes. Manage licences and vendor renewals.

• Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Contract to cash

• Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.

• Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance. Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.

• Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model

• Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).

• Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.

• Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes. Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.

• Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation

• Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.

• Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership

• Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product. Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements

• 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands-on admin of a live Salesforce org.

• Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric). dbt is a plus.

• Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.

• Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.

• Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.

• Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have

• Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.

• ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.

• Salesforce development (Apex, triggers, API).

• Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.

• Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.

• HubSpot to Salesforce migration.

• Attribution or CS health score data.

• Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer

• Remote-first environment

• Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises

• 20 working days of PTO per year

• US holidays and additional days off

• Professional development reimbursement

You will guide the evolution of a "shop-for-data" experience, moving our architecture from a robust Modular Monolith to a distributed Microservices ecosystem. You’ll be working with a cutting-edge stack (Java 21, AWS, AI-enhanced search) to ensure that "buying" digital assets is as seamless for our users as a consumer e-commerce experience. The end-goal is to build a comprehensive solution that enables FAIR data access to Digital Assets across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

• Architectural Evolution: Lead the strategic transition from a modular monolith to microservices, ensuring domain boundaries are respected and performance remains high. Take ownership of the development of new components and ideas as you cooperate with a multidisciplinary team to deliver end-to-end experiences to the End Users.

• Lead Development: Write clean, high-performance code using Java 21+ features (Virtual Threads, Pattern Matching) to handle complex data transactions.

• Search & AI Innovation: Work on the roadmap to integrate AI/LLM capabilities into our search engine ( Sinequa ), enabling users to explore data assets via natural language and intelligent discovery.

• Data Stewardship: Oversee the polyglot persistence layer, optimizing PostgreSQL for relational integrity and MongoDB for flexible metadata storage.

• Cloud Leadership: Design and maintain scalable infrastructure within AWS , ensuring our CI/CD pipelines and deployment strategies are best-in-class.

• Mentorship: Act as a force-multiplier for the team, conducting rigorous code reviews and setting the standard for technical excellence.

Requirements

Technical Requirements

• Strong experience with modern Java (21+) and Spring Boot 3.x

• Hands-on experience with messaging technologies, ideally Solace

• Good understanding of SPA architecture and frontend development with Angular and TypeScript

• Familiarity with integration patterns and enterprise networking

• Solid architectural knowledge, including modular monoliths, microservices, Data Mesh, and Domain-Driven Design

• Experience working with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and search platforms such as Sinequa

• Practical experience with AWS services, including EC2, RDS, Lambda, and EKS

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform

Who You Are

• A Technical Visionary: You don't just solve today's bugs; you anticipate where the architecture will break two years from now.

• Data-Centric: You understand that in a Data Mesh, the product is the data itself. You care about metadata, lineage, and discoverability.

• User-Centered: You care about the end users experience and can cooperate with UX and Frontend developers to map and deliver first-in-class solutions.

• Pragmatic Architect: You know when to stick with a monolith for speed and exactly when the "swell" justifies a move to microservices.

• AI Curious: You are excited about moving beyond keyword search into the realm of semantic search and AI-driven data exploration.

The Roadmap: What You’ll Build

• Phase 1: Refine the modular boundaries of the current Java 21 application. Deliver scalable and extensible transaction modules enabling Request-to-Use processes within the DataMarketPlace

• Phase 2: Orchestrate the "Great Migration"—consolidate existing Marketplace ecosystems into DataMarketPlace on-boarding tens of thousands of assets and thousands of users.

• Phase 3: Integrate AI-driven exploration features atop our Sinequa search layer.

postings.title: Product Manager - Anti Fraud
postings.descriptionText:
About Nebius :

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role
We run a large-scale GPU cloud and AI infrastructure platform. Fraud and abuse — stolen payment cards, fake sign-ups, compute mining, credential abuse, and coordinated free-tier exploitation — directly threaten platform economics, capacity availability for legitimate customers, and our standing with payment providers and cloud partners.
As Product Manager, Anti-Fraud, you own the product roadmap for the systems that detect, prevent, and respond to fraud and abuse across the customer lifecycle — from onboarding and payment through to ongoing consumption. You sit at the intersection of Trust & Safety, Payments/Billing, Risk, Data Science, and Product Engineering, and you balance two goals in constant tension: stop bad actors and keep friction near zero for real customers.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Own the end-to-end anti-fraud product roadmap: signup/KYC checks, payment fraud detection, account takeover protection, and compute-abuse (e.g., crypto mining, resource reselling) prevention.

• Own the rules and risk-scoring surfaces — the tooling that lets analysts and data scientists define, test, and deploy detection rules and ML models with clear guardrails and audit trails.

• Own the manual review and case-management experience for the Trust & Safety operations team, including queues, evidence views, and action workflows (block, limit, step-up verification, release).

• Own customer-facing friction points — verification flows, step-up challenges, and appeals — designed to minimize false positives and protect the legitimate user experience.

• Identify fraud and abuse incidents early — define the signals, alerts, and thresholds that surface incidents before they scale, and own the detection surface that flags them.

• Participate in incident reviews and post-mortems, capturing root causes and turning each finding into concrete improvements to detection rules, models, and the roadmap.

postings.title: Independent Consultancy - Technical Planning and Coordination
postings.descriptionText:
Terms of Reference: Independent Consultancy - Technical Planning and Coordination for the Open Energy Research and Analytics Consortium (ORA)
Background:The Open Energy Research and Analytics Consortium (ORA) is an open energy data partnership between the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air (CREA), Ember, Global Energy Monitor (GEM), Open Energy Transition (OET), and TransitionZero. Through a shared governance structure and a Secretariat currently housed at GEM, the consortium is working to build an open energy intelligence system based on trusted data, open-source tools, and collaborative analysis.
ORA’s members have already developed the expertise to build every component needed for a shared open data infrastructure as well as reproducible modeling, data pipelines, versioned and citable data, quality metadata, exploration tools, and aggregate data for validation. These components have not yet been coordinated in a cohesive system, and many of the ORA organizations have built similar supporting infrastructure separately. This leaves users and partners to repeatedly reconcile definitions, identifiers, formats, and methodologies, which limits interoperability, auditability, and reuse. The growing use of AI systems for energy questions adds urgency: the standardization, versioning, and source documentation needed to integrate data across ORA are also needed to make open, verified, citable data legible to AI systems.
ORA is entering a 12-month foundational phase to turn the consortium’s vision into an agreed technical and governance blueprint for an open energy data platform and orchestration system, including its audiences, governance, shared standards, and technical architecture for integrating member datasets, open models, and analyses. ORA is committed to ensuring that its core datasets, shared infrastructure, and collaborative tools remain open-source and publicly available.
Objective: ORA seeks an independent consultant, serving as Technical Coordinator, to facilitate and project manage the technical planning of building a shared data infrastructure across the five member organizations. The consultancy includes the interviews and research needed to develop concrete, detailed proposals for how members’ data can be integrated and supports members in agreeing on shared standards, a recommended architecture, and a roadmap for the next phase of the platform and the flagship product, the Open Energy Outlook. The result will be a consortium plan co-authored with the members.
Scope of Work: The Consultant will provide facilitation, project management, and technical analysis for ORA’s defined 12-month foundational planning phase. The Consultant will carry out the following work:

• Facilitation and Consortium Engagement:

• Facilitate the planning process with all five ORA members, preparing agendas and materials, guiding discussions, building consensus among members with different practices and priorities, and documenting decisions and next steps.

• Interview the data leads at each member organization to assess data assets, systems, workflows, and priority user needs.

• Facilitate a shared definition of the platform’s priority users (for example, energy modelers, policy analysts, journalists, civil-society researchers, planners in developing geographies, and AI systems) and the access patterns, tools, and guarantees each needs.

• Lead members through review of, and decisions on, the proposed shared protocols, architecture options, and data hub scope, ensuring all members have meaningful input.

• Project Management:

• Develop and manage an integrated workplan for the foundational phase, with milestones, dependencies, and responsibilities across the five member organizations.

• Track progress, risks, decisions, and action items.

• Coordinate with the ORA Secretariat on communication with members and ORA leads.

• Coordinate with GEM on the data hub proof of concept. The Consultant will define its requirements with the members, and GEM will manage the build.

• Technical Planning and Analysis

• Develop a centralized map of the datasets, scrapers, and in-house data held across the five members, and identify gaps and opportunities for greater interoperability.

• Develop proposed common schemas, identifiers, and metadata documentation, including a framework for a jointly governed identifier crosswalk linking each organization’s records.

• Guide the members to develop shared approaches to automated validation and open, machine-readable documentation.

• Analyze and recommend a design for the data platform (whether hosted, federated, or hybrid, and potentially varying by data product), ensuring datasets are clearly versioned and provenance is traced to primary sources.

• Work with GEM’s Chief Data Officer to contribute to a strategy for presenting the consortium’s trusted datasets to AI systems as a preferred source for energy and climate queries, and a structured learning exchange on AI-assisted research methods.

As Data Engineering Tech Lead, you will be the senior technical authority for R2 's data platform and the day-to-day leader of the Data Engineering team. You will report to the Director of Data Management.
You will own the architecture, technical roadmap, tooling and vendor decisions, reliability and cost of the platform behind ingestion, data processing, underwriting and our enterprise data warehouse.

The role evolves in three stages:

• Lead by influence. A hands-on lead engineer who sets technical direction and standards.

• Prior experience as a Principal or Staff Data Engineer, or as Tech Lead of a team of 4 or more engineers.

• Proven team leadership and project management. You have run a team's delivery, led multi-quarter initiatives and managed stakeholders end to end.

Bonus

postings.title: Transportation Logistics Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
About Nebius :

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role
We are looking for an experienced Transportation Logistics Specialist to manage the full scope of IT hardware logistics across the APAC region — including racks, servers, GPUs, and other data center equipment. The role focuses on air freight and road transport across APAC, with a primary emphasis on shipments originating from or transiting through Taiwan, and deliveries into key APAC markets including Singapore, India, South Korea, Japan, Malaysia, and additional destinations as the business expands.
You will be responsible for day-to-day execution of inbound and outbound shipments, RMA and RMS flows, cross-border customs coordination, and inter-facility transfers within the region. This is a hands-on, operationally focused role requiring deep knowledge of APAC freight markets, strong carrier and forwarder relationships, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, global environment.

Key Responsibilities

Logistics Operations

• Manage end-to-end transport of IT hardware — rack systems, servers, GPUs, and other data center equipment — across all APAC lanes, including inbound shipments from Taiwan, inter-regional moves, and outbound flows as required.

• Coordinate air freight and road transport scheduling, carrier and freight forwarder selection, and delivery execution to ensure on-time, damage-free arrival at APAC data center sites.

• Handle all RMA and RMS shipments within the APAC region, including coordination with vendors, carriers, and internal teams to ensure accurate and timely processing.

• Manage equipment transfers between company warehouses and data center facilities across the region, optimising routes and minimising handling risk.

• Maintain full visibility over active shipments across all APAC lanes and proactively resolve transit issues, delays, or exceptions.

• Develop contingency plans and alternative routing strategies to ensure business continuity.

• Manage time-critical air freight shipments where required, including carrier selection, booking, and end-to-end tracking to ensure expedited delivery of hardware.

Coordination & Documentation

• Coordinate closely with data center operations teams across APAC to support staging, buffering, and just-in-time hardware deployment.

• Maintain accurate in-transit inventory records and ensure proper chain-of-custody documentation for all shipments.

• Manage all shipment-related documentation in relevant systems (Jira, TMS, or equivalent), ensuring records are complete, accurate, and audit-ready.

• Manage customs documentation and clearance processes for all cross-border shipments within APAC, including imports into Singapore, India, South Korea, Japan, and Malaysia.

• Process and reconcile logistics invoices; manage payments for transportation operations, including ZIP payments to the appropriate vendors and partners.

• Work with the security team to establish and maintain secure shipment protocols for high-value hardware across the region.

Compliance & Quality

• Ensure all shipments comply with applicable regulations across APAC jurisdictions, including country-specific import/export requirements, customs procedures, and trade compliance obligations.

• Manage duties, taxes, and customs declarations for inbound and outbound shipments across the region, ensuring correct classification and valuation of high-value IT hardware.

• Maintain audit-ready documentation for all logistics activities, supporting internal (SOX) and external compliance requirements.

• Establish and enforce SLAs and KPIs with freight carriers, forwarders, and 3PL partners; drive accountability through regular performance reviews.

• Identify and escalate compliance gaps or process deviations, implementing corrective actions as needed.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with hardware engineering, procurement, finance, and data center operations to align APAC logistics execution with deployment timelines and business priorities.

• Collaborate with OEM suppliers based in Taiwan to coordinate international shipping windows, batch tracking, customs documentation, and inbound scheduling into APAC facilities.

• Act as the primary escalation point for transport-related issues across the APAC region.

• Work closely with the global transport team to ensure regional operations align with global standards, processes, and reporting requirements.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives through KPI tracking, root cause analysis, and process standardisation.

Planning & Cost Management

• Forecast transportation demand across APAC based on data center expansion plans, hardware deployment schedules, and capacity needs.

• Identify cost optimisation opportunities through carrier consolidation, routing improvements, and smarter scheduling across APAC lanes.

• Track and report on regional logistics costs, flagging variances and recommending corrective actions.

• Support data-driven decision-making through regular reporting, dashboards, and operational analytics.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in transportation, freight, or logistics management, with a strong focus on international shipping within the APAC region.

• Deep, hands-on knowledge of APAC freight markets, air freight lanes, and road transport operations — particularly routes involving Taiwan, Singapore, India, South Korea, Japan, and Malaysia.

• Proven experience managing high-value, time-critical IT hardware shipments — server racks, GPUs, data center equipment, or similar cargo.

• Strong understanding of customs regulations, import/export procedures, and trade compliance across multiple APAC jurisdictions.

• Experience managing and negotiating with carriers, freight forwarders, and 3PL partners across the APAC region.

• Hands-on experience with RMA/RMS shipment processes and reverse logistics flows.

• Familiarity with TMS platforms, Jira, or similar systems used for shipment tracking and documentation.

• Excellent organisational and documentation skills with a high standard for accuracy and completeness.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to work cross-functionally across technical and non-technical teams in a global environment.

• Self-starter mindset with the ability to operate independently in a remote environment with minimal supervision.

• Based in the APAC region; Singapore, India, or South Korea preferred. Must be eligible to work in the country of residence.

• Fluency in English required; additional Asian languages (Mandarin, Korean, Hindi, or similar) are a strong advantage.

Nice to Have

• Experience in a hyperscaler, cloud provider, or large-scale data center build-out environment.

• Familiarity with ATA Carnet processes and temporary import/export mechanisms for repair and return shipments.

• Experience with Taiwan-origin shipments and familiarity with Taiwanese export procedures and OEM supplier logistics coordination.

• Background in supply chain analytics, reporting, or continuous improvement methodologies.

• Familiarity with physical security protocols for high-value hardware shipments.

• Experience supporting logistics operations across emerging APAC markets such as Indonesia, Vietnam, or Thailand.

Benefits & Perks:

• Competitive compensation

• Career growth and learning opportunities

• Flexibility and ownership

• Collaborative and innovative culture

• Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

• International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius :

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

postings.title: Desk Director
postings.descriptionText:
We are currently recruiting a Desk Director to join our Programs team. This is a remote position open to candidates based within the UTC+1 to UTC+4 time zones and requires up to 30% international travel. The role reports to the Director of Program Implementation and is a senior member of Relief International 's Programs team.
At Relief International , we are committed to building a representative, inclusive and authentic workplace. We strongly encourage applications from candidates from minoritized backgrounds and those who bring lived experience of the contexts in which we work.
We are proud to be a global recruiter, hiring people from around the world. We offer competitive salaries and benefit packages for all staff that are applied fairly and transparently. This means we are unable to advertise the salary as it is dependent on the local job market of the staff member. Shortlisted candidates will be informed of the salary range during the selection process.
This role is classified as requiring enhanced pre-employment checks.

About Relief International

Relief International is an international non-profit organization that partners with communities impacted by conflict, climate change and disaster to save lives, build greater resilience and promote long-term health and wellbeing. Our teams work across Africa, Asia, and the Middle East, delivering Health and Nutrition, WASH, Protection, Education and Livelihoods programming that creates the foundation for resilient communities.
Operating under a one-team model, Relief International brings together global expertise and local knowledge to deliver effective humanitarian and development programming in some of the world's most challenging environments.

About the Opportunity
As Desk Director, you will provide strategic oversight and leadership for a portfolio of up to seven country programmes with a combined annual portfolio value of approximately $60 million. You will directly manage Country Directors and lead a Desk Team responsible for supporting country operations, programme quality, donor engagement, risk management and organizational sustainability.
The role sits at the intersection of strategy, operations and humanitarian leadership. You will work closely with Country Directors, the Resource Development team, Security, Finance, HR, Awards Management and senior organizational leadership to ensure that programmes are delivered safely, effectively and in compliance with donor and organizational requirements.
You will be expected to navigate complex humanitarian crises, political volatility, donor expectations and operational risks while ensuring Relief International remains responsive, accountable and focused on delivering impact for the communities we serve.
This is an exceptional opportunity for an experienced humanitarian leader who combines strategic vision with operational excellence and is passionate about strengthening country programmes, empowering leaders and driving organizational growth.

Your Responsibilities
This role includes the following responsibilities:

• Provide strategic leadership and oversight for a multi-country portfolio, ensuring alignment with Relief International 's global strategy, country priorities and donor expectations.

• Directly line manage Country Directors and the Desk Manager, providing leadership, coaching, accountability and support to drive high performance across the portfolio.

• Oversee programme quality, operational performance, financial management, compliance and security across all countries within the Desk portfolio.

• Ensure country programmes are delivering high-quality, timely and compliant services while effectively managing risk and maintaining strong donor confidence.

• Lead cross-functional coordination with Finance, HR, Security, Supply Chain & Operations, Awards Management and Technical teams to resolve challenges and improve programme performance.

• Support and guide donor engagement efforts, strategic positioning and business development initiatives to strengthen programme sustainability and portfolio growth.

• Provide oversight of proposal development processes, ensuring donor submissions are strategic, competitive, compliant and aligned with organizational priorities.

• Drive risk management across the portfolio, ensuring proactive identification and mitigation of operational, programmatic, security and reputational risks.

• Foster collaboration, innovation and knowledge sharing across countries and departments to strengthen learning and programme impact.

• Contribute as a senior leader within the Program Implementation Department, helping shape organizational strategy, priorities and continuous improvement initiatives.

About You
You will bring the following experience, skills and leadership qualities:

• Master's degree in International Development, Political Science, Social Sciences or a related field.

• Significant senior leadership experience within humanitarian and development organizations, including multi-country, regional or global management responsibilities.

• Demonstrated success managing large and complex donor-funded portfolios across fragile, conflict-affected and rapidly changing environments.

• Strong experience working with major institutional donors including BHA, PRM, ECHO, UN agencies and other international funding bodies.

• Excellent understanding of programme cycle management, programme quality standards, compliance frameworks and risk management systems.

• Exceptional leadership and people management skills, with experience coaching senior leaders and building high-performing teams across multiple locations.

• Proven ability to influence, negotiate and collaborate effectively with donors, partners, boards, senior executives and cross-functional teams.

• Strong strategic thinking and decision-making skills, with the ability to balance operational realities, humanitarian imperatives and organizational objectives.

• Excellent written and spoken English. French and/or Arabic language skills are highly desirable.

• Experience in localization, partnership strengthening, climate resilience or nexus programming would be an advantage.

How To Apply
To apply for this post, click on the Apply button in the job advert page.

• You will be asked to upload a CV and Cover Letter.

• The cover letter should be one page and explain why you are interested in this post with Relief International and how your skills and experience make you a strong fit for the role.

Closing Date

Monday 14 September
As a humanitarian organization, Relief International is committed to safeguarding all those we come into contact with through our work. We are committed to the core humanitarian principles regarding the prevention of sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment. Relief International expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment and uphold the values and behaviours outlined in our Code of Conduct.
Recruitment to all roles at Relief International includes references, a criminal records self-declaration and other pre-employment checks, which may include police and qualification checks.
Due to the nature of this role, applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and the position may be filled before the closing date. Early applications are strongly encouraged.

postings.title: Creative & Communication Strategist
postings.descriptionText:
En Boomit trabajamos con marcas que crecen en serio. Nuestro equipo de Growth Marketing combina estrategia, medios y creatividad para generar resultados reales — y hoy buscamos a alguien que sea el puente entre todo eso.
Buscamos una persona con cabeza creativa y lógica publicitaria: que sepa conceptualizar una campaña, escribir un copy que convierta, leer métricas y volver al brief con más criterio que antes. Alguien que entienda que creatividad sin estrategia es decoración, y estrategia sin creatividad es ruido.

¿Qué vas a hacer?

•

Traducir necesidades de clientes y equipos de medios en briefs claros, con enfoque de mensaje, jerarquía comunicacional y concepto creativo definido.

•

Desarrollar conceptos de campaña, ángulos de comunicación y adaptaciones por canal, formato y audiencia (Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn y más).

•

Escribir y revisar copies, guiones y bajadas para piezas estáticas y video — cuidando calidad comunicacional, tono de marca y adecuación al objetivo publicitario.

•

Leer métricas de performance, identificar qué anuncios están funcionando, detectar patrones y proponer ajustes desde la comunicación.

•

Interactuar con clientes en temas de mensajes, feedback creativo y ajustes — con madurez y capacidad de sostener criterio.

•

Trabajar de forma transversal con Performance Leaders, Paid Media Specialists y diseñadores, elevando el estándar creativo de todo el equipo.

Lo que buscamos

•

Experiencia en agencia o ecosistema similar — entendés la dinámica, los tiempos y lo que significa trabajar con múltiples marcas a la vez.

•

Excelente nivel de redacción y conceptualización. Criterio propio, voz propia, capacidad de tomar definiciones y defenderlas.

•

Creatividad aplicada a publicidad: pensar campañas, construir ángulos, generar ideas que luego se puedan ejecutar con claridad.

•

Conocimiento sólido de medios digitales — Meta, Google, TikTok — desde el lado creativo y comunicacional.

•

Comodidad con números: leer planillas, interpretar KPIs y convertir resultados en decisiones de mensaje.

•

Capacidad de dialogar con clientes y diseñadores por igual: argumentar, persuadir, ordenar conversaciones con madurez.

El perfil que nos entusiasma
Una persona apasionada por la comunicación y la publicidad, con sensibilidad creativa y lógica analítica al mismo tiempo. Alguien inquieto, profesional, que disfruta moverse entre un concepto de campaña, una métrica de performance y una conversación con un cliente — y que en cada uno de esos momentos agrega valor real. Que use la IA como palanca para ir más lejos, no como sustituto del criterio.
Modalidad: Remoto full-time. Colaborás con equipos en distintos países de Latam.

postings.title: Consultancy Opportunity: Coordinator, Global Platform for Action to End FGM/C
postings.descriptionText:
Consultancy Opportunity: Coordinator, Global Platform for Action to End FGM/C
Duration: 13 months, anticipated from 15 November 2026 to 15 December 2027
Estimated level of effort: Equivalent to three (3) days per week
Location and availability: This is a remote consultancy open to applicants globally, with applications particularly encouraged from consultants based in Asia and Africa. The Consultant must be able to coordinate across time zones and participate in agreed meetings with the Platform’s international membership.

About the Global Platform:
The Global Platform for Action to End FGM/C is a consortium of civil society organisations, champions, survivors, and grassroots representatives working together to accelerate the abandonment and prevention of female genital mutilation/cutting (FGM/C).
Established following consultations initiated at the 2019 Women Deliver conference in Vancouver, the Global Platform brings together members across regions to exchange knowledge, strengthen collaboration, and advance collective advocacy. Its Global Call to Action to End FGM/C, launched in November 2019, calls for urgent, coordinated action to end FGM/C.
The Global Platform works across intersecting movements, including those addressing sexual and gender-based violence, sexual and reproductive health and rights, and child, early, and forced marriage.

Purpose of the Consultancy:
The Global Platform seeks a consultant to provide coordination, governance, membership, and communications support. The assignment will help translate members’ collective commitments into an achievable programme of joint action and strengthen the Platform’s longer-term sustainability.
The consultancy will focus on three priorities, in the following order:

• Strengthening governance and membership arrangements.

• Establishing consistent coordination and communications.

• Supporting resource mobilisation and longer-term sustainability.

Advocacy activities, events, and other requests will be prioritised within the agreed workplan, level of effort, and available budget.
Scope of Work and Expected Deliverables:
1. Inception and work planning
In consultation with the Core Group and Equality Now , the Consultant will:

• Review existing governance documents, membership arrangements, communications channels, and relevant commitments.

• Prepare an inception workplan within the first month, setting out deliverables, milestones, dependencies, and a realistic allocation of the available consultancy time.

• Identify decisions, member contributions, and resources needed to complete the assignment.

2. Governance and membership

The Consultant will:

• Facilitate consultation on, and prepare a final draft of, the Platform’s membership terms of reference, including the proposed two-tier membership model, for Core Group approval.

• Develop practical guidance on membership, decision-making, and the respective responsibilities of members and the Core Group.

• Establish an organised membership database using an agreed system, with appropriate access and information-handling arrangements.

• Develop a membership outreach and onboarding approach, prioritising grassroots and survivor-led organisations and organisations based in the Global Majority.

• Produce an accessible overview of the Platform, its purpose, and opportunities for participation.

3. Coordination and member engagement

The Consultant will:

• Coordinate monthly Core Group meetings, including scheduling, preparation, and follow-up.

• Circulate agendas and relevant materials at least one (1) week before each meeting, subject to timely input from members.

• Circulate meeting records and an updated action tracker within five (5) working days after each meeting.

• Maintain a central record of agreed decisions, actions, responsibilities, and deadlines.

• Provide a central contact point for Platform enquiries and coordinate responses with the appropriate members.

• Facilitate member contributions and flag outstanding decisions or dependencies that may affect delivery.

4. Communications and shared resources

The Consultant will:

• Develop and implement a proportionate communications schedule covering the internal listserv, public mailing list, and social media channels.

• Coordinate member contributions and prepare content for approval through agreed processes.

• Coordinate website content updates and provide agreed content and member input to the external website redesign consultant.

• Support the development of common messages and positioning for Core Group approval.

• Organise key documents and resources so that members can access and use them.

5. Strategic planning and sustainability

The Consultant will:

• Facilitate the development of a three-year strategic workplan, including objectives, priority actions, indicative responsibilities, and resource requirements, for Core Group approval.

• Develop a practical tracker for commitments under the Movement-led Collective Vision on Ending FGM/C, drawing on updates provided by participating members.

• Map potential funding and partnership opportunities and recommend a prioritised approach to follow-up.

• Prepare a concise impact summary and a core set of materials to support partnership development and fundraising.

• Develop recommendations for sustaining the Platform’s coordination function beyond the consultancy period.

The Consultant will support resource mobilisation but will not be responsible for guaranteeing funding or the performance of individual member organisations.
6. Joint advocacy and events
Within the agreed workplan and available resources, the Consultant will:

• Provide secretariat support for the Platform’s engagement with the FGM/C Donor Working Group.

• Coordinate the preparation and dissemination of three shared advocacy materials during the consultancy period.

• Coordinate at least two webinars during the consultancy period, including agreed co-host arrangements, speaker coordination, and follow-up.

• Support the meaningful participation of grassroots activists and survivors in the planning and delivery of these activities.

• Support selected joint advocacy events were expressly included in the agreed workplan.

Any additional events or travel will require prior agreement on scope, timing, funding, and any effect on other deliverables. Representation of the Platform will require an agreed mandate and approved messaging.
7. Progress reporting and handover

The Consultant will:

• Submit a short quarterly progress report summarising completed deliverables, progress against the workplan, challenges, and decisions required.

• Coordinate agreed narrative inputs for donor reporting and maintain an activity expenditure tracker in collaboration with Equality Now . Financial approvals and formal donor submissions will remain with the authorised organisation.

• Submit a final report and handover package before the consultancy ends, including key documents, outstanding actions, and recommendations for continuity.

Contracting, Coordination, and Duration
Equality Now will contract and administer this independent consultancy, which is not an employee position, for 13 months, from 15 November 2026 to 15 December 2027, with an estimated level of effort equivalent to three (3) days per week.
The Consultant will organise delivery independently, coordinating availability across time zones for agreed meetings and deadlines. Equality Now ’s designated focal point will consolidate feedback, coordinate approvals, and accept deliverables, working with the Ending Gender-based Violence team. The Global Platform’s Core Group will guide substantive priorities and approve outputs requiring collective agreement. Member requests will follow this coordination process.
Performance will be assessed against agreed deliverables and milestones. Material changes to scope, timing, or level of effort require prior written agreement with Equality Now . The consultancy agreement will address confidentiality, intellectual property, information security, safeguarding, and payment.
Any extension will require available funding and a separate written agreement; renewal is not guaranteed.

Consultancy Fee and Payment:
The total consultancy fee is USD 26,000, payable in thirteen monthly instalments of USD 2,000, subject to satisfactory delivery of the services and submission of an invoice and brief progress summary.
The consultancy agreement will specify the invoicing periods and payment schedule, including the treatment of the first and final partial calendar months.
Travel and other reimbursable expenses are separate from the consultancy fee and must be approved in writing before they are incurred, subject to available funding and the terms of the consultancy agreement.
Consultant Qualifications and Experience:

The Consultant should demonstrate:

• Relevant coordination experience: A track record of coordinating coalitions, networks, or multi-stakeholder initiatives, including facilitating meetings, maintaining action plans, and supporting delivery across organisations.

• Relevant subject knowledge: An understanding of FGM/C and its connections to gender equality, human rights, and sexual and reproductive health and rights.

• Inclusive facilitation and relationship-building: Experience working respectfully with diverse partners, including grassroots organisations and survivor-led movements, and enabling meaningful participation across regions and time zones.

• Governance and planning skills: The ability to translate consultation and collective priorities into practical governance arrangements, membership processes, and achievable strategic workplans.

• Strong communications skills: The ability to produce clear, accessible written materials, synthesise contributions from multiple stakeholders, and coordinate digital communications. Strong written and spoken English is required; additional languages are an advantage.

• Independent delivery: The ability to organise the assignment, exercise sound judgement, manage competing priorities, and deliver agreed outputs within the available time and budget.

• Experience supporting resource mobilisation, donor reporting, joint advocacy, or online events would be an advantage.

• Relevant professional, community-based, and lived experience will be valued. Applicants should demonstrate a commitment to feminist principles, safeguarding, and respectful engagement with survivors.

HOW TO APPLY
Please visit: and submit a resume/CV and cover letter. The applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the application period closes at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on 30 October, 2026.
Due to the volume of applicants anticipated for this role, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.
Equality Now is strong because it is diverse. We actively seek a diverse applicant pool and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Equality Now offers a competitive compensation package, including base salary, savings, health and vacation benefits, and is an Equal Opportunity employer. Equality Now employees are selected on the basis of ability without regard to race, colour, religious beliefs, sex, gender identity and expression, language, political or other opinion, nationality, ethnic or social origin, disability, pregnancy, mental status, HIV status, age, marital status, or sexual orientation.
We welcome all kinds of diversity. Candidates are selected on the basis of ability, in accordance with all country and location-specific law

postings.title: Senior Performance Creative Strategist
postings.descriptionText:
Why This Role Exists This is a founding role — which means your ceiling is uncapped and your fingerprints will be on how an entire function works for years to come. You'll own how CDM identifies, develops, and scales creative — video and static — built Paid Social–first , with support for our Paid Search team, so our clients grow faster than their competitors can copy them. Here's the bet we're making: creative is the most durable lever in performance marketing. Budgets, algorithms, audiences, and targeting all converge over time — everyone eventually gets access to the same tools. The creative is what still separates the winners from everyone else. CDM believes the agencies that dominate the next decade will be the ones that treat creative strategy as a rigorous, repeatable discipline instead of a guessing game. You will be the person who builds that discipline here.

Key Responsibilities

Who We Are
Clever Digital Marketing is a performance marketing agency helping large home improvement companies across the US and Canada grow through Paid Social, Paid Search, CRO, and strategic advising. We manage a large portfolio of accounts, an in-house creative team, and significant monthly ad spend. As we scale, we're building a stronger creative-strategy function to help clients find new creative winners — and to turn one-off learnings into repeatable systems that compound across every account.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

What You'll Own This is a senior, strategic role. You won't be editing every asset or running campaigns day-to-day. Your job is to raise the quality of the thinking, research, and strategy behind everything we produce and test.
1. Generate net-new creative. Develop original concepts, messaging angles, hooks, formats, and storytelling approaches for video and static ads — not variations on the same three ideas.
2. Find the ideas before you have them. Run customer, competitor, and market research to uncover motivations, objections, and pain points that haven't been explored yet. Mine reviews, sales calls, and customer feedback for the insight that makes an ad work.
3. Turn performance into strategy. Analyze why creative wins or loses and translate it into clear next steps. Write sharp, actionable briefs grounded in customer insight, direct-response principles, and a defined testing hypothesis — and push iteration beyond surface-level hook and footage swaps.
4. Build the system. Create CDM's creative-strategy frameworks, brief standards, testing processes, and a shared learning repository. Spot what's working in one account and determine where it can be adapted across others.
5. Level up the whole team. Coach Media Buyers and editors so stronger creative thinking becomes a department-wide capability, not something that lives with one person. Partner with CRO to align messaging, personas, offers, and landing-page experiences. Provide direction for UGC, founder-led, and spokesperson-led formats.

6. Use AI as a force multiplier. Build AI-powered workflows and tools that accelerate research, ideation, and production for the entire team — more on that below.

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years in performance-focused creative strategy.

• Deep understanding of Meta advertising and direct-response creative.

• Strong direct-response copywriting and short-form storytelling skills.

• A track record of developing concepts from customer research and performance data — not just intuition.

• Fluency with creative metrics (Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CTR, CPL) and the judgment to weigh them against lead quality and down-funnel performance.

• Experience across multiple brands, accounts, or verticals.

• A structured approach to testing — hypotheses, iteration strategy, isolating variables.

• Demonstrated ability to build systems, processes, frameworks, or knowledge bases.

• Advanced, practical experience using AI for research, analysis, ideation, workflow design, or creative enablement.

• The ability to explain not just what you'd test, but how you found the opportunity and why you believe it will work.

• Strong communication, prioritization, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• A bias for speed — you generate learning quickly without over-engineering every test.

What "AI-First" Means to Us

We are not looking for someone who asks AI to spit out scripts and hooks. We're looking for someone who uses AI to:

• Analyze customer reviews, calls, and feedback at scale.

• Identify creative patterns across many accounts at once.

• Build and maintain shared account context.

• Surface cross-account testing opportunities.

• Automate recurring creative research and reporting.

• Improve the speed and quality of briefs and production workflows.

• Build systems that help the whole team make better creative decisions.

You bring strong, independent creative judgment. AI is how you increase the depth, speed, and scale of that judgment. Familiarity with tools like Motion, Looker Studio, Asana, Slack, and Claude is a plus.
Nice to Have

• Lead generation or high-ticket services experience.

• Home improvement experience.

• CRO and landing-page testing familiarity.

• UGC, founder-led, or spokesperson-led creative experience.

• Hands-on familiarity with editing or design tools.

What Success Looks Like

• CDM consistently introduces genuinely new creative ideas instead of recycling the same concepts and formats.

• Creative iterations are more deliberate, strategic, and evidence-based.

• Media Buyers and editors produce stronger briefs and creative recommendations on their own.

• Learnings are captured, shared, and applied across accounts.

• AI-supported research and creative workflows are adopted department-wide.

• CDM has a repeatable creative-strategy engine that gets stronger with every test.

Benefits

Benefits of Working at CDM

• Competitive base salary + performance-based bonuses

• Flexible remote work environment with option for in-person collaboration (Vaughan, ON)

• Group Benefits - Medical, Dental, Vision, RRSP/401k Plan w/matching, more.

• Company-provided MacBook computer

• Home office budget and Clever merch delivery to get you started

• Work Abroad Policy: Need a new working environment? Our work abroad policy supports this!

• The chance to shape and grow a high-performing Client Success team

• A culture of performance and respect where the best work happens with extreme ownership and accountability meets collaboration.

Clever Digital Marketing values the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the team. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of support during the recruitment and selection process. Please note that artificial intelligence (AI) may be utilized during the interview or candidate evaluation process to support the fair and efficient screening, assessment, and selection of applicants.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato .

YOUR ROLE
You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.
Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.
This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.
We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

By the end of your first year:

• Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier

• Carrier conversion data running in production models

• Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale

• A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions

• Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives

• Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

• 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact

• Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.

• You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included

• You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift

• You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view

• Expert Python and SQL

NICE TO HAVES

• Real ad budget spent in live auctions

• Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems

• Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms

• Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration

• Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior

• AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker

• CI/CD deployment

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

postings.descriptionText:
***For that position, we only hire in Buenos Aires🇦🇷 or Sao Paulo🇧🇷***

Who is Rollee

Rollee is a data platform that helps financial institutions make better risk decisions by accessing verified income, employment, and other alternative data directly from the source.
The way people work has changed. Income can now come from multiple employers, freelance work, gig platforms, or other sources, but many financial institutions still rely on traditional documents and credit data to understand someone's financial situation. This can make verification slow and fragmented and can leave people with non-traditional income profiles underserved.
Through a single platform, we connect to sources such as gig platforms, government tax portals, payment platforms, and other employment and income systems, then transform that information into structured, actionable data. Our customers use it to verify income and employment, improve their risk models, reduce fraud, and make better underwriting decisions.
Ultimately, our mission is to help build a financial system where people can be assessed based on a more complete picture of their real financial situation, regardless of how or where they work.

The role
We’re looking for a Backend Engineer to join our Coverage team.
The Coverage team is responsible for expanding and maintaining Rollee ’s ability to connect to employment and income data sources. You’ll work on challenging technical problems involving web and mobile applications, third-party systems, APIs, authentication flows, and data extraction.
We’re open to different levels of experience. You might be a junior engineer looking for an environment where you can learn quickly and take on increasing responsibility, or a more experienced engineer ready to own problems independently and contribute to technical decisions.
What matters most to us is your curiosity, problem-solving ability, and willingness to understand how systems work under the hood.

What you'll do

• Build, maintain, and improve integrations with employment and income data sources

• Investigate and resolve production issues

• Explore web and mobile applications to understand how they communicate with backend systems

• Work with undocumented or partially documented third-party APIs

• Debug authentication flows, network requests, and data extraction processes

• Write reliable, maintainable Python code

• Contribute to technical design decisions and help improve our engineering practices

• Improve the testing, monitoring, and automation of our systems

• Collaborate closely with engineers, Product Managers, Data Scientists, and other members of the team

• Take ownership of your work, iterate quickly, learn from feedback, and continuously improve

The scope and level of ownership will naturally depend on your experience.

What we're looking for

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

• Experience with Python

• Experience with web scraping, automation, data extraction, or similar technical challenges

• A good understanding of HTTP, APIs, and client-server communication

• Some experience exploring or debugging web and/or mobile applications

• The ability and curiosity to investigate systems with limited or incomplete documentation

• A strong problem-solving mindset and an interest in understanding how things work

• The ability to learn independently and get comfortable with unfamiliar technical challenges

• Good written and spoken English

We’re intentionally open to different experience levels, so you don’t need to tick every box. If you have strong technical foundations and enjoy solving unconventional engineering problems, we encourage you to apply.

Nice to have

Any of the following would be a plus:

• Experience with network debugging and traffic analysis

• Knowledge of authentication and authorization mechanisms

• Familiarity with application security, encryption, and common security protocols

• Experience reverse-engineering web or mobile application behavior

• An understanding of privacy-by-design principles

• Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring, or DevOps practices

• Experience designing maintainable backend systems and APIs

• Experience working in a remote engineering team

Why Rollee

• Build something that matters. Join an early-stage company with an ambitious mission: transforming how employment and income data is accessed around the world.

• Have real ownership. Work on meaningful technical challenges, make decisions, and have a direct impact on the product from day one.

• Grow with us. Whether you join as a junior, mid-level, or senior engineer, we’ll adapt the scope and level of ownership to your experience, with plenty of room to learn and grow.

• Work flexibly. We care about outcomes and ownership, not where you sit. We give our team the flexibility and trust to do their best work.

• Get the tools you need. We provide a MacBook, plus access to a coworking space and/or a remote-work equipment budget, depending on your location.

• Be part of an international team. Work with people from different backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives in an environment where everyone can contribute.

• Join a well-backed company. Rollee is backed by leading investors and business angels, including Speedinvest, Seedcamp, and 20VC.

• And there’s more. We offer additional benefits that we’ll be happy to walk you through during the interview process.

Our hiring process

• Cultural interview with our People Manager (30min)

• Take-home technical assignment

• Technical interview with members of the Coverage Team (1 hour)

You are one of the key support pillars as Avicado continues to grow. As the Business Operations Coordinator, you are the teammate who keeps things moving. • Help refine our SOPs, and surface the bottlenecks and blockers you find along the way

You will love this job if...

• Take pride in doing your work accurately

• You enjoy figuring out why something is off and fixing the root cause

Ideal Background

• Comfort with AI tools. You use AI assistants, and more importantly, you check what they produce before trusting it

Preferred:

• Experience working in or alongside a finance team on invoicing or recurring financial reporting.

• Experience maintaining data quality in Excel

Characteristics of an ideal candidate  

• Responsive; Avicado takes great pride in reacting quickly and positively to our clients and teammates, both internal and external 

• Innovative; a desire to drive innovation through new and unique solutions while embracing creative ideas

• Entrepreneurial; the drive to take initiative, deliver results, and create value for our clients

• Empowered; bring solutions instead of problems

• Performance Driven & Accountable; sets goals and challenges our high-performance culture

• Even-tempered; handles pressure and thrives in a fast-paced environment

• Coachable; recognizes strengths & weakness and open to guidance 

Why Avicado  

• Competitive compensation 

• Health insurance 

• 401k with employer match

• Flexible PTO

• Remote work

• Philanthropic Matching Gift Program  And more… 

About Avicado  

Avicado , LLP was established in 2015 with a focus on utilizing the latest cloud-based tools and applications to enhance our clients' experience. As a technology consultancy, we empower construction owners to make the most of their systems and data. Our team of experts collaborates with enterprise organizations such as data centers, universities, hospitals, and real estate developers to promote seamless interoperability across their teams and technologies. We are experiencing an exciting phase of expansion and actively searching for new talent to join our team.

Avicado 's unwavering dedication to creating a remarkable workplace experience has been widely acknowledged by experts in the industry. Additionally, we are humbled to have received the AYA Award, which recognizes allies who promote equality and actively foster positive change for women in technology. At Avicado , we take great pride in fostering a culture that is both inclusive and supportive, especially for women in the technology industry.

These accolades are a testament to our ongoing efforts to foster a culture of inclusion, mutual respect, and professional growth for all members of our team.

Staff Data Scientists are where Robots and Pencils’ promise of “production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days” is backed by evidence. Collaboration & Communication

Leadership & Influence

What You’ll Bring

• PhD, or a Master’s degree with 4+ years of experience, in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field

• Deep proficiency in Python or R, with strong skills in libraries like scikit-learn and TensorFlow/PyTorch, and fluency in models, algorithms, and ontologies

• Experience programming in Java, C++, or a related language

Helpful Extras and Unique Skills

• Hands-on penetration testing experience.

• Knowledge of software supply chain security, including SBOMs, SLSA, image signing, or similar practices.

postings.descriptionText:
Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production.

Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first.

We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien!

The Mission

As a Quality Analyst, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our contact center solutions across multiple communication channels. You will be responsible for testing and validating IVR systems and chat implementations workflows to deliver exceptional customer experiences. This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop expertise in contact center technologies while working with cutting-edge AWS services and industry-leading clients.

Your Assignment

Quality Assurance & Testing

• Execute comprehensive test plans for IVR systems, including call flow validation, DTMF input testing, and speech recognition accuracy

• Perform end-to-end testing of chat implementations across web, mobile, and messaging platforms

• Validate email routing, auto-response systems, and template rendering across different email clients

• Conduct functional testing of Amazon Connect contact flows, queues, and routing strategies

• Test integration points between contact center platforms and CRM systems, knowledge bases, and third-party applications

• Verify agent desktop functionality, including screen pops, call controls, and presence management

• Execute regression testing for system updates and new feature deployments

Test Planning & Documentation

• Assist in developing detailed test cases and test scripts for multi-channel contact center implementations

• Create and maintain test data sets for various customer interaction scenarios

• Document test results, defects, and issues in tracking systems with clear reproduction steps

• Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics for project stakeholders

• Maintain test case repositories and ensure documentation stays current with system changes

• Contribute to test automation frameworks for repetitive testing scenarios

Channel-Specific Testing

• IVR Testing: Validate menu navigation, voice prompts, call transfers, and self-service transactions

• Chat Testing: Test chat widget functionality, agent assignment, canned responses, and conversation history

• Test omnichannel customer journeys ensuring seamless transitions between channels

• Validate customer context preservation across different interaction channels

• Ensure compliance with accessibility standards across all customer touchpoints

User Experience Testing

• Perform usability testing to ensure intuitive customer experiences

• Test failover scenarios and disaster recovery procedures

• Verify system behavior under edge cases and error conditions

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

• Work closely with development teams to understand technical implementations and testing requirements

• Collaborate with business analysts to ensure test coverage aligns with business requirements

• Participate in daily stand-ups and sprint planning sessions

• Provide feedback on system design from a quality perspective

• Assist in user acceptance testing (UAT) coordination with client teams

• Support production deployment validation and post-implementation monitoring

Preferred Qualifications

• 0-2 years of experience in software testing or quality assurance

• Basic understanding of testing methodologies and QA best practices

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Excellent attention to detail and ability to identify edge cases

• Good written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team

• Adaptability to changing project requirements

Benefits

• Pay in USD

• 100% remote work

• Generous holidays and flexible PTO

• Competitive phantom equity

• Paid for exams and certifications

• Peer bonus awards

• State of the art laptop and tools

• Equipment & Office Stipend

• Individual professional development plan

• Annual stipend for Learning and Development

• Work with an amazing worldwide team and in an incredible corporate culture

postings.descriptionText:
Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production.

The Mission

This role is a Senior QA/Test Engineer specializing in Amazon Connect and contact center technology, responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies across contact flows, routing, IVR/self-service, and AI-driven conversational agents. They validate legacy-to-Connect migrations, build and maintain manual and automated test suites (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium) spanning UI, API, and serverless backend components, and ensure production readiness through cutover validation, monitoring verification, and incident triage. Beyond hands-on testing, they partner with engineers to shift quality left, run UAT sessions with customer stakeholders, and contribute reusable test assets and mentorship to strengthen Caylent's contact center QA practice.

Your Assignment

Test Strategy & Contact Center Quality

• Design and execute test strategies for Amazon Connect implementations covering contact flows, routing logic, IVR/self-service, Cases/Tasks workflows, and Contact Lens configurations

• Build test plans that validate AI agent behavior: intent recognition accuracy, escalation paths, barge-in/fallback handling, hallucination guardrails, and multilingual/SSML voice interactions

• Validate legacy-to-Connect migrations (i.e. Avaya, Genesys, Connect, NICE) through parallel-run testing, flow conversion verification, and data migration validation

• Define and track quality metrics (defect density, test coverage, escape rate) and report on release readiness to delivery leads and customer stakeholders

• Hands-on experience with web application and web automation testing

Manual, Automated & Full-Stack Testing

• Build, maintain, and execute manual and automated IVR test suites, using tools such as Cyara, Hammer, or Botium (preferred).

• Build, maintain, and execute manual and automated web application test suites, using frameworks such as Cypress, Selenium, or Playwright (preferred).

• Build and maintain manual and automated test suites: Playwright E2E and API tests, Cypress, Selenium, integration tests against live Amazon Connect instances, and end-to-end tests of Amazon connect call flows.

• Test custom Agent Workspace experiences (Amazon Connect, Agent Assist)

• Validate serverless, event-driven backends (Lambda, EventBridge, Step Functions, SQS/SNS, DynamoDB, Kinesis) with integration and contract tests

Production Readiness & Operations

• Execute phased rollout and cutover validation for live contact centers, where testing gaps translate directly into missed calls and customer impact

• Verify monitoring and alerting coverage (CloudWatch metrics, alarms, dashboards) across voice, chat, tasks, queues, agents, Lambda, and AI agents prior to go-live

• Participate in production incident triage, reproducing defects and validating fixes across the contact center stack

• Perform security and compliance validation: least-privilege IAM checks, DevSecOps scan review, and encryption standard verification

Collaboration & Practice Contribution

• Partner with engineers during development to shift testing left: pairing on test design, reviewing acceptance criteria, and flagging risk areas early

• Run UAT sessions with customer stakeholders, triage findings, and drive defects to resolution ahead of production cutovers

• Contribute reusable test assets (automated suites, test data sets, QA checklists) back to the CXE practice
