postings.title: Global Meal Coordinator
postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT ECHO
ECHO is a global Christian agricultural networking, training, and resourcing organization. Our mission is to strengthen the capacity of a diverse global network to defeat hunger and improve lives through sustainable food and agroecosystem strategies. ECHO has a significant network of over 20,000 individuals and organizations built over 45 years working in more than 190 countries. These partners serve as the primary multiplier for ECHO tested options, strategies, and research.

WHY JOIN ECHO
At ECHO, you will join a global Christian network committed to defeating hunger and restoring hope through sustainable agriculture. Our team is mission-driven, collaborative, and deeply committed to equipping leaders around the world with practical tools that create lasting impact. If you are passionate about faith-integrated service and sustainable solutions, you will find meaningful purpose in this role.

SUMMARY:
The Global Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning Coordinator is part of the Global MEAL team and contributes to ECHO’s development and roll-out of a Global MEAL system to foster the growth of a learning organization. The role helps ensure timely, accurate and useful program information is collected, analyzed and communicated through ECHO’s reporting processes, with reports reviewed and approved by the appropriate directors and executives. The role will contribute to the collection of quantitative data and qualitative stories to track progress on ECHO’s Strategic Framework Logframe indicators. This role requires a curious, proactive self-starter who gets excited about supporting our organization to move beyond a compliance attitude towards reporting on what happened, to always asking more questions on why and how change did or did not happen and what that means for strategic decision-making. This is a support role with room for initiative and independent work under the direction of the Global MEAL Lead; it does not carry decision-making authority.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Growing a Learning Organization:

• Assist the Global MEAL Lead in improving ECHO’s global MEAL practices.

• Support teams at Regional Impact Centers to implement their learning agendas by contributing to their MEAL planning, tool development and activity planning.

• Document emerging results, lessons and stories of change for reporting and learning.

• Proactively participate in the Impact Learning Circles and engage in outcome harvesting and mapping exercises on a continuous basis.

• Facilitate regular reflection on monitoring and evaluation findings with program and regional teams.

Regular Monitoring and Reporting:

• Support MEAL coordinators and reporting coordinators based at Regional Impact Centers with monthly reporting.

• Assist in managing the ECHO Kobo Toolbox account, including projects, tools and membership.

• Review submissions for completeness, consistency and data quality.

• Consolidate regional data, analyze progress against indicators, targets and annual plans and produce regular data summaries.

• Format and design reports with a clear layout and visual presentation that make data and stories of change easy to read and use.

Support Tracking of Progress Towards Strategic Framework Logframe:

• Contribute to the development of both qualitative and quantitative tools.

• Train and assist teams in data collection towards Strategic Framework Logframe indicators, including occasional in-person trainings on site.

• Contribute to dashboarding and visualization of data.

QUALIFICATIONS:
Core Skills and Competencies:

• Technical MEAL Knowledge: Basic quantitative and qualitative monitoring, reporting, data analysis, and evaluation abilities.

• Relational Project Management: Strong emphasis on prioritizing building relationships above completing tasks with strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to flexibly manage multiple tasks independently.

• Communication Skills: Ability to communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders and collaborate in a cross-cultural, team-oriented environment, making complex ideas simple and attainable. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, other languages such as Thai, French, Spanish or Kiswahili are an added advantage.

• Data Protection and Safeguarding: Experience with data protection and safeguarding, and a commitment to upholding the dignity of communities and community members in how data, stories, and images are collected, stored, and shared.

• Learning attitude: A proactive self-starter with a demonstrated commitment to long-term personal growth and professional development, and to building advanced MEAL capacity and skills through this role as a step toward broader professional aspirations.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Technical proficiency: Experience with Microsoft Sharepoint, experience with Kobo Toolbox as a data collection tool and PowerBI as a data visualization tool.

• Report design: Demonstrated skill in the formatting, layout, and design of reports, so that data and stories of change are clear, accurate, and engaging for varied audiences.

• Contextual knowledge: Experience with approaches to community-led MEAL approaches and holistic flourishing frameworks, such as the Light Wheel. Experience in the fields of food security, nutrition, agriculture, adult learning, or training is preferred.

Additional Requirements:
• Must adhere to the ECHO Statement of Faith and possess character traits consistent with ECHO’s Core Values.

REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

• Education: A bachelor’s degree in a related field (e.g., social sciences or information systems) is required.

• Experience: A minimum of 1 year of experience in MEAL practices in an NGO or foundation organizational setting.

ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:
Positions Directly Supervised:
This position has no direct reports.
Those Directly Supported:
Regional Impact Center staff, all MEAL staff and contributors.

Others to Work Closely With:
Advancement, Communications, Global Support Services, Department Managers, and the directors and executives who review and approve reports.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:
Primarily a computer-based office or remote work environment. There are occasional times when work is conducted in an outdoor or field office (international and domestic) setting, such as during site visits and trainings, which may involve hot and humid conditions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. This position is almost exclusively computer-based and requires the ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods and to communicate effectively in person and through virtual platforms. Occasional travel and on-site, in-person trainings may require standing or walking for periods of time.

POSITION TYPE AND EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK:
This is a full-time position. Days and hours of work may vary based on organizational needs. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required to fulfill job responsibilities and accommodate time zone differences.

WORK LOCATION:
This position may be performed remotely, in a hybrid arrangement, or at an ECHO Regional Impact Center, depending on organizational needs and position requirements. Candidates may be based in various countries, with a preference for those located in the Asia region .

TRAVEL:
Travel domestically and internationally may involve up to 10% of time annually.

OTHER DUTIES:
Undertake additional tasks as assigned, demonstrating flexibility and responsiveness to the organizational needs.

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with serious depth in SAP HANA Cloud and graph databases to own the data layer beneath OMS+ IA. Our product lives on top of large, complex, deeply interconnected enterprise data, and the quality of that data layer sets the ceiling for everything built above it.You will model and optimize on HANA Cloud, and design graph data models that let the product answer connected questions relational queries handle poorly. Things like material substitutions and compatibility, product and customer hierarchies, and supply and fulfillment networks. You will also make sure that layer serves our machine learning and search engineers well, since their pipelines start where your work ends.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, build, and optimize data models on SAP HANA Cloud, including tables, calculation views, CDS artifacts, stored procedures, and SQLScript.

• Design and implement graph data models and traversal queries for connected-data problems such as material substitution and compatibility, product and organizational hierarchies, and supply and fulfillment networks.

• Write and tune high-performance SQL and SQLScript: read execution plans, find the real bottleneck, and fix it.

• Assist with performance engineering across the data layer — partitioning, indexing, memory management, workload classes, and result caching.

• Build data ingestion and replication into HANA Cloud from SAP and non-SAP sources using things like SDI, SDA, SLT, change data capture, or comparable approaches.

• Expose data to the TypeScript product stack through clean, secure, well-documented service layers.

• Set and enforce standards for schema design, migrations, versioning, and code review of database artifacts.

• Implement security and access control: roles and privileges, data masking and anonymization, and multi-tenant data isolation.

• Work closely with machine learning and search engineers so the data layer serves feature pipelines and search indexing efficiently.

• Own monitoring, alerting, backup and recovery, capacity planning, and HANA Cloud upgrade readiness.

• Document data models and graph schemas so the rest of engineering can build on them confidently.

Required Qualifications

• Deep SAP HANA or HANA Cloud engineering expertise — modeling, SQLScript, calculation views, and production performance tuning.

• Experience with graph database capabilities: graph data modeling plus a traversal query language such as SAP HANA Graph, Cypher/Neo4j, Gremlin, or SPARQL, and the judgment to know when a graph model is genuinely the right tool.

• Expert SQL, including execution plan analysis and optimization of complex analytical and transactional queries.

• Experience with data replication and integration into HANA from source systems, and a realistic view of how those pipelines fail.

• Strong grasp of relational and dimensional modeling, normalization trade-offs, and safe schema evolution.

• Proficiency in at least one application language (TypeScript/JavaScript or Python ) for building services and tooling around the data layer.

• Database security and multi-tenant data isolation experience.

• Clear communication and a genuine habit of documenting data models for other engineers.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

• SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) experience, including the Cloud Application Programming (CAP) model and HDI containers.

• Working knowledge of SAP SD and MM data structures and order-to-cash processes.

• Experience with the HANA Cloud vector engine, spatial engine, or machine learning libraries (PAL/APL).

• Graph algorithms at scale: pathfinding, centrality, community detection, or graph-based recommendation.

• Knowledge graph, ontology, or RDF modeling experience.

• Experience supporting machine learning feature pipelines or search indexing from the data layer.

• CI/CD for database artifacts using tools, particularly HDI deployment pipelines.

• Containerization and Kubernetes experience.

• SAP HANA certification.

Ready to apply? Please upload your resume in English.
DataXstream Inc., is an equal-opportunity workplace and an affirmative-action employer. We are always committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. Discrimination is not welcome on the basis of any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we work.

postings.descriptionText:
Role Title: Legal & Compliance Expert
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote, global

Opportunity Snapshot
Pay: Up to $90/hour equivalent.
Time per task: ~10 hours per task
Engagement: Project-based — paid per approved task
Location: Fully remote — no geographic restrictions. Strong English required (B2 minimum, C1 preferred)
Next step: Complete the role-specific AI interview — it’s how your expertise gets in front of the client
Your tasks: Design realistic, multi-step legal and compliance tasks with objective criteria for grading the output
micro1 is engaging experienced legal and compliance practitioners to design the tasks that measure what AI systems can actually do. Your domain knowledge is what matters here — no prior AI experience required.
The work is to turn real legal workflows into benchmark tasks: realistic, difficult, and gradable against objective criteria. If you’ve built a review checklist, marked up a junior associate’s draft, or trained a team against a compliance standard, that’s the instinct this needs.

Scope of Work

• Design multi-step tasks drawn from real legal and compliance work — contract review, due diligence, regulatory assessment, risk analysis — with realistic reference files and clear instructions.

• Define objective grading criteria so two qualified reviewers would reach the same verdict on the same output.

• Build tasks that require judgment rather than lookup: ones where the right answer depends on reading the materials correctly.

• Create or source the supporting materials each task needs: agreements, policy documents, regulatory texts, diligence files.

• Flag tasks that turn out to be ambiguous or ungradable instead of submitting them anyway.

• Deliver approved tasks on schedule and at the required quality level.

Preferred Qualifications

• 5+ years of hands-on responsibility in contract review, due diligence, regulatory compliance, or risk — direct ownership of the work, not supervisory-only or adjacent exposure.

• Experience creating or applying structured review standards: review checklists, diligence protocols, compliance frameworks, playbooks, or training assessments.

• Comfortable reasoning across multiple documents at once and spotting inconsistencies between them.

• Law degree and bar admission, or equivalent compliance qualification, is a plus but not required — practitioner experience is what matters.

• Strong English, written and spoken — B2 minimum, C1 preferred.

• AI or LLM evaluation experience is a plus, but not required.

How the selection process works

• Apply and complete the screening questions

• Complete the AI interview — this is how we showcase your expertise to the client

• Profile review

• Onboarding — our Talent Ops team will get you set up

• 8+ years engineering substantial full-stack web codebases live in production, including ownership of systems at scale and experience understanding how frontend, backend, APIs, data, and infrastructure connect.

• 3+ years providing technical leadership for small engineering teams (3-6 engineers) on business-critical projects, including mentoring, technical direction, hiring support, and growing the effectiveness of other engineers. Direct people management is not required.

• 5+ years designing and shipping complex distributed systems, including API design, microservices integration, performance-critical architectures, and meaningful production ownership.

• Strong foundations in Computer Science, software engineering, and structured problem solving.

• Fluency with Internet web technologies and modern full-stack web application technology stacks. Backend language experience may include Node, Python, Java, .NET, or equivalent technologies.

• Familiar with best practices for DevOps, observability, testing, and quality practices for effective and efficient delivery.

• Experience with consumer internet applications and the ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes are strongly desired.

• Able to adjust calendar for meetings with Europe. Eastern Time location is preferred.

• Appreciation for consumer experience, visual aesthetics, and product quality is preferred.

• Comfortable in a fast-paced, distributed, and asynchronous engineering environment. Startup or high-ownership product experience is preferred.

• Advanced English Level is required for this role as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

•
Nice to have: Experience with 3D graphics technologies is a plus, but prior 3D development experience is not required. Experience building consumer retail e-commerce applications.

Global Impact, Local Culture 🌍

For over 25 years, we’ve been shaping digital transformation, delivering complex solutions for global enterprises and public sector organizations. Today, we are at the forefront of an AI-driven transformation era, helping organizations turn data into real business value. By combining deep domain expertise with data and AI, we design solutions that create immediate impact while scaling for the future.
We believe complexity doesn’t have to mean complicated, and that the best solutions are those that work in the real world, not just on paper. That’s why our clients trust us with their most ambitious, business-critical initiatives.
Apply now and let’s shape the future of technology together! 🧑‍💻

Headquartered in Davis, California, we are a global company with team members working remotely around the world to support a follow-the-sun operating model. We are looking for talented professionals ready to live our values of empathy, rigor, and innovation.

Job Overview
The Alternative Formats Quality Coordinator develops, implements, and manages quality assurance processes for accessible communications and alternative-format deliverables.
The role ensures that materials produced by external vendors meet client requirements, applicable accessibility standards, and Avantpage quality expectations.
Working closely with Project Managers, clients, vendors, and internal quality teams, this role reviews and improves the quality of accessible PDFs and electronic text, large print in 18-point Arial, Grade 2 Braille, and audio in CD/MP3 or equivalent formats.

The position serves as Avantpage 's subject-matter expert on document accessibility and alternative-format quality, supporting consistent, compliant, and scalable delivery.
The position focuses on quality oversight and vendor management rather than production or remediation.

Reviews are primarily digital. It performs direct QA when an output can be meaningfully evaluated with the available expertise and tools. For specialized, tactile, audio, or language-dependent deliverables that cannot be independently reviewed in full, the coordinator validates the vendor's QA process, evidence, qualifications, and sign-off before acceptance. External vendors remain responsible for production and any required hard-copy proofs or physical delivery.
This role may also participate in client meetings to clarify quality requirements, explain review approaches and findings, and support the resolution of accessibility-related concerns.

Duties and Responsibilities

• Establish, document, and maintain quality assurance standards, procedures, checklists, evaluation criteria, and acceptance requirements for accessible communications and alternative-format projects.

• For Braille, audio, tactile, language-dependent, or other specialized outputs that cannot be fully reviewed in-house, evaluate and document the vendor's QA methodology, reviewer qualifications, test results, sampling evidence, and formal sign-off.

• Review vendor deliverables and supporting quality documentation to determine whether client, contractual, regulatory, and Avantpage requirements have been met before acceptance.

• Conduct accessibility and usability testing using industry-standard validation tools, screen readers, and assistive technologies; document defects clearly and consistently.

• Maintain current knowledge of evolving accessibility regulations, standards, testing methodologies, assistive technologies, and industry best practices.

Skills and Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accessibility, Digital Publishing, Communications, Linguistics, Quality Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 2+ years of experience in accessibility quality assurance, document accessibility, digital publishing, accessible content, or a related field.

• Strong working knowledge of WCAG, PDF/UA, document accessibility principles, and manual and automated accessibility-testing methodologies.

• Hands-on experience reviewing accessible documents, applying structured QA checklists, documenting defects, and validating corrections or acceptance criteria.

• Ability to determine when direct review is possible and when quality must be validated through a specialized vendor's documented process, credentials, evidence, and sign-off.

That means real segmentation, not the same email sent to everyone. A solo agent in Lisbon and a 40-office network in Madrid don't need the same message. You get agents onto the app, push self-serve purchases through the dashboard, design offers that convert, and use content and every relevant channel to move them along.
2027 is the year we build and test the engine. 2028 is the year we scale it.
You set the strategy and you run it. You own the budget, get hands-on when needed, and lead the people who help you execute. You report to the CPO.

What you'll do

• Set the B2B growth strategy. Segments, markets, channels, offers, budget. Defend every euro with numbers.

• Segment the base for real. Office size, market, plan, activity, behavior. Each segment gets its own path.

• Design offers that convert. Plans, bundles, promotions, timing. Test them. Kill the losers.

• Make the app the agent's daily tool. Installs, adoption, weekly use. Move agents from desktop to mobile and keep them there.

• Grow monthly active users. Give agents reasons to come back. Leads, insights, alerts, content.

• Use every relevant channel. Email, push, in-app, content, webinars, paid, partnerships. Pick by segment, not by habit.

• Run experiments. Onboarding, messaging, offers, pricing. Fast cycles, clear reads.

• Work with sales and customer success. Self-serve for the long tail, humans for the big accounts. Hand them the right accounts at the right time.

• Work with product. Push for what moves activation and conversion. Bring evidence, not opinions.

• Lead the people who execute. Set their goals, review the work, raise the bar.

• Build the playbooks as Claude skills, so the team and the agents can run them.

• Talk to agents. Read the data yourself.

What we're looking for

• B2B growth track record. You've grown a B2B or SMB product with thousands of customers, largely self-serve. Real numbers, real graph. Show us. SaaS for small businesses, marketplace, or portal experience is a strong plus. Real estate is a bonus, not a requirement.

• Lifecycle and segmentation. You think in cohorts, segments, and lifecycles, not campaigns. The cheapest customer is the one already in your database.

• Self-serve monetization. You've moved users from free to paid through the product. You know your activation, conversion, expansion, and churn by segment.

• Multichannel range. You've owned several channels and have strong opinions on the rest. Single-channel specialists won't fit.

• Mobile adoption. You've driven app adoption with a professional audience. You know what makes a busy agent open an app twice.

• Product sense. You know how product changes move conversion. You bring PMs and designers evidence, not opinions.

• Strategist and operator. You build the plan and you run it. You've owned a budget and answered for the return. You set up the flow and pull the numbers yourself. No agency in between.

• Clarity. You explain things simply. You don't hide weak results behind charts.

• Languages. Fluent English. French or Spanish is a plus.

What we don't care about

• Where your degree is from. Bachelor preferred, not required. Track record beats papers.

• How polished your LinkedIn is. We read what you've shipped.

• Whether you've worked at a brand we recognize. The best operators we've met came from companies you haven't heard of.

Remote. Anywhere within +/- 3h of CET.

• Budget to test now, and a bigger one to scale in 2028.

• The AI stack you'd struggle to build elsewhere. Claude (Cowork and Code), Mixpanel, HubSpot. All paid for.

Multichannel range. You've owned several channels and have strong opinions on the rest. Single-channel ads specialists won't fit.

App growth. You've driven installs and, more importantly, retention. You know what makes people open an app twice.

Database mindset. You think in cohorts and lifecycles, not campaigns. The cheapest user is the one you already have.

Product sense. You know how product changes move conversion. You bring PMs and designers evidence, not opinions.

postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

Disclaimer: We're currently on the lookout for potential candidates to join our talent pool via this job listing. Your qualifications will be assessed for both present positions and future opportunities. Should your skills align with a role and an opening arise, our recruitment team will reach out to you promptly. However, please keep in mind that this doesn't guarantee immediate placement or communication.

A day in the life:
A Creative Strategist will be the lead ideator on strategic accounts. They are required to have a robust understanding of paid social creative best practices, their client’s brand, performance goals, historical data, current ecommerce trends, and consumer behavior, to develop winning paid social advertising that impacts their client's growth.
Creative Strategists know how to act fast to capitalize on good results, or on the flip side know what to change if an ad isn’t performing to their goal. This means testing with the intention of moving the needle on key performance metrics — from improving CPA, CTR, or ROAS to driving brand awareness. Creative Strategists pitch new ideas and concepts to clients, write scripts, and follow the execution and review of ads through to production and delivery to clients.
An ideal candidate for the Creative Strategist role is a self-starter who is passionate about maximizing success for their clients through creative strategy, and is eager to take the lead on developing creative concepts that are intentionally produced to generate clear testing results and insights. They have mastered presenting creative reporting to clients and team members through storytelling, and are constantly implementing learnings to enhance future campaign results. Sr. Creative Strategists are zealous about continuously testing various creative concepts to develop a strong understanding of how to not only effectively and efficiently meet client goals, but to surpass them. If creative deliveries are not meeting client expectations, or creative tests are not hitting target goals, Sr. Creative Strategists will be relentless in the pursuit to troubleshoot and problem solve with a growth mindset.

Key Responsibilities:

• Leads the paid social creative strategy for 8-10 clients

• Using data insights along with consumer and brand research to design high performing creative assets

• Collaborating closely with team members across internal departments and roles

• Maintaining client communications and sentiment

• Driven to iterate and ideate towards stated performance goals

• Develops rapport with client to build a foundation of open discussion, including understanding client product and goals, as well as explaining Power Digital processes

• Researches client brand, competitors, and industry trends, and effectively implements performance creative best practices by platform

• Continually audits account to identify winning ads, present data to client, and dictate hypotheses and test strategy via monthly roadmaps

• Writes strategic consumer-centric, direct response copy and messaging strategy

• Manages requests and output with production team using Asana

• Reviews video/image assets and provides clear and actionable feedback to editors

• Leads productive internal creative team syncs and brainstorms

• Works alongside client management team as client POC for all things creative strategy

• Understands scope of requested edits, reshoots, and other deliverables

• Pushes back on client on matters of timeline, scope, feedback, and direction to drive performance based on creative best practices

• Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes

• Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Role Requirements:

• Proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, and/or similar performance data tools (TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, etc)

• Technically skilled at pulling and using creative performance data to analyze trends, insights, and inform creative roadmaps

• Understanding of best practices for performance-driven creative & ability to apply these insights in work

• Ability to write effective ad copy, structure a script, and see through on the execution with corresponding visuals

• Ability to communicate and collaborate with clients, production, and post-production teams to deliver best possible creative output

• Ability to yield strong campaign results for clients through strategizing top performing creative

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• 5% or lower client churn

• Manage 8-10 mid level clients

• Maintain $22,000 RPE

Most Important Things (MITs)

• Technically skilled at pulling and using creative performance data to analyze trends and insights and inform the creative roadmap.

• Responsible for using data insights along with consumer and brand research to orchestrate a sales/messaging/visual strategy.

You will be the operational point of contact for tenants, vendors, and contractors — managing maintenance coordination, rent collection follow-ups, leasing support, move-ins and move-outs, and all the documentation and communication that keeps a multi-property portfolio running cleanly.
This role has a hard language requirement. You must be fully fluent in both English and Spanish, written and spoken. If you are highly organized, genuinely bilingual, comfortable handling difficult conversations professionally, and take pride in keeping operations tight across multiple moving parts, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

• You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)

•
Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy

• Observance of Holidays per company guidelines

•
100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive

• This role requires availability during US Pacific Time business hours

• Work directly with ownership on a growing residential portfolio with real operational ownership

• Stable, long-term role with clear responsibilities and room to grow as the portfolio scales

What You'll Work On

Tenant Communication and Support

• Respond to tenant inquiries via phone, text, email, and WhatsApp in both English and Spanish

• Handle difficult tenant conversations professionally and with a solutions-first approach

• Communicate with Section 8 and Housing Authority representatives as needed

• Assist with leasing coordination and tenant screening

Maintenance and Vendor Coordination

• Coordinate maintenance requests and follow up with vendors and contractors through to resolution

• Track open work orders and ensure nothing falls through the cracks

• Help source and manage vendors for repairs and renovations

• Escalate urgent property issues quickly and keep ownership informed

Leasing and Turnover Operations

• Coordinate move-ins, move-outs, inspections, and unit turnovers

• Assist with rent collection and payment follow-ups

• Maintain organized property records, leases, invoices, and tenant documentation

Systems, Reporting, and Automation

• Keep property management software, spreadsheets, and internal systems accurate and up to date

• Support ownership with operational reporting and administrative tasks

• Apply a fundamental understanding of multi-entity accounting including tracking income, expenses, intercompany transactions, and financial activity across multiple LLCs and properties

• Use AI tools and automation platforms to improve efficiency and streamline recurring workflows

What You Bring

• Full professional fluency in both English and Spanish, written and spoken — this is a non-negotiable requirement

• Prior experience in property management, real estate operations, or a closely related role

• Fundamental understanding of multi-entity accounting and tracking financial activity across multiple properties or business entities

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills with the ability to manage multiple open items simultaneously without dropping the ball

• Excellent communication and follow-through across phone, text, email, and messaging platforms

• Comfortable handling difficult tenant conversations professionally and calmly

• Experience coordinating maintenance vendors and contractors

• Tech-savvy with the ability to learn new systems quickly

• Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional work environment

• Available to work during US Pacific Time business hours

Nice to Have

• Experience with DoorLoop, Buildium, or similar property management software

• Experience working with Section 8 or affordable housing programs

• Experience managing remote vendors or contractors across multiple properties

• Familiarity with Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Airtable, or ClickUp

• Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT to improve workflows and reporting

How to Apply

Please include:

• Your updated resume

• A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself in both English and Spanish, describing your property management or real estate operations experience, and walking through how you handle a maintenance coordination issue or difficult tenant conversation end to end

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.
If you are bilingual, highly organized, and want to own the operations of a growing residential portfolio with real accountability and direct access to ownership, this role gives you the structure and the trust to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Application Process Overview
Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

•
Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions

•
Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience

•
Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)

•
Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team

•
Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment

•
Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting

•
Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification

•
Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

postings.title: Head of Regulatory Affairs-Europe ( Digital Assets & Fintech exposure)
postings.descriptionText:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fuelling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Tether and its affiliated entities (e.g. Bitfinex) are searching for an organized self-starter to join our Regulatory and Licensing team, to lead efforts in the European Union. The successful candidate is someone with an understanding of the regulatory environment pertaining to the crypto-asset industry / stablecoin industry in the Union, as well as broader legislation pertaining to topics such as communication technology and artificial intelligence, and who is excited by the opportunity to apply their existing regulatory affairs and / or legal experience in an exciting and dynamic business environment.
To succeed in this role, the incumbent will continuously strive to self-develop and enhance their skill sets including understanding the Company’s products and services, blockchain technology, and regulatory requirements.
You will have a focus around working with regulators to translate policy objectives of the companies into favourable regulatory requirements in the region, as part of enabling the broader business strategy across Tether’s business verticals.
The successful candidate should be comfortable managing relationships and communications between various stakeholders both internal and external to the business, including regulators and policy setters, as well as working with cross-functional teams such as Operations, Finance, Technology, Business Development.
You will report to the Vice President of the Regulatory and Licensing division, and work alongside project managers and members of the wider business to execute on regulatory affairs initiatives.

Responsibilities

Regulatory Affairs

• Maintain proactive relationships with policymakers, regulators, central banks, and financial intelligence units relevant to the Company’s product and service lines.

• Monitor regulatory developments impacting Tether and affiliates companies in the country.

• Represent the company in consultations, workshops, industry roundtables, and regulatory dialogues.

• Prepare briefing papers, comment letters, and policy submissions aligned with broader global regulatory strategy.

• Identify and successfully realise opportunities to shape emerging frameworks in a risk-sensitive, innovation-oriented manner.

Strategy & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Provide actionable risk and regulatory insights to internal stakeholders (legal, product, compliance, risk, commercial).

• Support enterprise-level planning for new products or expansions into the aforementioned countries, advising on regulatory constraints and enablers.

• Contribute to internal reporting and executive briefings on policy risks and regulatory trajectory regionally

• Minimum of 8 years governmental affairs / regulatory affairs / legal experience ideally within the financial services or crypto-asset industry in the EU, preferably Brussels based.

• Fintech or Digital assets exposure is important

• Experience engaging with regulators or government bodies advocating and advising in a regulatory capacity, with demonstrated achievements securing favourable policy positions on behalf of another organisation.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesise complex regulatory topics for non-technical audiences.

• Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders across borders and time zones.

• Communication: Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with experience in public speaking and representing companies in regulatory discussions.

• Must be a strong team player, and willing to be fully engaged with key stakeholders both in our company but also with our partners. Must be a hands-on professional capable of working collaboratively and independently.

• English speaking.

• Location: preferred location Brussels ( but open to other EU locations as well)

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

postings.title: OrioleDB Developer (AMER)
postings.descriptionText:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.



About the role

We're looking for an engineer to drive the evolution of OrioleDB and its collaboration with the upstream PostgreSQL community. OrioleDB is a next-generation storage engine for PostgreSQL, and this role sits at the intersection of database internals, open source community work, and Supabase's managed Postgres platform.

This role requires strong working overlap with Americas time zones due to production support and on-call responsibilities.

What you'll work on



• 
New OrioleDB features. Design and implement new capabilities in OrioleDB — for example, native index access methods (GiST, GIN, HNSW for pgvector), disaster recovery tooling, and other storage-engine-level features that expand what OrioleDB can do.




• 
Stability. Strengthen OrioleDB's reliability through deeper test coverage, fault injection, crash and recovery testing, and improvements to CI infrastructure. Ensure regressions are caught early and that OrioleDB behaves predictably under stress, replication, and failure scenarios.




• 
Upstream collaboration. Contribute changes directly to PostgreSQL core. Part of OrioleDB lives as a patch on top of PostgreSQL — moving the right pieces upstream shrinks what we maintain ourselves and benefits the wider community. This happens through PostgreSQL's open development process: the pgsql-hackers mailing list, public code review, and commitfests.




• 
Supabase integration. Work with Supabase's Postgres team to ensure OrioleDB fits naturally into Supabase's managed offering and roadmap.






You Will:



• 
Design, implement, and test new OrioleDB features and integrate them cleanly with PostgreSQL's planner, executor, and surrounding subsystems.




• 
Build out and maintain test infrastructure: regression suites, fuzzing, randomized testing, crash and recovery testing, and CI pipelines.




• 
Identify and prepare patches suitable for upstreaming to PostgreSQL core.




• 
Improve performance, resilience, monitoring, and operational tooling for production use.




• 
Debug and resolve complex issues in low-level C code, including in storage, replication, indexing, and query execution paths.




• 
Participate in design discussions, architecture reviews, and code reviews — both inside Supabase and in the PostgreSQL community.




• 
Write clear technical documentation, design notes, and upstream proposals.




• 
Contribute to troubleshooting, analyzing, supporting and maintaining OrioleDB in production deployments. This can include answering support ticket requests, an on-call rotation, and supporting our team members in troubleshooting and fixing live customer production databases.






You Are:



• 
An existing PostgreSQL core contributor or have equivalent experience in Database internals.




• 
An expert C programmer with 8+ years of production experience with focus on low-level systems programming




• 
Deeply familiar with PostgreSQL’s codebase, build system, and extension APIs.




• 
Have experience designing or implementing database storage engines, index structures, or query execution components.




• 
Comfortable contributing to community‑driven, upstream open source projects.




• 
Proficient in debugging and profiling complex C code in a database context.




• 
Able to write clear technical documentation and explain design trade‑offs.




• 
A strong communicator, committed to an open and collaborative development process.






What We Offer



• 
Fully Remote

We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.




• 
ESOP

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.




• 
Tech Allowance

Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.




• 
Health Benefits

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.




• 
Annual Off-Sites

Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.




• 
Flexible Work

We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.




• 
Professional Development

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.







About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.



• 
~400 team members




• 
60+ countries




• 
20+ languages spoken




• 
Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)




• 
540,000+ community members





We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

postings.title: Staff Engineer, Full Stack (Trust, Safety & Risk)
postings.descriptionText:
Phantom is on a mission to connect the world to the freedom of open markets. Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide.

Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Phantom partners with many of the most trusted and influential names in finance like Hyperliquid, Stripe, Kalshi and Visa, to make the most popular and innovative financial products accessible to everyone.

We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm.


Responsibilities

As a Trust, Risk & Safety Engineer at Phantom, you’ll build the systems that safeguard our users, products, and platform. Working across the stack, you’ll detect and prevent abuse, assess emerging risks, reduce financial loss, and equip internal teams with the tools and intelligence needed to respond quickly and effectively. The ideal candidate brings high agency, a strong sense of ownership, exceptional technical judgment and product taste, a relentless work ethic, and the emotional intelligence to navigate complex, high-stakes situations.



• 
Fraud prevention: Build real-time risk controls and decisioning systems for products such as ACH, debit cards, onramps, off-ramps, and other money movement experiences.




• 
Scam and abuse detection: Develop signals, models, and product interventions that identify malicious wallets, transactions, applications, and user behavior.




• 
Identity and compliance infrastructure: Build scalable KYC, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, case management, and audit systems.




• 
Data and intelligence: Create pipelines and tools that combine on-chain activity, product data, and third-party signals into actionable risk insights.




• 
Product safety: Partner with product and engineering teams to design safeguards into new features from the beginning without compromising the user experience.




• 
Operational tooling: Build internal tools that help Risk, Compliance, Support, and Security teams investigate incidents and take action efficiently.




• 
Team building: Help establish the technical foundations and engineering culture for a new, high-impact function at Phantom.





Qualifications



• 
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience




• 
8+ years of full-time software engineering experience




• 
Experience designing and operating reliable, data-intensive production systems




• 
Strong product judgment and the ability to balance user experience, financial risk, and operational complexity




• 
Ability to work across frontend, backend, APIs, data pipelines, and third-party integrations




• 
Demonstrated interest in protecting users and building trustworthy financial products




• 
Nice to have: Experience with fraud, risk, identity, KYC, AML, sanctions, payments, fintech, or blockchain systems




• 
English language proficiency






Why Work with Us



• 
First impressions matter: Wallets are responsible for a users first impression with crypto and onboarding new users into crypto. By ensuring that a user has a great first-time experience with crypto, we can help supercharge the growth of the entire ecosystem.




•

You'll bring real expertise in mobile performance marketing and user acquisition to that process. The opportunity could eventually span attribution and measurement, products built on top of existing acquisition channels, new ways to optimize spend using downstream monetization data, partnerships, advertising infrastructure, or things we haven't considered yet. We have hypotheses, but we're hiring you in part because we want your perspective on which ones are worth pursuing.

RevenueCat has some unusual advantages to build from: relationships with a large ecosystem of app developers, deep visibility into subscription and monetization outcomes, infrastructure already embedded in apps, and a growing advertising business. The challenge is figuring out how those assets can translate into something uniquely valuable for developers trying to grow.

About you:

•
You have 5+ years of experience owning meaningful product or growth decisions end-to-end. Your title may have been Product Manager, founder, growth leader, or something else — what's important is that you've been accountable for deciding what to build and whether it worked.

•
You have deep, hands-on experience with mobile user acquisition—either directly managing and optimizing acquisition for mobile apps, or building products and infrastructure used by mobile acquisition teams. You understand how app developers actually acquire users, measure performance, and make decisions about where to spend their next dollar.

•
You understand the modern mobile acquisition stack, including MMPs and attribution, Apple Ads, Meta and Google advertising products, conversion APIs, and related measurement infrastructure.

•
You can reason clearly about attribution, performance-marketing economics, and privacy. You understand concepts such as CAC, LTV, ROAS, optimization signals, ATT, SKAdNetwork/AdAttributionKit, consent management, and how downstream behavior should influence acquisition decisions.

•
You thrive in zero-to-one environments. You can take a large, ambiguous opportunity, identify the most important unanswered questions, narrow it into product bets, and find pragmatic ways to test those bets before making large investments.

•
You are sufficiently technical to work closely with engineering on integrations, APIs, SDKs, data flows, identity, attribution, and other technical product decisions.

•
You communicate clearly across different audiences and media, particularly in writing.

In the first month, you'll:

•
Spend significant time with developers understanding how they acquire users today, how they evaluate acquisition performance, and where the process is painful, expensive, fragmented, or opaque.

•
Build a deep understanding of RevenueCat's existing acquisition-related products, integrations, data, customer research, and technical capabilities.

•
Build strong working relationships with engineering, design, data, go-to-market, and other product teams whose work intersects with user acquisition.

•
Develop a clear picture of the acquisition ecosystem, the problems RevenueCat is particularly well positioned to solve, and the biggest assumptions we still need to test.

•
Begin forming your own point of view on where RevenueCat could create differentiated value in user acquisition.

Within the first 3 months, you'll:

•
Have narrowed the broad user acquisition opportunity into a small number of concrete product hypotheses, grounded in customer research, market understanding, and RevenueCat's unique advantages.

•
Have a clear recommendation for where we should focus first — and why.

•
Begin validating that direction through prototypes, design partners, technical exploration, lightweight product experiments, or an initial shippable bet.

•
Establish a learning agenda that makes the biggest risks and unanswered questions explicit, and gives us a fast path to increasing or decreasing our conviction.

•
Align senior stakeholders around what we're testing, what we're not pursuing yet, and what evidence would cause us to change direction.

Within the first 6 months, you'll:

•
Have shipped our first substantive user acquisition product bet, or generated enough evidence to decisively change or stop it before making a larger investment.

•
Have real evidence from the market about where RevenueCat can — and cannot — create differentiated value.

•
Be independently driving product discovery, prioritization, and execution for the user acquisition area.

•
Have developed an evidence-backed point of view on the most promising opportunities in the space and what capabilities RevenueCat would need to pursue them.

•
Have turned a broad strategic opportunity into an increasingly focused product direction.

Within the first 12 months, you'll:

•
Have established a clear strategic direction for RevenueCat in user acquisition, supported by customer behavior and product evidence rather than thesis alone.

•
Have shipped meaningful products or experiments that either created measurable value for developers or materially changed our understanding of the opportunity—including changing or killing bets when the evidence didn’t support them.

•
Have a credible longer-term roadmap for turning the strongest early signals into a meaningful RevenueCat product area.

•
Be the primary IC product owner for User Acquisition and the internal domain expert on how app developers acquire, measure, and optimize users.

Have helped define how RevenueCat's monetization data, developer footprint, and advertising capabilities can work together to create a differentiated position in app growth.

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

We’re building a high-performance CI/CD execution platform similar to runners used by tools like Buildkite, GitHub Actions, and Blacksmith CI. Our platform executes developer pipelines reliably at scale, integrates deeply with source control, and automates build, test, and deployment workflows.

In this role, you will design and build the distributed systems responsible for running CI/CD pipelines securely and efficiently. This includes orchestrating ephemeral compute environments, managing build isolation, scheduling jobs across fleets of workers, and ensuring reliability at scale.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

•
Design and improve the core orchestration engine that manages the lifecycle of creating, merging, and rebasing Supabase Branches .

•
Provision ephemeral sandboxed execution environment on EKS / ECS for running untrusted build workloads from connected git repositories with securely managed secrets.

•
Implement job scheduling that scale to thousands of concurrent builds.

•
Optimize and reduce pipeline runtimes with caching, artifact storage, and dependency reuse.

•
Manage retry, timeout, cancellation, and failure-propagation logic to ensure pipelines behave predictably under failure conditions.

•
Instrument the full pipeline lifecycle with observability tooling to surface traces, metrics, and structured logs to the end user.

•
Develop configuration files (JSON / TOML) and integrations (Terraform / Pulumi) that allow teams to easily define, trigger, and inspect pipelines in code.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

•
Have strong software engineering skills (Go and Typescript required);

•
Have 3+ years of experience building and operating cloud infrastructure or distributed systems at scale;

•
Have cloud Infrastructure knowledge - familiarity with AWS constructs is required, past experience using the AWS SDKs and IaC tools (Pulumi, Terraform, etc) to build and operate infrastructure is strongly preferred.

•
Have a production operations mindset - track record of building reliable, observable, and maintainable systems

•
Have an ownership mindset - you thrive in being able to operate independently with high-level guidance

•
Communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences

•
Have experience in async or globally distributed teams

•
Are energized by solving real-world problems for developers

•
Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly

Fully Remote

We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

•
ESOP

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

•
Tech Allowance

Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

Health Benefits

Annual Off-Sites

Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

Flexible Work

We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

•
Professional Development

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

~400 team members

60+ countries

•
20+ languages spoken

•
Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

•
540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

The TAM Leader owns the coverage model for the entire function — deciding, tracking, and refreshing who is assigned where, and closing gaps as they surface. This includes the two account universes the role is accountable for:

•
Named accounts — the full book currently ~$33.1M ARR across 120 accounts split across the team, capped at 20 accounts per TAM

•
Partner-mapped accounts — every partner with a named Technical Account Manager spanning Strategic AI, Growth, and Other tiers

•
Running the quarterly review/refresh of assigned accounts, rebalancing books as ARR and strategic relationships shift

•
Resolving open coverage gaps (e.g. regions or account types with no TAM alignment) and deciding when a controlled exception, a new hire, or a change in tier definition is the right fix

•
Approving leadership-discretion assignments and cap exceptions, and making the trim/reassign calls when an account is dropped for capacity

Customer Technical Ownership (oversight)

The TAM Leader ensures every assigned account — named or partner-mapped — has a clear, accountable technical owner. They spot-check account documentation, architecture understanding, and risk tracking across the book, and step in directly on the most strategic or highest-risk accounts.

Onboarding and Adoption (oversight)

The TAM Leader ensures the team consistently shortens time to value for new accounts by:

•
Auditing that architecture and deployment validation is happening post-sale, not skipped

•
Coaching TAMs on configuration guidance and best-practice delivery

•
Tracking early success milestones across the portfolio, not just account by account

Proactive Technical Guidance (oversight)

The TAM Leader ensures environment reviews and risk/optimization surfacing happen on a regular cadence across the whole book, covering scalability, reliability, security, and lifecycle planning — and holds the team accountable when reviews lapse.

Issue Management and Escalation

The TAM Leader is the escalation layer above the individual TAM — brought in on complex, high-impact, or multi-stakeholder issues rather than replacing the TAM as primary contact. This includes:

•
Coordinating across support, engineering, and success during major incidents

•
Owning execution of the Named Account Escalation SLA sequence when it's triggered

•
Ensuring root cause analysis and preventative action actually close out, not just the immediate fire

•
Isolating TAMs from technical repair work so they can stay focused on the relationship while the right team handles the fix

Strategic Technical Planning (oversight)

The TAM Leader ensures account plans across the book stay aligned to customer roadmaps, and personally engages on capacity, architecture, or growth planning for the largest or most strategic accounts and partners.

Internal Collaboration

Engineering and Product

The TAM Leader represents the aggregated voice of the customer — patterns across accounts, not just one-off feedback — to engineering and product, and prioritizes which recurring pain points or gaps get pushed for a fix versus handled as one-offs.

Support

The TAM Leader maintains the operating agreement between TAM and Support (TAMs are not frontline support) and is the point of escalation when that boundary needs adjudicating on a specific account.

Sales and Customer Success

The TAM Leader partners with Sales and Success leadership on account health and retention at the portfolio level — surfacing which accounts or partners are trending at risk, and where TAM coverage itself needs to change to protect NRR.

Partnerships

Because the TAM Leader owns the Technical Account Manager assignments inside the Partner Mappings, they work directly with each partner's Account Quarterback, Partner Manager, and Solutions Architect to make sure the technical relationship keeps pace with partner stage (Prospecting through Scaling) and tier (Strategic AI, Growth, Other) — while staying out of commercial terms, which live with the Partner Manager.

Success Metrics

Common indicators of TAM Leader effectiveness include:

•
Coverage: % of the $33.1M+ named-account book and partner-mapped accounts with an assigned, active TAM

•
Team health: ramp time to productivity for new TAMs, retention of the TAM team itself

•
Customer adoption and usage depth across the book

•
Reduction in critical incidents and time to resolution for escalated issues, portfolio-wide

•
Customer satisfaction and retention (NRR) across named and partner-mapped accounts

•
Consistency: QBR completion rate and account plan quality across the team, not just top performers

Tools Used by the TAM Team

This section documents the tools and systems used by the Technical Account Management team. It is intended to be kept up to date as tooling evolves.

•
Admin Studio

•
Grafana

•
Hex

•
pgAdmin

•
HubSpot (account ARR, tier, and health data)

•
Notion — Draft TAM Accounts doc and Partner Mappings database

Scope of Coverage

The TAM Leader is accountable for the full combined book the function covers, not a single portfolio:

•
Named accounts — every account already assigned to one of the individual TAMs, plus resolution of open decisions such as the current APAC coverage gap

•
Partner-mapped accounts — ensuring every partner that warrants a technical relationship has a named TAM against it, and that the mapping stays current as partners move through Stage and Tier

Account Mapping

TAM Standard (Pooled)

•
Spend — For customers at $100K ARR, access to pooled TAM resources for a set (time TBD) hours per month

•
Pooled TAM SKU — Customers of any scale can purchase pooled access to the TAM team (requires Enterprise Support SKU)

•
Leadership Discretion for Customer Needs

TAM Premium (Dedicated)

•
Spend — For customers at $250K ARR, access to a dedicated TAM resource for a set (time TBD) hours per month

•
Dedicated TAM SKU — Customers of any scale can purchase an assigned TAM (requires Enterprise Support SKU)

•
Leadership Discretion for Customer Needs

The TAM Leader owns tier decisions, the quarterly refresh of this mapping, and any leadership-discretion exceptions.

What TAM Leaders Do Not Do

To keep the function focused and scaling, the TAM Leader does not:

•
Replace the individual TAM as an account's day-to-day technical relationship owner — accounts scale by layering support on, not by handing off

•
Perform day-to-day operational work for customers

•
Own or negotiate commercial terms for either named accounts or partner deals — that stays with the AE or Partner Manager

•
Act as professional services for custom implementations

•
Manage frontline support case queues

Ideal Individual

A world-class Technical Account Manager Leader at Supabase has done the individual TAM job well and now wants to multiply it across a team.

•
Technical depth — Same bar as an individual TAM: can go deep on database internals, scalability, security posture, and infrastructure tradeoffs, and can still credibly work a strategic account directly when needed

•
People leadership — Has hired, coached, and grown a technical team before; gives direct, specific feedback and knows how to develop someone from good to great

•
Portfolio-level judgment — Can look across 100+ accounts and a partner book and tell where coverage is thin, where an account should move tiers, and where to spend leadership discretion

•
Escalation command — Comfortable being the senior voice in a high-severity, multi-stakeholder incident, coordinating support, engineering, and success without adding noise

•
Cross-functional influence at altitude — Represents patterns across the whole book to engineering, product, sales, and partnerships leadership — not just one account's feedback

•
Communication clarity — Can brief an executive on portfolio health and coach a TAM through a root cause analysis in the same day

•
Retention and expansion awareness — Understands that TAM Leader performance shows up in aggregate NRR across the book; proactively rebalances coverage toward the accounts and partners most at risk

•
Experience — Background in engineering, SRE, or technical consulting, plus a track record of leading a technical customer-facing team

Summary

The Technical Account Manager Leader exists to make sure every account and partner relationship the TAM function is accountable for — the full Draft TAM Accounts book and the entire Partner Mappings coverage — has a technical owner, and that the team delivering against it keeps getting better.
