postings.title: Product Expert
postings.descriptionText:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile.

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance.

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

The role:

A developer is getting ready to launch their first subscription app. A growth team wants to improve its paywalls. A founder has heard about Daily Payouts and wants to understand whether it could help. They all reach out to RevenueCat, and they all deserve a useful conversation. You’re that conversation.

As a Product Expert, your job is to understand what someone is trying to accomplish, explain and demo the relevant parts of RevenueCat, and help them take a sensible next step. Sometimes that means helping them get started themselves. Sometimes it means bringing in an Account Executive, a Sales Engineer, Support, or someone else.

This is a new role at the intersection of inbound sales, product education, and helping developers get started. You’ll own the inbound conversations that don’t go directly to our Account Executives or Sales Engineers, and help us build a great experience for the people behind them.

You might be early in your career, building apps on the side, or looking to turn your product knowledge into a more customer-facing job. You don’t need to have held this exact role before. You do need to know RevenueCat well, enjoy talking to people, and have good judgment about what would actually help them.

We’re initially hiring one person in EMEA and one in the Americas. You’ll initially report to our Sales Engineering lead and learn alongside teammates who have been handling these conversations for years. You’ll also help shape how the Product Expert team works as it grows.

What you’ll be responsible for:

•
Make a great first impression. Respond to inbound interest, run useful discovery conversations, and understand the app, the people building it, their goals, and what they need from us.

•
Turn product knowledge into practical guidance. Give clear demos, answer questions, and connect the relevant parts of RevenueCat to someone’s situation. Help them understand the product, its limits, and what getting started involves.

•
Help straightforward adoption move forward. Guide people through the next steps they can take themselves, share useful resources, and follow up so a good conversation turns into progress.

•
Recognize the right next step. Bring qualified commercial opportunities to an Account Executive and involve a Sales Engineer for deeper technical discovery, complex migrations, or solution design. Connect support questions and people who aren’t ready yet with the appropriate team or follow-up. Understand (and tell people) when RevenueCat is not right for them.

•
Make handoffs easy for the customer. Keep clear notes on goals, requirements, open questions, and next steps. Stay responsible for follow-through until the next owner has picked up the conversation, so the customer doesn’t have to start over.

•
Help us improve the experience. Share recurring questions and feedback with the team. Turn what you learn into better demos, resources, and playbooks, and help us see where conversations or handoffs get stuck.

What you’ll need to be successful:

•
Strong, hands-on knowledge of RevenueCat. You can show how you’ve used the product and explain it in your own words. We care about what you understand and can demonstrate, whether you learned it at work or through your own projects.

•
Curiosity about the app business. You want to understand how developers build products, make money, and grow, and how RevenueCat can help.

•
Clear, friendly communication. You listen carefully, ask useful questions, write concise follow-ups, and explain the same idea differently to a developer, founder, or growth lead.

•
Technical common sense. You’re comfortable discussing SDKs, APIs, subscriptions, and paywalls at a practical level. You can recognize when a question needs an engineer and bring them in with useful context.

•
Commercial common sense. You can spot a promising opportunity, understand why timing and fit matter, and recommend a useful next step without making every conversation a pitch.

•
Ownership and follow-through. You can manage several conversations, keep your notes and commitments straight, and make sure people hear back from you.

•
The ability to work remotely and keep learning. You communicate proactively, ask for help when you need it, and can work hours that meaningfully overlap with customers and teammates in your region.

We’re more interested in your product knowledge, judgment, and helpfulness than a particular degree, job title, or number of years on your résumé.

Ideally, you:

•
Have built or shipped an app using RevenueCat, including a side project or Shipaton entry.

•
Have helped people through support, community participation, teaching, demos, or another customer-facing role.

•
Have experience with developer tools, subscriptions, or a product with both self-service and sales-assisted customers.

•
Enjoy improving a process or creating a resource that makes the next person’s job easier.

What success looks like:

Within the first month, you’ll:

•
Deepen your RevenueCat knowledge, shadow customer conversations, and learn how Sales, Support, and other parts of the business work together.

•
Start handling conversations with support from the team and learn when to bring in a specialist.

•
Host one of our bi-weekly demo stream, for a live audience of customers and prospects.

Within the first three months, you’ll:

•
Independently run the inbound discovery conversations and demos in your coverage area.

•
Help people get started and make well-qualified handoffs with clear context and next steps.

•
Build a reliable follow-up rhythm and agree with the team how we’ll measure response quality, opportunity progression, and adoption.

Within the first six months, you’ll:

•
Be a trusted source of product guidance for prospects and teammates.

•
Show how your work helps people move from interest to a useful next step, and use feedback and data to improve the experience.

•
Contribute reusable guidance that helps the team handle common questions and situations more effectively.

Within the first twelve months, you’ll:

•
Have helped establish how the Product Expert team runs discovery, demos, follow-up, and handoffs.

•
Help new teammates get up to speed and bring customer insight into how we improve the product and our processes.

•
Be building deeper expertise around your interests and strengths, with a foundation that could lead toward Sales Engineering, Account Executive, or Customer Success work over time.

postings.descriptionText:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile.

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

The role

We’re looking for a GTM Operations Manager to build and improve the workflows that connect our go-to-market teams.

A promising account signs up. Does the right person find out, with enough context to act? A customer becomes eligible for a new product. Do they receive useful guidance? A data sync fails overnight. Do we catch it before it affects a campaign, account handoff, or business decision?

You’ll help make those things work reliably.

You’ll join an existing GTM Operations team, working closely with @Nathan Bellehsen on Salesforce and Sales systems and @Masha Tsaryk on Marketing and customer-lifecycle systems. Your initial focus will be lead handoffs and lifecycle execution: the data, automation, quality checks, and reporting that turn customer signals into useful action.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role. You’ll own agreed projects from understanding the problem through building, testing, rollout, and ongoing improvement. Experienced teammates will provide context, help set priorities, and partner with you on architectural decisions. Within that direction, we expect you to make progress independently and flag problems early.

Our stack includes Salesforce, Customer.io , Clay, Looker, automation tools, and a growing set of AI workflows. You don’t need to know every tool. You do need to understand how systems connect and enjoy figuring out why something isn’t working.

Why we’re hiring for this role now

RevenueCat’s GTM organization is growing across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Growth. We’re developing more deliberate ways to identify promising accounts, help customers adopt our products, and turn successful one-to-one work into programs that reach many more people.

Our operations team already supports the systems behind that work. We need more capacity to take important workflows from “this could work” to something dependable that people use every day.

You’ll help us ship those improvements while making the existing operation easier to run: fewer manual handoffs, clearer ownership, more trustworthy data, and less time spent solving the same problem twice.

What you’ll be responsible for

•
Own selected GTM workflows end-to-end. Translate a business problem into a practical solution, agree how success will be measured, build and test it, and stay responsible after launch.

•
Make lead and account handoffs dependable. Build and improve enrichment, qualification, routing, alerts, and follow-up visibility. Help ensure important signals reach a named owner, and make missed or failed handoffs visible.

•
Put lifecycle programs into production. Partner with Marketing and Customer Growth on audience definitions, triggers, exclusions, data syncs, campaign QA, and measurement. Turn repeatable requests into workflows and templates teammates can use.

•
Keep data connected and usable. Trace how account, contact, and product-usage data moves between systems. Investigate stale records, duplicates, mismatched relationships, and failed syncs; fix what you can and work with the relevant system or Data owner on deeper issues.

•
Build automation that holds up in everyday use. Test realistic scenarios and edge cases, monitor failures, and make it clear how to recover when something breaks. Bring consequential changes to the relevant system owner before rollout.

•
Use AI where it improves the work. Build or improve workflows for tasks such as enrichment, research, qualification, and quality checks. Evaluate the output, understand the failure modes, and measure whether the result saves time or improves quality.

•
Make what you build understandable and useful. Document your workflows, enable the people using them, gather feedback, and improve adoption. Share knowledge so another teammate can operate and troubleshoot your work. Keep documentation current as workflows change, and fill gaps in the existing processes you take on.

•
Make operational performance visible. Build and maintain reports that help teams understand workflow health, handoff gaps, campaign execution, and adoption. Work with senior Ops teammates and Data on consistent definitions.

What you’ll need to be successful

•
3+ years of hands-on experience in GTM, revenue, marketing, sales, or customer operations.

•
Practical Salesforce experience. You understand objects, relationships, fields, flows, and how data moves through the system. You have built or changed things yourself.

•
Experience building in a marketing automation platform such as Customer.io , HubSpot, Marketo, Braze, or Iterable, including segmentation, triggers, and integrations.

•
Experience building something useful with AI. You can explain the problem, your contribution, how you checked the result, what failed, and what you changed. A sanitized walkthrough is welcome; we don’t expect confidential work from a previous employer.

•
Strong troubleshooting and analytical judgment. You can trace a problem across systems, check your assumptions against data, and distinguish a symptom from its cause.

•
Ownership and follow-through. You can take an agreed problem, work through ambiguity, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver without needing every step assigned.

•
Clear written communication. You keep stakeholders informed, document decisions, and explain technical problems in language others can act on.

•
Care for the details. You think about the wrong audience, missing record, duplicate trigger, or failed handoff before it becomes someone else’s problem.

•
Learning agility and adaptability. You can transfer what you know to unfamiliar tools and adjust your plan when priorities change, while keeping commitments and stakeholders informed.

Ideally, you

•
Have worked in a product-led or usage-based business with both self-service and Sales-assisted customers.

•
Have connected CRM, marketing automation, customer-success, or product-usage systems.

•
Can use SQL, APIs, webhooks, or lightweight scripts to investigate data and connect tools.

•
Have improved adoption of an internal tool or replaced repeated manual work with a maintained workflow.

•
Have supported customer onboarding, product adoption, lifecycle education, or account-coverage programs.

What success looks like

Within the first month, you’ll:

•
Learn how customers move through RevenueCat and how our GTM teams support them.

•
Map an initial workflow with @Nathan Bellehsen and @Masha Tsaryk, including its data sources, owners, dependencies, and common failure points.

•
Ship your first useful improvement as part of RevenueCat’s “first ship” tradition.

•
Agree your initial ownership area and a prioritized set of problems to solve.

Within the first three months, you’ll:

•
Own the day-to-day operation of an agreed set of lead and/or lifecycle workflows.

•
Deliver an improvement from scoping through rollout, with clear documentation and stakeholder feedback.

•
Establish baseline measures and monitoring for the workflows you own.

•
Give another teammate enough context to support your work when you’re away.

Within the first six months, you’ll:

•
Demonstrate measurable improvement in a core workflow, such as fewer missed handoffs, faster campaign delivery, fresher data, or less manual effort.

•
Turn recurring operational requests into reusable processes.

•
Show that the people your workflows serve are using them successfully, and improve what isn’t working.

Within the first twelve months, you’ll:

•
Independently deliver projects across systems within your areas of ownership.

•
Have a track record of reliable workflows, useful automation, and improvements that make GTM teams more effective.

•
Help shape the next priorities using evidence from users, operational performance, and customer needs.

•
Be developing deeper expertise and taking on progressively more complex work.

Nos interesa conocer profesionales con trayectoria sólida en liderazgo tecnológico, arquitectura de soluciones y gestión de equipos de desarrollo.

• Gestión del desarrollo: dominio de metodologías ágiles, ciclo de vida del software (SDLC), estándares de calidad y buenas prácticas de ingeniería.

• Liderazgo técnico: experiencia acompañando equipos, desarrollando competencias y facilitando decisiones tecnológicas.

Más allá de los conocimientos técnicos, buscamos a una persona que pueda combinar profundidad tecnológica con una mirada integral del negocio.
Valoramos especialmente:

• Visión estratégica: capacidad para anticipar tendencias y convertirlas en oportunidades concretas.

• Liderazgo y desarrollo de personas: habilidad para orientar, inspirar y potenciar equipos técnicos.

2. Impulsar la IA y la innovación

Deseable:

About the company

At Nuitée , we are building the API backbone for the global travel industry. Founded in 2017, Nuitée is on a mission to transform a fragmented travel ecosystem with simple, scalable, and API-first infrastructure—think “Stripe for Travel.”

By enabling seamless connectivity between hotels, OTAs, fintechs, super-apps, and businesses, some of which are entering the travel market for the first time, Nuitée empowers companies to deliver reliable travel products effortlessly. Our robust platform simplifies complex supplier networks, offering direct access to hotel inventory with better pricing, coverage, and technology.

With teams across the globe, including hubs in London, New York, San Francisco, Palma de Mallorca and Casablanca, Nuitée has grown into a global infrastructure provider trusted by industry leaders like Hopper, Priceline, Google, and Uber.

Now backed by leading VCs and world-class investors including leaders from , Stripe, and Shopify, Nuitée is positioned to redefine the B2B travel market, streamline operations for hotels, and enable new applications through cutting-edge APIs.

Nuitée is at the forefront of a revolution—delivering AI-powered, smarter, and more personalized travel experiences for a new era.

About the role
Remote in Europe, or hybrid in Barcelona, Dublin, London, or Palma.
Imagine making a technical decision today and seeing its impact on revenue in days.
You'll lead engineering for Pricing & Revenue, a core part of Nuitée 's hotel booking infrastructure. This is where supplier connectivity, distribution, pricing, and monetisation come together, with engineering decisions directly affecting performance, competitiveness, and margin.
You'll own the technical direction, architecture, reliability, and delivery of the domain. You'll lead and grow a small engineering team, work closely with Product and Trading, and have the autonomy to decide how to solve problems without approval layers.
The technical challenge is central. A single hotel search can trigger synchronous queries across around 200 suppliers. We're now building more sophisticated trading capabilities, including a proper pricing engine and automated rebooking, to make better decisions about supply, pricing, and distribution at scale.

What makes it interesting for you

• Build something important from scratch. We're developing a proper pricing engine and new trading capabilities on top of an established, revenue-generating platform.

• Real technical ownership. You'll make architectural decisions, shape how the domain evolves, and see the commercial impact of your engineering choices.

• You stay close to engineering. You'll lead, mentor, and hire engineers while remaining deeply involved in the systems, code, and technical decisions.

• You can move fast. Small teams, little red tape, and the freedom to make decisions. You can identify a problem, make a change, and see its impact quickly.

Nuitée has grown 10x since 2022, was profitable before raising a $48M Series A led by Accel, and works with companies such as Revolut, Grab, Hopper, Priceline, and Sabre. This role comes with meaningful equity, so when we hit our next growth milestones, you get real upside in the company you’re helping build.

The kind of problems you'll work on

• How do we build a pricing engine that balances supply, demand, competitiveness, and margin across a complex hotel marketplace?

• How do we return competitive rates quickly when each hotel search can involve around 200 supplier connections, with different response times and reliability?

• How do we improve hotel search availability, currently around 42%, while ensuring customers can actually fulfil their bookings?

• How do we automate rebooking, first for our internal operations and eventually as a product our customers can use?

This role fits if you

• Have led, mentored, and grown engineering teams while staying hands-on with architecture, code, and production problems.

• Have built or improved marketplace, trading, or optimisation systems, with experience across both supply and demand.

• Understand how pricing, inventory, distribution, and fulfilment interact in a marketplace.

• Have strong Go experience and deep backend engineering expertise, including distributed systems, high-volume APIs, latency, concurrency, and reliability.

• Can translate complex commercial problems into engineering decisions and build systems that deliver measurable outcomes.

• Thrive in fast-moving environments where you're expected to take ownership and figure things out.

Experience with marketplaces involving real-world inventory, such as mobility, delivery, ecommerce, or travel, is particularly valuable.
Nuitée moves quickly, has little process, and gives people a lot of room to make decisions. You’ll do well here if ambiguity does not slow you down, you like going deep into difficult problems, and you want to be accountable for what your work actually delivers.
If this sounds like your kind of role, we’d love to hear from you. You can apply with your LinkedIn profile or CV.

Why Nuitee?

At Nuitée , we’re not just reimagining travel—we’re building the infrastructure to power it.

• Massive Market Opportunity: We are tackling the $9.9tn travel industry, starting with the $75 billion B2B hotel market, a fragmented space filled with outdated systems, gatekeepers, and inefficiencies. Nuitée ’s API-first platform is solving this, enabling businesses to access hotel inventory seamlessly and at scale.

• World-Class Backing: Backed by Accel and visionary leaders across tech and travel—including Booking.com, Stripe, and Shopify—we’re equipped to scale our ambition globally.

• Bootstrapped Resilience, Startup Agility: Having grown profitably for years without external funding, we combine operational discipline with the speed and innovation of a scaling startup.

• Global Impact: Our infrastructure supports partners like Google, Grab, worldwide fintechs, superapps, travel companies and others

• AI-Driven Innovation: Nuitée is uniquely positioned to power the future of travel in the AI era—enabling seamless, intelligent, and hyper-personalized travel interactions.

By joining Nuitée , you’ll be part of a team that’s building a category-defining platform. You’ll work on a global scale, innovate alongside industry leaders, and help drive the next phase of travel technology. If you’re excited to push boundaries, redefine a multi-trillion-dollar industry, and grow with us— Nuitée is the place for you.

Your information will be stored securely and will only be retained for as long as necessary for the recruitment process, or up to 6 months afterward, in accordance with our data protection policy and applicable laws. Location and Work Mode
Remote role based in Argentina or Mexico.

Who we are
The Nature Conservancy (TNC) is a global environmental nonprofit working to create a world where people and nature thrive. Founded in 1951, TNC advances conservation with the support of more than a million members and the work of over 400 scientists, impacting conservation in +80 countries and territories.

Our impact
Since its founding in 1951, The Nature Conservancy has grown to become one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Some key accomplishments include:

• 80+ countries and territories where TNC impacts conservation.

•
125M+ acres of land protected.

•
400+ scientists on staff.

•
1M+ members supporting our mission.

Purpose of the Position
The Senior Donor Communications Officer translates TNC's conservation priorities, results, and funding needs into compelling, donor-centered communications that support fundraising across Latin America.
As a strategic partner to the Director of Donor Communications, the role leads complex, multi-country initiatives and strengthens the quality, consistency, and persuasive power of communications for major and principal gift audiences. It is a senior individual contributor role, reporting to the Director of Donor Communications.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic planning and advisory

• Partner with the Director of Donor Communications to develop regional communications strategies, priorities, messaging frameworks, and content plans aligned with fundraising and conservation objectives.

• Advise Development colleagues, conservation teams, and regional leaders on donor positioning, narrative strategy, audience needs, and communications opportunities.

• Exercise independent judgment to resolve complex messaging challenges, reconcile competing stakeholder inputs, and maintain donor relevance, accuracy, and strategic alignment.

• Represent Donor Communications in designated regional, global, and cross-functional initiatives, meetings, and planning processes.

• Provide continuity and senior-level decision support to the Director within agreed responsibilities.

Donor communications and persuasive storytelling

• Lead high-priority communications for donor cultivation, solicitation, stewardship, campaigns, and major or principal gift opportunities.

• Develop or oversee funding proposals, concept notes, regional and country overviews, donor visit materials, stewardship reports, campaign collateral, presentations, impact reports, and leadership messages.

• Translate complex conservation, financial, and programmatic information into accurate, engaging narratives that inspire philanthropic support.

• Adapt messaging to donor interests, cultural contexts, audience needs, and stages of the fundraising relationship.

• Ensure communications do more than report information: they must explain why the work matters and why donors should support it.

Project and stakeholder leadership

• Lead complex communications initiatives from initial briefing and strategy through stakeholder alignment, execution, review, delivery, and evaluation.

• Define objectives, audiences, deliverables, timelines, responsibilities, risks, and trade-offs.

• Coordinate contributors across countries, functions, and seniority levels in a matrixed environment.

• Influence without relying on formal authority, facilitate decisions, and maintain momentum when priorities compete.

• Take ownership of outcomes end to end rather than limiting responsibility to an individual writing assignment.

Functional leadership and capability building

• Strengthen editorial standards, regional messaging consistency, multilingual content practices, and donor communications workflows.

• Provide mentorship, constructive feedback, and subject-matter guidance to communications and Development colleagues.

• Identify opportunities to improve the quality, effectiveness, and efficiency of content production, tools, systems, and processes.

• Oversee relevant vendor relationships and support training and knowledge-sharing across the region.

• Promote effective use of digital collaboration tools and AI-assisted content solutions while maintaining accuracy and institutional standards.

Multilingual and cross-cultural collaboration

• Navigate cultural and organizational differences to build trust, ensure local relevance, and facilitate alignment across regional and global teams.

Education

• An equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience may be considered.

Experience

• At least 5 to 7 years of relevant experience in donor communications, fundraising communications, strategic communications, or a related field.

• Demonstrated experience developing audience-focused communications that support fundraising, persuasion, engagement, campaigns, or other organizational objectives.

• Experience leading complex cross-functional, regional, or multi-country projects from planning through delivery.

• Fundraising communications, donor engagement, and persuasive writing.

• Strong writing, editing, synthesis, and storytelling skills.

• Ability to interpret scientific, conservation, financial, and programmatic information.

• Project management, prioritization, and delivery across multiple workstreams.

• Stakeholder management and facilitation in matrixed organizations.

• Editorial quality assurance and multilingual content coordination.

• Spanish: Professional fluency, with very strong writing, editing, and verbal communication skills.

• Portuguese: Advanced working proficiency sufficient to understand discussions, participate in meetings, and collaborate directly with Portuguese-speaking colleagues, particularly in Brazil.

• Ownership and proactivity: Anticipates needs, identifies opportunities, and drives work forward with autonomy.

They should be comfortable operating as a senior contributor who can influence peers and support the team without relying on direct managerial authority. The team is looking for someone who:

• Protection of land, oceans, freshwater, forests, and other critical natural systems.

Sustainable food and water systems.

The Role
You own the RAG and inference infrastructure for the world's first production AI built for antitrust law. October 2026 launch, 50+ competition authorities worldwide. You're not junior support — you own systems end-to-end: retrieval pipelines, vector databases, inference orchestration, API design. You make architecture decisions. You ship every week.
Why this matters: Concurrences .com is the definitive antitrust platform (20 years, 100K+ articles). Now we're turning 330–430K legal documents into a production-grade agentic research engine.

What You'll Build

• RAG pipelines: chunking, embedding strategies, retrieval optimization (BM25 + semantic + reranking), latency tuning

• Python + FastAPI APIs: exposing search, retrieval, agentic workflows to Claude, ChatGPT, enterprise copilots

• Weaviate: schema design, indexing strategy, query optimization, cost-per-query tuning

• LLM integration: managing context, prompt templates, cost/latency trade-offs

• Agentic systems: CrewAI, LangGraph, or LlamaIndex for multi-step research flows

• Infrastructure: CI/CD with Pulumi/Terraform, monitoring, observability

A Typical Week

• Monday: Bug in chunking pipeline. Root cause, fix, PR, test. Partner with LLM engineer on retrieval validation.

• Tuesday: Customer request: search across EU + US jurisdictions. Redesign query routing.

• Wednesday: Code review: intern's reranking module is slow. Pair on profiling, async batching.

• Thursday: Monitoring alert: 2-second tail latency. Design two-tier indexing. Draft design doc.

• Friday: Deploy indexing strategy, monitor post-launch. Async update to Anton.

Who You'll Work With
Anton Bossenbroek (CTO): 20+ years at BCG, Bain, EY, Deloitte, and C3.ai. Your primary technical collaborator.
Nicolas Charbit (founder): 20 years building Concurrences into the definitive antitrust platform.
Small team. Everyone ships. High signal-to-noise ratio.

Must-Have Qualifications

• Strong Python — ship production code daily. FastAPI is a big plus.

• Built APIs or backend systems — something other code calls.

• Hands-on LLM APIs — you've integrated Claude, ChatGPT, or another LLM into a system.

• Git and DevOps thinking — version control, CI/CD concepts, deploying code.

• Production mindset — you think latency, cost, monitoring, failure modes.

Big Pluses

• Vector database hands-on: Weaviate, Pinecone, pgvector, FAISS, or Milvus

• Agentic frameworks: CrewAI, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or LangChain

• Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation

• GCP experience: Cloud Run, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage

• FastAPI specifically: production FastAPI systems

• Law background: law degree, coursework, antitrust thesis

postings.title: Executive Heartbeat Lean Leader, Office of Heartbeat
postings.descriptionText:
Job Description Summary
Based in Europe, this executive role leads the enterprise-wide Lean transformation within GE HealthCare ’s Office of Heartbeat. It supports the development, deployment, and sustained alignment of the Heartbeat Business System with the company’s 2030 goals.

Transformation Leadership: The role champions, coaches, and mentors Lean change; leads Heartbeat Lean Leaders; partners with stakeholders to prioritize improvement opportunities; and co-leads operating reviews, strategy, and priority planning across regions, segments, and functions.

Business System Deployment: Responsibilities include supporting bootcamps, coaching, and training while embedding standard work, daily management, problem solving, kaizen, value stream mapping, and action planning into business operations. The position also builds Lean capability and manages the organizational change required to sustain these practices.

Operational Impact: By analyzing work at the genba, diagnosing challenges, testing improvements, and executing Hoshin Kanri priorities, the role is expected to improve business results and culture, strengthen leadership capability, and contribute to improved EBITDA and Free Cash Flow.

Required Profile: Candidates need a bachelor’s degree, at least 15 years of general management or Lean operational leadership experience, and at least 10 years of Lean capability-building experience. The profile also calls for regulated-industry knowledge, experience with AI-enabled tools, global Lean-system deployment, strong facilitation and program-management skills, executive communication, accountability, commercial focus, and change-management expertise, preferably using the ADKAR framework.
Job Description

Your Challenge
The Executive Lean Leader is responsible for supporting the design, adoption, functional leadership, and execution of the enterprise-wide Lean transformation within the Office of Heartbeat at GE HealthCare . As a key member of the Office of Heartbeat team, the Executive Lean Leader contributes to the overall strategy of how we run, change, and act in the business, guided by the principles and processes of the Heartbeat Business System (HBS).

This role is critical to ensure the Heartbeat Business System is developed, deployed, and sustained in direct alignment with the company’s 2030 goals. The Executive Lean Leader will lead impactful operating routines and drive execution of critical projects. The role is based in Europe.

Your Responsibilities
Our Heartbeat Business System is based on Lean thinking and practices and will be an integral part of the way we run, change, and act in our business for the long-term. Each Executive Lean Leader contributes to this progression within the organization.

The Executive Lean Leader will focus on selecting, supporting, and assisting with the improvement efforts tied to the Office of Heartbeat’s most critical business processes (e.g., Hoshin Kanri), primarily in the innovation (STO), commercial, integrated supply chain, service, and functional areas. By analyzing work at the genba with our people, diagnosing our challenges, and testing process improvements through an action plan, the Executive Lean Leader will demonstrate continuous improvement and breakthrough performance — ultimately shaping the company culture and brand.

The goal is to positively impact results and culture by establishing standards, institutionalizing daily management processes, adopting consistent problem-solving methods, and executing on Hoshin Kanri priorities. As a key member of the Office of Heartbeat team, the Executive Lean Leader will help strengthen and develop the evolving Heartbeat Business System and build people and leader capability in the Heartbeat fundamentals — standard work, daily management system, problem solving, kaizen, value stream mapping, and action planning — with a growth mindset that enables culture change. This will require significant change management to embed effectively throughout the organization.

Expectations

Lean Leadership & Transformation

• Provide overall Lean leadership at the appropriate Region / Segment / Function level and drive the Lean transformation by serving as a champion, coach, and mentor for change

• Lead and mentor the Region / Segment / Function teams of Heartbeat Lean Leaders across the organization

• Partner with global business stakeholders across segments and regions to identify, prioritize, and execute improvement opportunities through Kaizen events and Lean initiatives

• Co-lead Region / Segment / Function operating rhythms (operating reviews, long-term strategy, priorities planning) in partnership with subject-matter experts and senior leaders

Heartbeat Business System Deployment

• Support the development and activities of the Heartbeat Business System, including bootcamps, leader coaching, and training on Heartbeat fundamentals

• Install the Heartbeat behaviors and fundamentals into how we run the business: standard work, daily management system, problem solving, kaizen, value stream mapping, and action planning

Capability Building

• Establish a Lean capability program that ensures the application of globally recognized standards for Lean principles and practices, serves as a benchmark for achievement, and provides a common roadmap for continuous improvement and people development

• Develop capability across the spectrum — from the tactical (deployment and application of principles, concepts, and methods) to the strategic (a transformation that deeply impacts a key value stream) — with effective change management

Leadership, Culture, & Change Management

• Demonstrate and commit to servant leadership and partnership with peers and leaders

• Align behaviors and practices to our shared Cultural Operating Principles and Heartbeat Behaviors

• Development and deployment of the Heartbeat Business System will result in improved EBITDA and Free Cash Flow

Your Experience

• BS or BA Degree; Master’s Degree preferred

• Minimum 15 years of experience in a General Management or Lean/operational leadership role

• Minimum 10 years of capability building across a variety of Lean practices, including Hoshin Kanri, problem solving, daily management system, standard work, and value stream mapping

• Working knowledge of business processes within the medical equipment or other regulated industry

• Experience leveraging AI-enabled tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or similar platforms to accelerate the way work is done, and continuously learning new ways of using emerging technologies

• Ability to travel up to 40% across Europe and internationally.

Desired Characteristics

• Ideally built and/or designed an organizational management system

• Ideally developed the playbook for the core processes of an organizational business system

• Demonstrated successful leadership and proficiency in installing and sustaining a Lean system for a global organization with operations and services teams

• Deep, hands-on experience with Lean principles and practices; credible with practitioners and executives alike

• Ability to accurately assess key business metrics and situations from a general manager’s or executive leader’s perspective

• Excellent time, program, and project management skills — brings order and structure quickly to initiatives and other critical, high-visibility programs

• Strong facilitation and ability to influence without authority across segments, regions, and functions

• High attention to detail in daily and visual management without losing the strategic thread

• Proven ability to hold senior leaders accountable to commitments with candor and respect

• Growth mindset with hands-on approach; comfortable at the genba and in the boardroom

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive storytelling

• Experience with Change Management (preferably the ADKAR framework)

• Deep commercial experience with a focus on the customer and end-user experience

Additional Information
Relocation Assistance Provided: No

As a director, you'll pair thought leadership with hands-on mentorship. You'll create the conditions for teams to do their best work, and make sure every brand we touch carries clarity, creativity, and craft.

Lead the work

• Guide and mentor brand designers at every level, through the whole journey from insight to identity to expression.

• Partner with clients strategically, helping founders and executives shape, evolve, and scale their brands for a digital-first world.

• Build and refine brand systems that carry cleanly into product experiences, marketing, and motion.

• Make sure every engagement, ours or a client's, holds clarity, consistency, and purpose.

Shape creative direction

• Drive the creative process on major brand initiatives, setting the tone for identity systems, storytelling frameworks, and brand guidelines.

• Work closely with product design leadership so brand and product feel like one coherent experience.

• Lead cross-disciplinary critique, lifting the team's fluency in storytelling, systems thinking, and craft.

• Push creative boundaries with motion, 3D, and interaction to create brand moments that feel alive.

Champion collaboration and growth

• Partner with design leadership and help win new work by pitching bold, brand-led approaches.

• Keep Parallel 's own brand at the highest bar of craft and cohesion across everything we put out.

• Build a team culture rooted in openness, mentorship, and curiosity, where designers grow and thrive.

• Connect brand, product, and marketing so the experience holds together end to end.

What You Bring

• Visionary brand leadership. You inspire creative excellence, communicate a clear and compelling brand vision, and earn client trust. You balance creative risk with strategic rigour, so every direction is both aspirational and grounded in business value.

• Hands-on craft. You don't just direct great design, you do it. As one of the most senior makers in the room, you lead by example with exceptional craft and detail, and bring real design energy to pitches, reviews, and live work.

• Brand systems expertise. You turn complex ideas into coherent, scalable systems across visual, verbal, and experiential, and you know how an identity holds up across environments, from a screen to motion to a physical moment.

• Strategic storytelling. You see brand as narrative, where story, identity, and experience meet, and you guide teams and clients to articulate what makes their brand meaningful and distinct.

• Cross-disciplinary collaboration. You move fluidly across product, strategy, and marketing, bringing a systems mindset that connects every touchpoint.

Requirements

• Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and large-scale brand engagements from strategy through execution.

• A portfolio that shows mastery of visual identity, brand systems, and storytelling across digital touchpoints.

• Comfort with emerging tools, including everyday use of AI in your craft.

• Strong facilitation and communication skills, guiding workshops and strategic sessions with confidence and empathy.

• Deep knowledge of design trends and the evolving role of brand in the digital ecosystem.

• A passion for mentoring and shaping design culture.

How We Hire
The bar is high and the role is senior, so we take the process seriously and move quickly. Expect a couple of conversations with the team, then a small, paid real-world project so we can see how you actually think and work. The role is remote. Compensation matches the seniority we're hiring for.

postings.title: Freelance Data Engineer (Postgres / Systemintegration)
postings.descriptionText:
über juni

JUNI ist ein gemeinnütziges Ökosystem für Wissenschaft und Ausgründungen in Berlin. Wir betreiben unsere Programme über sieben SaaS-Tools hinweg — Newsletter, Events, Community, CRM, Formulare, Bewerbungen, Coworking — und darunter eine Postgres-Datenbank, die der eine Ort sein soll, an dem eine Person existiert.
Auf die Datenbank kommt es an. Ein aufgelöster Datensatz pro Person und pro Organisation, eine append-only-Zeile pro Interaktion, und ein deterministischer Weg zu entscheiden, zu welcher Person ein eingehender Payload gehört. Ziel ist, den Weg vom ersten Kontaktpunkt bis zum Meilenstein messbar zu machen. Die Verbindungsschicht zwischen den Tools und dieser Datenbank ist die Aufgabe.

deine aufgaben

Die Schicht bauen, die unsere Systeme mit einer Datenbank verbindet — in beide Richtungen — und uns dabei helfen, das Datenmodell richtig hinzubekommen.
Die Form der Daten steht weitgehend, und jedes neue System stellt sie auf die Probe. Quellen sind sich nicht einig, was als eine Person zählt, wann etwas passiert ist, und ob sie es zweimal melden. Das zu klären — und zu erkennen, wann das Modell angepasst werden muss, statt es um eine Quelle herumzubiegen — ist der Kern der Arbeit.
Wir suchen jemanden, der das mit uns durchdenkt und für einen bestimmten Entwurf argumentiert, nicht nur umsetzt, was spezifiziert ist.

dein profil

Umfang

Inbound Jedes System in die Datenbank. Mehrere Pipelines pro System — Quellen melden sehr unterschiedliche Dinge. Identitätsauflösung über Systeme hinweg. Outbound Manche Zustände entstehen bei uns, nicht im Tool. Die Datenbank entscheidet und schiebt an die Plattform, die es ausführt. Beide Richtungen sauber halten Plattformen melden zurück und widersprechen uns manchmal. Wer sich abgemeldet hat, darf nicht wieder hinzugefügt werden. Reporting KPI-Daten müssen in einem BI-Tool ankommen. Sie dorthin zu bringen gehört dazu, Dashboards bauen nicht. Suche Den Datenbestand in natürlicher Sprache durchsuchbar machen. Dokumentation Entscheidungen schriftlich, Pipelines in GitHub.

Nicht Teil der Rolle

• Frontend. Es gibt keins und es ist keins geplant.

Voraussetzungen

•
Integration gegen Third-Party-APIs und Webhooks , in der Tiefe: Pagination, Retries, Signaturprüfung, Rate Limits, undokumentierte Payload-Strukturen, verspätete und vertauschte Events, Quellen, die bei jeder Änderung feuern und nicht sagen, was sich geändert hat.

•
Bidirektionale Synchronisation zwischen Systemen, die beide dasselbe Feld für ihres halten — Loop-Vermeidung, Echo-Unterdrückung, eine klare Antwort darauf, wer bei Konflikten gewinnt.

•
Postgres als Anwendungsdatenbank, nicht nur als Ziel. plpgsql-Funktionen, Trigger, Constraints und RLS, um Regeln beim Schreiben durchzusetzen. Wenn sich deine SQL-Erfahrung auf Transformationen nach dem Load beschränkt, passt die Rolle nicht.

• Idempotenz als Gewohnheit, nicht als Nachgedanke. Eine Pipeline, die erneut läuft und nichts verändert, ist der Abnahmetest.

• Sauberes Arbeiten mit Git — Migrationen, PRs, Review.

• Arbeit mit personenbezogenen Daten unter der DSGVO, und ein Verständnis dafür, warum das einschränkt, was überhaupt eingelesen wird.

• Englisch in Schrift. Die Arbeit läuft überwiegend asynchron, und was du baust, muss für jemanden lesbar sein, der nicht dabei war.

Hilfreich, nicht erforderlich
n8n oder ein anderer Orchestrator · Supabase · Relevanzarbeit an einem Suchindex — Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Meilisearch oder vergleichbar; Cluster-Betrieb ist nicht der Teil, den wir brauchen · Erfahrung als einzige Person auf einem System · Deutsch.

wir bieten

Zusammenarbeit
Remote und überwiegend asynchron, aber nicht wortlos — gerade am Anfang sind echte Gespräche eingeplant, während du dich in die Systeme und ihre Zusammenhänge einarbeitest.

Rahmen
Freiberuflich, Start so bald wie möglich. Zunächst drei Monate; danach sehen wir, was gebraucht wird.

Berlin oder Remote innerhalb der EU.

* Propuestas de contenidos innovadoras , teniendo en cuenta últimas tendencias y formatos para campañas digitales de Paid Media.

• Ser ambiciosos para alcanzar el éxito.

• Ser imaginativos para superar los límites de lo posible.

• Estar siempre aprendiendo y escuchando para comprender.

Nosso processo de recrutamento não utiliza inteligência artificial para seleção. Utilizamos a IA para apoiar a eficiência e a consistência, e não para substituir o julgamento humano. A avaliação e a seleção de candidatos são realizadas sem o uso de IA para triagem ou tomada de decisão. Estamos comprometidos com uma experiência justa, cuidadosa e equitativa para cada candidato.

OLIVER, que forma parte del Grupo Brandtech, es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y se compromete a crear entornos de trabajo inclusivos en los que se motive a todos los empleados a alcanzar su máximo potencial, valorando y respetando las diferencias individuales. Todos los candidatos serán tenidos en cuenta sin distinción de raza, etnia, religión, sexo, orientación sexual, identidad de género, edad, neurodivergencia, estado de discapacidad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la legislación local.

OLIVER ha establecido ambiciosos objetivos medioambientales en torno a la sostenibilidad, con objetivos de reducción de emisiones basados en la ciencia. Colectivamente, trabajamos para cumplir nuestra misión, integrando la sostenibilidad en todos los departamentos y en todas las fases del ciclo de vida de los proyectos.

postings.descriptionText:
In Office

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

JOB PURPOSE

We are looking for an Office Assistant who will ensure that our office runs smoothly, and create a work environment in which everyone feels comfortable.

Yes, we are eager to bring on board the most talented experts in the game. Someone who is eager to learn and strives towards a better world, takes the stage, is a futurist at heart, and someone who is down to cheer with us to a successful week as well! Ultimately, we are looking for a unique individual who is able to strengthen our collective.

This is a full-time role in the office for 5 days a week.

Please note that this is a fixed-term position for a period of one year.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Responsible for reception and telephone support, all communications, and all organizational and administrative office activities;

• Manage office supply orders, including drinks, snacks, water, toiletries and other essential items needed for the smooth day-to-day operation of the office.

• Support the HR team in all matters, in particular with updating and maintaining office policies and procedures, ensuring that health and safety policies are up to date, managing and updating HR databases (new hires, terminations, vacations, sick leaves and employee benefits), drafting documents, and general administration;

• Support your colleagues in preparatory bookkeeping, and when it comes to business travel and organizing team building activities, you are the go-to-person, coordinator, and expert in our travel booking tool.

• Support the sourcing, ordering, and coordination of gifts for employees, including researching suitable options, requesting offers from suppliers, and coordinating orders.

• Assist in planning, organizing, and coordinating office events and activities that promote employee engagement, strengthen team spirit, foster connection and belonging, celebrate team achievements, and create a positive and welcoming office environment.

WHAT YOU'll BRING

• Speak and write English fluently;

• Have 3+ years of experience working as an office assistant or in a related field;

• Are highly computer literate and are expert in MS Office/Google Docs;

• Stand out for your service orientation and organizational skills;

• Are responsible, trustworthy and handle internal company matters discreetly;

• Have the ability to learn quickly new processes and tools;

• Have meticulous attention to detail and are very well organized;

• Have knowledge and experience in HR administration and processes;

• Have experience in finance and accounting (would be considered a plus!);

• Have a driving license B (would be considered a plus!).

WHAT YOU'll GET

• Private healthcare.

• Monthly bus ticket.

• SportMaster card with which you may do sport activities each day in different locations.

• Profit sharing bonus at the end of each year.

• Refreshments provided in the office all week, as well as drinks at 4pm on a Friday.

• A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021 and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards.

• Awesome clients. Whether big or small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with clients of all sizes and across all industries. And we celebrate all of our successes together!

• The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training, development and certifications.

• Global annual DEPT® Cares Month in which employees come together and donate their skills to support local charities

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here .

postings.title: Grupo QuintoAndar I Data Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Acerca del Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos el Grupo QuintoAndar, el ecosistema inmobiliario más grande de América Latina . Guiados por el propósito de ayudar a las personas a amar el lugar donde viven , creamos tecnología y soluciones que simplifican toda la experiencia de la vivienda, desde el alquiler hasta la compra y venta.

Estamos presentes en 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Perú, Ecuador y Panamá) y contamos con un hub de tecnología en Portugal , reuniendo a más de 3.100 personas unidas por el desafío de transformar el sector. Con el respaldo de inversionistas globales como SoftBank, General Atlantic y Kaszek, hemos levantado más de US$ 755 millones y hoy somos una compañía valuada en US$ 5,1 mil millones .

Lideramos la transformación del mercado siendo pioneros en la aplicación de Inteligencia Artificial a gran escala en el sector inmobiliario. Nuestras plataformas suman más de 50 millones de visitas al mes, administrando más de 350 mil contratos de alquiler activos y movilizando R$ 20 mil millones al año.

Si buscas resolver problemas complejos con autonomía, tecnología de punta e impacto a gran escala, adelante, estás en tu casa.

Para conocer más sobre nuestra historia, ingresa a: grupoquintoandar.com/es/

Ubicación y Modelo de Trabajo

Nuestro equipo de Data trabaja bajo el modelo híbrido , combinando la flexibilidad del trabajo remoto con el intercambio presencial en nuestra oficina de Ciudad de Buenos Aires, 2 veces por semana.

Sobre el Equipo y el Desafío

Buscamos un/a Data Specialist con mentalidad técnica y visión de negocio, capaz de articular las necesidades de los líderes operativos con la arquitectura de datos, diseñando reportes robustos y sentando las bases para herramientas basadas en IA.

Tus Responsabilidades

• Arquitectura de Reporting y Control Operativo: Diseñar, estructurar e implementar el modelo de métricas y la reportería integral, garantizando visibilidad de extremo a extremo (funnels de conversión, productividad comercial, análisis de cohortes y retención).

• Unificación y Consolidación del Stack de Datos: Mapear las fuentes de información existentes, diagnosticar brechas de datos y estructurar modelos analíticos consistentes que funcionen como única fuente de verdad para el negocio.

• Adopción de IA y Data Science: Explorar e implementar soluciones técnicas basadas en Machine Learning, analítica predictiva y herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial generativa / automatizaciones inteligentes para optimizar procesos comerciales y anticipar desvíos.

• Desarrollo de Dashboards y Autoservicio (BI): Crear tableros de control intuitivos, escalables y mantenibles en plataformas como Tableau, Looker o Power BI, capacitando a los líderes operativos para el consumo autónomo de información.

• Detección Proactiva de Oportunidades: Formular hipótesis de negocio, liderar análisis exploratorios complejos y traducir datos cuantitativos en recomendaciones accionables de alto impacto comercial.

• Impulso de la Cultura Data-Driven: Actuar como referente técnico y pedagógico, elevando la alfabetización de datos y el rigor metodológico en las distintas áreas funcionales.

Lo que buscamos (Requisitos)

•
Experiencia Profesional: Experiencia comprobada en roles de Data Analytics, Business Intelligence o Data Specialist, preferentemente en entornos de scale-up, startups tecnológicas o consultoría estratégica/analítica.

•
Dominio Avanzado de SQL: Capacidad sólida para estructurar consultas complejas.

•
Programación y Modelado: Manejo fluido de Python.

•
Enfoque en IA y Data Science: Criterio técnico e interés práctico en la aplicación de algoritmos de Data Science, automatización con modelos de lenguaje (LLMs) y técnicas analíticas avanzadas orientadas a la resolución de problemas.

•
Visualización y BI: Experiencia práctica en el desarrollo de dashboards ejecutivos y operativos mediante herramientas como Power BI, Looker, Tableau o Superset.

•
Visión de Negocio: Formación académica en Ingeniería, Economía, Administración de Empresas, Estadística, Ciencias de la Computación o carreras afines; habilidad demostrada para articular métricas cuantitativas con objetivos comerciales.

•
Idiomas: Nivel de inglés profesional - avanzado.

Deseables (Diferenciales)

• Experiencia previa en empresas de PropTech, marketplaces bifaciales, comercio electrónico o negocios B2B2C/SaaS.

• Experiencia previa colaborando estrechamente con equipos de operaciones comerciales o Revenue Operations.

¿Cómo es nuestro Proceso de Selección?

Diseñamos un proceso transparente, directo y enfocado en evaluar tu potencial técnico y comportamental, dándote la oportunidad de conocer a nuestros equipos y rutas de carrera:

•
Postulación y Revisión de Perfil.

•
Entrevista de Alineación (Equipo de Reclutamiento).

•
Evaluación Técnica (Caso Práctico, Desafío o Evaluación de Código).

•
Entrevista de Encaje Cultural y Liderazgo.

•
Propuesta y ¡Bienvenido/a!

Importante: Evaluamos todas las postulaciones de manera individual y garantizamos respuesta para todas las personas. Toda la comunicación se realiza por correo electrónico, así que asegúrate de revisar tu bandeja de entrada y permitir los correos del dominio @quintoandar.com.br .

Beneficios

• Plan médico.

• Wellhub.

• Licencia parental extendida.

• Reintegro de Guardería.

• Gastos de teletrabajo (monto mensual).

• Descuentos en servicios del día a día.

• Día libre por cumpleaños, Día del Padre y Día de la Madre.

Diversidad e Inclusión en Grupo QuintoAndar

Durante la inscripción, verás algunas preguntas sobre diversidad. Estas son confidenciales y tienen como objetivo apoyar nuestras acciones de diversidad e inclusión. En vacantes afirmativas, la información podrá ser utilizada para verificar el alineamiento con el público objetivo de la oportunidad y, en estos casos, podría tener carácter eliminatorio. Para vacantes no afirmativas, esta información no afecta tu postulación y se utiliza únicamente para ayudarnos a mejorar continuamente nuestras prácticas e iniciativas de inclusión a lo largo de tu trayectoria con nosotros.

Privacidad y Protección de Datos

El Grupo QuintoAndar actúa de conformidad con las leyes de privacidad y protección de datos, y garante la seguridad de sus datos personales. Para saber más, consulte nuestro Aviso de Privacidad para Personas Candidatas . Si tiene dudas o desea ejercer sus derechos como titular de los datos, póngase en contacto con nosotros a través de nuestro Canal de Atención .

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

Your job is to build Alpaca's algo trading platform to satisfy our users who expect high quality and performance from their brokerage service. This opportunity is similar to joining AWS or Heroku in their early days, designing and architecting our platform by wearing many different hats in our small team. As an experienced engineer, you will write tons of code and make critical decisions about delivering the best experience to our customers. This certainly requires deep knowledge in both frontend and backend, databases and distributed systems, as well as broad experience from low to high level in CPU-level hardware for high throughput, robust concurrency system design, abstract distributed system architecture for high availability and object-oriented data modeling with long term growth in mind. Joining an early stage startup, the payoff to this highly demanding environment will be worth the effort.

You must have previous software engineering experience with trading or exchange systems (OMS, EMS, exchanges, market making, algorithmic trading, quant trading).

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

• Strong, experienced software engineer with lead experience is preferred

• Coding skills in both low and high level languages around C/C++, Go, Zig, Rust, Java, Scala, Python

• Low latency and high throughput optimization

• Experience with messaging queues and message brokers

• Analytical data-oriented mindset and skills

• Knowledge of algorithms, distributed systems, scalability, high availability, databases, low latency systems and concurrency control

• System design skills with object-oriented data modeling, service-oriented architectures, system abstraction

• Experience with the development and implementation of Order Management systems (OMS) and Risk Management systems (RMS)

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):

• Algo trading experience (either professional or personal)

• FIX protocol knowledge

• Experience with observability, tracing, continuous profiling and benchmarking

• Financial market (exchange, broker-dealers, clearing, etc.) knowledge

• Experience with financial ledgers

• Statistical and quantitative analysis skills

• Experience with major cloud platforms (we primarily use GCP)

• Experience with Docker and Kubernetes

How We Take Care of You:

• Competitive Salary & Stock Options

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

postings.descriptionText:
About Sezzle

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the role:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Compliance Intern to support Sezzle’s Compliance Team. This role provides second-line oversight and day-to-day advisory support across a wide range of business activities by translating regulatory requirements into practical guidance, executing operational compliance reviews, and producing governance-ready documentation and reporting. This role plays a critical part in ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements and supporting the development of internal policies, standards and procedures, while fostering a culture of integrity and accountability across the organization.

What You'll Do:

• Provide compliance advisory support to business partners on consumer finance and payments requirements; document guidance, decisions, and follow-ups.

• Support the intake, tracking, and completion of Compliance Operations & Advisory work (advisory requests, reviews, and actions) using defined workflows and evidence standards.

• Perform second-line oversight reviews of complaint handling for higher-risk channels (e.g., CFPB, BBB, and executive escalations) and contribute to complaint trend and root-cause analysis.

• Support issues management governance by maintaining issue/action logs, validating remediation plans and evidence, and monitoring aging to closure.

• Participate in change management oversight by reviewing initiatives for compliance impacts, control readiness, and required approvals/escalations.

• Conduct pre-use compliance reviews of marketing and customer communications; identify required disclosures and risks (e.g., UDAAP, fair lending) and document results.

• Assist with product development compliance assessments for new products and material initiatives; coordinate inputs, maintain risk/control documentation, and track conditions for launch.

• Support third-party compliance activities for customer-facing vendors (e.g., due diligence documentation support, contract requirement tracking, ongoing monitoring).

• Prepare clear written memos and governance-ready summaries (metrics, themes, escalations) for leadership and partner reporting.

• Assist in gathering and delivering relevant information for internal and external regulatory reviews, examinations, audits, or other supervisory events.

• Support additional compliance-related initiatives and projects as assigned.

Required Qualifications

• Self-motivated, adaptable, and capable of working independently or collaboratively.

• Solid understanding of regulatory frameworks, laws, and compliance requirements applicable to consumer financial products and services.

• Experience in compliance operations/advisory, risk management, quality assurance, or other control/oversight activities (planning, documentation, analysis, and reporting).

• Strong written communication skills with the ability to produce clear documentation, memos, and evidence packages.

• Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize effectively across multiple workstreams.

• Analytical thinker with sound judgment and a proactive mindset; able to recommend practical solutions that mitigate risk and strengthen controls.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage with stakeholders at all levels and provide effective challenge and recommend practical solutions to mitigate risk and enhance controls.

• High integrity, sound ethical judgment, and comfort escalating concerns when needed.

Education & Experience

• A BS/BA degree or higher in accounting, finance, business administration, legal studies, information systems, or a related field.

• Minimum of 1 year of professional experience in consumer finance, fintech, banking, or another regulated environment preferred.

• Experience supporting complaint management oversight, issues management, change management, marketing review, product compliance assessments, or third-party oversight is highly desirable.

About You:

• You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

• You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

• You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

• You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation: The salary for the Compliance Intern is $800 USD monthly as an independent contractor.

postings.descriptionText:
Santex es una empresa global de tecnología Certificada como Empresa B, así como una de las compañías de más rápido crecimiento en Norteamérica, según el Inc. 5000. Tiene presencia en 18 países y más de 100 ciudades, con sede central en Argentina y oficinas en Estados Unidos, México y Perú.

Sus dos líneas de servicio —AI Tech Consulting y AI-Optimized Engineering— ayudan a las organizaciones a adoptar tecnología de manera integral, ampliar sus capacidades y mejorar los resultados de negocio a escala.

Este mismo enfoque define su cultura: Santex cuenta con un 80.4% de compromiso de los empleados (promedio global: 21%), una rotación anual del 8% (sector tecnológico: 20–25%), 9,369 horas de capacitación invertidas en 2025 —más del doble del promedio mundial— y una reducción del 26.5% interanual en su huella de carbono, logrando la neutralidad de carbono mediante la compensación. Santex. Una empresa con propósito y criterio. Yes, it's possible.

Somos un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y estamos comprometidos a fomentar un lugar de trabajo inclusivo y diverso. No discriminamos por motivos de raza, color, religión, sexo, identidad o expresión de género, orientación sexual, origen nacional, edad, discapacidad, condición de veterano, información genética o cualquier otra característica protegida por las leyes aplicables. Todos los candidatos calificados serán considerados para el empleo sin distinción de ninguno de estos factores. Alentamos firmemente a personas de todos los orígenes a postularse.

Solutions Engineer - AI & Automation / Ingeniero de Soluciones

Propósito del rol

Buscamos incorporar un/a Ingeniero/a de Soluciones para sumarse a nuestro equipo de Proyectos, Mejora Continua y Automatización, con un rol clave en el diseño y ejecución de soluciones de negocio y tecnología.

La persona será responsable de entender problemas complejos, descubrir cómo funcionan hoy, desafiar el statu quo y convertirlos en soluciones futuras simples, escalables y ejecutables .

Buscamos un perfil con fuerte capacidad analítica, entendimiento de negocio y buen background técnico. Alguien que pueda moverse cómodamente entre una reunión con usuarios de negocio, una mesa de diseño de solución y una conversación técnica con desarrolladores.

Trabajará directamente con el responsable del área como sponsor y líder, pero deberá contar con autonomía para liderar iniciativas, conducir reuniones, tomar decisiones dentro de su ámbito y escalar avances, riesgos y bloqueos.

Principales responsabilidades

• Liderar el entendimiento y diseño de soluciones de punta a punta, desde la identificación del problema hasta su implementación.

• Relevar y comprender procesos, sistemas, reglas de negocio, integraciones y restricciones existentes.

• Realizar ingeniería inversa sobre procesos y soluciones actuales para comprender el AS-IS y transformarlo en modelos futuros.

• Diseñar el TO-BE , buscando simplificar procesos y construir soluciones sostenibles y escalables.

• Liderar mesas de diseño con áreas de negocio, tecnología, proveedores y otros stakeholders.

• Desafiar requerimientos y supuestos. No limitarse a recibir pedidos: entender el problema detrás del requerimiento y proponer la mejor forma de resolverlo .

• Traducir necesidades de negocio en modelos, procesos y soluciones que puedan ser comprendidos y ejecutados por equipos técnicos.

• Evaluar alternativas de solución considerando impacto en negocio, experiencia, arquitectura, integraciones, datos y escalabilidad.

• Trabajar junto a desarrolladores, analistas funcionales, especialistas y proveedores durante la construcción e implementación.

• Utilizar IA y enfoques de Software-Driven Development (SDD) para acelerar el análisis, prototipado y construcción de soluciones.

• Cuando la situación lo permita, construir directamente prototipos, automatizaciones o componentes de una solución utilizando IA y herramientas modernas.

• Gestionar las iniciativas bajo su responsabilidad: próximos pasos, responsables, dependencias, riesgos y bloqueos, sin asumir un rol tradicional de Project Manager.

• Comunicar avances y decisiones de manera clara, estructurada y ejecutiva.

• A futuro, poder coordinar y desarrollar un equipo de analistas funcionales.

Perfil que buscamos

Nos imaginamos una persona con una base sólida en análisis funcional y diseño de sistemas , que con los años haya evolucionado hacia una mirada más integral de solución.
Alguien que no espere recibir un requerimiento completamente definido para comenzar a trabajar.
Frente a un problema ambiguo debería ser capaz de investigar, hacer las preguntas correctas, entender el negocio, reconstruir el funcionamiento actual, detectar oportunidades y proponer cómo debería funcionar en el futuro .

Buscamos especialmente:

• +7 años de experiencia en tecnología, análisis funcional, diseño de soluciones o posiciones similares.

• Experiencia significativa como Analista Funcional Senior, System/Business Analyst, Solution Analyst, Solution Engineer o roles equivalentes.

• Muy buena capacidad de análisis y resolución de problemas.

• Capacidad para comprender rápidamente modelos de negocio y procesos operativos.

• Capacidad para cuestionar constructivamente al negocio y transformar necesidades en soluciones.

• Autonomía y capacidad para desenvolverse en contextos con ambigüedad e información incompleta .

• Capacidad para facilitar reuniones y liderar mesas multidisciplinarias.

• Capacidad de gestión y seguimiento para lograr que las soluciones diseñadas efectivamente se ejecuten.

• Curiosidad tecnológica y predisposición permanente a investigar, experimentar y aprender.

• Comunicación clara con perfiles tanto técnicos como no técnicos.

• Buscamos una persona híbrida que pueda entender, diseñar, desafiar, construir y hacer que las soluciones ocurran .

Conocimientos técnicos

No buscamos un arquitecto empresarial ni un desarrollador especializado, pero sí esperamos una base técnica sólida que permita diseñar soluciones y conversar de igual a igual con equipos de tecnología.

Se valorará conocimiento de:

• Modelado de datos y diseño de bases de datos.

• APIs REST e integraciones entre sistemas.

• Arquitecturas modernas y conceptos de microservicios.

• Arquitecturas orientadas a eventos.

Competencias clave
