postings.title: Senior Collections and Debt Recovery Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
100% remote


At Anyone AI, we have a mission: to empower Latin American talent to play a leading role in the artificial intelligence revolution.

We are building the largest AI talent hub in the region. Through our AI Fellowship Program, we help software developers build on their experience to develop new skills, create technology with AI, accelerate their careers, and access global opportunities. We combine hands-on training, industry experts, and a community that learns and grows together.

Joining Anyone AI means helping more professionals transform their futures and enabling Latin American talent to play an increasingly important role in the global technology industry.




THE PURPOSE OF YOUR ROLE

You will be responsible for managing and recovering payments from fellows who have completed our training and whose payment obligations have been triggered under the terms of their contracts.

You will manage a regional portfolio: approximately 70% of the fellows are based in Argentina, while the rest are in Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and other LATAM countries.

We are looking for someone with experience in complex collections, strong negotiation skills, and confidence explaining contractual terms. You will combine persistence, firmness, and empathy to turn difficult conversations into payment agreements and successful collections.




YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Manage a portfolio of fellows with active payment obligations, outstanding balances, and unfulfilled payment agreements.

 - Review contracts, case histories, employment information, and contact records to prepare for each interaction.

 - Contact fellows by phone, email, WhatsApp, and other channels, following contact and confidentiality policies.

 - Design and execute follow-up sequences to reach individuals who are unresponsive or have stopped communicating.

 - Conduct conversations with fellows who raise objections, are unaware of their payment obligations, or state that they will not fulfill them.

 - Clearly explain applicable clauses, payment-triggering conditions, amounts, and due dates, using guidelines and materials validated by the legal team.

 - Negotiate payment commitments and plans within authorized limits, escalating discounts, exceptions, or changes for approval.

 - Follow up on agreements until payments are received and correctly recorded.

 - Document collection activities, responses, objections, commitments, proof of payment, and next steps in the CRM.

 - Coordinate with Finance, Operations, the fellow support team, and legal counsel to resolve cases.

 - Prepare complete case files for matters requiring legal review or escalation.




WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Enter serial number information for verification.
• Work with the team to meet daily and weekly deadlines.

• Agreement with other reviewers on shared samples at or above the client's targets.
• Reference-set labels delivered on time, with notes on hard cases.
• A weekly error-pattern report listing each pattern, an example card and the number of affected items.
• Meeting the SLAs for titling, match review and re-imaging reports.
• Meeting daily and weekly throughput targets.
Requirements
• Experience in data labeling, search-relevance rating, catalog QC or similar annotation work.
• Follows written guidelines exactly and asks when a case doesn't fit.
• Makes quick, consistent decisions while keeping accuracy high.
• Comfortable with spreadsheets and web-based review tools.
• Based in Argentina.
Nice to Have
• Working knowledge of trading cards across eras: sets, parallels, inserts, autographs, relics and serial numbering.

• Interest in sports, trading cards or collectibles.

postings.title: Site Reliability Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
GBS Chevron Global Business Services (GBS), located in Buenos Aires (Puerto Madero), Argentina, is accepting applications for the position of Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) – Automation & Observability. Successful candidates will join the IT Organization, which is part of a multifunction service and technical center with a workforce of more than 1800 employees that deliver business services and solutions to the corporation across the globe.

The Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) – Automation & Observability will design, implement, and operate reliability engineering capabilities across OT/PCN (Process Control Network) environments. This role focuses on improving system reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency by leveraging automation, observability, and SRE practices.
The engineer will partner with product owners, platform teams, and technical leads to define and enforce service reliability standards (SLIs/SLOs), build scalable observability capabilities, and integrate automation workflows with ServiceNow ITSM processes.

This role is critical to advancing the Automation & Observability platform by reducing operational toil, enabling proactive operations, and scaling reusable automation across environments. The position requires close collaboration with global teams and vendor partners to drive adoption of engineering-driven operations and continuous reliability improvement across critical OT systems.

Responsibilities for this position may include but are not limited to

• Define and implement SRE practices, including SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets, to improve service reliability.

• Build and standardize observability capabilities across metrics, logs, and traces, including dashboards and alerting strategies.

• Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and postmortems to drive continuous improvement.

• Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps) to automate deployment, validation, and operational workflows.

• Integrate monitoring and observability signals with ServiceNow ITSM (incidents, changes, indicator tasks).

• Design and enable reusable automation components (e.g., pipelines, roles, validation frameworks) to scale use cases.

• Operate within OT/PCN environments, adhering to security, segmentation, and compliance standards.

• Leverage telemetry from infrastructure and compliance platforms (e.g., SolarWinds) to improve operational visibility.

• Collaborate with product owners, architects, and vendor partners in Agile ceremonies and technical working sessions.

• Produce and maintain technical documentation, including runbooks, architecture diagrams, and operational guides.

Required Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience operating production systems with a strong focus on observability and reliability engineering

• Hands-on experience with SRE practices (SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, incident management).

• Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps).

• Experience integrating monitoring and operations with ServiceNow ITSM workflows.

• Strong scripting skills in Python and/or PowerShell.

• Solid understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, correlation).

• Experience working in complex or regulated environments, preferably OT/PCN.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate across global teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in industrial or OT environments (oil and gas, utilities, manufacturing).

• Familiarity with SolarWinds or similar observability and compliance platforms.

• Experience with ServiceNow Service Mapping, CMDB, or automation integrations.

• Exposure to automation frameworks (e.g., Ansible) and reusable design patterns.

• Knowledge of security and compliance frameworks (e.g., CIS, NIST, ISA/IEC 62443).

• Experience working in Agile delivery models with backlog-driven development.

Relocation Options:
Relocation may be considered.

International Considerations:
Expatriate assignments will not be considered

Chevron participates in E-Verify in certain locations as required by law.

Reportando al Gerente de Calidad, este puesto es responsable de establecer, implementar y mantener el Control de calidad y los procedimientos a lo largo de las diversas etapas de fabricación para asegurar un producto terminado con la más alta calidad posible.

Principales Responsabilidades

· Desarrollar y mantener sistemas efectivos para lograr los objetivos de calidad de la Planta y la Compañía.
· Dirigir y liderar a los asociados de control de calidad para que realicen de manera efectiva el muestreo, las pruebas y los informes de datos de calidad requeridos.
· Establecer un sistema de calibración y mantenimiento de equipos de medición e instrumentos de calibre para garantizar la "exactitud" y confiabilidad de todos los instrumentos aplicables, dispositivos de medición, equipos de prueba, etc. durante todo el proceso de fabricación, así como en el Laboratorio.
· Identificar tendencias de calidad adversas como lo demuestra el análisis estadístico y ayudar al personal de ingeniería de procesos y/o fabricación en el desarrollo de acciones correctivas y preventivas.
· Investigar, evaluar y reportar el producto devuelto por los clientes, asegurando una acción correctiva completa a través del Sistema Diamond.
· Trabajar con el personal de la planta para seleccionar las técnicas de mejora de procesos más apropiadas.
· Asesorar en la resolución de problemas.
· Gestionar eficazmente las relaciones interfuncionales con otros departamentos para respaldar el uso eficaz de la mano de obra y los materiales para lograr el nivel deseado de calidad del producto.

¿A quién estamos buscando?

Calificaciones:

· Ingeniero/a Industrial o similar
· Inglés avanzado
· Orientado a resultados con capacidad demostrada trabajando en un entorno de fabricación de alto rendimiento.
· Experiencia comprobada en gestión de aseguramiento de la calidad.
· Atención a los detalles, con la capacidad de manejar el panorama general.
· Habilidad para manejar múltiples tareas complejas y lidiar fácilmente con la presión diaria.
· Capacidad para motivar, comunicar e impulsar la mejora continua.
· Buenas habilidades de comunicación escrita y oral.
· Sólidas habilidades de planificación, liderazgo y administración.
· Capacidad demostrada para instalar y mantener equipos de prueba electrónicos.
· Debe ser capaz de motivar, comunicar e impulsar la mejora continua.
· Energía alta; demuestra urgencia y ritmo rápido.
· Buena comprensión de los principios y prácticas comerciales; puede gestionar eficazmente la función de calidad con un resultado final impulsado por el cliente.

Calificaciones preferidas:

· Pensador crítico, con excelentes habilidades analíticas. El conocimiento/experiencia en instrumentos eléctricos/electrónicos y en pruebas es una ventaja.

Team overview and job responsibilities

Accountable to the Quality Manager, this position is responsible to establish, implement, direct, and maintain Quality Assurance and procedures throughout the various stages of manufacturing to assure a finished product with the highest quality possible.

Main Responsibilities

· Develop and maintain effective systems to achieve Plant and Company quality objectives.
· Direct and lead Quality Assurance associates to effectively perform required sampling, testing, and reporting of quality data.
· Establish measurement equipment and gage instrument maintenance and calibration system to ensure “accuracy” and reliability of all applicable instruments, measuring devices, testing equipment, etc. throughout the manufacturing process, as well as in the Laboratory.
· Identify adverse quality trends as evidenced by statistical analysis and assists process engineering and/or manufacturing personnel in the development of corrective and preventive actions.
· Investigate, evaluate, and report returned product from customers, ensuring complete corrective action through the Diamond System.
· Work with the plant staff to select most appropriate process improvement techniques.
· Mentor problem solving.
· Effectively manage cross-functional relationships with other departments to support effective use of manpower and materials to achieve the desired level of product quality.

Who are we looking for?

Qualifications:
· Industrial Engineer or similar
· Advanced English
· Results driven with demonstrated ability working in a high-performance manufacturing environment.
· Proven experience in quality assurance management.
· Attention to details, with the ability to manage the big picture.
· Ability to manage multiple, complex tasks and deal easily with pressure on a daily basis.
· Ability to motivate, communicate and drive continuous improvement.
· Good written and oral communication skills.
· Solid planning, leadership, and administrative skills.
· Demonstrated ability to install and maintain electronic test equipment.
· Must be able to motivate, communicate and drive continuous improvement.
· High energy; demonstrates urgency and fast pace.
· Good understanding of business principles and practices; can effectively manage the quality function with a customer driven bottom line result.

Preferred Qualifications:

· Critical thinker, with excellent analytical abilities. Electrical/electronic gage and testing knowledge/experience is a plus.

En YPF buscamos personas que quieran ser parte de un gran equipo que transforma desafíos en oportunidades y que actúa con excelencia para generar valor. Con más de cien años de historia, somos la compañía energética líder de la Argentina, impulsando el desarrollo y la innovación tecnológica del país.

¡Sumarte a YPF es unirte a un proyecto que combina experiencia, pasión y la energía necesaria para seguir construyendo nuestro futuro!



¿Qué buscamos?



Buscamos una persona proactiva, que cuente con iniciativa, autonomía, buenas relaciones personales y este orientado a resultados para desempeñarse como GESTOR PRODUCCION REAL TIME dentro de la VP UPSTREAM.

Tendrá a cargo el monitoreo y detección de desvíos en tiempo real, anticipando fallas con mirada técnica y analítica. Será protagonista en diagnósticos de primera respuesta generando impacto real en la operación.

Tendrá la responsabilidad de la operación remota en tiempo real de los activos a su cargo, desde la producción de pozos y Facilities de la región. Integrando una célula de trabajo en tiempo real junto con la jefatura de producción e ingeniero de producción en tiempo real. Garantizando la eficiencia, productividad, seguridad y disponibilidad de los activos a cargo.



¿Cuáles serán sus principales tareas?



1. Monitorear y operar en tiempo real las instalaciones bajo su responsabilidad mediante sistemas de control (PI, alarmas, SCADA), para asegurar que las operaciones se mantengan dentro de los parámetros establecidos y cumplan los objetivos definidos de producción, seguridad y disponibilidad

2. Coordinar y comunicar directrices operativas a colaboradores de campo, a fin de garantizar la integridad y seguridad del sistema.

3. Detectar y reportar desvíos operativos, generando alertas y activados protocolos definidos a fin de minimizar impactos en la seguridad, medio ambiente y producción

4. Monitorear KPI's en tiempos real de forma tal de ajustar parámetros operativos y o actividades de campo en búsqueda de la eficiencia.

5. Elaborar partes diarios de novedades y proyectados de producción para seguimiento en tiempo real, asegurando información precisa y trazable.

6. Informar y anticiparse a incumplimientos del programa cuando se identifican eventos no previstos, comunicando la necesidad al jefe de producción, para asegurar la adecuación operativa con fin de minimizar el impacto en la evacuación de crudo.

7. Coordinar con supervisor, recorredores y operadores en campo ante eventos/desvíos de las variables operativas, para validar condiciones reales y asegurar la ejecución de acciones correctivas en campo de corresponder.

• Formación académica: Graduados de Ingeniería (Electrónica, Petróleo, Industrial, Químico) o afines.

Un entorno donde podés aportar lo más valioso que tenés: tu energía. Esa energía que impulsa, que se adapta, que aprende, que suma, que transforma.

Sumarte a la #ExperienciaYPF es:

🤩 Impulsar tu desarrollo al siguiente nivel con nuevas oportunidades de aprendizaje.

• · Realizar y distribuir los partes diarios de producción, balances y novedades.

• · Conocer completamente el programa de actividades del sistema.

• · Conocer la operación de las distintas plantas teniendo en cuenta las condiciones y rangos de trabajo, calidad y especificaciones


• · Conocer programa de entrega del día y cumplir con las ventas de gas a los transportistas según las demandas diarias.


• · Coordinar con Despacho de Gas los programas de inyección a gasoductos según las demandas.

postings.title: INGENIERO PROYECTO
postings.descriptionText:
Sumá tu energía a la compañía que contribuye al desarrollo de nuestro país.




En YPF buscamos personas que quieran ser parte de un gran equipo que transforma desafíos en oportunidades y que actúa con excelencia para generar valor. Con más de cien años de historia, somos la compañía energética líder de la Argentina, impulsando el desarrollo y la innovación tecnológica del país.




¡Sumarte a YPF es unirte a un proyecto que combina experiencia, pasión y la energía necesaria para seguir construyendo nuestro futuro!



¿Qué buscamos?

Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un profesional de Ingeniería para sumarse al equipo de Ingeniería del Complejo Industrial La Plata - DWN. La persona que se sume al equipo deberá contar con habilidades de gestión de proyectos con el fin de liderar los cambios y mejoras aprobados por el comité de inversiones para el complejo. El puesto a cubrir es Ingeniero de proyectos de especialidad metalurgia.



¿Cuál será su desafío?

Supervisar, planificar y revisar el diseño y construcción de proyectos de nuevas instalaciones, ampliaciones y modificaciones de las instalaciones actuales, a los fines de prever con suficiente antelación la dotación de recursos requeridos para el complimiento de las especificaciones, presupuestos, plan de mejora y mantenimiento, de acuerdo con la legislación y normativas vigentes, las políticas de Seguridad, Calidad, Medio Ambiente y Energía de la Compañía y las directrices por su línea de Mando.



¿Cuáles serán sus principales tareas?

1. Participar y colaborar en el estudio de las propuestas de proyectos de inversión definiendo las especificaciones técnicas y valoraciones económicas de los mismos a fin de contribuir con el aporte de lineamientos e información que asegure la ejecución óptima de los proyectos.

2. Realizar la presupuestación de los distintos proyectos a cargo, que formarán parte de la elaboración del Plan Anual de Inversiones del Complejo con las necesidades de ejecución de los Proyectos a fin de asegurar el cumplimiento de los estándares de calidad, energía, seguridad y protección del medio ambiente.

3. Revisar y analizar la información contenida en los proyectos (Ingeniería Básica, análisis de riesgo, análisis de necesidad de desarrollo u optimización de sistemas de control de la producción y control multivariable, análisis de criterios de seguridad y medio ambiente), y analizar las distintas alternativas de ejecución, a fin de optimizar los procesos y los costos a partir de la selección de las alternativas adecuadas.

4. Gestionar los recursos disponibles en la ejecución de las inversiones, cumpliendo el presupuesto aprobado, los plazos de ejecución con la finalidad de contribuir con la obtención de mejoras operativas en las unidades.

5. Coordinar grupos de trabajos que abarquen las distintas especialidades del proyecto, y gestionar las reuniones necesarias entre las distintas áreas intervinientes del proyecto a fin de garantizar la alineación de los equipos al logro del objetivo en común.

6. Controlar y aprobar la información contenida en los planos de ingeniería, listado de materiales, especificaciones técnicas que aplican a los mismos, asegurando el cumplimiento de las especificaciones técnicas de la Compañía con la finalidad de proveer los lineamientos que aseguren la Ingeniería apta para construcción.

7. Elaborar los pliegos, descripción y requerimientos para la provisión de materiales y equipos, solicitar la compra de los mismos y evaluar técnicamente las propuestas obtenidas de los distintos oferentes con el propósito de garantizar el cumplimiento de las normas para la provisión de los mismos.

8. Elaborar los pliegos, descripción y requerimientos de la mano de obra, enviando toda la información generada (Memoria descriptiva, planos, requerimientos y especificaciones a cumplir en la ejecución, cuantificación de cantidades de tareas a ejecutar en la obra) a contratos para realizar la licitación de dichos servicios; evaluando técnicamente las propuestas obtenidas de los distintos oferentes, analizando al alcance de la oferta, recursos asignados, tiempos programados, conocimientos de Normas, Plan de Seguridad, Plan de Calidad, etc., a fin de garantizar la adjudicación de los recursos necesarios que cumplan con los requerimientos establecidos.

9. Asesorar y colaborar con el resto de las áreas de Complejo en las actividades que requieran la participación de grupos de trabajos interdisciplinares, abordando la resolución de problemas de índole técnico a fin de contribuir con el desarrollo de las actividades y proyectos agregando valor a la organización.

10. Actualizar la información y documentación técnica asociada a los proyectos asignados, a fin de garantizar la disponibilidad de la misma, la actualización y la integración a los sistemas informáticos y gestión documental de la organización.

11. Confeccionar el cash Flow de los proyectos de la unidad, incluyendo la planificación de obras, ingeniería y materiales. Elaborar curvas de erogación, proyección de avances, etc. a fin de garantizar la ejecución adecuada, la disponibilidad y el uso de los recursos de acuerdo con los lineamientos establecidos en la planificación y el presupuesto.

12. Identificar y evaluar los riesgos de seguridad y salud y los aspectos ambientales del sector, los consumos energéticos significativos definiendo las acciones necesarias para mantenerlos bajo control e implementar las mejoras en el desempeño que sean factibles de modo de contribuir con el desempeño SGI minimizando cualquier impacto negativo sobre la seguridad y salud de las personas y sobre el ambiente y la energía.

13. Interpretar las normativas del SGI transfiriendo al personal del área; participar en los procesos de auditoría y en la ejecución de acciones de mejora para asegurar el correcto funcionamiento y actualización del sistema.

14. Evaluar los requisitos legales aplicables en su ámbito e implementar las acciones necesarias en los proyectos a fin de contribuir con el cumplimiento legal ejecutando las evaluaciones y evidencias necesarias de dicho cumplimiento.



¿Qué valoramos?

· Formación académica: Ingeniería Mecánica, Industrial, Química o afines.

· Competencias: Comunicación, coordinación, trabajo colaborativo resolución de problemas, adaptabilidad. Conocimiento general sobre metalurgia (no excluyente).

· Herramientas: Paquete Office, Project, software específico de la especialidad.

Santa Fe (AR-S)

En Bunge buscamos candidatos al rol de Negociador de Compras Sr (Packaging) para sumarse al equipo de Procurement en Puerto General San Martín, Santa Fe .

La posición tendrá un rol activo en la gestión estratégica de categorías de packaging, participando en procesos de sourcing, análisis de mercado, licitaciones y negociaciones con proveedores, con el objetivo de asegurar competitividad, continuidad de suministro y generación de valor para el negocio.

Buscamos una persona con fuerte capacidad analítica, curiosidad comercial y vocación por la negociación, interesada en desarrollar su carrera dentro de Procurement. Ubicación:



Puerto General San Martin, Santa Fe.


En Bunge (NYSE: BG), nuestro propósito es conectar a los agricultores con los consumidores para entregar alimentos, piensos y combustibles esenciales al mundo. Con más de 200 años de experiencia y presencia en más de 50 países, estamos comprometidos a fortalecer la seguridad alimentaria mundial, promover la sostenibilidad y ayudar a las comunidades a prosperar donde operamos. • HACEMOS LO CORRECTO – Con seguridad, sustentabilidad e integridad

Reconocemos que nuestro éxito depende de las diversas perspectivas que cada uno de nuestros colaboradores aporta a Bunge. Nos esforzamos por promover acciones que fomenten una cultura de pertenencia. postings.descriptionText:
Quiénes somos



AngloGold Ashanti es una compañía minera global de oro con una cartera diversificada de operaciones de alta calidad, proyectos y actividades de exploración en 10 países a lo largo de cuatro continentes. Buscamos constantemente oportunidades para crear valor a través de otros minerales, apalancando nuestros activos, habilidades y sólida experiencia en el sector.



En AngloGold Ashanti, aseguramos un entorno de trabajo significativo que genera resultados tangibles, entendiendo que nuestra labor trasciende la minería:





• Impacto Social y Económico: Construimos medios de vida en las comunidades, defendemos una gestión ambiental responsable y fortalecemos las economías tanto locales como nacionales.


• Cultura Colaborativa: Nuestros líderes y equipos están comprometidos con la escucha activa y el apoyo mutuo, valorando la diversidad y promoviendo la equidad en cada acción.


• Bienestar Integral: Estamos convencidos de que la excelencia solo se alcanza cuando priorizamos el bienestar de cada persona y fomentamos comportamientos basados en el respeto.





Sobre Cerro Vanguardia



Cerro Vanguardia es una empresa minera argentina dedicada a la exploración y tratamiento de oro y plata en la provincia de Santa Cruz. Desde 1998, funciona como un motor de desarrollo regional, promoviendo la explotación responsable de recursos y el crecimiento de comunidades como Puerto San Julián. Su misión se centra en generar valor para sus empleados y accionistas garantizando un ambiente seguro y protegido.



Conozca más sobre nuestra visión, propósito y valores - AngloGold Ashanti




Visión del puesto:

Contribuir a la planificación, coordinación y ejecución eficiente de proyectos de obras civiles mediante el seguimiento técnico, operativo, contractual y financiero de las actividades desarrolladas por contratistas. La función implica supervisar el cumplimiento de los plazos, costos y estándares de calidad establecidos, optimizando la utilización de recursos y asegurando el desarrollo de las obras conforme a los objetivos de la compañía.

Propósito del rol:

Coordinar y controlar la ejecución de obras civiles, garantizando el cumplimiento de los programas de trabajo, presupuestos, contratos y estándares de calidad. Realizar el seguimiento integral de los proyectos, supervisando las actividades de los contratistas y asegurando una gestión eficiente de los recursos, plazos y costos.

Principales responsabilidades:

- Planificar, coordinar y realizar el seguimiento de proyectos de obras civiles.
- Supervisar la ejecución de las obras a través de contratistas, verificando el cumplimiento de los plazos, costos y especificaciones técnicas.
- Realizar el control de avance físico y financiero de los proyectos.
- Gestionar y verificar las certificaciones de obra, asegurando su correspondencia con los trabajos ejecutados.
- Realizar el seguimiento contractual de los contratistas y controlar el cumplimiento de las obligaciones establecidas.
- Coordinar los recursos técnicos, logísticos y operativos necesarios para el desarrollo de las obras.
- Identificar desvíos, anticipar riesgos y proponer acciones correctivas para garantizar el cumplimiento de los objetivos.
- Elaborar informes de avance, cronogramas y reportes de seguimiento de los proyectos.
- Liderar y coordinar equipos de trabajo y contratistas tercerizados.
- Mantener una comunicación permanente con las áreas involucradas para asegurar la continuidad y correcta ejecución de los proyectos.

Requisitos obligatorios:

- Título universitario de Ingeniero/a Civil o Arquitecto/a.
- Experiencia comprobable en coordinación, supervisión y ejecución de obras civiles.
- Experiencia en gestión y seguimiento de contratistas tercerizados.
- Conocimientos de control de obras, certificaciones y seguimiento contractual.
- Experiencia en planificación y control de presupuestos, costos y plazos de ejecución.
- Manejo de AutoCAD.
- Manejo de Microsoft Office para elaboración de informes y certificaciones.
- Manejo de Microsoft Project para planificación y seguimiento de obras.

Cualificaciones deseables:

- Liderazgo y capacidad de gestión de equipos.
- Planificación, organización y gestión del tiempo.
- Pensamiento crítico y capacidad analítica.
- Proactividad y capacidad de anticipación.
- Resolución de problemas y toma de decisiones.
- Comunicación efectiva y trabajo en equipo.
- Metodología de trabajo orientada al seguimiento y control de resultados.
- Orientación al cumplimiento de objetivos, plazos y costos.

Condiciones de la posición:

- Modalidad de trabajo bajo diagrama 5x2.
- Lugar de trabajo: Puerto San Julián, Santa Cruz.
- Posición con responsabilidad de coordinación y seguimiento de contratistas tercerizados.
- Disponibilidad para atender comunicaciones o requerimientos operativos puntuales durante los días de descanso, según las necesidades de los proyectos.


Beneficios y Compromiso con el Colaborador y la Comunidad



Cerro Vanguardia prioriza la calidad de vida y el bienestar integral de sus colaboradores, ofreciendo iniciativas orientadas al desarrollo, salud, apoyo familiar y fortalecimiento del ambiente laboral. Entre las principales acciones se destacan programas de vínculo familiar, monitoreo ambiental participativo, asistencia integral al empleado, bienestar personal, asesoramiento técnico y gestión de liderazgo.



Además, la compañía brinda acceso a servicios especializados de salud, apoyo psicológico, nutricional y asesoramiento profesional para empleados y sus familias, reforzando su compromiso con un entorno seguro, colaborativo y sostenible. Los programas e iniciativas están sujetos a las políticas internas y criterios aplicables de Cerro Vanguardia.



Declaración de Igualdad de Oportunidades de Empleo



Estamos transformando la minería con una cultura de equidad, inclusión y respeto. Valoramos a cada persona y creemos que la diversidad de historias, ideas y perspectivas impulsa nuestro crecimiento.

About the Role

As an Animator / 2D Motion Designer, you’ll be a semi-senior creative force on high-profile brand marketing campaigns spanning social content, hero video, motion graphics, and typographic animation. Operating within a dedicated client team, you’ll own the animation process end-to-end—from concept and pre-production through final delivery—collaborating with creative directors, producers, illustrators, and animators across a global team. We are looking for someone who is collaborative, proactive, and able to manage their own time independently while delivering high-quality work under tight deadlines.

Responsibilities:

•
Own the full animation lifecycle—pre-production assessment, creative scoping, execution, and final delivery—across social assets, complex hero videos, and multi-platform campaign toolkits.

•
Lead early-stage creative ideation alongside art directors and creative leads, translating briefs and copy into high-quality motion work across formats, languages, and dimensions.

•
Build and optimize production templates that improve speed and consistency for the broader global animation team.

•
Maintain brand integrity across all deliverables—consistent across ad formats, platforms, and languages—while proactively flagging risks and unfeasible timelines before they become problems.

•
Champion and integrate generative AI tools into your workflow, staying ahead of market trends and helping the team adopt new techniques and software.

•
Present work and contribute to creative conversations with support from the craft director, collaborating with producers and cross-functional teams across multiple offices worldwide.

•
Support and mentor junior and semi-senior animators, actively sharing progress, problems, and creative solutions across the team.

About You

The essentials:

•
3+ years of professional experience in motion design and 2D animation, with a portfolio demonstrating ownership across brand campaigns, social content, and hero video production.

•
Advanced proficiency in After Effects, Premiere, Photoshop, Illustrator, and Figma, knowing how to execute the fundamentals right and when to break the rules for creative effect.

•
Hands-on experience with generative AI tools—Runway, MidJourney, Adobe Firefly, Whisk, or similar—with a genuine drive to stay current as the toolset evolves.

•
Strong visual design sensibility across typography, colour, layout, and composition in both static and motion contexts.

•
Proven ability to manage your own time, flag risks early, and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines independently.

•
Intermediate to advanced English proficiency (written and verbal) to work fluidly with international teams, communicate blockers clearly, and present creative work.

•
Collaborative mindset, equally comfortable leading a creative direction, mentoring a junior, or taking notes from a craft director.

Not a must, but a plus:

postings.descriptionText:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com .

The Role

At WPP Production, Senior Front-End Developers deliver rich, immersive, and performant digital interactions that bring our clients' storytelling to life. You will help create sophisticated consumer experiences by building and maintaining a mature, large-scale design system and a proprietary ecosystem of shared libraries and global elements (headers, footers, media galleries, analytics wrappers) used by multiple independent development teams using advanced HTML, CSS, and Javascript.

Embedded in a hybrid US and Argentina team, you will manage interdependent code repositories, resolve cross-repository dependencies, and collaborate with designers and engineers to define interaction behaviors.

Above all, your technical voice is just as important as your code. We thrive on open debate and live collaboration—As a Senior Developer we expect you to actively share your technical perspectives, challenge assumptions, and help drive design and engineering decisions.

What does a Producer do at WPP Production?
 

The Role

The Audiovisual Producer are responsible for end-to-end project management, management of client relationships, agency relationships while leading a diverse and dynamic team to deliver. They play an important role in ensuring the smooth operations and delivery excellence of their clients’ projects.

He/she is responsible for delivering a completed project on time, on specification, and on budget.

The successful candidate will use their superior problem-solving skills, a passion for production, marketing and advertising and a desire to learn. They are highly organized and accountable leaders, who are able to build relationships and collaborate drawing on the expertise of Hogarth’s resources and capabilities. 

Key Areas of Responsibilities

Communication

• The key day-to-day project contact with lower to mid-level clients and creative agencies

• Possesses accurate sense of client satisfaction level - facilitates the sharing client feedback with the team and management; sensitive to the client's needs and concerns

• Takes accountability to ensure that all team members are aware of timelines and deliverables

Collaboration

• Develops and maintains high levels of team effectiveness (trust, communication, collaboration, productivity diversity and engagement)

• Serves as a mentor/coach to junior producers

 

Process

• Manage medium- to large-sized projects independently, from initiation through completion

• Serve as the production expert on audiovisual campaigns, working with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced agency Must be used to work with people in charge and in several projects at the same time.

• Manages client objectives, budget, expectations, deliverables and timelines and communicating changes/directions to team members

• Keeps projects on track through clear task lists, issue tracking, status reports, and meeting notes

 

Financial Management

• Demonstrates strong commercial abilities and business and financial acumen

• Works with interdisciplinary teams of creative, production and technologists to define and develop scopes and estimates of projects (goals, deliverables, schedule, and budget), helping to translate creative concepts into clear sets of deliverables with proper staffing

• Owns project budget and tracking of all ongoing costs throughout project lifecycle, reconcile estimates to actuals on all projects, and resolution of budget discrepancies between disciplines, vendors and clients

 

Day to day tasks can include

• Develops and maintaining scopes, timelines and budgets

• Coordinates and partners with Hogarth’s global production network to ensure global campaign launches are successful and work is completed

• Manages status documents, agendas, contact reports, trackers and day to day communication with teams and client

• Liaises with clients/agencies/suppliers to obtain schedules, briefs, assets, technical specifications

• Responsible for managing the talent and traffic teams at Hogarth

• Manages of POs, financial reporting, tracking, billing against all project budgets

 

Requirements

• 5+ years of production experience in an integrated agency or production house. Professional experience in Offline, Online and 2D, 3D & compo, audio & media production, shooting, AI, quotation

• General knowledge of the LATAM industry. And unions like SADAIC, SAL, SICA, AAA in Argentina.

• Solid understanding of production, postproduction and the creative development process. Knowledge of the whole postproduction process from start to finish.

• Experience with data handling & assets managements, buyouts and formats

• Successful history of project leadership to clients and account, with demonstrable experience in setting

• Ability to medium to complex projects with varying components, demonstrating ability to deliver on time and on budget

• Proven negotiation skills

• Fluent in English.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, workflow tools, online project management/collaboration/ticketing tools e.g. JIRA, Sharepoint, Smartsheet, etc.

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

About the Skuad Acquisition

Back in August 2024, Payoneer acquired Skuad. Skuad's expertise helps businesses in over 160 countries navigate complex challenges such as international payroll, remote onboarding, and regulatory compliance. This acquisition reinforces Payoneer's mission and solidifies Skuad's role as a trusted partner for global workforce management (WFM).

This role will be part of our WFM business unit.

Role Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive HR Operations Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing the end-to-end employee lifecycle — including onboarding, offboarding, query resolution, and compliance. You’ll be a key player in ensuring smooth experiences for employees and clients across various geographies while maintaining adherence to local labor laws and SLAs.

Location – Argentina

What you’ll do

Onboarding & Offboarding:

• Manage end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes as per defined SLAs

• Coordinate with internal teams, clients, and third-party vendors to ensure seamless transitions

• Trigger communication workflows and ensure document compliance

Employee Helpdesk Management:

• Resolve HR-related help requests in a timely and empathetic manner

• Collaborate cross-functionally with payroll, legal, and tech teams to resolve employee queries

• Maintain documentation and response logs for audits and process improvements

Compliance & Labor Law Adherence:

• Stay updated with labor laws and statutory regulations in assigned countries

• Ensure all HR processes and documentation are compliant with local employment laws

• Work closely with legal teams to implement policy updates as needed

SLA Monitoring & Reporting:

• Track service level agreements for onboarding/offboarding and help requests

• Generate weekly/monthly reports on operational efficiency and issue resolution metrics

• Identify process gaps and suggest continuous improvement initiatives

Who you are

• +5 years of experience in HR operations or employee lifecycle management

• Strong understanding of Latin America HR processes and local labor laws

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

• Familiarity with HR systems (e.g., Zoho People, BambooHR, or similar) is a plus

The Payoneer Ways of Working

Act as our customer’s partner on the inside
Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.

Do it. Own it.
Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.

Continuously improve
Always striving for a higher standard than our last.

Build each other up
Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.

If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.

Nos apasiona co-crear soluciones innovadoras junto a nuestros clientes. Combinamos experiencia, calidad y escalabilidad para desarrollar productos estratégicos y de misión crítica. Nos destaca nuestra obsesión por aportar valor rápido y de calidad.

Buscamos Sr DevOps Engineer con ganas de sumarse a una compañía nativa digital. Queremos incorporar personas apasionadas por el ecosistema financiero, que quieran trabajar en soluciones que generen impacto real en los negocios y en las personas que las usan.


Por requisitos del cliente, esta vacante es híbrida con una presencialidad de una vez por semana en las oficinas del cliente en Parque Patricios, CABA. 
 
También, cuenta con guardias rotativas.

¿Cuáles serán tus desafios?
• Proveer soporte y evolucionar la infraestructura en AWS (EKS, Cognito, Lambda) y entornos Tanzu, asegurando estabilidad y escalabilidad.

• Diagnosticar y resolver incidentes en sistemas cloud y on-premise, garantizando disponibilidad, resiliencia y desempeño.

• Configurar y mantener pipelines de CI/CD y GitOps (GitLab, ArgoCD), asegurando despliegues eficientes y confiables.

• Implementar prácticas de observabilidad (logging, métricas y tracing) y colaborar en estrategias de recuperación ante desastres y tolerancia a fallos.- Optimizar costos en la nube, automatizar procesos y asegurar la infraestructura mediante buenas prácticas de seguridad (OAuth, JWT, OIDC, HTTPS).

¿Qué esperamos de vos?
• +5 años de experiencia sólida en infraestructura AWS, especialmente EKS, Cognito y Lambda, y conocimientos en Kubernetes/Tanzu.

• Experiencia configurando y gestionando pipelines CI/CD en GitLab y herramientas GitOps como ArgoCD.

• Conocimientos en observabilidad, alta disponibilidad, resiliencia y estrategias de recuperación ante fallos.

• Experiencia aplicando buenas prácticas de seguridad en infraestructura

• Proactividad, capacidad analítica, buenas habilidades de comunicación y disponibilidad para implementaciones fuera de horario cuando sea necesario, coordinado con el líder de cliente.

About Lemon.io
Lemon.io is a profitable, growing talent marketplace that connects vetted senior engineers with companies that need them. We’ve been in business for 10 years, have 60 people across Ukraine, Europe, Canada, and the US, and process over $16M in annual GMV. We compress the traditional 2–5 week hiring timeline down to 24–48 hours through a curated, pre-vetted supply of developers.
Hiring is still broken. Recruiters spend weeks building candidate pipelines on traditional platforms, burning energy on unqualified leads. We’re building the product that changes that. Giving recruiters qualified, vetted candidates within 24 hours without the grind. This is a pivotal moment: we’re transitioning from a services-driven marketplace to a technology-driven platform. We need an engineering leader who can drive that transformation.

The Role
You will own engineering at Lemon.io . You’ll lead a growing team of engineers, make critical architecture and prioritization decisions, and be directly accountable for the speed and quality of what we ship. This is not a management-layer role. You’ll be hands-on, deeply involved in product decisions, and working side by side with the founder.

What You’ll Do:

• Own the technical roadmap and make sure every engineering effort maps directly to business impact. No features for features’ sake.

• Lead and grow an engineering team that ships fast, iterates constantly, and treats complexity as a cost.

• Tackle the hard, multi-layered problem: automated vetting, intelligent matching at scale, demand-side bottlenecks. And figure out where the real leverage is.

• Make hard prioritization calls. Decide what we build, what we skip, and what we kill.

• Work directly with the founder and product team to define what success looks like before writing a single line of code.

• Build the engineering culture: high ownership, high speed, low bureaucracy.

Who You Are:

• Product-minded, business-first

• Obsessed with simplicity

• First principles thinker

• Fast. Bias toward action

Experience:

• You’ve led engineering teams (5–30+ people) at a startup or high-growth company.

• You have hands-on experience with modern stacks and are comfortable with AI/ML tooling.

• You’ve worked in a distributed, async-first team.

Why Lemon.io :

• Profitable and growing. No fundraising pressure, real business fundamentals.

• A pivotal moment: you’re not maintaining an engine, you’re building one. The product roadmap is wide open.

• Direct access to the founder. No layers. Your decisions ship.

• A massive, unsolved problem: hiring is still broken. We’re building the product that makes it radically faster for companies to find qualified engineers.

• A team of 60 people who move fast, care deeply, and have survived the hard years together.

postings.title: Cloud Support Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Cloud Support Engineer to build a career with Canonical and support the technical needs of customers leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have an affinity for open source development and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

While our engineers regularly solve deeply interesting, complex technical problems - from triaging cloud environments to root-cause analysis on unseen Linux kernel crashes - this is fundamentally a role rooted in human connection. You will act as a trusted peer and technical guide to external engineering teams, translating intricate open-source challenges into clear, empathetic solutions. We are rapidly expanding and looking for brilliant problem solvers who are just as passionate about building strong, collaborative relationships with customers as they are about the next generation of Canonical solutions.

Location: This is a globally remote role.

The role entails

• Empathetic Engagement: Partner directly with customers across remote sessions, ticketing,, and live conversations to deeply understand and resolve their technical roadblocks.

• Collaborative Problem Solving: Work hand-in-hand with internal engineering teams and regional peer groups to bridge the gap between complex code fixes and real-world customer satisfaction.

• True Ownership: Manage your support cases with a strong sense of personal integrity, ensuring commitments are honored and customer expectations are communicated transparently and predictably.

• Ubuntu Lifecycle Guidance: Develop a rich understanding of the Ubuntu development process, empowering you to give customers clear, human context regarding timelines for engineering fixes.

• Knowledge Advocacy: Author and maintain accessible knowledge base articles, ensuring lessons learned are shared openly to elevate the entire open-source community.

• Operational Reliability: Participate in a regular weekend working rotation to maintain seamless, high-touch continuity of care for our global partners.

What are we looking for in you

• Communication Excellence: Exceptional written and spoken English, with a natural ability to convey technical complexity clearly, warmly, and compellingly.

• The Soft-Skill Edge: A genuine passion for helping people, paired with the emotional intelligence to navigate high-stakes technical situations with composure and empathy.

• Academic Dedication: Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.

• Educational Background: An undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.

• Driven Mindset: A proven track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to deliver meaningful, outstanding results for teams or customers.

• Linux & Cloud Familiarity: Practical, hands-on experience supporting Linux systems, with an exposure to three or more of the following:

• Virtualization & Cloud: Using KVM or OpenStack.

• Containers: primarily Docker, LXD/LXC, or Kubernetes.

• Storage Ecosystems: Block, object, and network storage technologies.

• System Networking: Navigating bonding, firewalls, bridging, switching, or MTU tuning.

• Analytical Curiosity: A strong troubleshooting mindset—the ability to look into stack traces or logs, identify OS/application-level bugs, and strategically guide the customer through next steps.

• Development Fundamentals: Basic programming logic in any language to help parse code and collaborate effectively with Canonical Engineering teams.

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Maternity and paternity leave

• Employee Assistance Programme

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

• Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

postings.title: Lifecycle Marketing Automation Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
The Role We Need:

We are seeking a Lifecycle Marketing Automation Specialist dedicated to supporting supply-side growth by building, optimizing, and scaling communication journeys for our Host community. In this role, you won't just monitor existing flow, you will actively design, build, and deploy data-driven campaigns across the entire host lifecycle: driving initial lead acquisition, nurturing prospective hosts into qualified opportunities, guiding them through activation, and securing long-term retention. Utilizing our core stack and Segment, you will bridge marketing operations and technical execution to build multi-channel experiences across email, SMS, push notifications, and in-app messaging.

The Person We Are Looking For:

We are looking for a hands-on, detail-obsessed builder who understands how lifecycle marketing touches every stage of the host journey. While you keep the big picture in mind, you thrive in the tactical details that make campaigns succeed. You are a strong team player who excels in a highly collaborative environment, partnering closely with cross-functional teams to ensure campaigns align with broader business goals.

As a hands-on Specialist, you focus on practical execution. You can take a campaign brief and event payload to build end-to-end journeys, defining triggers, eligibility, exclusions, and exit criteria, or analyze a broken workflow to find and fix the root cause. You combine strong technical skills across our platforms (leveraging Pardot, SFMC, and Salesforce CRM for supply-side pipeline management while driving high-volume campaigns in Iterable) with a critical eye, knowing when to verify data anomalies and overlapping flows before launching a campaign.

Here’s What You’ll Do Day-To-Day:

• Build, Execute & Optimize Lifecycle Journeys: Design, build, execute, and optimize multi-channel campaigns across email, SMS, push notifications, and other owned channels to engage prospective and active hosts effectively.

• Manage Automation Flow Performance: Monitor and maintain automation flows to ensure campaigns are delivered consistently and perform at a high level.

• Manage & Integrate Marketing Stack: Work directly inside Iterable , Pardot , Salesforce Marketing Cloud , and Salesforce CRM to ensure seamless data flow, segment syncs, lead scoring, and campaign triggering across host lifecycle stages.

• Troubleshoot HTML and CSS: Troubleshoot HTML and CSS issues to ensure communications render properly across various devices and platforms.

• Conduct A/B Testing: Conduct A/B testing and experimentation to identify strategies that optimize user engagement and campaign success.

• Analyze Performance Data Insights: Analyze performance data and generate insights to enhance the effectiveness of marketing strategies.

• Collaborate on Campaign Content: Collaborate with creative and cross-functional teams to refine content and visuals for multi-channel campaigns.

Here’s What You’ll Need To Be Successful:

• Marketing Automation & Stack Experience: 1–3 years of hands-on experience in lifecycle marketing, marketing operations, or automation, with a proven track record of building workflows from scratch. Direct experience using Iterable, Pardot, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC).

• Audience Segmentation & Data Verification: Working knowledge of SQL (or platform segmentation engines) to query audience tables, validate host event data, and build targeted segments.

• System Connections & Event Triggers: Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON payloads, and Webhooks to understand event mappings and help trigger real-time, automated flows. Able to communicate technical requirements effectively with Product and Data teams.

• Dynamic Content & Personalization: Practical experience using scripting languages (such as Liquid syntax, AMPscript, or basic JavaScript) to apply conditional logic and render personalized content.

• Email Template & HTML Troubleshooting: Functional knowledge of HTML/CSS to make edits, update layouts, and troubleshoot responsive email templates across devices.

• A/B Testing Expertise: Experience in A/B testing and the ability to interpret results to drive improvements.

• Prioritization Skills: Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

• Stay Updated on Trends: Knowledge of multi-channel marketing trends and best practices to stay ahead in a competitive industry.

• Detail-Oriented: Strong attention to detail, ensuring accuracy and quality in all aspects of marketing execution.

The Interview Process:

• Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by the Hiring Manager.

• If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a phone screen with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes.

• If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our Sr Lifecycle Marketing Automation Specialist for thirty (30) minutes.

• If warranted, the next step would be a forty-five (45) minute interview with our Director of Lifecycle Marketing.

• If warranted, the final step would be a video interview with a small panel of key stakeholders for one (1) hour. For this interview, a candidate would execute a live assessment to the panel for discussion.

• If warranted, then we move to offer!

Compensation

Compensation is based on the role's scope, market benchmarks, the person's expertise and experience, and the impact of their contributions to our business goals.

postings.title: Account Executive I
postings.descriptionText:
The Role We Need:

PadSplit is growing rapidly, and we’re expanding our Sales team to meet increasing demand from property owners and real estate investors eager to join our mission. As we continue to scale, we need driven Account Executives who can connect new partners to the PadSplit platform and help unlock more affordable housing opportunities across the country.

The Person We Are Looking For:

We’re seeking a tenacious, optimistic problem-solver who thrives in a dynamic startup environment. The ideal candidate loves sales, cares about helping people, and can blend hustle with high integrity. You’re excited by challenge, passionate about purpose-driven work, and ready to help PadSplit change the world—one room at a time.

Here's What You'll Do Day-To-Day:

• Lead Qualification: Identify and qualify new prospects from a mix of inbound (80%) and outbound (20%) leads.

• Prospecting & Outreach: Execute high-volume cold calling, emailing, and social selling to meet monthly KPIs.

• Sales Execution: Deliver tailored pitches that demonstrate the superior financial and social impact of PadSplit.

• Presentations & Webinars: Host group presentations for real estate investors to showcase PadSplit’s value proposition.

• Pipeline Management: Maintain accurate deal flow in Salesforce and SalesLoft, ensuring timely follow-ups.

• Collaboration: Work closely with Sales Ops, Marketing, and Customer Success to create a seamless partner experience.

• Feedback Loop: Share customer insights to help refine our sales strategy and influence product development.

• Goal Achievement: Consistently meet or exceed monthly and quarterly sales targets.

Here's What You'll Need To Be Successful:

• Sales Experience: 2+ years in consultative B2B inside sales, with a track record of exceeding goals.

• Outbound Skills: Proficiency in phone, email, and text-based prospecting and outreach.

• CRM Proficiency: Skilled in managing accurate data and workflow within Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar tools.

• Relationship Building: Strong ability to engage, educate, and influence small to mid-market clients.

• Communication: Confident speaking and presenting over video to groups or individuals.

• Industry Interest: Curiosity and enthusiasm for real estate and the future of housing innovation.

• Cultural Fit: Embodies PadSplit’s values—compassionate directness, integrity, optimism, curiosity, empathy, and strong work ethic.

• Bonus Experience: Background in real estate investment or prior success in an early-stage startup sales role.

The Interview Process:

• Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by the Hiring Manager

• If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a phone screen with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes

• If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our Revenue Ops Lead for forty-five (45) minutes

• If warranted, the final step would be a video panel interview with our with our Sales Leadership team presenting research from a Case Study.

• If warranted, then we move to offer!

Compensation

Compensation is based on the role's scope, market benchmarks, the person's expertise and experience, and the impact of their contributions to our business goals. In addition to the base salary, there is a commission component:

The base salary range for an Account Executive I is $20,000-$30,000 USD with a variable commission structure.

Variable: $25 per room expansion
On-Target Variable Commission is 480 rooms/year, or $12,000 in variable compensation

postings.title: Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Core
postings.descriptionText:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring technical engineering manager to redefine the embedded Linux experience with the smallest, most secure, and most reliable operating system in the IoT market.

This is an opportunity for a technical leader passionate about open source software, Linux, containers, security, and the developer experience, to shape the future of Linux from the smallest systems up to desktops. This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill as well as high caliber for inspiring and driving people.

Our mission is to allow everyone to build robust solutions in various fields including but not limited to IoT, automotive, and aviation using the next generation secure embedded Linux operating system in a simple solution. We define a reliable and secure set of device recovery mechanisms that enable device manufacturers to simplify and standardize the field operations for fleets of heterogeneous appliances.

As an engineering manager, you’ll lead a team of strong software developers to design and implement Ubuntu Core system software on various CPU architectures, such as ARM, RISC-V, and X86. You will meet stakeholders, prioritize requests, plan the roadmap and ensure the team can deliver their goals. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

The role entails

• Building and leading a distributed team of engineers through hiring, coaching, mentoring, feedback and career development

• Demonstrating sound engineering principles by directly contributing toward your team’s goals

• Coaching and mentoring team members with hands-on career development

• Effectively setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders

• Advocating and advancing modern, agile software development practices and helping develop and evangelize great engineering and organizational practices

• Contributing to a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values

• Actively participating in the leadership team and collaborating with other leaders in the organisation

What we are looking for in you

• Demonstrated competencies in embedded software development

• Strong skills in Golang, C++ and Shell

• A solid understanding of Linux and a modern GNU/Linux distribution, Debian or Ubuntu preferred

• Love for developing and growing people and have a track record of doing it

• Demonstrated ability of planning and executing to deliver high quality software in a timely manner

• Solid experience working in an agile development environment

• Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

• Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path

• Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills

Nice-to-have skills

• Familiarity with an immutable Linux distribution, preferably Ubuntu Core

• Experience with multiple CPU architectures such as ARM, RISC-V

• Experience with Linux native containerization and security

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Maternity and paternity leave

• Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

• Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2025—and we need a Casting Associate who can find the fresh faces and authentic voices that power our high-performance content.

Why This Role Matters
Faces, authenticity, and performance are your playground. As a Casting Associate, you are the gatekeeper of our creative output. You’ll be responsible for hunting down the perfect talent—from polished actors and models to authentic UGC creators and real-world testimonials—that align with our clients' brands.
In the world of performance marketing, the right face can double the results of an ad. Your ability to scout, vet, and book top-tier talent at speed will directly impact the success of our campaigns and the growth of our agency. If you have an eye for talent and thrive on the thrill of the hunt, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

•

Scout & Source Talent

• Relentlessly hunt for new talent across social media (Instagram, TikTok), casting platforms, and agencies.

• Identify diverse actors, models, and UGC creators who fit the specific demographic and aesthetic needs of top DTC brands.

• Build and maintain a robust internal database of go-to talent for quick activation.

•

Manage Outreach & Vetting

• Handle high-volume outreach to potential talent, checking availability, rates, and interest.

• Conduct initial screening calls and review self-tapes to ensure talent meets High Scale’s quality and energy standards.

• Negotiate rates and usage terms within project budgets.

•

Coordinate Casting Logistics

• Organize casting calls (virtual and in-person) and manage self-tape submissions for Producer review.

• Create polished "casting decks" and presentation materials for internal teams and clients to review.

• Ensure all talent paperwork, releases, and contracts are signed and organized before shoots begin.

•

Stay Ahead of Trends

• Keep a pulse on social media trends to understand what "look" and "vibe" is currently performing well in ads.

• Proactively scout for emerging talent pools and new platforms to find untapped creators.

Who You Are

•

A Talent Magnet

• 1–3 years of experience in casting, talent management, or production (agency or freelance).

• You have a sharp eye for charisma and authenticity—you know who has "it" the moment you see them.

•

Social Media Native

• You live on TikTok and Instagram. You know how to search hashtags, find creators, and slide into DMs professionally to get results.

• You understand the difference between a "TV commercial actor" and a "TikTok creator."

Excellent Communicator

Organized & Fast-Paced

Resourceful & Persistent

postings.title: Web Developer & Marketing Technology Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
We are knowmad mood !
We are a leading digital transformation company, constantly evolving and at the forefront of technology. We were born to drive real change through innovation and sustainable development, with the mission of delivering value to our clients and empowering our talent.
Our team is made up of more than 3,000 creative, digital, and innovative professionals connected by a shared purpose and capable of building meaningful connections with people around the world. We are a responsible, flexible, and highly adaptable team, committed to meeting our clients' and the market’s needs while providing value, vision, creativity, expertise, professionalism, and passion for technology in every project.
The values that define our path and guide us toward excellence are collaboration, innovation, commitment, enjoyment, and trust .
Role purpose: Take technical ownership of the agency-built website after launch, maintain its performance and security, and progressively expand the site to support campaigns, customer journeys, lead generation and business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Website ownership, maintenance and support

• Own the technical operation of the corporate website following agency handover, ensuring the platform remains reliable, secure, accessible and scalable.

• Manage WordPress core, themes, plugins, hosting configurations, backups, security patches and routine technical updates.

• Monitor site availability, performance and Core Web Vitals; diagnose and resolve defects, broken functionality and integration issues.

• Manage development, staging and production environments, including testing, release management and rollback procedures.

• Maintain technical documentation, access controls, configuration records and website governance standards.

Website development and expansion

• Build and publish responsive landing pages, campaign pages, product and solution pages, forms, microsites and reusable content components.

• Develop and enhance WordPress themes, templates and custom functionality using clean, maintainable code.

• Convert approved designs and Figma files into accurate, responsive and accessible web experiences.

• Extend the initial agency-built website over time, introducing new sections, user journeys, capabilities and integrations based on business priorities.

• Test new functionality across devices and browsers and ensure releases meet quality, security and performance standards.

Marketing technology and integrations

• Support the technical integration of WordPress with HubSpot, Salesforce, analytics, and other approved marketing platforms.

• Build and maintain HubSpot forms, landing-page functionality, tracking and campaign-related website components.

• Ensure accurate, secure data capture and reliable flow between website forms, HubSpot and downstream systems.

• Troubleshoot APIs, scripts, tags, plugins and third-party integrations in partnership with Marketing Operations and IT.

• Support the ongoing evolution of the marketing technology stack through configuration, testing, documentation and technical recommendations.

Performance, SEO, analytics and compliance

• Implement technical SEO requirements, including metadata frameworks, structured URLs, XML sitemaps, redirects, schema and indexation controls.

• Maintain Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking in partnership with Marketing Operations.

• Improve site speed, usability, accessibility and conversion performance using data, testing and user feedback.

• Support GDPR, cookie consent, privacy, security and WCAG accessibility requirements across website experiences.

Agency and cross-functional collaboration

• Lead the technical handover from the website agency, including codebase, environments, credentials, templates, plugins, integrations and documentation.

• Work with the agency on major enhancements where specialist capacity is required, while independently delivering routine maintenance and ongoing development.

• Translate marketing and business requirements into practical technical solutions, estimates and delivery plans.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Web Development, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5+ years of experience developing and maintaining business-critical WordPress websites.

• Strong front-end development skills in HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript, with practical PHP and WordPress development experience.

• Experience building custom themes, page templates, reusable components and responsive landing pages.

• Experience managing plugins, hosting environments, staging, deployment, version control and website security.

• Experience with technical SEO, performance optimization, cross-browser testing and accessibility standards.

Preferred Qualifications

• Hands-on experience with HubSpot Content Hub/CMS, forms, landing pages, templates, modules or HubL. Experience integrating WordPress with HubSpot and Salesforce.

• Experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager and consent management platforms.

• Familiarity with Pantheon or comparable managed WordPress hosting, Advanced Custom Fields and common security, SEO and performance plugins.

• Previous experience working within a Marketing, Demand Generation or Marketing Operations function.

Success Measures

• Effective technical handover and stable ownership of the website after agency launch.

• Timely delivery of landing pages, campaign support and prioritized website enhancements.

• Accurate lead capture, analytics and MarTech integrations.
