postings.title: Customer Success Lead
postings.descriptionText:
Customer Success Lead
Recycled materials
Location: Remote — Europe
About MineHub

At MineHub , we’re transforming how the world’s largest producers, traders, and consumers manage raw material supply chains. Our solutions combine critical B2B marketplace functionality (handling high-volume transactions for global supply chains) with intuitive B2C design, enabling customers to streamline logistics, reduce costs, and build more resilient, sustainable operations through real-time data integration and predictive analytics.
Jules extends MineHub ’s offering into the recycled materials industry. Scrap and secondary-materials traders, recyclers and brokers use Jules to run their business end to end: buying and selling; managing inventory across yards and stockpiles; container, bulk, and truck logistics; trade documentation; invoicing and payments; and price-risk management.
The Role

We're looking for a Customer Success Lead to own customer success for the Jules platform. You'll combine a strong understanding of commodity supply chains with the leadership to build and develop a small, high-performing CSM team. You'll personally own our most strategic accounts while setting the standards, processes, and priorities the rest of the team works to. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll be as comfortable running a go-live with a customer's operations team as you are coaching a CSM or making the case to Product for what our customers need next. The role is highly cross-functional: you'll collaborate across CS, Product, Engineering, Sales and leadership.
Responsibilities

• Lead, coach and develop the Jules CSM team: set clear expectations, give regular feedback, support career growth, and help hire as the team scales.

• Own the Jules customer portfolio's health, retention and expansion, and report on it to leadership with clear, commercially grounded metrics.

• Personally manage our most strategic and complex accounts, from implementation through to renewal and expansion.

• Build and continuously improve the team's playbooks: onboarding and go-live, data migration, health monitoring, QBRs, renewals and escalations.

• Act as the voice of the customer to Product and Engineering: synthesise feedback across accounts, frame it in commercial and operational terms, and influence roadmap priorities.

• Partner with Sales on pre-sales scoping, handover and expansion opportunities, ensuring what we sell can be delivered and adopted. (This is not a quota-carrying role.)

• Work with your counterparts across MineHub to share best practice and align ways of working across the group's platforms.

Experience & Skills

• Experience in recycled materials, metals or wider commodities trade is a strong advantage. If you're coming from an adjacent background, you'll be keen to learn how recycled materials are sourced, graded, shipped and documented, and to pick up the industry's terminology quickly.

• Experience leading, mentoring or coaching others, formally or informally: you've raised the performance of the people around you and set a standard others follow.

• Leadership qualities we'll look for at interview: sound judgement under pressure, clear prioritisation, ownership, the ability to give direct and constructive feedback, and the credibility to lead both internally and in front of customers.

• A strong track record of managing complex, multi-stakeholder accounts and software implementations, with measurable outcomes in adoption, retention or expansion.

• Strong professional English. French is a plus, as we work with a number of French-speaking customers.

• Comfortable with technical topics: data set-up, document workflows, data imports, integrations and reporting. You can get into the detail yourself and guide your team through it. SQL or BI tool experience is a plus.

• Commercially minded. You understand how our customers make money, from margins to logistics costs and price risk, and can tie platform value to their P&L.

• Process-oriented without being bureaucratic. You introduce structure that helps a small team scale, and you know when to keep things simple.

• You're a self-starter who embraces ambiguity and enjoys building something, not just running it.

Why MineHub ?

• Help build the digital backbone of the circular economy, in an industry where secondary raw materials are becoming strategically critical.

• Join a mission-driven team that values integrity, collaboration, and long-term thinking in everything from customer relationships to code.

• Be part of a fast-growing company that combines startup energy with partnerships across major industry players worldwide.

• Enjoy the freedom to lead initiatives, own your accounts, and shape how recycled materials businesses experience our platform.

postings.descriptionText:
Company Overview
Our client is a software company that helps property managers inspect properties and turn what they find into clear, shareable reports. Someone opens the app on their phone, walks a property capturing photos, video, and voice notes even with no signal, since it works offline and syncs later, then reviews everything and runs reporting on the web. It plugs into the property-management systems teams already use, so the data doesn't sit in a silo. They've been at this since 2014, profitable and self-funded the whole way, and today more than 20,000 people use it across the U.S. and 20-plus countries, together capturing over 100 million inspection photos. There's even a new AI feature that turns spoken notes into a finished report on its own, so an inspector can walk a property, say what they see, and skip the typing.

Your Role
You own how work moves through the product from the first step to the last: the steps, the logic, the states, and the handoffs between the phone in the field and the review screen back at the office. You'll map how property managers actually work, find where a flow gets confusing or breaks, and redesign it so the next person doesn't have to think about it. There's another designer on the team who leans visual and component-level, so you lean process and flow, and together you cover the whole surface. This is a design role about how work behaves, not visual polish. You report to the Head of Engineering, and what you design gets built instead of sitting in a backlog.

You'll

• Map property management workflows end to end, from field capture to sync to review to report

• Talk to the people who live in a workflow, then redesign it with fewer steps

• Write the logic, branches, and edge cases behind each flow so engineering builds it right the first time

• Design the offline and retry states so users always know what's happening when the signal drops

• Prototype in Figma and check it with quick usability runs

• Hand engineering annotated specs (states, rules, microcopy) they can build from with little back-and-forth

• Review builds, log precise issues, and confirm the fixes before sign-off

You Bring

• Experience designing complex, multi-step workflows (B2B, SaaS, operations, or field tools). We care more about how the flows in your portfolio hold up than about a year count, and we'll happily hire someone earlier in their career who clearly has the instinct for this

• A portfolio that shows the whole path, problem to mapping to logic to final, not just polished screens

• Systems thinking: you design for the states, branches, permissions, errors, and empty cases, not just the happy path

• You write clear flow documentation and specs engineering can build straight from

• Strong Figma for mapping, prototyping, and handoff

• AI fluency: you use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or Figma AI to move through options and specs faster without lowering quality

• A working handle on accessibility (contrast, tap targets, text size, focus order)

Bonus Points

• Service design or process mapping (journey maps, service blueprints, workflow diagrams)

• Experience designing information-dense web UIs (tables, filtering, bulk actions, reporting dashboards)

• Background in workflow-heavy B2B products: property management, field services, logistics, or operations tooling

• Comfort using analytics to confirm a redesigned flow actually performs better

What's Offered

• Fully remote across LATAM, around 40 hours a week, flexible for the right person, with a few hours of overlap during U.S. Pacific business hours

• What we'd estimate for a role like this: around $2,000 to $4,000 USD a month, based on experience. Tell us the range that fits you and we'll go from there

•
Paid weekly in USD as a contractor

• Up to 20 days of paid time off a year (10 vacation days plus 10 local public holidays)

• A two-person design team where you own the flow side and a counterpart owns the visual side, plus a direct line to the Head of Engineering

• A team that ships small, steady improvements over big rebuilds, so your work gets built instead of sitting in a backlog

Interview Process
1️⃣ Intro call: your background and how you approach workflow and product design
2️⃣ Practical exercise: map and simplify a real inspection workflow
3️⃣ Portfolio and collaboration deep dive: with the designer you'd partner with
4️⃣ Conversation with the Head of Engineering: handoff and how design fits release cycles
5️⃣ Final conversation with the CEO: context and next steps
Timeline: most people go from first call to decision in about 2 to 3 weeks.

postings.title: Performance Marketing Manager B2B
postings.descriptionText:
Somos la capa de infraestructura en la que confían empresas globales, plataformas digitales y agentes de IA para mover dinero de forma segura y conforme a la normativa. A través de una única API, brindamos a cada transacción la certeza que requiere antes de que se mueva un solo dólar: que la cuenta es real y que la operación cumple con la normativa local. Conectamos a empresas con más de 7.500 instituciones financieras en más de 110 países. Nuestro equipo está formado por profesionales de distintas nacionalidades y sigue creciendo.
Te invitamos a conocernos y a sumarte a la construcción de la infraestructura que habilita todos los mundos posibles.

Descripción del rol:
Buscamos un/a Sr. Performance Marketing Manager B2B, resultadista y con mucha curiosidad por la tecnología, para liderar la estrategia y ejecución de nuestras campañas B2B en Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads y canales complementarios. El objetivo del rol no es generar leads: es generar pipeline calificado y ventas para Prometeo .
El rol requiere dominio en profundidad de las plataformas publicitarias y sus funcionalidades de IA (Performance Max, Smart Bidding, generación de audiencias y creativos con IA, Predictive Audiences de LinkedIn, Advantage+ de Meta, entre otras) aprovechándolas activamente para mejorar resultados, no de forma superficial.
Asimismo, se espera una mentalidad analítica y estratégica, con fuerte capacidad técnica en tracking, etiquetado y medición end-to-end —desde el clic hasta la venta cerrada— para asegurar una atribución precisa y decisiones basadas en datos.

Funciones principales:

• Diseñar y ejecutar la estrategia de paid media B2B (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads y otros canales según oportunidad), con el pipeline y las ventas como norte, no solo el volumen de leads.

• Administrar y optimizar campañas de lead generation, awareness y remarketing, priorizando la calidad del lead y su conversión en venta por sobre el volumen.

• Explorar y adoptar de forma proactiva las funcionalidades de IA de las plataformas publicitarias (automatización de pujas, generación de audiencias, creativos y copies con IA) para ganar eficiencia y mejorar resultados.

• Definir, testear y mejorar mensajes, audiencias, keywords y formatos publicitarios, iterando rápido en base a datos.

• Medir y reportar resultados con foco en métricas de negocio —SQLs, pipeline generado, CAC, ROAS— además de CTR, CPC, CPL y CPA, asegurando decisiones basadas en datos.

• Colaborar con los equipos de Contenido, Diseño, CRM y Ventas para construir journeys completos de conversión, desde el primer clic hasta el cierre.

• Gestionar el presupuesto mensual y trimestral de medios, maximizando la eficiencia de la inversión y el retorno.

• Implementar y mantener etiquetas, eventos y conversiones en Google Tag Manager y Google Analytics 4 para un seguimiento preciso de las campañas.

• Monitorear la correcta atribución y trazabilidad de los leads desde las campañas hasta el CRM (HubSpot) y el cierre de la venta.

• Mantenerse curioso/a y a la vanguardia de las tendencias en performance marketing B2B, IA aplicada a advertising, tracking y automatización, testeando herramientas y funcionalidades nuevas apenas salen.

¿Cuáles son los requisitos?

• +4 años de experiencia gestionando campañas B2B en Google Ads y LinkedIn Ads.

• Experiencia práctica usando funcionalidades de IA dentro de plataformas publicitarias (Performance Max, Smart Bidding, generación de audiencias y creativos con IA, etc.) para mejorar performance, no solo conocerlas de nombre.

• Experiencia en tracking, etiquetado y eventos en Google Tag Manager y Google Analytics 4.

• Conocimientos sólidos de embudos de conversión y generación de leads calificados que efectivamente conviertan en ventas.

• Dominio de HubSpot u otro CRM conectado con campañas de performance.

• Experiencia administrando presupuestos significativos.

• Capacidad analítica y una orientación obsesiva a resultados de negocio (pipeline, ventas, revenue), no solo a métricas de marketing.

•
Inglés intermedio o avanzado.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y coordinación cross-team, incluyendo con el equipo de Ventas.

postings.descriptionText:
Hybrid

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

JOB PURPOSE

In this role, you’ll work with a talented team of digital designers in our growing offices in Zagreb or Split, shaping top-notch experiences for international clients.

As a UI Designer at Dept, you’ll shape industry leading digital experiences into their final form. You have a soft spot for branding. You love to create digital products that look and feel just right. And you enjoy working in a dynamic environment with what we think are the best people the industry has to offer.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Translating strategy and UX into pixel-perfect interface designs;

• Work back-to-back with ux designers on the final product and delivery;

• Substantiating your design choices with annotations and animations;

• Presenting your work to clients and stakeholders and handle input and feedback;

• Taking responsibility for the highest quality of final delivery and proper implementation.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• 3+ years of experience in a same or similar role and an impressive portfolio showcasing sophisticated experience design and a deep understanding of digital platforms, ideally gained within a fast-paced agency environment.

• Experience with designing websites, apps and digital products.

• A strong portfolio (website or PDF) demonstrating your experience and passion for digital design.

• You enjoy working in cross-functional teams, speaking the "languages" of UX Designers, Copywriters, and Developers to bring together ideas to life.

• You are fluent in English and are able to effectively communicate complex design concepts to both executive-level clients and engineers.

• Mastery of Figma is a must; experience with motion design and prototyping tools like Framer or Jitter is a massive plus.

• You actively explore and implement AI-powered design tools and workflows, using them to accelerate ideation and prototyping, and raise the quality of design outcomes while maintaining a strong focus on craft and human-centred design.

WE OFFER

• Transparent career development and pay;

• A flexible, hybrid working policy;

• A rewarding, supportive and healthy company culture.

• Supplemental and additional health insurance;

• Pension scheme: third pillar pension fund;

• Referral bonus program;

• Stay happy and healthy with a contribution to your health through the OpenUp platform, and a multisport programme;

• A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021 and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards.

• Awesome clients. Whether big or small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with clients of all sizes and across all industries. And we celebrate all of our successes together!

• The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training, development and certifications.

• Global annual DEPT® Cares Month in which employees come together and donate their skills to support local charities.

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here .

postings.title: Junior Emulation Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Celero Communications is a fast-growing semiconductor startup developing high-performance coherent DSP technology for next-generation AI infrastructure. We recently announced a $275M Series C following the validation of the industry’s first 2nm coherent DSP silicon. Bloomberg also reported that Alphabet’s CapitalG has backed Celero at a $3B valuation. As we continue to grow, we’re hiring exceptional talent across the United States, Canada, and Argentina for a variety of exciting opportunities.

We are seeking a motivated Junior Emulation Engineer to join our pre-silicon verification team. This is an excellent opportunity for recent graduates and early-career engineers to build hands-on experience bringing up complex SoC designs on hardware emulation platforms. In this role, you will help compile, run, and debug RTL on emulation systems, supporting early validation of hardware and firmware ahead of tape-out. You will work closely with RTL design, verification, and firmware teams, learn from senior engineers, and grow into an independent contributor on next-generation semiconductor products.

Key Responsibilities

• Emulation Bring-Up: Support compilation, partitioning, and bring-up of RTL designs on hardware emulation platforms.

• Environment Support: Assist in building and maintaining emulation environments, including testbenches, transactors, and run configurations.

• Debug & Triage: Analyze waveforms, logs, and traces to isolate failures, and work with RTL and verification engineers to root-cause issues.

• Automation: Develop and maintain scripts in Python, Tcl, Perl, or shell to automate builds, regressions, and reporting.

• Firmware & Software Enablement: Help run pre-silicon firmware and software workloads on emulation to validate functionality before silicon.

• Documentation & Growth: Document findings, flows, and best practices, and actively learn emulation methodologies from senior team members.

Key Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Electronic, Electrical, or Computer Engineering (or a related field), completed or expected within the next 6–12 months.

• 0–2+ years of relevant experience; internships, thesis work, and academic or personal projects in digital design, verification, or FPGA are welcome.

• Digital Design Fundamentals: Solid understanding of combinational and sequential logic, FSMs, clock domains, and basic timing concepts.

• HDL Knowledge: Working knowledge of Verilog/SystemVerilog; able to read RTL and debug simple design or testbench issues.

• Scripting & Linux: Basic proficiency in Python, Tcl, Perl, or shell scripting, and comfort working in a Linux command-line environment.

• Communication: Professional English (written and spoken) for collaboration with global teams.

• Nice to Have: Exposure to emulation or FPGA prototyping tools (e.g., Cadence Palladium/Protium, Synopsys ZeBu, Siemens Veloce, Vivado/Quartus), UVM or SystemVerilog assertions, SoC basics (AXI/AMBA, ARM/RISC-V, DDR, PCIe), and Git or CI tools.

• This is an on-site position. Qualified candidates must be willing to relocate to Cordoba.

postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT ANYONE AI

At Anyone AI, we’re building Latin America’s largest AI talent hub, helping software developers gain the skills and confidence to pursue global career opportunities.

Through our AI Fellowship program, we combine hands-on training, experienced instructors, and career support to help technology professionals take their next career step.

Our scholarship and deferred-payment model enables eligible fellows to access training and pay afterward, once they meet the employment or compensation milestones specified in their agreement.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an Admissions Advisor who combines consultative sales skills with a strong interest in technology and education.

You will guide prospective fellows from their initial application through enrollment. These candidates have already expressed interest through our digital channels; your role is to understand their goals, assess their fit, explain the program’s value, and help qualified applicants make an informed decision.

Success means enrolling candidates who have the preparation, motivation, and commitment to complete the Fellowship and pursue opportunities with global companies.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own your admissions pipeline: Review inbound applications, qualify leads against Anyone AI’s criteria, and keep every opportunity moving with clear next steps.

 - Connect with qualified applicants: Reach out through WhatsApp, email, and other company-approved channels to schedule interviews and maintain consistent follow-up.

 - Lead consultative admissions interviews via Zoom: Explore each candidate’s professional background, technical experience, career goals, English proficiency, and availability.

 - Assess readiness and potential: Evaluate applicants’ ability to meet the program’s demands and their readiness to pursue global employment opportunities, using established criteria.

 - Communicate comfortably with developers: Discuss software development experience, technical projects, and AI learning goals using relevant terminology.

 - Explain the Fellowship’s value: Connect the curriculum, learning experience, and career support to each applicant’s needs and aspirations.

 - Clarify contract and payment terms: Explain eligibility, commitments, and the contractual milestones that trigger payment, ensuring applicants understand their obligations before enrolling.

 - Handle objections and close enrollments: Address concerns about time, readiness, career outcomes, and financial commitments with empathy and clear information.

 - Coordinate candidate assessments: Partner with the academic and career teams when an application requires further technical or employability evaluation.

 - Maintain accurate CRM records: Document qualification decisions, interview notes, communications, objections, and enrollment status.

 - Improve the admissions process: Share insights on lead quality, conversion barriers, and candidate expectations with Marketing and other teams.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Proven experience in consultative sales, recruitment, admissions, enrollment advising, or a comparable role involving discovery, qualification, objection handling, and closing.

 - Fluent spoken and written English and Spanish, with the ability to conduct interviews and sales conversations confidently in both languages.

 - A working understanding of software development and basic IT terminology, including programming languages, frontend and backend development, APIs, databases, cloud technologies, and common technical roles.

 - The ability to ask thoughtful questions about candidates’ technical backgrounds and recognize when a specialist assessment is needed.

 - Experience managing inbound leads, structured follow-up sequences, and sales pipelines in a CRM.

 - A track record of meeting conversion or enrollment targets while maintaining strong qualification standards.

 - Clear communication skills and the ability to explain program requirements and payment conditions accurately.

 - Strong organization, sound judgment, and the ability to work independently in a fully remote environment.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Familiarity with technology hiring expectations in Latin America and the United States.

 - Experience with scholarships, education financing, or deferred-payment programs.

 - An interest in AI and how it is changing software development careers.




HOW WE’LL MEASURE SUCCESS

 - Qualified applicant-to-enrollment conversion.

 - Enrollment target attainment.

 - Response times, contact rates, and interview attendance.

 - Consistent follow-up and accurate pipeline management.

 - Quality of qualification decisions and completeness of candidate handoffs.

 - Candidates’ understanding of program commitments and payment terms.

 - Early fellow engagement and retention, in collaboration with the academic team.




WHY JOIN ANYONE AI?

 - Work 100% remotely.

 - Help technology professionals make meaningful career decisions.

 - Contribute directly to expanding AI talent across Latin America.

 - Take ownership of an admissions pipeline and influence how the process evolves.

 - Work at the intersection of education, technology, and global career development.

postings.descriptionText:
This role is open to candidates based in LATAM, Africa, and Eastern Europe. Please note that as this role supports U.S.-based clients, candidates must be available to work during U.S. business hours aligned with the client’s time zone.

 

Our client is a rapidly growing SaaS company that provides AI-powered marketing technology and customer engagement solutions for businesses looking to scale their digital marketing efforts. Their platform helps marketing teams streamline campaign management, automate customer communications, analyze performance, and optimize lead generation across multiple digital channels.




LOCATION

Fully Remote | 9 AM – 5 PM EST




ROLE OVERVIEW

The Social Media Community Manager will oversee the company's day-to-day social media presence across LinkedIn, X (Twitter), Facebook, Instagram, and other relevant platforms. This role focuses on community engagement, content publishing, brand consistency, and customer interaction rather than developing creative campaigns from scratch.

Working closely with the marketing team, the Social Media Community Manager will publish approved content, engage with audiences, support product launches and marketing campaigns, monitor conversations, and help position the company as a trusted voice within the B2B SaaS marketing space. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building relationships, maintaining an active online presence, and supporting marketing initiatives through thoughtful community management.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


COMMUNITY MANAGEMENT & AUDIENCE ENGAGEMENT

 - Monitor and manage daily engagement across LinkedIn, X (Twitter), Facebook, Instagram, and other relevant social platforms.

 - Respond professionally to comments, direct messages, and customer inquiries.

 - Foster meaningful conversations with customers, prospects, marketing professionals, and industry partners.

 - Escalate product questions, support requests, or customer feedback to the appropriate internal teams.

 - Help build an engaged community around the company's products, educational content, and brand.
   
   


CONTENT PUBLISHING & BRAND CONSISTENCY

 - Schedule and publish approved content across all social media channels.

 - Review captions, links, hashtags, images, and formatting before publication.

 - Ensure all published content aligns with brand voice, messaging, and marketing objectives.

 - Repurpose existing blogs, webinars, case studies, customer stories, product announcements, and thought leadership content into social media posts.

 - Maintain a consistent publishing schedule across all platforms.
   
   


CAMPAIGN & MARKETING SUPPORT

 - Support integrated marketing campaigns, product launches, webinars, virtual events, and promotional initiatives.

 - Coordinate social media promotion for new product features, customer success stories, and company announcements.

 - Collaborate with the marketing team to maximize campaign reach and engagement.

 - Assist with employee advocacy and thought leadership initiatives.
   
   


SOCIAL LISTENING & MARKET INSIGHTS

 - Monitor conversations related to digital marketing, SaaS, AI, automation, and customer engagement.

 - Track competitor activity and emerging industry trends.

 - Identify recurring customer questions, feature requests, and community feedback.

 - Share actionable insights with Marketing, Product Marketing, and Customer Success teams.
   
   


ANALYTICS & REPORTING

 - Monitor engagement, audience growth, reach, and content performance.

 - Prepare recurring social media performance reports.

 - Identify opportunities to improve engagement, community participation, and overall social performance.

 - Support data-driven optimization of social media activities.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS


EXPERIENCE

 - 2–4 years of experience in social media community management.

 - Experience supporting B2B SaaS, marketing technology, software, or technology companies preferred.

 - Experience managing communities across LinkedIn, X (Twitter), Facebook, and Instagram.

 - Experience scheduling and publishing social media content.

 - Experience supporting integrated marketing campaigns.

 - Experience monitoring engagement metrics and social media performance.
   
   


SKILLS

 - Strong written English communication and copy-editing skills.

 - Strong understanding of B2B social media marketing and community engagement.

 - Experience using LinkedIn, X (Twitter), Facebook, and Instagram professionally.

 - Experience with Hootsuite, Sprout Social, Buffer, or similar social media management platforms.

 - Familiarity with Canva for basic content preparation and image resizing.

 - Strong attention to detail and commitment to brand consistency.

 - Excellent organizational and time management skills.

 - Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced marketing environment.

 - Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

 - Analytical mindset with experience reviewing engagement and performance metrics.
   
   


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Social media channels maintain a consistent, professional, and engaging presence.

 - Community engagement increases through timely, meaningful interactions.

 - Marketing campaigns receive strong social support and audience participation.

 - Content is published accurately and on schedule with minimal errors.

 - Community feedback provides valuable insights that support marketing and product initiatives.

 - Brand awareness and customer engagement continue to grow across all social platforms.

postings.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Fraud & Abuse Detection
postings.descriptionText:
About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network , to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

The Role

As a Machine Learning Engineer on the Messaging team, you will own the systems that decide — in real time — which of the many millions of outbound messages a day reach real people and which get stopped. You'll build and operate fraud and abuse detection for our messaging platform: phishing and smishing, brand impersonation, artificially inflated traffic (AIT), and social-engineering scams targeting real users.

You'll join at an inflection point. We're rebuilding our detection stack on a modern decision-engine architecture — inline hot-path decisioning, a complete decision audit ledger, and entity-level risk state — with active programs in social-engineering, phishing, and brand-impersonation detection.

What You Will Do

• Design, train, evaluate, and operate text classifiers end-to-end: data curation, labeling, offline evaluation, deployment, and production drift monitoring.

• Run shadow-mode evaluations against labeled fraud corpora and human-reviewed legitimate controls before any model earns enforcement authority; report precision, recall, and calibration per abuse archetype.

• Build detection that holds up against adversarial content: obfuscated and confusable brand text, URL and domain evasion, and cross-account template fingerprinting.

• Serve detection models inline on the message send path under strict latency budgets, with deliberate fail-open/fail-closed behavior per dependency.

• Power human-in-the-loop fraud review: reviewer tooling, label quality, and turning fraud dispositions into replay and training signals.

• Collaborate with fraud operations, trust & safety, and cross-functional engineering teams.

• Participate in code reviews and help raise code quality and standards.

What You Bring

• 3+ years of software development and/or machine learning experience.

• Strong proficiency in async Python webservice frameworks (e.g. FastAPI).

• Production experience building and operating text classification systems in fraud, spam, abuse, or trust & safety.

• Rigorous evaluation methodology: labeled corpora, holdout sets, precision/recall tradeoffs, and calibration.

• Experience using LLMs as classifiers or judges within a larger decision pipeline.

• Experience deploying and maintaining ML models in production.

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

Nice to Have

• Familiarity with A2P messaging abuse: artificially inflated traffic, smishing, brand impersonation, and 10DLC / toll-free verification regimes.

• Adversarial ML experience: evasion-resilient detection, obfuscation handling, or attack-surface hardening.

• High-scale data experience with ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, Redis, and streaming systems such as Kafka.

• Experience with a cloud-native stack (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes, Prometheus).

• Experience with distributed batch scoring (e.g. Ray).

ABOUT THE ROLE

AI is a core part of how we make ads, but it works alongside classic motion design, graphic design, and video editing. In this role, you’ll generate static and video footage with AI tools and bring them to a final result. You’ll work closely with the Lead Designer and Creative Producers on advertising campaigns across multiple platforms, turning ideas and performance data into creatives that scale.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Stay up to date with Instagram and TikTok trends and adapt them into ad creatives.

 - Generate AI video and images, and build AI workflows that speed up production.

 - Propose your own ideas in creative team meetings.


QUALIFICATIONS

NICE TO HAVE

LOCATION

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.




BENEFITS

postings.title: Representante de Producción de Semillas
postings.descriptionText:
La posición tendrá como principal objetivo brindar soporte al equipo de Producción en el seguimiento y control de la producción de semillas, realizando tareas tanto a campo como en plantas de procesamiento, asegurando el cumplimiento de los estándares de calidad, los cronogramas establecidos y los requerimientos técnicos de cada cultivo.
Principales responsabilidades
Seguimiento de la producción a campo: realizar controles y recorridas de lotes de producción de semillas, verificando el estado de los cultivos, el cumplimiento de los protocolos establecidos y registrando la información correspondiente.

Controles de producción: participar en las distintas etapas del proceso productivo, realizando controles de calidad y seguimiento de los principales parámetros definidos para cada cultivo.

Seguimiento de cosecha y acondicionamiento: acompañar las actividades de cosecha, recepción, secado, limpieza, clasificación y almacenamiento de semillas, verificando el cumplimiento de los procedimientos establecidos.

Controles en plantas de proceso: realizar inspecciones y controles durante el procesamiento de los lotes, identificando desvíos y dando seguimiento a las acciones necesarias para su resolución.

Registro y análisis de información: mantener actualizados los registros de producción, controles de campo y planta, generando reportes sobre avances, incidencias y resultados.

Detección y resolución de desvíos: identificar problemas durante las diferentes etapas del proceso y colaborar con los equipos involucrados para encontrar soluciones y evitar impactos en la producción.

Coordinación y comunicación: mantener una comunicación fluida con los equipos de Producción, Calidad, Campo y las plantas de procesamiento, informando avances, problemas y necesidades.

Cumplimiento de procedimientos: asegurar el cumplimiento de los protocolos de producción, calidad, seguridad y trazabilidad establecidos por la compañía.

Buscamos una persona con perfil técnico, proactivo y dinámico, con capacidad para trabajar tanto en campo como en plantas de procesamiento. Se valorará especialmente la capacidad de observación, organización, seguimiento de procesos y resolución de problemas.
Será valorada experiencia previa en producción de semillas, producción agrícola, control de calidad, plantas de procesamiento o actividades relacionadas con el sector agropecuario.
Se requiere disponibilidad para realizar recorridas a campo y eventuales viajes a establecimientos productivos y plantas de procesamiento.

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
The Keet engine team works on the core that makes Keet tick: connecting peers, replicating data, syncing rooms, and keeping calls and file transfers fast and reliable across every kind of network. We're looking for an organized, curious Junior Project Manager to help keep that work moving.
You'll work closely with a globally distributed team of senior engineers, help turn priorities into clear plans, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks between releases. This is a great role for someone early in their career who wants to grow into technical project or product management in a deeply technical, open-source environment.

Responsibilities

• Track engine work across sprints and releases, keeping issues, milestones, and roadmaps current

• Run or support stand-ups, planning sessions, and retrospectives across time zones (mostly async)

• Coordinate between the engine team, Keet app/UI developers, and QA so dependencies are visible early

• Write clear status updates, release notes, and meeting summaries

• Help triage bug reports and user feedback, and route them to the right engineers

• Spot risks and blockers early and help the team resolve them

• Keep internal documentation and processes tidy and easy to follow

Mandatory:

• 1–2 years of experience in project coordination, project management, or a similar role (internships and open-source involvement count)

• Excellent written English communication; you can explain technical progress clearly and concisely

• Highly organized, with strong attention to detail and follow-through

• Comfortable working with engineers and learning technical concepts quickly

• Experience with issue trackers and project tools (e.g. GitHub Issues/Projects, Jira, Linear)

• Self-starter who thrives in a fully remote, async-first team

Preferred:

• Basic understanding of networking or distributed systems concepts (P2P, DHTs, NAT traversal, replication)

• Familiarity with software development lifecycles, Git, and release processes

• Some exposure to JavaScript/ Node.js or experience working alongside a dev team

• Interest in privacy, decentralization, or open-source software

• Agile/Scrum knowledge or a certification (PSM, CAPM, etc.)

• Experience working across many time zones

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

postings.descriptionText:

Chevron is accepting online applications for the position through 11/10, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. (GMT - 3) .

About the Opportunity
Chevron Argentina is entering a multi-year midstream build-out to support its accelerating Shale & Tight development in Vaca Muerta. At the center of it is the TGS NGL Project, a multi-billion program that includes expansion of the Tratayén gas plant, a new ~360-mile Y-grade pipeline, a new fractionation complex, and an expanded LPG and C5+ export terminal in Bahía Blanca. Chevron is participating as an anchor producer, and the project is critical to the company’s flow assurance and value realization in Argentina.
We are looking for a senior engineer to serve as Chevron’s primary technical focal point for third-party midstream developments in Argentina, making sure Chevron’s requirements shape the design, the agreements, and the start-up of the infrastructure our production depends on.

Role Summary
The Midstream Integration Lead will serve as Chevron Argentina’s primary technical and commercial interface with midstream partners, anchor producers, service providers, and key industry stakeholders. The role will own Chevron Argentina’s technical position with TGS and other strategic partners, ensuring alignment between Chevron’s business objectives and external midstream infrastructure initiatives.
This position connects Facilities Engineering, Operations, Commercial, and Business Development teams in Argentina with Chevron’s Shale & Tight (S&T) organization and Houston-based S&T teams. The role is responsible for coordinating engineering, commercial, and strategic activities associated with the development of midstream infrastructure, influencing technical and commercial outcomes that support Chevron’s long-term growth strategy in Argentina.
The initial focus of the role will be the TGS NGL Project and the associated gas takeaway infrastructure build-out. Responsibilities include close collaboration with project stakeholders, operators, producers, and industry partners involved in gas processing, natural gas liquids (NGL) recovery, transportation, and related infrastructure. As Chevron’s Argentina business expands, the scope is expected to grow to include oil and water midstream infrastructure opportunities.
The successful candidate will combine strong process engineering expertise with stakeholder management capabilities, project execution experience, and commercial acumen. The role requires the ability to build alignment, influence decisions across multiple organizations without direct authority, and effectively integrate technical, operational, and business priorities to achieve strategic objectives.

Responsibilities

• Serve as Chevron Argentina's technical focal point for interactions with midstream partners and joint venture participants.

• Develop and own the associated gas management strategy for the asset, integrating production forecasts, gas composition, NGL handling, processing, compression, transportation, and commercialization requirements.

• Maintain close collaboration with the Argentina Facilities Execution team to ensure alignment between midstream developments and Chevron’s facilities plans and project execution activities.

• Coordinate engineering and commercial discussions related to gas processing, NGL recovery, transportation, and associated infrastructure developments.

• Support the evaluation, development, and execution of strategic midstream opportunities that create value for Chevron.

• Collaborate with Commercial, Business Development, Operations, and Engineering teams to align technical and business objectives.

• Influence partners, operators, and external stakeholders to advance solutions consistent with Chevron's strategic interests.

• Review engineering studies, conceptual designs, technical proposals, and project execution plans associated with third-party infrastructure projects.

• Identify technical, commercial, operational, and execution risks and support development of mitigation plans.

• Support negotiations and technical evaluations related to transportation, processing, and midstream service agreements.

• Maintain awareness of industry developments, emerging technologies, and regulatory trends affecting the Argentine Oil & Gas sector through active engagement with industry stakeholders and participation in industry committees representing Chevron.

• Support project governance activities, decision-making processes, and executive presentations as required.

• Facilitate effective communication between local stakeholders and global Chevron subject matter experts.

• Evaluate and recommend technically and economically optimal solutions for associated gas treatment and evacuation, considering available technologies, infrastructure constraints, regulatory requirements, and evolving domestic and export market conditions.

• Ensure compliance with pipeline and transportation specifications while maximizing value capture from gas and NGL streams throughout the field development lifecycle.

Required Qualifications
Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.

• Process Engineering specialization preferred.

Experience

• Minimum 8 years of experience in Oil & Gas facilities, gas processing, midstream operations, or related infrastructure projects.

• Demonstrated experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering activities.

• Strong technical background in natural gas treatment, gas processing, NGL recovery, and associated facilities.

• Experience working with third-party operators, midstream companies, or joint venture partners.

• Experience supporting or leading project development and execution activities.

Communication & Leadership

• Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills.

• Proven ability to build relationships and drive alignment across organizations.

• Demonstrated success working in multicultural and matrix organizations.

• Ability to influence stakeholders without direct reporting authority.

Technical Expertise

• Strong technical knowledge of gas processing facilities and process engineering principles, including gas treatment, separation, compression, NGL recovery, and transportation considerations.

• Ability to evaluate engineering studies, process designs, operational impacts, and project risks.

• Knowledge of natural gas quality and pipeline specifications and their implications for processing, transportation, and commercialization.

• Familiarity with industry standards, process safety principles, and project development practices.

Language

• Spanish with native-level or equivalent professional proficiency (written and verbal) required.

• Fluent English (written and verbal) is required.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with major gas processing or NGL projects.

• Experience supporting commercial negotiations related to processing, transportation, or midstream services.

• Previous experience in project execution, project management, or owner-team engineering roles.

• Knowledge of the Argentine midstream and Oil & Gas industry environment.

• Experience working with international teams and stakeholders.

Domestic Relocation Options:
Relocation could be offered for this role.

International Considerations:
Expatriate assignments will not be considered.

Data Review & Reporting

Business Development & Strategy

Additional Contributions

Qualifications & Experience

• Proven experience in clinical research (≥3 years) as a study physician/investigator or within Pharma, CRO, or Biotech environments.

• Advanced English level, able to speak and communicate fluently, able to discuss with different stakeholders about medical assessments for clinical trials. Global scope, global teams.

Key Competencies

• Strong ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary and matrixed global teams, driving alignment and consensus

• Demonstrated ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment

• Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage complex projects with shifting timelines and requirements

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to translate complex medical concepts into clear, actionable insights.

postings.title: COORDINADOR ALMACEN
postings.descriptionText:

Formamos parte del grupo YPF y contamos con más de 70 años de experiencia en la ejecución de los proyectos industriales y la provisión de servicios de Upstream y Downstream más importantes de la Argentina.




Conocé más de nosotros ingresando a nuestra web: www.aesa.com.ar




#SomosAESA






¿Qué buscamos?




Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un Coordinador de Almacén .




¿Cuál será tu misión?




Coordinar y controlar las operaciones del almacén, asegurando la correcta recepción, identificación, almacenamiento, preservación, control de inventarios y despacho de materiales, garantizando la trazabilidad de los movimientos y la confiabilidad del stock físico respecto de SAP. Armado de equipos para atender los diferentes almacenes que se solicitan en la unidad de Servicios Petroleros.




¿Cuáles serán tus principales tareas?






• Coordinar las actividades diarias de los almacenes que brindan asistencia en la unidad de servicios petroleros. Armado de equipos y distribución de las tareas del personal.


• Controlar el correcto registro de los movimientos de materiales en SAP.


• Organizar la ubicación, almacenamiento, identificación y preservación de los materiales.


• Coordinar la preparación y despacho de materiales hacia producción, proveedores u otros almacenes.


• Controlar transferencias y movimientos entre centros y almacenes.


• Mantener la trazabilidad documental y física de los materiales.


• Controlar periódicamente las diferencias entre stock físico y stock SAP.


• Planificar y coordinar inventarios generales, cíclicos y conteos de control.


• Analizar diferencias de inventario y gestionar su regularización conforme a los procedimientos aplicables.


• Realizar seguimiento de materiales inmovilizados, sin movimiento, sobrantes y materiales pendientes de definición.


• Mantener el orden, identificación y correcta sectorización de las áreas de almacenamiento.


• Coordinar las necesidades provenientes de los ingenieros de suministros.


• Supervisar el cumplimiento de los procedimientos y registros correspondientes a la gestión del almacén.


• Generar información e indicadores para el seguimiento de la gestión.


• Detectar desvíos operativos y promover acciones correctivas.


• Coordinar y controlar al personal asignado al almacén.


• Coordinar el abastecimiento de los diferentes almacenes.


• Recibir las necesidades de los ingenieros de Suministros y promover las acciones correspondientes para atender las mismas.











¿Qué valoramos como diferencial?




Formación Académica: Carreras a fines




Conocimientos:


• Gestión de almacenes e inventarios.
• SAP aplicado a gestión de materiales y almacenes.
• Recepción, almacenamiento y despacho.
• Inventarios físicos y conciliación de diferencias.
• Trazabilidad de materiales.
• Excel y herramientas Microsoft 365.
• Procedimientos de gestión de almacenes.
• Seguridad aplicada a manipulación, carga, descarga y almacenamiento de materiales.
• Conocimientos en la industria de gas y petróleo
• Experiencia mayor a 5 años como supervisor de almacén
• Carnet de conducir.







Competencias:




• Organización y planificación.
• Liderazgo operativo.
• Orientación al control.
• Capacidad analítica.
• Resolución de problemas.
• Comunicación y coordinación entre áreas.
• Orientación a resultados.
• Mejora continua.

Con 11.000 empleados en 35 países, COFCO International es la plataforma de negocios de agro de COFCO Corporation, la empresa más grande de alimentos y agro de China. La compañía comercializa con 50 naciones, mientras provee a los productores un acceso único y directo al mercado creciente de China. La empresa está acelerando su crecimiento para crear una cadena de suministro internacional de primera línea, anclada en China y con alcance global.




📢 Búsqueda Laboral: Jefe de Mantenimiento



Para incorporarse a nuestro equipo de Mantenimiento en el Complejo Industrial de Saforcada (Buenos Aires), nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Jefe de Mantenimiento .

Orientamos la búsqueda a profesionales con formación universitaria en Ingeniería Mecánica, Eléctrica, Industrial o carreras afines, y con al menos 5 años de experiencia en posiciones con liderazgo de equipos y nivel avanzado de inglés.

Definir e implementar la estrategia y el plan de mantenimiento de los activos de la planta, gestionando las áreas de suministro y servicios para garantizar el cumplimiento de los compromisos operativos.

🛠️ Principales Responsabilidades



• Liderar y desarrollar al equipo a cargo.


• Planificar y asegurar el mantenimiento integral de la planta.


• Gestionar el presupuesto del área y su seguimiento mensual.


• Analizar indicadores y promover mejoras continuas.


• Detectar oportunidades de optimización junto a Ingeniería.


• Supervisar el mantenimiento y la performance de los equipos.

• Autorizar compras, servicios y gastos del sector.


• Garantizar el cumplimiento de los estándares de mantenimiento y calibración.



💡 Competencias que valoramos

• Capacidad de análisis
• Creatividad e iniciativa
• Flexibilidad y adaptabilidad al cambio
• Orientación a resultados
• Autonomía en la toma de decisiones

• Comunicación oral y escrita efectiva
• Habilidades interpersonales
• Negociación

• Liderazgo

postings.title: (EG0075) Senior Adobe Journey Optimizer
postings.descriptionText:
Join   Nortal   for your next big adventure. We are   seeking   a Senior Adobe Journey Optimizer to join our team.

• Say Goodbye to Micromanagement:   We   champion   autonomy, open communication, and respect for diversity as our core values.

• Outcomes Over Hours:   We believe in a work model focused on impact, providing you with the flexibility to balance your professional success with your personal well-being.

• Vibrant Community:   Join our close-knit LATAM remote team and connect through tech talks, virtual coffee breaks, and team-building activities.

• Support from Day One:   Our People Care team is here to support you throughout your journey, from wellness check-ins to professional growth.

Our benefits   ✨

• Competitive USD salary.

• 100% remote work:   While you can work from anywhere, you’re always welcome to connect with teammates and grow your network at our coworking spaces across LATAM.

• Paid   off   &   national   holidays:   Take   the   time   you   need   according   to   your   country’s   regulations   while   receiving   your   full   salary.

• Sick leave:   Focus on your health without   stress. Take the necessary time to recover and feel better.

• Annual   credit:   Spend   it   on   the   perks   you   love   to   enhance   your   work-life   balance.

• Team-building activities:   Join us for coffee breaks, tech talks, and after-work gatherings to bond with your   Nortal   family and feel part of our vibrant community.

• Birthday off:   Enjoy an extra day off during your birthday week to celebrate in style with friends and family.

About the project

As a Senior Adobe Journey Optimizer you will be responsible for leveraging the Adobe Journey Optimizer platform to design, implement, and optimize personalized customer journeys across various channels. This role requires a deep understanding of customer behavior, data analysis, and marketing automation techniques to drive engagement, conversions, and retention.

What   you’ll   do

• Develop and execute personalized customer journeys using Adobe Journey Optimizer, incorporating various touchpoints such as email, SMS, push notifications, and more.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including marketing, data analytics, and IT to gather requirements, define audience segments, and implement targeted campaigns.

• Utilize Adobe Experience Cloud tools to analyze customer data, identify insights, and optimize journey performance.

• Implement A/B testing and multivariate experiments to continuously improve campaign effectiveness and conversion rates.

• Monitor key performance metrics and provide regular reports and insights to stakeholders, highlighting successes and opportunities for optimization.

• Stay up-to-date with industry trends, best practices, and platform updates to drive innovation and maximize the impact of Adobe Journey Optimizer.

What makes you a great fit   🎯

• 1+ year of Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO): Hands-on experience designing, implementing, and optimizing customer journeys.

• 3+ years of Marketing Automation: Experience managing automated, multichannel campaigns (email, SMS, push notifications).

•
2+ years of Customer Journey Management: Experience with journey mapping, personalization, and customer lifecycle strategies.

•
2+ years of Audience Segmentation & Data Analysis: Experience defining target audiences and analyzing customer behavior.

•
1–2+ years of Adobe Experience Cloud: Familiarity with Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Adobe Analytics, or related solutions.

•
2+ years of Campaign Optimization: Experience with A/B testing, performance tracking, and conversion optimization.

•

postings.title: Growth Marketing Manager, B2B SaaS
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

*** This job application is for a role at one of Power Digital's partner companies. Power Digital is assisting this partner company with its recruiting efforts. If you are selected for this position to interview, please make note of the above statement.

A day in the life:

As a Growth Marketing Manager, you’ll own the strategy and execution behind the integrated marketing campaigns that fuel Cardinal’s pipeline. You’ll architect full-funnel initiatives, from webinars and events to reports and eBooks, then lead cross-functional teams to bring each campaign to life with cohesive messaging and high-impact creative. Daily, you’ll monitor performance, optimize in real time, and ensure that every channel works together to generate high-quality leads. You’ll collaborate closely with internal contributors and contractors, keeping projects on track and jumping in to execute when needed. This is a role for someone who moves fast, thinks big, and owns outcomes end to end.

Responsibilities:

• Campaign Strategy & Planning

• Build full-funnel campaign strategies for major launches (webinars, in-person events, eBooks, reports).

• Define audiences, messaging, channel mix, goals, and success metrics.

• Develop campaign plans and timelines aligned with growth and revenue priorities.

• Integrated Activation

• Lead cross-channel execution across email, paid media, social, and web.

• Create creative briefs and coordinate with design, copy, video, paid, and email teams.

• Ensure campaigns land with cohesive messaging, strong creative, and clear CTAs.

• Performance & Optimization

• Monitor performance and identify what’s working, what’s not, and why.

• Optimize live campaigns—messaging, audience, UX, offers, funnel flow.

• Build testing plans and share insights to improve results continually.

• Collaboration & Leadership

• Manage internal contributors and contractors, ensuring deadlines and quality.

• Step in to execute when needed—no ego, high ownership.

• 12-Month Success Indicators

• Launch 6–8 major campaigns that generate a measurable pipeline.

• Improve conversion rates across key funnel stages.

• Build a campaign playbook and reporting cadence.

• Elevate the quality and cohesion of Cardinal’s thought leadership.

Role Requirements:

• Data-driven, audience-obsessed growth marketer.

• Comfortable owning both strategy and execution.

• Strong communicator across creative and performance teams.

• Obsessed with iteration—never settles for “good enough.”

• Strong collaborator who gets the best from teammates and contractors.

• Bias toward action and proactive problem-solving.

• 5–7 years in B2B growth, demand gen, or integrated marketing (agency/professional services a plus).

• Demonstrated success running multi-channel, full-funnel campaigns with measurable results.

• Expertise in LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads, Google Ads, email marketing platforms, and webinar tools.

• Deep understanding of digital channels and how they work together.

• Ability to write or refine campaign copy (emails, landing pages, ads).

• Strong analytical skills: reporting, performance diagnosis, and conversion optimization.

• Experience thriving in fast-paced environments with high standards.

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Power Digital does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process. postings.title: Senior Data Scientist, Product
postings.descriptionText:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile.

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance.

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

The role

We are looking for a Senior Product Data Scientist who is deeply product-minded and highly proactive.

This is not a role for someone who waits for perfectly defined questions or works in isolation. We are looking for someone who actively looks at our data, understands our customers’ pain points, identifies opportunities, and pushes ideas forward.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, and Analytics to shape what we build, why we build it, and how we measure success. Your work will directly power customer-facing features such as LTV prediction, experimentation and statistical significance, benchmarking, and entirely new data-driven products we have not built yet.

You will be expected to bring ideas to the table, backed by analysis and clear hypotheses, and to influence product direction through data.

Our data stack includes a Python backend, PostgreSQL production databases, Snowflake, dbt, and AWS.

What you will do

•
Proactively explore RevenueCat’s data to identify customer problems, opportunities, and product bets.

•
Translate ambiguous product and business problems and questions into clear analyses, models, and recommendations.

•
Partner with Product Managers to shape roadmaps, not just execute on them.

•
Design, build, and ship production-grade predictive and descriptive models that power customer-facing features.

•
Define and evaluate statistical approaches for experimentation, benchmarking, and forecasting.

•
Communicate insights clearly and persuasively to technical and non-technical audiences, with a focus on customer impact.

•
Continuously iterate on shipped models and features based on real-world usage and feedback.

This role has real ownership. You will not just support decisions, you will help drive them.

About you

You are a Senior Data Scientist who cares deeply about impact and product outcomes.

From a skills perspective, you bring:

•
5+ years of experience working as a Data Scientist.

•
Strong SQL skills and comfort with data modeling.

•
Experience building and deploying predictive and descriptive models in production.

•
Experience writing or collaborating on production-ready Python code.

•
A solid understanding of statistics and experimentation, ideally including Bayesian approaches.

•
The ability to clearly explain complex ideas and results to broad audiences.

You recognize yourself in several of these:

•
You are highly proactive and opinionated, and you are comfortable pushing ideas forward.

•
You enjoy working with messy, real-world data and imperfect information.

•
You care more about creating customer value than academic elegance.

•
You are comfortable operating in ambiguity and building structure where none exists.

•
You enjoy working closely with Product teams and influencing decisions.

•
You are excited by the consumer subscription ecosystem and curious about how developers make money.

What success looks like

In the first month, you'll:

•
Understand our data models.

•
Get to know the team.

•
Ramp up on the ongoing data feature work.

•
Implement and ship your first project.

Within the first 3 months, you'll:

•
Meaningfully contribute to shipping a data feature to thousands of developers.

•
Learn the basics of incident response, and be part of the on-call rotation.

•
Work with our Product, Analytics and Engineering teams to improve our data pipelines for data science features.

•
Launch your own explorations into our data to fulfill your own curiosity.

Within the first 6 months, you'll:

•
Own one or more core data-powered features end to end.

•
Influence the data feature roadmap with clear, data-backed proposals.

•
Be a go-to partner for product teams on data-driven decision making.

Within the first 12 months, you'll:

•
Propose and lead entirely new data-driven product initiatives.

•
Push the boundaries of how RevenueCat uses data to help developers grow revenue.

•
Help shape how data science operates at RevenueCat as the function grows.

What we offer:

•
Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator

•
10-year window to exercise vested equity options

•
A fully remote environment designed around autonomy and flexibility

•
4-5 weeks of flexible time off annually

•
Paid desk at a co-working space

•
Workspace budget and continuous learning stipend

Interviewing at RevenueCat

Our interview process is rigorous on purpose. We want to be sure that everyone we bring on is genuinely excited about this work, aligned with how we operate, and ready to meet our high bar for performance. Curious what that actually looks like? Read more in our blog post on how we hire at RevenueCat , including tips to help you succeed.

Triangulate Digital is a paid media agency for VC and PE-backed B2B SaaS companies, mostly in the US and Canada. We run paid media mainly on Google and LinkedIn, for clients spending from about $30k to over $100k a month.

It's a full-time, fully remote role, and a full-time commitment to Triangulate.

Why work with me
I've spent 10 years in B2B SaaS marketing. I worked at Directive, one of the biggest B2B SaaS agencies, then spent 5 years consulting for SaaS companies across the US and Canada. Now I'm building Triangulate Digital, and you'd be my first hire.

• Shape how we work. As the first person on the team, you help build the processes everyone after you will use.

What you'll do
First 90 days: execute reliably across your assigned accounts, with no preventable errors, missed deadlines or rework for me

• Build campaigns in Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads, and other channels where they fit

• Run weekly optimisation on each account: budgets and pacing, bids, search terms, audiences and creative rotation

• QA everything before it goes live: conversion tracking, UTMs, targeting and budgets

• Maintain client dashboards, and draft weekly updates and monthly reports from our templates

• Spot problems early, such as broken tracking, overspend or spend with no conversions, and flag them the same day

• Help turn how we work into checklists, so the work gets more consistent over time

Once you've earned client ownership

• Progress toward owning 2 to 4 accounts, with capacity set by account complexity and the quality you've shown

• Understand each client's goals, economics and measurement, and find the main thing holding performance back, even when it sits outside paid media

• Build and lead paid media strategies tied to pipeline and revenue

• Lead weekly client calls, day-to-day Slack, and monthly and quarterly business reviews

What success looks like

• Campaigns launch with no tracking, targeting or budget errors

• Problems are flagged the same day you spot them, with a suggested fix

• Weekly updates and monthly reports land on time and need few edits

• I can trust a change you've made without re-checking it

• Over time, you run your clients without me carrying the strategy, and clients clearly understand what's happening, why, and what comes next

• The work reduces my review and correction time over time. If every task still needs to be rebuilt by me, the role isn't working.

How we work together

• You start behind me. I lead client calls, strategy and sign-off at first. You join calls as you're ready, then lead them.

• Autonomy grows with trust. At first you propose changes and I approve them before they go live. Routine work, then whole clients, move to you as we build a track record together.

• Daily: a short end-of-day note in Slack covering what you did, what's next and anything blocked.

• Weekly: a 30-minute review of every account together.

• Hours: full-time and flexible, with at least 3 hours a day overlapping 1pm to 6pm UK time, and some overlap with US Eastern time for client calls once you own clients.

• Tools: Slack, Google Workspace, the ad platforms and the AI tools we use for reporting and analysis.

What I'm looking for

• 2+ years of strong hands-on experience with Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads for B2B companies, ideally SaaS and ideally at an agency

• Experience running at least 3 accounts at once, with monthly budgets of $20k or more

• A strong understanding of B2B demand generation, ABM and measurement

• Experience using CRM and attribution data to judge paid media performance

• Confidence with conversion tracking: Google Tag Manager, GA4, the LinkedIn Insight Tag, and CRM data from HubSpot or Salesforce

• Clear written and verbal English, and the confidence to present recommendations to marketing leaders

• The habit of flagging issues early rather than waiting to be asked, and someone who follows a process precisely

• A track record of taking ownership when something is unclear, blocked or going wrong, with a specific example and measurable result

Nice to have: Meta, Reddit or Microsoft Ads; ABM and attribution tools such as 6sense, Demandbase or Fibbler; Looker Studio.

Pay and contract

• Pay: $4,000 to $5,000 a month in USD to start, depending on experience and the scope you can own, and higher for candidates who can own clients from day one. Paid by bank transfer. Pay is reviewed as your responsibility grows, including when you start owning clients.

• Contract: full-time contractor agreement with an NDA. This is intended to be a full-time commitment to Triangulate Digital: you wouldn't take on other client work during your agreed working hours.

• Trial and notice: the first 90 days are an initial trial period. It starts with a 30-day paid trial on one live account, with 7 days' notice on either side. If it's working, at day 90 we move to an ongoing contractor agreement, with 30 days' notice on either side.

Hiring process

Movement, energy, and visual communication are your playground. As a Motion Graphics Editor, you are the visual alchemist of our post-production team. In the world of performance marketing, dynamic text and seamless transitions are often the difference between a skip and a sale. If you thrive on creating kinetic typography, stunning visual effects, and fluid motion that drives conversion, this is your launchpad.

Design & Animate High-Impact Assets

• Design engaging "explainer" sequences and infographics that visually communicate product USPs (Unique Selling Propositions).

•

Elevate Video Edits

• Apply visual effects (tracking, compositing, screen replacements) to enhance production value.

• Ensure all graphics align perfectly with the brand guidelines and visual identity of our diverse DTC clients.

•

Build Scalable Systems (MOGRTs)

• Create and optimize Motion Graphics Templates (.mogrt) for use in Premiere Pro, allowing our editing team to scale their output efficiently.

• Develop reusable animation libraries and assets to speed up the post-production workflow.

Innovate Visual Styles

• Experiment with new plugins and techniques to constantly raise the bar of our visual output.

Who You Are

A Motion Design Pro
