• A strong reel showcasing not just animation skills, but a strong eye for design , layout, and typography.

Adobe Suite Master

Performance-Driven

Organized & Efficient

Daily, you’ll monitor performance, optimize in real time, and ensure that every channel works together to generate high-quality leads. • Campaign Strategy & Planning

• Integrated Activation

• Lead cross-channel execution across email, paid media, social, and web.

• Create creative briefs and coordinate with design, copy, video, paid, and email teams.

• Ensure campaigns land with cohesive messaging, strong creative, and clear CTAs.

• Performance & Optimization

• Monitor performance and identify what’s working, what’s not, and why.

• Optimize live campaigns—messaging, audience, UX, offers, funnel flow.

• Build testing plans and share insights to improve results continually.

• Collaboration & Leadership

• Manage internal contributors and contractors, ensuring deadlines and quality.

• Step in to execute when needed—no ego, high ownership.

• 12-Month Success Indicators

• Launch 6–8 major campaigns that generate a measurable pipeline.

• Improve conversion rates across key funnel stages.

• Build a campaign playbook and reporting cadence.

• Elevate the quality and cohesion of Cardinal’s thought leadership.

Role Requirements:

• Data-driven, audience-obsessed growth marketer.

• Comfortable owning both strategy and execution.

• Strong communicator across creative and performance teams.

• Obsessed with iteration—never settles for “good enough.”

• Strong collaborator who gets the best from teammates and contractors.

• Bias toward action and proactive problem-solving.

• 5–7 years in B2B growth, demand gen, or integrated marketing (agency/professional services a plus).

• Demonstrated success running multi-channel, full-funnel campaigns with measurable results.

• Expertise in LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads, Google Ads, email marketing platforms, and webinar tools.

• Deep understanding of digital channels and how they work together.

• Ability to write or refine campaign copy (emails, landing pages, ads).

• Strong analytical skills: reporting, performance diagnosis, and conversion optimization.

• Experience thriving in fast-paced environments with high standards.

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. postings.descriptionText:
About High Scale
We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.
Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026—and we need an Associate Producer who is the ultimate organizer, anticipating needs and keeping our high-velocity production engine running smoothly.

Why This Role Matters
Momentum, organization, and details are your playground. As an Associate Producer, you are the right hand of the Production team. You operate in the trenches, ensuring that briefs are clear, assets are organized, timelines are met, and quality is maintained.
You are the glue that holds the creative process together. While the Senior Producers look at the big picture, you ensure no detail slips through the cracks. Your work directly impacts our efficiency and speed to market. If you are a master multi-tasker looking to learn the ropes of high-end commercial production from the inside out, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

•

Support End-to-End Production

• Assist Senior Producers in managing the daily workflow of video campaigns, from project kickoff to final delivery.

• Track the status of dozens of simultaneous projects, updating project management boards (Asana, ClickUp, Notion) in real-time.

• Flag potential blockers or delays immediately and work to resolve them before they impact the deadline.

•

Asset Management & Organization

• Act as the gatekeeper for creative assets. Ensure raw footage, music, scripts, and brand guidelines are organized and accessible to the editing team.

• Perform quality checks on incoming assets from creators and outgoing deliverables from editors (checking for correct specs, spelling, and audio levels).

•

Coordinate Creative Teams

• Serve as a liaison between the creative team (editors, designers) and the account team.

• Translate feedback into clear, actionable notes for editors to execute.

• Ensure creative briefs are fully populated with all necessary information before production begins.

•

Resource & Vendor Support

• Assist in sourcing voice-over talent, stock footage, or specialized freelancers as needed.

• Handle administrative tasks related to production, such as contract management, release forms, and invoicing.

Who You Are

•

A Rising Production Talent

• 1–3 years of experience in production, project management, or account coordination (agency or digital media preferred).

• You have a basic understanding of the video production lifecycle (Pre-Pro, Production, Post).

•

The Most Organized Person in the Room

• You love checklists, spreadsheets, and color-coded calendars.

• You have an obsession with file naming conventions and folder structures.

•

Proactive Problem Solver

• You don’t wait to be told what to do. You see a gap in the process or a missing file, and you fix it.

• You are "solution-first" in your communication style.

•

Tech-Savvy

• Proficient in project management tools (Asana, Monday, ClickUp) and Google Suite.

• Familiarity with Adobe Creative Cloud (Premiere,) is a massive plus, even if you aren't an editor.

•

Excellent Communicator

• Strong English proficiency is required. You are clear, concise, and professional in Slack, email, and Zoom. You know how to chase people for deliverables without being annoying.

Perks & Benefits

• Growth Opportunities: This is the training ground for becoming a Senior Producer. Master the details, and the path upward is clear.

• Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world—one perfectly managed project at a time.

Why This Role Matters
Authenticity, pacing, and performance are your playground. As a UGC Video Editor, you are the bridge between a raw influencer review and a profitable ad campaign. You understand that in 2026, a polished cinematic commercial often loses to a well-edited, authentic-looking TikTok shot on an iPhone.
Your job is to craft the narrative, nail the hook, and apply the specific editing language of the internet (captions, sounds, pacing) to drive sales. If you are obsessed with why some videos go viral and others flop, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

•

Transform Raw Assets into Ads

• Ingest raw footage from creators and influencers (testimonials, unboxings, demos) and craft them into cohesive direct-response video ads.

• Structure edits around proven marketing frameworks (Hook → Problem → Solution → Social Proof → CTA).

• Ensure the "vibe" feels native to the platform (TikTok/Reels/Shorts), avoiding the "over-produced" look that kills engagement.

•

Master the "Hook"

• Create multiple variations of the first 3 seconds of every video to test what grabs attention best.

• Utilize visual disruption, sound effects, and trending audio to prevent viewers from scrolling past.

•

Apply Native Visuals

• Implement platform-native text styles, dynamic captions (e.g., Alex Hormozi style), emojis, and stickers that enhance the storytelling without looking cluttered.

• Clean up audio levels and apply basic color correction to ensure mobile viewing quality.

•

Iterate at Speed

• Produce high volumes of iterations (e.g., same body, different hook; same hook, different music) to feed our testing machine.

• Respond quickly to data feedback from the media buying team (e.g., "Shorten the intro," "Make the text bigger").

Who You Are

•

A Social Media Native

• 1–3 years of experience editing UGC or social-first content (Agency or Freelance).

• You understand the "visual language" of TikTok and Instagram. You know what trending fonts, sounds, and cuts are working right now .

•

Technically Proficient

• Expert proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro is required for our agency workflow.

• Basic skills in After Effects or Photoshop for static asset integration.

•

A Storyteller

• You can take 20 minutes of rambling raw footage and cut it down to a sharp, persuasive 30-second story.

• You have a good sense of rhythm and comedic timing.

•

Fast & Adaptable

• You are comfortable with high-volume workflows. You can churn out quality edits quickly.

• You don't get attached to your cuts—you iterate based on what the data says.

•

Excellent Communicator

• Strong English proficiency is required. You can interpret creative briefs accurately and collaborate with producers remotely.

Perks & Benefits

• Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

postings.title: DevOps Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Remote, Latin America (minimum 4-hour overlap with US Eastern hours) | Engineering | Reports to: Technical Lead
Time Doctor is hiring a DevOps Engineer to run and scale the cloud infrastructure behind our platform. Most of it runs on Google Cloud, defined in Terraform across 40+ environments, with legacy systems still running on AWS. Your job is to keep it secure, available and quick to change, and to give our DevOps coverage a base in the Americas so that issues during US business hours have an owner in the room.

Who we are
Time Doctor is a workforce analytics platform that gives distributed teams the visibility they need to improve trust and performance. We serve remote, hybrid and outsourced organisations worldwide, with particular strength in BPO, healthcare and tech services. We are bootstrapped, profitable and fully remote, with team members across 30+ countries. We built a durable business on customer revenue rather than venture capital, and we are now focused on growing it.

The role
You will design, build and operate the infrastructure behind our production, staging, sandbox and customer-specific deployments. You own it hands-on, from Terraform modules and CI/CD pipelines to monitoring, security and your place on the on-call roster.

Three things define this seat.

• The platform. Google Cloud is home: GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Cloud Build, VPC networking, Cloud Armor and Load Balancers, all managed as code. We need someone for whom GCP has been their main platform, not one job inside an AWS career.

• The coverage. Our DevOps team works from time zones a long way from most of our customers. This seat exists to cover US Eastern hours, which is why we are hiring in Latin America.

• The operating model. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and automation by default. If a task gets done twice, it gets scripted.

Who you are

• You treat production as yours. When something breaks, you own it until it is fixed and written up.

• You stay calm in an incident and you are clear in the follow-up afterwards.

• You think in modules and environments, not one-off changes.

• You automate repetitive work in Bash, Python or Go.

• You care about security: least-privilege access, secrets in Secret Manager, nothing sensitive in code.

• You communicate clearly in English, live and async.

• You are organised and self-directed. You thrive fully remote.

What you will own

• Infrastructure as code. Terraform across 40+ environments, reusable modules that follow DRY principles, and multi-environment management through GitOps workflows and Terraform Cloud.

• GCP services. GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Cloud Build, VPC networking, Cloud Armor and Cloud Load Balancers.

• CI/CD. Pipelines in GitHub Actions, Helm or Cloud Deploy that let our engineers ship safely and often.

• Data infrastructure. Redis (Cloud Memorystore) for caching, session management and real-time features.

• Security. IAM, Secret Manager and our security services, and acting on what security scans find.

• Observability and on-call. Proactive monitoring and alerting with GCP Monitoring, Grafana and similar tools, and a place on the on-call support roster.

• Our AWS footprint. Keeping the legacy systems we still run on AWS stable.

This role may not suit you if

postings.title: Operations Associate (Hiring or Client Delivery)
postings.descriptionText:
Grow our AI image service.

The role
We are Drop Zero Digital , a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person who is good at deciding. Our AI image service is our fastest-growing service, and whichever area you own, you will be helping it grow.
You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:

• The hiring machine. How we find, screen and hire people. Running the funnel end to end, sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and telling us when the process itself is broken.

• Client delivery operations. How work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped for our clients. Holding timelines, briefing the team properly, and making sure nothing quietly stalls.

Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.
This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.
We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.

What we are looking for

• You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.

• You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.

• You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.

• You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.

• You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.

• You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.

On experience
We do not ask for a number of years and we do not screen on your CV, because we decide on what you do in the trial.
Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.

How the process works, and we tell you all of it now

• Application with a short Loom video.

• A short written step: your internet speed, your computer, and a few questions in your own words.

• Aptitude tests, with a published floor.

• A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.

• A short call with the founder.

• A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning. From the first week you will be making calls on live work, and we will tell you straight how each one landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

Requirements

• Full time once hired, and this is your only job. During the paid trial you work 4 hours a day with us, 2 of them at a fixed time inside our working day, and you can keep your current job. If you pass, you give notice and join us full time within 30 days.

• Reliable internet, at least 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.

• Strong written English.

• Based in Argentina.

• You track your working time with our time tracking tool from day one.

Benefits
1300 USD per month on hire, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.
Pass your 90-day review and your pay goes up by 50 percent. The 90 days count from the day you start full time.

On top of that:

• A one-month annual bonus.

• 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.

• Paid sick leave.

• A health allowance.

• A coworking allowance.

Responsibility and pay move quickly here for people who earn them. Authority over decisions that reach a client moves slowly and deliberately, and it is earned on a track record rather than on a good first month. We would rather tell you that now than have you discover it in month two.

postings.title: Traffic (User Acquisition) Team Lead
postings.descriptionText:
About ScholarshipOwl

ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the U.S., connecting over 14 million Gen Z students with private scholarships — and the brands that power them. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.
We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.

The Role
We are seeking an analytical, hands-on Traffic Team Lead / User Acquisition Team Lead to take full ownership of scaling user acquisition across paid (PPC) and partner (Affiliate) channels. In this player-coach role, you will manage, develop, and coach a dedicated team of PPC and Affiliate Managers while maintaining direct involvement in campaign mechanics, tracking architecture, and partner economics.
Your role is to elevate the profitability, scalability, and predictability of our multi-channel traffic acquisition. If you are an experienced performance marketer who loves diving deep into funnel economics, diagnosing attribution leaks, catching traffic fraud, and mentoring high-output teams, this role is built for you.

What You’ll Do

• Team Leadership & Coaching: Act as a hands-on "player-coach," mentoring the Affiliate and PPC team while setting clear KPIs, testing roadmaps, and accountability standards.

• Team Development: Conduct structured performance reviews with each team member and ensure clear ownership of priorities and deliverables.

• Stakeholder Communication: Update adjacent team leads and relevant stakeholders on performance, risks, opportunities, and changes to projections.

• Budget & Strategy Ownership: Manage and dynamically allocate multi-channel acquisition budgets across PPC and Affiliate networks based on real-time CAC, ROAS, and LTV.

• Channel Optimization: Guide the team's daily execution—from PPC bidding and creative testing to negotiating high-leverage affiliate deals and scaling new traffic sources.

• Unit Economics & Forecasting: Own the math behind customer acquisition, monitoring full-funnel conversion rates, payback periods, and delivering accurate weekly forecasts.

• Data Integrity & Fraud Triage: Maintain strict attribution accuracy across tracking platforms (GA4, Mixpanel, TUNE, etc.) and aggressively eliminate click fraud, bot traffic, and budget waste.

Requirements

Must-Haves

Experience & Leadership Baseline

• Relevant Experience: 3+ years of professional performance marketing / user acquisition experience, with at least 1+ year in a hands-on PPC role, 1+ year in hands-on affiliate management, and 1+ year managing or leading a growth/traffic team.

• Player-Coach Mentality: Proven ability to balance strategic leadership, team communication, and coaching with direct execution—pulling reports, analyzing campaign mechanics, and troubleshooting ad accounts alongside your team.

• Budget Management: Demonstrated track record managing meaningful acquisition budgets and making disciplined, performance-based capital allocation decisions.

Channel & Commercial Mastery

• PPC Execution: Strong working knowledge of PPC campaign management, keyword bidding, creative testing, and paid media optimization.

• Commercial Acumen & Affiliate Strategy: Deep understanding of partner economics, how to structure commercially attractive deals, and broad awareness of major players and developments across the UA ecosystem.

Economics, Analytics & Traffic Quality

• Acquisition Economics: In-depth understanding of full-funnel performance metrics, including CAC/CPA, conversion rates, payback periods, ROAS, and LTV.

• Traffic Quality & Fraud Mitigation: Demonstrated ability to evaluate traffic quality and actively diagnose issues such as click fraud, attribution hijacking, bot traffic, poor targeting, or low-intent sources.

• Tracking & Analytics Tooling: Hands-on experience with affiliate tracking and traffic-management platforms (e.g., TUNE, Affise, Everflow) and product analytics tools (e.g., Mixpanel, GA4).

• Quantitative Investigation: Strong analytical and quantitative foundation, with the ability to independently query data, segment performance, uncover hidden patterns, and identify incremental growth opportunities.

Behavioral Traits & Working Style

• Communication & Transparency: Clear, direct communication style with the ability to simplify complex data, while remaining completely transparent and honest when performance misses targets.

• Analytical Temperament: Composed, objective demeanor during unexpected performance drops, combined with a natural curiosity to dig beneath surface-level explanations.

• Strategic Prioritization: Intellectual humility to challenge existing assumptions (including your own) and the operational discipline to cut low-value or unprofitable initiatives early.

Nice-to-Haves

Advanced Technical & Data Skills

• Proficiency in writing SQL queries to pull, aggregate, and analyze raw data independently.

• Basic programming or scripting experience to automate repetitive workflows.

• Hands-on experience building custom dashboards or automated reporting solutions.

• Strong familiarity with multi-touch attribution models and structured experimentation frameworks.

• Experience deploying modern AI prospecting, research, and workflow tools (e.g., Clay, automated web scrapers, LLMs for copy/data analysis).

Channel Scaling & Zero-to-One Growth

• Track record of managing PPC and affiliate acquisition simultaneously while scaling a user acquisition function.

• Experience discovering, validating, and scaling brand-new acquisition channels or traffic sources from scratch.

Industry Background, Network & Education

• Direct industry experience within EdTech, freemium subscription models, lead generation, or Gen Z-focused consumer marketplaces.

• An active personal network of affiliate partners, traffic brokers, and direct publishers.

• Proven history of attending relevant industry conferences and converting them into commercial partnerships.

• Degree or professional qualification in Marketing, Business, Economics, Statistics, Data, or a related field (hands-on track record prioritized over formal education).

Why Join ScholarshipOwl ?

• Mission-Driven Work: Build technology that helps students unlock education opportunities and reduce financial barriers.

• Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world while collaborating with a global team.

• High Impact & Ownership: You aren't just a cog in a machine; you own your domain and directly drive results.

• Unlimited PTO: We value outcomes over hours worked and trust you to manage your time.

• Computer Upgrade Budget: Up to $1,600 to invest in your ideal primary work computer.

• Workspace Upgrade Program: Up to $800 to set up your home office.

• Monthly Coworking Allowance: $200/month to rent desks or workspace passes whenever you want a change of scenery.

• Owl Shine Program: Monthly employee recognition and awards celebrating extraordinary contributions.

• Continuous Learning Culture: Dedicated support for curiosity, bold experimentation, and career growth.

• Annual Global Off-sites: Connect with your teammates in person at exciting locations around the world.

Highlights
We are seeking an analytical, hands-on player-coach Traffic (User Acquisition) Team Lead to take full ownership of scaling user acquisition across PPC and Affiliate channels and lead the traffic team.

Top-of-market salary in USD.

About the Role:
We are seeking a curious, driven, and thoughtful Product Intern to join our Payments & Fees team. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.
If you want to truly understand how fintech works, there's no better place to start than payments — and no better seat than product. The Payments & Fees team sits at the intersection of technology, data, and business, working with payment processors, payment method providers, and cross-functional partners across the company. As a product intern here, you won't be watching from the sidelines. You'll be in the room (or the channel) where decisions get made, picking up context fast and contributing to a team that moves quickly and takes its craft seriously.
You'll support the product manager across a high-throughput environment: helping keep the backlog organized, digging into data to understand payment flows, and working alongside an efficient and technically sharp engineering team, as well as Design and Data teams. Product management is one of those rare roles where no two days look the same — you're constantly context-switching between technical conversations, business problems, and user needs, and that's exactly what makes it exciting.

What You'll Do:

Ticket Management & Product Support

• Assist the product manager in drafting, organizing, and tracking tickets for changes and improvements to the payments service. Help ensure work is well-documented, properly prioritized, and moving through the backlog. Follow up on status and surface blockers when needed.

Context Gathering & Stakeholder Support

• Help the product manager stay on top of inputs from multiple stakeholders by gathering background context, summarizing key information, and preparing materials ahead of provider meetings. Respond to routine internal questions by pulling the right information from available resources.

Payment Workflow Analysis

• Learn and apply SQL to query payment data and support the creation and maintenance of dashboards that track payment performance, processing failures, and operational health. Help flag anomalies in payment flows and assist in assembling data for reviews and investigations.

Documentation & Process Tracking

• Maintain clear internal documentation for payment flows, fee structures, and operational processes. Help keep cross-functional teams aligned with concise, well-structured written updates.

Agile Meetings

• Participate in agile meetings and collaborate with engineering, operations, compliance, and support teams. One of the most valuable things a product manager does is serve as a bridge between tech and the business — translating technical challenges into clear language and business needs into actionable requirements. You'll get hands-on experience doing exactly that.

What We Look For:

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, or a related field

• A genuine interest in payments, fintech, and how complex financial systems work under the hood

• Natural curiosity and a logical mindset — you enjoy working through problems, aren't afraid to ask questions, and get satisfaction from figuring things out

• Strong attention to detail — you notice when something's off and follow through until it's resolved

• Comfort working with data and a willingness to learn SQL; prior experience is a plus but not required

• Effective written and verbal communication — you can summarize a complex topic clearly and ask the right questions to fill in gaps

• Prior experience in internships, projects, or extracurriculars related to product, fintech, data analysis, or startups is a plus — but we hire for potential, not just pedigree.

• Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

About You:

• You have relentlessly high standards — many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You're not bound by convention — your success and much of the fun lies in developing new ways to do things.

• You need action — speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

• You earn trust — you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have backbone; disagree, then commit — you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

• You deliver results — you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

postings.descriptionText:
WHY DEPT®?

We are pioneers at heart. What this means, is that we are always leaning forward, thinking of what we can create tomorrow that does not exist today. We were born digital and we are a new model of agency, with a deep skillset in tech and marketing. That’s why we hire curious, self-driven, talented people who never stop innovating.

Our culture is big enough to cope and small enough to care. Meaning, that with people across 20+ countries, we’re big enough to provide you with the best tools, global opportunities, and benefits that help you thrive. While acting small by investing in you, your growth, your team, and giving you the autonomy to solve our clients problems, no matter where you are in the world.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Associate Director, Delivery is a critical contributor within the DEPT® Delivery team - responsible for managing the successful execution of high-value digital campaigns and projects across media engagements. You’ll work cross-functionally to bring ideas to life, meet our client’s performance goals - turning strategic direction into high-quality, on-time delivery.

This role requires a strong sense of ownership, comfort with complexity, and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders across timelines, disciplines, and workflows. You will act as a central liaison between internal teams and clients, advocating for both process efficiency and operational excellence.

You are fluent in the tools, methods, and mindsets of performance marketing & digital campaigns - and energized by building great work through strong collaboration, structured planning, and proactive problem-solving.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

This role requires a proven track record of best-in-class delivery, and you'll be expected to manage a variety of tasks and projects, including:

• Project Leadership & Management:

• Manage mid-sized to large-scale digital campaigns with agency budgets typically ranging from $500K to $1M+, across a.o. Digital marketing strategy and media planning, SEA, Social advertising, Programmatic advertising, SEO, content & analytics

• Define project scope, deliverables, timelines, and resourcing plans in collaboration with cross-functional teams.

• Drive end-to-end execution, from kick-off to delivery, ensuring work is delivered on time, on brief, and within budget.

• Identify risks, resolve blockers, and escalate challenges early with solution-oriented thinking.

• Monitor and manage project financials including estimates, actuals, ETC (Estimate to Complete), and EAC (Estimate at Completion).

• Anticipate risks and blockers; proactively resolve issues or escalate as needed.

• Process Improvement & Team Collaboration:

• Identify opportunities to streamline project workflows and reduce operational friction.

• Collaborate with internal teams to evolve delivery processes, templates, and ways of working.

• Support the integration of new tools or practices that improve efficiency and cross-discipline collaboration.

• Champion consistency in documentation, QA, and project standards.

• Client & Stakeholder Relations:

• Serve as a key client point of contact on day-to-day delivery needs — communicating clearly, managing expectations, and keeping momentum.

• Prepare agendas, run project meetings, and ensure alignment across stakeholders.

• Document decisions, action items, and next steps with clarity and follow-through.

• Build strong working relationships across departments to keep work flowing smoothly and transparently.

• Peer Support & Knowledge Sharing:

• Informally mentor junior project managers by sharing knowledge, best practices, and process tips.

• Contribute to internal discussions around delivery improvement, workflow evolution, and team enablement.

• Maintain a strong sense of accountability and “managing across” with peers and adjacent roles.

WHAT YOU BRING

Experience & Skills

• 5-7 years of experience in digital project or program management, with ownership over large engagements or multi-track workstreams.

• Experience managing single projects with budgets of $1M+ from end to end.

• Proven media agency experience, with a strong track record of successfully partnering with and delivering for English-speaking client accounts.

• Demonstrated expertise in client-facing stakeholder management, setting clear expectations, and driving cross-functional alignment.

• Deep understanding of performance marketing - Digital marketing strategy and media planning, SEA, Social advertising, Programmatic advertising, SEO, content & analytics

• Familiarity with agile, waterfall, and hybrid approaches (e.g., Scrumfall).

• Proficient in Jira, Trello, and G Suite - and comfortable adopting new tools as needed.

• Strong financial awareness and experience managing estimates, tracking budgets, and reporting on profitability.

• Excellent time management and communication skills in cross-functional environments.

Key Traits

• Execution-Driven – You’re focused on getting the work done right, on time, and with precision.

• Process-Minded – You love structure and understand how process unlocks great creative.

• Collaborative – You’re a great communicator who builds trust across disciplines.

• Detail-Oriented – You have a keen eye for clarity, consistency, and quality.

• Proactive – You anticipate challenges and solve problems before they escalate.

• Growth-Oriented – You’re always looking to improve how you work and help others do the same.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

• Premium healthcare through OSDE for the employee and their immediate family members

• Mendel prepaid card with a monthly allowance for grocery purchases

• Monthly reimbursements for Wi-Fi/electricity expenses

• Monthly reimbursements for training/English classes

• 100% covered “Plan Total” membership at Sportclub

• Access to a our benefits platform through Bonda

• A flexible vacation policy

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is at its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s lived experience, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, and genetic information. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work . Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world, and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a pioneering technology and marketing services company that creates integrated end-to-end digital experiences for brands such as Google, KFC, Philips, Audi, Twitch, Patagonia, eBay and more. Its team of 2,500+ digital specialists across 30+ locations on 5 continents delivers pioneering work on a global scale with a boutique culture.

Learn more about DEPT®

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here .

Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

Your Role:

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build the developer platform that agents and partners use to integrate and build on. You evolve Alpaca’s MCP servers, tools, and skills, and you build the APIs behind them.

You play a central role to define the architecture that provides the fastest time to market for integrators. Builders who embed Alpaca for their end users all use this surface.

This is a hands-on role. You will lead through architecture, code, design reviews, and mentorship, and you will ship the first version yourself. You will partner with Product, Compliance, Risk, and Platform Engineering teams.

Things You Get To Do:

• Design and build Alpaca’s agent-facing developer platform: MCP servers, tools, skills, and the APIs behind them.

• Evolve that platform as the MCP protocol and connector, plugin, and skill standards change.

• Build new APIs that make trading and account capabilities available to apps and agents.

• Decide which components the platform renders, so developers and partners build apps faster from shared building blocks.

• Keep Alpaca’s execution model current with the MCP protocol and with connector, plugin, and skill standards, and translate what changes into the application architecture of the developer platform.

• Own production reliability and quality for the services you build.

• Mentor engineers and raise the quality of design and implementation in this area.

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

• 5+ years of software engineering experience, with ownership of production systems that other developers use.

• Shipped a developer-facing API, SDK, or platform as a primary contributor.

• Enough MCP architecture to work with stateless and stateful behavior, and experience building to MCP, or to connector, plugin, or skill standards, as they have changed in production.

• Strong API design, including schemas, compatibility, and responses other developers can rely on.

• Proficiency in Python or TypeScript, and a willingness to work primarily in Go.

• Strong architectural judgment, with a record of shipping while requirements are still being defined.

• Clear communication with engineers, product, compliance, and risk partners.

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):

• Experience shipping developer-facing tools, SDKs, or MCP servers.

• Experience building agents with a framework such as LangChain.

• Experience or understanding of financial markets

• Production experience with Go.

• Experience working at a startup.

• Experience working remotely.

How We Take Care of You:

• Competitive Salary & Stock Options

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

• Trace discrepancies from account activity and source records through transformation logic to furnished outputs; identify root causes and implement lasting fixes

• Investigate escalations from Customer Service, explain what happened to account data and what should be reported under approved policies, and provide evidence to support their dispute responses

• Partner with Engineering on defects in production services or the consumer app, providing reproducible examples, affected-account analysis, and clear requirements; validate fixes through the reporting pipeline

If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated, best-in-class Senior Data Engineer. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. This position will own the data pipelines, transformations, and reporting processes that support accurate, complete, and timely furnishing of customer account information to credit bureaus.

This role presents an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, high growth environment while taking hands-on ownership of a critical customer-facing data function. You will dig into account data and code, debug SQL and Python workflows, and carry issues from investigation through verified resolution. You will partner with Customer Service to resolve technical dispute escalations, with Compliance to apply approved reporting requirements, and with Engineering when a fix is needed in production services or the consumer app. We are looking for an independent problem solver who can manage recurring reporting operations while improving the systems behind them.

What You’ll Do:

• Own recurring credit bureau furnishing operations, including data preparation, validation, submissions, bureau feedback, exception resolution, and reconciliation

• Build, maintain, and debug SQL transformations, Python scripts, and data pipelines that produce credit reporting data

• Trace discrepancies from account activity and source records through transformation logic to furnished outputs; identify root causes and implement lasting fixes

• Investigate escalations from Customer Service, explain what happened to account data and what should be reported under approved policies, and provide evidence to support their dispute responses

• Identify all accounts affected by reporting defects, implement corrections and controlled reprocessing, and verify the resulting reporting outcomes

• Develop automated tests, reconciliations, monitoring, and alerts to catch inaccurate, incomplete, duplicate, or unexpected reporting before submission

• Partner with Engineering on defects in production services or the consumer app, providing reproducible examples, affected-account analysis, and clear requirements; validate fixes through the reporting pipeline

• Work with Compliance to translate approved reporting requirements into technical rules and escalate ambiguous reporting scenarios

• Document reporting logic, data lineage, procedures, and incident resolutions so the process is repeatable and can be supported by others

What We Look For:

• Degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related quantitative discipline

• 5+ years of relevant experience in data engineering or software engineering, including hands-on ownership of production data pipelines and operational workflows

• Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, account-level reconciliation, data profiling, and troubleshooting transformation logic

• Strong Python skills, including the ability to read unfamiliar code, debug existing scripts, and implement maintainable fixes

• Demonstrated ability to independently investigate ambiguous problems, prioritize recurring operations and incidents, and carry issues through to verified resolution

• Experience with version control, code review, automated testing, monitoring, and safe deployment and reprocessing of data workflows

• Excellent problem-solving skills, with a track record of tracing data defects across systems and preventing recurrence

• Strong business judgment and communication skills; able to explain technical findings to Customer Service and Compliance and work effectively with Engineering

• Fluent in English

• Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

•
Experience with credit reporting dispute workflows, e-OSCAR, Metro 2 format, and investigating escalations from customer support teams

•
Experience with dbt, Redshift, PostgreSQL, AWS, and workflow scheduling or orchestration tools

•
Experience in consumer lending, servicing, payments, financial services, banking, fintech, or BNPL

The Tech You’ll Work With:

• Python

• Redshift, PostgreSQL

• Data build tool (dbt)

• WS, G Suite, Mac

• Coding agents Claude, ChatGPT

Interview Process:

• Application submitted (you are here)

• Wonderlic test (30-40 min)

• Interview with recruiters (30 min)

• Online coding assessment focused on SQL, Python, and debugging

• Verbal case study interview. Walk through a credit reporting discrepancy, trace the data and code, and explain how you would correct and prevent the issue.

• Verbal behavioral interview. Share examples of independently resolving data incidents, improving reliability, and partnering with Engineering and Customer Service.

• Offer

About You:

• You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

• You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

• You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

• You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production.

Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first.

We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien!

The Mission

We are seeking a Senior Revenue Forecasting & Operations Business Partner to own Caylent’s revenue forecast and the operational data that feeds it, and to act as the finance partner to our Sales and Delivery leadership. Reporting to the Director of Finance, you will turn signed SOWs, staffing plans, and billing schedules into a forecast leadership can rely on, and explain the variance when actuals land.

This is a hands-on role with high visibility to the CFO and the executive team. You will work daily with senior leaders across Sales, Delivery, Resource Management, and Accounting, challenging assumptions, influencing decisions, and translating financial trade-offs into clear recommendations they can act on. As we grow, you will also help integrate acquired entities into our forecasting, reporting, and systems.

Your Assignment

Revenue Forecasting and Finance Business Partner

• Own the monthly and quarterly revenue forecast across all entities (US, Canada, Brazil, Argentina, Mexico) and subsidiaries, and maintain a rolling 12-month forecast that supports the annual budget and reforecast cycles.

• Build the forecast bottom-up from signed SOWs, change orders, staffing plans, and billing schedules, and reconcile it top-down to the Salesforce pipeline and bookings.

• Forecast by revenue type : time and materials, fixed fee, managed services, and AWS-funded engagements.

• Model backlog burn, utilization, and bench impact on revenue, and flag engagements at risk of under-delivery or overrun.

• Deliver a monthly forecast vs. actuals package with variance explained by engagement, practice, and entity.

Business Partnering

• Act as the trusted finance partner to Sales, Delivery, and Resource Management leaders, joining their forecast, pipeline, and staffing reviews on a recurring basis.

• Partner on deal and SOW structuring (pricing, fee model, AWS funding) before signature, not only after.

• Challenge assumptions (pipeline conversion, utilization, staffing, deal structure) with data, and influence decisions.

• Translate financial trade-offs (margin, cash, risk) into clear recommendations for senior, non-finance stakeholders.

Systems, Data & Reporting

• Be the Finance owner of revenue data across Salesforce, the PSA or time tracking system, and the ERP; define the fields and controls that keep them in sync.

• Build and maintain forecast models and dashboards with full traceability from reported numbers back to source records.

• Automate recurring reporting where practical (Google Sheets, Apps Script, SQL, BI tooling, or AI tools).

• Document revenue operations processes and controls to support audit and month-end close.

What Success Looks Like

• First 30 days: Understand the forecast end to end and map every active engagement to its fee structure, billing schedule, funding terms, and staffing plan.

• First 90 days: Own the monthly forecast and deliver the first forecast vs. actuals package with variance explained by engagement; establish regular cadences with Sales and Delivery leadership and become their go-to finance partner for forecast and deal questions.

• First 6 months: Forecast accuracy within 5% of actuals at the company level and within 10% by offering; forecast reviews with Sales and Delivery leaders run on a regular cadence.

• First year: Forecast model and dashboards are the single source of truth for revenue; recurring reporting is automated; Sales and Delivery leaders rely on Finance’s view in their own planning decisions.

Your Qualifications

• 5+ years in FP&A, revenue operations, or revenue accounting, with at least 2 years in professional services or consulting.

• Proven track record as a finance business partner to senior commercial and operational leaders.

• Hands-on experience forecasting project-based revenue : time and materials, fixed fee, and milestone engagements

• Experience in Salesforce and at least one PSA or time tracking system

• Advanced Google Sheets or Excel modeling ; comfortable building models others will audit

• Clear written and verbal communication; executive presence with senior stakeholders; able to explain a variance in a few sentences.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience at an AWS or cloud consulting partner , including AWS funding programs

• Exposure to M&A , including integration of acquired entities into forecasting, reporting, and systems.

• Working knowledge of ASC 606 for services revenue, including percentage-of-completion and deferred and unbilled revenue.

• SQL, Apps Script, or Python for reporting automation

• Experience with multi-entity and multi-currency reporting

Language Requirement

Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey? 
 
At Aleph, we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.
 
Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.
 
With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.


The Head of Sales will be responsible for one of the largest markets in the region, helping our clients in different industries grow their business using X.
You will be navigating complex business situations, helping clients solve their challenges and driving our commercial teams toward our revenue objectives with ad products.
You need to utilize your strategic and analytical business skills, along with talent management skills to cultivate and lead the team. An ideal candidate will have a strong digital media sales track record with team management experience, hands-on use of AI and a strong focus on metrics to achieve our revenue objectives.

Main Responsibilities
•
Lead and develop the X team by coaching, training and building its structure, including recruiting

•
Drive the commercial teams strongly toward sales, setting priorities by advertiser, vertical and product, and helping close strategic pitches and proposals with clients

•
Build a strong partnership with X's regional team and sustain close alignment on programs, product roadmap, incentives and targets for the Argentine market

•
Regularly consult and align with internal directors and leadership on strategy, performance and resources

•
Track and report the performance of the business (revenue, pacing, pipeline, campaign metrics and client trends) and turn it into actions

•
Establish managerial processes: annual planning, budget prioritization, impact measurement

•
Use AI to work faster and at a greater scale, and drive its adoption across the team and the commercial teams

Skills and Experience required:
•
Minimum qualification will be sales track record in digital media or understanding of branding and full funnel marketing

•
Minimum 6+ years of work experience in a media sales, partnerships or account management role with knowledge in digital performance marketing and ad metrics from tech-driven companies, agencies or media platforms

•
2+ years of team and people management experience

•
Leadership skills – strong point of view with the ability to navigate clients, partners and internal leadership, and to build and foster relationships in a matrix organization

•
Strong analytical skills to track KPIs and campaign performance and turn data into decisions

•
Advanced, hands-on use of AI in day-to-day work, with concrete examples of improved results

•
Proficient in Spanish and English with writing, communication and interpersonal skills

Why Join Us?
 
Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.  
 
We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together.

postings.title: Territory Manager (Texas Panhandle)
postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT HALTER

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. 

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund https://foundersfund.com, Bessemer Venture Partners https://www.bvp.com/, BOND, https://www.bondcap.com/ DCVC https://www.dcvc.com/, Blackbird https://www.blackbird.vc/, Promus Ventures https://www.promusventures.com/, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures https://www.icehouseventures.co.nz/?utm_term=icehouse%20ventures&utm_campaign=Brand+Keywords&utm_source=adwords&utm_medium=ppc&hsa_acc=4064636360&hsa_cam=16902737884&hsa_grp=134004309485&hsa_ad=592971340272&hsa_src=g&hsa_tgt=kwd-1082530126230&hsa_kw=icehouse%20ventures&hsa_mt=b&hsa_net=adwords&hsa_ver=3&gclid=Cj0KCQjw2v-gBhC1ARIsAOQdKY0J0DepRVFDmjQlAkJPbZuQnLSA5UVzUzOXYiPxkjX-SeVa513_BhkaAr-MEALw_wcB.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Ever dream about being in tech but aren’t quite ready to trade in your cowboy boots? Look no further than Halter! As the leading provider of virtual fencing technology, Halter is on a mission to enable 50% of the world’s landmass to be more productive and sustainable. This role is paramount for our growth aspirations and will enable us to continue making an impact on ranches across the US.

As a Territory Manager at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving new business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction. In this role, you will prioritize daily efforts that optimize performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and Customer Onboarding, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of US farmers.

Your day-to-day could include being on horseback, helping customers gather their cattle, on a side-by-side traversing their pastures, talking about how Halter could benefit their pastures, or attending industry events like CattleCon or your local Livestock Association meetups.



This role covers the Panhandle region of West Texas. Frequent travel is required as apart of this role.




WHAT YOUR DAY COULD LOOK LIKE

 - Prospecting New Business: You’re driving up driveways, attending local cattle auctions, meeting with your local Livestock, Cattleman's, Stockman's associations, building your new business pipeline through outbound lead generation efforts. You’re fielding inbound leads in a timely manner, prioritizing administrative tasks with your in-field activities.

 - In-Field Sales: You don’t mind getting your hands and boots dirty. Halter is best discussed over a coffee at a kitchen table, in the horse saddle, or on a side-by-side in a pasture. You’re out on the ranch helping potential customers before diving into the value of Halter. You’re dropping off coffee during calving season. You value the magic moments that make all the difference to our customers.

 - Expanding Existing Opportunities: You’re always looking for new opportunities, and that includes expanding your existing customers with Halter. You find value in expanding relationships and finding new ways to increase value over time. Not every rancher will collar all of their cows, so you see this as a unique opportunity to meet your goals.

 - Hitting Sales Targets: High-growth sales targets don’t scare you; you step up to a challenge and like shooting high. You’re an expert pipeline manager and don’t second-guess unqualifying a lead. You’re able to manage today’s deals while keeping next month in your sights.

 - Customer Account Management: Building relationships is more than just making the sale to you. After the sale, you aim to maintain close relationships with your customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.

 - Territory Ownership: You have a high level of ownership and take pride in what you build. Owning an entire territory means giving treatment to every corner and leaving no stone unturned. You value being the face of your territory, meeting with high-level stakeholders from various local, state, and federal agencies to build lasting relationships with regional agricultural groups.

 - Customer Onboarding: Your high level of ownership doesn’t stop after the sale. You dive in to make sure your customers have the very best onboarding experience possible. You actively own the end-to-end customer experience during onboarding and deployment of Halter’s product, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation even when you’ve handed off the customer to different teams across Halter.

 - Field Learnings & Feedback: Feedback is not only paramount to the companies you want to work for, but it’s also ingrained in how you would own your territory. Serving as the primary point of contact for gathering customer feedback in your territory, you work tirelessly to advocate for what your customers need.

 - Collaborating with Support Teams: You’re a natural collaborator, seeking out partners across Halter to resolve any issues your customers encounter, and quickly. You escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.

 - Attending Industry Events: You leverage opportunities at relevant industry and Halter events to generate leads and deepen relationships with existing customers. You’ll participate in demonstrations and network to expand Halter’s influence in the market.

postings.title: Data Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join a high-performing data engineering team at a leading global company operating at the intersection of sports, technology, and digital commerce.
 
In this role, you will take ownership of the systems responsible for ingesting, transforming, validating, and publishing data across a large-scale data ecosystem. You will work at the data ingestion boundary, where information from multiple internal and external sources enters the platform, ensuring it is accurate, reliable, and ready to power downstream products, analytics, and services.
 
You will be responsible for building and maintaining scalable data pipelines, solving complex identity and entity-matching challenges, identifying and addressing data-quality issues, and improving the reliability and observability of data flows across the organization.
 
This is a highly hands-on engineering role that combines AWS data engineering, Python, SQL, event-driven architectures, data quality, and identity resolution. You will work closely with engineering, product, analytics, and downstream platform teams to troubleshoot complex data challenges, improve existing systems, and build reliable solutions that support data-driven products at scale.
 
What You'll Do
• Own and evolve data ingestion pipelines that bring data from multiple external and internal sources into the platform, including ingestion, cleaning, curation, entity resolution, and event-driven publishing.
• Design, build, and maintain scalable batch and event-driven data workflows using Python, SQL, and AWS.
• Solve complex identity resolution, entity matching, and deduplication challenges across multiple data sources, ensuring reliable and consistent entity mappings.
• Build and maintain data quality and validation frameworks, including freshness monitoring, null-rate and consistency checks, and schema-drift detection.
• Monitor data at the ingestion boundary and proactively identify, troubleshoot, and resolve issues before they impact downstream products and services.
• Partner with engineering teams responsible for event infrastructure and downstream identity services to trace data and events end-to-end.
• Collaborate with Product, Assessments, Analytics, and Engineering teams to understand how data is consumed downstream and ensure pipelines meet evolving product and business requirements.
• Work with AWS services such as Glue, Athena, S3, and DynamoDB to build and operate reliable, scalable data infrastructure.
• Automate infrastructure and pipeline changes using Infrastructure as Code, primarily Terraform or AWS CDK.
• Participate in production incident response, quickly assessing impact, identifying root causes, and implementing effective remediation.
• Continuously improve the reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability of data pipelines and platform infrastructure.
 
What You'll Bring
• 5+ years of experience building and operating production-grade data pipelines and data infrastructure.
• Strong experience with both batch processing and event-driven architectures.
• Hands-on experience with AWS Glue, Athena, and S3-based data lakes, including layered or medallion-style data transformations.
• Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for data processing, transformation, and analysis.
• Experience solving identity resolution, entity matching, and deduplication problems, including exact and fuzzy matching approaches.
• Understanding of durable identifiers and identity-mapping strategies, including the challenges associated with maintaining consistent first-seen or locked mappings over time.
• Experience working with event schemas and schema-registry-backed contracts, such as Protobuf, and an understanding of the impact of schema evolution on downstream consumers.
• Strong troubleshooting and production incident-response skills, with the ability to assess impact, identify root causes, and drive issues through resolution.
• Ability to understand and debug code written in a functional or concurrent programming language, such as Elixir.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, analytics, and other technical teams.
 
Nice to Have
• Experience with Elixir/Phoenix or other BEAM-based concurrent processing frameworks.
• Experience with DynamoDB-backed identity, lookup, or matching services.
• Experience with the Snowflake ecosystem, including data modeling, Snowpipe, Streams, and Tasks.
• Experience working with sports data providers, licensed data providers, or other complex external data ecosystems.
• Experience implementing data observability, including freshness and staleness alerts, null-rate monitoring, schema-drift detection, and data-quality dashboards.
• Experience managing infrastructure through Terraform or AWS CDK.

postings.title: Coordinador/a de Producción y Servicios
postings.descriptionText:
Buscamos incorporar un/a Coordinador/a de Producción y Servicios para acompañar el desarrollo de la nueva Planta de Crushing de Bahía Blanca.

Durante la etapa de construcción y puesta en marcha, su principal responsabilidad será liderar el área de Servicios Industriales, participando activamente en su montaje, commissioning y puesta en servicio. Complementariamente, dará soporte al Jefe de Producción en otras necesidades operativas del proyecto, adquiriendo progresivamente una visión integral de los procesos de la planta.
Posteriormente, durante la operación de la planta, liderará la gestión de Producción y de los Servicios Industriales (Utilities), garantizando la disponibilidad de los sistemas críticos, la continuidad operativa, el cumplimiento de los objetivos de producción, calidad, eficiencia energética y sustentabilidad, promoviendo una cultura de seguridad y mejora continua.
Principales responsabilidades
Durante la etapa de construcción y puesta en marcha:

• Liderar y coordinar las actividades vinculadas con los Servicios Industriales , incluyendo calderas y generación de vapor, captación y tratamiento de agua industrial, tratamiento de efluentes, aire comprimido, sistemas contra incendio, sala de bombas y redes de cañerías.

• Supervisar las actividades de montaje mecánico, eléctrico e instrumentación, asegurando el cumplimiento de las especificaciones técnicas, estándares de calidad, seguridad y cronograma establecidos.

• Asegurar la correcta interpretación y ejecución de planos, P&ID, especificaciones técnicas y documentación de ingeniería.

• Coordinar contratistas y equipos multidisciplinarios, realizando el seguimiento de avances, calidad de ejecución y cumplimiento del cronograma.

• Participar activamente en las actividades de commissioning, pruebas funcionales, pruebas de estanqueidad, energización y puesta en marcha de equipos y sistemas.

• Coordinar la resolución de fallos y desvíos durante el arranque, documentando causas, soluciones y oportunidades de mejora.

• Asegurar la correcta transferencia de los sistemas hacia el equipo de Operaciones, incluyendo documentación técnica, procedimientos y capacitación.

• equipo de Operaciones, incluyendo documentación técnica, procedimientos y capacitación.

• Garantizar la disponibilidad y confiabilidad de los servicios necesarios para sostener la operación continua.

• Liderar investigaciones de desvíos operativos e incidentes, impulsando análisis de causa raíz y acciones correctivas.

• Promover una cultura de seguridad basada en el liderazgo visible y la prevención.

postings.title: Corporate offsites and travel manager (100% REMOTE)
postings.descriptionText:
We are seeking an experienced and operationally minded Corporate Offsites & Travel Manager to lead our regional internal meetings, executive dinners, and global corporate travel program. In this role, you will be responsible for planning and executing recurring department offsites (~30-50 attendees), managing curated corporate dinners, and governing our day-to-day relationship with our 3rd-party Travel Management Company (TMC).

You will design scalable "Meeting-in-a-Box" playbooks to streamline internal offsites while ensuring high traveler satisfaction, policy compliance, and operational efficiency across our global footprint.

Responsibilities

• External & VIP Event Travel Support

Serve as the dedicated travel and booking focal point for all flagship and VIP events produced by the External Events team.
Oversee room block commitments, flight manifests, and VIP ground transfers for keynote speakers, executive guests, and attendees.
Coordinate white-glove, high-touch travel arrangements for executive leadership and special guests during major external functions.
2. Regional Offsites & Corporate Dinners
Own end-to-end planning, venue sourcing, and logistics for regional department offsites.
Curate high-touch private dining experiences and executive venues for corporate dinners.
Develop, standardize, and maintain repeatable "playbooks" and self-service guidelines so internal team leads can execute smaller meetings with operational consistency.
Manage vendor contracts, catering, room blocks, and ground transport for all gatherings.
3. Corporate Travel & TMC Agency Governance
Serve as the primary operational owner for our 3rd-party Travel Management Company (TMC).
Monitor agency Service Level Agreements (SLAs), online booking tool (OBT) adoption, traveler support responsiveness, and policy compliance.
Oversee corporate travel policy updates, travel safety/duty-of-care frameworks, and travel profile administration.
Partner with the Travel & Logistics Coordinator to ensure seamless handling of group airfare, room block releases, and executive escalations.
4. Administrative & Stakeholder Management
Partner with the Event & Travel Finance Lead to track budget actuals, audit TMC billing feeds, and manage purchase orders.
Gather post-event feedback and analyze travel data to continuously optimize offsite playbooks and corporate travel experiences.
5. Team Leadership & People Management
Directly manage, mentor, and oversee day-to-day tasks for the Travel & Logistics Coordinator and supporting event staff.
Coordinate workload distribution across team members to manage overlapping offsite schedules, peak conference travel rosters, and VIP travel requests.
Set performance goals, conduct reviews, and foster professional development within the travel and offsite operations pod.

Qualifications & Experience

Experience: 7+ years of experience leading corporate meetings, regional offsites, and corporate travel management operations.

Leadership & Management: 2+ years of direct people management or proven experience supervising, coordinating, and delegating work to direct reports, coordinators, or cross-functional team members.

Travel Operations: Proven track record of managing 3rd-party Travel Management Company (TMC) relationships, online booking tools, and group travel logistics.

Event & VIP Logistics: Experience coordinating travel manifests, hotel room blocks, and VIP concierge services for high-profile external events or large conferences.

Event Execution: Strong background in venue sourcing, hotel room block negotiations, catering coordination, and run-of-show planning for mid-sized gatherings.

Vendor Management: Experience negotiating corporate rate agreements with hotel chains, boutique properties, and event vendors.

Skills: Exceptional organizational, communication, and project management skills; ability to balance multiple offsite timelines simultaneously.
