postings.title: Corporate Security and Crisis Management Lead
postings.descriptionText:
Company Overview:
Accenture, a Fortune 500 company, is a global management consulting and professional services firm that solves its clients' toughest challenges by providing unmatched services in strategy, consulting, digital, technology, and operations. We serve clients in more than 120 countries and have over 745,000 employees.

Overview of the Team:
People are at the heart of Global Protection & Security, Accenture's Corporate Security Team. They are an organization of highly skilled, experienced, and diverse professionals who take immense pride in serving Accenture and helping grow the business. The Regional Protective Services team is a core part of Global Security & Protection, and its members are based out of various regions of the world.
Job Summary:
Reporting to the Regional Protective Services Lead for Latin America, the Regional Protective Services (RPS) Manager in Argentina is a full-time role responsible for incident and crisis management, emergency preparedness, physical security strategy and standards compliance, facility threat, vulnerability and risk assessments, workplace violence prevention, travel security, geo-political threat monitoring, corporate security related training.

They also support investigations, behavioural threat assessment and management, executive protection and event security, security officer vendor selection, deployment, and performance reviews within their area of responsibility (Argentina, Chile, and Colombia).

They will provide guidance and support in a complicated corporate environment that values collaboration, independent thinking, proactive problem-solving, integrity, collegiality, efficiency, and continuous organizational transformation. They are expected to develop a close collaborative relationship with Accenture's Business, IT, Cyber Security, Legal, Travel, Workplace, and HR leaders, as well as with domestic and foreign law enforcement and diplomatic and intelligence services.
They will support the wider Latam Regional Protective Services team, it is required to be flexible and be available on call (24/7). Travel 25% of the time & work outside normal business hours and at short notice. Must be able to work nights, weekends, and holidays as operational needs dictate.
Requirements:
All candidates must have at least 5 years of relevant security experience or the equivalent in private, government, or security forces. A degree from an accredited college or university is required, and an advanced degree is a plus.

postings.title: Senior Regional Security Governance & Risk Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
At dentsu, we are committed to protecting our clients’ brands and data, therefore information security is at the forefront of our business.
Job Description:
As a Senior Regional Security Governance & Risk Analyst on the Americas Security team, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining a security governance and risk program that supports our information security management system, certification initiatives, policy implementation, and risk and exception management. You'll collaborate with regional and global stakeholders to coordinate risk assessments, maintain regional inputs to the global security risk register, evaluate control effectiveness, and drive agreed remediation and security improvement actions. You'll also maintain compliance obligations and supporting evidence, helping translate security requirements into practical business processes that protect information confidentiality, integrity, and availability. Led by the Americas Region BISO, our Americas Region Security team is responsible for security initiatives across the Americas Region and supporting dentsu’s clients and brands.

If you're a proactive, detail-oriented professional with a passion for cybersecurity and a desire to make a meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply and be part of our mission to protect what matters most

Responsibilities

• Build positive relationships with regional and global stakeholders, partnering with business, risk, and control owners to embed security governance requirements and progress agreed actions.

• Coordinate risk remediation activities supporting the information security management system, working with action owners to address findings from incidents, root cause analyses, audits, and risk assessments.

• Assess and report on the design and operating effectiveness of security controls, documenting supporting evidence, control gaps, and recommended improvements for risk and control owners.

• Actively contribute to security training initiatives to increase employee awareness

• Coordinate the regional security exception process, documenting business justification, risk assessments, compensating controls, required approvals, and review or expiry dates in line with the defined process.

• Coordinate information security risk assessments using the defined information security risk management process, ensuring relevant stakeholders provide inputs and agreed assessments are completed within established timeframes.

• Assess risks for in-scope platforms across the Americas.

• Maintain regional risk records and their corresponding entries in the global security risk register, keeping risk descriptions, owners, assessments, treatment plans, and status updates accurate and current in coordination with global risk stakeholders.

• Coordinate regional activities supporting security certification initiatives and audits, maintaining assessment schedules, organizing evidence, and tracking findings and agreed corrective actions.

• Maintain the regional security improvement plan, tracking action owners, milestones, and agreed target dates; validate completion evidence and escalate overdue actions or delivery barriers through the appropriate governance channels.

• Partner with business and technology stakeholders to review and improve internal processes and systems, addressing security risks and dependencies identified through business impact assessments and data protection impact assessments to protect information confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

• Define and maintain a regional record of applicable security compliance obligations, mapping each obligation to relevant controls, evidence requirements, and evidence owners to demonstrate alignment.

• Document and regularly review governance, risk assessment, risk treatment, and exception procedures, keeping regional practices aligned

• with the defined global security governance and risk management processes.

• Drive continuous improvement in regional security governance and risk management by identifying recurring control gaps, analyzing risk trends, and recommending practical, risk-based improvements to regional and global stakeholders.

Candidate Profile

• Stakeholder management and interpersonal skills at both a technical and non-technical level.

• Demonstrated experience in information security governance and risk management, including supporting an information security management system and applying knowledge of security practices, technologies, and architectures to business risks.

• Ability to work independently on complex governance and risk activities, prioritize competing demands, and manage assessments and remediation actions through to completion while adapting to changing business conditions.

• Proactive, upbeat and collaborative communication style, with the ability to be direct, tactful, and transparent

• Ability to work effectively as part of a team

• Solid problem-solving skills. Ability to analyze problems and risk from multiple perspectives

• Comfortable with managing uncertainty, ambiguity, and change to make decisions and prioritize tasks

• Practical experience applying information security risk assessment and treatment techniques, maintaining risk registers, and documenting risk decisions and exceptions using a defined risk management process.

• Ability to translate complex technical findings into clear business-risk statements and concise governance reports for technical and non-technical stakeholders, supported by strong communication and organizational skills.

• Is demonstrably self-motivated, pro-active, action orientated to achieve deadlines

• Proactive development of trending knowledge and skills within information security community

• Demonstrated ability to support policy reviews, maintain compliance obligations and evidence mappings, and coordinate risk treatment and exception workflows with relevant stakeholders.

• Desirable qualifications include experience with IT assurance and auditing techniques, an understanding of network architecture and protocols, and an achieved or in-progress information security qualification such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or CRISC. These are advantageous rather than mandatory.

• Experienced with IT assurance functions and auditing techniques (desirable)

• Understanding of network architecture, protocols and principles (desirable)

• Fluency in Spanish and English is required. Portuguese proficiency is highly desirable.

Analista Sr de Estrategia de Cuenta - Mercado Pago

En Mercado Libre estamos democratizando el comercio, el dinero y los pagos en América Latina.
Nuestro negocio Fintech ofrece, a escala regional, una propuesta de valor integral que busca democratizar los servicios financieros y satisfacer las necesidades de millones de personas que utilizan nuestras soluciones.
Brindamos una plataforma online que permite cobrar ventas electrónicas realizadas tanto dentro como fuera de Mercado Libre, y un sistema de códigos QR y dispositivos Point para cobrar ventas realizadas en el mundo físico. Así, damos la posibilidad a millones de comerciantes, emprendimientos y profesionales de procesar de manera segura sus operaciones.
También, otorgamos acceso gratuito a una cuenta digital, que permite pagar, enviar y recibir dinero, generar rendimientos y operar con tarjetas para hacer compras o extracciones.
A través de Mercado Crédito, ofrecemos créditos para satisfacer las necesidades de las personas que utilizan nuestros servicios y para ayudar a potenciar el negocio a quienes venden a través de nuestra plataforma.

Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

Hola. Somos Haleon. Una nueva empresa líder mundial en salud del consumidor. Moldeados por todos los que se unen a nosotros. Juntos, estamos mejorando la salud cotidiana de miles de millones de personas. Al crecer e innovar nuestra cartera global de marcas de categoría líderes, incluidas Corega, Centrum, Sensodyne, Alikal, Uvasal, Voltaren, Hinds, entre otras, a través de una combinación única de profundo conocimiento humano y ciencia confiable. Además, estamos teniendo éxito en una empresa de la que tenemos el control. En un entorno en el que estamos co-creando.

¿Te motiva resolver problemas, trabajar con datos y estar cerca del negocio? ¿Querés empezar tu carrera profesional en un equipo dinámico y colaborativo? ¡Esta es tu oportunidad!

Como Pasante de Customer Service, vas a formar parte del equipo de Operaciones Comerciales y serás un punto de apoyo clave para el área de Ventas. Vas a contribuir a que nuestros clientes reciban un servicio ágil y de calidad: gestionarás reclamos, coordinarás entregas con grandes clientes y operadores logísticos, y generarás información que ayude a mejorar los procesos del área.

Principales responsabilidades

● Brindar soporte al equipo de Ventas en los procesos de facturación.
● Gestionar los retiros de mercadería por devoluciones para la posterior carga de créditos.
● Atender y dar respuesta a las consultas y reclamos de gerentes y vendedores del área comercial.
● Solicitar y coordinar turnos de entrega con grandes clientes.
● Hacer el seguimiento de los reclamos de entrega junto al operador logístico, hasta su resolución.
● Generar las [órdenes de pago / órdenes de pedido] (OP) del sector.
● Analizar datos y elaborar estadísticas e informes de gestión del área.

¿Por qué VOS?

Tus calificaciones:

● Estudiante de Administración de Empresas, Contador Público, Ingeniería o carreras afines, con aproximadamente un año y medio de cursada restante para recibirte.
● Manejo de Excel Intermedio-Avanzado
● Manejo de Power Bi.
● Nivel de inglés intermedio.
● Disponibilidad para trabajar en el turno mañana, de 9 a 13 h (20 horas semanales), en Zona Norte, San Fernando.
● Perfil proactivo, organizado y con muchas ganas de aprender.
● Orientación al cliente y buenas habilidades de comunicación.
● Atención al detalle y capacidad para gestionar varias tareas a la vez.
● Interés por el análisis de datos y la mejora de procesos.

Diversidad, Equidad e Inclusión

En Haleon incentivamos una fuerza de trabajo diversa creando un ambiente inclusivo que celebra nuestras perspectivas únicas, genera curiosidad para crear una incomparable comprensión mutua, promoviendo resultados justos y equitativos para todos. Nos esforzamos por celebrar nuestra diversidad de todas las formas, tratándonos con respeto, estando abiertos a nuevas perspectivas, respaldando a nuestras comunidades y creando un ambiente de trabajo en el que nos sintamos auténticos, perteneciendo y prosperando.

¿Sientes que este puede ser tu próximo paso de carrera? ¡Inscríbete ahora!

Job Posting End Date

2026-11-11

Equal Opportunities
Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.

The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

Adjustment or Accommodations Request
If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

Note to candidates
The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

postings.title: ANALISTA PLANIFICACION PAROS
postings.descriptionText:
Sumá tu energía a la compañía que contribuye al desarrollo de nuestro país.

En YPF buscamos personas que quieran ser parte de un gran equipo que transforma desafíos en oportunidades y que actúa con excelencia para generar valor. Con más de cien años de historia, somos la compañía energética líder de la Argentina, impulsando el desarrollo y la innovación tecnológica del país.

¡Sumarte a YPF es unirte a un proyecto que combina experiencia, pasión y la energía necesaria para seguir construyendo nuestro futuro!



¿Qué buscamos?



Buscamos una persona proactiva, con visión estratégica y orientación al negocio, con foco en la ejecución y logro de resultados y con alta capacidad de gestionar entornos complejos y de alta incertidumbre, flexibilidad para adaptarse a procesos de cambio. Se necesitan sólidas habilidades de trabajo en equipo y comunicación efectiva para desempeñarse en el rol de analista de planificación de paros dentro de la DIRECCION DEL COMPLEJO INDUSTRIAL LUJAN DE CUYO.



¿Cuáles serán tus desafíos con nosotros?



Serás responsable de planificar, coordinar y ejecutar la planificación de los recursos necesarios y el proceso de contratación, velando por el cumplimiento de los planes de parada de unidades, a fin de garantizar una ejecución eficiente del plan de mantenimiento, de acuerdo con la normativa vigente, las políticas de Seguridad, Calidad y Medio Ambiente de la Compañía y las directrices fijadas por su línea de Mando.



¿Cuáles serán sus principales responsabilidades?



Elaborar y verificar las especificaciones técnicas, definir los mecanismos de control y participar en el proceso de contratación de los trabajos, asegurando la incorporación de todo lo solicitado, y análisis técnicos.

Planificar y programar los recursos materiales y de mano de obra necesarios para la ejecución de paradas de unidad, verificando la planificación de las tareas solicitadas, coordinando los equipos de trabajo y realizando el seguimiento de las necesidades de recursos y de la adquisición de los mismos.

Supervisar y controlar la ejecución de los trabajos de parada de unidad de acuerdo a los estándares de calidad, seguridad y protección del medio ambiente, analizando los avances de los programas establecidos y anteponiéndose a posibles problemas y desvíos.

Valorar y verificar la calidad de los trabajos efectuados por las empresas contratistas, participando en el proceso de clasificación de empresas contratistas.

Identificar las características y especificaciones de materiales en su adquisición y/o sustitución de acuerdo a normas y estándares de codificación.

Utilizar los sistemas informáticos de Ingeniería y Mantenimiento, generando información periódica sobre su actividad, detallando sus intervenciones, reflejando los costes y recursos implicados y actualizando la documentación técnica afectada, utilizando herramientas específicas de planificación y control de trabajos.

Controlar las certificaciones y mayores actividades aprobando las mismas.

Colaborar con los ingenieros de mantenimiento, en la preparación y ejecución de trabajos de envergadura, Paradas Programadas y no programadas y otros trabajos de gran incidencia en la producción.



¿Qué Valoramos?





• Formación académica: título universitario en Ing. Mecánica, Electromecánica, Industrial o carreras afines.


• Experiencia : experiencia en Paradas de Planta, Mantenimiento, Gestión de Proyectos dentro de la industria.


• Conocimientos Específicos: conocimiento avanzado de planificación, programación y ejecución de Paradas de Planta y Proyectos. Gestión económica de proyectos: certificaciones, contratos, análisis de costos. Manejo avanzado de herramientas analíticas y de visualización de datos.


• Idiomas : Inglés Técnico







Información del puesto



Reporte directo: MATIAS FARINA, JEFE PAROS

Lugar de trabajo: REF. LUJAN CUYO

Encuadre gremial: Fuera de convenio

Disponibilidad para viajar: eventualmente





Si sos una persona que:



• Trabaja con excelencia y profesionalismo.


• Da lo mejor cada día, valora la meritocracia y busca siempre la milla extra.


• Vive los desafíos como oportunidades para innovar y aprender.

¡Este puesto es para vos!



¿Qué ofrecemos?

Un entorno donde podés aportar lo más valioso que tenés: tu energía. Esa energía que impulsa, que se adapta, que aprende, que suma, que transforma.

Sumarte a la #ExperienciaYPF es:

🤩 Impulsar tu desarrollo al siguiente nivel con nuevas oportunidades de aprendizaje.

postings.title: COORDINADOR ASEGURAMIENTO CALIDAD OPERACIONAL
postings.descriptionText:
En YPF somos mucho más que una empresa productora de petróleo y gas. Somos la marca bandera que desde hace 100 años lleva la energía a cada rincón del país impulsando así su desarrollo y el de las personas que lo habitan. ¡Formá parte del equipo que está cambiando el ecosistema energético de nuestro país!



¿Qué buscamos?



Estamos en búsqueda de una persona que se desempeñe en el rol de Coordinador de Aseguramiento de Calidad Operacional con sólida experiencia en participación de procesos de obras de construcción.



¿Cuáles serán tus desafíos con nosotros?



Liderar las actividades y recursos a su cargo que aseguren el cumplimiento de los requisitos de Calidad establecidos para los Proyectos y Obras asociadas, bajo una visión con foco en el QA en los procesos propios de la Gerencia de Proyectos Industriales (GDPI) y de sus Contratistas, durante todo el ciclo de vida de los proyectos.



¿Cuáles serán tus principales tareas?





• Participar en el desarrollo y actualización de los Planes de Aseguramiento de la Calidad de las Obras y la integración de los mismos para establecer una metodología de trabajo estandarizada entre proyectos y enfocada en el Plan de Mejora Continua de los Procesos propios de la Gerencia de Proyectos industriales.


• Evaluar la gestión de la calidad de las empresas contratistas en etapa previas a la ejecución de Proyectos. Participar en la corrección del Plan de Calidad de la Contratista para el Proyecto. Realizar la valoración de oferentes en temas de Calidad, durante los procesos de Evaluación Técnica.


• Participar junto con el equipo de Construcciones del proyecto en el dimensionamiento de los equipos de trabajo, necesarios para el seguimiento de los procesos de Calidad en los Proyectos.


• Establecer el Plan Anual de Formación en temas de Calidad.


• Controlar, previo al comienzo de las actividades, que los Planes de Inspección y Ensayos respondan a los requisitos definidos en los documentos contractuales.


• Elaborar el plan de Auditorías Propio de la GDPI y el aplicable a sus empresas contratistas conforme los planes de Calidad aprobados.


• Establecer y monitorear los indicadores (KPI) definidos por la GDPI para detectar potenciales desvíos que den origen a la No Calidad. Elaborar y mantener actualizado los tableros de control de seguimiento por cada uno de los Proyectos en Ejecución y unificados para reportar a la Gerencia de la GDPI.


• Asegurar la gestión de desvíos a través de No Conformidades y/o mediante evidencia objetiva que permita realizar el seguimiento de los mismos.


• Velar por el cumplimiento, por parte de la Contratista, del Plan de Capacitaciones de Calidad. Monitorear la implementación de las acciones preventivas que surgen de los análisis de causa raíz de las No Conformidades o desvíos.


• Asegurar las Comunicaciones asociadas al Plan de difusión de las actividades lideradas por el sector de Calidad.


• Participar con el equipo de Construcciones en el control de la documentación que conforma los Data Books del proyecto entregada por la Contratista. Asegurar la transferencia de la totalidad de entregables al usuario final una vez alcanzada la finalización del Proyecto.


• Asegurar la gestión de los documentos de obra de acuerdo con la normativa interna. Verificar el cumplimiento de la gestión documental establecida para el Proyecto.


• Participar y asegurar el cumplimiento del proceso de emisión y revisión de los documentos de la GDPI en Y-DOC u otros sistemas establecidos por la compañía, dando soporte a las áreas responsables de cada proceso.





¿Qué valoramos como adicional?





• Formación Académica: Ingenieros/as o Licenciados/as con conocimiento en sistemas de gestión de calidad (graduado Universitarios).


• Experiencia Profesional:

This role will primarily work with the US-based Accounts Support Finance teams and directly support US-based Client Serving engagement teams.

• Prepare and analyze invoice adjustments / reversals


• Collaborates with US-based account support to client cash collection, escalation and resolution




Basic qualifications:

Superside is hiring a Director of Creative Strategy to lead and evolve our Strategy function. You'll shape how strategy drives creative excellence across the business, leading a team of strategists while partnering with executive customers and internal leaders to solve complex business challenges through insight-driven creativity.

You'll define the future of strategy at Superside, building scalable frameworks, growing strategic talent, and ensuring strategy becomes a key driver of customer success, creative quality, and commercial growth.

What You'll Do

• Lead, mentor, and develop the Creative Strategy team, fostering high performance and continuous growth.

• Define the vision, standards, and operating model for Strategy across Superside.

• Partner with senior customer stakeholders to solve complex business challenges and strengthen long-term relationships.

• Guide strategic development across major customer engagements, ensuring consistently high-quality thinking.

• Build frameworks, methodologies, and best practices that scale strategic excellence across the organization.

• Partner with Creative, Marketing, Sales, Product, and Account teams to shape integrated customer solutions.

• Champion AI-powered ways of working that improve research, strategic thinking, and creative development.

• Identify opportunities to expand strategic services, contributing to customer growth and new business.

• Use market intelligence, customer insights, and performance data to shape strategic priorities and innovation.

• Represent the Strategy function internally and externally, helping position Superside as a leader in AI-powered creative strategy.

What You'll Need To Succeed

• 8+ years of experience in strategy within creative, advertising, branding, or digital agencies.

• Proven experience leading and developing high-performing strategy teams.

• Strong track record advising senior stakeholders and executive customers.

• Deep expertise in brand strategy, digital marketing, creative effectiveness, and customer insights.

• Experience building strategic frameworks, methodologies, and scalable ways of working.

• Commercial mindset with experience contributing to customer growth, business development, or strategic consulting.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business and creative strategies.

• Experience integrating AI into strategic research, planning, and creative development.

• Exceptional communication, facilitation, and presentation skills.

• Ability to influence cross-functional leaders and drive strategic alignment across the business.

Compensation

Additional Information

Why Join us?

Superside's vision is to create equal opportunities globally by accelerating the world’s transition to online work. With that in mind, we're building a fully remote company that attracts people where they are.

Remote-first. Customer-led.

Remote isn’t just a perk; it’s how we deliver better for customers. We are fully committing to our customers by hiring top talent and collaborating seamlessly across time zones.

Global team, local impact.

Join a community of 60+ nationalities working across time zones, cultures, and disciplines, all aligned on doing great work for great brands.

High performance, low ego.

Work in a fast-paced, high-trust environment where feedback is direct, growth is constant, and kindness leads collaboration.

Impact meets opportunity.

We’re in the sweet spot — big enough to be stable, small enough for you to shape what’s next. Your ideas will matter here.

Grow fast. Lead well.

You’ll gain mentorship, take on real responsibility, and grow your career while helping us disrupt a global industry.

About Superside

Superside is the leading AI-powered creative company that quickly and cost-effectively enhances in-house functions. We help over 500 ambitious brands get great creative concepts done at scale. Built to be an extension

of in-house teams, we unbottleneck marketing and creative teams so they can move faster and drive more reliable creative performance.

Superside is a fully remote company with over 700 team members working across 60+ countries and 13 timezones.

Learn more at superside.com

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal-opportunity company. All applicants will be considered regardless of ethnicity, appearance, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran or disability status.

postings.descriptionText:
Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

What you'll do
We're looking for a Fraud Strategist Expert to shape and scale Clara's global fraud detection strategy across all markets and fraud vectors. Fraud prevention at Clara goes beyond reacting to suspicious transactions—it's about building intelligent, scalable systems that stay ahead of evolving fraud threats. This is a senior Individual Contributor role reporting to the Head of Fraud. You will combine deep fraud expertise, strong analytical judgment, and a builder mindset focused on AI and automation to ensure innovation is balanced with strong governance and effective risk controls.
In this role, you will:

• Define and own global fraud detection strategies, methodologies, and standards across fraud vectors, ensuring consistency and effectiveness across regions.

• Drive the evolution of Clara's fraud detection infrastructure, including rule engines, machine learning models, risk signals, and case management tools.

• Lead the AI and automation roadmap for fraud detection, identifying opportunities to automate alert triage, investigations, decision-making, and operational workflows using tools like N8N .

• Explore and implement AI-powered detection capabilities, including anomaly detection, behavioral analysis, intelligent alerts, and automated rule optimization.

• Anticipate emerging fraud threats, including AI-enabled fraud, synthetic identities, deepfakes, and evolving attack patterns, and develop robust mitigation strategies.

• Establish strong model governance and risk management practices, ensuring explainability, fairness, performance monitoring, auditability, and appropriate human oversight.

• Build mechanisms to share fraud intelligence across regions, enabling faster identification of emerging patterns and consistent deployment of detection strategies.

• Independently monitor and challenge regional fraud detection performance, identifying gaps, risks, and opportunities for improvement using data platforms like Databricks and Metabase .

• Partner closely with Fraud Operations, Risk, Product, Engineering, and Data Science to translate detection strategies into scalable tools and solutions.

• Define automation and monitoring strategies that enable 24/7 fraud detection coverage, reducing manual dependencies while maintaining effective controls.

• Establish clear KPIs and performance frameworks to measure detection effectiveness, automation coverage, model performance, and platform reliability.

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

THE ROLE:

The manager of client finance will be responsible for owning the end-to-end financial health of assigned client projects, with a particular focus on complex creative work and cross-functional engagements. This role will partner closely with client partners and delivery teams to ensure forecasts are accurate, budgets are realistic, and projects are delivered in line with financial targets. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience in forecasting, reporting, invoicing, and timesheet and budget reconciliation, along with the ability to interpret data, spot risks early, and communicate clearly with both finance and non-finance stakeholders to support sound decision-making and sustainable profitability.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• Strategic financial business partner to Client teams and Finance leadership helping to influence positive financial management and decision making supported by data

• Development of monthly forecasts and annual Budget planning, with an ownership over revenue and expense planning, with oversight from Group Director and Executive Director

• Partner with cross functional leads to develop strategies that drive profitable growth

• Monitoring month-end close processes including but not limited to reviewing revenue recognition and journal entries, ensuring actuals are updated accurately and bringing forth any issues to be resolved for the following month

• Draft or oversee preparation of financial reporting such as month end reports, and variance analysis. Recommending areas to improve reporting, where needed

• Understand results and ability to respond to questions from Finance and Senior Leadership on key drivers impacting the P&L

Client Finance:

• Partner with the Sales, Client, Operations and Legal teams in new business efforts including pricing client proposals, assisting in responding to RFP/Is and the development of budgets to maintain healthy margins

• Partner with Client leads, Legal and Finance leadership to review statements of work including analyzing and supporting the development of new pricing models or opportunities for increased revenue

• Review monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue versus the forecast to provide commentary and determine whether we met or exceeded financial goals, including the tracking of client margins and profitability

• Partnering with Client leads to maintain a strong knowledge of the client's business models, contractual arrangements, health of the business, and growth opportunities

• Liaise between DEPT entities on intercompany transactions inclusive of reviewing and helping to set up intercompany contracts and projects

• Analyze, identify, and communicate areas of concern or suggested improvements within the Client Portfolio to both Finance and Client Leaders

• Evaluate fees for client staffing plans and suggest staffing and margin recommendations with the support of Finance leadership

• Ensure agency performance is consistent with contract obligations

Other Responsibilities:

• Serve as the initial FP&A point of contact for client audits

• Lead development and delivery of regular and ad hoc reporting for client teams and senior leadership, as needed

• Lead the development of process improvement initiatives with minimal oversight from Finance Leadership

• Ensure adherence to reporting deadlines for both client and finance calendars

WHAT YOU BRING:

• Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, or business preferred

• 2-4 years experience, 2 years experience in an Agency, preferred.

• Experience working at a Media or Creative Agency is a plus.

• Proven experience managing project financials end-to-end, including forecasting, budgeting, billing, and invoicing.

• Strong forecasting and budgeting skills, with the ability to assess the financial health and trajectory of client projects.

• Knowledge of GAAP and IFRS accounting principles and their practical application related to revenue accruals preferred (ASC 606, IFRS 15).

• Experience with Financial Systems; such as Anaplan and Netsuite, is a plus

• Exhibit judgment on when to elevate issues and when to resolve independently

• Strong analytical orientation. Skills in financial analysis, including review of financial statements and analysis of key business metrics

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office with emphasis on Excel skills and Google Product Suite software applications

• Forward thinking - challenges the status quo and proactively and creatively identifies opportunities for improvement

• Ability to effectively work and communicate with both finance and non-finance stakeholders

• Motivated self-starter; able to effectively manage workload, prioritize and streamline tasks to ensure accuracy and ownership in work/clients/practices.

• Strong interest, or proven experience, in AI, automation, advanced analytics and emerging Finance technologies

TAKE INTO ACCOUNT:

You will have to communicate with your team members abroad, therefore fluency in English and excellent communication skills (both written and verbal) are a must for this role.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

• We enjoy spending time together, working closely with other local colleagues, and getting to know one another. Our Buenos Aires offices (Villa Crespo or Mar del Plata) are fully equipped with refreshments and great common spaces!

• Premium healthcare through OSDE for the employee and their immediate family members

• Mendel prepaid card with a monthly allowance for grocery purchases

• Monthly reimbursements for Wi-Fi/electricity expenses

• Monthly reimbursements for training/English classes

• 100% covered “Plan Total” membership at Sportclub

• Access to a our benefits platform through Bonda

• A flexible vacation policy

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU:

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

DEPT® participates in E-Verify, meaning your Form I-9 information will be sent to the federal government to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work . Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Coach, eBay, and OpenAI.

Learn more about DEPT®

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

postings.title: Director, Sales (Core & Supplemental)
postings.descriptionText:
Why You’ll Love This Role

Newsela is seeking a strategic, high-growth Director of Sales to lead, scale, and inspire our Core Curriculum and Supplemental sales organization. Reporting directly to the Sr. Director of Sales, you will oversee the Sales Managers and Account Executives driving the expansion of Newsela’s core curriculum and Newsela supplemental portfolios with an immediate strategic focus on balancing how to amplify the successful national supplemental and California core strategy nationally.

In this role, you will lead through frontline managers to build high-performing sales teams, architect regional go-to-market strategies, and partner with district- and state-level education leaders. You will foster a positive, "people-first" high-performance culture while establishing predictable revenue models, refining enterprise sales plays (utilizing MEDDPICC), and positioning Newsela as the premier core curriculum partner across school districts.

What You’ll Be Doing

Strategic Leadership & Revenue Growth

• Drive Regional Strategy & Quota Achievement: Accountable for consistently meeting or exceeding sales targets across new logo acquisition, and expansion for both supplemental and core.

• Build & Scale Talent: Recruit, hire, coach, and retain top-tier frontline Account Executives that can effectively balance selling core and supplemental Newsela products in adoption and open territory.

• Pipeline Oversight & Strategic Forecasting: Deliver precise, reliable monthly, quarterly, and annual regional revenue forecasts to executive leadership. Maintain rigorous pipeline discipline across teams, ensuring a minimum of 2.5x pipeline-to-quota coverage at all times.

Management Coaching & Operational Excellence

• Cultivate a High-Performance, "People-First" Culture: Lead through frontline leaders by creating an environment that empowers teams, celebrates wins, and establishes repeatable best practices across territories.

• Manager & Deal Coaching: Conduct regular deal and pipeline reviews with Sales Managers and Senior AEs. Leverage methodologies like MEDDPICC and insights from tools such as Gong to coach on complex K-12 procurement, school board approval navigation, and multi-year adoption cycles.

• Performance & Territory Management: Guide managers in designing and executing comprehensive regional territory plans. Oversee team performance management on a weekly, monthly, and quarterly basis, providing actionable feedback and establishing gap-to-goal strategies when necessary.

Market Execution & Field Engagement

• Executive & Field Modeling: Travel up to 30–40% within the region to co-sell, model leadership behaviors in the field, and build executive relationships with key district superintendents, county office leaders, and state adoption decision-makers.

• GTM Alignment: Shape Newsela’s go-to-market approach for core subjects (including Core ELA/ELD) and supplemental subjects (ELA, Social Studies, STEM, Writing). While California is our first state and we have a team deployed, you will need to fully bring to life the vision for selling during a state adoption cycle while balancing that in one team with supplemental GTM motions. Further, you will lead our other regional teams as we roll out our national core solution into their territories over the next 12+ months. You will continuously align strategy with unique territory needs, including helping managers balance core and supplemental strategies by state and subject.

• Cross-Functional Executive Partnership: Serve as the strategic voice of the field to executive leadership, Product, Field Marketing, Customer Success, Enablement, Finance, and Operations teams to inform future core product development and streamline go-to-market alignment.

• Data-Driven Operations: Oversee accurate CRM usage (Salesforce) and leverage modern AI sales tools to optimize territory prioritization, deal flow analytics, and operational efficiency across the leadership hierarchy.

About You

• 10+ years total K-12 Sales Experience: Deep expertise in the K-12 EdTech and instructional material space, with a minimum of 5+ years directly focused on K-12 core curriculum sales (ELA/ELD highly preferred).

• 4+ years Sales Leadership Experience: Proven track record as a second-line leader or Senior Sales Manager leading quota-carrying teams to a collective annual revenue target of $8M+.

• Core Curriculum Mastery: Demonstrated experience leading teams or directly executing multi-year core curriculum adoption campaigns aligned with state board approvals, district funding streams, and complex procurement cycles.

• Enterprise Deal Leadership: Extensive track record navigating large enterprise district accounts (20,000+ students) and managing high-stakes school board and state-level approval processes.

• Framework & Tool Mastery: Deep proficiency in structured sales methodologies (MEDDPICC, Challenger) and sales tech stack execution (Salesforce, Gong, Salesloft, and AI-driven workflow optimization).

• Location & Travel: Willingness to travel up to 30–40% to meet with district/county leaders and support managers in field execution.

• Education & Authorization: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Education, or related field (or equivalent practical experience); legally authorized to work in the US.

All offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check as part of our pre-employment process.

This role is classified as an exempt salaried role and is not eligible for overtime.

Why you’ll love working at Newsela:

• Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical benefits with employer contribution to premiums and to HSA accounts. Additional benefits such as gym reimbursement, pet insurance, free access to the Calm app, Rocket Lawyer and more to help you stay healthy: mind, body, and soul.

• Work From Home: We are a fully remote company. We provide a monthly tech stipend to support your WFH needs!

• Supporting ALL Families: Inclusive benefits to support you and your family, including parental leave, fertility support, adoption, and more!

• Financial Wellbeing: Invest in your future with our 401(k) plan, which includes a employer match to help you build long-term financial security.

• Time Off: Flexible PTO, paid sick time off, company holidays plus winter break (Dec 24th - Jan 1st).

• Professional Development: Newsela offers an annual learning and development allowance to employees to attend external training sessions, classes, workshops, conferences, and educational materials to foster professional growth within their current role and career aspirations at Newsela.

• Make A Difference: No matter your role or department, the work you do each day helps share the future of education and improves the lives of students and teachers.

About Newsela:

Newsela is a leading education technology company dedicated to meaningful classroom learning for every student. We deliver integrated, AI-powered solutions designed to unlock student engagement, empower teachers, and drive meaningful learning outcomes. Our suite of products supports knowledge and skill development, writing practice, daily instruction, assessment, and data-informed decision-making across K–12 classrooms. Grounded in learning science research, Newsela’s solutions integrate content, assessment, and analytics to help educators track progress, understand student outcomes, and deliver high-impact instruction that supports every learner.

postings.title: Compensation Manager LATAM
postings.descriptionText:
Despegar es parte de Prosus, el mayor ecosistema de internet consumer fuera de China. Operamos en más de 20 países, con millones de personas viajando a través de nuestras plataformas cada año. En ese contexto, la función de Compensaciones no es soporte: es palanca estratégica.
Hoy buscamos a alguien que venga a challengear, construir, y crecer. Alguien que no espere tener todo definido para moverse, sino que encuentre en la ambigüedad una oportunidad.
El rol
Reportás a la Directora de Compensaciones & Payroll, con scope regional. Tu trabajo tiene impacto directo en cómo Despegar atrae, retiene y valora a su talento en toda Latinoamérica — Argentina, Brasil, México y más.
No es un rol de mantenimiento. Es un rol de construcción.
Lo que vas a hacer
Estrategia y diseño
Diseñar, gestionar y evolucionar las estructuras de compensaciones a nivel regional (Argentina, Brasil, México), entendiendo las realidades económicas, regulatorias y de mercado de cada país — no como contexto decorativo sino como input directo de tus decisiones.
Analizar y ajustar la estrategia de compensación total: incentivos de corto plazo (bonos, comisiones, esquemas variables) y de largo plazo, garantizando competitividad externa, equidad interna y sostenibilidad del costo.
Colaboración y ejecución
Trabajar en squads multidisciplinarios con HR, Finanzas y líderes de negocio de distintos países, aportando perspectiva técnica y criterio en cada etapa del proceso.
Colaborar de cerca con People Operations para asegurar la ejecución correcta de los programas, con Contabilidad para la precisión de los registros, y con Planning para anticipar el impacto de cada decisión sobre el costo de la estructura.
Articular con el grupo Prosus y sus empresas: alineando criterios, compartiendo mejores prácticas y contribuyendo a la agenda de compensaciones del ecosistema.
Cómo vas a trabajar

postings.title: Territory Manager (Kentucky East)
postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT HALTER

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. 

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund https://foundersfund.com, Bessemer Venture Partners https://www.bvp.com/, BOND, https://www.bondcap.com/ DCVC https://www.dcvc.com/, Blackbird https://www.blackbird.vc/, Promus Ventures https://www.promusventures.com/, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures https://www.icehouseventures.co.nz/?utm_term=icehouse%20ventures&utm_campaign=Brand+Keywords&utm_source=adwords&utm_medium=ppc&hsa_acc=4064636360&hsa_cam=16902737884&hsa_grp=134004309485&hsa_ad=592971340272&hsa_src=g&hsa_tgt=kwd-1082530126230&hsa_kw=icehouse%20ventures&hsa_mt=b&hsa_net=adwords&hsa_ver=3&gclid=Cj0KCQjw2v-gBhC1ARIsAOQdKY0J0DepRVFDmjQlAkJPbZuQnLSA5UVzUzOXYiPxkjX-SeVa513_BhkaAr-MEALw_wcB.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Ever dream about being in tech but aren’t quite ready to trade in your cowboy boots? Look no further than Halter! As the leading provider of virtual fencing technology, Halter is on a mission to enable 50% of the world’s landmass to be more productive and sustainable. This role is paramount for our growth aspirations and will enable us to continue making an impact on ranches across the US. 

As a Territory Manager at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving new business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction. 

In this role, you will prioritize daily efforts that optimize performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and Customer Onboarding, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of US farmers. Your day-to-day could include being on horseback, helping customers gather their cattle, on a side-by-side traversing their pastures, talking about how Halter could benefit their pastures, or attending industry events like CattleCon or your local Livestock Association meetups. 

 

This role covers the East region of Kentucky. Frequent travel is required as apart of this role.

 


WHAT YOUR DAY COULD LOOK LIKE

 - Prospecting New Business: You’re driving up driveways, attending local cattle auctions, meeting with your local Livestock, Cattlemans, Stockmans associations, building your new business pipeline through outbound lead generation efforts. You’re fielding inbound leads in a timely manner, prioritizing administrative tasks with your in-field activities. 

 - In-Field Sales: You don’t mind getting your hands and boots dirty. Halter is best discussed over a coffee at a kitchen table, in the horse saddle, or on a side-by-side in a pasture. You’re out on the ranch helping potential customers before diving into the value of Halter. You’re dropping off coffee during calving season. You value the magic moments that make all the difference to our customers. 

 - Expanding Existing Opportunities: You’re always looking for new opportunities, and that includes expanding your existing customers with Halter. You find value in expanding relationships and finding new ways to increase value over time. Not every rancher will collar all of their cows, so you see this as a unique opportunity to meet your goals. 

 - Hitting Sales Targets: High-growth sales targets don’t scare you; you step up to a challenge and like shooting high. You’re an expert pipeline manager and don’t second-guess unqualifying a lead. You’re able to manage today’s deals while keeping next month in your sights. 

 - Customer Account Management: Building relationships is more than just making the sale to you. After the sale, you aim to maintain close relationships with your customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.

 - Territory Ownership: You have a high level of ownership and take pride in what you build. Owning an entire territory means giving treatment to every corner and leaving no stone unturned. You value being the face of your territory, meeting with high-level stakeholders from various local, state, and federal agencies to build lasting relationships with regional agricultural groups. 

 - Customer Onboarding: Your high level of ownership doesn’t stop after the sale. You dive in to make sure your customers have the very best onboarding experience possible.  You actively own the end-to-end customer experience during onboarding and deployment of Halter’s product, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation even when you’ve handed off the customer to different teams across Halter. 

 - Field Learnings & Feedback: Feedback is not only paramount to the companies you want to work for, but it’s also ingrained in how you would own your territory. Serving as the primary point of contact for gathering customer feedback in your territory, you work tirelessly to advocate for what your customers need. 

 - Collaborating with Support Teams: You’re a natural collaborator, seeking out partners across Halter to resolve any issues your customers encounter, and quickly. You escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.

 - Attending Industry Events: You leverage opportunities at relevant industry and Halter events to generate leads and deepen relationships with existing customers. You’ll participate in demonstrations and network to expand Halter’s influence in the market.

 - Contributing to the US Sales Strategy: You strongly believe that a team can only be stronger when they work together. You strive to work with the broader team to optimize and evolve the sales process, ensuring it fits the US market. As we scale, your input will help drive greater efficiencies.
   
    


YOU'LL BE GREAT IF YOU EXHIBIT

 - Driven Attitude & Communication skills: Results-driven, motivated, and adaptable, you excel in high-stakes environments. You’re well-prepared and skilled at communicating with customers and internal teams alike. You are proactive and do not wait to act. 

 - Ranching / Cattle Experience: You know the ropes (and the reins) of ranching or cattle operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. This experience allows you to connect meaningfully with customers about what matters most.

 - Sales & Customer Success Expertise: You have a strong history of creating new business opportunities, negotiating a value-based sales conversation, and have a background in building lasting customer relationships. You build relationships versus transactional sales, aiming for the long-term success stories and can expand existing relationships through upsell opportunities. 

 - Territory Management experience: Experience managing a large territory with a balanced focus on sales and customer success, ideally within agriculture or technology.

 - Problem Solving & Collaboration ability: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to address challenges and drive solutions.

 - Willingness to Travel: Frequent travel within your territory to engage with customers and prospects.



BONUS THINGS YOU COULD BRING ALONG TO THE ROLE

 - Familiarity with precision agriculture or virtual fencing technologies.

 - Background in customer-facing roles within agriculture technology.

 - Background in selling software (SaaS) solutions in a B2B environment.



OUR BENEFITS

 - Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP): Own a part of Halter and share in our growth and success

 - 401(k): 100% match on the first 3% contributed, plus 50% match on the next 2% (up to a 4% employer match), with immediate vesting

 - Comprehensive health benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting the first day of the month after you join (with most premiums covered, including 100% of employee-only health premiums on select plans)

 - Employee Assistance Program (EAP) & paid wellness leave: Access confidential support through JustWorks plus 3 paid wellness days per year

 - Personal growth fund: $750 USD per year to support learning, development, or personal growth goals

 - Unlimited PTO: Take time off when you need it—no accrual required, available from day one

 - Parental leave: 16 weeks paid leave for birthing parents and 8 weeks paid leave for non-birthing parents

 - Onboarding travel to New Zealand: Fly to NZ for onboarding at Halter HQ in Auckland—meet the team, visit a test farm, and immerse yourself in all things Halter

The annual OTE salary range for this role is $140,000 - $165,000. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Halter and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location.


JOIN OUR TEAM

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page https://www.halterhq.com/careers for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.




WHY OUR TEAM LOVES WORKING AT HALTER:

 - Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

postings.title: B2B Growth & Outbound Marketing Manager
postings.descriptionText:
This role is open to candidates based in LATAM, Africa, and Eastern Europe. Please note that as this role supports U.S.-based clients, candidates must be available to work during U.S. business hours aligned with the client’s time zone.

 

About the Client
Our client is an established eCommerce business specializing in renewed educational technology, serving consumers through online marketplaces and selling directly to schools and districts.


With a growing B2B channel, the company is focused on building a scalable outbound lead generation engine to reach educational institutions, generate qualified opportunities, and support continued revenue growth.
The company operates with a lean, AI-forward team that values ownership, initiative, and customer care.


Role Overview


We are seeking a hands-on B2B Growth & Outbound Marketing Manager to own and scale the company's outbound lead generation and demand generation efforts.
The primary focus of this role is building, managing, and optimizing high-volume cold email campaigns that consistently generate qualified leads and sales opportunities.
The ideal candidate has proven experience developing outbound strategies, managing email infrastructure, building targeted prospect lists, and improving campaign performance through data-driven testing and optimization.


Beyond outbound execution, this person will help identify new opportunities to strengthen B2B demand generation, improve lead quality, and create a more predictable acquisition pipeline. Experience with Google Ads, HubSpot, AI-powered automation, and other growth marketing channels is highly valued, but the primary priority is demonstrated success in outbound lead generation. 


Key Responsibilities
Outbound Lead Generation & Cold Email Strategy

 - Own and execute high-volume B2B cold email campaigns, with the goal of scaling outreach beyond 100,000 emails per month.

 - Develop and implement outbound strategies targeting schools, school districts, and other relevant educational organizations.

 - Manage outbound email platforms such as Instantly, SmartLead, Scaledmail, or similar tools.

 - Build, maintain, and optimize email infrastructure to support campaign scalability and deliverability.

 - Monitor inbox placement, sender reputation, bounce rates, reply rates, and campaign performance.

 - Develop effective cold email messaging, personalization strategies, and multi-step sequences.

 - Continuously test subject lines, messaging, targeting, and campaign structures to improve qualified response rates.

 - Identify underperforming campaigns, diagnose issues, and implement improvements.
   
   

B2B Demand Generation & Prospecting

 - Build and execute targeted prospecting strategies to identify and engage potential B2B customers.

 - Develop qualified prospect lists using Apollo, Clay, LinkedIn, scraping tools, and data enrichment platforms.

 - Define and refine ideal customer profiles (ICPs), audience segments, and targeting criteria.

 - Research market opportunities and identify new audiences, segments, and growth opportunities.

 - Develop scalable prospecting processes that maintain data accuracy and lead quality.

 - Coordinate with leadership and the sales team to align lead generation efforts with business priorities.

 - Track lead quality, positive response rates, meetings generated, and pipeline contribution.

 - Continuously improve prospecting and acquisition strategies based on campaign results.
   
   

Campaign Performance & Growth Optimization

 - Monitor outbound and demand generation performance to identify opportunities for improvement.

 - Analyze campaign metrics, conversion rates, and lead progression to understand what drives qualified opportunities.

 - Conduct structured testing across audiences, messaging, and outreach strategies.

 - Maintain visibility into lead generation performance through dashboards and regular reporting.

 - Provide actionable recommendations to improve acquisition efficiency and pipeline growth.

 - Collaborate with leadership to prioritize growth initiatives and implement improvements.
   
   

Additional Responsibilities & Growth Opportunities
Depending on experience, the successful candidate may also contribute to the following areas:
Paid Acquisition & Google Ads

 - Support or manage Google Ads campaigns focused on B2B lead generation.

 - Optimize campaign targeting, budgets, and conversion performance.

 - Analyze ROAS and other paid acquisition metrics.
   
   

HubSpot & Marketing Automation

 - Build and optimize HubSpot workflows, lead nurturing sequences, and automated follow-up processes.

 - Improve lead routing, lifecycle management, and marketing-to-sales handoffs.

 - Identify opportunities to automate repetitive marketing activities.
   
   

AI & Workflow Automation

 - Leverage AI tools such as Claude to improve prospect research, personalization, campaign development, and operational efficiency.

 - Build or optimize automated workflows using tools such as n8n, Make, or Zapier.

 - Explore AI agents and other automation opportunities to improve lead response times and internal processes.
   
   

Additional Growth Channels

 - Support SEO, content marketing, and organic demand generation initiatives.

 - Explore direct mail and other complementary acquisition channels.

 - Identify opportunities to diversify and strengthen the company's B2B acquisition strategy.
   
   

Qualifications

The ideal candidate has experience creating high-performing short-form video content for SaaS or B2B products, managing social media distribution, and implementing CRM and analytics tracking workflows. CAMPAIGN TESTING & PERFORMANCE OPTIMIZATION

MARKETING AUTOMATION & LEAD MANAGEMENT

 - Set up follow-up and reminder workflows similar to standard inbound marketing funnels.

- Business Intelligence: Experience building enterprise-grade BI solutions and data warehouses.
 
Preferred Qualifications:

- Analytics Background: Understanding of marketing, product, and customer analytics use cases.
- Communication Skills: Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
- Remote Collaboration: Experience working effectively with distributed teams across time zones.
- Monitoring Tools: Experience with data observability and monitoring platforms (Monte Carlo, Great Expectations, etc.).
- Performance Optimization: Advanced knowledge of warehouse optimization and cost management strategies.
 
Key Responsibilities:
- Data Modeling: Design, build, and maintain dbt models for business intelligence and analytics use cases.
- Infrastructure Management: Optimize Snowflake warehouse performance, cost management, and data architecture.
- Self-Service Analytics: Build and maintain Omni dashboards, reports, and self-service capabilities for business teams.

postings.title: Senior Database Administrator
postings.descriptionText:
Bajo el liderazgo de Nicolás Mindlin y Ariel Sbdar, Cocos se consolidó en 5 años como uno de los grupos financieros digitales más relevantes de Argentina 🥥
Hoy somos casi 2 millones de usuarios que ahorran, invierten y pagan desde una plataforma 100% digital. Seguimos creciendo a un ritmo que pocas fintech de la región conocen: tomamos decisiones rápido, lanzamos productos en tiempo récord y estamos obsesionados con la experiencia del usuario.
Cambiamos cómo los argentinos manejan su dinero, pero recién estamos empezando, el objetivo es ser una de las plataformas financieras digitales más relevantes de América Latina.

Por esto, ¡tenemos una oportunidad para vos! Nos encontramos en búsqueda de una persona que ocupe el rol de Senior DBA (Database Administrator) para sumar a nuestro genial equipo de IT 🚀

Serás un jugador clave en la estabilidad de Cocos, responsable de diseñar, optimizar, custodiar y evolucionar nuestros motores de bases de datos para soportar el crecimiento transaccional de la plataforma con máxima disponibilidad, rendimiento y seguridad.

Analizarás los esquemas, consultas y configuraciones existentes para detectar cuellos de botella en performance, garantizando la integridad de los datos críticos y liderando estrategias de alta disponibilidad y contingencia.

Trabajarás mano a mano con los equipos de Desarrollo, DevOps y Arquitectura, acompañando el ciclo de vida de los datos y la modernización continua de nuestra infraestructura 💻

Se trata de una posición híbrida , nuestras oficinas se encuentran en Florida, Vicente López.

👉 ¿Qué vas a hacer en tu día a día?

• Administrar, monitorear y garantizar la alta disponibilidad y escalabilidad de bases de datos en entornos on-premise y en la nube (AWS).

• Realizar tareas continuas de performance tuning, optimización de queries, índices y planes de ejecución para cargas de trabajo críticas y de alto volumen transaccional.

• Diseñar, ejecutar y validar estrategias robustas de backup, replicación, failover y Disaster Recovery (DRP / RPO / RTO).

• Implementar políticas estrictas de seguridad de datos: control de accesos por mínimos privilegios, encriptación en reposo y en tránsito, auditorías y cumplimiento normativo del sector financiero.

• Colaborar activamente con los equipos de desarrollo en el diseño de modelos de datos, revisión de migraciones y buenas prácticas de consultas.

• Automatizar tareas de mantenimiento rutinario, parches, monitoreo proactivo y alertas de métricas de base de datos.

• Diagnosticar y resolver incidentes complejos de producción, participando en guardias pasivas y análisis de causa raíz (post-mortems).

• Participar en proyectos de modernización y migración de datos hacia servicios gestionados en Cloud.

🙌 ¿Qué esperamos de vos?

• Que cuentes con más de 5 años como Database Administrator (DBA) o roles similares.

• Que cuentes con experiencia gestionando motores relacionales tradicionales tanto en infraestructura on-premise como en la nube (AWS: RDS, Aurora, EC2).

• Que domines técnicas avanzadas de tuning de rendimiento, optimización de motores, particionamiento e indexación.

• Que tengas experiencia en configuración de arquitecturas de alta disponibilidad (clústeres, Always On, streaming replication, log shipping, etc.).

• Que manejes scripting (Bash, Python o PowerShell) para la automatización de backups, mantenimientos y chequeos de salud.

👉 ¿Qué suma? (deseable)

• Que tengas conocimiento y experiencia en administración de motores SAP ASE / Sybase (Adaptive Server Enterprise).

• Que tengas experiencia en entidades bancarias, financieras, fintech o brokers con alta exigencia transaccional y regulatoria.

• Que tengas experiencia con motores open source o Cloud Native como PostgreSQL, MySQL o MariaDB.

• Que cuentes con experiencia en bases de datos NoSQL (DynamoDB, Redis, MongoDB).

• Que conozcas herramientas de observabilidad y monitoreo de bases de datos (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, APMs).

• Que manejes conceptos de Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) y CI/CD aplicados a despliegues de esquemas de base de datos (Flyway, Liquibase).

💥 ¿Cómo es trabajar en Cocos?

• Somos una Fintech que no cree en los límites, nos ponemos objetivos desafiantes y buscamos superarnos constantemente.

• Aprendemos en movimiento, somos curiosos, ágiles, nos encanta probar y mejorar.

• Valoramos todas las voces, las ideas y creemos que siempre hay algo nuevo para aprender.

• Tenemos un equipo con mucho talento, buena onda y ganas de construir cosas que transforman.

• Tenemos una cultura donde la educación financiera, la innovación y la colaboración están en el centro de todo lo que hacemos.

• Y no solo buscamos crecer como empresa, sino también hacer crecer a las personas que forman parte del equipo.

Hola. Somos Haleon. Una nueva empresa líder mundial en salud del consumidor. Moldeados por todos los que se unen a nosotros. Además, estamos teniendo éxito en una empresa de la que tenemos el control. En un entorno en el que estamos co-creando.

¿Te apasiona el análisis de datos y quieres comenzar tu carrera profesional en un entorno dinámico y colaborativo? ¡Esta es tu oportunidad!

Como Pasante de Business Intelligence , tendrás un rol clave en apoyar la toma de decisiones estratégicas del negocio a través del análisis de datos y generación de reportes. Principales responsabilidades

• Apoyar con la generación de reportes y seguimiento de los Indicadores Claves de Rendimiento (KPI´s) del negocio.

• Dar soporte al proceso de definición de precios y al monitoreo de su implementación y evolución.

• Asistir con el cálculo y seguimiento de gestión del Gross to Net.

• Apoyar con la creación y seguimiento de las actividades comerciales en SAP.

• Desarrollar propuestas para mejorar los procesos actuales.

¿Por qué TÚ?

Tus calificaciones:

• Estudiantes avanzados carreras de Ingeniería Industrial, Actuario, Administración, Finanzas y/o afines.

• Disponibilidad para laborar de manera híbrida 20h semanales en San Fernando, Zona Norte.

• Nivel intermedio/avanzado de Excel

• Deseable conocimiento en Power Bi

• Perfil analítico, organizado y con alta atención al detalle

• Buenas habilidades de comunicación y trabajo colaborativo.

• Orientación a resultados y seguimiento de KPIs.

• Atención al detalle y foco en la calidad de ejecución.

• Buena organización y capacidad para gestionar múltiples tareas.

• Adaptabilidad y rapidez de aprendizaje.

• Orientación al cliente y al negocio.

Note to candidates

postings.title: INGENIERO RECURSOS HIDRICOS
postings.descriptionText:
Sumá tu energía a la compañía que contribuye al desarrollo de nuestro país.

En YPF buscamos personas que quieran ser parte de un gran equipo que transforma desafíos en oportunidades y que actúa con excelencia para generar valor. Con más de cien años de historia, somos la compañía energética líder de la Argentina, impulsando el desarrollo y la innovación tecnológica del país.

¡Sumarte a YPF es unirte a un proyecto que combina experiencia, pasión y la energía necesaria para seguir construyendo nuestro futuro!



¿Qué buscamos?



Buscamos una persona proactiva, que cuente con iniciativa, autonomía, buenas relaciones personales y este orientado a resultados para desempeñarse como INGENIERO DE RECURSOS HIDRICOS dentro de la VP UPSTREAM.





¿Cuáles serán tus desafíos con nosotros?



Serás responsable de asegurar la generación de la documentación de soporte (estudios, clasificación, planos, informes) para obtener la aprobación de las obras de mitigación aluvial de las instalaciones, locaciones y ductos para los proyectos NOC – Vaca Muerta, tanto para desarrollo como para exploración.



¿Cuáles serán sus principales tareas?





• Participar como parte integrante del equipo de proyectos desde el inicio de la definición de las obras con el fin de minimizar las obras de riesgo aluvial asesorando sobre la ubicación más conveniente.


• Coordinar el proceso de clasificación hídrica de obras y elaboración de estudios de riesgo hídrico a ser presentados ante las autoridades Hídricas y sus actualizaciones en el ámbito de la provincia del Neuquén, asegurando que se cumplan los hitos y plazos de entrega de los diferentes interlocutores.


• Gestionar y revisar los estudios de riesgo hídrico asociados a su ámbito de aplicación, conforme a las normas internas y/o requerimientos de autoridades de aplicación.


• Velar por la incorporación de los requisitos normativos ambientales internos y externos vigentes en las operaciones a desarrollar en la provincia de NQN, en los Estudios de Riesgo Hídrico.


• Proponer medidas de monitoreo y control acorde a las mejores prácticas de la industria.


• Validar la consistencia técnica de los documentos previo al envío a las autoridades de aplicación.


• Identificar de manera precisa las prioridades en conjunto con los sectores clientes.


• Colaborar con el seguimiento y publicación del tablero de permisología.


• Colaborar con el seguimiento y actualización del cronograma del proceso de permisología. Levantar alertas que correspondan.


• Gestionar los contratos de consultoría requeridos para dar cumplimiento al proceso.


• Dar respuesta a todas las comunicaciones con las autoridades de aplicación relacionadas a los estudios de riesgo hídrico hasta obtener el permiso correspondiente.







¿Qué Valoramos?





• Formación académica: Graduados de Ingeniería Civil, Ingeniería en Recursos Hídricos, Ingeniería hidráulico o Geología.


• Experiencia profesional: experiencia en estudios de riesgo hídricos.


• Conocimientos Específicos: Modelación en sistema computacional HEC-RAS y HEC-HMS, Sistemas de Información geográfica (ARC GIS, QGIS), AUTOCAD.





Información del puesto



Reporte directo: MARINA ARANA, JEFE RECURSOS HIDRICOS

Lugar de trabajo: OFICINAS NEUQUEN CAPITAL

Diagrama: lunes a viernes (4 dias presencial, 1 remoto)

Encuadre gremial: Fuera de convenio

Disponibilidad para viajar: si, eventualmente





Si sos una persona que:



• Trabaja con excelencia y profesionalismo.


• Da lo mejor cada día, valora la meritocracia y busca siempre la milla extra.


• Vive los desafíos como oportunidades para innovar y aprender.


• Disfruta del trabajo en equipo y del intercambio de distintos puntos de vista.


• Encara los proyectos con pasión y compromiso.


• Promueve un buen clima de trabajo, con empatía, escucha activa y respeto.




¡Este puesto es para vos!



¿Qué ofrecemos?

Un entorno donde podés aportar lo más valioso que tenés: tu energía. Esa energía que impulsa, que se adapta, que aprende, que suma, que transforma.

Sumarte a la #ExperienciaYPF es:

🤩 Impulsar tu desarrollo al siguiente nivel con nuevas oportunidades de aprendizaje.

💡 Crear soluciones innovadoras que impactan en el país.

🤝 Formar parte de una empresa comprometida con la equidad y la inclusión.

🧘‍♀️ Disfrutar del acompañamiento integral del Programa Be #BeneficiosYExperiencias.




Programa Be (Beneficios y Experiencias)



• Descuentos exclusivos en combustibles, gimnasios y muchos otros productos y servicios.


• Iniciativas para estar cerca en los momentos familiares claves: ayuda escolar, licencias parentales extendidas y regalo de nacimiento.


• Cobertura médica para vos y tu familia.


• Descuentos especiales en universidades orientados a impulsar estudios de especialización y posgrado.


• Servicios de refrigerio, frutas, snacks y comedor (según locación).


• Día libre de cumpleaños


• Esquema de vacaciones adicionales





¡Te esperamos para seguir generando valor y construyendo juntos el futuro energético de nuestro país!
