Make banking a Fifth Third better®
We connect great people to great opportunities. Are you ready to take the next step? Discover a career in banking at Fifth Third Bank .

GENERAL FUNCTION:
Individual is responsible for managing the development, execution and leadership of the Credit Risk Review (CRR) Continuous Review program for assigned CRR team and/or line of business units. Primary components of the CRR Continuous Review program include (i) the critical and independent evaluation of the accuracy and effectiveness of credit risk management processes across the Bancorp through an assessment of risk identification/rating, underwriting, new origination, borrower selection and portfolio management practices; compliance with Bancorp loan policies, procedures and applicable laws and regulations; problem asset administration and loan impairments/charge-offs; (ii) a review of credit quality and related trends on a portfolio, industry sector and/or product basis; and (iii) the identification of emerging risks. Attend (as required) regular meetings with executive management, senior leaders, regulators, external auditors and first and second line business personnel.
Responsible and accountable for risk by openly exchanging ideas and opinions, elevating concerns and personally following policies and procedures as defined. Accountable for always doing the right thing for customers and colleagues, and ensures that actions and behaviors drive a positive customer experience. While operating within the Bank's risk appetite, achieves results by consistently identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring, and reporting risks of all types.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Display an advanced background, understanding and technical proficiency in all pertinent lending and credit risk topics, including risk appetite and framework, Bank policies and procedures, and risk monitoring and mitigation practices for assigned areas of responsibility.

• Maintain awareness of general economic conditions, industry trends and product specific issues. Display an advanced working knowledge of pertinent regulatory issues and sound lending practices and their relative impact on credit risk. Assist CRR management team in ensuring CRR meets regulatory heightened standards expectations.

• Demonstrate the ability to analyze and assess credit risk in highly complex Commercial borrowers and portfolios and adequately support all conclusions.

• In conjunction with CRR leadership team, establish key annual goals and risk-based business plans for assigned areas of responsibility and update as necessary throughout the year. Identify, elevate and promptly address variances to plan. Assist in ensuring CRR procedures remain current and correctly reflect actual/desired practices.

• Complete or ensure the completion of all aspects of required continuous review activities for assigned Commercial portfolios with minimal supervision and in accordance with CRR procedures, deadlines and performance/financial plan objectives. Manage, lead and/or participate in horizontal, targeted and other portfolio review activities.

• Present CRR activities and results (as required) at regular meetings with executive management, senior leaders, regulators, external auditors and first and second line business personnel. Complete or assist in the preparation and dissemination of all related and required quarterly/ annual summaries of results in an accurate and timely manner, including an annual assessment of credit risk and the overall quality of assigned portfolios.

• Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of key line of business strategies, risk considerations, portfolio quality trends and open issues and observations for assigned portfolios, while maintaining current and forward-looking views on aggregate portfolio risk levels. Attend applicable Committee, portfolio review, problem asset review and business controls meetings, and hold routine informational meetings with first and second line senior business leaders and personnel to gain and share perspectives on these matters.

• Effectively challenge and provide consultative advice to first and second line senior business leaders and personnel on risk ratings, credit risk management practices, emerging risks, borrower/portfolio credit quality trends, strategies, policies, organization design and/or staffing levels and expertise.

• Work in a balanced and consultative manner with the first and second lines of defense to develop positive working relationships and to provide feedback on the results of continuous review activities. Ensure the timely socialization and publication of concise and well-written reports that summarize review results, meet the information needs of report recipients, and include issues, observations and recommendations for improvement (as appropriate).

• Manage a system of accountability for open CRR issues, observations and recommendations under assigned areas of responsibility. Solicit appropriate action plans and responses from responsible management that address root causes, resolve CRR’s concerns and mitigate the overall risk to the Bancorp. Assist CRR management team in promptly resolving any matters requiring attention (MRAs) or issues assigned to CRR with sustainable improvements to business practices.

• For Commercial roles, manage and execute work processes that review the accuracy of assigned risk ratings (i.e. regulatory, probability of default and loss given default ratings) and accrual status utilizing knowledge of Bancorp policies, risk rating models and definitions. Effectively convey rating changes to first and second line business leaders and personnel with minimal assistance from manager and promptly escalate any unresolved disagreements to their manager and/or CRR Director.

• Complete quality assurance review activities (i.e. active engagement in effective challenge meetings, secondary reviews of work papers and supporting review process documents, proficiency in providing peer-to-peer feedback, etc.) and assist in sustaining a strong CRR quality assurance program to ensure the consistency and accuracy of CRR work products and review results. Use quality assurance results constructively for employee and personal development and to make recommendations for program enhancements.

• Assist in driving a continuous improvement approach to process management within CRR, including making appropriate recommendations for change, in order to gain efficiencies and ensure the effectiveness, consistency and relevance of CRR processes. Benchmark best practices with peer institutions and incorporate into CRR procedures as appropriate.

• Share review findings and emerging risks with Internal Audit and other Risk functions and coordinate work efforts to ensure appropriate coverage and independent oversight of credit risk management processes across the Bancorp.

• Assume leadership roles and/or participate in due-diligence reviews of potential Bank acquisitions and other special projects as requested.

• Recruit qualified candidates to fill open positions and maintain a pipeline of qualified potential talent to ensure appropriate staffing levels, expertise and bench strength are maintained. For employee manager roles, maintain a succession plan for all critical CRR positions under your supervision.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES (AS APPLICABLE):
Individual is responsible for developing and managing direct reports to ensure optimal performance to achieve CRR’s goals and performance objectives. Ensure employees have performance and developmental goals in place and are (i) provided with timely, candid and constructive performance feedback; (ii) developed to their fullest potential and provided with training opportunities and challenging job assignments that enhance their career growth; and (iii) recognized and rewarded for their accomplishments.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES REQUIRED:

• Bachelor's degree in a business related field. Graduate degree in relevant field (Business, Finance or Economics) preferred.

• Minimum of 12 years lending and/or credit related experience, with a minimum of 7 years managing or leading employees in project management assignments. Credit Risk Review or similar loan review or regulatory agency managerial experience preferred.

• Possess sound leadership and excellent interpersonal, analytical and verbal/written communications skills.

• Ability to display a positive business presence and exercise sound judgment when interfacing with executive management, senior leaders, regulators, external auditors, first and second line business personnel and peers.

• Strong project management and presentation skills and ability to quickly synthesize data to reach accurate conclusions.

• Advanced ability to understand and interpret data from various applications and database tools, draw high-level conclusions and determine actions needed.

• Demonstrate strong influencing and negotiation skills that are leveraged to reach effective outcomes.

postings.title: Director of Ecommerce
postings.descriptionText:
Hadley Designs is a family-founded brand committed to making early learning engaging, screen-free, and fun. Our journey began with hand-drawn educational tools and has grown into a beloved brand, trusted by millions of parents, grandparents, and teachers. We design developmentally sound products for children ages 3 to 8, such as educational posters, busy books, and emotional learning kits. Our mission is to create tools that help children thrive through connection, curiosity, and real learning.
Our vision is bold. We want to become the most trusted children's brand in the world, present in millions of homes and passed down for generations, and we are building toward $100M in revenue by 2030.

Role Overview
We are hiring a Director of Ecommerce to own our Shopify business as its general manager. You will own the Shopify P&L and the growth engine that feeds it, from paid acquisition and creative testing to offers, funnels, and lifecycle marketing, and you will build the team and systems that let the channel scale without the founder in the day to day.
Shopify is our dominant D2C channel, and it does not stand alone. Our Amazon team owns Amazon, and TikTok Shop is an important part of our ecosystem. You will see the whole customer life cycle across Shopify, Amazon, and TikTok Shop, including the halo our launches create on Amazon and how acquisition converts there, and you will connect the dots so a launch lifts all three.
Your target is to scale our direct-to-consumer business to $20M+ in profitable revenue, with a net margin of at least 15% on Shopify.
You will work closely with our CEO, partner with our Amazon team so every launch lifts both channels, and lead our ecommerce team.

What You'll Own

• The P&L. Own Shopify revenue and profitability, with a net profit margin of at least 15%.

• Customer acquisition. Run Meta and other paid media to unit economics, with a Meta ROAS of at least 2.5, and keep a high-velocity creative testing rhythm fed by our AI content engine, creator video, UGC, and in-house production.

• Offers, funnels, and CRO. Launch new funnels that meet our KPI thresholds every month, build bundles and ascension paths, and keep homepage, collection, and product pages aligned with what converts.

• Lifecycle and LTV. Drive email and SMS to at least 25% of Shopify revenue through Klaviyo and Postscript, and keep the 30-day GPLTV to CAC ratio above 3.

• Channel connection. Partner with our Amazon team so every launch lifts Amazon too, understand TikTok Shop's place as a social-commerce channel, and keep each channel's role in the customer journey deliberate.

• Team leadership. Lead our ecommerce operators with clear ownership, weekly operating rhythms, and scorecards, and bring in freelancers and contractors as output grows.

• Reporting. Deliver a weekly scorecard and P&L review, and a monthly plan and forecast for the CEO.

• Systems and compliance. Document a playbook for every working funnel, keep the store and ads compliant, and turn repeat work into AI-assisted workflows.

• Brand. Protect and build what the brand stands for in every ad, page, and customer touchpoint.

How Success Is Measured

• Profitable growth in Shopify revenue against the plan

• Net profit margin of at least 15% on Shopify

• Meta ROAS of at least 2.5

• Email and SMS at 25% or more of Shopify revenue

• 30-day GPLTV to CAC above 3

• A team and operating rhythm that run without daily founder involvement

Requirements

Who You Are
You are a high ownership leader who thinks like a general manager, not just a marketer. You are energized by building systems, leading people, and owning outcomes.

• You have 5 to 10+ years of experience scaling DTC ecommerce brands on Shopify with paid social.

• You have a proven track record growing brands beyond $20M in revenue.

• You have owned a P&L and hit revenue and profit targets.

• You understand the full D2C life cycle across Shopify, Amazon, and TikTok Shop, including the Amazon halo, and you have run or worked alongside social commerce, not Shopify alone.

• You have built and led a team, and the people who worked for you will say so.

• You are deeply fluent in Meta ads and high-velocity creative testing, including AI-assisted creative pipelines.

• You are hands-on with Shopify, Klaviyo, and Postscript.

• You understand bundles, upsells, and LTV, and you can write and review a landing page that converts.

• You are comfortable leading a remote team with weekly cadences.

• You use AI every day to get more done with less. That is a capability, not a particular tool, and it is a must-have here. You also work inside a CRM and documented SOPs, and you want to build how we use all three now and going forward.

Benefits

Why You'll Love Working Here
You will have real ownership. Real trust. And real impact. Hadley Designs is a remote first company built on autonomy, creativity, and accountability. You will work closely with our CEO and a leadership team that moves fast and expects results.

• Remote-first work environment

• Paid time off and holidays

• Access to learning resources and professional development

• Free Hadley Designs products

• Regular interaction with leadership, including the CEO

• Stability from more than a decade as a family-founded, mission-driven brand

Our Hiring Process
Every candidate completes a Culture Index assessment and a case study before interviews. For this role, reference checks are done by phone.

Apply Today
If you are ready to own the growth of a brand families love, we would love to hear from you. Apply now to join Hadley Designs as our Director of Ecommerce.
P.S. If you don't hear from us within four weeks of your application, please consider that as our decision to move forward with other candidates, but we truly appreciate your interest in Hadley Designs .

About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research.
We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, With Heart®.

About the Role
We are seeking a Solutions Consultant – Logistics to join our team in a remote capacity in Latin America. As a Solutions Consultant – Logistics, you will be a recognized professional in clinical supplies, ancillary supplies and/or laboratory logistics, with experience supporting the design, operational conduct, and successful delivery of global clinical trial logistics solutions. You will join a highly collaborative, growth-oriented environment where strategic insight, commercial awareness, and solution design directly influence business opportunities. Working in partnership with operational, commercial, and other cross-functional teams, you will help develop creative, cost-effective, operationally achievable clinical logistics solutions that address client needs and differentiate Parexel . Your work will span the pre-sales and post-sales lifecycle, from understanding client requirements and developing competitive solutions through supporting effective transition to operational teams and identifying opportunities to strengthen or expand solutions for existing clients. This role offers the opportunity to deepen your clinical trial logistics expertise, strengthen client partnerships, and contribute to industry-leading solutions across Parexel .

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Logistics Solution Development

• Develop creative, cost-effective, high-quality competitive strategies and business solutions that differentiate Parexel as a premier provider of clinical supplies, ancillary supplies and laboratory logistics solutions.

• Craft creative solutions for sales campaigns and strategic clinical logistics opportunities.

• Engage with experts across Parexel to develop short- and longer-term solutions that address client requirements and maximize value.

• Consider operational and financial risks, implementation requirements, scope assumptions, milestones, and budget considerations when developing solutions.

• Develop solutions that are operationally achievable while supporting quality, efficiency, financial objectives, and customer expectations.

• Apply appropriate risk assessments and assumptions to support clear scope definition and effective management of potential scope changes.

• Maintain strong knowledge of Parexel clinical trial supply and logistics offerings and understand how those services connect with broader Parexel capabilities.

• Apply knowledge of industry trends, competition, innovations, and relevant regulatory developments to strengthen solutions and identify business opportunities.

Sales and Proposal Support

• Support Strategic Business Unit sales targets and participate in discovery sessions to understand client business objectives, clinical trial logistics requirements, and solution needs.

• Create customer-focused, professionally presented proposal content that clearly differentiates Parexel from competitors and supports business growth across Strategic Business Units.

• Ensure proposals and client responses reflect strategy discussions, address client requirements, communicate a clear value proposition and critical success factors, and are based on appropriate assumptions.

• Support the development of solutions with accurate and achievable scope, milestones, budget considerations, and operational assumptions.

• Define bid pursuit content and review and integrate relevant clinical logistics considerations into request-for-proposal strategies.

• Participate in capabilities meetings, proposal development, bid pursuit and bid defense meetings, and client Q&A sessions as needed.

• Drive a consultative approach that enables Parexel to develop differentiated business solutions and clearly communicate their value to clients.

• Support clients through the pre-award process and provide subject matter expertise to help address complex clinical logistics needs.

Post-Award Solution Support

• Support the effective handover of awarded solutions to operational teams, helping ensure alignment between the proposed solution and operational delivery.

• Maintain appropriate knowledge of awarded projects and collaborate with operational teams to help ensure solutions continue to support agreed quality, efficiency, financial, and customer objectives.

• Work collaboratively with broader Parexel teams to help address post-award client issues and provide coordinated clinical logistics solutions.

• Contribute clinical logistics expertise when changes or challenges require adjustments to the solution approach.

• Support opportunities for scope expansion and additional business with existing clients by identifying evolving clinical logistics needs and potential solutions.

• Apply lessons learned and client feedback from solution implementation to strengthen future offerings and opportunities.

Client and Solution Communication

• Advise sponsors and internal teams, applying clinical trial logistics subject matter expertise to develop competitive solution models.

• Communicate credibly with audiences ranging from operational and project teams to senior client stakeholders.

• Translate complex clinical logistics concepts into clear, understandable, and compelling recommendations.

• Ensure client communications provide consistent messaging and clearly articulate Parexel 's value proposition.

• Bring an outside-in and One Parexel perspective by channeling client feedback and market requirements into Product Management and the broader solution development process.

• Support internal and external consultations and the preparation of clinical logistics content for relevant industry forums and professional organizations.

• A strong understanding of the commercial ecosystem and industry trends within your area of expertise.

• Awareness of relevant global regulatory developments affecting clinical trial logistics.

• The ability to balance strategic thinking with pragmatic, operationally achievable approaches to delivery.

• Strong commercial and operational judgment, including the ability to consider scope, budget, timelines, assumptions, and operational and financial risk in solution development.

• Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively at different business levels.

• The ability to build strong client and cross-functional relationships and understand client needs.

• Independent thinking and a flexible approach to assignments and the development of new capabilities.

• The ability to manage multiple and varied tasks, prioritize workload, and maintain strong attention to detail.

• The ability to communicate complex ideas in a simple, understandable, and compelling manner.

• Strong analytical, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.

• Willingness to travel up to 30%.

Required Qualifications

• Multiple years of experience in the life sciences industry.

• Clinical trial logistics expertise, with experience in clinical supplies, ancillary supplies and/or laboratory logistics.

• Experience in strategic drug development planning or significant involvement in planning clinical, technical, operational, or logistics strategies.

• Experience designing, operationalizing, and successfully delivering solutions globally.

• Experience collaborating across operational and commercial teams to develop client-focused solutions.

• Strong commercial awareness and the ability to develop operational and technical strategies, risk assessments, scenario plans, and business solutions.

• Excellent communication, relationship-building, analytical, prioritization, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Advanced degree.

Job Summary:
The Agency Compliance Manager provides operational leadership for the agency’s enterprise compliance program, including governance, policy management, investigations, monitoring, corrective action, training, reporting, audit coordination, and technology-enabled compliance processes. This position supervises assigned staff and serves as a key advisor to the Chief Compliance Officer by identifying emerging compliance risks, recommending program enhancements, and advancing a culture of integrity, accountability, and ethical decision-making across the agency.

Major duties and responsibilities include but are not limited to:
• Enterprise compliance program leadership, work planning, and staff management. Maintain the Compliance Program Plan and annual compliance work plan; translate CCO and Compliance Committee direction into priorities, deliverables, assignments, and measurable outcomes; and maintain an enterprise-level view of significant compliance obligations, emerging compliance risks, program gaps, and priorities. Oversee workloads and quality; supervise, coach, and evaluate assigned staff; ensure appropriate delegation; identify resource and capacity needs; and elevate material risks, trade-offs, or barriers to the CCO.
• Policies, procedures, standards, and compliance controls. Direct the development, review cycle, maintenance, publication, and operationalization of the Code of Conduct, compliance policies, procedures, standard work, and related controls. Coordinate regulatory research and interpretation with OGC, program leadership, and subject-matter experts; oversee policy life cycle controls, documentation, approvals, acknowledgments, exceptions, and implementation follow-up; and verify that written requirements remain aligned with actual operational practices.
• Effective reporting channels, compliance concerns, investigations, escalation, and corrective action. Oversee accessible and confidential reporting channels and the end-to-end compliance concern life cycle, including intake, logging, triage, assignment, review or investigation, documentation, disposition recommendations, corrective or preventive actions, follow-up, and closure. Establish and administer consistent escalation, decision-routing, and status-reporting protocols; provide timely, appropriate updates to the CCO and other authorized leaders or governance bodies; maintain complete, defensible case records; coordinate appropriate referrals; and promptly elevate high-risk, sensitive, legally significant, executive-level, or reputational matters to the CCO.
• Risk-based compliance monitoring, enterprise compliance risk, and audit coordination. Partner with business owners to identify, assess, and prioritize enterprise compliance risks; support the development of appropriate mitigation strategies; and monitor mitigation progress and effectiveness. Coordinate periodic compliance risk assessment inputs; develop and oversee risk-based monitoring and review activities; evaluate controls and remediation effectiveness; identify trends and systemic weaknesses; and elevate material compliance risks, ineffective mitigation, or unresolved ownership to the CCO for appropriate escalation. Support external audits and regulatory reviews as assigned; coordinate Compliance Office responses and evidence; maintain visibility into findings and recommendations; and track corrective actions through validated closure. The position coordinates compliance monitoring and audit follow-up but does not replace independent assurance functions or operational ownership of remediation.
• Compliance training, education, communication, and culture. Direct the annual compliance training and education plan; identify training and awareness gaps based on compliance risks, concerns, audits, monitoring, corrective action, and regulatory changes; and ensure training is appropriately targeted to identified risks and audiences. Oversee general, targets, role-based, on-boarding, and remedial training; coordinate agency communications and awareness initiatives; evaluate training completion and effectiveness; and support Compliance Committee and divisional compliance liaison engagement.
• Metrics, reporting, program evaluation, and GRC enablement. Establish program measures and service expectations; monitor trends, aging, timeliness, closure, training, policy, monitoring, and corrective-action data; prepare reports for the CCO, Compliance Committee, and executive leadership; conduct or coordinate periodic program-effectiveness assessments; recommend improvement actions; and serve as Compliance Office business owner for relevant ServiceNow/GRC workflows, requirements, data quality, dashboards, access controls, and adoption.

Knowledge of:
• Effective compliance program principles, including HHS OIG guidance and the operation of the seven elements of an effective compliance program
• Compliance concern intake, triage, fact-finding, investigation, evidence management, root-cause analysis, referrals, corrective action, and closure validation
• Risk-based compliance assessment, monitoring, auditing, control evaluation, external-audit coordination, and findings-management practices
• Enterprise compliance governance, compliance committees, federated compliance models, escalation protocols, and defensible decision documentation
• Medicaid, healthcare, managed-care, fee-for-service, federal award, public-sector, privacy, confidentiality, ethics, conflicts-of-interest, and program-integrity compliance concepts
• Federal and Arizona regulatory structures and methods for researching, interpreting, documenting, and operationalizing regulatory requirements
• Policy, procedure, standard-work, control, exception, acknowledgment, and records-management lifecycles
• Adult-learning principles, role-based training, communication planning, and training-effectiveness evaluation
• Compliance metrics, trend analysis, program-effectiveness assessment, dashboards, data integrity, and continuous improvement
• GRC concepts and ServiceNow-enabled policy, compliance, issue, investigation, audit, corrective-action, and reporting workflows

Skilled in:
• Leading professional compliance, policy, investigation, monitoring, and audit personnel through clear assignments, quality expectations, coaching, and accountability

• Converting enterprise strategy and regulatory obligations into practical work plans, procedures, controls, training, monitoring, and measurable deliverables
• Managing sensitive concerns objectively, consistently, promptly, and with appropriate confidentiality
• Preparing concise executive briefings, findings, recommendations, dashboards, and decision memos

Ability to:

matters requiring CCO, executive, cross-divisional, or regulator involvement

Qualifications:

postings.descriptionText:
About Intento

Founded in 2016, Intento has grown alongside the AI and language technology industry itself — from early machine translation, through the rise of LLMs, to the AI agents we build today. Throughout that shift, the problem we're solving hasn't changed: helping global enterprises communicate authentically in the native language of every customer and employee. What's changed is our ability to solve it well. Today, Intento is AI Agents for Enterprise Translation: we automate translation for global enterprises across every touchpoint — websites, apps, help centers, support, and internal tools — in 650+ languages, with AI agents that meet the requirements of each company: terminology, tone, and compliance. Not just fluency.
We've built this fully remotely, with a diverse team spread across the world, held together by a culture of teamwork, ownership, and trust. And because the technology we work with keeps moving, so do we — we don't hold onto an approach just because it used to work. When something changes in the landscape, or in what our customers need, we adjust fast and keep building.

Why Intento ?
At Intento , we're solving a problem that looks simple from the outside and isn't: getting AI to translate not just fluently, but to the requirements of each company — terminology, tone of voice, compliance — and to verify and repair the output automatically when it falls short. It's a harder, more interesting engineering and product problem than most AI applications get to work on, and it's why 60+ global enterprises, including Indeed, Hexagon, Strava, and Agilent, trust Intento with it.
We're a multicultural team working remotely from different parts of the world, with a culture built around flexibility, transparency, and ownership. We offer competitive compensation and an environment where people are trusted to do their best work.

• Join a fast-paced environment where you can directly shape the course of the company.

• Get real transparency into business strategy and decisions — you'll understand the big picture and your impact on it.

• Enjoy a balance of autonomy and responsibility: make decisions and own outcomes.

• Work on a genuinely hard problem — translation that meets enterprise requirements automatically, beyond fluency — alongside people who've thought deeply about it.

• Get hands-on experience deploying AI agents into production for global enterprises.

• Work alongside a talented team — Software engineers, Language engineers, operations, and beyond — who care about doing the job well and supporting each other.

About the role:
We’re looking for a Technical Support Expert to join our 2nd-line support team. This is the team the rest of Support, our Technical Account Managers and Customer Success Managers turn to when an issue needs an investigation.
You’ll take escalations from our 1st-line team and reproduce and root-cause problems across our API, our platform, and the integrations our enterprise customers rely on. Then you’ll either resolve the problem yourself or hand it to Development with everything they need to act on it.
Most of your communication will be with internal teams: 1st-line support, TAMs, CSMs, Product and R&D but occasionally the role may require you to also join technical calls with customers and own the troubleshooting part of the conversation.
We’re looking for someone who has already done this work at a B2B SaaS company, supporting that company’s external, paying customers.

Responsibilities:

• Investigate, reproduce and resolve issues escalated from 1st-line support, using our platform, test environments and API tooling.

• Trouble-shoot non-trivial integration issues across TMS systems, such as Trados, memoQ, XTM and Phrase and third-party MT/LLM providers. This includes going directly to those vendors’ teams when the root cause is on their side.

• Escalate to R&D after you’ve done your own investigation, with clear reproduction steps, logs, scope and impact. Keep driving the issue until it’s resolved.

• Keep 1st-line and customer-facing teams updated with full context.

• Join technical calls with customers when needed and own the troubleshooting.

• During incidents, notify stakeholders and help keep customers informed

• Document new scenarios, workarounds and fixes in our internal and external Knowledge Base.

• Spot inefficient workflows and gaps in alerting or tooling, and fix them, including scripts and automations that can be reused by the rest of the team

• From time to time, cover the front-line queue.

• Be available on-call for high-severity issues outside standard hours

If this sounds like a good fit for you, we'd love to hear from you!

Requirements

3+ years in Tier-2 / 2nd-line technical support or support engineering at a B2B SaaS company, supporting that company’s external, paying customers.

• A track record of personally investigating and resolving escalated technical issues: bug reproduction, log analysis, root-cause analysis.

Fluent written and spoken English.

Preferred :

SQL and HTML.

postings.title: Full-Time Telehealth Dietitian (Salary + Benefits)
postings.descriptionText:
Simplex Health is seeking a Registered Dietitian (RD/RDN) to provide telehealth outpatient medical nutrition therapy using an integrative and functional nutrition approach. This is a fully remote, full-time role offering a consistent schedule and the opportunity to build deep, ongoing relationships with patients.

Unlike many outpatient roles, this position offers a full-time, salaried structure with benefits, providing stability and consistency in your schedule and income—while giving you the flexibility to choose a schedule that fits your lifestyle.

The ideal candidate has experience in clinical or outpatient nutrition counseling, is licensed (or eligible for licensure) in Pennsylvania, and is passionate about delivering personalized, root-cause care to support long-term health outcomes.

Our Mission: Radically improve the health of Humankind—one person, one appointment, one connection at a time.

At Simplex Health , we do things differently. Our insurance-funded medical nutrition therapy goes beyond symptom management to improve — and in many cases reverse — chronic conditions. We partner with hospitals, healthcare practices, and individuals to provide personalized, root-cause nutrition care across a wide range of conditions, including metabolic health, digestive disorders, hormonal imbalances, and chronic disease.

Our approach is grounded in prevention, root-cause resolution, and sustainable lifestyle change, supporting patients throughout their health journey. Through a fully virtual, telehealth model, we meet patients where they are, delivering accessible, high-quality care.

Our evidence-based, progressive nutrition interventions are tailored to each patient’s unique biochemistry. Through nutrition counseling, education, and health coaching, we empower patients to improve their health, build lasting habits, and achieve meaningful, long-term outcomes.

Role details:

• Location: Telehealth

• 32 hours/week (4-day work week): $44,000–$59,000 annually

• 40 hours/week (5-day work week): $55,000–$70,000 annually

If you’ve ever run (or dreamed of running) your own private practice, you know what it takes — the marketing, the scheduling, the billing, the insurance headaches, the empty calendar days, the tech issues, the isolation…

At Simplex Health , you get the best parts of private practice — the autonomy, the flexibility, the deep 1:1 relationships with patients — without the burnout or business stress.

Here, you get to focus on what you do best: helping patients transform their health through integrative and functional nutrition.

What we are looking for:

Preferred:

• CDCES (Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist) strongly preferred

• IFNA Certified (IFNCP credential a plus); candidates actively enrolled in IFNA training welcome

PA license and completion of major insurance credentialing required before start; this process may take 3–6 months.

Role Responsibilities (including but not limited to):

• Provide telehealth medical nutrition therapy using a functional and integrative approach

• Implement Simplex Health protocols, tools, and educational materials in patient care

• Assess the nutritional health of patients/clients and develop personalized, root-cause care plans

• Create and modify individualized nutrition interventions based on patient needs and goals

• Document all new and follow-up appointments in the Healthie platform with strong attention to detail

• Respond to patient communications in a timely, professional, and supportive manner

• Collaborate with team members through case discussions, meetings, and shared learning opportunities

• Communicate openly and effectively to resolve work-related issues and support team outcomes

• Contribute to a positive, collaborative team environment and ongoing clinical initiatives

• Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and clinical standards

• Stay current with emerging research and best practices in nutrition and health

• Manage a full and consistent patient caseload, ensuring timely follow-ups, continuity of care, and optimal patient outcomes

What to expect:

• Regular case reviews and clinical collaboration

• Real-time support via team chat and peer connection

• Team meetings and shared learning opportunities

• Opportunities to contribute to committees, resources, and clinical initiatives

Servant Leadership: Nobody is above any task, and we are all here to serve others. Every customer—internal or external—needs help, and the most powerful way to lead will be to serve.

If you’ve ever wished you could combine the freedom of private practice with the camaraderie and stability of a larger organization, this is where you belong.

Apply today and rediscover the joy of patient care without the grind of running a business.

Simplex Health Core Values:

Simplex Health strives to embody the following values and to apply them to every aspect of how we run our business, including how we interact with each other as teammates and leaders. These values also apply to how we interact with and continue to inspire our clients and strategic partners:

postings.title: Middle Years Program Lead (Trailblazers)
postings.descriptionText:
👋 About Boundless Life

Boundless Life helps families live, work and learn together while exploring the world. We provide family-friendly homes, an education program that travels with the family, and a community of like-minded families in every destination.
Since our founding in 2021, we've grown to eight locations across Europe, Asia and Latin America, with a team of more than 200 people, and expanded our curriculum to cover children from the age of 18 months to 14 years.
Our Education Centres sit at the heart of it all, combining project-based and place-based learning for families who want more than a traditional school can offer.

🙌 The role
Education at Boundless Life places equal emphasis on academic and social-emotional skills, developing students who know themselves and their passions, can relate to others with empathy and compassion, and are true global citizens ready to make a difference in the world.
Trailblazers is our rapidly expanding Middle Years program, soon to be taught in six destinations globally. The program combines engaging project-based learning (Quests) rooted in the local environment with core academics delivered online, all underpinned by our global framework of standards and competencies.
This unique combination allows students to follow their passions, solve real-world problems, and fully experience the place they're living in, while opening up a new world of flexibility for families wishing to live a more global life.
As Middle Years Program Lead (Trailblazers), you'll be responsible for end-to-end program design, creating both the content and the global systems needed to ensure excellent delivery at scale for our unique community of learners.
Working closely with our Education Centre Directors (ECDs), educators, and other Program Leads, you'll be responsible not only for how students progress academically but also for how they grow as people.

Location & Travel

• Location: Ideally based in one of our Boundless Life destinations in Europe. Remote candidates will also be considered, provided they can regularly work during European hours.

• Travel: This role requires significant and regular travel across Boundless Life destinations to support program implementation, collaborate with local teams, and ensure consistent quality across locations.

Primary Responsibilities

Curriculum & Program Design

• Own end-to-end design and implementation of the Trailblazers curriculum and all associated resources, built from the Boundless 8 competencies outwards.

• Design unique and engaging project-based and place-based learning experiences that use each destination as a classroom.

• Ensure the curriculum works as a coherent whole with the rest of the Boundless Continuum, while integrating the unique developmental needs and challenges of the age group.

• Engage and manage freelance curriculum designers as needed to ensure all program goals are met.

Assessment & Learner Progress

• Design the assessment approach for Trailblazers, covering both academic progress and social-emotional growth.

• Capture and use learner data and feedback to identify gaps and continuously improve the design and implementation of the program.

• Ensure systems are in place to enable consistent communication of student progress to relevant stakeholders across all locations.

Quality & Consistency at Scale

• Set a clear, shared standard of what excellent Trailblazers delivery looks like.

• Ensure policies and practices align with accreditation (WASC) requirements and any country-specific legal or regulatory constraints.

• Design and deliver professional development that equips educators across all destinations to deliver Trailblazers effectively.

• Collaborate with ECDs and build professional development systems that scale across multiple sites and new launches, ensuring quality does not depend on your direct presence.

Online Academics & Educational Technology

• Select, evaluate, and manage the online education providers delivering Trailblazers' core subjects.

• Lead the rollout of new educational technology in classrooms across multiple sites.

• Collaborate with educational technology developers and internal product teams, providing meaningful input into the design of future in-house learning tools.

Implementation Across Destinations

• Support ECDs and the Head of Education Excellence in implementing Trailblazers effectively across all aspects of the classroom experience: academic, social-emotional, and behavioural.

• Support Trailblazers launches in new locations, ensuring consistent experiences for students and families regardless of destination.

• Travel regularly to destinations to understand our student population, gather on-the-ground feedback, support educators, and strengthen program delivery.

• Act as the go-to Trailblazers expert for colleagues across Education, Real Estate, Interior Design, Admissions, Sales, and Marketing.

💥 What's in it for you

• Meaningful impact – Help shape an innovative Middle Years education program that supports children's academic and personal growth.

• Curriculum innovation – Lead the development of project-based and place-based learning experiences across global destinations.

• Global collaboration – Work alongside educators, education leaders, and cross-functional teams in an international environment.

• Professional growth – Play a key role in shaping and scaling a rapidly expanding program.

• Family benefits – Enjoy discounted tuition for your children at our Boundless Schools.

Take a look at our policies and benefits here.

🫶 About you

Qualifications & Experience

• Deep expertise in project-based learning, with several years of experience designing and delivering it successfully.

• Deep expertise in curriculum development, including the successful implementation of new curricula.

• Experience driving continuous improvement in teaching and learning at scale, across multiple sites or locations.

• Strong experience selecting online education providers and rolling out educational technology across multiple classrooms or sites.

• Ideally, experience contributing to the development of online learning tools, such as collaborating with educational technology developers or providing substantial input into product design.

• Strong understanding of Middle Years learners, both academically and developmentally.

• Experience designing and implementing High School programs is a significant advantage, as we look to expand into these age groups in the future.

• Willingness and ability to travel regularly across our global destinations.

How You Work

• Collaborative – You build programs with people, not for them, working closely with educators, ECDs, designers, and external partners.

• Cross-functional – You work comfortably across Education, Product, Operations, Admissions, and Marketing, ensuring alignment around the Trailblazers program.

• Whole-child focused – You care as much about student wellbeing and social-emotional growth as you do about academic achievement.

• Built for scale – You design systems, resources, and training that work across multiple destinations, not just one.

• Global start-up mindset – You thrive in a fast-moving environment where building systems and processes from scratch is part of the challenge.

Appointment will be subject to a satisfactory enhanced criminal records check or equivalent.

✨ What's next?

• First call with our Recruitment team (30 min).

• Interview with our Program Learning & Design team (60 min).

• Interview with the Hiring Manager (60 min).

• Final check-in with senior leadership, if required (60 min).

Our final steps include reference checks and a personality assessment. The assessment isn't used to evaluate your candidacy—it's a tool to help us work well together from day one.
The process might change slightly as we go along, and we'll keep you posted at all times.
Want to know more about working at Boundless Life ? Check out our story!

postings.title: Growth Marketing Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
About hireworks
hireworks connects top talent across Latin America with opportunities at leading U.S. companies. As your employer, hireworks supports your interview, onboarding, and ongoing employee experience, while connecting you with a community of local peers and mentors.

About our client
Our client develops science-led nutritional products that make its approach to health and longevity accessible to more people. This role supports marketing analytics spanning ecommerce and telehealth customer journeys. They're a small, fast-moving team that values analytical thinking, clear communication, and ownership.

About the Position
We're seeking a curious, meticulous Growth Marketing Analyst to support across paid media, organic/direct, partnerships, and other growth initiatives. You'll own daily reporting, ad hoc analysis, opportunity sizing, and the modeling behind quarterly plans.
You'll work with the Growth lead weekly to prioritize questions and review findings, while independently owning data pulls, QA, modeling, and follow-through. Channel owners handle campaign decisions, creative, and execution; our attribution and analytics lead owns attribution and engineering projects.

What You'll Do

Ad Hoc Requests & Historical Analysis

• Analyze channel performance from traffic and acquisition through conversion, revenue, retention, and customer value, including paid social, search, YouTube, creator/affiliate partnerships, and organic/direct.

• Reconstruct historical cohorts and baselines to explain performance changes across channels, products, audiences, creative, and offers. Account for launch and rollout dates, promotions, seasonality, overlapping changes, and conversion lag.

• Trace acquisition sources through actual purchases, cross-sell, retention, and customer value. Evaluate product-level contribution and payback to inform CAC guardrails with Finance.

• Handle team requests from question to validated recommendation: compare landing pages, identify historical creative winners, assess budget changes, and investigate performance. Agree priorities and turnaround times with the Growth lead and requesters; flag blockers early.

Quarterly Planning, Forecasting & Business Reviews

• Build quarterly planning models and monthly forecasts by business, channel, and product. Reconcile paid, non-paid, and blended views with Finance, refine assumptions with the Growth lead, and track results against targets.

• Model conservative, base, and upside scenarios for spend, acquisition, CAC, revenue, and contribution/payback. Separate testing budgets from ongoing activity, avoid double-counting improvements, and quantify investment tradeoffs.

• Explain week-over-week and month-over-month changes in volume, conversion, mix, and efficiency. Prepare business-review summaries and validated analysis for channel and creative readouts, highlighting drivers, uncertainty, and decisions needed.

Opportunity Sizing & Funnel Analysis

• Size opportunities across channels, products, offers, and new initiatives using traffic or audience potential, conversion, incremental customers, revenue, costs, and payback. Show assumptions, ranges, and sensitivities to support prioritization.

• Identify drop-offs from landing page through checkout or intake to purchase or paid prescription. Quantify improvement opportunities and escalate tracking gaps to the attribution and analytics lead.

Daily Reporting, Automation & Data Quality

• Own daily reporting in #growth-team-ops across both businesses: summarize performance and pacing, include channel owners' explanations and confirmed changes, and flag material issues to the owner for action. State reporting windows, data freshness, and conversion-lag limitations.

• Build dashboards and reusable reporting from existing data sources, using agreed definitions and mappings. Escalate attribution, pipeline, or instrumentation issues with clear evidence.

• Own the accuracy of every number and conclusion you present. Before sharing, validate source completeness, joins, duplicates, formulas, denominators, reporting windows, and attribution settings; reconcile totals and investigate anomalies. Document sources and assumptions, flag uncertainty, and promptly correct errors and their implications.

• Use AI, agents, scripts, and lightweight applications to automate recurring pulls and turn one-off analyses into maintained dashboards or workflows. Validate generated code, calculations, and conclusions, and preserve reliable refreshes and history.

What You'll Bring

• Hands-on growth marketing experience is required.

• Advanced SQL is non-negotiable: independently query complex and nested datasets, validate joins and aggregations, and troubleshoot results that do not reconcile.

• Proficiency in BI tools such as Sigma, Hex, Streamlit, Tableau, or Looker Studio, and strong Sheets or Excel skills for forecasting, scenario analysis, and opportunity sizing.

• Strong growth fundamentals: connect spend, traffic, conversion, channel mix, retention, and margin to CAC, customer value, and payback. Understand attribution limitations and diminishing returns across paid and non-paid channels.

• Sound forecasting judgment: distinguish targets from forecasts, account for seasonality, conversion lag, and changing efficiency at scale, challenge unsupported assumptions, and revise models as evidence changes.

• Meticulous self-QA, curiosity, and follow-through. You investigate unexpected results, adapt to new evidence, and manage competing requests without sacrificing accuracy.

• Excellent written and spoken English is required. You can lead analytical discussions, ask precise questions, and clearly explain findings, limitations, and recommendations to a U.S.-based team.

Nice to Have

• Python or R for analysis, automation, statistical modeling, or building lightweight analytical tools.

• Experience with DTC ecommerce or subscriptions and tools such as Shopify, Triple Whale, or PostHog.

• Experience with incrementality testing, lifetime value modeling, or analysis across multiple products and international markets.

• Experience analyzing telehealth or other multi-step funnels with an intake or consultation stage before purchase.

Benefits
hireworks is cultivating a growing community of top talent across LATAM. In addition to unlocking access to positions at top tier U.S. based companies, we offer a variety of benefits to enhance your experience:

• Competitive Pay - compensation that reflects your experience and accomplishments

• Remote Flexibility - work from anywhere within your home country (Colombia, Brazil, or Argentina)

• Paid Time Off - ample vacation days to rest and recharge

• Public Holidays - local federal holidays are fully paid days off

postings.descriptionText:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel , we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.
Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel , contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.
Parexel FSP is looking for a Manager, Central Monitoring to join our team in Argentina!

Job Overview
The Manager, Central Monitoring is accountable for centralized monitoring activities for global and/or complex trials, analytical data review of key risk and/or operational performance data and presenting as an integral member of the Clinical Study team for clinical development studies. The reviews include interpretation of Key Risk Indicator (KRI) and/or Key Performance Indicator (KPI) data housed in an analytical tool as well as a comprehensive review of supplemental operational data/trends and issues to be interpreted, reported and presented to the study teams. The Manager, Central Monitoring , will be responsible for supporting several studies within a therapeutic area and program-level. They will work closely with other Central Monitors and Centralized Data Risk Analysts (CDRAs) to ensure effective identification, conduct and reporting of central monitoring activities. This role will contribute to continued process improvement and innovation activities, and industry collaborations in central monitoring capabilities.

Job Description

JOB DUTIES:

• Collaborate on Study Quality Risk Assessment: Participate in the development and refinement of the Study Quality Risk Assessment and Control Tracker (QRACT) to identify and manage study risks.

• Develop and Author the Central Monitoring Plan: Lead the creation of the Central Monitoring Plan, ensuring alignment with study-specific needs and Risk Based Quality Management (RBQM) methodologies.

• Oversee Central Monitoring Execution: Work with data analysts to configure, implement, and execute the Central Monitoring RBQM system across assigned studies, ensuring effective signal detection.

• Analyze and Interpret Data Trends: Conduct study-level Central Monitoring Reviews using data analysis tools, interpret KRIs/KPIs, and assess trends to identify areas requiring intervention.

• Facilitate Study Team Decisions: Present findings to clinical study teams, support root cause analysis, and provide recommendations for follow-up actions to address identified risks.

• Document and Track Actions: Document outputs from Central Monitoring Review meetings, track decisions, and ensure timely closure of actions.

• Act as Central Monitoring subject matter expert. Represent Central Monitoring as a subject matter expert during audits, inspections, and within study teams on client processes.

• Provide Oversight of Contract Research Organization (CRO) Activities: Partner with outsourcing management to align monitoring strategies and ensure CRO partners execute Central Monitoring activities according to the agreed standards.

• Drive Process Improvements: Evaluate the effectiveness of Central Monitoring processes, identify areas for improvement, and recommend enhancements to tools, metrics, and methodologies.

• Represent Central Monitoring in Initiatives: Represent the function in cross-functional process improvement initiatives and assess emerging technologies to enhance Central Monitoring capabilities.

Knowledge, skills, and abilities required to perform the job

• Strong analytical problem-solving and critical thinking abilities, with experience troubleshooting data refreshes and resolving execution errors in analytical systems.

• Working knowledge of the clinical drug development process, including ICH, GCP guidelines, and regulatory requirements

• Effective communication and interpersonal skills; ability to build relationships internally and externally

• Demonstrated ability to identify and interpret current and future business trends and apply them to centralized monitoring practices

• Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and analytical insights in a clear and concise manner

• Aptitude for mathematical concepts, statistical methodologies, and data analytics, with a focus on interpreting KRIs and KPIs

• Knowledge and experience with clinical databases, electronic data capture systems, quality control processes, and auditing procedures

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, with advanced skills in Excel for data manipulation and reporting

• Preferred: Experience using CluePoints or similar centralized monitoring system.

Minimal educational requirements:

• High School Diploma

• Associates Degree

• Bachelors Degree

• Masters Degree

• Ph.D.

• PharmD

• MD

• Board Certified MD

Minimum Years of Experience:
At least 7 years of relevant experience in the biotechnology/pharmaceutical industry, with a minimum of 1 year with direct Central Monitoring experience. Site monitoring or data management experience a plus.

postings.title: Data Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join a high-performing data engineering team at a leading global company operating at the intersection of sports, technology, and digital commerce .
In this role, you will take ownership of the systems responsible for ingesting, transforming, validating, and publishing data across a large-scale data ecosystem. You will work at the data ingestion boundary, where information from multiple internal and external sources enters the platform, ensuring it is accurate, reliable, and ready to power downstream products, analytics, and services.
You will be responsible for building and maintaining scalable data pipelines , solving complex identity and entity-matching challenges , identifying and addressing data-quality issues, and improving the reliability and observability of data flows across the organization.
This is a highly hands-on engineering role that combines AWS data engineering, Python, SQL, event-driven architectures, data quality, and identity resolution . You will work closely with engineering, product, analytics, and downstream platform teams to troubleshoot complex data challenges, improve existing systems, and build reliable solutions that support data-driven products at scale.

What You'll Do

•
Own and evolve data ingestion pipelines that bring data from multiple external and internal sources into the platform, including ingestion, cleaning, curation, entity resolution, and event-driven publishing.

• Design, build, and maintain scalable batch and event-driven data workflows using Python, SQL, and AWS.

• Solve complex identity resolution, entity matching, and deduplication challenges across multiple data sources, ensuring reliable and consistent entity mappings.

• Build and maintain data quality and validation frameworks , including freshness monitoring, null-rate and consistency checks, and schema-drift detection.

• Monitor data at the ingestion boundary and proactively identify, troubleshoot, and resolve issues before they impact downstream products and services.

• Partner with engineering teams responsible for event infrastructure and downstream identity services to trace data and events end-to-end.

• Collaborate with Product, Assessments, Analytics, and Engineering teams to understand how data is consumed downstream and ensure pipelines meet evolving product and business requirements.

• Work with AWS services such as Glue, Athena, S3, and DynamoDB to build and operate reliable, scalable data infrastructure.

• Automate infrastructure and pipeline changes using Infrastructure as Code , primarily Terraform or AWS CDK.

• Participate in production incident response , quickly assessing impact, identifying root causes, and implementing effective remediation.

• Continuously improve the reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability of data pipelines and platform infrastructure.

What You'll Bring

•
5+ years of experience building and operating production-grade data pipelines and data infrastructure.

• Strong experience with both batch processing and event-driven architectures .

• Hands-on experience with AWS Glue, Athena, and S3-based data lakes , including layered or medallion-style data transformations.

• Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for data processing, transformation, and analysis.

• Experience solving identity resolution, entity matching, and deduplication problems, including exact and fuzzy matching approaches.

• Understanding of durable identifiers and identity-mapping strategies , including the challenges associated with maintaining consistent first-seen or locked mappings over time.

• Experience working with event schemas and schema-registry-backed contracts , such as Protobuf, and an understanding of the impact of schema evolution on downstream consumers.

• Strong troubleshooting and production incident-response skills , with the ability to assess impact, identify root causes, and drive issues through resolution.

• Ability to understand and debug code written in a functional or concurrent programming language , such as Elixir.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, analytics, and other technical teams.

Nice to Have

• Experience with Elixir/Phoenix or other BEAM-based concurrent processing frameworks .

• Experience with DynamoDB-backed identity, lookup, or matching services .

• Experience with the Snowflake ecosystem , including data modeling, Snowpipe, Streams, and Tasks.

• Experience working with sports data providers, licensed data providers, or other complex external data ecosystems .

• Experience implementing data observability , including freshness and staleness alerts, null-rate monitoring, schema-drift detection, and data-quality dashboards.

• Experience managing infrastructure through Terraform or AWS CDK .

Technologies

Languages: Python, SQL, familiarity with Elixir

AWS: Glue, Athena, S3, DynamoDB

Data & Streaming: Data Lakes, Event-Driven Architecture, Protobuf, Schema Registries

Infrastructure: Terraform, AWS CDK

Data Platforms: Snowflake

Engineering Practices: Data Quality, Data Observability, Identity Resolution, Entity Matching, Incident Response

About EnterpriseAlumni

EnterpriseAlumni isn't your average software company. We're a market-leading provider of Alumni Management software, globally. We are looking for a Customer Support Specialist to own the day-to-day support experience for our enterprise customers. You will be their first point of contact for product, technical and service questions, and accountable for making sure every issue is resolved quickly, clearly and to the standard our clients expect.
Our customers are senior teams in large, often heavily regulated organizations. When something goes wrong, they should never have to chase a status update, escalate internally, or wonder whether the right people are working on it. You will triage and manage tickets within SLA, coordinate across Engineering, Product and Customer Success to bring the right urgency to each issue, and keep customers informed at every stage.
Beyond individual tickets, you will look across the support queue to spot recurring issues and trends, feed them back to Product and Engineering, and help improve how we support customers at scale.
Working within a global Customer Support team across multiple time zones, you will combine deep product knowledge with clear, calm communication - the kind that earns trust with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.

Key Responsibilities

• Establish strong relationships with key customer stakeholders and maintain consistent lines of communication to drive high customer satisfaction.

• Take a pro-active role in monitoring and actioning/assigning customer-facing service desk tickets within SLAs; replying to customer and/or escalating to development teams.

• Handle all customer contacts, inquiries and complaints regarding product, services, and technical related issues in the first level.

• Collaborate across the global Customer Support team and ensure smooth handoffs of all pertinent tickets between time zones.

• Partner with sales and customer success teams to identify commercial opportunities within active accounts and align customer goals and strategy to product deliverables.

• Provide multi-faceted support both to customers and internal teams, including resolving problems, explaining products and services, training on use of software, configuration of software, and troubleshooting.

• Contribute to the overall Customer Support reporting efforts by keeping information up-to-date and communicating transparently.

• Maintain working knowledge of an ever-evolving software solution as a product expert and pro-actively keep informed with up-to-date information regarding our products, services, systems and strategy.

• Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical roles in Product, Development, Sales, and Customer Operations.

• Monitor, respond to, and escalate incidents within Stage and Production environments and software stack.

Experience

• 2–3 years' experience in a customer-facing Technical Support, Service Desk or Delivery Manager role, ideally in enterprise SaaS.

• Experience supporting international B2B customers at all levels, from end users to senior stakeholders.

• Fluent written and spoken English.

• Working knowledge of third-party SaaS stack applications.

• Strong organizational, prioritization and time management skills, with the judgement to manage competing urgent issues.

• Clear, confident communication, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences. You will be speaking to customers every day via email, phone or video calls.

• Ability to coordinate across teams and influence without direct authority.

• A consistently high standard of service, delivered in line with EnterpriseAlumni 's processes and guidelines.

• Hands-on experience with support and productivity tools such as Jira, Zendesk and AI assistants (e.g. Claude).

• Desirable: experience running customer training, project management (agile and/or waterfall), or supporting customers in regulated industries.

Why Join Us?
You'll join a growing team supporting some of the world's best-known organizations, where your work directly shapes how our customers experience EnterpriseAlumni . We value work-life balance, collaboration and respect, and we celebrate our successes together.
At the heart of our company is EA DNA - the essence that connects our six core values and shapes how we work every day. It guides every decision, behavior and interaction, and defines the way we do business. When you join us, you become part of a team that truly lives these values: People First, Customer at Our Core, Think Commercially, One Team, Own It, and Urgency. These principles shape your experience here—how we support you, how we work together, and how we deliver for our customers.

Operations Manager
We're looking for an Operations Manager to own the day-to-day delivery of US production, inventory, fulfilment, and logistics through an outsourced 3PL and co-manufacturing partner. You will set daily priorities, hold partners accountable to commitments, resolve operational issues end to end, and give the Operations Director accurate reporting and practical recommendations so they can manage the overall plan and make decisions.
This is a hands-on ownership role. You are not coordinating from a distance. You are the main day-to-day point of accountability for US operations, covering a 3PL relationship, a co-manufacturer relationship, multi-channel fulfilment, inventory accuracy, and financial controls. If you have 5 or more years of experience in fulfilment, logistics, inventory, or production, have managed outsourced 3PL and co-manufacturer relationships at a manager level, and can show evidence of independent ownership rather than just task execution, this role is a strong fit.

Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy

100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive

• Own a critical operations function for a fast-growing consumer goods brand with distribution across DTC, wholesale, Amazon, and US retail

• High-ownership role with direct accountability for fulfilment performance, inventory accuracy, and partner management

What You'll Work On

3PL and Co-Manufacturing Partner Management

• Lead the day-to-day relationship with the 3PL and co-manufacturer including floor managers, account managers, and supervisors

• Align production and fulfilment priorities, confirm commitments and deadlines, and hold responsible people accountable for delivery

Fulfilment and Logistics

• Manage DTC, wholesale, Faire, Amazon, and retail fulfilment against agreed priorities and channel requirements

• Resolve overdue, partial, replacement, and unscanned orders and reconcile systems to what was physically dispatched

• Confirm carrier handover and track domestic freight through to customer delivery

• Review carrier performance, resolve delivery-window risks, and keep account managers informed of exceptions

Inventory and Systems

• Keep receipts, transfers, production, and dispatch records accurate in Cin7

• Coordinate stock counts, recounts, and month-end reconciliations and resolve variances with evidence

• Reconcile Amazon stock with Cin7 and prepare replenishment requirements using agreed forecasts and inbound receipts

• Resolve discrepancies across Cin7, the 3PL's warehouse management system, Shopify, and Faire

Financial Controls

• Check 3PL, co-manufacturing, and domestic freight charges against approved rates, bookings, quantities, and services

• Document late or incorrect orders, production errors, replacement costs, and inventory losses

• Give Finance shipment costs, invoices, agreed terms, and due dates; follow up shipped orders that have not been invoiced

Continuous Improvement

• Improve recurring workflows to reduce manual effort, errors, and repeat failures

• Document procedures and verify the accuracy of automated or AI-assisted outputs

• Analyse fulfilment and freight costs by channel and check packaging and shipping assumptions for new products and bundles

• At least 2 to 3 years at manager level as the main day-to-day owner of a co-manufacturer or contract manufacturer relationship covering production scheduling, blending, filling, packaging, quality checks, and corrective actions

• Evidence of independent ownership such as a partner transition or turnaround you led, KPIs you were accountable for, disputes and credits you recovered, or escalations you brought with a recommendation rather than just a problem

• Confident with Cin7 or a comparable inventory system, Shopify, and 3PL warehouse management systems

• Experience with multi-channel fulfilment including DTC, wholesale, Amazon, and US retail requirements such as routing guides, BOL, ASN, and EDI

• Available to work US Eastern business hours plus regular calls with an Australia-based team outside standard hours

Nice to Have
