postings.descriptionText:
About us
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and .
We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.
The Opportunity
We're looking for an Expansion Manager to lead our expansion into the North American corporate travel market. This is a strategic, revenue-generating role focused on identifying, engaging, and closing partnerships with corporate travel management companies (TMCs), travel agencies, procurement teams, and enterprise travel buyers to bring their travel volume onto our marketplace.

What you will do:

• Build and execute a go-to-market strategy for acquiring corporate travel channel partners (TMCs, corporate travel agencies, travel procurement teams, GDS/OBT partners) across North America

• Identify, prospect, and build relationships with key decision-makers at target accounts, including VP/Director-level travel procurement and travel management leaders

• Own the full sales cycle: prospecting, pitching, negotiating commercial terms, and closing partnership agreements

• Develop a deep understanding of the corporate travel ecosystem (TMCs, GDS, OBTs, travel policy, RFP processes) to tailor value propositions to different buyer types

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Legal, and Operations to structure partnership deals and ensure smooth onboarding of new channel partners

• Build and manage a pipeline of prospective partners, forecasting accurately against revenue and volume targets

• Represent the company at industry conferences, trade shows, and travel-industry events (e.g., GBTA) to build brand presence and generate leads

• Negotiate commercial agreements, including pricing, volume commitments, and integration requirements

• Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and regulatory shifts in corporate travel to inform strategy

• Partner with Customer Success/Account Management to ensure a smooth handoff and long-term retention of acquired channels

• Report regularly on pipeline health, deal progress, and market insights to senior leadership

• As the channel matures, help define the hiring plan and eventually recruit, onboard, and lead a small business development team focused on corporate travel.

Workplace: within the Americas region & Remote

Requirements

Who you are:

• 4+ years in business development, partnerships, or enterprise sales, with a significant portion focused on corporate travel, TMCs, or the broader travel/mobility industry

• Proven track record of sourcing and closing complex, multi-stakeholder B2B partnerships or enterprise deals, as an individual contributor

• Existing network of relationships within the corporate travel ecosystem (TMCs, travel buyers, GDS providers, OBT vendors) strongly preferred

• Experience negotiating commercial agreements involving volume commitments, revenue share, or marketplace integration terms

• Deep understanding of how corporate travel is bought, managed, and booked (RFP cycles, managed travel programs, policy compliance)

• Strong consultative selling and negotiation skills; comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders (VP/C-level)

• Entrepreneurial mindset — comfortable building a channel and playbook from the ground up in a new market

• Excellent communication and relationship-building skills across internal and external stakeholders

• Data-driven approach to pipeline management and forecasting (CRM proficiency, e.g., Salesforce or HubSpot)

• Willingness to travel domestically (and occasionally internationally) for partner meetings and industry events

Nice to Have

• Existing relationships with major North American TMCs or corporate travel agencies

• Experience in travel marketplaces, GDS, or travel tech platforms

• Familiarity with API/technical integration concepts relevant to travel booking systems

What you can expect:

• Make a global impact. Help shape how millions of people discover and book ground transportation worldwide.

• Own your work. Take responsibility from day one and see the direct impact of your contributions.

• Build with the best tools. We move fast, continuously evolve our tech stack, and invest in modern, efficient solutions.

• Work with industry leaders. Our partners include , Google Maps, Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.

• Grow with exceptional people. Join an international team that will challenge, support, and inspire you every day.

• Work your way. Enjoy flexible and remote-friendly working options, relocation opportunities, and plenty of room to grow.

postings.title: Senior Accounting Manager - CPA Level
postings.descriptionText:
Senior Accounting Manager – Multi-Entity Accounting & Financial Reporting | Remote
Position Type: Full-Time
Location: Remote
Function: Accounting / Finance

About the Role
At Pavago , one of our clients is hiring a Senior Accounting Manager to manage accounting operations across multiple locations and business units.
This is a hands-on accounting leadership role with ownership of the month-end close, financial reporting, reconciliations, audit support, and accounting controls . You’ll work closely with the VP of Accounting and leadership to maintain accurate financial records while strengthening the systems and processes needed to support continued growth.
The ideal candidate brings strong U.S. GAAP knowledge, multi-entity accounting experience, and expert-level QuickBooks Online skills .

What You’ll Own

Month-End Close & Financial Reporting

• Own the month-end close across multiple locations and entities

• Manage and review financial records by business unit

• Review P&L, AR, AP, payroll, and other accounting records

• Ensure financial reporting is accurate, complete, and timely

• Analyze financial results and investigate discrepancies or unusual activity

• Maintain financial records in accordance with U.S. GAAP and U.S. accounting practices

• Help leadership maintain clear visibility into financial performance

Reconciliations & Accounting Operations

• Perform and review bank reconciliations

• Reconcile credit card accounts

• Perform and review balance sheet reconciliations

• Maintain accurate records in QuickBooks Online

• Oversee accounting activity across multiple entities, locations, and business units

• Identify inconsistencies and ensure issues are resolved promptly

• Maintain supporting documentation and organized accounting records

Audit & Controls

• Perform and review audit procedures across:

• Revenue

• Accounts Receivable

• Inventory

• Fixed Assets

• Accounts Payable

• Debt

• Equity

• Payroll

• Support external audits and respond to audit requests

• Maintain accurate audit documentation

• Evaluate existing internal controls

• Identify accounting and financial risks

• Strengthen controls as the organization scales

• Improve accounting processes and procedures where needed

Accounting Leadership & Process Improvement

• Partner closely with the VP of Accounting and company leadership

• Help develop scalable accounting systems and processes

• Identify opportunities to improve financial accuracy and efficiency

• Standardize processes across locations and business units

• Help ensure accounting operations can support continued company growth

• Bring a structured, analytical approach to financial problem-solving

Requirements

•
5+ years of accounting experience , including direct ownership of the month-end close

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or a related field

• Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and U.S. accounting practices — essential

• Experience managing accounting across multiple entities, locations, or business units — essential

• Expert-level QuickBooks Online experience

• Strong Microsoft Excel skills

• Hands-on experience with:

• Financial reporting

• Bank and balance sheet reconciliations

• Accounts Receivable

• Accounts Payable

• Payroll

• Month-end close

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Highly organized and detail-oriented

• Ability to work independently and take ownership of accounting responsibilities

Preferred Qualifications

•
CPA license preferred but not required

• 2–4 years of public accounting or external audit experience

• Experience working in a fast-growing organization

• Experience supporting multi-location businesses

• Experience improving accounting systems, processes, and internal controls

• Experience supporting external audits

Tools & Accounting Knowledge
QuickBooks Online | Microsoft Excel | U.S. GAAP | Financial Reporting | Month-End Close | Account Reconciliations | AR | AP | Payroll | Audit Procedures | Internal Controls

What Makes You a Strong Fit
You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

• Have personally owned a complete month-end close

• Understand U.S. GAAP beyond basic bookkeeping

• Have managed accounting across multiple entities or locations

• Are highly proficient in QuickBooks Online

• Can review financial statements and quickly identify inconsistencies

• Understand both day-to-day accounting operations and audit requirements

• Have strong reconciliation and financial reporting discipline

• Think critically about internal controls and financial risk

• Can improve accounting processes rather than simply maintain them

• Are comfortable partnering directly with senior finance leadership

• Can operate independently while maintaining exceptional attention to detail

What a Typical Day Looks Like
Depending on the point in the accounting cycle, you may be reviewing month-end close activity across multiple locations, reconciling balance sheet accounts in QuickBooks Online, reviewing P&Ls by business unit, or investigating discrepancies in AR, AP, payroll, or other financial records.
You may also review audit procedures, prepare documentation for external auditors, assess an internal control, or work with the VP of Accounting to improve a process that needs to scale across the organization.
In short: you’ll own the accuracy and integrity of the accounting function while helping build the processes and controls needed for growth.

Key Metrics for Success

• Timely and accurate month-end close

• Accuracy of financial reporting

• Quality and completeness of reconciliations

• Compliance with U.S. GAAP

• Accuracy across multiple entities and locations

• AR, AP, and payroll accuracy

• Identification and resolution of financial discrepancies

• Audit readiness and documentation quality

• Effectiveness of internal controls

• Reduction in accounting errors and unresolved items

• Improvement and scalability of accounting processes

Interview Process

• Initial Application

• Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview

• Client Interview

• Offer Stage

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required
As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire .
After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.
Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage . Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now
If you’re an experienced Senior Accounting Manager with strong expertise in U.S. GAAP, multi-entity accounting, month-end close, QuickBooks Online, reconciliations, financial reporting, and audit support , we’d love to hear from you.
This is an opportunity to take meaningful ownership of accounting operations while helping build a stronger, more scalable financial infrastructure.

postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca 's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

Your Role:
We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build the developer platform that agents and partners use to integrate and build on. You evolve Alpaca ’s MCP servers, tools, and skills, and you build the APIs behind them.
You play a central role to define the architecture that provides the fastest time to market for integrators. Builders who embed Alpaca for their end users all use this surface.
This is a hands-on role. You will lead through architecture, code, design reviews, and mentorship, and you will ship the first version yourself. You will partner with Product, Compliance, Risk, and Platform Engineering teams.

Things You Get To Do:

• Design and build Alpaca ’s agent-facing developer platform: MCP servers, tools, skills, and the APIs behind them.

• Evolve that platform as the MCP protocol and connector, plugin, and skill standards change.

• Build new APIs that make trading and account capabilities available to apps and agents.

• Decide which components the platform renders, so developers and partners build apps faster from shared building blocks.

• Keep Alpaca ’s execution model current with the MCP protocol and with connector, plugin, and skill standards, and translate what changes into the application architecture of the developer platform.

• Own production reliability and quality for the services you build.

• Mentor engineers and raise the quality of design and implementation in this area.

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

• 5+ years of software engineering experience, with ownership of production systems that other developers use.

• Shipped a developer-facing API, SDK, or platform as a primary contributor.

• Enough MCP architecture to work with stateless and stateful behavior, and experience building to MCP, or to connector, plugin, or skill standards, as they have changed in production.

• Strong API design, including schemas, compatibility, and responses other developers can rely on.

• Proficiency in Python or TypeScript, and a willingness to work primarily in Go.

• Strong architectural judgment, with a record of shipping while requirements are still being defined.

• Clear communication with engineers, product, compliance, and risk partners.

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):

• Experience shipping developer-facing tools, SDKs, or MCP servers.

• Experience building agents with a framework such as LangChain.

• Experience or understanding of financial markets

• Production experience with Go.

• Experience working at a startup.

• Experience working remotely.

How We Take Care of You:

• Competitive Salary & Stock Options

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

postings.title: Strategic Partnership Manager
postings.descriptionText:
7-Eleven is an iconic family of brands with over 86,000 locations, surpassing every retailer in the world. We revolutionize convenience, restaurants and fuel through cutting edge innovation — working hard to be the customer's first choice. 7-Eleven empowers our employees to "activate awesome" and make a meaningful impact in their stores and communities every day. If you're ready to grow, lead and make a difference, come join our team and help shape the future of convenience.

JOB SUMMARY:
The Commercial Fleet team at 7-Eleven manages a diverse portfolio of fleet payment providers, channel partners, and strategic programs designed to drive commercial fuel volume across more than 8,000 retail fueling locations nationwide. The team also supports the growth of the 7FLEET Diesel Network, serving professional drivers, transportation companies, and fleet operators throughout the United States.
The Strategic Partnership Manageris responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of strategic partner relationships that contribute to the expansion and success of the Commercial Fleet programs. This role serves as the primary liaison between 7-Eleven and assigned fleet payment providers, channel partners, technology partners, and other industry stakeholders.
The ideal candidate is customer-focused, highly organized, relationship-driven, and comfortable navigating a fast-paced business environment. This individual will collaborate across multiple internal and external teams to identify growth opportunities, support partner initiatives, optimize program performance, and help drive profitable fuel volume through the Commercial Fleet Programs.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITES:

• Manage a portfolio of strategic fleet payment, transportation, technology, and channel partner relationships.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned partners, developing trusted relationships with key stakeholders and executive decisionmakers.

• Develop and execute account plans that support fuel volume growth, network utilization, partner engagement, and program expansion.

• Conduct recurring business reviews with partners to evaluate performance, review key metrics, identify opportunities, and align on future growth initiatives.

• Analyze partner performance data, fuel volume trends, program utilization, and customer activity to provide actionable recommendations.

• Act as the voice of assigned partners by communicating market feedback, competitive insights, customer needs, and growth opportunities to internal stakeholders.

• Collaborate with Operations, Marketing, Finance, Product, Technology, Customer Service, Credit, and other cross-functional teams to ensure successful execution of partner initiatives.

ABOUT THE PROJECT
Sensus AI - FZCO is seeking a senior stylized 3D character generalist or a specialist studio to create production-ready assets for Lumi, the feline companion in Tabimi.
This is a remote, project-based contract. The scope covers one character with one base outfit and its props: an editable master, production rig, and mobile-ready derivatives. The estimated production period is 12 weeks, subject to the agreed plan.

WHAT YOU WILL DELIVER

• An editable Blender master, high-poly sculpt source files, clean topology, UVs, PBR materials and textures, and editable grooming.

• Body, face, and tail rigging, controllers, weights, necessary shape keys, and test poses or short clips demonstrating deformation quality.

• Mobile-ready USDZ and GLB assets derived from the same master, with asset-side support for iPhone import and playback checks.

• Organized source files, export instructions, dependency and third-party asset disclosures, and clear version records.

SCOPE BOUNDARIES
This project includes rig-validation clips. A full production animation library, additional outfits, and video-sprite deliverables are outside the current scope. Our engineering team owns application code and integration; you support asset-side validation.

SKILLS WE NEED

• End-to-end production experience with stylized feline or other quadruped characters.

• Sculpting, retopology, UVs, materials, grooming, hair-card or equivalent runtime conversion, rigging, and mobile optimization.

• Strong character likeness and visual quality, including appealing eyes, fur, and fabric, with dependable face, body, and tail deformation.

• Blender production and delivery experience, PBR workflows, and USDZ/GLB export. ZBrush may be used as a supporting tool; Blender Python experience is a plus.

• Reviewable work-in-progress files, clear communication, and traceable revisions.

WHAT TO INCLUDE IN YOUR APPLICATION

• At least one relevant stylized feline or quadruped case study, with your exact contribution identified.

• Final images and production breakdowns covering topology, materials, grooming, runtime hair conversion, and rig or deformation tests.

• Mobile asset delivery examples, where available.

• Your availability and proposed project-based pricing approach. Studios should identify the lead artist and the people responsible for each part of the work.

Please share only portfolio material you have permission to disclose. Keep prior-client confidential source files private.

PROJECT FEES AND PROCESS
Portfolio review is followed by an NDA, the full project brief, a same-scope quote, and a joint founder/engineering interview. Detailed character references, numerical asset budgets, pipeline requirements, and acceptance criteria are shared after shortlisting and the NDA.
The final project fee, settlement currency, payment milestones, and start date will be agreed in the contract. Visual quality and technical delivery are reviewed together.

postings.title: Technical Recruiter
postings.descriptionText:
Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things, so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition.
Now, we’re entering our next chapter, defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end-to-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together.
This position is 100% remote in Latin America.

About the Role
As our Technical Recruiter, you'll specialize in AI, ML and engineering recruitment and own hiring from intake to offer. That includes our hardest searches, Senior and Principal AI Engineers, plus our regular full-stack, front-end and back-end roles. You'll know the AI engineering market well enough to tell a mid-level from a senior, from a principal before they reach our interview team. You'll also use AI tools to source and run searches better than a manual process can.

What We’re Looking For

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

• Specialize in AI, ML and engineering recruitment: own full-cycle hiring for AI and ML Engineers (Senior and Principal) and for full-stack, front-end and back-end engineers. That covers intake, sourcing, screening, scheduling, feedback, debriefs and offers.

• Design and execute recruitment strategies: build a search plan for each role, covering target profiles, channels, messaging and timelines. Adjust it when the market says otherwise.

• Find principal-level AI talent: build pipelines for Senior and Principal AI Engineers beyond LinkedIn. Look in GitHub, open-source projects, research papers, technical communities and referrals.

• Level candidates accurately: screen against senior-vs-principal so the interview team only meets candidates at the right level.

• Use AI tools to improve search: use AI tools and LLM assistants for market mapping, search strings, candidate research and outreach.

• Turn recruiting data into insights: track time-to-fill, pass-through rates, sources and decline reasons in Greenhouse. Use them to show where searches stall and what to change.

• Optimize hiring processes: tighten intake, scorecards, scheduling and candidate communication. Document playbooks and interview plans so searches run the same way every time.

Required Skills & Experience

• 5+ years of technical recruiting, with full-cycle ownership of engineering searches.

• Recent experience hiring AI or ML engineers at Senior level or above, and you can explain how a Principal differs from a Senior.

• Enough technical fluency to discuss LLM applications, RAG, evaluation, fine-tuning and MLOps with engineers, and to probe their claims.

• Hands-on, daily use of AI tools in your recruiting work, with examples of what changed because of them.

• A track record of sourcing passive senior candidates through channels other than LinkedIn.

• Fluent written and spoken English. You'll work with engineers and leaders across many countries.

• A data-driven approach: you use funnel metrics to make decisions and explain them to hiring managers. Comfortable with Greenhouse or a similar ATS.

• Experience designing recruitment strategies and improving hiring processes, not only running them, in a small team where processes are still being built.

Nice to Have

• Experience recruiting for consulting firms or agencies with client-driven hiring

• Experience hiring across multiple LATAM countries and the US

• Spanish or Portuguese

• Experience with Juicebox AI or similar AI sourcing tools

What Success Looks Like
We’re looking for someone who brings more than technical skills. The right person for this role is:

•
AI-fluent. You already use AI tools in your day-to-day work to analyze information, automate repetitive tasks, draft materials, and work more efficiently.

•
A builder. You’re comfortable creating processes and systems where there isn’t a playbook yet. You’d rather ship a useful first version and improve it than wait for perfection.

•
A clear communicator. You surface problems early, ask questions when something is unclear, and communicate what you know — and what you don’t.

•
Comfortable with ambiguity. Able is growing and evolving quickly. You’ll help shape the processes and systems you’ll eventually own.

Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. We’re actively investing in our team through AI training, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on experimentation to ensure everyone grows alongside the technology.
This position is 100% remote in Latin America. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are a requirement.

As a team member, you can expect:

• To work 40 hours per week, and be available during normal business hours as needed

• Payments made in USD

• 18 days of PTO per year, observance of local holidays, and an annual break between Christmas and New Years

• Wellness + Remote Stipend

• AI Voucher

About Able

Able builds technology products in a portfolio model. We believe that people, teams, and processes are more important than the ideas themselves, so we’ve focused on bringing great people together, and investing in their growth.
We’ve built products in a variety of industries. Everything from media to finance to toys to healthcare. Sometimes we work with management teams to help their businesses grow faster or unlock value using technology. Other times we start or buy businesses outright. Each time, we look for opportunities to leverage technology built at the portfolio-level to drive value faster.
Able is committed to inclusion and diversity and is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or veteran status.
This is but the beginning of a conversation we’d love to have with you.

Apply, and let’s get this adventure started!

postings.title: Media and Content Intern
postings.descriptionText:
This is an unpaid placement of four months. It starts in January 2027, takes around fifteen hours of your week, and is fully remote. You do not have to be a student, and we have no requirement about what you studied or whether you studied at all.

What you would actually do
Every week you take one topic from our content calendar and carry it the whole way. That means five published pieces a week: a long-form article for our blog, a post for LinkedIn, a thread on X, an Instagram carousel and a short Instagram reel. You write them, you make the artwork, you proofread everything against our house style, and you publish and schedule it yourself across all five accounts. Two weeks later you go back and record how each piece performed. Once a month you run the research that decides what we write about next.
You do this from a written procedure rather than from somebody standing over you. We pair with you for the first two cycles, and after that the week is yours to run.
If you want to apply, the subject line of your email is “Placement application – ” followed by the name of one of the five things we publish every week, listed above. We read the subject line before we read anything else.

What you leave with
More than fifty published pieces with real numbers attached to them. A portfolio file we build with you as you go and export for you at the end. It holds every carousel and reel as a file, every article as a link, a line on each one saying what you did, and the figures for how it performed. A written reference. And a named person here who will take a call about you.
We are not offering experience and exposure, because those words cost us nothing and are worth nothing to you.

Who this suits
Somebody who makes things already, whether or not anybody is paying them to. Somebody who can be edited directly and get interested rather than defensive. Somebody who would rather read a procedure than ask a question that the procedure already answers, and who will tell us when the procedure is wrong.
You do not need Adobe, a design degree, or any certificate. If your Canva work shows you can control type and space, that counts for more here than the software you own.

How we work, so that you can decide
Our editing is direct and it is not personal. Every draft comes back marked up, and in the first month most of it will be marked up. If that sounds like the wrong arrangement for you, it probably is, and we would both rather know now.

How to apply
Send us three things you made, with links. Any medium, and it does not have to be marketing: a newsletter, a student magazine, a video account, a zine, a modification for a game, a set of photographs. For each one, tell us in a line or two what you used to make it, what you made yourself, and what came with the template or the tool. If you used Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini anywhere in it, say what it did and what you did – we use these tools ourselves and we are asking out of interest rather than suspicion.
Then tell us which of the three is the weakest, and what you would change. One hundred and fifty words.
Last, and this one is optional: name one thing Sigma Growth Specialists should be doing on social media and is not. Two sentences.
No curriculum vitae and no cover letter. Applications to [address].

• You have written loyalty, rewards, and win-back programming, and you understand that driving repeat purchase and long-term value is a core outcome of this role.

postings.title: Jr. Salesforce Administrator / QA Tester
postings.descriptionText:
Role Summary
Prove Partners is consolidating two Salesforce orgs and migrating a legacy system of record into Salesforce. The program runs in continuous release cycles, and every cycle changes objects, page layouts, permission sets, flows, Apex, and integrations. Each of those changes has to be proven out end to end before it reaches production users.

We are looking for a junior Salesforce administrator (remote) who wants to spend the bulk of their time in structured, repeatable quality assurance. This person will execute full end-to-end test passes in our sandboxes, over and over, across each release: building and maintaining the test scripts, running them, logging what breaks, retesting fixes, and confirming regressions have not been introduced elsewhere.

Repetition is the job, not a side effect of it. The right candidate is someone who is genuinely comfortable running the same 200-step regression pass every sprint and catching the one step that changed — and who is methodical enough to keep the documentation accurate while doing it.
Engagement at a Glance

Working title Junior Salesforce Administrator / QA Tester Reports to Director of Program Management & CRM Location Offshore / nearshore, fully remote Time zone requirement Minimum 6 hours of daily overlap with 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. US Eastern Commitment Full-time, 40 hours per week Duration 6–12 months, with option to extend Engagement type Open — vendor staff augmentation, individual contractor, or employer-of-record Seniority Junior (1–3 years); this is a hands-on execution role, not a lead role
Time zone is a hard requirement. Testing is iterative and conversational — the tester needs to be able to ask an administrator or developer a question and get an answer inside the same working session. Candidates should be located where the standard working day overlaps with US Eastern.
Key Responsibilities

End-to-end and regression testing (primary, ~60% of time)

• Execute full end-to-end test passes across core business processes in the sandbox environments, following documented scripts, for every release cycle.

• Run regression suites after each configuration or code change to confirm that existing functionality still behaves as expected.

• Test across the full record lifecycle — record creation, field updates, stage and status transitions, automation firing, downstream record effects, and reporting output.

• Retest and close out defects after fixes are deployed, and confirm the fix has not broken adjacent functionality.

• Validate behavior after sandbox refreshes and deployments, including smoke testing of critical paths.

Test design and documentation (~20% of time)

• Write and maintain test cases and test scripts from user stories, acceptance criteria, and process documentation.

• Keep the test case library current as requirements change; retire cases that no longer apply and add coverage for new functionality.

• Log defects with clear, reproducible steps, expected vs. actual results, affected records, screenshots, and severity.

• Maintain test execution records so that release readiness can be assessed at a glance.

Test data and environment support (~10% of time)

• Prepare and refresh test data sets, including bulk loads via Data Loader or Data Import Wizard.

• Write basic SOQL queries to verify data state and confirm expected record changes.

• Test across multiple user profiles and permission sets to confirm record visibility, field-level security, and sharing behave correctly for each role.

Light administrative configuration (~10% of time)

postings.title: Transaction Coordinator
postings.descriptionText:
Real Estate Transaction Coordinator – California Transactions & Compliance | Remote
Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Industry: Residential Real Estate

About the Role
At Pavago , one of our clients is hiring a detail-oriented Real Estate Transaction Coordinator to manage the administrative, documentation, and compliance side of California residential real estate transactions .
You’ll support agents from the time a purchase agreement is executed through the close of escrow , ensuring transaction files remain organized, deadlines are tracked, required disclosures and documents are completed, and all parties stay informed throughout the process.
This is an operations-focused role requiring strong organization, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple transactions at different stages simultaneously.
If you understand California real estate transactions and know how to keep files, deadlines, disclosures, and stakeholders organized from contract to closing, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Transaction & File Management

• Open and manage transaction files from executed purchase agreement through close of escrow

• Maintain accurate records within the transaction management platform

• Review contracts, addenda, disclosures, and supporting documents for completeness

• Maintain organized transaction files according to brokerage recordkeeping and compliance requirements

• Prepare and organize documents for review, approval, and signature

• Keep transaction records current throughout the transaction lifecycle

• Identify missing or incomplete information before it creates delays

Deadlines & Compliance

• Track critical transaction deadlines, including:

• Contingency periods

• Inspection windows

• Loan contingencies

• Appraisal contingencies

• Close-of-escrow dates

• Proactively monitor deadlines and alert agents when action is required

• Collect and confirm required California disclosure forms and transaction documents

• Help ensure files meet California and brokerage compliance requirements

• Review files for missing signatures, documents, or required information

• Follow up on outstanding compliance items

• Maintain accurate documentation throughout the transaction

California Transaction Documentation

• Work with California residential real estate contracts and disclosures

• Support documentation involving forms such as:

• Transfer Disclosure Statement (TDS)

• Natural Hazard Disclosure (NHD)

• Seller Property Questionnaire (SPQ)

• Agent Visual Inspection Disclosure (AVID)

• Ensure required documents are appropriately collected and organized

• Monitor transaction files for outstanding documentation

• Support agents in maintaining complete transaction records

Communication & Coordination

• Act as a point of contact between:

• Real estate agents

• Buyers and sellers

• Escrow/title officers

• Lenders

• Clients

• Other transaction partners

• Keep relevant parties informed about transaction progress and outstanding requirements

• Follow up on pending documents, signatures, approvals, and transaction items

• Coordinate information between internal and external stakeholders

• Help keep transactions progressing smoothly from contract through closing

• Communicate professionally and clearly throughout the transaction lifecycle

Documents & Electronic Signatures

• Prepare and route transaction documents for electronic signature

• Use DocuSign, DocuSign Rooms, Dotloop, or similar platforms

• Track outstanding signatures and follow up as needed

• Confirm completed documents are properly stored within transaction files

• Maintain accurate document organization and version control

• Support agents with transaction-related administrative documentation

Closing & Transaction Support

• Coordinate additional transaction items such as:

• Home warranty orders

• Repair documentation

• Vendor scheduling

• Outstanding signatures and approvals

• Support agents with administrative tasks related to active transactions

• Monitor outstanding items as transactions approach closing

• Help ensure required documentation is complete before close of escrow

• Maintain organized records throughout the closing process

• Manage multiple active transactions without sacrificing accuracy

Requirements

•
1–3+ years of experience as a Transaction Coordinator, Escrow Assistant, or in a similar real estate transaction support role

• Working knowledge of California residential real estate transactions

• Familiarity with California:

• Contracts

• Transaction timelines

• Disclosure requirements

• Strong understanding of transaction coordination from executed contract through close of escrow

• Experience managing multiple transactions, files, and deadlines simultaneously

• Experience using transaction management and electronic signature platforms

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to proactively track deadlines and follow up on outstanding items

• Ability to identify missing or incomplete transaction documentation

• Ability to work independently without constant supervision

• Comfortable communicating with agents, clients, lenders, escrow/title teams, and other transaction partners

A California Real Estate License is not required for this role.

Nice to Have

• Experience supporting multiple real estate agents or a full brokerage team

• Experience with DocuSign Rooms, Dotloop, or similar transaction management platforms

• Experience working with California disclosure forms such as:

• TDS

• NHD

• SPQ

• AVID

• Previous experience coordinating with escrow/title companies

• Experience working directly with lenders and other transaction partners

• Experience working within a real estate brokerage or transaction coordination environment

• Bilingual Spanish/English communication skills

Tools & Technology
DocuSign | DocuSign Rooms | Dotloop | Transaction Management Platforms | Electronic Signature Tools | Real Estate Documentation Systems | Email | Calendar & Scheduling Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit
You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

• Are highly organized and comfortable managing multiple deadlines simultaneously

• Have hands-on familiarity with California residential real estate transactions

• Pay close attention to details and quickly identify missing or incorrect information

• Understand the importance of documentation and compliance

• Proactively follow up without needing constant supervision

• Communicate clearly and professionally with agents, clients, and external partners

• Are comfortable working with contracts, disclosures, transaction documents, and real estate systems

• Can stay calm and organized while managing transactions at different stages

• Take ownership of your work

• Understand that small documentation or deadline errors can create larger transaction issues

What a Typical Day Looks Like
Your day may begin by reviewing active transaction files and identifying upcoming contingency, inspection, appraisal, loan, or closing deadlines.
You could then review newly executed contracts, organize disclosures, prepare documents for electronic signature, follow up on missing paperwork, and update transaction files.
Throughout the day, you’ll communicate with agents, escrow/title officers, lenders, clients, and other transaction partners to ensure outstanding requirements are addressed.
As transactions approach closing, you’ll monitor remaining documentation and administrative items to help ensure files stay organized and transactions continue moving forward.
In short: you keep California real estate transactions organized, compliant, documented, and moving from executed contract through close of escrow.

Key Metrics for Success

• Accuracy and completeness of transaction files

• On-time tracking of transaction deadlines

• Timely collection of required documents and disclosures

• Reduced missing or incomplete documentation

• Consistent follow-up on outstanding items

• Accurate electronic signature and document routing

• Smooth coordination between agents and transaction partners

• Timely escalation of potential deadline or compliance issues

• Ability to manage multiple active transactions simultaneously

• Organized files through close of escrow

Why This Role Stands Out

• Hands-on involvement throughout the California residential transaction lifecycle

• Ownership of transactions from executed contract through close of escrow

• Work directly with agents, lenders, escrow/title teams, clients, and other transaction partners

• Exposure to California-specific disclosures and transaction processes

• Fully remote working environment

• Opportunity to deepen expertise in real estate operations and compliance

• Potential career growth into:

• Senior Transaction Coordinator

• Lead Transaction Coordinator

• Real Estate Operations Coordinator

• Transaction Operations Manager

• Brokerage Operations Manager

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.
Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage . Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now
If you have experience as a Transaction Coordinator, Escrow Assistant, or real estate transaction professional and understand California residential real estate transactions, disclosures, deadlines, and close-of-escrow processes , we’d love to hear from you.
Apply today and help keep real estate transactions accurate, organized, compliant, and moving smoothly from contract to closing.

postings.descriptionText:
Molecule and BIO.xyz are building the foundation of Decentralized Science (DeSci) — where biotech meets web3 to make scientific research community-owned, transparent, and faster to market.
Molecule provides the infrastructure to turn intellectual property (IP) into programmable, on-chain assets through our IP-NFT framework and evolving protocol stack. This enables researchers, patients, and communities to fund and govern biotech projects in new, open ways.
is the coordination and economic layer of DeSci, powering BioDAOs through funding, governance, and ecosystem alignment.
Together, we are creating a new model for scientific discovery — one where breakthroughs are owned and advanced by the communities that believe in them.

The Role
You will be an AI Scientist at Molecule. In your first four weeks, you will live on-site, embedded with the founding team, and ship your first autonomous agent fleet into production against a real disease area. From day one you own the loop: design the agents, deploy them, pilot them, iterate, and generate scientific output that moves IP forward.
This is not a research role with a roadmap handed to you. You will pick targets, stand up infrastructure, recruit your sub-agents, and prove that autonomous science works at the bench-to-IP level. After the residency, you scale: more fleets, more disease areas, more shots on goal.

What You'll Do

• Architect and deploy fleets of scientific agents spanning literature mining, target identification, molecular design, assay design, and data analysis

• Pilot each fleet against a specific disease area and drive it to a tangible deliverable — a validated target, a candidate molecule, a novel dataset, an IP-NFT

• Run multiple fleets in parallel across disease areas, reporting results directly to the CEO

• Own the full stack: agent design, orchestration, evaluation, and scientific judgment on outputs

• Define and set the standard for how autonomous science gets done at Molecule

Who You Are

• Entrepreneurial to the core. You ship. You don't wait for permission.

• Technically deep across LLMs, agent frameworks, and at least one wet-science domain - chemistry, biology, pharma, structural biology, or genomics

• Comfortable with ambiguity. You may be the only person in the room who knows how to do what you do, and that energizes you

• Credential-agnostic. PhD, MSc, BSc, or straight from high school - output matters, not titles. If you hold a degree, it should be from a top-tier institution (Oxbridge, Ivy League, MIT, Caltech, Stanford, ETH/EPFL, Imperial, or equivalent). If you skipped the degree, show us what you built instead.

• All-in on intensity. Willing to live on-site for 4 weeks and operate at founder pace

What We Offer

• An early seat at the company building the infrastructure for autonomous science

• Direct ownership over a frontier no one else is running at

• Equity in the form of $BIO token allocation

• The fastest path from idea to deployed IP that exists in biotech today

We are an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equality and weaving a community that values diverse perspectives and experiences and are actively seeking a diverse pool of applicants. postings.title: Investment Associate
postings.descriptionText:
The Mission
We aren't looking for a traditional venture capital analyst who sits passively behind a desk waiting for pitch decks to land in an inbox. We need an "Ecosystem Scout" to join our core team. Your job is to hunt down early-stage opportunities, execute rigorous technical and financial analysis, and run deep due diligence on high-velocity ventures with surgical precision. This is a remote, high-availability role for an emerging investment professional who views digital economies as a 24/7 landscape and wants to master the mechanics of capital deployment at the absolute frontier of the Web3 economy.
We value a killer instinct and extreme attention to detail over corporate pedigrees. Whether you are a rising star with a track record of identifying trends before they break or an analytical powerhouse looking to transition into the fast-paced venture ecosystem, we care about your drive. If you have the persistence to manage massive deal pipelines, the research rigor to deconstruct complex protocols, and the communication skills to conduct high-level founder meetings, we will give you the platform to accelerate your career.

Key Responsibilities

• Seed Deal Sourcing: Proactively scout digital communities, developer ecosystems, and on-chain metrics to discover and engage high-velocity early-stage ventures before they hit the mainstream.

• Due Diligence: Coordinate and execute end-to-end due diligence processes, stress-testing a project’s technology, market fit, tokenomics, and team capabilities.

• Financial Analysis: Run rigorous, cold, and calculated breakdowns of market sizes, revenue models, financial projections, and economic incentive structures using hard logic rather than hype.

• Investment Memos: Author clear, data-backed synthesis documents and investment memos that translate complex technical data into actionable deployment decisions for the executive committee.

• Founder Meetings: Lead initial discovery calls and deep-dive evaluation meetings with elite operators, assessing their grit, product judgment, and technical execution.

• Portfolio Support: Step into the trenches with active portfolio companies, providing operational support, tracking data dashboards, and connecting them with our internal resources to accelerate growth.

The Requirements

• The "Eye" for Detail: An innate ability to spot structural market shifts and elite execution before they are obvious. You notice the subtle signals and community momentum that point to a winning model.

• Analytical Rigor: You love numbers and raw data. You are entirely comfortable breaking down a complex business model or a protocol's transaction flows using hard logic.

• Hyper-Availability: This isn't a 9-to-5. Markets shift fast and founders operate around the clock. You must be available 7 days a week to lock down opportunities, support portfolio needs, and keep deployment timelines moving.

• Web3 Literacy: You possess a solid, native understanding of the Web3 landscape. You are highly familiar with decentralized infrastructure, smart contract risks, and the unique psychology of digital asset communities.

• Remote Excellence: Self-motivated and highly organized; you can manage a massive matrix of active deal flows, data sheets, and founder threads without a single detail slipping through the cracks.

Operational Details

• Location: Fully Remote.

• Schedule: On-call 7 days a week (Requires high flexibility to handle real-time market shifts and global founder coordination).

• Payment: All compensation is processed in digital assets (USDC/USDT).

Why Join Us?
We offer more than just an entry-level investment role; we offer a masterclass in the future of the digital economy.

• High-Velocity Execution: You won't just be reviewing pitch decks; you will be helping to deploy capital into cutting-edge systems, gaining unparalleled insight into what makes a venture succeed.

• Transferable Mastery: The skills you develop here—surgical market analysis, high-level deal structuring, and data-driven company building—are the most sought-after capabilities in the modern economy.

• A Culture of Momentum: We excel at creating an environment where you are never stagnant. You will constantly be learning, tracking fresh investment strategies, and pushing the boundaries of execution.

• High-Growth Upside: We value "potential over pedigree." For an associate who consistently sources elite opportunities and hits their marks, there is a clear, fast-track runway into senior deployment roles.

postings.title: Vice President, Public Relations (Health)
postings.descriptionText:
WHO WE ARE
The PR industry hasn't really changed in fifty years. Relationships, lunches, luck, and a clip report at the end of the month.
Interdependence is rebuilding it from the ground up. Interviewed, our proprietary platform, analyzes 300,000+ stories every day across a network of 250,000 journalists. We turn earned media into something measurable, repeatable, and worth paying for, and apply the same data and discipline across paid, social, content, and brand. Integrated marketing run by one team, on one system, accountable to one result.
Forbes named us one of America's Best PR Agencies. Our 100+ person team works with brands, CMOs, founders, and entrepreneurs across consumer, healthcare, tech, B2B, travel and entertainment.
We move fast. The best argument wins. We hire for sharp thinking, real craft, and ownership from day one. If you want comfortable, this isn't the place. If you want to win, build with us.

THE ROLE
We are seeking an accomplished and strategic leader to join the team as a Vice President, Health. This role requires a seasoned professional with deep expertise in the healthcare industries, outstanding communication skills, and a proven track record in client management and team leadership. As the Vice President, you will spearhead PR initiatives for our clients, lead thought leadership, drive business growth, and deliver impactful results that enhance their reputation and visibility in the market.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Leadership: Provide visionary leadership and strategic direction for the health and lifestyle industries, guiding team members to achieve excellence and drive results.

• Client Management: Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with healthcare clients, serving as the primary point of contact and ensuring delivery of high-quality PR services.

• Strategy Development: Develop comprehensive PR strategies tailored to each client's objectives and target audience, leveraging industry knowledge and market insights.

• Campaign Execution: Oversee the implementation of PR campaigns, including media relations, thought leadership initiatives, crisis communications, and executive visibility programs.

• Team Management: Lead, mentor, and empower a team of PR professionals specializing in health and lifestyle services, fostering a collaborative and supportive work environment.

• Media Relations: Build and maintain relationships with key health and lifestyle contacts, securing impactful placements in top-tier outlets and healthcare publications.

• Thought Leadership: Position clients as industry thought leaders through strategic content development, speaking opportunities, and participation in relevant industry events and conferences.

• Crisis Communications: Develop and implement crisis communication plans to safeguard clients' reputation and mitigate reputational risks in the event of crises or negative publicity.

• Performance Analysis: Monitor and analyze campaign performance metrics, providing insights and recommendations for optimization and continuous improvement.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN IN YEAR ONE

• Own the practice's account management rhythm with structured weekly business reviews, account health scoring, and proactive risk identification across the existing client book

• Bring practice-level retention into the top quartile of the firm through tight service delivery, fast time-to-value on new accounts, and structured save-the-account interventions where necessary

• Develop and execute 5+ recurring expansion plays within the existing client base, building toward 1.5–2% monthly MRR expansion as a sustained rate

• Lead and develop the existing healthcare team, direct senior coaching, selective recruiting, and accountability for delivery quality

• Build a productized healthcare service offering that leverages the Interviewed platform: competitive intelligence, regulatory media monitoring, KOL targeting, payer narrative tracking

• Win new healthcare clients in partnership with our new business team, with focus on biotech, pharma, medical devices, hospital and health systems, digital health, and consumer wellness

• Represent the practice externally, industry events, healthcare-specific publications, thought leadership in the healthcare communications space

QUALIFICATIONS

• Minimum of 15 years of experience in public relations, with a focus on the healthcare and lifestyle industries.

• Proven track record of successfully managing PR campaigns for healthcare clients, with measurable results in media placements and client satisfaction.

• Strong leadership and management skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate a team to achieve excellence.

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to craft compelling narratives and communicate complex healthcare and lifestyle concepts effectively.

• Strategic thinker with a deep understanding of the healthcare industry.

• Extensive network of media contacts and industry connections within the healthcare and lifestyle sectors

• Results-oriented with a passion for delivering high-quality work and exceeding client expectations.

WHO YOU ARE

• 15+ years in healthcare communications or healthcare PR, with senior leadership experience leading teams and owning practice-level outcomes

• Demonstrated specialty depth in at least three of: FDA and regulatory communications, biotech and pharma, medical devices, hospital and health systems, payer relations, clinical trial communications, digital health, healthcare policy

• A documented track record of measurable client retention and expansion you can describe in numbers

• Comfortable carrying gross revenue retention, net revenue retention, and expansion as primary KPIs, not just media impressions and placements

• Strong network of healthcare media contacts across business, trade, clinical, and consumer publications

• Strategic operator, equally fluent in client strategy, team development, and operational rigor

• Comfortable with AI-driven workflows and a data-disciplined approach to earned media

WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT INTERDEPENDENCE
🏡 100% Remote, Forever - Work from anywhere in the world while you enjoy the flexibility of your fully remote workplace. Skip the annoying commute, create a workspace that works for you, and collaborate with teammates across the country, all without sacrificing connection or career growth.
🩺 Comprehensive Health Benefits - Choose from three Anthem Blue Cross PPO medical plans, plus dental and vision coverage to support your health and well-being.
💰 Retirement Savings - Save for the future with our 401(k) program, including a company match that is increasing further to 3% in 2027 .
🌴 Work-Life Balance - Enjoy paid vacation, sick time, 11 company holidays, a floating holiday, and Summer Fridays to recharge and spend more time doing what you love.
👶 Paid Parental Leave - We support growing families with paid parental leave, giving new parents dedicated time to recover, bond with their baby, and return to work with confidence.
📈 Career Growth - As one of the nation's fastest-growing strategic integrated marketing and communications firms, we're committed to helping ambitious people like you grow. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, lead from every level, and build a career with meaningful real impact.
🌟 Supportive, Collaborative Culture - We set high standards, celebrate big wins, and work together to achieve exceptional results. You'll join a team that's collaborative, entrepreneurial, and committed to helping one another succeed.

HOW TO APPLY
Submit your resume, a brief cover letter, and one additional document we genuinely want to read: a one-page write-up of your most significant healthcare client retention or expansion outcome. Tell us what the situation was, what you did, and the numbers you moved. The write-up will be weighted more heavily than the resume.

This opportunity focuses on supporting a major underground mining expansion project in Latin America through the review, development, and improvement of operational procedures related to underground mine development and drill & blast activities.
As a specialist SME, you will bring extensive operational experience to challenge existing practices, assess procedural effectiveness, identify operational and safety risks, and recommend practical improvements aligned with industry leading practices and Critical Control Management principles.

Why This Industry
The Metals & Mining industry continues to evolve as operations transition into increasingly complex underground environments while striving to improve safety, operational performance, and long-term asset value.
As underground mining projects expand, organisations must ensure that operational procedures effectively address technical challenges, operational risks, and critical control requirements.
At dss+ , we partner with mining leaders to strengthen operational resilience, improve risk management practices, and support safer, more productive operations across the mining value chain.

Your Impact at dss+

You will provide specialist technical expertise to assess, challenge, and improve operational procedures, ensuring that operational and safety risks are appropriately identified, understood, and controlled.
Working closely with dss+ and client stakeholders, you will apply your underground mining expertise to strengthen risk management practices and support safer, more effective operations.

Key Accountabilities

• Review operational procedures covering the underground mine development cycle, including drilling, charging, blasting, ventilation, scaling, ground support, mucking, haulage, and mine service installation

• Assess alignment between documented procedures, field execution, and industry good practice

• Evaluate operational and safety risks associated with underground development activities

• Identify hazards, credible scenarios, control gaps, and Critical Controls

• Review procedures from both operational and risk management perspectives

• Support the development and enhancement of risk-based operational procedures and standards

• Define operational hold points, authorization requirements, and stop-work criteria where appropriate

• Conduct technical reviews, field observations, interviews, and specialist workshops

• Engage with operators, supervisors, engineers, and contractors to validate procedural effectiveness

• Develop recommendations that improve operational performance and strengthen risk controls

What You'll Experience at dss+

Deliver on our Purpose
Be part of a values-led organisation where your work helps save lives, improve performance, and advance sustainability for our clients and their people.

Develop your Trusted Expertise
Apply your specialist expertise to complex operational challenges while collaborating with mining and risk-management professionals across the globe.

Thrive in a Culture of Respect
Join an inclusive and collaborative environment where your expertise is valued and where diverse perspectives help create better outcomes.

Shape your Impact
Contribute to projects that improve operational performance, strengthen critical controls, and support safer workplaces across the mining industry.

Who You Are
You are a highly experienced underground mining professional with strong operational credibility and deep practical expertise in underground development and drill & blast activities.
You are comfortable reviewing procedures, identifying risks and gaps, challenging existing practices, and translating technical knowledge into practical improvements that support both operational effectiveness and risk management.

Experience

How do we work?

postings.title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend
postings.descriptionText:
Hi, I'm Paul, VP of Engineering at Customer.io . We're looking for a staff engineer to set technical direction for the systems that move billions of messages a day. This isn't a role about shipping more, faster. It's about deciding what gets built, where the architecture needs to go next, and raising the ceiling for the engineers around you.

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive.
We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. Under the hood: Go, React, Ember and AI help us ship fast and scale with confidence.

What We Value

Ownership at company scale
You take on the problems nobody has claimed yet — the ones that span squads, have no obvious owner, and would quietly cost us a year if left alone. You either solve them or get leadership aligned to.

Engineers with product taste
You think like a user, not just an engineer. You connect architectural decisions to what customers actually experience, and you can explain that connection to people who don't write Go.

A healthy skepticism for "the way things are done"
You retire practices that have outlived their usefulness, including ones you helped build. Best practices matter — but never more than forward motion.

Force multiplication
Your best quarter isn't measured by what you shipped. It's measured by what the department can now do that it couldn't before.

What You'll Do

• Shape the technical direction of our distributed messaging systems in Go — making the high-level architectural calls on mission-critical services where scale, cost, and reliability are all in tension

• Take on ambiguous, high-stakes problems that cross squad and function boundaries, and drive them to a decision when the right answer isn't obvious to anyone yet

• Build consensus on contested technical questions across teams, and communicate the tradeoffs clearly enough that senior leadership can act on them

• Raise the department's bar — set quality and design standards, mentor senior engineers, and turn what you know into frameworks and documentation other teams can use without you in the room

• Drive engineering process and tooling improvements that span multiple squads, not just your own

• Interview and calibrate against our career ladder, giving honest, evidence-based assessments of candidates

• Use AI agents to make multi-file changes by scoping the work, writing the prompt, and verifying the output

What we're looking for

• 10+ years building scalable, distributed systems in Go (or similar statically typed languages), including several as the person others turned to on architecture

• Depth across multiple systems or domains, not just one — you've been the recognized expert in more than one place

• A track record of designing for production reality: you quantify tradeoffs in throughput, cost, and reliability rather than picking a reasonable path and defending it

• Experience designing observability and recovery as first-class concerns — metrics, alerting, rollback, backpressure, checkpointing — not logging added afterward

• Comfort working in cloud-native environments (AWS, GCP), with relational databases (we use MySQL) and a real understanding of performance tradeoffs

• Evidence of making other engineers better: mentorship, technical writing, design review, standards that outlasted your involvement

• A bias for action over perfection, and the judgment to know which decisions are worth slowing down for

Compensation & Benefits
We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $200,000 - $240,000 USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment. This role also carries a 10% annual bonus target.
We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process
No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

•
Application - We review everyone with care. Tell us why you're interested.

•
Recruiter Call (30 mins) - Let's chat about what you're looking for and how we work.

•
Hiring Manager Interview (60 mins) - Talk with one of our hiring managers about your working style and a project you've owned end-to-end, plus a short AI-assisted coding exercise.

•
Architecture Interview (60 mins) - A collaborative system design conversation focused on scaling challenges, tradeoffs, and failure modes.

•
Take-Home Assignment - Complete a short, realistic task similar to what you'd work on here.

•
Assignment Review Call (60 mins) - Walk us through your work and discuss tradeoffs, priorities, and how you'd iterate.

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.
Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.
Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact .

Join us!
We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you're excited by what you read and want to build software that makes communication better for everyone—apply now.

postings.descriptionText:
About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at .

The Opportunity 🚀

Carrot is seeking a Sr. Data Engineer to lead the evolution, reliability, and scalability of our modern data infrastructure across analytics, reporting, and business intelligence. In this role, you will architect, build, and maintain robust, automated data pipelines, orchestrate workflows, integrate diverse data sources, and partner with stakeholders across the business to deliver secure, compliant, high-quality data solutions.
Your work will span the full data lifecycle, from architecting resilient ETL/ELT pipelines and developing real-time and batch data integrations to automating reporting, reducing technical debt, and enabling advanced analytics. Sr. Data Engineers at Carrot are operational stewards and technical mentors, driving improvements in system maturity, cost efficiency, automation, and collaborative practices.
You will join our Data Engineering team, which develops and optimizes scalable data pipelines and cloud infrastructure to enable secure, automated reporting and analytics across Carrot. The team collaborates closely with Business Intelligence, Product, Finance, Legal, and Commercial partners to deliver reliable integrations and self-serve solutions that drive business insights and operational efficiency.

What You’ll Own 💼

In this role, you will:

• Architect, build, test, deploy, and maintain scalable, automated ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, dbt, and orchestration tools such as Prefect and Airflow

• Administer and optimize cloud-based data warehouse and lake platforms, including Snowflake, AWS (S3, Redshift), and Google Cloud, integrating new sources and tuning for performance and cost

• Orchestrate data workflows with custom scheduling, alerting, dependency management, monitoring, and error resolution

• Design and maintain secure external data flows through SFTP, Files.com, and APIs, with a focus on reliability and compliance

• Automate manual reporting and operational tasks, building robust, reusable pipeline components that reduce operational overhead

• Partner with backend product engineers to optimize production database schemas with analytics use cases in mind

• Strengthen data quality, lineage, governance, and documentation practices across key data domains

• Mentor teammates and reinforce best practices in version control, code review, and structured workflow management

What Success Looks Like 📈

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

• Taken end-to-end ownership of core pipelines and integrations, with measurable improvements in reliability, data recency, and cost efficiency

• Automated high-effort manual workflows, reducing operational risk and freeing capacity for higher-value engineering work

• Delivered secure, compliant data integrations that stakeholders across the business trust for decision-making

• Strengthened observability across the platform, including monitoring, alerting, and incident response for critical data workflows

• Established yourself as a technical mentor and a go-to partner for Business Intelligence, Product, and cross-functional teams

About You ✨

You likely have:

• Expert-level proficiency in Snowflake, dbt, and Python for data modeling, transformation, pipeline development, and advanced analytics

• Advanced SQL skills for complex querying, large-scale data model design, and database optimization

• Proven experience architecting, building, testing, deploying, and maintaining scalable, automated ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools such as Prefect and Airflow

• Hands-on administration of cloud-based data warehouse and lake platforms, including Snowflake, AWS (S3, Redshift), and Google Cloud

• A strong understanding of secure external data flows through SFTP, Files.com, and APIs, with a focus on reliability and compliance

• Mastery of version control (Git, GitHub) and structured workflow management (Jira) for code review, audit trails, and operational transparency

• A demonstrated ability to automate and simplify complex manual tasks, building robust, reusable pipeline components

• Dependability, adaptability, and a collaborative approach to engineering, thriving in dynamic and ambiguous environments

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

• Hands-on experience in startup or rapid-growth environments, delivering technical solutions under shifting priorities

• A background supporting business intelligence, analytics, and data science teams through large-scale integrations and multi-tenant reporting

• Familiarity with both batch and event-driven ingestion paradigms, including near-real-time pipelines built on Snowflake, dbt, and Python

• Experience automating operational, financial, or compliance-driven workflows within cloud data environments

• Exposure to audit, privacy, and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO, and SOX, particularly in data governance and secure access controls

• Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare, healthtech, or SaaS

Why This Role Matters 🧡

Reliable data is the foundation of how Carrot operates, from the analytics that guide business decisions to the reporting our customers and partners depend on. The systems this role owns determine the accuracy, recency, and security of data used across the entire company.
As Carrot scales globally, the Sr. Data Engineer will make our data platform more automated, resilient, and cost-efficient, enabling teams across the business to move faster with data they trust. This work directly supports Carrot's mission of expanding access to fertility and family-building care worldwide.

Interview Process 🤝

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

• Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes

• Hiring Manager Interview — 30–45 minutes

• Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes

• Executive Leadership Conversation — 30 minutes

• Hiring Manager Wrap-Up — 15 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

• A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.

• A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.

• Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

• Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.

• Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
