value.text:
Qué buscamos
Buscamos Data Scientist para sumarse al equipo de Analítica Avanzada / Datos Retail de uno de nuestros clientes líderes en retail de moda (con decenas de tiendas propias y múltiples marcas), en modalidad híbrida en Santiago de Chile.
En este rol reportarás al Chief Digital Officer y trabajarás codo a codo con el Data Lead, Data Engineer y las gerencias Comercial y Logística para transformar tres decisiones operativas críticas del negocio en modelos optimizados de alto impacto: la previsión probabilística de demanda por SKU y tienda, la derivación dinámica de la curva óptima de reposición (mínimos y máximos) desde el centro de distribución, y la estrategia de precios con análisis de elasticidad e inferencia causal para optimizar el markup inicial y las rebajas de temporada. Todo esto sobre una plataforma de datos ya construida en arquitectura Medallion en producción con BigQuery sobre la capa Silver.

Responsabilidades:
Previsión de Demanda (Caso Base): Construir pronósticos probabilísticos por el grano donde haya señal real. Corregir la censura en los datos resolviendo el problema técnico central: separar la venta registrada de la demanda real ajustando por historial de stockout/quiebres. Desagregar de forma consistente mediante curvas de talla y color.
Optimización de Reposición: Derivar las curvas de stock mínimo (demanda esperada durante el lead time + ciclo de revisión) y máximo (utilizando cuantiles altos de la distribución) para que el stock de seguridad se ajuste dinámicamente a la incertidumbre.
Optimización de Precios & Inferencia Causal: Estimar elasticidad para alimentar el markup inicial y gatillar rebajas en temporada. Superar el sesgo de confusión causal en datos observacionales mediante el diseño y ejecución de experimentos/pruebas A/B en grupos comparables de tiendas.
El Loop de Medición: Generalizar y sistematizar la medición permanente del resultado operacional de las decisiones (días a nuevo quiebre, sell-through y stock muerto al final del ciclo de vida).
Aporte al Harness de IA: Especificar fórmulas determinísticas, intervalos y supuestos exactos para las herramientas (tools) que invoca la IA corporativa, garantizando que cualquier cifra generada por IA sea auditable y tenga respaldo.
Método y Comunicación: Definir protocolos estrictos de validación (partición temporal ciega, baselines explícitos, métricas adecuadas sin contaminación), documentar supuestos/límites y comunicar los resultados de forma clara a las gerencias Comercial y Logística.
Requisitos:
Forecasting Aplicado en Producción: Experiencia comprobable en modelos de series de tiempo en entornos de producción.
Demanda Intermitente: Dominio del tratamiento de series con alta presencia de ceros y conocimiento de alternativas cuando ARIMA/ETS fallan (Croston, TSB, agregación temporal).
Pronóstico Probabilístico: Manejo de cuantiles y distribuciones de probabilidad para la toma de decisiones con incertidumbre.
Validación Rigurosa & Métricas: Dominio de backtesting honesto y selección de métricas adecuadas.
Python & SQL Analítico: Python sólido orientado a código ejecutable por orquestadores y SQL avanzado para interactuar directamente con marts de decenas de millones de filas.
Comunicación & Criterio: Habilidad para traducir hallazgos técnicos a un lenguaje claro para usuarios de negocio, rigurosidad para medir con datos y capacidad de adaptación ante la reprioritización.
Será un plus:
Inferencia Causal & Diseño de Experimentos: Manejo de variables confusoras, controles, diseño cuasi-experimental y pruebas A/B a nivel de grupos de tiendas (tamaño de muestra, potencia).
Forecast Jerárquico & Reconciliación: Experiencia pronosticando a alto nivel y desagregando de forma consistente.
Optimización Matemática: Programación lineal/entera para la asignación de stock escaso.
Modelos Fundacionales & BigQuery ML: Uso de modelos pre-entrenados para series de tiempo (TimesFM o similares) o entrenamiento dentro del motor analítico en Google Cloud.
Dominio de Retail / Consumo Masivo: Comprensión de estacionalidad, temporadas, colecciones, curvas de talla, sell-through, markdowns y OTB.
Orquestación: Manejo de Dagster u otros orquestadores para la ejecución automática de modelos.

postings.title: AI-enabled Accountant
postings.descriptionText:
This is a full-time, remote position from Latin America.
About the Role
Our client is looking for a hands-on Accountant to own their accounting function end to end, leveraging AI and automation to make processes faster, more accurate, and more efficient than traditional accounting workflows.
In this role, you will manage day-to-day bookkeeping, lead the monthly close, prepare financial statements, and serve as the primary point of contact for external auditors. You will also take ownership of controller-level responsibilities, including cash flow management, vendor payments, and supporting accounts receivable collections.
You will work primarily through their internally developed accounting application, Book It, and Claude. Using Claude's existing skills and developing new ones, you will continuously improve accounting workflows, eliminate manual tasks, and strengthen internal controls.
You don't need to be a software engineer. They have already built an internal month-end close application that automates recurring journal entries, posts transactions directly to QuickBooks Online with supporting documentation, generates auditable balance sheet schedules, and verifies that balances reconcile to the ledger.
Your role is to operate and oversee these systems, validate their outputs, and identify opportunities to automate the next manual step.
If you've ever thought, "I could write a skill for this" halfway through a reconciliation, this role is for you.
Key Responsibilities
1. Accounting & Month-End Close
• Own and execute the monthly close process from start to finish using their internally developed application.
• Manage day-to-day bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online, including bank and credit card reconciliations, chart of accounts maintenance, and applying deposits to invoices.
• Upload and review monthly source files, including Carta reports, benefits carrier invoices, and payroll allocations.
• Review and approve proposed journal entries, ensuring accuracy before posting them to QuickBooks Online.
• Maintain supporting documentation and ensure all balance sheet accounts are reconciled and supported by accurate schedules.
2. Financial Reporting & Audit
• Prepare and issue monthly financial statements, including the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement.
• Provide concise monthly variance and flux analysis commentary.
• Support the preparation of quarterly investor reporting.
• Lead the external audit process, serving as the primary contact for auditors.
• Prepare audit PBC (Prepared by Client) schedules, supporting documentation, and respond to auditor inquiries.
• Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to streamline audit preparation and reduce adjustments.
3. Controller & Financial Operations
• Monitor daily cash balances and maintain a rolling cash flow forecast.
• Proactively communicate potential cash shortfalls and liquidity concerns to the COO.
• Manage the vendor payment cycle, including bill approvals, payment scheduling through Bill.com, and ensuring timely payments within cash constraints.
• Complete vendor onboarding requirements, including W-9s, banking information, insurance certificates, and supplier questionnaires.
• Support accounts receivable collections through aging reviews, payment reminders, and coordination with account management teams.
4. Specialized Accounting Operations
• Manage invoice factoring activities, including submissions, payment and reserve reports, fee accruals, and clearing entries.
• Use our internal accounting application to process and reconcile factoring-related transactions.
• Maintain accurate supporting schedules for prepaids, prepaid commissions, accruals, notes payable (including SBA EIDL and shareholder loans), stock-based compensation, and other balance sheet accounts.
5. AI & Process Automation
• Use Claude as a primary working environment to improve and automate accounting workflows.
• Own, maintain, and continuously improve existing Claude skills covering close procedures, balance sheet schedules, and factoring processes.
• Develop new reusable Claude skills and workflows whenever repetitive manual tasks can be automated.
• Maintain a prioritized list of manual processes, evaluating automation opportunities based on time savings, risk reduction, and operational impact.
• Partner with internal developers by translating accounting requirements into clear specifications, defining expected outcomes, and validating implemented solutions.
• Keep accounting procedures and documentation up to date as processes evolve.
How You'll Work
AI is central to this role, not just an additional productivity tool. You will use Claude to execute accounting workflows, develop reusable skills, organize financial information, and continuously improve how the accounting function operates.
Our approach is built around a few principles:
• Review, don't retype: Our internal application proposes journal entries and supporting schedules. You review, validate, and approve them rather than manually entering everything.
• Strong internal controls: Nothing gets posted without human approval. If a control cannot be verified, it blocks the close. You are responsible for confirming what actually landed in QuickBooks Online.
• Continuous improvement: When a task becomes repetitive, you look for opportunities to turn it into a reusable skill or automated workflow.
• Clear documentation: You maintain accurate, practical procedures that allow others, including non-accountants, to understand and follow the process.
• Collaboration with developers: You define what needs to be fixed or built, explain what the expected result should look like, and validate the outcome.
Tools & Technologies: Claude (Skills, Projects, and Connectors), QuickBooks Online, Google Sheets, Bill.com, Carta, BigQuery (read-only), Slack, and Asana.
What Success Looks Like
First 30 Days
• Complete one full month-end close alongside the team.
• Review existing accounting procedures and Claude skills.
• Identify and document all remaining manual steps in the accounting workflow.
• Begin taking ownership of bookkeeping and shadowing controller-level responsibilities.
First 60 Days
• Independently execute the monthly close.
• Improve or develop at least two Claude skills.
• Issue a complete set of monthly financial statements using the existing workflows.
• Take over day-to-day controller responsibilities.
First 90 Days
• Fully own the month-end close calendar and financial reporting process.
• Deliver the first automation improvement from the identified manual-process backlog.
• Develop and implement an audit PBC preparation plan.
First 12 Months
• Reduce the monthly close timeline from 20 business days to 5.
• Deliver a clean external audit with no material adjustments.
• Reduce post-close corrections quarter over quarter.
• Build and maintain a documented library of Claude skills that can be used to onboard future accounting team members.
Requirements
Must-Haves
• 4+ years of hands-on accounting experience, including ownership of the full monthly close process.
• Strong knowledge of US GAAP, including accruals, prepaids, revenue recognition, stock-based compensation, and notes payable.
• Experience preparing monthly financial statements and supporting external audits.
• Daily, practical experience using Claude or a comparable AI tool for accounting or financial workflows, with examples of how you've applied it.
• Experience creating at least one reusable Claude skill, project instruction set, or structured prompt workflow that others can follow.
• Advanced proficiency in QuickBooks Online and spreadsheets.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a highly detail-oriented and skeptical approach to validating AI-generated outputs.
• Ability to explain and substantiate financial figures and identify discrepancies before they become reporting issues.
• Strong written communication skills and the ability to document accounting procedures clearly.
Nice-to-Haves
• CPA certification or currently pursuing CPA licensure.
• Experience with invoice factoring or other receivables financing arrangements.
• Experience in ad-tech, media, or marketplace revenue accounting.
• Basic SQL knowledge and experience querying financial data in BigQuery.
• Familiarity with Claude Code, MCP connectors, or no-code automation platforms such as Make or Zapier.
• Previous experience as the first or sole accountant at a startup.
What This Role Is Not
• Not a software engineering position: You won't be expected to build or deploy applications. You will define accounting requirements and explain precisely how systems should work.
• Not accounting by prompting: AI helps you work faster, but you remain responsible for reviewing, validating, and approving every financial figure.
• Not a people-management role (yet): This is a hands-on individual contributor position. As the accounting function grows, the processes and skills you develop will help scale the team.

postings.title: Mobile Growth Manager
postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT US

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Mobile Growth Manager to take full ownership of monetization and retention for our AI LLM chat mobile app on iOS and Android. You will be accountable for how much revenue each mobile user generates and for how long they stay.

This is a senior, hands-on role with end-to-end ownership. You own the funnel from store listing to first session, trial, paid conversion, renewal and win-back. You decide what to test, what to scale and what to cut, and you are accountable for the results. We need someone who has grown ARPU and retention on subscription apps, who can run experiments quickly and independently, and who knows how to work within Apple and Google subscription rules.

You will manage performance against real revenue data (ARPU, trial-to-paid conversion, ROI D7, retention and cohorts), not vanity metrics. We also work AI-first, and we expect you to use Claude and automation to move faster.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own mobile growth end to end: from store page to paid conversion and renewal, across strategy, experimentation, launch, reporting and documentation.

 - Deliver a quarterly ARPU target on mobile (set against a measured baseline), through conversion, retention and perceived product value.

 - Own the paywall and pricing: offerings, packaging, trial and intro-offer structure, price tests by geo, and placement. Run them through RevenueCat or an equivalent.

 - Own onboarding and activation: shorten the path to the first moment of value and fix drop-offs in the first session and first week.

 - Build retention and win-back loops: push, in-app messaging, cancellation-save flows and involuntary-churn recovery (billing retries, grace periods).

 - Own store conversion: ASO, listing and screenshot tests, ratings and review prompts on the App Store and Google Play.

 - Keep web and app aligned: manage the web-to-app handoff and make sure subscribers get a consistent experience and entitlement across both.

 - Manage signal quality: subscription and in-app events, attribution and MMP data, and measurement under iOS privacy rules (ATT / SKAdNetwork).

 - Run a structured experiment process: own the mobile backlog, with a clear hypothesis, target metric and kill/scale rule for every test. Run the A/B tests end to end.

 - Review sessions daily: find friction, drop-offs and behavioural patterns, and turn them into backlog items.

 - Build the reporting: Mixpanel dashboards and a weekly report on mobile ARPU, trial conversion, ROI D7 on matured cohorts, 1-hour cancellation and retention.

 - Own policy compliance: keep paywalls, subscription disclosure, refunds and store listings within Apple and Google rules, with prevention-first checks before launch.

 - Prototype with AI: use Claude and automation for prototypes, analysis, QA and reporting, and ship the ones that work.

 - Diagnose drops and spikes quickly and act on them.

 - Document tests, learnings and playbooks.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS


MUST-HAVE EXPERIENCE

 - 5+ years in mobile growth, product growth or lifecycle roles on subscription apps.

 - Proven, measured ARPU, conversion or retention gains on a live subscription app, on both iOS and Android.

 - Strong understanding of subscription economics: trials, intro offers, renewals, LTV, payback windows and cohorts.

 - Hands-on paywall and pricing experimentation (RevenueCat, Superwall or similar).

 - Hands-on with Mixpanel or an equivalent: funnels, cohorts, custom boards.

 - Experience with StoreKit and Google Play Billing mechanics: grace periods, billing retries, refunds, cancellation flows.

 - Experience with MMPs (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Singular or similar) and with ATT / SKAdNetwork-era measurement.

 - Experience with push and in-app messaging tools and with building retention mechanics.

 - Working knowledge of ASO and store listing conversion.

 - Strong experiment discipline: hypotheses, sample sizing, readouts and clean decisions.

 - Daily use of Claude or other AI tools for prototyping, analysis and writing.

 - Ownership mentality: you run the funnel with minimal supervision and take responsibility for outcomes.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with AI or consumer-subscription products.

 - Experience with web-to-app subscription funnels.

 - Experience coordinating paid acquisition with product conversion, as a partner to a UA lead.

 - Experience working under strict platform policy (subscription disclosure, ROSCA-type rules).




LOCATION

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.




BENEFITS

 - Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.

 - Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.

 - Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.

 - Company-provided MacBook: Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.

 - Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Read more about it here: Independent Contractor Agreement
   
   https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1_mni_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab=t.0#heading=h.ndsdl4wapxtt

Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!




LIFE AT RUBY LABS

At Ruby Labs, we are more than a team; we're a community united in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation. Our combined passion fuels our ambition for excellence, driving impact that resonates around the globe.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that a diversity of thought and backgrounds builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, religion, color, place of birth, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military service status, or disability status. Join us and be part of a company that is crafting the future of technology across multiple industries.

Job Summary

¿Te gustaría formar parte de un equipo donde tu atención al detalle contribuya a que nuestros productos lleguen a destino de manera segura, correcta y a tiempo?

Como Operador de Warehouse , tendrás un rol clave en la preparación, control, movimiento y despacho de productos terminados, asegurando que los pedidos estén correctamente preparados y disponibles de acuerdo con la planificación establecida.

Formarás parte del equipo responsable de las operaciones de depósito y despacho en nuestra operación de Garín, Buenos Aires. • Preparar pedidos de producto terminado de acuerdo con las necesidades y prioridades de despacho.

• Realizar el movimiento, ubicación y traslado de productos terminados dentro del depósito y las áreas de Shipping.

• Verificar producto, lote, cantidad y condiciones de los materiales antes de su despacho.

• Realizar y registrar en SAP los movimientos correspondientes de acuerdo con los procedimientos establecidos.

• Mantener el orden y la limpieza de las áreas de trabajo, cumpliendo los procedimientos de Calidad, Inocuidad, Seguridad y Medio Ambiente (Q&EHS) y participando en inventarios, controles físicos y entrenamientos cuando corresponda.

• Conocimientos de SAP.

• Experiencia en el manejo de autoelevadores.

Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Ingeniero/a de Proyectos para sumarse al equipo de Proyectos, con el desafío de gestionar y ejecutar fases, subproyectos o alcances parciales de manera integral, asegurando el cumplimiento de los objetivos de alcance, plazo, costo, calidad y seguridad.

Gestionar y ejecutar las actividades de las fases, subproyecto o alcance parcial de trabajos asignados a su cargo de forma transversal e integral para garantizar el logro de los mismos en el plazo, alcance y presupuesto establecidos, apuntando a la seguridad del personal e infraestructura, la maximización del beneficio y la satisfacción del cliente; con el fin de contribuir al resultado global del proyecto.

Deal Enablement Call Coordinator
Level: Associate
Location: GDS, Buenos Aires
Role Summary
The Deal Enablement (DE) Call Coordinator coordinates required calls across the stages of the DE review process, including Approval Review calls.
The coordinator serves as the primary point of contact for scheduling, working with DE specialists, pursuit teams, approving reviewers, executive assistants, and other internal stakeholders to coordinate availability, track invitation responses, and confirm call completion. When DE specialists have scheduling conflicts, the call coordinator may provide backup support by attending calls and using Microsoft Copilot to capture discussion notes. The coordinator may also follow up on open items and ensure final documentation is provided to reviewers and DE specialists.
This role requires strong organizational and communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple reviews and competing stakeholder schedules in a fast-paced environment.
Key Responsibilities
• Monitor GEM+ and coordinate Approval Review calls once a required review has been identified and the appropriate approving reviewers have been assigned.
• Monitor review activity and navigate DE CRM as needed to support coordination and status tracking.
• Coordinate availability across pursuit teams, assigned approving reviewers, executive assistants, and other required participants.
• Prepare and send calendar invitations in accordance with established coordination procedures.
• Track assigned reviews and changes in schedules across the coordination process.
• Provide backup support to DE specialists by attending Approval Review calls, coordinating meeting logistics and capturing reviewer feedback as needed.
• When providing backup call support, use Microsoft Copilot and established prompts to capture key discussion points and prepare call notes.
• When providing backup call support, review call notes for accuracy and distribute them to the appropriate stakeholders following the meeting.
• Monitor approval status following the call and follow up with assigned reviewers when approval in the system remains outstanding.
• Communicate with pursuit teams, Approval Reviewers, executive assistants, and other stakeholders regarding scheduling, follow-ups, and review status.
• React to scheduling challenges, time-sensitive requests, outstanding approvals, or other coordination issues and escalate through established channels as appropriate.

• Follow established Approval Review coordination procedures and reviewer-specific scheduling practices.
• Work on Ad Hoc projects such as contacting teams with stalled opportunities, as needed.
• Work with DE team to manage workload, provide coverage, and respond to changing priorities.
• Identify recurring coordination challenges and opportunities to improve process consistency, efficiency, and stakeholder experience.
Skills and Attributes for Success
• Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple active requests and competing priorities.

• Strong attention to detail when managing calendars, meeting information, documentation, follow-ups, and status tracking.

• Confidence facilitating virtual meetings and communicating with stakeholders at varying levels of seniority.

• Ability to work collaboratively within a team and provide coverage as priorities shift.
• Proactive and service-oriented approach to supporting internal stakeholders.
• Comfort working with Microsoft Outlook, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot, and workflow and tracking tools.

postings.descriptionText:
IT Risk Management – BCM - Business Impact Analysis and Continuity Analyst



Today’s world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of almost 900 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets! Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team helps protect the EY brand and build client trust.

Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.


The opportunity

The role of the Business Impact Analysis and Continuity Analyst within Information Security-IT Risk Management is responsible for the administration of the creation, completion and management signoff of IT Business Continuity Management (BCM) and more general risk documents using established policies and procedures. You will also work on the ongoing cycle of periodic refresh and signoff of existing documents ensuring compliance with established standards and policies.


Your key responsibilities

The IT Risk Management BCM function creates and maintains business continuity management framework, processes, tooling, and strategy. Our primary objectives are to enable EY Technology to build a risk-aware culture, reduce IT risk, defend against internal and external threats, and protect client and EY data.

As an Associate in the ITRM BCM team,



• You will be required to work to existing policies and procedures and to handle exceptions to those policies with the agreement of the BCM team leader.


• You will be required to use existing precedents and procedures as a guide when making decisions,(for example, on the criticality of a process or system based on similar examples in other geographic locations), but may be expected to review this with an appropriate member of the management team before final signoff


• Solid understanding of key performance indicators relevant to the role


• Demonstrated skills in efficiently implementing agreed roadmaps and managing a work stream


• Able to work independently but with some supervision as required




Skills and attributes for success



• Understanding and exposure to risk management/BCM, preferably in a multinational environment.


• Flexibility to balance multiple work streams and adjust to change


• Ability to work and team with colleagues at different levels and across locations


• Ability to understand when to escalate to deal with potentially difficult situations


• Ability to understand and follow established policies and procedures


• A methodical and detailed approach


• Act within set guidelines and policies, with regular contact and oversight from the manager/supervisor. However, you will also be expected to have the ability to make initial decisions independently.




To qualify for the role you must have



• 2+ years of relevant experience in one or more of the following areas: information technology, Business Continuity, disaster recovery, IT risk management, or similar roles.


• An advanced degree in Computer Science, Information Security or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.


• One or more of the following or equivalent certifications: BCI Certified (Business Continuity Institute - AMBCI or MBCI), Certified Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC), Certified Information Systems Security Processional (CISSP) or Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)




Ideally, you’ll also have



• An operational understanding of ISO 22301, ISO 27001, ISO 31000


• Familiarity with local and regional regulatory requirements and how they impact IT policies


• Good appreciation of the business benefits of internal control and good risk management


• Working knowledge of cloud fundamentals (Azure, AWS, etc.)


• Proficiency in advanced reporting and data visualization tools, specifically PowerBI


• Experience with RSA Archer




What we look for

A self-starter, independent-thinker, with ambition to learn and desire to join a team of security and risk management professionals


What we offer

As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:



• Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.


• Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.


• Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.


• Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.



We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodations.

EY is committed to being an inclusive employer, and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

Make your mark.

Apply now.

postings.title: Geologo
postings.descriptionText:
Quiénes somos



AngloGold Ashanti es una compañía minera global de oro con una cartera diversificada de operaciones de alta calidad, proyectos y actividades de exploración en 10 países a lo largo de cuatro continentes. Buscamos constantemente oportunidades para crear valor a través de otros minerales, apalancando nuestros activos, habilidades y sólida experiencia en el sector.



En AngloGold Ashanti, aseguramos un entorno de trabajo significativo que genera resultados tangibles, entendiendo que nuestra labor trasciende la minería:





• Impacto Social y Económico: Construimos medios de vida en las comunidades, defendemos una gestión ambiental responsable y fortalecemos las economías tanto locales como nacionales.


• Cultura Colaborativa: Nuestros líderes y equipos están comprometidos con la escucha activa y el apoyo mutuo, valorando la diversidad y promoviendo la equidad en cada acción.


• Bienestar Integral: Estamos convencidos de que la excelencia solo se alcanza cuando priorizamos el bienestar de cada persona y fomentamos comportamientos basados en el respeto.





Sobre Cerro Vanguardia



Cerro Vanguardia es una empresa minera argentina dedicada a la exploración y tratamiento de oro y plata en la provincia de Santa Cruz. Desde 1998, funciona como un motor de desarrollo regional, promoviendo la explotación responsable de recursos y el crecimiento de comunidades como Puerto San Julián. Su misión se centra en generar valor para sus empleados y accionistas garantizando un ambiente seguro y protegido.



Conozca más sobre nuestra visión, propósito y valores - AngloGold Ashanti




Visión del puesto:

Contribuir a la eficiencia y calidad de las operaciones mineras mediante la planificación y supervisión de las actividades geológicas, asegurando el control del mineral desde su extracción hasta la alimentación a planta. La función implica coordinar proyectos de perforación, actualizar cubicaciones, controlar la dilución y realizar relevamientos geológicos, proporcionando información confiable para la toma de decisiones operativas y el aprovechamiento eficiente de los recursos minerales.

Propósito del rol:

Liderar y coordinar las actividades de geología de mina, garantizando el cumplimiento de los procedimientos operativos y estándares de seguridad. Asegurar el control de la calidad, movimiento y disponibilidad del mineral mediante la planificación de perforaciones, actualización de cubicaciones y seguimiento de las operaciones en campo.

Principales responsabilidades:

- Liderar y coordinar el equipo de trabajo, asegurando el cumplimiento de los procedimientos y estándares de seguridad.
- Planificar, desarrollar y realizar el seguimiento de proyectos de perforación.
- Actualizar cubicaciones y estimaciones de volúmenes de mineral.
- Realizar el control de dilución para contribuir a mantener la calidad del mineral extraído.
- Coordinar y ejecutar mapeos y relevamientos geológicos en campo.
- Controlar el movimiento y destino del mineral durante las operaciones.
- Supervisar y controlar la alimentación de mineral a planta.
- Analizar información geológica y generar reportes técnicos para la toma de decisiones.
- Coordinar actividades con las áreas operativas involucradas en la extracción y procesamiento del mineral.
- Identificar oportunidades de mejora en los procesos de control geológico y gestión del mineral.

Requisitos obligatorios:

- Título universitario de Geólogo/a.
- Experiencia superior a 5 años en posiciones similares dentro de operaciones mineras.
- Experiencia en planificación y seguimiento de proyectos de perforación.
- Conocimientos de cubicaciones, control de dilución y mapeo geológico.
- Experiencia en control de movimiento de mineral y alimentación a planta.
- Experiencia en liderazgo y coordinación de equipos de trabajo.
- Residencia en Puerto San Julián o disponibilidad para radicarse en la localidad.

Cualificaciones deseables:

- Conocimientos de software geológico Datamine y Leapfrog.
- Manejo de bases de datos geológicas.
- Inglés básico/intermedio.
- Liderazgo y capacidad de gestión de equipos.
- Capacidad analítica y orientación a resultados.
- Planificación, organización y resolución de problemas.
- Comunicación efectiva y trabajo en equipo.
- Proactividad y compromiso con la seguridad operacional.

Condiciones de la posición:

- Posición con personal a cargo: equipo de aproximadamente 10 colaboradores.
- Modalidad de trabajo bajo diagrama 5x2.
- Jornada laboral de 8:00 a 17:00 horas.
- Traslado al lugar de trabajo desde Puerto San Julián.
- Residencia requerida en Puerto San Julián, Santa Cruz, o disponibilidad para radicarse.
- Contratación efectiva.


Beneficios y Compromiso con el Colaborador y la Comunidad



Cerro Vanguardia prioriza la calidad de vida y el bienestar integral de sus colaboradores, ofreciendo iniciativas orientadas al desarrollo, salud, apoyo familiar y fortalecimiento del ambiente laboral. Entre las principales acciones se destacan programas de vínculo familiar, monitoreo ambiental participativo, asistencia integral al empleado, bienestar personal, asesoramiento técnico y gestión de liderazgo.



Además, la compañía brinda acceso a servicios especializados de salud, apoyo psicológico, nutricional y asesoramiento profesional para empleados y sus familias, reforzando su compromiso con un entorno seguro, colaborativo y sostenible. Los programas e iniciativas están sujetos a las políticas internas y criterios aplicables de Cerro Vanguardia.



Declaración de Igualdad de Oportunidades de Empleo



Estamos transformando la minería con una cultura de equidad, inclusión y respeto. Valoramos a cada persona y creemos que la diversidad de historias, ideas y perspectivas impulsa nuestro crecimiento.

postings.title: Sr. Revenue Operations Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
The Role We Need

PadSplit 's demand engine spans Marketing, Lifecycle, Member Acquisition, and Member Success, but no one owns how these teams connect once a lead is approved, leaving us blind to where members stall on the way to a move-in and unable to see which outreach actually converts. We need a Sr. Revenue Operations Analyst to own the last, most critical leg of the funnel: the calling and human outreach that turns an approved lead into a housed member, along with the reporting that makes the whole funnel legible. This role starts narrow (conversion and outreach) with room to expand into the broader Demand Growth function over time.

The Person We Are Looking For

We're looking for a builder-operator with 5+ years in revenue operations, growth operations, or funnel analytics, who is fluent in SQL or a BI tool like Hex, Mode, or Looker and has real instinct for calling operations, script testing, and agent coaching. This person uses AI daily to build reporting, analyze calls, and scale outreach, and has a clear point of view on where AI makes an ops team faster. They can hold many channels at once without losing the thread, and translate a messy funnel into decisions leadership can act on.

Here's What You'll Be Doing Day-to-Day:

• Optimizing call performance: Own how members convert across AI-driven calls and human phone calls, refining scripts, follow-up cadence, and objection handling.

• Coaching agents: Test what actually moves conversion and feed findings back to human agents and the teams they support.

• Sequencing hand-offs: Decide where AI calls hand off to a person and where a person hands off to Lifecycle.

• Building funnel dashboards: Maintain the end-to-end view of the demand funnel — lead to approved to booked to moved-in — primarily in Hex.

• Closing reporting gaps: Surface stage-by-stage conversion, drop-off, and velocity without re-deriving data each time.

• Driving retention outreach: Partner with Member Success to flag churn-risk changes and behavioral events, and proactively reach out before a member decides to leave.

• Standing up interventions: Launch retention and transfer offers as caller campaigns or lifecycle text messages.

• Fixing the stack: Bring order to lead routing, CRM hygiene, and experiment instrumentation, and set clear SLAs across Performance Marketing, Lifecycle, MA, and Member Success.

Here's What You'll Need to Be Successful:

• RevOps background: 5+ years in revenue operations, sales operations, growth operations, or funnel analytics, ideally in a marketplace, subscription, or high-volume consumer-sales environment.

• AI fluency: A strong AI toolkit used daily to build reporting, analyze calls, draft and test scripts, and scale outreach.

• Analytical rigor: Fluency in SQL or a BI tool such as Hex, Mode, or Looker, with comfort tying operational work to conversion, velocity, and cost.

• Funnel instinct: Real operating experience with lead routing, calling operations, script and cadence testing, and agent coaching.

• Cross-team coordination: Ability to hold many channels at once — from AI callers to affiliates to market launch — without losing the thread.

• Strong communication: Excellent English communication skills to work daily with US-based teams and partners.

• Marketplace experience (bonus): Background in marketplace, proptech, real estate, or two-sided consumer platforms.

• Zero-to-one experience (bonus): Track record standing up a RevOps or sales-ops function from scratch, including instrumentation and cross-team SLAs.

The Interview Process:

• Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by a human being in the PeopleOps department.

• If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a video call with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes.

• If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our VP of Member Growth for forty-five (45) minutes.

• If warranted, the final step would be a video panel interview with additional stakeholders for one (1) hour. For this interview, a candidate would participate in a campaign exercise to the panel for discussion.

• If warranted, then we move to contract!

Compensation

Compensation is based on the role's scope, national market benchmarks, the person's expertise and experience, and the impact of their contributions to our business goals.

Additional Information

Please note: Although the job posting says it's in Brazil, this is a fully remote position open to anyone in South America. This is a result of our Applicant Tracking System requiring a location to post the role on LinkedIn.

Quality assurance is central to that mission. By holding our advice to the highest standards, we build lasting trust with our customers. We make sure our advice is always clear, accurate and in their best interest. This is a place for people who embrace challenge, hold themselves to a high standard and use technology to do their work better. We celebrate those who bring passion, accountability and fresh ideas. At the heart of everything we do are our behaviours: care personally, challenge directly, put people first, keep exploring, love what you do, and always be accountable. If that sounds like you, we want you on the journey with us.

The Roles

Both roles assess mortgage advice and listen to calls. The Senior role does that and also leads the team. Every individual case assessment is made by an assessor using their own judgement. You will work in a small, dedicated team where your eye for detail and analytical skills are central to the integrity of our mortgage advice. Your assessments give us confidence that customers receive clear, accurate advice. Your insight helps us keep raising the standard.

Key Responsibilities

What Both Roles Do

•
Assess advice. Assess mortgage advice against our internal standards, the FCA Consumer Duty and the Conduct Rules, meeting the T&C Scheme sampling requirements. Listen to calls as part of every assessment.

•
Own your output. Complete your agreed monthly volume to the quality and turnaround standards set by the Operational Compliance Manager. Flag risks early.

•
Give clear feedback. Record every outcome with specific, evidence-based feedback that Mortgage Experts and Sales Managers can act on without re-listening or re-working the case.

•
Stand behind your decisions. Apply the scoring criteria consistently. Explain your reasoning in calibration and defend your decisions on appeal.

•
Drive improvement. Escalate compliance risks promptly, find the root causes, and highlight routine checks that could be automated.

How the Two Roles Differ

Customer Outcomes & Advice Quality Assessor (£35,000)

•
No line management. You focus on your own assessments.

•
Review ID&V referrals. Review Smartsearch referrals, decide what additional verification checks are needed, and escalate any PEP or sanctions list matches to Risk & Compliance.

Senior Customer Outcomes & Advice Quality Assessor (£40,000)

•
Line manage four QA assessors. Set objectives, track the team’s output against the monthly requirement, and raise people concerns with the Operational Compliance Manager and HR.

•
Spend about 70% of your time assessing , including the most complex and highest-risk cases.

•
Lead calibration and coach assessors. Make clear, defensible scoring decisions. Coach through feedback, side-by-side reviews and “check the checker” assessments.

•
Manage the appeals process. Appeals are decided by someone other than the original assessor, so the Operational Compliance Manager or another senior assessor decides any appeal against your own assessments.

•
Produce monthly MI. Analyse failure trends and recommend action.

•
Set the risk-based case selection approach. Prioritise high-risk cases and cover all advice areas in line with the T&C framework.

•
Support T&C oversight. Help the Operational Compliance Manager maintain the Adviser Competence framework and RAG status records, and advise where our QA framework needs to change.

•
Be the voice of QA. Represent QA with Operations, Sales and Risk & Compliance, and help shape tooling, process and the T&C Scheme.

Who We’re Looking For

You embody our behaviours. You are meticulous, self-driven and confident in your own judgement. You give direct feedback that builds trust between QA, Mortgage Experts and Sales Managers, and you work at pace without letting accuracy slip. For the Senior role, you are also a fair, supportive line manager who brings others with you.

Qualifications (both roles)

• CeMAP 1, 2 & 3 or equivalent.

• Hold, or be able to obtain, the competence status needed to assess advice and sign off assessments under our T&C Scheme.

Experience

•
Customer Outcomes & Advice Quality Assessor: A minimum of 2 years’ experience as a QA assessor in financial services, ideally in mortgage advice, with a track record of meeting volume and quality expectations.

•
Senior Customer Outcomes & Advice Quality Assessor: We would expect 3+ years as a QA assessor or QA lead in UK mortgage advice, or equivalent experience gained at Mojo. This must include line managing a team, leading calibration, handling appeals and coaching others.

Skills (both roles)

• Sound knowledge of FCA mortgage advice requirements, with the confidence to explain and defend scoring decisions on complex cases.

• Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy under pressure.

• Experience of, or appetite to learn, AI and automated tools, with the judgement to test their outputs.

• Comfortable with change.

• Intermediate proficiency in Google Sheets, Docs and Slides.

Additional skills (Senior role)

•
Expert FCA knowledge, including T&C, high-risk cases, vulnerable customers and conduct breach investigations.

• Strong analytical skills and the credibility to influence stakeholders at all levels of seniority.

Benefits

postings.title: Associate Director - Investments
postings.descriptionText:
This role is part of our Central M&A Team at saas.group .

What is saas.group ?
Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group , established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 380+ colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella.Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.
Also, don’t forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company.

Profile Overview
Our Investment Team deploys $50M+ of capital a year into niche, bootstrapped PLG software companies across North America and Western Europe. These are capital-efficient, founder-built businesses that most funds overlook because they are too small, too founder-owned or too unconventional. We see the opportunity, and we operate what we buy.
We're hiring an Associate Director, Investments to sit in the principal seat. You'll report to our Head of M&A, work alongside an existing Associate Director and have significant exposure to our C-suite. As deal captain, you qualify the opportunity, make the first offer, build the investment case, set the price, negotiate with the founder, run diligence and take the deal to close. You won't be building pitch books or playing a supporting role, and you won't wait years to lead a deal of your own. Your judgement decides where our capital goes.
If you bring the commercial diligence skills or deal instincts of a lower mid-market PE or M&A team, and you want to own outcomes rather than advise on them, this is your role. You'll work directly with founders, our C-suite and the operators who scale the businesses you buy.

Your impact in the first 6-12 months will be:

• Own early-stage qualification: take new opportunities from first call to a non-binding offer quickly, kill weak ones early and turn the strongest into IC-ready investment cases.

• Earn the trust of founders, our C-suite and the operating teams who will run the businesses you buy.

• Step in as deal captain on your first live transactions and drive them from LOI to signed SPA.

Your responsibilities

•
Capital allocation: Underwrite every deal you lead. Form a clear view on value, risk and returns, write the investment memo and defend your recommendation in front of our Investment Committee.

•
Qualification and offers: Qualify new opportunities fast, kill weak ones early and issue non-binding offers on the ones worth pursuing. You set the price and structure that frame the deal all the way to LOI.

•
Deal captaincy: Own the process end to end, from first call and non-binding offer through LOI, diligence and SPA to closing. You set the timeline, run the workstreams and own the outcome.

•
Commercial due diligence: Lead our in-house CDD. Size the market, map the competition, define the right to win and get to the truth on quality of revenue: retention, concentration, pricing power and the durability of growth.

•
Financial and commercial modelling: Build models from a blank sheet: ARR bridges, cohort and retention analysis, unit economics, scenarios, valuation and returns.

•
Negotiation: Lead negotiations with founders and their advisors on price, structure and key terms, landing deals that work for the seller and for our returns.

•
Diligence leadership: Run the full DD process across internal experts (finance, tech, product, marketing, legal, people) and external legal, financial and tax advisors, and turn their findings into decisions.

•
Stakeholder leadership: Represent saas.group to sellers, brokers and advisors, and work hand in hand with our C-suite, leadership and the operators who take over after closing.

•
Coaching: Develop the junior members of the team as a hands-on player-coach.

What You bring to the table

• 6+ years of professional experience after university, with a strong track record in transactions, strategy or both.

• Training at a top-tier firm or team in one or more of:

•

•
Private equity: lower mid-market transactions, typically sub-$10M EBITDA, ideally in software or tech-enabled services.

•
Strategy consulting: MBB (McKinsey, BCG, Bain) or leading strategy firms such as Roland Berger, Oliver Wyman, Kearney, L.E.K. Consulting, OC&C, Simon-Kucher or Arthur D. Little.

•
Big Four strategy and deals: Strategy& (PwC), EY-Parthenon, Deloitte (Monitor Deloitte / M&A) or KPMG Deal Advisory, especially in commercial due diligence.

•
Corporate development / in-house M&A: ideally at a high-velocity aggregator or buy-and-build strategic.

•
Investment banking: M&A advisory at mid-market or tech-focused boutique banks, ideally on lower mid-market transactions with enterprise values below $50M.

•
An investor's mindset: you think like an owner, form a point of view quickly and back it with numbers.

•
Live deal experience: you know what it takes to get a deal over the line, and ideally you've led workstreams or been the day-to-day deal lead.

•
Excellent financial modelling and valuation skills: you build from a blank sheet and can defend every assumption.

•
A player-coach approach: you have experience developing junior talent and enjoy doing it.

•
Real commercial due diligence experience: market sizing, competitive analysis, customer and expert interviews, and quality-of-revenue work.

•
Presence: you can negotiate with founders selling their life's work and hold your ground with the C-suite and advisors.

•
Rigorous project management: you keep multiple parties, timelines and documents moving without dropping the ball.

• A genuine interest in software and SaaS business models. A software background is an advantage but not a requirement.

• Fluent English, written and spoken; additional European languages are a plus.

•
Real AI fluency and the drive to put it to work : you already use AI tools (Claude especially) day to day and look for ways they can speed up research, analysis, modelling and diligence workflows.

What’s in it for You

•
Principal seat, real ownership: You'll lead deals and allocate capital as a principal, not an advisor, then watch the companies you bought grow inside our portfolio.

•
Deal flow and exposure: $50M+ deployed every year across two continents, with direct access to our C-suite and Investment Committee from day one.

•
Ultimate flexibility: We’re 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.

•
Freedom and autonomy: We’re a high-trust team, and you’ll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way — with plenty of help from the team when you need it.

•
Minimum bureaucracy: We don’t like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.

•
Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.

•
Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally.

•
Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.

We don’t just simply offer you to “take a job with us” but rather to “join us on this journey” to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.
Sounds like something you’re up for? Feel free to apply even if you don’t check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!

—

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. postings.title: Solutions Architect
postings.descriptionText:
We're hiring a Solutions Architect to design the systems behind the products Bolder Apps builds for US-based clients. You'll be the technical lead in the room from the first discovery call. You'll turn a client's idea into an architecture, a scope and a plan our engineering team can build. This is a design and review role, not a coding seat. You won't write production code. You'll guide the dev team, review their code and architecture, and own technical quality from kickoff to launch, so what ships matches what was designed. Our projects cover web, mobile and AI products. Many have multi-tenant setups, lots of third-party integrations and real privacy and security needs. This is a contract role, paid hourly and fully remote. It is open to people based in the countries listed in this post, with overlap into US Eastern time for client calls. If you've designed and shipped client products at an agency or consultancy, and you can explain a trade-off to a founder as clearly as to an engineer, we want to talk.
About Us
Bolder Apps is a product development studio that partners with US-based startups and established companies to build and scale innovative digital products. We specialize in AI-powered development, full-cycle product creation, and engineering team augmentation. Our mission is simple: build bolder, faster, and smarter.
Our Culture & Values (read before applying)
We move fast. We take ownership. We work with AI, not against it. And we expect everyone to bring ideas, not wait for instructions.
There are no daily checklists, no micromanagement, and no corporate politics. Instead, you'll have autonomy, trust, and a team that's always ready to help you grow. At Bolder Apps , impact matters more than titles, and curiosity matters more than seniority.
If you want a place where you can level up fast and actually see your work making a difference - welcome aboard.

Responsibilities

• Lead technical discovery with clients. Ask the right questions, find the real constraints and turn a rough idea into a clear solution design

• Design the system architecture for web, mobile and AI products. Services, data model, hosting and how the pieces talk to each other

• Write the technical parts of proposals and scopes of work. Modules, user flows, acceptance criteria, edge cases and estimates the team can stand behind

• Design integrations with third-party APIs and vendors. Plan for retries, queues, webhooks and monitoring, and keep a clean way to swap a provider later

• Plan multi-tenant and white-label setups with proper data isolation and access control

• Build security and privacy in from day one. Encryption, audit logs, consent, data residency and the evidence clients need for an outside audit

• Design AI and LLM features for client products, including model choice, retrieval (RAG), guardrails and the evaluations that prove quality in production

• Plan in phases. Ship a lean MVP first and keep the design ready for the full build without a rewrite

• Work with sales and project managers on scope, timelines and risk. Push back early when something will not fit

• Review the dev team's code, pull requests and technical approach. Catch drift from the design early and explain what to change

• Guide and unblock engineers, set technical standards, and own technical quality through delivery and handover

• Keep the architecture docs current so anyone on the team can pick up the context

Requirements

• 5+ years in software engineering, with at least 2 years designing systems as a solutions architect, technical lead or similar

• Agency, consultancy or studio background. You've designed for several clients at the same time and you can switch context without losing quality

• You've owned the architecture of client products that went live with real users. Diagrams that never shipped don't count

• Strong backend and data fundamentals. You've designed APIs and relational data models (Postgres or similar) and you know where they break

• Cloud architecture experience on AWS, Azure or GCP, including containers, deploys and monitoring

• Real integration design experience. Third-party APIs, webhooks, SSO and OAuth, background queues and failure handling

• Hands-on AI architecture. You've designed LLM or RAG features with evaluation for production client products, and you know what they change about cost, latency and testing

• Strong code and architecture reviewer. You can read a pull request, spot when it drifts from the design and explain the fix to the engineer

• Comfortable running client-facing technical calls. You can explain a trade-off to a non-technical founder in plain words

• You write clear technical scopes with estimates the team actually hits

• AI-augmented workflow. You use AI tools every day in your own design, review and writing work

• Excellent written and spoken English. Clients read your documents and hear your voice directly

• Available for live client calls during US Eastern business hours

Nice to have

• Multi-tenant SaaS, row-level security or white-label deployments

• Products with strict privacy or compliance needs, such as sensitive personal data, data residency rules or third-party security audits

• Mobile architecture (React Native or Flutter)

• Comfortable reviewing TypeScript and Node.js (NestJS or similar) and React or Next.js code

• E-commerce platforms such as Shopify

• Mentoring engineers and setting technical standards for a team

Benefits

• Contract role, paid hourly, fully remote, with overlap into US Eastern time for client calls

• A wide mix of web, mobile and AI products for the US market

• Steady pipeline of client work as part of a growing team

• Real ownership over technical design, with no rigid playbook

• Direct line to decision-makers, no extra layers between you and the people who own the outcome

• A peer network of engineers, designers and PMs working on overlapping projects

At MagicLinks , we believe social video is magic. As leaders in creator marketing, we partner with leading retailers and consumer brands to build creator programs that drive awareness, commerce, and long-term growth. Backed by more than a decade of experience in the creator economy, we've built proprietary creator intelligence and deep YouTube expertise to help brands connect with the right creators, optimize campaign performance, and stay ahead as consumer discovery continues to evolve.

The Opportunity

If you're excited by executive-level conversations, complex deals, emerging technology, and the opportunity to help shape the future of creator commerce alongside a collaborative, high-performing team, we'd love to meet you!

What You’ll Own
This is a full-cycle enterprise sales role where you'll own the entire client journey—from opening doors with enterprise brands to building long-term strategic partnerships that drive measurable business impact.

You will:

• Build trusted relationships with senior marketing leaders and create new opportunities within enterprise brands

• Lead strategic conversations around creator marketing, commerce, measurement, AI, and the evolving digital media landscape

• Achieve revenue targets while maintaining accurate forecasts

• Grow existing partnerships while continually expanding your portfolio

• Partner cross-functionally with Campaign Operations, Client Success, Product, and Leadership to deliver exceptional client experiences

• Represent MagicLinks at industry events and executive meetings

The Person We’re Looking For

• You have 3-6 years of experience in influencer marketing, the creator economy, social platforms, digital media, retail media, commerce, or marketing technology

• You have a proven track record of building pipeline, winning enterprise business, and succeeding in a full-cycle, quota-carrying sales role

• You have experience selling into complex organizations and building relationships from marketing managers to executive leadership

• You understand influencer measurement beyond impressions. You can comfortably speak to brand building, incrementality, attribution, retail outcomes, and long-term business impact.

You’ll Thrive Here If…

• You’re naturally curious

• You’ve earned credibility because clients trust your thinking. Not because you have the loudest pitch or the most outbound e-mails

• You read industry news because it makes your heart sing

• You follow creators because you’re fascinated

• You experiment with AI because you know it’s changing shopping behavior

• You ask better questions than your competitors

• You're energized by building new business and comfortable navigating ambiguity

• You move with urgency, maintain high standards, and enjoy solving complex challenges

• You don’t wait for perfect information before taking action

• You're collaborative, accountable, and bring an ownership mindset to everything you do

• You care deeply about your teammates’ success as well as your own

• You love to win!

Total Rewards

• Comprehensive healthcare package for all full-time employees

• 401K with a Company Match

• Unlimited PTO + 14 Company Holidays (including your birthday off!)

The provided salary range is base salary, exclusive of commission potential and is a good faith estimate of cash compensation. MagicLinks is flexible pending candidate's experience and how our business needs evolve throughout the search. Every employee of MagicLinks receives equity on top of cash compensation.

A Few Words on Diversity

We're equally committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in our workplace and in how we show up in this world. To us, diversity means recognizing that different views and experiences are as important as those we're already familiar with. It means taking radical ownership of the things we affect as individuals and as a company - including even inherited ways of doing things which may be destructive or biased and which we must work to change. It means looking at the world and making sure we embody as many of its best qualities as we can, and striving for that as a matter of principle, not as a marketing goal we check off a list.

This is how we strive to practice: We define diversity as making sure (1) our table represents people from varying backgrounds, (2) inclusion as making sure our people have a seat at the table, and (3) equity as making sure our people have the same means to get to the table in the first place. Externally, we apply the same policies to partnerships, marketing, and product development.

Ultimately, diversity goes beyond what we look like, who we are, who we love or how we think. Diversity is shorthand for an integrity-driven way of operating and growing every single day, and we wouldn't have it any other way.

postings.descriptionText:
Ready to Build the Team Behind a Brand Families Love?
At Hadley Designs , we believe that learning should be enjoyable, engaging, and screen-free. Millions of parents and teachers trust our beautifully designed, developmentally aligned educational tools to help children grow and thrive. As a fast-growing, family-founded brand, we are on a mission to make learning meaningful for families around the world.
We are seeking a Director of Recruiting to own how Hadley Designs finds, vets, and closes the growth operators and future leaders who will carry our next phase of growth. If you treat recruiting like a growth problem, love being the face of a brand to candidates, and want the autonomy to run the whole engine, this role is for you.

About Hadley Designs

Hadley Designs is redefining early education with creativity and purpose. Every product we create is hand-drawn and teacher-designed, crafted with care to build confidence and connection. Our screen-free tools help families and teachers make learning fun and meaningful, nurturing curiosity and creativity in children.
Our mission is to design screen-free products that parents can trust to help their children learn, grow, and reach their full potential. Our vision is to build the most trusted children's brand in the world, present in millions of homes, reshaping how families learn, connect, and grow.

Role Overview
As our Director of Recruiting, you will own how Hadley Designs sources, vets, and closes top talent for every open role, from Amazon and ecommerce operators to senior leaders. You will design and run the recruiting engine that consistently delivers a strong top of funnel, put every candidate through a process that shows who they really are, and bring our leadership only the people worth their time.
This is a leadership-tier role with end-to-end ownership of recruiting, from the pipeline to the right people joining our team. A recruiting administrator handles the busy work, so your time goes to meeting candidates, sourcing them, and finding new ways to reach great talent. You will run first-round interviews, including for director-level roles, manage our outside recruiting partners to our standards, and be the face of Hadley Designs for every candidate, so you need to be great on camera and great with people.

Key Responsibilities

• Recruiting pipeline management. Source candidates outbound and inbound across LinkedIn, Workable, job boards, online communities, referrals, and your own network, and filter applicants for red flags, competency match, and alignment with each role profile.

• Test project and interview operations. Run our Culture Index step, case studies, and first-round interviews, review submissions, and manage the candidate experience end to end, including for the people we do not hire.

• Sourcing channel optimization. Manage and optimize sourcing channels based on performance, and build "always hiring" shortlists for recurring high-leverage roles.

• Outside recruiting partners. Manage our agency partners so every candidate they send follows the same process, and hold them to our terms.

• New talent channels. Find creative new ways to reach great people, especially in the online communities where they already spend time.

• Employer brand and reviews. Monitor and manage Glassdoor and Indeed reviews, organize team review drives, ask for feedback, flag issues, and protect our rating.

• Hiring metrics and funnel reporting. Deliver weekly hiring pipeline reports broken down by channel and role, and track funnel performance against KPIs.

• Reference checks. Run reference checks, by phone for leadership roles.

How Success Is Measured

• Average time to fill open roles under 45 days

• 250 or more qualified applicants per active role per week

• Weekly hiring pipeline report by sourcing channel, 100% complete and on time

• 15 or more completed candidate case studies available for review per role per week

• A Glassdoor company rating of 4.5 or higher across the year, with Indeed tracked beside it

• An interview and recruiting experience candidates rate highly, including the people we do not hire

Requirements

Who You Are
You are a recruiting-strong, systems-oriented leader. You have personally closed difficult hires, not just managed a team that did. You move fast in a sourcing pipeline, you can run a structured interview that lands the right read on a candidate in 30 minutes, and you are as comfortable pitching a role on camera as you are defending the company on Glassdoor. You look at people the way a growth marketer looks at growth, and you want the autonomy to run the whole engine.

You Have

• 3 to 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally in remote or ecommerce organizations; agency recruiting experience is a big plus

• A proven track record of hiring across marketing, operations, Amazon, ecommerce, product, and leadership roles

• Confidence and presence on camera, and comfort representing a brand to candidates

• Experience running structured interviews, test projects, and case studies

• Outbound sourcing experience, and expert-level LinkedIn and Workable skills

• Real creativity in tapping online communities to find talent in unusual places

• AI capability, a CRM and documented SOPs. You use AI every day to get more done with less, which is a must-have here and a capability rather than any one tool, and you have a clear view of how all three make recruiting faster and better now and going forward

• Strong writing ability, from clear job posts to compelling outreach and direct candidate communication

• The ability to handle 5 to 10 active roles at a time with no drop-off in process

• Experience building and running reporting for hiring metrics

• Experience managing outside recruiting agencies

Benefits

Why You'll Love Working Here
Your work will directly impact how families experience learning through the Hadley Designs brand. You will join a passionate, mission-driven team that values trust, creativity, and collaboration, with the freedom of a remote role and flexible working hours.

• Remote-first work environment

• Paid time off and holidays

• Access to learning resources and professional development

• Free access to Hadley Designs products

• Regular interaction with leadership, including the CEO

• Stability from more than a decade as a family-founded, mission-driven brand

Our Hiring Process
Every candidate completes a Culture Index assessment and a case study before interviews. For this role, reference checks are done by phone.

Apply Today
If you are ready to build the team behind a brand that is shaping the future of learning, apply now to join Hadley Designs as our Director of Recruiting.
P.S. If you don't hear from us within four weeks of your application, please consider that as our decision to move forward with other candidates, but we truly appreciate your interest in Hadley Designs .

We are looking to expand our software engineers, seeking those with deep rooted entrepreneurial spirit. Success looks like production code live in customer environments, customer teams able to extend it on their own, and a wider partnership with each account.
Our serverless platform is a multi-tenant monorepo — Next.js and React on the front, tRPC and Prisma behind it, deployed on SST, TypeScript throughout. One engineer can follow a change from a form field to the database without crossing a team boundary. That's the point.
Engineering at Bask Health is AI-first and builder-led. Work starts with general understanding of problem, moves to tools like Claude and Cursor for further investigation, making a plan and building, tested on staging with realistic data, released to production, tested with real patient and care teams, and then back for systems and polish. AI is a default part of how we work, not a side experiment — because moving fast in healthcare requires every advantage.
We are looking for engineers who take end-to-end ownership, treat AI as a real collaborator, and care deeply about building software that meaningfully improves how healthcare is delivered.

What You'll Do

•
Design, build, and ship high-quality product experiences. Own key surfaces end to end, from concept through production. Write elegant, well-tested code — we have a real test suite and we intend to keep it that way.

•
Work across the stack. Follow a feature from the interface through the API to the database. No handoffs, no waiting on another team.

•
Work AI-first with Cursor and Claude Code. Use LLMs as your starting point. Draft intent, explore implementations, scaffold components, and refactor with AI in the loop. Apply your own judgment to meet the quality bar healthcare demands.

•
Prototype fast and validate with real users. Build and test quickly with real patients and care teams. Use what you learn to refine before fully committing — especially in sensitive clinical contexts where getting it right matters.

•
Build for scale and own the codebase. Translate product needs into reusable, well-architected patterns that make the next feature faster to ship.

•
Make automation legible and trustworthy. Build systems that clearly communicate what AI and automation are doing on behalf of patients and providers. Earn trust through transparency, reliability, and thoughtful defaults.

•
Champion performance, accessibility, and reliability. Ship work that is fast, robust, and accessible. Partner across the team to debug, optimize, and raise the bar over time.

•
Share AI-native workflows. Document prompts, patterns, and workflows that work, so we move faster together without cutting corners that matter to patient outcomes.

We are a highly collaborative team.

Requirements
A full-stack generalist who has taken a product from 0 to 1 and can apply that instinct inside a system that already has real patients on it. Entrepreneurial, willing to roll up their sleeves, and drawn to a mission that disrupts how healthcare gets delivered.

• 3+ years of experience

• You are dangerous on the frontend of the stack.

• You are a highly skilled dev (React, TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind and JavaScript).

• You also have backend skills (tRPC, Drizzle ORM, SQL, Node, SST).

• You can work independently and are comfortable owning entire projects or large areas of the codebase.

• Strong experience building paid products and services is preferred.

• React Native or Expo experience is a plus.

• You are a strong communicator, able to clearly articulate technical problems, constraints, and timelines.

• You are comfortable working in a fast-paced, unstructured, startup environment.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience building and maintaining production messaging solutions that deliver notifications across multiple channels, including SMS, email, voice, and mobile push.
