This role sits on our own internal team.

Your Role
This is lead generation pointed at people instead of customers. You'll work across many different roles and industries, and every search starts with two questions: who is this person, and what would actually make them reply? If you've done lead gen or marketing, it's the same muscle you already have. You research an audience and write messages that convert, except here a conversion is a great candidate writing back.
A lot of what you'll source for is marketing and creative work: creative strategists, paid media, performance, growth, and data roles. So if you come from a marketing or agency world, you already understand the people you're reaching and what they care about. You figure out where the right people are, write the outreach, post the role so the right people see it, and improve based on what actually gets responses. Some recruiters treat this as the boring first step of hiring. We think it's the most interesting part, and it's most of this job. No recruiting experience needed. You'll be mentored while you learn the talent side, and you'll have real tools, including a dedicated sourcing platform and AI, to do it at scale.

You'll:

• Research each new role to understand who the ideal candidate is and where to find them

• Write and personalize outreach, then test subject lines and openers to lift reply rates

• Post and promote roles so the right people actually apply

• Review incoming applicants and shortlist the ones worth talking to

• Use AI and sourcing tools to work through a large volume without losing the personal touch

You Bring

Bonus Points

1️⃣ Apply, including a short outreach exercise

4️⃣ Final conversation with the team

Location As an Analytics Engineer, you will join the Business Intelligence team within Business Systems Engineering, a group of several teams that builds and runs the systems the company operates on. This role is based remotely in Mexico or Colombia as a full-time employee or in other LATAM locations as a contractor, with working hours that overlap meaningfully with US time zones.

Who We Are DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.
Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.
With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity
Our governed data platform is a core part of how DoiT operates, with hundreds of Do’ers relying on it every month. We are growing the team that builds and runs it, and we’re looking for an Analytics Engineer to help carry it forward.
You will work as an engineer on the data platform, not just a builder of reports. You are the kind of person who is averse to doing the same manual task twice, who treats data models like production code, and who instinctively adds tests and monitoring so problems are caught before anyone else sees them. You will own a meaningful share of the platform’s day-to-day engineering, which lets our analysts stay focused on analysis and lets our larger platform initiatives get the sustained attention they need.
This is a high-ownership role with real room to grow. You will work closely with our BI analysts and engineers and with partners across the business, reporting to the Head of Business Intelligence.

Responsibilities

•
Shared ownership of the platform's engineering : routine model changes, the engineering backlog, new data source onboarding from raw ingestion to certified datasets, CI/CD maintenance, and infrastructure operations. This is a full-ownership role, not a narrow lane.

•
Build, test, and maintain data models and pipelines that power dashboards, finance and investor reporting, and our AI analytics layer, across 15+ business domains including Finance, Sales, Customer Experience, Marketing, Product, and HR.

•
Manage data infrastructure as code. Provision and configure BigQuery datasets, views, GCS buckets, and IAM permissions through Terraform. This includes onboarding ingestion destinations, managing access controls, and handling schema drift on source tables.

•
Own data access and governance. Own and continue expanding our RBAC implementation — extend the access control framework as new domains and consumers come online, keep data catalog metadata (tier, domain, owner, PII tags) current, and keep documentation up to date.

•
Improve platform reliability by strengthening testing standards, observability, and alerting, so issues are caught early rather than reported by users.

•
Support orchestration and scheduling. Understand how Airflow DAGs run dbt builds (daily, hourly, monthly), tag models so they land in the right schedule, and troubleshoot build failures in Cloud Composer.

•
Build and maintain custom data connectors. When a SaaS source isn't covered by a native Fivetran connector, write and maintain Python-based Fivetran SDK connectors — including pagination, rate limiting, error handling, and automated tests.

•
Partner with BI analysts to turn ambiguous questions into well-modeled, trustworthy datasets, and help raise the team's engineering practices through code review and shared standards.

•
Use modern AI tooling to draft code and accelerate routine work, amplifying your output rather than adding manual effort.

Qualifications

•
Analytics engineering experience. 3–5 years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI engineering, with a track record of delivering data models that other people depend on.

•
Strong SQL and data modeling. You write, read, and optimize complex analytical queries, reason about grain and joins, and design clean, layered models with sound judgment about where logic belongs (staging, business logic, consumption layer).

•
dbt / Data transformation proficiency. You've built and maintained dbt projects professionally — packages, macros, incremental strategies, snapshots, seeds, and CI/CD. You've implemented staging → intermediate → mart patterns and understand deferred builds, state comparison, and slim CI.

•
Software engineering discipline. Version control, code review, automated testing, and CI/CD, with the habit of making changes safe to ship. You have a strong drive to automate repetitive manual work.

•
Pipeline reliability instincts. You debug data issues to their root cause, and you think about freshness, volume, duplicates, and late-arriving data before they become incidents.

•
Business translation. You translate business needs into data requirements, work with non-technical stakeholders (including Finance), and push back constructively when a request is better solved a different way.

•
Multi-repo comfort. Our data platform spans several repositories (transformation, data infrastructure, orchestration, custom connectors, foundational cloud resources). You're comfortable navigating across these boundaries rather than treating dbt as the whole world.

•
AI-assisted development. Proven track record of using AI coding tools in your daily workflow.

•
Remote ownership. Independence in a remote, global team, with clear written communication and the discipline to document your work.

•
Fluent English. Both written and spoken; knowledge of any other language is an advantage.

Bonus Points

•
Our stack. Hands-on experience with Google BigQuery, Fivetran, and Apache Airflow (Cloud Composer); or an AWS/Azure equivalent.

•
Data catalog and governance tooling. Experience with a data catalog (for example OpenMetadata) or data observability tooling (for example Elementary).

•
Git-based CI/CD for data. Experience with CI/CD workflows for data projects — branch-based deployments, slim CI, Docker image builds, and automated plan/apply cycles.

•
Terraform for data infrastructure. You've provisioned BigQuery datasets, IAM bindings, or GCS buckets with Terraform.

•
Python for data integration. You've written Python that talks to REST APIs — pagination, rate limiting, error handling.

•
dbt build lifecycle fluency. You understand how dbt compiles Jinja into SQL, how run/test/snapshot phases chain together, and you've written macros beyond basic ref() and source().

•
BigQuery performance tuning. Experience with partitioning, clustering, incremental strategies, and reasoning about slot consumption and query costs for large datasets.

•
Docker and Kubernetes. Our dbt builds run in containers on GKE. Experience with Docker images and basic Kubernetes concepts (pods, logs, deployments) helps when debugging pipeline issues.

•
Pre-commit hooks and code quality automation. Experience with SQLFluff, pre-commit frameworks, or custom validation scripts.

•
SaaS source system familiarity. Prior experience modeling data from CRM, support, project management, marketing automation, or ERP platforms.

Are you a Do’er? Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.
We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

About SecurityScorecard :
SecurityScorecard is the global leader in cybersecurity ratings, with over 12 million companies continuously rated, operating in 64 countries. Founded in 2013 by security and risk experts Dr. Alex Yampolskiy and Sam Kassoumeh and funded by world-class investors, SecurityScorecard ’s patented rating technology is used by over 25,000 organizations for self-monitoring, third-party risk management, board reporting, and cyber insurance underwriting; making all organizations more resilient by allowing them to easily find and fix cybersecurity risks across their digital footprint.
Headquartered in New York City, our culture has been recognized by Inc Magazine as a "Best Workplace,” by Crain’s NY as a "Best Places to Work in NYC," and as one of the 10 hottest SaaS startups in New York for two years in a row. Most recently, SecurityScorecard was named to Fast Company’s annual list of theWorld’s Most Innovative Companies for 2023 and to the Achievers 50 Most Engaged Workplaces in 2023 award recognizing “forward-thinking employers for their unwavering commitment to employee engagement.” SecurityScorecard is proud to be funded by world-class investors including Silver Lake Waterman, Moody’s, Sequoia Capital, GV and Riverwood Capital.

About the Role:
We're starting a new engineering team, and its job is to change how SecurityScorecard builds software. You'll be one of the first people on it.
The team works out how a company our size should ship code now that agents can write most of it. That means real work on the codebase: running agentic coding workflows end to end, finding where they break, building the tooling and guardrails that fix those breaks, and turning what works into the way the rest of engineering operates. We'll pick product areas to test against as we go. Over time the team takes on real product ownership and folds back into the wider engineering org.
We want strong engineers who went deep on AI coding because they couldn't leave it alone. You know how production systems fail and you've pushed agentic tools far enough to know where they still fall short. You also care about building a team you'd want to work on, and you'll stick around after the novelty wears off.
This is greenfield. You'll report to our CTO or to an engineer leading the team, and the reporting lines will move as the team grows. If titles and org charts matter a lot to you, this role won't be a good fit. We care about execution and impact.

What you'll do

• Run agentic coding workflows on production code and find out what actually holds up at our scale

• Build the tooling, guardrails, evals and review practices that let agents ship code we trust

• Design systems that stay sound when most of the code is written by agents, and decide where humans need to stay in the loop

• Ship real changes to our products, using them as test cases for the new way of working

• Pair with engineers across the org, review their work and help them adopt what we learn

• Raise the hiring bar: interview candidates and help decide who joins the team

• Write down what we learn so other teams can use it without us in the room

• Design, build, and ship customer-facing AI-powered product features using TypeScript, Go, and AWS, owning quality and reliability end-to-end

• Architect and implement agentic workflows, LLM pipelines, and intelligent automation that help customers surface faster, more actionable security insights

• Integrate foundation models into existing product surfaces with a practical eye toward latency, cost, output quality, and evaluation

• Use AI-native development tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.) as a core part of your workflow, setting the standard for how this team builds

• Lead architecture and code reviews with a focus on production-grade reliability, security, and maintainability

• Own projects end-to-end from concept through production, including monitoring, iteration, and improvement post-launch

• Stay current with the AI tooling and foundation model landscape and bring relevant advances into our roadmap and practices

Required Qualifications:

• 10+ years building and shipping production software, with a track record at strong engineering companies (big tech, high-growth startups, or both)

• Evidence that you drove things. We want the people who set the direction on their teams, not the ones who rode along.

• Deep computer science and system design fundamentals. You can design a distributed system on a whiteboard and explain how it fails.

• Heavy, hands-on use of AI coding tools on real codebases, with opinions about what works and what doesn't

• Experience building with LLMs: agents, tool use, evals, prompt, and context design

• Proficiency in TypeScript and strong backend engineering fundamentals

• Comfort with ambiguity and a team that changes shape. You'll help define the job as we go.

• Experience designing and operating distributed systems in cloud environments (AWS preferred)

• Hands-on experience with CI/CD, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and production deployment practices

• Clear, direct communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Our tech stack
TypeScript / JavaScript, Go, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL

How we interview:
Expect a system design round, a coding exercise where you're expected to use AI tools, and a deep dive into a project you led, including how you used AI on it. We'll ask follow-up questions until we understand the decisions you made and why.

Location and compensation:
Remote. We're hiring across United States, Canada, and Latin America.
Benefits:

Specific to each country, we offer a competitive salary, stock options, Health benefits, and unlimited PTO, parental leave, tuition reimbursements, and much more!
Actual compensation for the position is based on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to affordability, skills, qualifications and experience, and may vary from the range. In addition to base salary, employees may also be eligible for annual performance-based incentive compensation awards and equity, among other company benefits.

• For candidates based in U.S. locations, the estimated total compensation range for this position is $350,000-$400,000 USD, all base salary. This role also includes a substantial equity grant on top of cash compensation.

• For candidates based in Canada, the estimated total compensation range for this position is $400,000-$500,000 CAD, all base salary. This role also includes a substantial equity grant on top of cash compensation.

The Product
The platform helps hospitals automate supply room monitoring and inventory management. Fixed cameras and AI continuously track supplies in storage areas and update on-hand counts in real time. Drafter / Takeoff Specialist – Commercial Roofing, Cladding & Architectural Sheet Metal

Role Overview
We are looking for detail-oriented Drafters to produce shop drawings and material takeoffs for commercial roofing, cladding and architectural sheet metal projects. Your takeoffs jump-start procurement so Project Managers can review, finalize and release material orders months before field measurements are available. We welcome candidates with experience in roofing, cladding, or sheet metal, or any combination of these. Candidates will be matched to project types based on their background.

Workflow

• Project is awarded and handed off from estimating to the PM.

• Drafter prepares shop drawings and completes the initial material takeoff from the same set, working primarily from contract/architectural drawings (DWG/PDF).

• Takeoff is reviewed with the team; Project Managers review and finalize before any order is placed.

• Takeoff/cut list is delivered to the PM as an organized Excel sheet (plus Autodesk layout exports where useful) so materials can be released to external suppliers.

• Turnaround is set per task and project scope. Tasks can range from a few hours to multi-week drawing sets.

Key Responsibilities

• Takeoffs: Perform quantity takeoffs from architectural and engineering drawings. Roofing: square footage, membrane (e.g., TPO/PVC), insulation board counts, fasteners, edge metal, flashing. Cladding and sheet metal: panel counts and lengths, clips, trims, flashing, coping, master-sheet optimization for ACM/MCM, and linear footage for field roll-forming.

• Cut lists & orders: Build supplier-ready cut lists and order data in Excel or via Autodesk export, following the templates and examples provided.

• Shop drawings: Produce shop drawings, roof plans, panel layouts, elevations and details in AutoCAD; mark up in Bluebeam.

• Review & release: Walk takeoffs through with the team, incorporate PM feedback, and release materials once finalized.

• Quality: Verify quantities against drawings, engineering, manufacturer specifications and local codes before release.

Requirements & Qualifications

• Experience: Drafting experience is the core requirement. An experienced superintendent / senior superintendent who has installed systems and done their own takeoffs is also a strong fit.

• Industry knowledge: Experience in commercial roofing, cladding, or architectural sheet metal (one or more) is preferred but not required. Experience in both roofing and cladding/sheet metal is a plus. Must read architectural drawings and understand material limitations (e.g., trims, panel widths, sheet optimization).

• Technical skills: Proficiency in Autodesk/AutoCAD (team uses 2025) and Bluebeam (or Adobe Acrobat Pro); strong Excel skills.

• Core attributes: High attention to detail, accuracy under deadlines, and ability to manage multiple projects at once.

• Communication: Clear written and verbal English for working with Project Managers and the wider team.

Tools, Equipment & Device Requirements

• Software seats: A license/seat will be provided for every program required for the role (e.g., Autodesk/AutoCAD, Bluebeam).

• Own device: If working on a personal computer, it must be able to run AutoCAD and Bluebeam reliably. Devices will be checked against the specifications below during screening.

• Monitors & accessories: Candidates must provide their own dual-monitor setup and associated accessories (keyboard, mouse, headset with microphone, webcam, cables/docking).

Schedule & Work Arrangement

• Employment type: Full Time

• Days: Monday through Friday

• Working hours: US business hours, Central Time (9:00 AM–5:00 PM CT; 8:00 AM–4:00 PM CT also acceptable)

Benefits of Working for Hyre

postings.descriptionText:
Company Overview:
Our client is a small, founder-led consumer brand based in Austin, TX, that makes a regulated nicotine product (tobacco-free pouches) and sells it direct-to-consumer in the UK. Because Meta, Google, and TikTok all prohibit nicotine advertising, there is no ad budget this company can spend to buy growth — every channel that's left (search, owned email and SMS, subscription retention, referral, retail and trade, athlete and podcast partnerships, field sampling) has to be built and wired together by hand. That constraint is the whole shape of this job.

Your Role:
This role exists because the easy version of growth marketing isn't available here — someone has to build the campaign machinery, not just brief it. You'll spend real time each week directing Claude Code to connect APIs, enrich lists, and automate recurring work, and the rest of your time running campaigns alongside the people actually knocking on doors: sales, field, and partnerships. You report directly to the two founders, at manager level, fully hands-on, with no reports of your own (headcount comes later, if at all). Success looks like a trade and partnership outbound engine that runs itself, a field team that's armed and getting better each cycle, owned channels (search, lifecycle, retention, referral) doing the growth work that paid acquisition can't, and numbers everyone can actually trust.
A note on the category: this is a regulated product, and the rules aren't style guidance — they're hard constraints on the job itself. No health, cessation, or performance claims anywhere, ever. Age and territory gating (18+, UK only) stays intact, full stop. No paid social or paid search for the product, no workarounds. Nothing overstated in writing. If that reads as a limitation on the work rather than the actual shape of it, this isn't the right seat.

You'll:

• Build and run the trade and partnership outbound engine — define the segment, pull and enrich the list, verify and score contacts, write and track the sequence, and know when not to use a sequencer (some outreach has to go out by hand)

• Arm the field team (sampling, shop visits, trade shows) with target lists, routes, one-pagers, and post-visit follow-up sequences, then work alongside them so the next version is better

• Own the channels that are actually open here: search and content, lifecycle email and SMS, subscription retention (win-back, dunning recovery, pause-instead-of-cancel), and referral programs, including the reconciliation behind them

• Produce creative in-house with AI tools against the brand's existing visual system — knowing when to generate, when to composite a real product shot instead, and when to send a piece to a human

• Automate anything manual and recurring — enrichment scripts, list hygiene, report pulls, campaign QA, content pipelines — instead of adding it to someone's checklist

• Own first-party measurement (order and subscription data, cohort retention, referral attribution, search visibility), since no ad platform is feeding this business conversion data, and flag a bad number before anyone else finds it

You Bring:

• Real, hands-on experience directing Claude Code (or an equivalent coding agent) on live work — connected to an API or MCP server, shipping something still in use today. This is the one non-negotiable requirement on this list, and it's tested directly in the interview process; nearly everything else here is trainable

• 3+ years hands-on in marketing — the profile that fits typically started in a coordinator-type role, got tired of waiting on others to pull data or wire up tools, and taught themselves to do it

• Cold outbound you've run yourself, start to finish: built the list, wrote the sequence, watched the reply rate, fixed deliverability when it broke, using Apollo or an equivalent plus at least one sequencer

• Comfortable with data — you read a CSV without flinching, write SQL or get there with help, and know why a bad join can quietly double your numbers

• Working scripting ability in Python or JavaScript (or a track record of directing AI to write and debug it while keeping it honest), and you use git

• APIs are ordinary to you: auth, keys, rate limits, webhooks, and reading docs to find the endpoint you need

• A genuine eye for marketing — you can tell a good offer from a weak one, spot a broken page, and write an email a retail buyer will actually answer — and you write plainly, in specific, filler-free sentences

Bonus Points:

• Experience with this kind of stack: list/enrichment tools (e.g. Apollo), sequencers, a commerce/subscription backend, Postgres/SQL, transactional email, SEO tooling, workflow automation (e.g. n8n), and AI image tools

• Background marketing in a regulated or high-constraint category (alcohol, supplements, pharma, gambling, or similar), where claims review and compliance shape every campaign

• DTC subscription or ecommerce experience, especially retention/win-back programs and referral mechanics

What’s Offered:

• Based in Austin, TX, or remote with 9–5 CT overlap

• Direct reporting line to the two founders — high visibility, real ownership, minimal layers

• A hands-on, builder-first seat: you ship the work yourself rather than briefing someone else to

• Real autonomy over a growth stack built on search, lifecycle, retention, referral, trade, and field — not ad spend

• The chance to help build out the company's own agent and automation stack from the ground up

• Compensation based on experience and location — to confirm with the client before this goes to candidates

Interview Process:

About RAB2B

•
RAB2B is a global B2B marketing agency that partners with ambitious brands to drive measurable growth. We combine strategic thinking, media excellence, and operational rigor to deliver integrated solutions across markets. Our culture is built on accountability, clarity, and performance — empowering our teams to lead with ownership while collaborating across disciplines.

About the role

RAB2B is growing its data practice into a service clients buy in its own right. The Data Director sets its direction and leads the team that delivers it.

The role owns how data creates commercial value across the agency: the strategy, the capability roadmap, the offerings taken to market, and the narrative that persuades a client to invest. The Data Director partners with media, account and performance leadership as the person accountable for what data makes possible, and sits with client marketing leaders as the person who explains what their investment produced and what it should fund next.

The practice serves enterprise B2B clients across technology, manufacturing and healthcare, delivering measurement, reporting and dashboarding on a modern cloud data stack. Its next phase centers on advanced attribution and incrementality, marketing mix modeling, AI-assisted measurement and a portfolio of commercial data offerings.

This is a builder’s mandate. The Data Director carries end-to-end authority over the data discipline — strategy, capability, commercial offerings and team design — with the latitude to set the practice’s direction and the accountability that comes with it.

What you'll do

1. Commercial leadership of data

• Define the commercial strategy for data at RAB2B : what we sell, to whom, at what price and with what proof.

• Develop monetizable data products and services that grow client accounts and create agency revenue. Shape and price them jointly with media, account and finance leadership, against a shared target for what they produce.

• Partner with business and client leads to identify high-value data use cases across existing accounts and new logos, then deliver them.

• Present investment recommendations (data sources, partners, platforms, licenses) to the executive team, with the business case behind each one.

2. Data strategy and capability

• Build the capability roadmap and align the organization behind it: the methods, the stack, the sequence and the investment each stage requires.

• Lead the move past campaign reporting into multi-touch attribution, incrementality testing and marketing mix modeling, including a clear view of where each method holds and where it breaks.

• Build on the team’s early adoption of AI-assisted measurement: decide where AI belongs across the practice, scale what already works and set the standard for the discipline.

• Identify the data sources and partners worth acquiring, and negotiate the terms.

3. Client-facing leadership

• Embed data across the commercial cycle: pitches, RFP responses, strategic planning, media activation and effectiveness measurement.

• Translate complex data into actionable insight and a commercial narrative that moves a CMO to act.

• Own the measurement conversation in the room: model the path from media investment to pipeline, qualified opportunity and closed revenue, and defend that model under scrutiny.

• Raise client ambition through insight, storytelling and thought leadership.

4. Standards, team and organization

• Own the standards by which the practice operates — measurement frameworks, taxonomy, data governance and reporting quality — and hold the discipline to them.

• Build and lead a cross-functional team of data strategists, analysts and technologists, and define the shape that team takes as the practice scales.

• Partner with the MarTech and Digital Experience teams, who own tagging, consent, CRM and marketing automation, so the data the practice reads and sells is trustworthy.

• Make the case for data internally and build agency-wide fluency in what the practice offers.

Qualifications

• 8+ years in data strategy, analytics or data-driven marketing, with progressive leadership responsibility across teams and client relationships.

• A track record of building or scaling a data capability inside an agency, holding company or consultancy.

• Commercial fluency: experience shaping offerings, defending pricing and contributing to revenue, not only to delivery.

• Depth across paid media measurement (search, social, programmatic, partner media) and web analytics.

• Hands-on experience designing and defending advanced measurement — multi-touch attribution, incrementality testing and marketing mix modeling — and a clear rationale for choosing one method over another.

• Command of the modern data stack: SQL, a cloud warehouse (BigQuery preferred) and visualization tools such as Looker Studio, Tableau or Power BI.

• Executive presence: able to hold a room of client executives, answer hard questions under pressure and influence decisions.

• Fluent professional English: US client leadership, RFP defense and agency-wide written communication.

• Daily use of AI in their own work, and a considered view of where it belongs in an analytics practice.

• Remote, based in LATAM. Works on US client hours. Able to travel to the United States as needed.

Preferred

Streamkap , Inc. is an industry-leading technology firm developing cutting-edge distributed systems and streaming solutions. We are committed to providing robust and efficient data processing platforms. We are seeking an experienced Senior Streaming Engineer to join our talented team and help us build and maintain state-of-the-art streaming pipelines.

Job Responsibilities:

• Design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance streaming pipelines using Kafka, Flink, Debezium, and other related technologies.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams at Streamkap , Inc to gather requirements, define data models, and implement streaming solutions that meet business objectives.

• Optimize existing streaming pipelines for performance, fault tolerance, and reliability.

• Develop and implement data validation and monitoring strategies to ensure data quality and pipeline stability.

• Troubleshoot and resolve data processing issues in a timely manner.

• Maintain up-to-date documentation for data processing workflows, architecture, and data models to facilitate knowledge sharing and collaboration within the team.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

• A minimum of 3 years of senior-level experience in Java development, specifically in the context of distributed systems and streaming technologies.

• 3-5 years of experience working with Kafka, Debezium, distributed systems, and stream processing technologies.

• Proven experience in designing, building, and maintaining streaming pipelines.

• Strong understanding of distributed systems concepts and architecture.

• Proficient in at least one programming language such as Java, Scala, or Python.

• Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

• Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.

Streamkap , Inc is an equal-opportunity employer and values diversity in its workforce. We are committed to providing an inclusive work environment and encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.
To apply, please submit your resume, a cover letter detailing your experience with the required technologies, and any relevant project samples or portfolios to . We look forward to reviewing your application and exploring the possibility of welcoming you to the Streamkap , Inc team.

postings.title: VP of New Business
postings.descriptionText:
Real ownership from day one, not check-ins and micromanagement. That's what the VP of Client Servicesrole at Nortal looks like.

What working with us looks like

• Remote work with a LATAM team. Coffee breaks, tech talks, and games keep it human, even at a distance.

• No micromanagement. We hire for autonomy and expect you to use it.

• Support beyond the job. Our People Care team helps with time off, wellness, and anything in between.

• Our accounts team handles client relationships, so you focus on the work.

What you get

• Competitive USD salary.

• Full remote work, with coworking spaces across LATAM if you want to meet the team in person.

• Paid time off under your country's rules, at full salary.

• National holidays.

• Sick leave, no stress attached.

• A yearly refundable credit. Spend it on anything related to your health and well-being.

• A day off for your birthday.

About this search
Great talent doesn't wait for job postings, so we don't either. We're building a network of skilled professionals for roles that come up regularly with our clients.
Join our Future Talent network and you'll be one of the first people we reach when the right opening appears. We make around 160 hires a year, so it happens often.

The role
As a VP of Client Services, you will own a new-logo quota in the US. You'll design and run the strategy to attract new opportunities, build a network of US technology buyers, and take each deal from first conversation to signed contract.
Your day-to-day: Win new business in the US

• Own and hit a specific new-logo quota in the US market.

• Prospect directly into CTOs, CIOs, COO, VPs of engineering, and product leaders at US mid-market and enterprise companies.

• Run the full sales cycle: discovery, solution shaping with architects, proposal, pricing, SOW, and contract negotiation.

• Close new logos and agree a clear plan for the first project.

Build a US network

• Build and keep a network of US technology and business leaders.

• Travel to the US regularly for client meetings, industry events, and conferences.

• Use your network, events, and partners to get warm introductions.

Design the demand strategy

• Think, design, and execute the strategy to attract new opportunities: target segments, accounts, channels, and messaging.

• Work with BDRs and marketing to align efforts, warm up target accounts, and increase inbound and outbound pipeline.

• Partner with the Growth team to find new levers for company growth.

Improve conversion

• Build a strategy to raise conversion at each stage of the funnel, from first meeting to signed deal.

• Review lost and stalled deals, find the patterns, and fix them.

• Keep the CRM current and the forecast accurate, and tell leadership early when a deal is slipping.

Expand current clients

• Spot growth potential in our current portfolio: new relationships inside existing clients and new service lines to sell them.

• Work with Client Services so expansion deals are coordinated, not duplicated.

What we're looking for

• 5+ years in a similar new business sales role at a technology company (IT services, software engineering services, or digital consulting), selling to US clients.

• A record of closing new logos, with deals you can describe in detail: the client, the problem, the deal size, and how you won it.

• Experience selling nearshore delivery models (staff augmentation, dedicated teams, project-based work) and knowing when each fits.

• Experience designing a go-to-market or demand strategy, not only executing one.

• Comfort leading C-level and VP conversations with US buyers.

• A genuinely social profile: you enjoy meeting people and building relationships that last.

• Availability to travel to the US on a recurring basis.

• Advanced English Level is required for this role, as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons. 

How the process works

• Apply and upload your resume.

• We review your profile and add it to our talent database.

• We reach out for an interview to learn about your experience and share more about what we're looking for.

• When a role opens that fits, we contact you to start the process. Because we already know you, it moves faster.

• No intermediaries. You deal with us directly.

About Nortal

For over 25 years, we've built the systems that global enterprises and public institutions run on. Today, that means using AI and data to help organizations make better decisions, not just build what they asked for.
We believe good solutions don't have to be complicated. That's why our clients trust us with the initiatives that matter most.
Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement. If that's what you're after, apply now. 👇

postings.descriptionText:
Senior Software Engineer (ReactJS)
Important: This role is open only to candidates currently living in Mexico or Latin America . Applications from other regions will not be considered.
Join MagmaLabs , a leading provider of expert software engineers dedicated to helping companies achieve their goals across diverse and impactful industries. We are actively seeking a seasoned Senior Software Engineer (ReactJS) to join our fully remote team.
In this pivotal role, you will apply your expertise in modern frontend and full-stack development to build scalable, high-performance web applications. You will collaborate with clients across healthtech, e-commerce, fintech, and other innovative sectors, delivering robust and intuitive user experiences powered by ReactJS and modern web technologies.
You will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable frontend architectures while contributing to backend integrations and full-stack solutions that directly impact business success.

About the Role
Are you a seasoned Senior Software Engineer (ReactJS) passionate about building modern, scalable, and high-performance web applications?
Join our fully remote team and take ownership of designing and developing sophisticated frontend systems while contributing to full-stack architectures. You will shape the future of our products by making key architectural decisions that enhance user experience, performance, accessibility, and long-term scalability.
You will drive engineering best practices, ensuring our SaaS platforms, e-commerce systems, and high-traffic applications maintain exceptional quality, performance, and maintainability.
If you thrive on solving complex problems using ReactJS, modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems, and cloud-native technologies, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

• Lead the architectural design, development, and continuous improvement of scalable frontend applications using ReactJS and TypeScript.

• Design and implement reusable, maintainable, and testable UI components following modern design patterns.

• Collaborate on full-stack implementations, integrating frontend applications with RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs.

• Ensure optimal application performance, accessibility (WCAG standards), and cross-browser compatibility.

• Contribute to backend integrations and server-side logic (Node.js or other backend technologies as required).

• Optimize application performance using modern techniques such as code splitting, lazy loading, memoization, and performance monitoring.

• Ensure code quality through automated testing (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress or similar).

• Participate in code reviews, maintain high engineering standards, and mentor junior engineers.

• Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

• Contribute to DevOps practices including CI/CD pipelines, Docker-based workflows, and cloud deployments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

• Maintain clear and comprehensive technical documentation.

• Proactively identify technical debt and lead refactoring initiatives to improve scalability and maintainability.

Requirements

• Minimum of 7 years of software development experience, with at least 4–5 years focused extensively on ReactJS and modern frontend ecosystems.

• Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript.

• Deep understanding of ReactJS fundamentals, hooks, state management patterns, and component-driven architecture.

• Experience with state management solutions (Redux, Zustand, Context API, or similar).

• Solid understanding of frontend architecture patterns and scalable project structure.

• Experience integrating with RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs.

• Working knowledge of backend technologies (Node.js preferred) and full-stack development principles.

• Strong understanding of HTML5, CSS3, responsive design, and modern styling solutions (Styled Components, TailwindCSS, CSS Modules, etc.).

• Experience with version control systems (Git) and collaborative workflows.

• Familiarity with automated testing strategies and testing frameworks.

• Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum, Kanban, etc.).

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in a remote-first environment.

• Excellent English communication skills (written and spoken).

• Proven ability to collaborate effectively across time zones and distributed teams.

Bonus Points If You Have

• Experience with Next.js or other React-based frameworks.

• Knowledge of server-side rendering (SSR) and static site generation (SSG).

• Experience with microfrontend architectures.

• Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).

• Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or infrastructure-as-code.

• Understanding of performance monitoring tools and observability practices.

• Exposure to design systems and scalable component libraries.

• Experience contributing to technical leadership or architectural decisions in high-growth environments.

About Us
We are a team of innovative software professionals dedicated to delivering high-quality solutions across diverse industries. With a proven track record of success, we prioritize excellence, creativity, and the continuous growth of our team members.
We are committed to professional development, mentorship, and fostering a culture of technical excellence. Join us to work on impactful projects, collaborate with talented engineers, and advance your career as a Senior Software Engineer (ReactJS).

postings.title: GSCC | Senior Digital Campaigner - Global Shipping
postings.descriptionText:
This position is with the Global Strategic Communications Council (GSCC), a global network of communications professionals in the field of climate, energy and nature. GSCC is a programme hosted by the Meliore Foundation.

You’ll be a key member of the Shipping Team within GSCC’s Transport Theme. As Senior Digital Campaigner - Global Shipping , you will lead on translating strategic objectives into impactful integrated campaign strategies, using insights, experimentation, and cutting-edge tactics to engage priority audiences where they’re consuming content, news and media, and influence specific audiences.

You will be on the forefront of developing and executing regional digital strategies to reach our target audiences where they are: policy-makers in Africa, Europe and South America, as well as the global industry. You will combine creative vision with analytical rigour to ensure our campaigns are not just seen, but drive impact.

How you'll contribute

1. Campaign Strategy & Execution

• Design and deliver integrated digital strategies that align with campaign goals, audience insights, and organisational priorities.

• Partner with campaigners, comms specialists, and creatives to translate messaging into high-impact digital plans.

• Ensure campaigns are timely, targeted, and adaptable to fast-changing political and cultural moments.

2. Insights & Analytics

• Develop audience segmentation and targeting strategies informed by research, data, and behavioural insights.

• Monitor campaign performance in real time, optimising creative, messaging, and channel mix for maximum impact.

• Produce clear insights reports that drive decision-making and learning across the organisation.

3. Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration

• Work closely with policy, advocacy, and media colleagues to ensure message discipline and coordinated rollout.

• Brief and manage external agencies, media partners, and content creators.

• Present strategies, insights, and recommendations to senior leadership and partners.

4. Testing & Innovation

• Lead the testing of new media channels, formats, and partnerships, from influencer collaborations to podcast partnerships, programmatic media plans and fully integrated campaign strategy.

• Champion a test–learn–iterate culture in the digital team, embedding best practices for experimentation.

• Track emerging trends and tools, making recommendations for adoption where they can increase reach or influence.

Our ideal candidate has

To succeed in this role, you will have the below qualities:

• Proven experience in campaign strategy and digital campaigning, advocacy, or marketing, ideally with an issues-based or political focus.

• Proven experience managing teams within a complex organisational matrix

• Strong grasp of audience targeting, integrated media strategy, and analytics tools (e.g. Google Analytics, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, programmatic platforms).

• Demonstrated ability to plan, execute, and evaluate multi-channel campaigns.

• Skills in A/B testing, message and creative testing, and adapting strategies based on results.

• Experience in influencer collaboration, new media partnerships, and/or developing thought leadership networks.

• Experience in managing agencies, vendors and 3rd party suppliers

• Excellent storytelling and copywriting skills tailored for digital audiences.

• Ability to work in dynamic teams and thrive in fast-paced, reactive campaign environments.

• Knowledge of political landscapes, advocacy campaigning, or movement-building.

• Familiarity with social listening and insights analysis.

• Experience running direct media buys with news publishers.

• Comfort working across multiple time zones and cultures.

• Fluency in written and spoken English, our working language; additional knowledge of Spanish and/or French is a bonus.

Why join us?

• Be part of a remote-first, international network of professionals working on climate, energy and nature and work with a bunch of dynamic, culturally diverse individuals who combine their passion to make a difference with a rigorous and results-oriented approach to work.

• 6 offline days (with no calls or meetings) per year to focus on your work

• Reduced working time on Fridays during the Dry Season (summer)

• Access to our employee assistance program to support your mental health and personal development

• Supplementary paid business closure for end-of-year holidays

• Maternity leave matched to 20 weeks for countries where regulation allows less than that

• Enjoy regular opportunities to connect and collaborate with colleagues around the world

• A full-time position with an employment or consultant contract, subject to location, for 12 months, with possible renewal after one year.

Location: Australia, Europe, LATAM, Africa, the UK

Some international travel will be required. We may be able to provide co-working spaces in some locations. Only candidates with the right to work in their location will be considered.

Contract and Benefits disclaimer : Contract type and some benefits may vary by jurisdiction. We will confirm eligibility and the applicable terms during the hiring process.

Salary / Fee: Meliore sets compensation levels through a systematic alignment with local market data, taking into account the responsibility level of each role or the expected level of services and the skills and experience of the selected candidate. We apply a consistent, equitable, compensation policy, and provide data on our calculations and pay or fee ranges, in all locations where we operate. Our compensation practices reflect our commitment to fairness, inclusion, and accountability, and are regularly reviewed to ensure alignment with evolving market standards and organisational values.

postings.title: Senior Microsoft Dynamics GP Consultant
postings.descriptionText:
Role Summary
The Senior Microsoft Dynamics GP Consultant serves as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert for clients utilizing Microsoft Dynamics GP (Great Plains) across a variety of industries. This role is responsible for providing functional consulting, application support, troubleshooting, solution design, and business process optimization for Dynamics GP and related third-party applications.
Working directly with clients, the consultant will help resolve complex business and system challenges, recommend best practices, support upgrades and enhancements, and ensure clients maximize the value of their Dynamics GP investment. This is a highly client-facing role requiring strong consulting skills, deep Dynamics GP expertise, and the ability to build trusted relationships with stakeholders across finance, operations, sales, customer service, and leadership teams. In partnership with Deel’s recruitment platform, we are seeking a Senior Microsoft Dynamics GP Consultant based in LATAM for a remote Contractor of Record (COR) or Employer of Record (EOR) engagement. Candidates must be available to work during EST or CST business hours.

Position Responsibilities

Dynamics GP Consulting & Client Advisory

• Serve as a functional expert for Microsoft Dynamics GP, providing guidance and recommendations to clients across multiple industries.

• Analyze business requirements and translate them into effective Dynamics GP solutions.

• Lead solution design sessions, business process reviews, and system optimization initiatives.

• Assist clients with system enhancements, upgrades, module implementations, and process improvements.

• Recommend best practices that improve operational efficiency, reporting accuracy, and data integrity.

• Build and maintain strong client relationships by providing exceptional service and trusted advice.

Application Support & Issue Resolution

• Provide advanced functional support for core Dynamics GP modules, including Financial Management, Distribution, Inventory, Purchasing, Sales Order Processing, Project Accounting, Fixed Assets, Payroll, and Field Service.

• Troubleshoot complex application, transactional, and configuration issues.

• Investigate and resolve data discrepancies, posting errors, reconciliation issues, workflow challenges, and integration-related concerns.

• Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end processes.

• Coordinate with technical consultants and developers as needed to identify and resolve system issues.

Business Process Optimization

• Evaluate existing client processes and identify opportunities for improvement.

• Configure Dynamics GP to support evolving business requirements.

• Support workflow automation, approval processes, and operational efficiencies.

• Help clients improve reporting capabilities, data quality, and system adoption.

• Assist with documenting business processes and future-state recommendations.

Third-Party Applications & Integrations

• Support and troubleshoot third-party applications commonly integrated with Dynamics GP, including SalesPad and other ISV solutions.

• Assist with integration troubleshooting between Dynamics GP and external business systems.

• Advise clients on configuration options, process impacts, and best practices when utilizing integrated applications.

• Coordinate with software vendors and client stakeholders as needed to resolve issues and implement agreed enhancements.

Training, Documentation & Knowledge Sharing

• Deliver user training and knowledge transfer sessions for clients.

• Create and maintain functional documentation, process guides, and knowledge base articles.

• Document solutions, root causes, and recommended corrective actions.

• Provide functional guidance and knowledge sharing with other consultants as appropriate.

• Identify recurrent issues and recommend long-term corrective measures.

Required Skills

• Deep functional knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics GP.

• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a focus on root cause analysis and data integrity.

• Ability to understand and improve business processes through technology solutions.

• Excellent client relationship management and consulting skills.

• Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and client engagements simultaneously.

• Experience working within a managed services, consulting, or support environment.

• Strong documentation and organizational skills.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Desired Skills

• Bilingual in English and French.

• Experience with SmartConnect and Dynamics GP integrations.

• Familiarity with SQL Server and Dynamics GP reporting tools.

• Previous experience in a Microsoft partner or consulting environment.

About Us
Endeavour Solutions is a top Microsoft Partner for ERP, CRM, and AI Cloud Business Applications, providing SMB, mid-market, and corporate clients with advisory services, implementation and training, and ongoing support for their Microsoft Business Applications. Key focus areas include Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Business Central, and Dynamics GP, supporting clients across the United States and Canada.
With offices coast-to-coast across Canada and the United States, Endeavour Solutions works with over 1,100 active clients spanning each of the major time zones across North America. Founded in 1989, Endeavour operates several key brands, including Endeavour Solutions , GP Support North, and Purely CRM.

Compensation

• The compensation range for this role is $4,000–$4,200 USD per month, depending on years of comparable experience, skill set, and the unique value you bring.

• Candidates must reside in a LATAM country and be legally authorized to work in their country of residence.

Transparency Statement

• This posting reflects an existing Contractor of Record (COR) or Employer of Record (EOR) engagement opportunity.

•
Endeavour Solutions uses AI tools, such as Microsoft Copilot, to assist with administrative tasks such as transcribing interview notes. These tools do not make hiring decisions.

Accessibility & Inclusion

•
Endeavour Solutions is committed to an inclusive recruitment process.

postings.descriptionText:
🌎 Remote from EMEA or LATAM
Remote from India
Hello👋I am Willian , Trading and Analytics Lead at Kayzen , and I am now looking for a Growth Analyst to join our team 🙌

About Kayzen

Kayzen is a mobile demand-side platform (DSP) dedicated to democratizing programmatic advertising. We enable leading apps, agencies, media buyers, and brands to run programmatic customer acquisition, retargeting, and brand performance campaigns through our self-serve and managed service options. Built on the three core pillars of performance, transparency, and control, Kayzen powers the world’s best mobile marketing teams with bespoke solutions that fuel business growth and deliver a competitive advantage. With an unprecedented scale of 300B+ daily ad requests from 1.6B+ unique users worldwide, we serve up to 1B+ ads per day in 180 countries. Kayzen is accessible through our APIs and user interface.

The Team
The Trading team is responsible for creating growth through the management and optimization of mobile performance advertising campaigns for clients utilizing the managed service offering. The goal of the team is to deliver on the client's objectives through established or new trading best practices and communicate account status regularly and effectively with their CSM counterparts.

Why this role
This is a hands-on trading role where you'll manage mobile programmatic campaigns across verticals like gaming, fintech, and betting, optimizing toward CPA/ROAS targets while learning to scale efficiently. You'll work closely with senior growth analysts and cross-functional partners, gaining exposure to advanced analytics, LLM-powered workflows, and trading strategies that go well beyond what most desks offer at this level. If you're analytical, curious about automation, and want to accelerate your programmatic career, this is the role for you.

What you’ll do

Trading excellence

• Manage day-to-day campaign optimization across a set of advertisers; monitor and hit KPI targets (CPA, ROAS, retention) with guidance from senior growth analysts.

• Execute supply-side and audience optimization tactics including publisher management, bid adjustments, and dayparting across ad formats (banner, video, native, CTV).

• Run A/B tests on bids, budgets, creatives, and geos as part of broader testing roadmaps; document results and contribute learnings to the Trading Playbook.

• Monitor pacing and budget allocation daily, flagging risks and under-delivery proactively.

• Build a working understanding of mobile attribution (postback flows, attribution windows, MMP integrations) and how attribution models affect how we measure and optimize campaign performance.

Analytics & automation

• Use SQL to pull and analyze campaign data from internal databases; build comfort with joins, CTEs, and window functions over time.

• Learn to leverage LLMs (GPT/Claude) for recurring analyses, data briefs, and performance diagnostics, this is a core part of how our team works.

• Support the creation and maintenance of dashboards and reporting tools used by the trading team.

• Develop your analytical instincts: learn to ask the right questions, understand what's driving performance, and use available tools (SQL, AI, BI tools) to find answers.

Cross-functional impact

• Work with CSMs to understand client goals and communicate campaign status clearly.

• Support QBR preparation and client-facing deliverables alongside senior growth analysts.

• Collaborate with Product Support to troubleshoot delivery issues and with Supply on inventory quality questions.

Since I am based in Argentina and other key product and customer success team members are located mostly across EMEA and India, we are open to a remote setup of this position. For optimal overlap with customers’ time zones and internal teams your main working location should preferably be close to the CET time zone.

Requirements

• Minimum 1–3 years of programmatic ad buying, ad operations, or adjacent adtech experience is a must

• Familiarity with MMPs (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Singular) and attribution concepts; hands-on experience preferred.

• Analytical mindset; SQL ability or a demonstrated willingness to learn quickly.

• Curiosity about AI and automation — you don't need to be an expert, but you should be excited to use LLMs as part of your daily workflow.

• Nice-to-have: Any exposure to Python, CTV/OTT, or mobile in-app DSP platforms.

• Solution-oriented with a bias toward action.

• Clear communicator who's comfortable asking questions and collaborating across teams.

What do we offer?

• Competitive compensation with a performance-based component

• Exceptional career growth and learning possibilities — you'll be mentored by experienced growth analysts and exposed to advanced workflows (LLMs, ClickHouse, audience strategy) earlier than at most organizations

• A unique opportunity to be part of an experienced team of industry experts and entrepreneurs who bring massive change to the Adtech market

• A high degree of responsibility and independence

• Direct, day-to-day work with the management

• A fun, driven, and multinational team located across Germany, India, Argentina, Ukraine, Spain, the UK and many more countries

• A flexible work-from-home arrangement: work from our Berlin, London, Bangalore office or fully remote - you decide.

• A 500-dollar home-office setup budget

• A 1000-dollar annual learning and development budget

postings.title: QA Principal
postings.descriptionText:
Coinspaid Dev is the engineering brand behind the technology, infrastructure, and R&D expertise built within Coinspaid. With more than 120 engineersand over 11 years of industry experience, Coinspaid Dev brings together software engineering, infrastructure, security and R&D teams with experience building distributed systems and blockchain infrastructure operating across more than 20 blockchain networks.

Coinspaid Dev emerges as an independent engineering brand with a straightforward mission: to advance blockchain infrastructure engineering and contribute practical expertise back to the industry. The structure is new. The experience behind it is not.

Position Description:

We are looking for a Principal QA Engineer to take ownership of a company-wide QA system and lead its continued development. You will dive into the current processes, leadership model, automation and tooling direction, quality controls, and improvement roadmap; challenge existing approaches where needed, and drive the next stage of maturity across engineering domains. We need a senior technical leader who sees Quality Engineering as an engineering system, connects business and technical risks with practical changes in the SDLC, test architecture, automation, environments, release quality, and metrics, and turns systemic problems into measurable and sustainable improvements. This is a senior individual contributor role working primarily through QA Technical Leads and Senior QA Engineers and partnering with Engineering Managers, Product, Architecture, and DevOps/SRE, while remaining hands-on in high-impact reviews, pilots, and critical investigations.

Responsibilities:

• Take ownership of the company-wide Quality Engineering strategy, operating model, and improvement roadmap; continue evolving them as products, risks, and organizational needs change.

• Assess Quality Engineering maturity across domains, identify systemic bottlenecks and inconsistencies, and prioritize the improvements with the highest company-wide impact.

• Define and evolve cross-domain standards and guardrails for test architecture, coverage, quality evidence, testability, observability, release readiness, and production validation.

• Drive continuous improvement of the end-to-end QA process and embed shift-left practices, quality controls, and risk-based gates across the SDLC together with Product, Engineering, Architecture, and DevOps/SRE.

• Own the strategic direction of the QA toolchain and automation architecture, and validate key technical decisions hands-on through code, prototypes, and architecture reviews across UI and backend automation. Python is preferred, while Go, Node.js, or another suitable stack is also relevant.

• Continuously benchmark market practices and emerging technologies, including AI; validate ideas through experiments and turn successful findings into company-wide transformation initiatives such as framework modernization, contract and performance testing, smarter test selection, and cloud-native test environments. Actively use AI in daily engineering work and advance its adoption across QA.

• Define scalable release-quality principles and provide technical recommendations for systemic, cross-team, or ambiguous quality risks.

• Lead cross-team investigations and root-cause analysis for critical incidents, unstable environments, systemic automation failures, and quality problems without a clear owner.

• Establish meaningful quality metrics and make trends, risks, technical debt, and improvement outcomes visible to engineering leadership.

• Develop QA Technical Leads as domain-level technical owners, strengthening their ability to translate company-wide direction into sustainable practices and decisions within their domains.

• Influence, align stakeholders, and translate business, regulatory, and operational risks into clear engineering priorities.

Requirements:

• 8+ years in Quality Assurance / Quality Engineering, including technical leadership across multiple teams or domains.

• Experience defining QA strategy, standards, or large-scale transformations with measurable results.

• Deep knowledge of Quality practices risk-based testing, coverage strategy, shift-left, quality gates, testability, release readiness, and production quality signals.

• Strong hands-on programming experience and the ability to design and contribute to scalable UI and backend automation. Python is preferred, but strong experience with Go, Node.js, or another relevant stack is welcome.

• Strong experience with distributed backend systems, REST APIs, event-driven workflows, third-party integrations

• Experience with CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes, cloud-native or GitOps environments, and observability tools.

• Ability to define useful quality metrics, communicate technical risk, and influence senior stakeholders

• A research-driven mindset, practical experience evaluating new technologies, and confident, responsible, and active use of AI tools in everyday engineering work.

• Good spoken and written English and Russian.

Nice to have:

• Experience in fintech, crypto, payments, compliance, financial operations, or another regulated domain with complex integrations and high operational risk.

• Experience with Kafka, MQ, Debezium, ledger-like systems, eventual consistency, and event-driven architecture.

• Experience with contract, performance, load, resilience, or reliability testing.

Why join CryptoProcessing by Coinspaid

You’ll be joining a company that is actively shaping its space – with enough scale to matter and enough room to make an impact.

At Coinspaid, people are expected to think, contribute, and take ownership – and are supported in doing so.

We focus on flexibility, wellbeing, and long-term growth – without overcomplicating how benefits work.

Flexible Benefits

Benefit Bar – up to €230/month A flexible monthly budget you can use for what matters most to you – from sports and mental health to coworking, home office, or medical-related expenses.

Work & Flexibility

•
Fully remote work from almost anywhere

We're looking for a Senior Product Engineer (Backend-Focused) to join a U.S.-based B2B SaaS product team.
This is a hands-on engineering role with a strong focus on Python backend development, data modeling, and scalable application architecture , while also contributing to frontend development using React and TypeScript.
You'll work closely with Product Management and other engineers to improve an established platform, build customer-facing features, and make technical decisions that support long-term product growth.

What You'll Do

• Design, maintain, and evolve complex data models to support scalable product features.

• Develop and enhance backend services and APIs using Python (FastAPI, Flask, or Django).

• Improve database performance, data integrity, and application scalability.

• Lead database schema changes, migrations, and data optimization initiatives.

• Build and maintain integrations with external systems and APIs.

• Collaborate with Product Managers to design and deliver customer-facing features.

• Contribute to frontend development using React and TypeScript.

• Evaluate existing architecture and recommend improvements based on business and technical needs.

• Collaborate with DevOps engineers on AWS-based infrastructure and deployments.

• Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and mentoring.

Must Have

• 6+ years of professional software engineering experience.

• Strong production experience with Python (FastAPI, Flask, or Django) .

• Proven expertise in data modeling, database design, schema evolution, and migrations .

• Strong experience with PostgreSQL and/or MongoDB , including query optimization and performance tuning.

• Experience developing customer-facing products in B2B SaaS environments .

• Working knowledge of React and TypeScript , with the ability to build and review frontend features.

• Hands-on experience with AWS .

• Experience designing and maintaining REST APIs and third-party integrations.

• Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot.

• Strong technical ownership, problem-solving, and communication skills.

•
Advanced English proficiency , both written and spoken.

Nice to Have

• Experience with complex hierarchical or graph-based data structures.

• Experience with large-scale database migrations.

• Familiarity with Kubernetes/EKS.

• Experience with role-based permissions and access control.

• Exposure to LLM-powered or AI-driven product features.

Why Apply?

•
100% remote opportunity from Latin America.

• USD compensation 6k-7k monthly.

• Paid time off.

• Take ownership of meaningful backend and data architecture decisions.

• Build customer-facing features with real business impact.

• Work closely with a U.S.-based product and engineering team.

postings.title: Call Center Sales Intake Specialist (Dominican Republic)
postings.descriptionText:
About Us
Ovation Law Firm is a fast-growing, consumer-focused law firm committed to delivering exceptional legal services while fostering a high-performance, accountable, and supportive workplace. As we continue to scale, we are building strong client-focused systems to ensure consistency, compliance, and an outstanding experience from the very first interaction.
We work closely with partner legal teams to connect injured individuals with the legal support they need, and our intake team plays a critical role in setting the tone for every client relationship.

About the Role
We are seeking a high-energy, empathetic, and motivated Legal Intake Specialist to serve as the first point of contact for individuals seeking legal help after an injury.
In this role, your goal is to listen, qualify, and warmly introduce potential clients to our partner legal teams using an assumptive, sales-minded approach. You will guide callers through the early stages of their legal journey with confidence, compassion, and urgency, ensuring they feel heard, supported, and ready for the next step.
This is a fast-paced position well-suited for individuals with backgrounds in legal intake, sales, customer service, call centers, or customer acquisition of any kind, who thrive in high-volume environments and know how to balance empathy with performance.
Strong English communication skills are essential for success in this role.

Key Responsibilities

• Respond to incoming inquiries via phone, web forms, and chat in real time, providing rapid, attentive support to individuals seeking legal help after an injury.

• Conduct concise (5–8 minute), compassionate discovery calls to gather and assess essential case details such as incident information, injuries, liability, and insurance status.

• Apply proprietary scripts and strict qualification criteria to quickly determine whether a case is a fit for partner legal teams.

• Use an assumptive, sales-minded approach to perform live warm transfers to our partner legal teams or schedule timely callbacks for qualified leads.

• Accurately document all caller information, case details, and outcomes in Salesforce, ensuring data accuracy and completeness.

• Manage follow-ups for pending leads, maintaining an organized pipeline and re-engaging prospects who were not ready to proceed on initial contact.

Qualifications

• Strong English communication skills (C1 level), both verbal and written.

• Fully bilingual, fluent in both English and Spanish, with the ability to seamlessly support callers in either language.

• At least 1 year of experience in a high-volume call center, customer service, or medical/legal office environment.

• Exceptional verbal communication skills with the ability to mirror a caller’s tone, demonstrate empathy, and build rapport quickly.

• Sales-minded approach focused on educating callers and guiding them toward taking action on their personal injury matter.

• Tech-savvy and comfortable typing 45+ WPM while speaking with callers and navigating multiple software platforms simultaneously.

Nice-to-Have / Preferred Qualifications
The following experience is helpful but not required for success in this role:

• Personal injury intake experience.

• Experience with Salesforce.

Requirements

• Ability to work independently from a home office with stable, high-speed internet and a quiet, professional workspace.

• Must have a laptop or desktop computer with a minimum of 16GB RAM and an Intel Core i5 processor or higher.

• Must have a stable internet connection with a minimum speed of 25 Mbps.

• Available to work U.S. business hours.

• Willingness to use time-tracking software.

What We Offer

• Earn $5-$8/hour DOE (full-time, 40 hours/week - including weekends).

• Performance based incentives.

• 100% remote work environment.

• 10 paid time-off (PTO) days per year.

• Opportunity to work closely with leadership and legal professionals in a growing, modern law firm.

This position is only open to candidates located in LATAM. Resumes must be submitted in English. Applications that do not meet these criteria will not be considered.
Salary: $5-$8 Hourly DOE Originally posted on Himalayas
