postings.title: Growth & Performance Lead Paid Media, Analítica e IA (Remoto Latam)
postings.descriptionText:
AIT Tech Venture es una empresa tecnológica española fundada en 1993. Somos 40 personas, hemos entregado más de 1.500 proyectos y trabajamos con más de 1.000 clientes de industria, retail y e-commerce. Somos partner oficial de Odoo y de Shopify.
No somos una agencia: construimos software, montamos tiendas online, integramos ERP y automatizamos procesos con inteligencia artificial.
Ahora estamos cerrando el único eslabón que nos faltaba controlar de verdad: la captación. Buscamos a la persona que monte nuestra máquina de crecimiento desde cero —con AIT como primer cliente— y que después la convierta en un servicio para nuestra cartera.
No entras a mantener campañas que ya existen. Entras a construir un área.

Tareas

Captación de pago

• Estrategia, montaje y optimización de campañas en Google Ads y Meta Ads, con presupuesto propio desde el primer mes y libertad para decidir dónde se invierte.

• Supervisión de la agencia externa que hoy lleva redes sociales.

Embudos y medición

• Diseño de los embudos completos: anuncio, landing, formulario, seguimiento y cierre en HubSpot.

• Medición seria de principio a fin: GA4, Google Tag Manager (incluido server-side), consent mode, conversiones mejoradas, API de conversiones de Meta y envío de conversiones offline desde el CRM.

• Un informe mensual con las cifras que importan: coste por oportunidad, coste de adquisición y retorno. Nada de impresiones ni de capturas de pantalla.

Visibilidad en buscadores y en IA

• Conseguir que AIT aparezca cuando alguien pregunta por nuestros servicios, tanto en Google como en ChatGPT, Gemini o Perplexity.

• Contenido, datos estructurados y presencia en las fuentes que los modelos citan. Y un método para medirlo.

Automatización con agentes de IA

• Detectar qué partes del trabajo de marketing y preventa pueden ejecutarse solas, especificarlas y medir las horas que ahorran.

• No las programas tú: las construye nuestro equipo técnico contigo. Tienes 40 personas para hacer realidad lo que diseñes.

De AIT a nuestros clientes

• Los primeros meses trabajas puertas adentro. Después empaquetas lo aprendido (alcance, precios, plantillas e informes) y lo llevas a las primeras cuentas de cliente.

Lo que este puesto NO es

• No es cerrar ventas: para eso está el equipo comercial.

• No es coordinar a una agencia y reenviar sus informes.

Requisitos

Imprescindible

• Experiencia real gestionando presupuesto propio o de cliente en Google Ads y Meta Ads, con resultados que puedas explicar con números.

• Dominio técnico de la medición: GA4, Google Tag Manager (incluido server-side), consent mode, conversiones mejoradas y API de conversiones.

• Haber trabajado con un CRM como parte del embudo, no como un archivo aparte. Nosotros usamos HubSpot.

• Criterio para venta B2B de ciclo largo y ticket alto, no solo e-commerce de compra impulsiva.

• Mentalidad de construir sistemas, no de apagar fuegos.

Muy valorable

• Trabajo hecho en posicionamiento en motores generativos (GEO/AEO) y capacidad de explicar cómo lo mides.

• Automatización con herramientas de flujos y uso serio de IA en tu día a día, con ahorros medidos.

• Experiencia previa entregando servicio a clientes, no solo in-house.

• Conocimiento de industria, retail o e-commerce con ERP detrás.

Qué esperamos de ti y cuándo

• A los 90 días: medición limpia y validada, campañas encendidas y un coste por oportunidad de referencia sobre el que trabajar.

• A los 6 meses: un flujo estable de oportunidades cualificadas entrantes, con su coste conocido y bajando.

• A los 12 meses: una parte relevante del pipeline con origen digital y el servicio funcionando en las primeras cuentas de cliente.

No te vamos a pedir retorno en el mes dos. Te vamos a pedir que a los 90 días podamos confiar en los números.

Beneficios

• Presupuesto de medios propio desde el primer mes. No vas a tener que pelear cada euro.

• Un equipo técnico de 40 personas que construye lo que diseñes: integraciones, agentes de IA, landings y conexiones con ERP. En una agencia eso no lo tienes.

• Una cartera de más de 1.000 clientes a la que ofrecer el servicio cuando esté listo.

• Acceso directo al CEO y autonomía real: las decisiones se toman en la misma conversación, no en tres comités.

• Contrato indefinido y salario acorde a experiencia demostrable, más variable ligado a resultados.

- Formación y herramientas cubiertas.

• Recorrido real: este puesto está pensado para acabar dirigiendo un área con equipo propio.

Si has llegado hasta aquí y te reconoces en el puesto, escríbenos con un caso concreto: una cuenta que mejoraste, qué medías antes, qué mediste después y qué cambió en el negocio. Un párrafo con un número real nos dice más que tres páginas de currículum.
Nuestro proceso son cinco pasos y unas dos semanas: primer contacto, entrevista técnica, una prueba práctica sobre un caso real nuestro (que pagamos, porque tu tiempo vale), defensa de la prueba con nuestro equipo y conversación final de encaje y condiciones.
Te responderemos en todos los casos, tanto si avanzamos como si no.

postings.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
postings.descriptionText:
Location: Remote (US or LATAM Preferred)

About AlphaPoint

AlphaPoint is the infrastructure platform behind digital asset businesses worldwide. Since 2013, we have powered exchanges, brokerages, banks, and fintechs across dozens of countries, giving them the trading, custody connectivity, tokenization, treasury, and settlement capabilities they need to operate in digital assets at institutional scale.
We are not a collection of products in a box. AlphaPoint is a single platform with many capabilities: one integration that lets a client offer trading, brokerage, treasury, and stablecoin workflows to their end users, connect to the liquidity venues, custodians, and banking partners of their choice, and expand into new use cases without re-platforming. Every super app needs a super platform underneath it. That is what we build.

The Role
The Sales Development Representative (SDR) owns the top of AlphaPoint 's funnel. You'll research and prospect companies that need digital asset infrastructure, qualify them, and book well-briefed meetings for our Account Executives. Working closely with sales and marketing, you'll turn a target account list into a predictable pipeline of qualified opportunities.
You must already understand the market we operate in. You know the difference between an exchange, a broker, and a custodian; you can speak to why a bank or fintech would launch a digital asset product; and you can hold a credible first conversation with a Head of Digital Assets, CTO, or COO.

What You'll Do

• Outbound prospecting. Build and work target account lists that match AlphaPoint 's ideal customer profile. Run personalized email, phone, and LinkedIn sequences to engage decision-makers.

• Lead qualification. Qualify inbound leads (web, events, partner referrals) and outbound responses against defined criteria: fit, need, timing, and buying authority.

• Meeting booking and handoff. Book qualified meetings for AEs and brief them on the account, contacts, pain points, and context before every call.

• Nurture. Keep qualified-but-not-ready accounts warm with relevant follow-up until they are ready for a sales conversation.

• Campaign and event support. Drive registrations and follow-up for AlphaPoint events and marketing campaigns and report on results.

• CRM discipline. Log every activity in HubSpot, keep account and contact data clean, and report weekly on activity, meetings booked, and pipeline created.

• Hit your numbers. Own monthly targets for qualified meetings and pipeline generated.

Must-Haves

• Digital asset market knowledge. A working understanding of the crypto and digital asset ecosystem: exchanges, brokers, custodians, tokenization, stablecoins, and the banks and fintechs entering the space. You can explain who buys infrastructure like ours and why.

• 1–3 years of outbound prospecting or SDR/BDR experience in crypto, digital assets, fintech, or financial services, selling to enterprise buyers.

• Strong written and verbal communication. Clear, concise outreach that earns replies from senior executives.

• Familiarity with enterprise sales cycles and consultative selling; comfortable engaging C-level and senior management.

• Proficiency with HubSpot (or a comparable CRM) and sales engagement tools; disciplined about pipeline hygiene.

• Self-directed and resilient. Comfortable with high activity volume, rejection, and a fast-changing market.

Nice-to-Haves

• Experience selling white-label, SaaS, or infrastructure products to financial institutions.

• Existing network in the digital asset or fintech space.

• Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo/Apollo, or similar prospecting tools.

• Additional languages (Spanish) given our LatAm client base.

How Success Is Measured

• Qualified meetings booked and held per month

• Pipeline generated from SDR-sourced opportunities

• Meeting-to-opportunity conversion rate

• Outreach activity and response rates

• CRM accuracy and completeness

Why AlphaPoint

You will sell a proven product into a market that is moving from experimentation to production, alongside a team with deep payments, fintech, and crypto infrastructure experience. High performers have a clear path to an Account Executive role.

postings.title: Sr Data Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
THIS OPENING IS AVAILABLE FOR CANDIDATES IN LATIN AMERICA, NOT LIMITED TO ONLY MEXICO.
Sonatafy Technology , headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, is an award-winning nearshore software development company with a strong reputation. They have a dedicated in-house team of engineers, offering end-to-end software solutions and supporting client development staff augmentation. Catering to companies of all sizes and industries, including some of the world's largest brands, Sonatafy Technology is a trusted provider of nearshore enterprise-level cloud and mobile application software development services.

About the Role
We're looking for a senior analytics engineer with deep experience in dbt and Snowflake to join a Managed Delivery POD building a governed data platform for a multi-location franchise brand.
The platform is a layered Snowflake Enterprise instance (RAW, STAGING, CORE, MARTS, SANDBOX) fed by CDC, with functional RBAC and a dbt Cloud project. The role centers on the dbt transformation layer: staging models, identity resolution, Customer 360 core models, seven production marts, and the tests, contracts, and documentation that let the client's team own the platform after handoff.
You will work alongside the lead data architect and own a defined set of models end to end.

Key Responsibilities

• Build and own dbt staging, intermediate, core, and mart models from ticket to production, following the project's naming, routing, and test conventions.

• Turn business rules into documented, testable logic: survivorship, location attribution, consent history, membership lifecycle, and mart metrics.

• Work directly with marketing, operations, and finance subject matter experts to confirm definitions, then get sign-off before a model is promoted.

• Write tests and model contracts with every model. Add source freshness and soft-delete handling for CDC-landed tables.

• Set up and maintain dbt Cloud Production and CI environments, and keep the main branch compiling and deployable.

• Review pull requests from other engineers and take review from the lead architect.

• Reconcile model output against source systems and write up any gap with its cause.

• Document every attribute you build, and contribute to the runbooks and wiki pages used at

• handoff.

Requirements

• 5+ years in data or analytics engineering, with at least 3 years building production dbt projects on Snowflake.

• Strong dbt: layered modeling, incremental models, snapshots and SCD Type 2, macros and Jinja, packages such as dbt_utils, model contracts, exposures, and docs.

• dbt testing in depth: generic and singular tests, source freshness, severity and failure handling, and CI that builds into isolated per-PR schemas.

• Snowflake beyond querying: roles and grants, warehouses and cost controls, UDFs, Secure Views, masking policies, and tags.

• Customer identity resolution or entity matching: deterministic match tiers, survivorship rules, and a stable customer key across source systems.

• Expert SQL, including window functions and semi-structured data.

• Experience handling PII and consent data with an append-only, auditable design.

• Git-based workflow with pull requests, code review, and protected branches.

• Clear written English and the habit of documenting decisions so others can pick up the work.

Nice to Have

• dbt Cloud administration: environments, jobs, service users with key pair auth, and network policies.

• Modeling data landed by CDC tools such as Snowflake OpenFlow or AWS DMS, including soft-delete flags.

• Source familiarity with Zoho CRM, Customer.io, GA4 exports, or appointment and POS systems.

• Multi-location or franchise reporting, including row-level security by franchise, market, or region.

• Building marts for Power BI and matching metrics to existing report logic.

• Consent and data deletion workflows across marketing and CRM tools.

• Terraform or schema changes for Snowflake objects.

Why Work with Sonatafy?
At Sonatafy, you’ll join a fast-growing, Inc. 5000-recognized firm with 60+ completed client engagements. You’ll be backed by account-based marketing, executive events, and our Software Leaders Uncensored podcast. We provide the platform and support. You bring the hustle, relationships, and follow-through.
If you have reached this point and feel you are our ideal candidate, it’s time for you to apply!

Sonatafy recruitment communications will only come from @ email addresses. We do not request fees, sensitive financial information, or conduct hiring solely through online forms without interviews. If you receive a suspicious message, contact us at .

Solution Architect (ServiceNow HRSD) Ubicación/Modalidad: Europa / Remoto con posibilidad de contratar en LATAM Horario: 09:00 - 18:00

En Initium Software no somos una consultora tradicional. Conectamos al mejor talento técnico con los proyectos más desafiantes e innovadores del mercado. Creemos en el impacto real a través de la tecnología, y para este viaje no buscamos un gestor pasivo; buscamos un referente técnico capaz de evangelizar y negociar las mejores soluciones del ecosistema ServiceNow junto a nuestros clientes de clase mundial.

Tu Misión (Tus desafíos y responsabilidades)

• Diseño de Arquitectura de Impacto: Diseñar, documentar y comunicar estratégicamente el enfoque de integración de todos los componentes arquitectónicos de la plataforma.

• Mentoría y Liderazgo Técnico: Guiar, dar coaching y elevar la vara de calidad técnica para otros desarrolladores y arquitectos, actuando como el último punto de escalación técnica dentro de los programas.

• Consultoría Estratégica: Investigar y proponer alternativas de solución disruptivas que resuelvan necesidades complejas de negocio en distintas líneas de operación.

• Construcción de Equipos de Alto Rendimiento: Definir procesos de evaluación técnica para la atracción de talento de élite, realizar entrevistas y detectar las habilidades emergentes que el equipo requiere desarrollar.

Requirements

Tu Arsenal (¿Qué buscamos en ti?)

Imprescindible:

• Certificación requerida: ServiceNow CIS-HRSD (Certified Implementation Specialist for Human Resources Service Delivery).

• Certificación requerida: ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).

• Configuración Avanzada: Flujos de trabajo específicos de COE (Nómina, Beneficios, Adquisición de Talento) y elementos del catálogo de RRHH.

• Integraciones y Ecosistema: Experiencia sólida conectando ServiceNow HRSD con plataformas HCM líderes ( Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM ).

• Trayectoria Sólida (+5 años): En consultoría general, gestión de servicios, desarrollo de software y configuración integral de la plataforma ServiceNow.

• Formación Académica: Graduado en Ciencias de la Computación, Ingeniería de Tecnologías de la Información o carrera equivalente con experiencia en roles de consultoría técnica.

• Idiomas: Inglés Avanzado ( C1 requerido), con competencias excepcionales de comunicación escrita, interpersonal y de presentación.

​

Valoramos especialmente si además… (Deseable):

• Cuentas con las certificaciones ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) o Certified Master Architect (CMA).

• Posees la certificación ServiceNow CIS-ITSM o certificaciones CIS adicionales.

• Tienes experiencia con Employee Center Pro y configuraciones de portales multidepartamentales.

• Cuentas con un sólido background de desarrollo en JavaScript, HTML, CSS, frameworks modernos de JS y metodologías ágiles (Agile/SDLC).

• Tienes conocimientos validados en ITIL (preferiblemente nivel Foundation).

• The ideal candidate will have a strong background in building and maintaining high-performance computing services, expertise in distributed systems, and a passion for systems engineering, scaling, and storage architecture. This role involves working closely with our development teams to design, implement, and optimize HPC solutions that meet our growing needs.

• This opportunity is particularly unique, placed within our skunkworks team at Insight Softmax. While the exact nature and purpose of this work is confidential, it is an extremely exciting set of projects and objectives that touch HPC, ML, Simulation, and Quantum swimlanes. Our HPC team is building CFD services and architecture that will integrate directly with ML and Simulation services. You will interface and work with some of the most experienced and talented people on the planet across these swimlanes.

• The infrastructure team we are putting together requires individuals with focus on delivery and results, hunger to learn, ability to adapt, and also thrive in an environment where you will not be provided all the training nor instructions to get your deliverables done. You will be given top-level engineering goals and milestones, so you are responsible for figuring out and delivering what is required to get there. Folks with startup experience may be more comfortable in this position, as will people that have a mental itch that can never be fully scratched. While senior-level individuals often bring well-needed experience to the table, we are always open to less-experienced individuals who may have great attributes suitable for our team culture.

• Depending on engineering objectives, priorities, and team member skill sets, in the future we may swap team members between responsibilities, or we may all team up together to finish one project more quickly, so you may have the opportunity to work on other projects (ML, Simulation, Quantum, etc) outside of HPC.

Key Responsibilities:

• Design, build, and maintain high-performance computing (HPC) infrastructure.

• Develop and implement scalable distributed systems for complex computing tasks.

• Scaling services and systems from smaller deployments of ~50 nodes into larger ~250+ node clusters.

• Using orchestration, configuration management, virtualization, linux, CLI, deploy tools, monitoring, APM.

Qualifications:

• Robust networking expertise.

• Strong linux chops.

Optional Experience and Skills:

• HPC CFD experience.

• Scaling services and systems from single-region clusters into multi-regional deployments.

• Experience with clusters of greater than 100 nodes.

• Building on-prem systems (on-premise, data center, rack-n-stack, etc).

• Distributing workloads onto both cloud and on-prem systems.

• Balancing business needs, product delivery dates, and customer satisfaction.

Bonus Experience and Skills:

• Backend work like SQL, API development, and serverless.

• Software engineering

• Python, and/or other programming languages

• Harnessing creativity, generating innovative products and features, and ensuring a delightful customer experience.

• Using linux as your primary desktop workstation environment.

Attributes that we value:

• Transparency

• Grit

• Effectiveness

• Willingness to learn

Location and Hours:

• Some customer meetings will occur each week at non-standard / nighttime hours, as we currently support a global team across 3-4 continents.

References:

You will need to be able to work in EST time zones. ***

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN US?
At EventMobi , you won’t just ship UI features. You’ll help shape the core front-end architecture behind a global event platform used by thousands of organizations that rely on it to perform, scale and evolve.
Our web applications are not thin presentation layers. They are large, offline-capable, cross-device React/TypeScript systems with shared design foundations, complex state management, performance-sensitive rendering and long-term architectural considerations. The decisions you make here compound.
We believe great software is built by engineers who take ownership beyond the ticket. You’ll have the space to challenge assumptions, improve abstractions, influence technical direction, and think in systems - not just components.
We also believe the strongest engineers of the future know how to work with AI. We actively encourage AI-native development to reduce repetitive work, increase quality and ultimately drive higher throughput — so your time goes toward design thinking, architecture, and meaningful problem-solving.
If you care about product thinking, craftsmanship and building software that lasts, you’ll find real leverage here.
HEAR FROM OUR SENIOR ENGINEER & DEV LEAD ALI:
“I joined the team as a Software Engineer five years ago, and what keeps me here is the rare balance between high-level technical challenge and a genuinely sustainable pace. In many senior roles, you expect to spend your days 'extinguishing fires,' but here, the focus is on architectural integrity and long-term stability.
The engineering culture is built on mutual respect and deep technical expertise. We don't just ship features to hit arbitrary deadlines; we take the time to conduct thorough, meaningful PR reviews that serve as a mentorship tool for the whole team. Having been here for half a decade, I've seen our systems evolve, and I've always felt empowered to take ownership of the roadmap and advocate for the right technical decisions.
What stands out most is the lack of ego. Even as a Senior, I'm constantly learning from my peers. The environment is collaborative which makes it easy to focus on what actually matters - writing clean, scalable code and solving complex problems.
If you're a seasoned engineer looking for a place where your experience is valued, your growth is supported, and your work-life balance is actually protected, this is the place to be.”

WHAT YOUR WORK WILL FOCUS ON:
This isn’t a “pixel pusher” role. You’ll operate at the intersection of product thinking, architecture, and hands-on engineering.

Build Modern Web Experiences

• Evolve our high-performance, responsive Progressive Web App

• Implement offline-first capabilities, real-time updates, and scalable front-end architecture

• Deliver experiences that work flawlessly across devices, even in low-connectivity environments

Own Features End-to-End

• From ideation and design review to implementation, testing, CI/CD, deployment, and monitoring

• Implement offline-first capabilities, real-time updates, and scalable front-end architecture

• Deliver experiences that work flawlessly across devices, even in low-connectivity environments

Architect for Scale

• Design abstractions that survive real-world complexity

• Navigate and improve large codebases and legacy systems

• Keep performance, maintainability, and developer experience in balance

Raise the Bar

• Mentor engineers and lead by example

• Advocate for clean code, strong testing, and disciplined engineering practices

• Contribute to a culture of technical excellence

Work Smarter with AI

• Embrace AI-assisted development using tools like Claude, Codex, and other LLMs to move faster on feature, tech and routine work

• Reinvest that time into more ambitious features, stronger code quality, and better long-term systems

• Focus on solving high-impact problems instead of repetitive tasks

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS:
You’re not just experienced—you’re thoughtful about how software should be built.

• 8+ years building scalable, user-facing software

• 4+ years of deep experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and React

• Strong architectural thinking and problem-solving skills

• Comfort working in large, evolving codebases

• Experience with REST APIs, JSX, modern HTML/CSS

• Automated testing experience (Jest, React Testing Library, end-to-end)

• Clear, professional written communication (we’re async-first)

• Strong understanding of SOLID principles, domain modeling, and design patterns

• A mentorship mindset—you elevate the people around you

NICE TO HAVE:

• Strongly typed TypeScript across hooks and components

• React Query or similar API integration libraries

• Mobile app development experience (Capacitor, Cordova, React Native)

• Docker, AWS, GitHub Actions, and CI/CD pipelines

THIS ROLE IS PROBABLY NOT FOR YOU IF..
Let’s be honest. You’ll struggle here if:

• You prefer tightly scoped, ambiguity-free tasks

• You need frequent synchronous meetings to move work forward

• You’re uncomfortable making independent decisions

• You’re skeptical of AI-assisted workflows

• You haven’t worked in a fully remote, async-first environment

We value autonomy, clarity in writing, and momentum.

OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS
If your profile moves forward, here’s what you can expect during the hiring process:

• Introductory Conversation (45 minutes)
Meet with the VP of Product & Engineering to discuss your background, experience, and career goals.

• Technical Assessment (120 minutes)
Participate in a live, hands-on session with members of our technical team to demonstrate your problem-solving and coding skills.

• Project Deep Dive (90 minutes)
Walk us through impactful projects you’ve worked on, highlighting your contributions, decisions, and outcomes.

• Offer Stage

Final discussions and next steps.

We’ll provide more details at each stage and ensure you have plenty of opportunities to ask questions along the way.

WHAT WILL YOU GET FROM EVENTMOBI?

• Compensation: Base salary ranges from $50k to $85k CAD per annual, depending on experience

• Time-Off: 2-weeks PTO + 3-summer days + your birthday is a holiday (seriously! log-off and hang out with the fam or go do something fun) + opportunities to meet your co-workers in person throughout the year

REMOTE WORKSPACE REQUIREMENTS:

• You have a reliable internet connection capable of participating in video calls, with at least 30Mbps download speed

• Ability to collaborate during EST working hours

We're focused on building the most comprehensive event management platform to help conference organizers create engaging event experiences. We believe live events bring people together and enable positive change. Over 30,000+ events in 70+ countries from major brands such as Shoppers Drug Mart, to amazing non-profits such as American Psychiatric Nurses Association and Canadian Real Estate Association have trusted EventMobi ’s suite of software technology to manage their events and engage their attendees.

• Manage outreach replies, follow-ups, introductory calls, and long-term nurture with independent sponsors.

• Research and connect with sponsors, M&A professionals, lenders, attorneys, and referral networks.

• Understand investment strategies, assess initial fit, gather transaction details, and prepare concise internal handoffs.

Success isn't about sending the most messages. It's about building trust, creating a pipeline of relevant opportunities, and making relationships compound over time.

Your Toolbox: Skills to be Successful

• Around 2–5 years of relevant experience in finance, investing, lending, M&A, financial services, or financially sophisticated B2B business development. Demonstrated ability matters more than a specific career path.

postings.title: Vice President of Sales
postings.descriptionText:
Cross-industry, insurance-first | Global remit | Americas-based, remote | Reports to the Chief Commercial Officer

Who we are
Adlib is the AI Production Layer for regulated industries. We turn complex, unstructured documents into governed, validated, AI-ready data so enterprises can make defensible decisions without rebuilding their stack. Customers see 60% fewer exceptions, 50% faster cycle times and 70% less manual handling.
On top of that trusted data layer sits our agentic intake capability. Agents read the packet, decide what it is, apply the customer’s rules, route the exception and trigger the next action. The document layer establishes trust in the data. The agentic layer acts on it.
For insurance carriers that means agentic intake across FNOL packets, police reports, medical records, adjuster notes, loss runs, submissions and endorsements. We are model-agnostic and system-agnostic by design, sitting in front of Guidewire, Duck Creek, Sapiens and Majesco rather than replacing any of it. We serve life sciences, insurance and public sector customers, and we are backed by Diversis Capital.

The role
This is not a standard VP of Sales job. Insurance is our core growth driver and this role goes deepest there, but it carries the whole company number across life sciences, public sector and OEM as well, worldwide. It also has to absorb sellers and systems from an acquisition, and leave the sales function in a state that stands up to institutional scrutiny.
You will inherit a small, capable team and an open field. We are blending a startup mentality with an established business, so you can innovate faster while deploying proven sales tactics and processes that work. You are building the machine: territory and quota design, capacity planning, methodology, deal inspection, and a forecast the Board can rely on. You report to the Chief Commercial Officer and sit on the commercial leadership team.
You will also sell. At our current team size this is a working leadership role, and you will personally lead the largest opportunities in your first two quarters.

The details

Role

Vice President of Sales

Reports to

Chief Commercial Officer

Scope
All new ARR worldwide, cross-industry, with an insurance-first focus

Team
Matrixed leadership with line-of-business General Managers (GMs) of the quota-carrying sales team, scaling with the plan

Location
Remote, based in the Americas. Global remit, with travel of approximately 30%.

Base salary

$175,000 to $200,000 USD

On-target earnings
$350,000 to $400,000 USD (50/50 base and variable, with accelerators above plan)

Equity
Participation in the management incentive plan, with change-of-control treatment

What you will own

• The number. Carry and deliver the company new ARR number worldwide, across all industries, direct and partner-influenced. You are based in the Americas and the remit is global, including EMEA.

• Team build. Recruit, ramp and coach the quota-carrying team. Expect to spend a meaningful share of your time on hiring. The team you build in your first six months is what shows up in bookings in your second year.

• Capacity and quota. Own territory design, quota assignment, and the sales capacity model. Quota is derived from rep productivity and carries deliberate over-assignment, not calculated backwards from the target.

• Forecast integrity. Own a weekly forecast with defined stage exit criteria and conversion rates derived from actual closed-deal history. Forecast means high confidence, not hope.

• Insurance leadership. Go deepest in insurance. Own the executive relationships at target carriers, MGAs, TPAs and brokers, and make sure our claims and underwriting story lands with operators, not just IT.

•

Hold the differentiation line. Our biggest competitive risk is being boxed as another OCR or IDP tool by buyers who have been pitched by every extraction vendor and are now hearing agentic AI from their core platform vendor as well.

• Acquisition integration. Bring the acquired selling team onto one CRM, one pipeline, one forecast and one comp philosophy. Retain the sellers worth retaining, resolve account conflict, and deliver the cross-sell the acquisition was underwritten on.

• Cross-functional partnership. Partner with the Industry General Managers on vertical strategy and named accounts, with Marketing on pipeline coverage, with Strategic Partnerships on partner-sourced opportunities, and with Revenue Operations on quota, comp mechanics and reporting.

• Institutional readiness. Keep the sales function audit-ready. Cohort retention, quota attainment distribution, pipeline quality, win-loss, sales cycle by segment and forecast accuracy history should be current at all times, not reconstructed under deadline.

What you bring

• Scale experience. You have taken B2B software businesses from $2M to $50M or more in ARR in a sales leadership seat. You can speak precisely to ARR, seller count and per-rep productivity at the start and the end.

• Insurance depth. You have sold into insurance carriers, MGAs, TPAs, brokers or reinsurers and can hold a conversation with a Chief Claims Officer or Chief Underwriting Officer on their terms. You understand the claims and submission lifecycle, loss ratio and expense ratio, cycle time, leakage and straight-through processing. You know your way around Guidewire, Duck Creek and the wider core and content stack, and around ACORD and ISO forms, NAIC and state DOI expectations.

• Cross-industry range. You have carried a number across two or more unrelated verticals at the same time. You know how to keep a small team focused without letting one vertical starve the others.

• Global remit. You have led sellers or carried a number across more than one region, including Europe. You know how deal cycles, buying norms and employment practice differ outside North America, and you can run a team you do not sit beside.

• A team you built. You have personally recruited and ramped five to eight quota carriers. You can name them and say where they are now.

• Operating rigor. You build quota from steady-state rep productivity, plan for ramp, and can explain your capacity model on a whiteboard. You track attainment as a distribution, not an average.

• Acquisition integration. You have merged two selling teams after an acquisition. You have made the single versus dual go-to-market call, harmonized comp and territories without losing the people who mattered, and consolidated onto one pipeline.

• Exit experience. You have owned the sales side of a sale process or major diligence. You know what a buyer or banker asks the sales organization for, and what breaks when the data does not hold up.

• Enterprise and regulated selling. You are credible on AI without overselling it. You sell business outcomes and defensible data, not model hype.

• A working leader. You are still close enough to the work to run a deal yourself, and you want to be. You take coaching as readily as you give it.

•

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

• Experience in a private equity backed company with a defined growth mandate and reporting cadence.

• Relationships in the insurance systems integrator ecosystem, including Guidewire and Duck Creek implementation partners.

• Experience selling AI, intelligent document processing or data platform solutions into regulated industries.

• Life sciences or public sector selling experience alongside insurance.

• Experience selling in Canada and Latin America as well as the United States.

What is in it for you
This is a rare shape of role: enough scale that the fundamentals exist, enough whitespace that you will build most of what matters, and a clear horizon to build toward. You will have direct access to the CEO and the Board, and your work will be visible in every conversation about the company’s value.
Adlib ’s headquarters are in Burlington, Ontario. This role is remote and based in the Americas, with a global remit. We care about employee health and wellness and build programs around personal and professional satisfaction. Our employee programs and benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Wellness and lifestyle spending account

• No limit vacation

• Extended maternity and paternity leave

• Employee assistance programs, and much more

To learn more about this role, please express your interest here, or follow us on LinkedIn for future opportunities.
Adlib seeks to inspire and nurture the human spirit. We understand that each person brings a distinct life experience to the table. Embracing diversity not only enhances our work culture, it drives business success. Adlib encourages applications from everybody, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

postings.descriptionText:
Who we are.

Newfold Digital is a leading web technology company serving millions of customers globally. Our customers know us through our robust portfolio of brands. What we’re looking for
We are looking for a hands on Senior Applied AI Engineer who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with practical AI problem solving. You will help build production AI experiences across Network Solutions, including conversational agents, business and website creation, knowledge and FAQ agents, content experiences, domain discovery, and intelligent automation.
You will work with senior engineers, architects, and product partners to turn customer and product problems into reliable, secure, observable, and cost efficient AI systems. This is an applied engineering role focused on building, measuring, and continuously improving real AI products.

What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark

• Translate product requirements into practical AI solutions using LLMs, RAG, tool calling, agents, deterministic workflows, or traditional software where appropriate.

• Build production AI services using Python, FastAPI, asynchronous workers, PostgreSQL, Redis, queues, model APIs, and external tools.

• Implement reliable tool calling agents and multi step workflows that interact with internal APIs, MCP tools, business systems, and knowledge sources.

• Build event driven workflows using RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or equivalent platforms, including retries, dead letter handling, idempotency, and failure recovery.

• Build and improve RAG systems covering ingestion, chunking, embeddings, hybrid retrieval, reranking, metadata filtering, context construction, and citations.

• Integrate models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, and open weight ecosystems, and help select models based on quality, latency, reliability, and cost.

• Build and run AI evaluations using curated datasets, regression tests, retrieval metrics, LLM as judge techniques, groundedness checks, and tool execution evaluation.

• Debug hallucinations, retrieval failures, incorrect tool usage, agent loops, latency issues, provider failures, and unexpected inference costs.

• Operate as an AI powered engineer using Cursor, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or equivalent coding agents to accelerate implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring, and documentation.

Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed

• 5 or more years of professional software engineering experience building production backend, distributed, or cloud based systems.

• At least 1 year of hands on experience building Applied AI, LLM, RAG, NLP, or agent based applications, with production experience strongly preferred.

• Strong Python skills including FastAPI, asynchronous programming, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy or SQLModel, and production API development.

• Good backend and distributed systems fundamentals including REST APIs, concurrency, background processing, caching, reliability, and production debugging.

• Hands on experience with RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or equivalent queue and messaging architectures is required.

• Hands on experience integrating LLM APIs and building structured output, function calling, tool calling, or agent execution workflows.

• Experience building or contributing to a RAG or knowledge grounded system, including retrieval, embeddings, indexing, context construction, and evaluation.

• Working knowledge of PostgreSQL and data modeling, with exposure to Redis, pgvector, vector databases, or hybrid search technologies.

• Demonstrated use of AI coding agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent tools as a regular part of software engineering work.

Nice to have.

• You should be comfortable going beyond a working demo and understand the core engineering patterns needed to make AI systems reliable in production.

• Understanding of prompting, structured outputs, tool schemas, context management, retries, fallbacks, rate limits, caching, and streaming responses.

• Ability to use experiments and evaluations to compare approaches using measurable outcomes rather than subjective testing alone.

• Understanding of retrieval quality, grounding, hallucination mitigation, prompt injection risks, tool authorization, and practical agent guardrails.

• Experience with Docker, CI/CD, automated testing, logging, observability, distributed tracing, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or similar tooling.

How you’ll work

• You will often receive a product goal or technical direction rather than a fully specified implementation.

• You should be able to break the problem into manageable pieces, validate assumptions, implement the solution, and work with senior engineers when architecture tradeoffs require discussion.

• Turn product goals into testable technical tasks and prototype alternatives when the best approach is not obvious.

• Choose simple, maintainable solutions and avoid using an agent or LLM when a deterministic approach solves the problem better.

• Measure quality, latency, reliability, safety, and cost and use those signals to improve the solution over time.

• Own implementation across APIs, workflows, data, queues, model integration, evaluations, observability, and production support for assigned features.

• Use AI coding agents aggressively to increase engineering velocity while preserving testing discipline, security, maintainability, and code quality.

What will make you stand out

• Experience with Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, PydanticAI, or equivalent agent frameworks.

• Experience building or consuming Model Context Protocol tools and servers, or working with model gateways such as LiteLLM.

• Experience with Azure AI Search, pgvector, Chroma, Kubernetes, Azure, OCI, or similar production AI platform technologies.

• Experience contributing to customer facing AI products, open weight model inference, AI safety controls, automated evaluations, or high scale backend platforms.

• Curiosity, strong problem solving, solid software engineering fundamentals, and the ability to learn quickly and turn ideas into reliable production features are the foundation for this role.

Join us to build the agent-powered backbone of our AI platform—robust, model agnostic, and ready for millions of users.

This Job Description is not an exhaustive list of all functions that the employee performing this job may be required to perform. postings.title: Marketing Manager, AI and Lifecycle (Mexico, Remote)
postings.descriptionText:
Marketing Manager, AI and Lifecycle

Company: Rove Next, by Rove Concepts

Location: Remote. Open across the Americas and Europe.
Hours: Full-time overlap with Pacific or Eastern time. This is a requirement, not a preference.

Type: Independent contractor, full-time

Apply: []
About the role

Rove Next is a new premium line from Rove Concepts , a Vancouver-based modern furniture brand selling direct to consumer across Canada and the US. Rove Next launches with improved versions of our best-selling pieces, and it needs its own marketing built from the ground up.

That's this role. You'll own how Rove Next reaches customers and keeps them, starting with email and lifecycle. The goal is a marketing function that scales through AI and systems rather than through headcount, and the advantage here is that you're building it clean rather than inheriting one.

This is not a coordination role. We need someone who takes a problem and builds the answer, and who catches things before they reach leadership.

Scope

Initially focused on Rove Next, with room to expand across the Rove Concepts group as the brand grows.

What you'll own

Email and lifecycle as our primary owned channel. Campaign calendar, flows, segmentation, deliverability, list health. We run on Klaviyo.

Quality control on everything that ships. Copy, creative, link destinations, offers, regional versions. If something goes out wrong, it was yours to catch.

Building AI into the daily work. Not proposing it, shipping it.

Working alongside our lifecycle and email team, our designers, and our external ads partner to keep the calendar moving.

Translating results into plain business language. What we spent, what we made, what we'd do differently.

Must-haves

Five or more years in ecommerce or DTC marketing with real ownership of email and lifecycle. Klaviyo or a comparable ESP.

Evidence that you build with AI yourself rather than assigning it. When you hit a wall, your instinct should be to build through it, not to raise a ticket and wait.

Fluent, native-level English, written and spoken. This one is non-negotiable. You will be writing copy that goes out to our customers under our name, so we need someone who can hear the difference between a line that sounds premium and one that sounds like a discount retailer.

A strong eye. You can look at an asset and tell whether the destination matches the promise, whether the tone is right, and whether the offer math actually adds up.

Comfortable being told when something isn't landing, and comfortable telling us the same.

Nice to have

Furniture, home, or another considered-purchase category with a long buying cycle. Shopify, GA4 and Meta Ads familiarity. Experience holding a team to brand guidelines.

What success looks like

Flow revenue grows as a share of total email revenue. Work stops reaching leadership with errors in it. AI is doing measurable work inside the function within 90 days, rather than sitting in a proposal.

Compensation

$3,500 to $4,500 USD per month depending on experience. Independent contractor.

How to apply

Send your CV to []. In a few lines, tell us two things:

One AI workflow or automation you built yourself in a real business. What it did, and what it saved.

One time you caught something before it shipped that nobody else had noticed.

Please also include a short voice note, around 60 seconds, introducing yourself and telling us what you'd want to know before writing your first email for us.

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a short paid project.

postings.descriptionText:
About Us
Ovation Law Firm is a fast-growing, consumer-focused law firm committed to delivering exceptional legal services while fostering a high-performance, accountable, and supportive workplace. As we continue to scale, we are building strong quality controls to ensure consistency, compliance, and excellence across every stage of the client lifecycle.

About the Role
We are seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Quality Assurance Specialist to support the firm’s QA function within the Intake Department. This role reports to the QA Manager and works closely with Intake Leadership and Training to ensure that every client interaction meets firm standards from the very first point of contact.
You will be responsible for monitoring and evaluating live and recorded intake calls, scoring interactions against predefined quality criteria and providing clear, actionable feedback to help intake agents continuously improve. Your work will directly impact compliance, client experience and the overall effectiveness of the intake process.
Strong English communication skills are essential for success in this role.

Key Responsibilities

• Monitor and evaluate live and recorded intake calls to assess agent performance, script adherence and compliance.

• Score calls using predefined quality criteria, ensuring consistency and objectivity in all evaluations.

• Ensure intake agents follow approved scripts, ask all required qualifying questions and provide accurate, compliant information to callers.

• Identify misleading statements, missed disclosures, compliance risks or deviations from firm standards.

• Provide clear, actionable feedback and coaching recommendations to the QA Manager, Intake Leadership and Training teams.

• Flag recurring errors, trends, and systemic quality issues observed across intake calls.

• Maintain detailed QA documentation, scorecards and audit trails for all evaluations completed.

• Track and report quality metrics and performance trends to the QA Manager on a regular cadence.

• Support the development and refinement of QA guidelines, evaluation forms and scoring benchmarks.

• Participate in calibration sessions to ensure alignment and consistency across the QA team.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives within the Intake Department.

Qualifications

• Bilingual (English/Spanish) with strong verbal and written communication skills in both languages (C1 level).

• At least 1 year of experience in quality assurance, call monitoring or customer service auditing, preferably in a law firm, call center or regulated environment.

• Strong analytical, listening, and critical-thinking skills with exceptional attention to detail.

• Ability to identify compliance risks and handle sensitive issues with professionalism and confidentiality.

• Experience providing structured, constructive feedback based on objective evaluation criteria.

• Tech-savvy, with hands-on experience using call monitoring tools, CRM systems and spreadsheets for tracking and reporting. Proficient in Microsoft Office, Slack and Google Workspace.

• Strong time management skills with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

Nice to Have

• Previous experience supporting legal teams or working in a law firm environment.

• Lemon law, consumer protection, or high-volume intake experience.

• Experience with QA scorecards, evaluation frameworks, or reporting dashboards.

• Familiarity with Salesforce, Five9 or similar CRM platforms.

Requirements

• Ability to work independently from a home office with stable, high-speed internet and a quiet, professional workspace.

• Must have a laptop or desktop computer with a minimum of 16GB RAM and an Intel Core i5 processor or higher.

• Must have a stable internet connection with a minimum speed of 50 Mbps.

• Availability to work during U.S. business hours (PST).

• Willingness to use time-tracking software.

What We Offer

• Earn $5-$6/hour.

• Competitive hourly pay based on skills and experience (full-time, 40 hours/week).

• 100% remote work environment.

• 6 paid time-off (PTO) days per year.

• Opportunity to work closely with leadership and legal professionals in a growing, modern law firm.

• Long-term growth and stability in a high-impact operational role.

This position is only open to candidates located in LATAM. Resumes must be submitted in English. Applications that do not meet these criteria will not be considered.

postings.descriptionText:
Overview

• At World Business Lenders (WBL), we provide flexible, short-term commercial loans backed by real estate to help small and medium-sized businesses across the United States, particularly those facing difficulties securing traditional financing.

• We are a fast-moving, results-driven organization focused on efficient execution, strong risk management, and protecting the company's collateral position.

About the Role

• The Closing Team Leader supports the day-to-day operations of the Closing function, helping ensure loans move efficiently from Clear-to-Close through funding while meeting quality standards, internal procedures, and required service-level agreements (SLAs).

• This role provides hands-on leadership, guidance, and support to Closing team members, monitors workload and pipeline performance, and helps resolve operational issues that may affect closing timelines or funding. The Closing Team Leader works closely with Title, Underwriting, Credit, Processing, Valuations, Legal, and Funding to ensure closing conditions are satisfied accurately and on time.

• The role also supports coordination with closing attorneys, title companies, settlement agents, and other third-party partners to facilitate timely closings and protect WBL's collateral position.

What Success Looks Like

• Maintain an organized, productive Closing Team with clear priorities and accountability.

• Ensure loans progress efficiently from Clear-to-Close through closing and funding, meeting established SLAs and quality standards.

• Promote accurate and complete closing documentation while minimizing delays and post-closing defects.

• Identify workflow bottlenecks, resolve routine operational issues, and escalate complex exceptions appropriately.

• Support effective coordination across internal departments and external partners while helping protect WBL's collateral position.

What You'll Be Doing

Closing Operations & Team Leadership

• Coordinate the day-to-day activities of the Closing Team, including workload distribution, task prioritization, and deadline management.

• Monitor the closing pipeline to ensure loans progress from Clear-to-Close through closing and funding.

• Provide guidance, coaching, training, and day-to-day support to Closing team members.

• Monitor team productivity, turnaround times, workload, and compliance with established SLAs.

• Follow up on outstanding closing conditions, missing documentation, and pending approvals.

• ·Review closing packages and related documentation for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with established procedures.

• Help ensure loan documents, settlement statements, payoff documentation, closing instructions, and funding conditions are properly addressed before closing.

• Assist team members in resolving routine closing issues and escalate complex exceptions when necessary.

• Coordinate with Underwriting, Credit, Processing, Valuations, Legal, Title, and Funding to address outstanding conditions and keep transactions on schedule.

• Communicate pipeline status, delays, risks, and operational concerns to management.

• Support onboarding and training for new team members and reinforce established procedures and performance expectations.

Title Coordination & Collateral Requirements

• Coordinate with the Title Team to ensure title clearance requirements are addressed before closing.

• Track outstanding title conditions, lien-related requirements, vesting issues, and other items that may affect closing readiness.

• Follow up on title commitments, title policies, lien searches, payoff information, and related documentation as needed.

• Help ensure title requirements and exceptions are resolved accurately and within established timelines.

• Coordinate with title specialists and escalate complex title defects, lien priority concerns, judgments, vesting issues, or other exceptions affecting collateral.

• Support the verification of requirements necessary to protect WBL's collateral interests and first-lien position.

• Communicate title-related delays and outstanding requirements to the appropriate internal stakeholders.

Attorney, Title & Settlement Partner Coordination

• Maintain day-to-day communication with closing attorneys, title companies, settlement agents, escrow providers, and other third-party partners.

• Follow up on pending documents, closing schedules, payoff statements, settlement figures, and other transaction requirements.

• Help resolve routine vendor and transaction-level issues that may affect closing timelines.

• Monitor partner responsiveness and communicate recurring service issues or delays to management.

• Support positive working relationships with external partners to improve coordination, turnaround times, and closing quality.

Process Improvement & Quality Control

• Follow established SOPs, checklists, workflows, and documentation standards.

• Identify recurring errors, process gaps, and workflow bottlenecks and recommend practical improvements to management.

• Perform quality checks on closing documentation and ensure identified issues are addressed before closing or funding.

• Monitor outstanding items, recurring defects, and operational trends.

• Support corrective actions and process updates designed to improve accuracy, efficiency, and consistency.

• Help maintain accurate pipeline records, transaction notes, and reporting.

• Reinforce consistent application of procedures and quality standards across the team.

Compliance & Risk Management

• Ensure day-to-day Closing activities follow company policies, established procedures, applicable legal requirements, and relevant investor requirements.

• Verify that required closing conditions and documentation are addressed before loans proceed to closing and funding.

• Identify and escalate potential legal, title, documentation, lien, and collateral risks.

• Follow established escalation procedures for exceptions, unresolved conditions, and transactions requiring additional review or approval.

• Work with Legal, Title, and other relevant stakeholders to help resolve issues while protecting WBL's collateral position.

• Maintain appropriate documentation and communication records in accordance with company procedures.

Requirements

Education

Required Experience

• 5+ years of experience in mortgage or commercial lending closing, title, escrow, settlement, or related lending operations preferred.

• Previous experience providing day-to-day guidance, training, workflow coordination, or operational support to team members.

• Experience managing loan pipelines, closing deadlines, and service-level requirements.

• Experience reviewing loan documentation, title commitments, settlement statements, payoff documentation, and closing requirements.

• Experience coordinating with closing attorneys, title companies, settlement agents, and internal lending departments.

Must-Have Requirements

• Strong knowledge of loan closing, title clearance, collateral documentation, and real estate-secured lending.

Preferred Background / Industry Experience

Specific Technical Skills Needed

postings.title: Senior SDET, Agentic Quality
postings.descriptionText:
About Onfleet

Onfleet ’s mission is to power the future of commerce by enabling businesses of all sizes to move goods more efficiently and delightfully . Our product includes intuitive smartphone apps for drivers, a powerful modern web dashboard for logistics teams, and automatic notifications and real-time tracking for recipients. Onfleet powers millions of deliveries every week for thousands of businesses around the world across a range of industries, from grocery and prepared meals to pharmacy, flowers, and furniture.

About the role

Onfleet is hiring two senior SDETs to shape how our engineering teams build and trust automated quality. At Onfleet , the team that builds a feature owns its quality. Developers write and maintain their own tests. Your job is to make those teams better at it: you pair with them, teach, review, and find the cases they missed. You will not be the person who tests everyone else's work.

Together with our quality leads, you’ll own our test frameworks and the shared quality tooling every team depends on. You’ll also do feature development in production code and internal tooling. You’ll be part of our core quality engineering group, sometimes embedded on one team and sometimes working across several.

You’ll start by taking ownership of our existing automation and making it more reliable and complete, alongside greenfield work on new platform services. We measure this role by what the teams can do because you were there.

How We Work

We code using agents, and nearly 100% of our code is written this way. Generating code is the easy part. Knowing what good looks like, and holding the bar, is the job. The engineers who thrive here are scrutinizing and questioning: they reject AI slop and catch the wrong call before it ships.

Every engineer helps improve how we work instead of only following it. For this role that means building and improving the agentic tooling itself: test generation, review, verification, and the workflows around them.

We are candid and have a low ego. Challenge us on tooling direction, and expect to be challenged back.

What You’ll Do:

•
Strengthen the current suite. Improve reliability, extend coverage, and modernize patterns. A flaky test is a failing test.

•
Own the test frameworks. Unit, integration, and end-to-end, treated with the same care as production code.

•
Own the quality gates in CI/CD (continuous integration and continuous delivery). Pipelines, checks, and gates, so standards are enforced by the system and not by people.

•
Build agentic quality tooling. Extend the agents and workflows we use for test design, review, and verification.

•
Raise the bar through teams. Pair on test design, review code, help make hard-to-reach code testable, and write things down so the practice outlives any one person.

•
Ask the testability question early. In planning, ask how we'll test it and how we'll know it broke in production.

•
Know when a release is healthy. Metrics, dashboards and alerts that tell us something is wrong before a customer does, and that tell a team whether a release is safe to keep rolling out.

•
Ship features. Full-stack work in production code and internal tooling, alongside the teams you support.

What You'll Bring (required):

• 8 or more years of professional software development experience, in any role.

• 5 or more years where building and maintaining test automation was a core part of your job, as an SDET, test automation engineer, or software engineer who owned test infrastructure. Your title matters less than the work.

• You build software, not just tests: test frameworks, internal tools, CI tooling, or product features. You want feature development in production code and internal tooling to be part of your job here.

• Depth across unit, integration, and end-to-end testing, including hands-on work with a browser framework such as Playwright or Cypress.

• Hands-on CI ownership: you have created, configured, or fixed a CI pipeline (GitHub Actions or equivalent), not just used one.

• A track record of being the person who drove automated test coverage on a team, whatever your role was.

• Working knowledge of DevOps practice: how code is built, deployed and monitored in production. You have added metrics, dashboards or alerts so a team knew when something broke.

• Daily professional use of AI coding agents, and experience building or improving agentic tooling, not just using it.

• A multiplier mindset: you get your satisfaction from the team shipping safer and faster, not from your own test count.

• Excellent written and spoken English, roughly C1 level, and experience working day to day on an international team.

Nice To Have:

• Mobile development (Android or iOS) and mobile test automation, using native frameworks such as Espresso or XCUITest, or cross-platform tools such as Appium or Maestro.

• TypeScript, Node.js, and React.

• Rust, or another statically typed language.

• Clear evidence of driving CI/CD practice for a whole team or company.

• Production canaries and progressive delivery: you have used production signals (error rates, latency, business metrics) to decide whether a release continues or rolls back, through canaries, feature flags or automated rollback.

• Test data and environment management: getting a realistic system into a known state quickly and repeatably.

• Test-driven development (TDD).

• AWS and cloud-native services.

Location and Benefits:

• Remote, open to candidates based in Canada or Latin America.

• The team works on US Pacific Time. You'll need to reliably work a schedule that frequently matches US Pacific business hours (9am to 5pm PT).

• Flexible PTO.

• Laptop and work-from-home setup stipend.

• Monthly technology stipends (internet and AI tooling).

Onfleet is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Onfleet 's culture is one that strongly values diversity in its workplace and we are committed to working with potential team members who can bring diverse perspectives and experience to our company and culture.

We do not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state or federal law.

We highly encourage members of underrepresented groups to apply and we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $70,000 to $95,000 USD per year for candidates in both Canada and Latin America, depending on experience, skills, and background. Where an offer lands within that range reflects the depth and experience a candidate brings to the role.

How We Hire

You need an identity-verified LinkedIn profile to apply. That's the free "Verified" badge, the shield icon next to your name. We check for it, and applications without it don't move forward.

Before any offer, we verify your identity and work history. That includes a live video ID check and reference calls. We use AI, automated systems, and a person to review applications: every application that meets the requirements is also read by an engineering leader or a recruiter. If you misrepresent your identity or experience, the process ends.

postings.title: Senior Performance Creative Editor (Contract)
postings.descriptionText:
Senior Performance Creative Editor (Contract)
Everyday Dose · Remote, Europe or Latin America · $4,000-5,000 USD/month · Contract
We sell mushroom coffee direct to consumers. Paid ads on Meta and Google are how we grow, and the creative is the variable that decides whether it works. We test continuously and we measure what wins, so the feedback you get here is specific rather than taste-based.
Our creative strategists write the scripts and own the angle. You own the execution and, specifically, the first five seconds. You will ship 15 to 25 finished ads a month, deliberately fewer than most performance shops expect, because we would rather you spend the hours deciding what to change than cutting another variant nobody learns from.

What you will do

•
Cut paid ads for Meta and Google from scripts and angles handed to you by a strategist. Vertical, sound-on, short, fast-paced.

•
Own the hook. The script arrives written; the first five seconds are your call. We have firm views, built from our own account data, about which openers work for this product and which quietly kill a good ad. You will learn them in week one, apply them without being asked, and argue when one is wrong.

•
Iterate winners, not only originate. Most of your month is making something that already works work harder, which in our testing beats originating from scratch by a wide margin.

•
Build variants that change one thing on purpose. We have burned whole quarters on same-day copies that duplicated instead of testing. A variant that teaches us nothing is worse than no variant.

•
Read your own numbers. You get access to our creative analytics and attribution tools, and your output is measured. You bring reads to the weekly creative review rather than waiting to be told what lost.

Requirements

What we are looking for
Three or more years cutting ads that ran on a paid account. We care about what you have shipped, not your title.

Required

•
Paid ads as the spine of your work. You can name a brand that spent money distributing something you cut.

•
A performance number you personally moved on a specific piece of creative, before and after.

•
You know which metrics decide and which mislead. An ad is judged on spend and acquisition cost over its first week, not on thumbstop or hold rate. Plenty of good editors optimise for retention and engagement because those are the numbers they are shown. We will ask you which metrics you have actually been held to and what you think they do and do not predict. There is a right answer and it is not the obvious one.

•
AI creation, fluently and invisibly. Generative tooling is how you hit variant volume at this cadence: image and video generation, voice, upscaling, automated captioning and reframing. The bar is output nobody can tell was generated. We are not buying AI-looking content, we are buying your speed.

•
Premiere or DaVinci to a professional standard , plus After Effects or CapCut. You finish your own sound.

• English good enough to argue with a media buyer about why a hook is wrong.

• Your own machine, reliable internet, a quiet place to take a call.

Strongly preferred

• Supplements, wellness, beverage, beauty or DTC subscription. Our claims language is regulated.

• Range across the formats direct response actually runs on: offer-led creative, objection and confession openers, and one person talking to camera. Tell us which you are strongest in.

• Creative analytics tooling such as Motion, Triple Whale or Northbeam.

• Cutting from creator and UGC footage, including the unglamorous work of making mediocre raw material perform.

Not required: a degree, a cinematic showreel, agency names on your resume, or managing anyone. Senior here means judgment, not headcount.

Before you apply
We decline a lot of genuinely skilled editors who have never cut a direct-response ad. That wastes everyone's time, so, plainly:
Not a fit if your portfolio is mainly corporate or internal communications, brand films, weddings and events, news or broadcast, documentary, event recaps and sizzle reels, music videos, real estate, podcast production, long-form YouTube, or B2B training. Those are real crafts and close to the opposite problem: a beautiful 90-second brand film and an ad that holds a stranger for three seconds and sells coffee are not the same skill.
The test: can you name a brand that paid to distribute something you cut, and the metric you were judged on? If the honest answer is that you have made great videos but nobody bought media against them, this seat will not work, and we would rather say so now than after two interviews.
One more thing. A cover letter that repeats this posting back to us reads exactly as it sounds. Tell us about your work instead.

Benefits

Compensation
$3,500-5,000 USD per month, depending on experience and portfolio

Engagement
Independent contractor, ongoing, invoiced monthly.

Location
Remote, anywhere in Europe or Latin America. You are responsible for your own taxes and any local registration.

Hours
Async by default. We ask for 2-3 hours of daily overlap with Austin, Texas (Central Time) for the creative review and buyer conversations. You choose which hours.

Commitment
Full-time equivalent effort. We are not looking for someone fitting this between three other clients.

Equipment
Yours. We provide software seats (Adobe CC, Motion, Frame.io) and all footage, product and creator assets.

Email and lifecycle as our primary owned channel. Campaign calendar, flows, segmentation, deliverability, list health. We run on Klaviyo.

Translating results into plain business language. What we spent, what we made, what we'd do differently.

Five or more years in ecommerce or DTC marketing with real ownership of email and lifecycle. Klaviyo or a comparable ESP.

Evidence that you build with AI yourself rather than assigning it. When you hit a wall, your instinct should be to build through it, not to raise a ticket and wait.

Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. The Opportunity

We're hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer to build the AI-native, self-service infrastructure platform that powers how Luxury Presence ships software. It's a platform where every developer, human or agent, can validate a change in minutes, understand failures immediately, and ship confidently.

You'll join a small, high-leverage Infrastructure team with a clear mandate: multiply what every engineer and agent can do through automation, self-service, and guardrails-by-design. The goal is a platform where self-service is the default and human intervention is the exception, and you'll help make that real.

What You'll Do

• Build and operate the self-service infrastructure platform. Make the right thing the easy thing, and the secure thing the default.

• Build the golden paths engineers and agents ship on. Within a technical direction set by the team's Staff engineers, build and operate the layers they rely on (a unified CI/CD pipeline, GitOps-based delivery with ArgoCD, an IaC module catalog, and scaffolding for new services), owning specific components end to end. The goal is for engineers and agents to provision infrastructure and ship changes within guardrails, without hand-writing Terraform/Kustomize or waiting on a ticket.

• Make agents first-class developers. Help generalize our agent isolation pattern into reusable platform primitives: sandboxed runtime, workload identity, audit trails, and approval gates. Every agent action runs on the same identity, audit, ownership, cost-attribution, and approval rails as a human.

• Build and operate the validation platform and quality gates. Provide the rails that teams validate changes on before production: ephemeral PR environments with auto-teardown, plus the security, performance, and load-testing gates developers rely on. Implement new gates as coverage grows, keep them fast and low-flake, and drive services onto them. Make gate and test results machine-readable and callable outside the PR flow, so agents and humans alike can act on a failure directly.

• Own the reliability and observability of what you build. Create the dashboards and operational controls that make the surfaces you own observable and improvable as throughput grows: gate pass rates, approval-rate and self-service-ratio trends, common failure modes, cost attribution, and DORA metrics surfaced to teams. Carry on-call for those surfaces and run incidents from detection through follow-up, turning recurring toil into automation and runbooks other engineers reuse.

What We're Looking For

• Senior-level experience in SRE, DevOps, or Platform Engineering. You've built and operated production infrastructure at scale and can own a significant workstream end to end with limited oversight.

• An active, opinionated use of AI development tools (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) in your own infrastructure workflow: Terraform changes, Kubernetes debugging, automation, operational investigations. You have a point of view on where these tools help and where they don't.

• Deep Kubernetes (EKS) and AWS experience (IAM, VPC, ECR, SSM/Secrets Manager, S3, SQS, Lambda, RDS/Aurora).

• Strong IaC (Terraform) and GitOps experience, including PR-driven apply workflows (Atlantis or similar) and ArgoCD.

• CI/CD depth (GitHub Actions), including caching/parallelism, artifact management, test reliability, and pipeline observability.

• Full incident-ownership experience: you've carried on-call for systems you built and driven incidents from detection through follow-up.

• Excellent cross-team communication: you can translate platform constraints into developer-friendly solutions and documentation.

Bonus Points

• Identity, access, and policy-as-code experience: workload/service identity (SPIFFE/SPIRE, OIDC), short-lived credentials, secrets management (Vault), and policy enforcement.

• Experience building self-service developer platforms, ephemeral environments, CLIs, scaffolding tools, or internal developer portals (Backstage or custom). You treat infrastructure as a product.

• Cost-awareness: you've built cost attribution, budgets, or rightsizing into a platform.

Our Tech Stack

Infrastructure: AWS, EKS, Terraform (with Atlantis), Vault, Docker, OPA (Open Policy Agent).

CI/CD: GitHub Actions, ArgoCD + Kustomize (GitOps).

Messaging: Kafka (Confluent Cloud).

Observability: Datadog, OpenTelemetry.

Languages/Apps: Node.js/TypeScript microservices, Python, React front-ends.
