postings.title: Compliance Data and Reporting Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Value Proposition
Our values define us and our culture inspires us to change lives for the better. Our employees are the heart and soul of our company, and every success we experience begins with them. Together we are committed to making a positive impact in our local communities. We champion a culture of continuous learning, work-life integration, and inclusion. We promote a digitally enabled work environment to continuously enhance the experience of our employees and customers.

Overview
This full-time position is remote and open to candidates residing within the Mid and South-Atlantic region . Travel to the corporate headquarters in Lancaster, PA will be required on an as-needed basis.
The primary responsibility of this role is to support the Consumer Compliance Department and Program through the development, implementation and delivery of reports, dashboards and metric-level analysis to identify, assess, monitor and report consumer compliance risk. The incumbent partners with Enterprise Risk Management, Business Lines, Internal Audit, and Technology teams to develop reporting and analytics supporting compliance monitoring and testing, complaint management, fair lending, Community Reinvestment Act (CRA), Unfair, Deceptive, or Abusive Acts or Practices (UDAAP) and regulatory change management activities. This role is responsible for ensuring the integrity and governance of compliance data utilized in risk assessments, issue management, examination management, regulatory reporting and other compliance programs. The incumbent translates complex datasets into conclusions and actionable insights support consumer compliance risk management, risk assessment, GRC reporting, regulatory compliance, and the ongoing effectiveness of the Consumer Compliance Management System (CMS).

Responsibilities

• Source, compile, convert, organize and transfer data from various sources and advise Department on data design, extraction and interpretation in support of Department’s execution of associated Compliance Management programs.

• Develop, maintain, and analyze key risk indicators (KRIs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and compliance metrics used to monitor consumer compliance risk across products, services, channels, and third-party relationships.

• Analyze trends, identify patterns, and develop data-driven recommendations to improve compliance outcomes.

• Identify, develop, document and deliver data analysis by importing, transforming, cleansing, validating data files, etc. and applying knowledge of other critical requirements as appropriate. Design, create and maintain consumer compliance dashboards and reporting, supporting Compliance Monitoring and Testing, Complaints, Issue Management, Regulatory Change Management, CRA, Fair Lending, UDAAP and other data related to compliance programs.

• Support the Consumer Compliance Monitoring and Testing and Risk Assessment functions by providing validated data populations, exception reporting, trend analysis, and other tracking metrics.

• Determine the optimal mode of delivery based on requesting party’s need, i.e. custom reports, Power BI, dashboards/visualization, graphs, tables, tabular reports, etc.

• Collaborate with IT data team, other members of the Compliance Department, and data analysts throughout the organization to understand data structure, methodology and tools, gain appropriate access to required data, and issue resolution and provide technical expertise regarding compliance data and reporting outputs.

• Ensure that appropriate validation and controls are built into data related processes to ensure that compliance data integrity is maintained. Lead and perform this effort with other team members as appropriate to ensure consistency and documentation of validation efforts for each project.

• Coordinate efforts with third party vendors as well as Lines of Businesses for identifying, changing, mapping, and testing data files and fields. Work with applicable business functions to ensure accurate data models and reporting output.

• Provide comprehensive operational, analytical, and technical support for projects that impact the corporate use of technology by advocating for the use of technology and reporting within the department to improve processes, controls, and reporting. Make recommendations to department management regarding projects as a technical resource during system enhancement reviews, consolidations/acquisitions, and other projects as needed.

• Regularly monitor data to identify changes needed and develop recommendations for leadership consideration while drawing attention to trends observed and data anomalies. Enhance existing processes and reporting and analysis through automation, ongoing presentations and visualization enhancements, and conversations with key stakeholders.

• Represent the Department in meetings, focus groups, projects, etc. regarding data and reporting that is needed, used or produced by the Department. Provide insight and guidance regarding Department’s data sourcing, structure and usage to ensure stakeholders’ understanding of the data output.

• Serve as the data advocate for the Department to ensure needs are being met.

• Promote the use of data analytics and related tools to internal staff, identify and communicate opportunities for technology-based enhancements, stay abreast of current and emerging industry and technology trends and the regulatory landscape.

Additional Responsibilities

• May serve as back-up administrator for Department-related tools and platforms.

Qualifications

Education
Bachelor's Degree or the equivalent experience. Specialty: data analytics, data science, computer science. (Preferred)

Experience
5 or more years data analysis, report development and familiarity with banking-related systems/databases in support of Audit or Compliance Testing. (Required)
5 or more years banking operations, compliance operations, banking/compliance systems reporting/data management or data analysis experience. (Preferred)
Strong experience with business intelligence tools such as PowerBI, Tableau or similar tools (Required)

Certifications
CRCM or other relevant certification/credentials. (Preferred)

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Ability to maintain a growth mindset and adjust effectively to change (Required)

• Ability to convey verbal and/or written information and ideas clearly, concisely and professionally to individuals or groups (Required)

• Ability to work cooperatively with others in order to achieve common goals both internally and with external departments (Required)

• Proficiency in mathematics, statistics, data analytics, data visualization (Preferred)

• Strong analytical and technology skills with tools such as Excel, SharePoint or One Drive (Preferred)

• Experience with Python, Java, SQL ACL or other programming language (Preferred)

Other Duties as Assigned by Manager
This role may perform other job duties as assigned by the manager. Each employee of the Organization, regardless of position, is accountable for reading, understanding and acting on the contents of all Company-assigned and/or job related Compliance Programs, regulations and policies and procedures, as well as ensure that all Compliance Training assignments are completed by established due dates. This includes but is not limited to, understanding and identifying compliance risks impacting their department(s), ensuring compliance with applicable laws or regulations, and escalating compliance risks to the appropriate level of management.

Pay Transparency
To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges on all job postings regardless of state. We set standard salary ranges for our roles based on the position, function, and responsibilities, as benchmarked against similarly sized companies in our industry. Specific compensation offered will be determined based on a combination of factors including the candidate’s knowledge, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials. The salary range may vary based on geographic location.
The salary range for this position is $72,500.00 - $120,800.00 annually.

Additional Compensation Components
This job is eligible to participate in a short-term incentive compensation plan subject to individual and company performance.

Benefits
Additionally, as part of our Total Rewards program, Fulton Bank offers a comprehensive benefits package to those who qualify. This includes medical plans with prescription drug coverage; flexible spending account or health savings account depending on the medical plan chosen; dental and vision insurance; life insurance; 401(k) program with employer match and Employee Stock Purchase Plan; paid time off programs including holiday pay and paid volunteer time; disability insurance coverage and maternity and parental leave; adoption assistance; educational assistance and a robust wellness program with financial incentives. To learn more about your potential eligibility for these programs, please visit Benefits & Wellness | Fulton Bank .

EEO Statement
Fulton Bank (“Fulton”) is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all qualified persons. Fulton will recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles, and ensure that all other personnel actions are administered, without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, gender, gender identity, age, genetic information, marital status, disability, covered veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Operations Associate – HubSpot CRM, Deal Pipeline & Excel Reporting | Remote
Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Eastern Time (EST)
Location: South Africa or Latin America

About the Role
At Pavago , one of our clients is hiring a highly organized Operations Associate to keep a high-value deal pipeline accurate, structured, and consistently moving forward.
This is not a traditional finance, investment banking, or sales role. You won’t be responsible for complex financial modeling, sourcing deals, or hitting sales quotas. Instead, your focus will be on execution, HubSpot CRM management, reporting, deal coordination, and consistent follow-through .
You’ll own the operational details behind long, 6–12 month deal cycles , ensuring every opportunity, follow-up, next step, meeting, and task is properly tracked and completed.
If you’re experienced with HubSpot, comfortable with Excel, and naturally make sure nothing falls through the cracks, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

• Pitch materials

• Deal tracking

• CRM updates

• Tasks

• Follow-ups

• Pipeline management

• Intermediate Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets skills, including:

• Formatting

• Strong written English communication skills

• Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills

• Ability to work during U.S. Eastern Time (EST) business hours

• Deal-based environments

• Experience supporting founders or senior executives

• Experience supporting long-cycle transactions or opportunities

Tools & Technology
HubSpot | Microsoft Excel | Google Sheets | Calendar & Scheduling Tools | Internal Deal Tracking Systems

What Makes You a Strong Fit
You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

• Are exceptionally organized and detail-oriented

• Follow through without needing repeated reminders

• Are comfortable managing high-volume, repetitive follow-ups

• Notice when deals, tasks, or communications are becoming stale

• Enjoy maintaining clean systems and structured processes

• Communicate professionally and clearly in writing

• Are dependable with recurring operational work

• Proactively flag issues instead of waiting for someone else to notice them

• Take ownership of tasks through completion

• Understand that small operational details can have a significant impact on long-cycle deals

What a Typical Day Looks Like
You’ll start by reviewing HubSpot for new activity, overdue tasks, outstanding follow-ups, and deals requiring attention.
Throughout the day, you’ll send professional follow-ups, update deal stages and notes, maintain Excel and Google Sheets trackers, coordinate meetings, organize deal information, and prepare reports or materials for leadership.
You’ll also regularly review the pipeline for opportunities that have stalled and proactively ensure the appropriate next step happens.
In short: you keep the deal pipeline clean, organized, and moving so leadership never has to chase updates or wonder what happens next.

Key Metrics for Success

• CRM data accuracy and completeness

• Percentage of follow-ups completed on time

• Number of overdue or missed tasks

• Deal pipeline accuracy

• Reporting accuracy and timeliness

• Reduction in stale or unattended opportunities

• Accuracy of Excel and Google Sheets trackers

Why This Role Stands Out

• Clear, structured responsibilities and measurable outcomes

• Hands-on experience with HubSpot and deal operations

Apply Now
If you’re highly organized, experienced with HubSpot CRM , comfortable working in Excel and Google Sheets , and relentless about following through until every task is complete, we’d love to hear from you.
Apply today and become the operational engine that keeps high-value deals organized, accurately tracked, and consistently moving forward .

🌍 100% Remote (Priority Regions: South Africa, Latin America, & Europe)

Since 2013, THE/STUDIO has been building the definitive operating system for product creation. We are combining modern SaaS technology with custom manufacturing to make producing physical goods as seamless, fast, and scalable as launching software.
We operate two core platforms: Customize Now (our best-in-class, on-demand manufacturing platform) and Source Anything (our new SaaS product that enables customers to seamlessly work with global factories beyond our own network).

💻 The Role
We are looking for a high-energy, consultative Inside Sales Representatives to own our inbound engine. You will manage a high-volume, high-velocity stream of inbound opportunities. We call them Creative Specialist. You aren't just an order-taker or customer support rep; you are a trusted advisor who uncovers deep client needs, closes the initial deal with urgency, and actively nurtures accounts to maximize repeat business.

🎯 What You’ll Do

• Consult & Close: Own the full inbound sales cycle. Guide inbound leads through their production journey, confidently handle objections, and position THE/STUDIO as the premier alternative to "cheap but risky" sourcing options.

• Nurture the Engine: Go beyond the one-off sale. Build and manage your own healthy book of repeat accounts, turning initial inbound buyers into long-term partners.

• Direct Access to Leadership: You will have the opportunity to work directly with our CEO and executive team, giving you high visibility, direct mentorship, and a seat at the table.

• Product & Strategic Influence: We operate with flat hierarchies. Your daily insights from the ground level will directly shape our product roadmap, workflows, and company strategy.

• Rapid Scale & Career Trajectory: We are growing rapidly. Joining us right now means high autonomy, minimal red tape, and massive room for personal and professional acceleration.

💡 The Profile We’re Looking For (Our Core Pillars)
Our Founder/CEO defines our top performers by three distinct traits. If this describes how you operate, you will thrive here:

• Raw Intelligence & Problem-Solving: High processing power, business acumen, and logical reasoning. You can think on your feet, connect complex ideas, and break down ambiguous problems quickly.

• "Give a Shit" Energy (Extreme Ownership): You take 100% accountability for your domain and outcomes. You don't make excuses or blame external factors. You look inward, find solutions, and push across the finish line.

• Rapid Adaptation & Radical Candor: You embrace blunt, constructive feedback and pivot instantly without ego. You excel in a fast-moving environment where you need to act with urgency without waiting for hand-holding.

🧩 What You Bring

• 2–5 years of recent, quota-carrying sales experience (Account Executive or consultative Inside Sales experience preferred).

• Remote Infrastructure: Laptop/desktop (8GB+ RAM), stable internet connection (10+ Mbps), and a quiet, professional workspace for calls.

Note that every role is different, so the process may vary depending on the requirements of the role. Please note that due to the volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide feedback to all applications.

postings.title: Senior Customer Marketing Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Company Overview:
At Panopto , we are the most customer-centric learning technology company in the world. As the leader in visual and audio-based learning , we empower organizations to share knowledge effortlessly in a capture and post-capture world. We don’t just build software; we obsess over our users’ goals to deliver solutions that truly matter. Our mission is simple: to attract the brightest talent, people like you, to Elevate the Craft and do the most impactful work of your career.

To enhance our team we are seeking an experienced Senior Customer Marketing Manager.

Position Summary

In this role, you will have the opportunity to do meaningful work in your career, elevating your craft while contributing to a team that values lifelong learning.

Panopto is seeking an experienced, strategic, and hands-on Senior Customer Marketing Manager to establish and grow our customer marketing function. As the foundational hire in this area, you will assess existing activities, define priorities, and build repeatable programs that turn customer success into compelling proof, strengthen engagement, and support retention and expansion opportunities.

Working closely with Product Marketing, Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, and cross-functional marketing partners, you will balance strategy and hands-on execution, establishing the relationships, processes, and measurement practices needed to scale customer marketing over time.

You'll also have opportunities to contribute to other initiatives that directly advance our core values and support you in elevating your craft.

How You’ll Contribute

In this role, you will have the opportunity to…

• Customer marketing strategy and program development: Establish the foundation of Panopto ’s customer marketing function by evaluating current activities, defining priorities, creating scalable processes, and setting program goals and measurement practices.

• Customer storytelling and advocacy: Own the customer storytelling program, identifying and cultivating advocates across key industries, use cases, and segments. Source and draft case studies, testimonials, customer quotes, video stories, and quantified outcome narratives that serve marketing and sales needs.

• Strategic customer proof: Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to identify evidence gaps and prioritize stories aligned with go-to-market priorities, product launches, and competitive differentiation.

• Customer reference program: Build and maintain a scalable customer reference program and process to match customer advocates with relevant sales opportunities. Establish permissions, approvals, and reference-use guidelines.

• Customer lifecycle and expansion programs: In partnership with Product Marketing, Account Management, and Demand Gen teams, assess opportunities and develop targeted engagement, adoption, and expansion campaigns, prioritizing efforts based on business needs and available customer data.

• Customer communications: Own the customer marketing communications calendar, including newsletters, advocacy invitations, customer-only events, and campaign communications. Partner with Product Marketing on the positioning and messaging for product-related communications to the customer base.

• Review and advocacy platforms: Manage relevant third-party review and customer advocacy initiatives, including platforms such as G2, based on business priorities and measurable value.

• Customer insights and measurement: Use customer feedback, NPS/CSAT trends, engagement data, and input from Customer Success to inform priorities, identify advocates, and track progress.

• Systems and operational collaboration: Partner with Marketing Operations and RevOps to evaluate and improve the processes, data, and systems that enable customer marketing, including marketing automation, segmentation, and reference management.

What Success Looks Like

• Within 45 Days: Assess current customer marketing activities, stakeholder needs, customer proof and reference processes, and operational capabilities; establish initial benchmarks and a prioritized roadmap; deliver high-value early wins.

• Within 3 Months: Launch repeatable advocacy and customer storytelling programs, pilot targeted engagement initiatives with cross-functional partners, and establish practical reporting and operating processes.

• Within 6 Months: Demonstrate measurable contributions from customer advocacy and engagement initiatives, establish a sustainable customer marketing operating model, and use results to recommend the next stage of program growth.

Values in Action

• Customer First, Always : You proactively surface friction points in the customer experience before they are escalated — and propose solutions, not just reports.

• Thrive Together : You share work-in-progress for early feedback, knowing that challenge improves the outcome. You separate critiques of ideas from critiques of people.

• Elevate the Craft : You hold the bar high on your own work and invest in developing those around you. You treat every project as an opportunity to learn something new.

• Act with Ownership : You define success by outcomes, not activity. You flag problems early and bring a proposed path forward, not just the problem.

• Clarity Over Complexity : You default to the simpler solution. Your written communication — internal or external — is direct, specific, and free of filler.

How We Thrive

You will join a team that values clarity, ownership, and continuous improvement. We balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and work collaboratively to achieve measurable business outcomes. We value different perspectives, thoughtful feedback, and a shared commitment to customer success.

The Foundation for Success

• Experience: 5+ years of B2B SaaS marketing, including 3+ years in customer marketing, advocacy, or lifecycle marketing; demonstrated ownership of customer-facing programs.

• Storytelling: Exceptional writing and interviewing skills, with examples of customer stories that translate technical or business outcomes into persuasive, evidence-based narratives.

• Program development: Demonstrated experience establishing or scaling customer marketing programs, defining strategy and operating processes, aligning stakeholders, and delivering results with limited existing infrastructure.

• Cross-functional partnership: Ability to collaborate effectively with Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, Product Marketing, and Marketing Operations.

• Measurement and execution: Strong project management skills and experience defining meaningful KPIs, evaluating campaign performance, and communicating business contributions.

What Sets You Apart

• Growth and expansion marketing: Experience supporting customer adoption, cross-sell or upsell campaigns in mid-market or enterprise SaaS.

Most paid ads ask a stranger to trust a claim. This company’s ads don’t have to.
Every ad from this company points to one action: run the free scan. A business owner enters their website address, and in under 90 seconds, the company’s scanner shows what their own site is doing right now: trackers firing before anyone has consented, AI running without disclosure, and missing legal pages. They get the report. Then they decide what to do about it. That is a clean funnel with a real hook: ad, scan, report, plan. Your job is to fill the top of it, make every step convert better than last month, and prove it with numbers.

Who they are:

They find the hidden risks on websites, fixes them, and keeps the proof. Businesses hire them to check their site against the rules that now apply to tracking and AI, fix what is broken, and show the proof with a live trust badge that their customers, partners and insurance carrier can check. If the site stops passing, the badge shows it. That last part is why people believe it.

They are a small, remote team spread across the US, Latin America, and Europe, with roughly half a dozen people. Engineering, client experience, marketing, and sales are all one message away from each other and the founder. Decisions get made in hours, not quarters. The founder has built and sold three companies, has been a licensed attorney since 1999, and has written four books, with a fifth on the way. You will work with him directly, not through three layers.

What you would be marketing:

• The free scan. Ten checks on any website, free to the public. It is the front door for almost every customer we have.

• They earned plans. Tiered subscriptions with a monthly re-scan, the fixes that follow, and a live trust badge that stays honest.

• They Consent. Their own consent platform. It controls which scripts run before a visitor agrees and keeps the records that prove consent was given.

• Their partner program. Agencies and affiliates who send their clients to us and earn commission. They want finished, ready-to-send material, and you will help keep it that way.

One more thing worth saying up front: they sell consent and tracking done right. Their own pixels, tags and audiences have to be clean too. If you have only ever run tracking the loose way, you will learn the right way here, and it will make you better at this job anywhere.

The role:

Paid ads are the core of this job, roughly two-thirds of your week. The rest is the marketing those ads depend on: content, organic, brand and partner support. On a lean team, the person who is good at ads is directly involved in all of it.

• Run paid acquisition. Plan, build, launch and manage campaigns in Meta and/or Google. You own the budgets, audiences, bidding and testing calendar.

• Own the ad accounts. Manage our Meta Business account and/or Google Ads account: users, pixels, conversion events, domains, billing and policy issues.

• Make the ads. Write the copy and build the creative: static, carousel and short video. You will use AI tools and their brand design system to produce more variations, faster.

• Own the numbers . Cost per scan, cost per signup, customer acquisition cost and return on ad spend. Report them weekly in plain words, cut losers fast and scale winners.

• Improve the funnel. Work with engineering on landing and offer pages, and with sales on follow-up sequences in GoHighLevel, so more scans turn into customers.

• Support organic and partners . Help with LinkedIn, blog and email content, and keep partner materials current. Their brand voice and approved words matter, and you will learn them.

• Use AI every day . Research, drafts, ad variations, analysis. They build with AI on purpose, and we expect you to bring new ways to use it.

• Show up to the 10:00 AM ET standup . Fifteen minutes, whole team, what moved and what is stuck.

Requirements

Who this fits:

• You have personally built and managed paid campaigns in Meta Ads Manager and/or Google Ads for at least 3 years, working with real budgets, and you can walk us through a campaign’s performance from the first click to the sale.

• You have managed a Meta Business account and/or a Google Ads account yourself, not just had access to one.

• You love conversions. You read a results dashboard because you want to, not because someone asked.

• You are not afraid of technology. Pixels, conversion APIs, UTMs, GA4, landing page builders and CRM automations do not scare you, and when something breaks you dig in.

• You already use AI tools in your work and want to use them more.

• You are a self-starter. They run a macro-management shop: they agree on the goal and the number, and you decide how to hit it.

• You are fluent in English at a C1 to C2 level, especially written. You will be writing copy that business owners read. Accents are awesome; strong writing is the requirement.

• You care how a brand looks and sounds, and you notice when something is off.

Who this does not fit:

• Anyone who needs a manager to sign off on every ad before it goes live.

• Anyone who only wants to manage spend and hand the creative to someone else.

• Anyone who sees AI as a threat rather than a tool.

Nice to have, not required:

• Experience in both Meta and Google, not just one.

• Hands-on CRM Experience, GoHighLevel experience preferred but NOT required. Our stack may change.

• LinkedIn Ads, Google Tag Manager or server-side conversion tracking.

• Short-form video editing. Great news is their tech tools do almost all of this work now!!

• Marketed B2B services, SaaS, or to professional services firms, agencies or healthcare.

• Worked with an affiliate or partner program.

• Worked on a US and Latin America remote team before.

Room to grow:

This is a new company in its start-up phase, and the market is moving fast. The person in this seat will see the whole business up close, shape how they go to market, and have real room to grow with the company as the team does. Your results will be visible to everyone, including the founder, every week.

Benefits

• $2300 - $3500 USD/monthly

• 100% remote from anywhere in Latin America

postings.title: Concierge Manager Position -	Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Concierge Manager | Remote | Luxury Travel Leadership

About Ascend
Ascend helps founders, investors, and executives book international business and first-class flights at rates that are typically 30-80% below what you would find on a regular booking site. We combine smart, proprietary booking methods with round-the-clock personal service delivered over WhatsApp.
We have grown from 12 to 60+ people in just over a year, backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, and 5x'd our revenue year-over-year. We are at $22M+ ARR and growing fast. Our mission is to make first-class travel accessible to the people who are shaping the world.
Our clients are founders, investors, and senior executives who expect fast, accurate, and polished service. They do not chase confirmations. They trust us to get it right every time.

The Role
We are looking for an experienced luxury service leader who wants to build world-class operations and grow their impact at a fast-moving company.
As Concierge Manager, you own shift-level operations across three core functions: Client Service, Ticketing, Trip Fulfillment. You lead Team Leads who manage specialists across each function. You are responsible for making sure every client receives a five-star experience, every shift runs smoothly, and every team member is growing under your leadership.
This is a role for someone who thinks in systems but leads with people. Process without empathy is just bureaucracy. You bring both.

What You'll Do

Lead and Develop Your Team

• Manage 3 Team Leads across Client Service, Ticketing and Trip Fulfillment,

• Coach Team Leads daily with direct, specific feedback that builds their judgment and confidence as leaders

• Build a shift culture where ownership, accuracy, and client empathy are the baseline, not the exception

• Conduct regular performance reviews that give team members clarity on where they stand and what comes next

Own Shift Operations

• Direct all client-facing operations during your shift with real-time decisions and clear priorities

• Allocate team resources, manage escalations from Team Leads, and resolve complex situations before they reach the client

• Ensure clean, complete handovers between shifts so the incoming manager has everything they need

• Maintain 95%+ SLA adherence and 98%+ data accuracy through effective team management and systems

Deliver Exceptional Client Experiences

• Own the end-to-end client experience for your shift: every request, every quote, every booking, and every follow-up

• Personally handle VIP clients and high-complexity situations that require senior judgment

• Ensure clients receive proactive updates, creative solutions, and service that consistently exceeds their expectations

• Turn service recovery moments into opportunities to deepen client relationships

Drive Process Excellence

• Submit at least two documented process improvements per month that increase efficiency or quality for the team

• Spot patterns across client feedback, system performance, and team errors, and address them systematically rather than reactively

• Partner with the Process Management team and other functions to streamline workflows across the operation

• Use data to make decisions, validate improvements, and demonstrate impact

Collaborate Across Ascend

• Work closely with Product, Operations, and Leadership to implement new systems and maintain consistency as we scale

• Represent the voice of both your clients and your team in strategic conversations

• Contribute insights that shape how Ascend grows globally while maintaining the quality standard clients expect

What You Bring

Must Have

• 4+ years in luxury travel, hospitality, or high-touch service operations. Apply even if you do not have every year listed but are confident in your skillset

• 2+ years in a leadership or management role where you coached and developed a team, not just managed tasks and deadlines

• Strong Sabre GDS proficiency: you are comfortable with fare rules, complex routing, and ticketing at a level that lets you support and QA your team's work

• A data-driven approach to leadership: you use metrics to spot trends, validate changes, and hold the team to clear standards

• Excellent written and verbal communication: you can coach with clarity, write polished client messages, and present confidently to leadership

• Composure under pressure: when everything is happening at once, you are the calm and steady presence the team needs

Nice to Have

• Experience with international business class or first-class bookings, or award travel programs

• Familiarity with tools like Asana, Periskope, Stripe, or similar workflow and CRM platforms

• A track record of building or improving operational processes, SOPs, or training programs

• Experience managing remote, global teams across time zones

• Background in luxury hospitality brands such as premium hotels or high-end concierge services

You do not need to check every box. If you have 80% of the skills and the drive to learn, we want to hear from you.

What Makes You Stand Out
We are especially interested in candidates who:

• Have turned around an underperforming team or operation and can speak to the specific changes they made and the results they drove

• Are known as the manager people want to work for because they genuinely develop the people around them

• Have a reputation for spotting problems early and solving them before they reach the client

• Think in systems but are not rigid: you improve processes without losing the human element that makes a service feel premium

• Are comfortable being hands-on when the situation calls for it while consistently pushing ownership down to the team

Why Ascend

Clear Growth Path
The progression here is: Concierge Manager to Senior Concierge Manager to Associate Director to Director. We promote from within based on demonstrated performance and impact, not politics or tenure.

Build, Don't Just Maintain
We are implementing our concierge framework and career systems right now. You are not inheriting a rigid legacy structure. You are helping build how Ascend's operations scale globally. Your insights will have a direct and visible effect on how we work.

Real Support

• We hire proficient people: you will not be carrying underperformers

• Regular performance reviews with clear metrics and honest feedback

• A Head of People who understands operations and partners with you

• A Process Management team dedicated to making your job easier

Work-Life Balance

• Predictable scheduling: you will know your shift in advance

• Structured handovers so the incoming manager receives everything they need without you staying late

• A global team with talented colleagues across continents

• Merit-based performance incentives

Learn While You Lead

• Advanced travel optimization strategies used by elite professionals in the industry

• How to lead global teams using shared metrics and real-time decision-making

• Cross-functional collaboration with Product, Engineering, and Operations

• Operational leadership at a venture-backed company growing 5x year-over-year

What Success Looks Like
First 90 days: You have learned our core systems and tools, including Sabre, Asana, and our booking platforms. You are leading shifts independently with 95%+ SLA adherence. You are coaching your Team Leads with specific, useful feedback and you have identified your first improvement opportunity.
Within 6-12 months: You are consistently delivering 95%+ SLA and 98%+ accuracy. Your team sentiment scores are at 8/10 or above. You have led at least one initiative that measurably improved client satisfaction or team efficiency. Your Team Leads are stronger leaders because of your coaching.

Our Values

• Customer Obsession: We win when our customers win

• Urgency with Impact: Clients expect answers in minutes, not hours

• Radical Candor: Honest, direct, respectful feedback builds trust

• Ownership: If something breaks, we fix it

• Relentless Excellence: Good enough is never enough

Should You Apply?
If you are thinking that you may not have all the experience listed, apply anyway. We are looking for people with 80% of the skills and 100% of the drive to learn. What we care about most:

• Have you led teams or operations in a high-touch service environment?

• Do you have a track record of meeting or exceeding operational targets?

• Can you coach, give feedback, and genuinely develop other people?

• Are you excited about building something excellent rather than maintaining something average?

If the answer to these questions is yes, we want to hear from you.

Why You'll Love This Role

This is perfect for someone who:

• Wants to work directly with founders, investors, and global business leaders

• Sees themselves at Ascend for years, building toward senior leadership

• Takes genuine pride in building something excellent and watching their team grow

• Values both high performance and sustainable, respectful working practices

• Wants to lead a high-performing team that holds itself to a standard most operations never reach

Ascend is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.
Engagement Structure, Compensation, Shifts, and Benefits
Ascend is a remote-first, global team. This role is structured as a direct independent contractor engagement, with compensation being stated in USD and be paid in your local currency
As this is an independent contractor engagement, the compensation will not follow a traditional local payroll structure or salary breakup. This means statutory deductions or components or other local payroll-linked benefits are not applicable unless specifically required under the terms of engagement or communicated in writing by Ascend. Contractors are responsible for managing any applicable taxes, filings, and compliance requirements in their own location.
This role is part of Ascend's 24/7 client service operations and involves rotating shifts to support clients across different time zones. This may include overnight shifts, weekends, or public holidays depending on business and team scheduling needs. Weekly offs and shift schedules are planned in advance wherever possible and managed fairly across the team.
The consolidated monthly compensation is designed to account for the nature of the role, including rotating shifts and operational coverage requirements. Separate allowances for night shifts, weekends, holidays, overtime, or additional hours are not applicable unless specifically communicated otherwise for a particular role.
At this stage, Ascend does not provide medical insurance, mediclaim, or similar statutory benefits for this role. Further details on leaves, schedules, contractor terms, and applicable policies will be shared during the offer and onboarding process.
Ascend values work-life balance and aims to distribute schedules thoughtfully. At the same time, because this is a client-facing operational role, some flexibility and responsiveness may be required from time to time.

Senior Software Engineer, Front End – Dashboard

About Caliza

Caliza is commercial banking infrastructure for companies that operate across borders. Most global businesses still piece together several banks, FX providers and spreadsheets to move money. Caliza replaces that with one platform and API: hold USD accounts, collect and pay in 33+ currencies, and convert between fiat and stablecoins, over local rails, SWIFT or stablecoins, in minutes instead of days. On top of that, we’re building the treasury layer: programmable accounts, approval policies, automated reconciliation and working capital, run by a customer’s finance team or their AI agents.

Our customers are importers, exporters, FX brokers, payment companies and fintechs across the Americas, Europe, Africa and Asia. We’re licensed and regulated across our core markets, and our team has built financial infrastructure at Visa, Nubank, EBANX, Flutterwave, Upstart, Intuit and Silicon Valley Bank.

Our backers

Initialized Capital, Better Tomorrow Ventures, Abstract Ventures, New Form Capital, QED Investors, Valor Capital and Quona Capital, along with the founders of Flutterwave, Chipper Cash, Rappi, Pomelo, Dock, Remesa Online and Anchorage.

About the role

The Caliza dashboard is where our customers see and control money moving across rails, currencies and countries. When a payment is in flight, a balance changes, or a compliance check is pending, the dashboard has to show it accurately and immediately, even across thousands of transactions.

As a Senior Software Engineer focused on the dashboard, you'll own features end to end, including transaction and settlement views, balances across currencies, search and filtering, exports and reporting, and the permissions that control who sees and does what. You'll work closely with design, product, back-end and compliance.

Location: Remote, open to candidates based in Latin America. Professional English required.

In your first six months, you'll

• Design and build the real-time dashboard experience, so customers see payment and balance changes as they happen.

• Make large transaction tables fast and usable, with solid filtering, search and export.

• Improve how we show payment and settlement state, so users always know where money is and what happens next.

• Strengthen our shared component library and set front-end conventions for testing, performance and accessibility.

What you'll be doing

• Build and maintain the dashboard in TypeScript and React.

• Design data-dense interfaces: tables, detail views, charts and reports.

• Integrate with back-end APIs, handling the loading, error and edge-case states that matter when money is involved.

• Contribute to our back-end services in Kotlin and Spring Boot when a feature needs it, such as adding or changing the APIs the dashboard depends on.

• Implement role-based access so each user sees exactly what they should.

• Own performance, from rendering large data sets to efficient data fetching.

• Write meaningful automated tests and review your teammates' code.

• Work with product and design from early concept through launch.

What we're looking for

• 5+ years of professional front-end development experience.

•
Deep expertise in TypeScript and React.

• Experience with data fetching, caching and state management tools such as Redux Toolkit and TanStack Query.

• Experience building real-time interfaces (websockets, live updates).

• Comfort working across the stack: you're happy to make back-end changes when a feature needs them.

• Experience building data-heavy applications such as dashboards, admin tools or analytics products.

• Strong product sense: you care about building rich, highly usable interfaces, not just shipping tickets.

• A strong grasp of front-end security: handling sensitive data, XSS/CSRF protection, and secure authentication flows.

• Real experience writing automated tests and caring about test quality.

• Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development in your daily work, with the judgment to review and question what the tools produce.

• Solid understanding of performance and accessibility (WCAG).

• Comfort with high autonomy and ambiguity in a fast-moving, remote startup.

• Clear written communication. Most of our collaboration is async.

Nice to have

• Experience in fintech, payments, banking or crypto products.

• Back-end experience with Kotlin or Java and Spring Boot.

• Experience building or maintaining a design system.

• Experience with multiple currencies, languages, and number and date formats.

How we work

We use AI coding tools every day and expect you to as well. They make us faster at the routine parts of the work. But you own every line you ship: you understand it, test it, and can defend it in review. Because we handle financial data, we follow clear rules about what code and data can go into which tools.

Benefits

Benefits vary by country of employment and may include health coverage, paid time off and holidays, a home office or equipment allowance, a professional development budget, and in-person team offsites. Candidates based outside the US may be employed through an employer of record or engaged as contractors, with pay and benefits structured to local law and market practice.

Equal opportunity and other disclosures

Equal opportunity employer. Caliza is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We value diverse backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every listed qualification.

Accommodations. We provide reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants with disabilities and to anyone who needs one during the hiring process. To request an accommodation, contact the recruiting team.

Background screening. Because we handle sensitive financial data and regulated activity, any offer will be contingent on a background check, which may include criminal history, employment and education verification, and sanctions screening, to the extent permitted by law. In the US, we conduct screening in line with the Fair Credit Reporting Act and applicable state and local fair chance laws, and we consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with those laws.

Work authorization. Candidates must be authorized to work in their country of residence. We are not able to sponsor visas for this role.

Employment terms. For US-based hires, employment with Caliza is at-will. Terms for hires outside the US follow local law.

Applicant privacy. We collect and process applicant personal data solely for purposes of evaluating applications and managing the recruitment process in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), Brazil’s General Data Protection Law (LGPD), Mexico’s Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (LFPDPPP), the European Union’s General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), and the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 (NDPA). We retain personal data only for as long as necessary for these purposes or as required by applicable law. Subject to applicable legal requirements, applicants may request access to, correction or deletion of their personal data, as well as exercise other applicable rights, including restricting or objecting to processing and requesting data portability.

Use of AI in hiring. We may use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications or assessing responses. These tools assist our team but do not replace human judgment, and final hiring decisions are made by people.

Recruitment fraud. Caliza will never ask candidates for payment, banking details, or cryptocurrency during the hiring process. Official communications come only from Caliza email addresses. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from us, please report it to our team.

AirDNA began with a big dream in a balmy California garage in 2015. Since then, the technology startup has grown into the leading provider of data and business intelligence for the billion-dollar travel and vacation rental industry—with offices in Denver and Barcelona.

This marriage of scraped and source data, enhanced by our proprietary algorithms, makes our solutions the most accurate and comprehensive in the world.
We’re firm believers that data isn’t the destination; it’s the starting point. The launchpad. The bedrock for any future-forward business.

The AirDNA Team
At AirDNA , we’re a team of data nerds on a mission to empower our customers to smartly grow their businesses. And we're looking for people with a broad range of experiences and perspectives, who are excited by our mission, values, and drive to change the short-term rental market. In short: Life is never boring here. And we genuinely live and breathe our company values: Happy, Hungry and Honest. People who are ready to exemplify these values are especially encouraged to apply. We invite you to apply even if you are unsure about whether you meet every single requirement in this posting. We carefully consider every application, not just those that check off all the boxes.

The Role:
Adapt is AirDNA 's dynamic pricing engine, and hosts trust it with their income. When something looks off, like a rate that makes no sense or a sync that says it worked but didn't, our frontline Support team and AI tools handle most of it. The hardest problems come to you.
As our Product Support Specialist, you'll be the technical bridge between Support and Engineering: the final line of defense who digs into logs, data, and code to find the real root cause before an issue ever reaches Product or Engineering. Then you'll explain it to the host in a few clear sentences and make sure it never happens again.
This isn't a script-reading job, and it isn't a race to clear a queue. We won't measure you on how fast you close tickets. We'll celebrate you for solving problems for good. And because you're joining a brand-new pod, you'll help write the playbook for everyone who comes after you.
This is a full-time, long-term contractor role. It's fully remote and open to candidates based in Latin America or the Caribbean.

Here's what you'll get to do:

•
Own escalations end to end. Take the technical issues frontline Support can't solve and drive them all the way to resolution, escalating to Engineering only when it truly needs an engineer.

•
Play detective. Diagnose pricing and sync issues by reproducing the problem, forming a hypothesis, and isolating the cause (PMS connection, comp set, host override, or market shift).

•
Dig into the back end. Use SQL, logs, analytics reports, and existing code to pull the data and confirm what actually happened.

•
Make the algorithm make sense. Explain why Adapt did what it did in a few plain sentences, a short screen recording, or a quick call that a host can act on.

•
Turn every repeat ticket into an asset. Write help-center articles, in-app guidance, and content for the Adapt AI agent so the next host never has to ask.

•
Be Product's eyes and ears. Share weekly escalation themes, grouped by host type and portfolio size, and follow fixes all the way to shipped.

•
Protect our hosts. Spot at-risk accounts early and loop in Revenue Management before a frustrated host walks away.

•
Build the playbook. Create the SOPs, macros, and escalation paths that set the quality bar for everyone who joins the pod after you.

Here's what you'll need to be successful:

•
2+ years in technical support, SaaS product support, or another analytical, customer-facing role. Tier 2 support folks ready to level up, we're looking at you!

•
SQL proficiency. You can write queries against a live database to find what you need.

•
Working knowledge of Python. You're comfortable reading existing code and working with datasets. You don't need to be a developer.

• Hands-on experience with APIs and log analysis .

•
Strong quantitative reasoning. Percentages, averages, and rates are second nature, and you spot a number that can't possibly be right.

•
Structured problem-solving. You break a vague complaint into a testable hypothesis instead of guessing.

•
A gift for translating tech into plain language. You can explain to a non-technical host why their rates look different than they expected, clearly, warmly, and in just a few sentences.

• Excellent verbal and written English.

• Composure with frustrated customers, and the honesty to own a mistake without over-promising a fix.

•
Follow-through. You close loops without being chased.

• Willingness to work hours that overlap with US Eastern and European business time.

•
Bonus points for: familiarity with webhooks; support tools like Intercom or Zendesk; experience with short-term rental pricing or property management tools (PriceLabs, Wheelhouse, Beyond, Guesty, Hostaway); a hospitality or revenue management background; or a knack for using AI to automate your own repetitive work. You don't need to know how a pricing engine works on day one. We'll teach you!

Here's what you can expect from us:

postings.descriptionText:
Senior Software Engineer, DevOps

About Caliza

Caliza is commercial banking infrastructure for companies that operate across borders. Most global businesses still piece together several banks, FX providers and spreadsheets to move money. Caliza replaces that with one platform and API: hold USD accounts, collect and pay in 33+ currencies, and convert between fiat and stablecoins, over local rails, SWIFT or stablecoins, in minutes instead of days. On top of that, we’re building the treasury layer: programmable accounts, approval policies, automated reconciliation and working capital, run by a customer’s finance team or their AI agents.

Our customers are importers, exporters, FX brokers, payment companies and fintechs across the Americas, Europe, Africa and Asia. We’re licensed and regulated across our core markets, and our team has built financial infrastructure at Visa, Nubank, EBANX, Flutterwave, Upstart, Intuit and Silicon Valley Bank.

Our backers

Initialized Capital, Better Tomorrow Ventures, Abstract Ventures, New Form Capital, QED Investors, Valor Capital and Quona Capital, along with the founders of Flutterwave, Chipper Cash, Rappi, Pomelo, Dock, Remesa Online and Anchorage.

About the role

Caliza moves money in real time across payment rails and countries. When our systems are down, our customers' money stops. That makes reliability, security and the ability to ship safely core to the business, not a back-office concern.

Good DevOps makes every other engineer faster and safer: you'll own the infrastructure we use to run, ship and monitor our software end to end, reporting to our security & infrastructure lead, who focuses on security while you drive DevOps. This isn't a role that only runs other people's code: you'll write and ship production code yourself, in our application services as well as our infrastructure, held to the same standards of review and testing as the rest of the team. Strong software engineering fundamentals matter as much here as infra experience: you should be comfortable reading and contributing to our codebase, not just the pipelines around it.

Location: Remote, with at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern time. Professional English required.

In your first six months, you'll

• Learn our infrastructure and deployment pipelines end to end.

• Help design and build our agentic development environment.

• Improve our monitoring and alerting so we catch payment-impacting issues before customers do.

• Strengthen our disaster recovery and backup strategy, and test it.

• Make our compliance evidence (access reviews, change logs, audit trails) easier to produce.

What you'll be doing

• Maintain and evolve our Kubernetes-based infrastructure on AWS: AWS CDK for provisioning, Helm/kubectl for workload deployments.

• Build and improve deployment pipelines with GitHub Actions.

• Write and ship production code: infrastructure as code, internal tooling, and changes to our application services, such as instrumentation, health checks and performance fixes.

• Own observability with New Relic: dashboards, alerting, and SLOs for critical payment flows.

• Operate and scale our managed services, including messaging (CloudAMQP) and databases (MongoDB Atlas, PostgreSQL).

• Manage secrets, access controls and identity infrastructure.

• Design for high availability and disaster recovery, and lead incident response and postmortems.

•
Optimize AWS cost and performance.

• Partner with engineering and compliance on security controls and audit readiness.

What we're looking for

• Strong programming skills in at least one general-purpose language, ideally Java or Kotlin, with a real track record of shipping and reviewing production code. This matters as much as your infra background, since you'll work directly in our SDLC and application codebase, not just around it.

• 5+ years of experience in infrastructure, DevOps or SRE roles.

• Strong experience operating production systems on AWS.

• Proficiency with Kubernetes in production.

• Experience with infrastructure as code (AWS CDK, Terraform or similar) and Helm.

• Experience building CI/CD pipelines, ideally with GitHub Actions.

• Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as New Relic.

• A security-first mindset: least-privilege access, secrets management, network security.

• Comfort with on-call and incident response.

• Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development in your daily work, with the judgment to review and question what the tools produce.

• Comfort with high autonomy and ambiguity in a fast-moving, remote startup.

• Clear written communication. Most of our collaboration is async.

Nice to have

• Experience in fintech, payments or other regulated environments.

• Experience supporting SOC 2 audits, which we maintain today, or ISO 27001, which we may pursue.

• Experience working in Spring Boot codebases, in Java or Kotlin.

• Experience with RabbitMQ and MongoDB in production.

• Experience operating identity and access management systems (e.g. Keycloak).

How we work

We use AI tools every day and expect you to as well. They make us faster at the routine parts of the work. But you own every change you ship: you understand it, test it, and can defend it in review. That matters even more for infrastructure, where a bad change can take down payments. Because we handle financial data, we follow clear rules about what code, configuration and data can go into which tools.

Benefits

Benefits vary by country of employment and may include health coverage, paid time off and holidays, a home office or equipment allowance, a professional development budget, and in-person team offsites. Candidates based outside the US may be employed through an employer of record or engaged as contractors, with pay and benefits structured to local law and market practice.

Equal opportunity and other disclosures

Equal opportunity employer. Caliza is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We value diverse backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every listed qualification.

Accommodations. We provide reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants with disabilities and to anyone who needs one during the hiring process. To request an accommodation, contact the recruiting team.

Background screening. Because we handle sensitive financial data and regulated activity, any offer will be contingent on a background check, which may include criminal history, employment and education verification, and sanctions screening, to the extent permitted by law. In the US, we conduct screening in line with the Fair Credit Reporting Act and applicable state and local fair chance laws, and we consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with those laws.

Work authorization. Candidates must be authorized to work in their country of residence. We are not able to sponsor visas for this role.

Employment terms. For US-based hires, employment with Caliza is at-will. Terms for hires outside the US follow local law.

Applicant privacy. We collect and process applicant personal data solely for purposes of evaluating applications and managing the recruitment process in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), Brazil’s General Data Protection Law (LGPD), Mexico’s Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (LFPDPPP), the European Union’s General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), and the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 (NDPA). We retain personal data only for as long as necessary for these purposes or as required by applicable law. Subject to applicable legal requirements, applicants may request access to, correction or deletion of their personal data, as well as exercise other applicable rights, including restricting or objecting to processing and requesting data portability.

Use of AI in hiring. We may use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications or assessing responses. These tools assist our team but do not replace human judgment, and final hiring decisions are made by people.

Recruitment fraud. Caliza will never ask candidates for payment, banking details, or cryptocurrency during the hiring process. Official communications come only from Caliza email addresses. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from us, please report it to our team.

postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are
KLDiscovery is a leading global provider of best-in-class eDiscovery, information governance, and data recovery solutions, serving AmLaw 100 firms, Fortune 500 corporations, and government agencies. Our technology-enabled services and software help these law firms, corporations and agencies solve complex data challenges. Our Nebula and RelOne platforms deliver SaaS-based legal technology underpinned by managed services and professional services. The company, with offices in 26 locations across 17 countries helps clients with their litigation, regulatory compliance, internal investigation and data recovery and management needs all around the world.
Serving clients for over 30 years, KLDiscovery offers data collection and forensic investigation, early case assessment, electronic discovery and data processing, application software and data hosting for web-based document reviews, and managed document review services. In addition, through its global Ontrack Data Recovery business, KLDiscovery delivers world-class data recovery, email extraction and restoration, data destruction and tape management.
KLDiscovery has been recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in North America by both Inc. Magazine (Inc. 5000) and Deloitte (Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500. Additionally, KLDiscovery is an Orange-level Relativity Best in Service Partner, a Relativity Premium Hosting Partner and Relativity’s 1 st Service Provider partner, and maintains ISO/IEC 27001 Certified data centers.

Who You Are & What You’ll Do
KLDiscovery is seeking a Strategic Account Executive to drive net-new logo acquisition for our Legal Technologies business across the Americas. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, focused on personally sourcing, qualifying, and closing new enterprise accounts that have not previously purchased KLD eDiscovery and managed review services. The successful candidate is a proven enterprise hunter who can open and win complex, multi-stakeholder deals, then partner with internal teams to ensure a smooth transition to delivery. This role carries an individual new-business revenue target and reports to the Chief Revenue Officer.

Key Responsibilities:

• Prospect, identify, and qualify net-new and current enterprise accounts across law firms, corporations, and government entities within an assigned territory.

• Build and maintain a robust personal pipeline through outbound prospecting, networking, referrals, retention, and partnership with Marketing and Sales Development.

• Manage complex, multi-month sales cycles from initial contact through close, engaging stakeholders across Legal, IT, Privacy, Procurement, and Finance.

• Develop and deliver tailored value propositions, presentations, and proposals that address client business and legal challenges.

• Negotiate pricing, scope, and contract terms within approved commercial guidelines, defending value rather than discounting.

• Achieve or exceed an assigned individual new-logo revenue target of $5M in annual contract value.

• Maintain accurate and timely records of activity, pipeline, and forecasts in Salesforce, sustaining healthy pipeline coverage.

• Partner with Client Success and Delivery to ensure flawless onboarding and a strong foundation for future expansion of newly signed accounts.

• Represent KLDiscovery at industry conferences and events (e.g., Legalweek, ILTACON), building brand presence and relationships.

• Provide field and competitive intelligence to Product and leadership to inform packaging, positioning, and go-to-market strategy.

Qualifications:

Required

• 10+ years of B2B enterprise sales experience in legal technology and/or services with a sustained record of personally attaining or exceeding individual annual quotas of at least $5M.

• Deep knowledge of the legal technology, eDiscovery, or litigation-support industry.

• Demonstrated success in new-logo acquisition and client retention personally sourcing and closing net-new enterprise accounts, not solely growing an inherited book of business.

• Experience managing complex, enterprise sales cycles (3–12+ months) involving multiple decision-makers across Procurement, IT, Privacy, and Legal.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce executive-level proposals and presentations.

• Trained in and consistently applying a structured sales methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC) and Challenger Sale principles to qualify opportunities and lead value-based, insight-driven customer conversations.

• Proficiency with Salesforce or comparable CRM systems and modern sales tooling.

• Willingness to travel for client meetings and industry events.

Preferred

• Understanding of legal workflows, including litigation, regulatory and internal investigations, compliance, and antitrust / second requests.

• Background in professional services or technology-enabled services sales.

• Familiarity with adjacent offerings such as cyber incident response, information governance, and managed review.

• Prior experience in a private-equity-backed or high-growth organization.

Education

• Bachelor’s degree required; MBA, JD, or equivalent qualification preferred.

Our Mission & Values
Our Mission: We bring clarity, trust, and meaning to data for clients navigating legal matters worldwide.
These four values guide how we operate, make decisions, and work together every day.

• Client is Always in the Room - We operate and make decisions as if the client is in the room. We anticipate their needs, consider their perspective, and prioritize their best interests.

• Own the Outcome - We bring an unwavering bias for action, act with urgency, and hold ourselves accountable to our clients, and each other.

• Better Every Day - We improve our tomorrow by always striving to be better than today. We embrace curiosity, question assumptions, and raise the bar constantly.

• Deliver Results Together - We collaborate obsessively to achieve shared success. We assume good intentions, debate ideas thoughtfully, treat each other with respect, and fully commit once decisions are made.

KLDiscovery is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital or family status, pregnancy, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, compensation, promotion, training, discipline, and termination. Employment decisions are based on job-related qualifications, skills, and experience.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING FOR KLD

At KLD, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that when our employees feel supported, valued, and empowered, they can thrive both personally and professionally. That’s why we’re committed to fostering a collaborative, inclusive workplace where you can grow your career, make meaningful contributions, and enjoy a healthy work-life balance.
Our competitive benefits and programs are designed to support your well-being and success. Depending on your location, these may include comprehensive health and wellness benefits, retirement and financial programs, paid time off and leave options, employee assistance resources, and professional development opportunities.
We also embrace flexibility, offering remote work opportunities for most employees to support work-life balance while keeping our teams connected and collaborative. Certain roles may require an office-based or hybrid schedule based on business and operational needs.
Wherever you’re located, you’ll be part of a global team that values your contributions, supports your growth, and celebrates your success.
Benefits and eligibility vary by country, location, employment status, and applicable plan or program requirements.
At KLD we invest in employees and their families by placing their wellbeing first. We offer competitive total compensation that includes base pay, bonus potential, inclusive benefits, wellness programs, and perks. We use market and industry data to inform pay decisions while considering geography and labor markets, individual experience, and business needs. Individual compensation will vary, although a reasonable estimate of the current annualized base pay range for this position is $170-195,000.

This is not a traditional software engineering role. It’s for someone who can walk into a department, quickly understand the process, spot what’s inefficient, and build something useful—often in days rather than months.

Role Details

•
Location: Fully remote; open to candidates based in Latin America or the Philippines

•
Compensation: USD 3,500–5,000 per month, flexible for the right candidate

•
Experience level: 2–4 years of relevant experience

What You’ll Do

• Work with business teams to understand workflows, data processes, and operational bottlenecks.

• Design, prototype, and deploy AI-powered automations, internal dashboards, lightweight applications, and workflow improvements.

• Use AI-assisted development tools, APIs, automation platforms, SQL, Python, databases, and low-code technologies to move quickly.

• Connect disconnected systems, reduce repetitive manual work, and improve accuracy across key processes.

• Build reporting tools and internal applications that improve visibility and help teams make better decisions.

• Identify practical ways to apply LLMs, AI agents, and related tools to improve productivity or accuracy.

What We’re Looking For

• 2–4 years of experience in software engineering, automation, data engineering, technical operations, or a similar role.

• Strong proficiency with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or comparable platforms.

• Ability to work with APIs, databases, SQL, Python, and integration tools.

• Strong analytical instincts and the ability to understand business processes quickly.

• A self-starter who can identify problems, propose solutions, and execute without extensive specifications.

• Comfort moving quickly, experimenting, and building practical solutions that solve real operational problems.

Prior forward-deployed engineering experience is not required. What matters most is demonstrated building ability, resourcefulness, business intuition, and the ability to deliver useful solutions.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you’ll have independently identified and deployed multiple improvements that measurably reduce manual work, improve operational visibility, increase accuracy, or accelerate key business processes.

You’ll be evaluated primarily on the business value of what you build—not lines of code or technical complexity.

Why This Role Is Different

They automate high-effort workflows, launch AI-powered product lines, and turn complex internal data into structured, usable assets—from custom-trained models and retrieval pipelines to systems that reason across vast datasets, technical documents, and domain-specific logic. Their clients span engineering, defense, financial services, and healthcare.

Delivery & Sprint Execution: Own the delivery lifecycle post-signature. Translate SOW objectives into epics, technical specs, user stories, and strict acceptance criteria while managing day-to-day sprint velocity.

Stakeholder & Scope Governance: Act as the primary technical counterpart for client engineering leads. Navigate scope evolution, govern change requests, and maintain clear delivery roadmaps.

Backend & API Integration Oversight: Steer the interface between core AI knowledge systems and client software platforms, ensuring reliable API contracts, data fidelity, and low-latency query performance.

•
Delivery Rhythms: Establish delivery visibility, milestones, tracking dashboards, and lightweight agile rituals across the engineering pod.

Responsibilities:

•
Author Technical Requirements: Write detailed requirements, system workflows, API contracts, and QA/acceptance criteria for backend-heavy data ingestion, model retrieval, and third-party software integration.

•
Govern Scope with Rigor: Proactively identify delivery drift; triage and negotiate client change requests with diplomatic firmness to protect timelines and quality.

•
Identify Account Expansion: Bring a consulting mindset to client interactions, identifying operational bottlenecks and framing follow-on technical SOWs.

•
Facilitate Technical Alignment: Run high-impact client working sessions, lead technical demos, and deliver structured status updates to client leadership.

Required experience:

•
8+ Years in Technical Product Management: Proven background as a Senior, Principal, or Staff TPM delivering complex backend, platform, or data-infrastructure systems.

•
Relentless Project Management & Detail: Strong, hands-on experience driving day-to-day agile execution, milestone tracking, and rigorous acceptance testing.

•
SOW & Commercial Scope Governance: Demonstrated experience scoping engagements, authoring SOWs, breaking down contract deliverables into technical tasks, and managing client change requests.

Backend & AI Technical Literacy: Solid understanding of API design (REST/gRPC), JSON schemas, data pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and modern AI/LLM retrieval architectures (semantic search, embeddings, vector databases).

•
Flawless Verbal & Written Communication: Professional, near-native or native English fluency; capable of independently leading technical working sessions with executive client stakeholders.

•
Regulated or High-Security Domain Experience: Prior experience delivering software within GovTech/defense, fintech, healthcare, or similar environments with strict data security and compliance requirements.

Bonus qualifications:

•
Consulting Background: Prior experience in technology consulting or professional client-services delivery.

•
Systems Engineering / Complex Modeling Tooling: Experience integrating with enterprise modeling, CAD, or engineering data systems (e.g., SysML, Cameo).
