postings.descriptionText:
Compliance Operations Manager, Transaction Monitoring

Role snapshot

Title

Compliance Operations Manager, Transaction Monitoring

Team

Compliance

Reports to

Chief Risk Officer

Location

Remote, United States or Latin America

Employment type

Full-time

Direct reports

None at start; builds and leads a team of TM analysts as volume scales

About Caliza

Caliza is commercial banking infrastructure for companies that operate across borders. Most global businesses still piece together several banks, FX providers and spreadsheets to move money. Caliza replaces that with one platform and API: hold USD accounts, collect and pay in 33+ currencies, and convert between fiat and stablecoins, over local rails, SWIFT or stablecoins, in minutes instead of days. On top of that, we’re building the treasury layer: programmable accounts, approval policies, automated reconciliation and working capital, run by a customer’s finance team or their AI agents.

Our customers are importers, exporters, FX brokers, payment companies and fintechs across the Americas, Europe, Africa and Asia. We’re licensed and regulated across our core markets, and our team has built financial infrastructure at Visa, Nubank, EBANX, Flutterwave, Upstart, Intuit and Silicon Valley Bank.

Our backers

Initialized Capital, Better Tomorrow Ventures, Abstract Ventures, New Form Capital, QED Investors, Valor Capital and Quona Capital, along with the founders of Flutterwave, Chipper Cash, Rappi, Pomelo, Dock, Remesa Online and Anchorage.

What you'll do

Build the program

Own the real-time transaction monitoring implementation. Partner with Engineering to constantly update requirements, run user acceptance testing, and continue to enhance TM tooling, ensuring it continues to be best in class.

Write and tune AML rules, scenarios, and thresholds across fiat and stablecoin flows and across our corridors (US, Brazil, Mexico, and others), mapped to a documented typology coverage assessment.

Run above- and below-the-line testing and ongoing tuning to cut false positives without leaving coverage gaps.

Update documentation for the TM program: policies, procedures, investigation playbooks, QA standards, and model and rule validation, including preparing for independent validation and audit.

Define TM metrics for Compliance leadership and the Board: alert volumes, aging, disposition rates, SLA adherence, and filing timeliness.

Run the program

Run daily alert triage, investigation workflow, case management, and disposition tracking.

Review held and pended transactions, decide release, return, or escalation, and follow up with customers and integrator partners for information and documentation.

Detect and investigate fraud patterns, including account takeover, authorized push payment and social engineering scams, mule activity, and first-party fraud.

Lead SAR and STR decisioning and filing for the US (FinCEN), Bermuda (Financial Intelligence Agency), and relevant LATAM jurisdictions such as Brazil (COAF) and Mexico (UIF), meeting each regime's deadlines and continuing-activity review requirements.

Manage sanctions-adjacent escalations and requests from law enforcement and partner banks (for example, 314(a) and 314(b) requests and RFIs), in coordination with Compliance and Legal.

Act as the primary point of contact for TM-related questions from regulators, examiners, auditors, and correspondent and sponsor banks.

Build a culture of clear documentation, sound judgment, and fast, well-reasoned decisions.

What you'll bring

6+ years in AML, BSA, or financial crime compliance, with at least 3 years focused on transaction monitoring at a fintech, payments company, money services business, crypto business, or bank.

Hands-on experience implementing or migrating a TM system: writing requirements, testing rules, and taking it live with an engineering team.

A track record of writing and tuning AML rules and thresholds, and documenting the rationale for examiners and auditors.

Deep familiarity with cross-border payment, remittance, and B2B money movement typologies, plus fraud patterns in real-time payments.

Direct experience making SAR decisions and filing them with FinCEN, including narrative writing and continuing-activity reviews.

Experience supporting regulatory exams, independent audits, or bank partner due diligence on a TM program.

Comfort working with data. You can query transaction data in SQL, build analyses to support tuning decisions, and explain them in plain language.

Clear, concise writing, and judgment you can defend in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.

Professional working fluency in English. Spanish or Portuguese is a strong plus.

Ability to work hours that overlap with US Eastern and Brazil time zones.

Nice to have

Experience with stablecoin or digital asset transaction monitoring, including on-chain analytics and Travel Rule compliance.

Certifications such as CAMS, CFE, CAMS-FCI, CCI (Certified Cryptocurrency Investigator), or CAMS-Audit.

Benefits

Benefits vary by country of employment and may include health coverage, paid time off and holidays, a home office or equipment allowance, a professional development budget, and in-person team offsites. Candidates based outside the US may be employed through an employer of record or engaged as contractors, with pay and benefits structured to local law and market practice.

Equal opportunity and other disclosures

Equal opportunity employer. Caliza is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We value diverse backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every listed qualification.

Accommodations. We provide reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants with disabilities and to anyone who needs one during the hiring process. To request an accommodation, contact the recruiting team.

Background screening. Because we handle sensitive financial data and regulated activity, any offer will be contingent on a background check, which may include criminal history, employment and education verification, and sanctions screening, to the extent permitted by law. In the US, we conduct screening in line with the Fair Credit Reporting Act and applicable state and local fair chance laws, and we consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with those laws.

Work authorization. Candidates must be authorized to work in their country of residence. We are not able to sponsor visas for this role.

Employment terms. For US-based hires, employment with Caliza is at-will. Terms for hires outside the US follow local law.

Applicant privacy. We collect and process applicant personal data solely for purposes of evaluating applications and managing the recruitment process in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), Brazil’s General Data Protection Law (LGPD), Mexico’s Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (LFPDPPP), the European Union’s General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), and the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 (NDPA). We retain personal data only for as long as necessary for these purposes or as required by applicable law. Subject to applicable legal requirements, applicants may request access to, correction or deletion of their personal data, as well as exercise other applicable rights, including restricting or objecting to processing and requesting data portability.

Use of AI in hiring. We may use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications or assessing responses. These tools assist our team but do not replace human judgment, and final hiring decisions are made by people.

Recruitment fraud. Caliza will never ask candidates for payment, banking details, or cryptocurrency during the hiring process. Official communications come only from Caliza email addresses. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from us, please report it to our team.

ROLE DETAILS

JOB TITLE

Chief of Staff

JOB ID
JENMEL1EA

Real Estate Development & Design

South Africa or LATAM

JOB STATUS

Full Time

WORK SCHEDULE

Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm Eastern Time

$4000 per month

Role overview

About the client
The client is a dynamic multi-entity family office and serial entrepreneur operating across four distinct market sectors:

• Real Estate Investment & Development: A portfolio of cash-investment residential properties across multiple regions, managed under individual entity structures alongside property management for outside owners.

• Boutique Interior Design & Contracting: A boutique interior design practice specializing in high-end residential projects, turnkey furnishing, and property contracting.

• Boutique Fitness & Wellness: A fast-growing infrared fitness studio brand with locations across key markets undergoing strategic expansion, corporate structuring, and location rollouts.

• Personal & Family Office: Family office administration, executive scheduling, and personal household logistics.

The business operates with a small, high-touch core team—including licensed brokers, property accountants, bookkeepers, and studio managers. The Managing Partner requires a central partner to maintain cross-business oversight, streamline administrative follow-through, and bridge operational gaps across all four sectors.

About the role
As the Chief of Staff, you will serve as the primary point of organizational accountability and central connective tissue across all four business entities and personal operations.
You are the "layer above and between" the Managing Partner, external accountants, bookkeepers, studio managers, contractors, and clients—ensuring information is gathered, organized, updated, and dispatches to the right people on time. You will manage executive priorities, oversee property management logistics, support back-office design procurement, monitor fitness expansion deliverables, and handle high-level executive and personal administration.
As you demonstrate capability, the role will expand to include light marketing, client outreach, and broader operational management to drive business growth and client retention.

BUSINESS AREA

HOURS ALLOCATION

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & SCOPE

1. Real Estate & Property

Baseline: 10 hrs/wk

Swing: 6–16 hrs

• Master Property Registry maintenance

• Monthly utility close & statement reviews

• Tenant/vendor communications & access

• Turnover SOPs & lease renewals

2. Design & Contracting

Baseline: 10 hrs/wk

Swing: 6–14 hrs

• Project back-office & budget tracking

• Purchasing, orders & trade logistics

• Client invoicing & vendor matching

• CRM marketing & portfolio updates

3. Fitness Brand

Baseline: 10 hrs/wk

Swing: 6–14 hrs

• Investment & reimbursement tracking

• Corporate entity & lease compliance

• Build-out & expansion tracking

• Agency & marketing follow-through

4. Executive & Family Admin

Baseline: 10 hrs/wk

Swing: 6–12 hrs

• Calendar triage & focus protection

• Family appointments & logistics

• Travel itineraries & household admin

Key responsibilities
1. Real Estate Investment & Property Management Coordination

• Master Property Registry: Maintain a current master database across all properties (holding entities, tenant details, rent schedules, security deposit holdings, lease expiration alerts at 120/90/60 days, insurance policies, tax appeal timelines, and utility logins).

• Monthly Utility Close: Download, review, flag variance (>20% spikes), and reconcile monthly statements across all owner-paid utilities by the 7th of every month for the bookkeeper.

• Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs): Write and execute SOPs for acquisitions, tenant move-in/move-out workflows, utility transfers, lease renewals, and maintenance requests.

• Property Administration: Field tenant and vendor requests, coordinate property access, manage insurance/permit renewals, and log property maintenance/markup fees.

2. Boutique Interior Design Practice Support

• Project Back-Office: Set up and maintain project files, scope sheets, vendor contracts, and decision logs for all active interior design jobs.

• Purchasing & Logistics Tracker: Track all orders from procurement to delivery (SKUs, deposits, delivery dates, damage reports, and storage logistics).

• Budget & Invoicing Control: Perform weekly updates on budget vs. committed spend; draft client invoices, reconcile vendor receipts, and pass coded records to the financial team.

• Marketing & Client Outreach: Compile project photos, maintain the CRM database, draft client check-ins, coordinate project photography, and manage digital portfolio updates during lull periods.

3. Fitness & Wellness Business Operations Support

• Investment & Capital Tracking: Maintain a clear ledger of capital contributions, member loans, and business expenses; ensure all brand-related spend is executed on dedicated business cards.

• Corporate & Compliance Records: Track studio LLC entities, lease terms/options, insurance renewals, and legal agreements.

• Expansion & Build-Out Logistics: Maintain project timelines, site evaluation files, contractor schedules, and grand-opening checklists for new studio locations.

• Agency & Marketing Follow-Up: Monitor external marketing, PR, and ad agencies against agreed deliverables, timelines, and scope.

4. Executive & Personal Administration

• Calendar Management: Triage, structure, and protect the Managing Partner’s calendar; confirm daily appointments, resolve conflicts proactive of client meetings, and block focus time.

• Family Logistics & Personal Admin: Coordinate recurring family appointments, school calendars, travel itineraries, household vendors, and personal renewals with absolute discretion.

• Inbox & Triage Management: Monitor primary inboxes, flag priority action items, and draft responses to maintain timely follow-up.

Operating Cadence & AI Tooling

• Daily Morning Brief: Deliver a daily summary detailing priorities, required approvals, and daily schedules before Eastern business hours begin.

• Daily Close-Out Note: Provide an end-of-shift update on completed tasks and pending items.

• Weekly Syncs: Conduct a weekly strategy review with the Managing Partner and structured handoffs with the financial team.

• AI-Enabled Execution: Utilize modern AI productivity tools (such as Claude/Claude Design) to quickly generate project spec sheets, floor plans, draft communications, summarize documents, and prepare client-facing materials.

Qualifications & skills (Non-Negotiable)

• 5+ Years Experience: Proven track record in a high-level support role—such as Chief of Staff, Operations Manager, or Senior Executive Assistant—directly supporting a Founder or Senior Executive across multiple business entities.

• Real Estate / Property Management Background: Direct experience handling property back-office operations, leases, utility setups, tenant transitions, and vendor coordination.

• Financial & Numerical Aptitude: Proficient in spreadsheet management, budget tracking, invoice reconciliation, and preparing clean reporting packages for bookkeepers/accountants.

• Systems Builder Mindset: Proven ability to create, implement, and maintain SOPs, CRM databases, project trackers, and checklists independently.

• AI & Tech Proficiency: Comfortable utilizing modern software and AI tools (Claude/Claude Design, CRM platforms, project management tools, shared password managers) to drive operational efficiency.

• Communication Skills: Flawless written and verbal English communication skills with a professional, warm, and collaborative tone suitable for high-touch clients and external partners.

• Proven Tenure: Demonstrated history of long-term reliability and stability in previous positions.

• Availability & Reliability: Available full-time (40 hours/week) during US Eastern business hours, with a reliable remote work setup (including backup power/internet solutions where applicable).

Qualifications & skills (Non-Negotiable)

• Spanish language proficiency is a plus.

• Prior familiarity with property tracking tools, password manager security vaults, and modern financial reporting tools (e.g., Ramp, QuickBooks read-access).

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• 100% On-Time Monthly Financial Packages: Utility closes, invoices, and expense logs delivered cleanly to the financial team by designated monthly deadlines.

• Zero Lapsed Obligations: Zero missed lease renewal deadlines, insurance renewals, or permit expirations.

• Seamless Transitions: Zero gaps in utility service during property turnover events.

• Budget Accuracy: Design and expansion budgets updated weekly with proactive flags on budget variances.

About the Role
The Life Sciences Program Executive (PE) is a senior, executive-facing individual contributor (IC) within the Global Life Sciences Acceleration Hub at Salesforce . As an IC, Program Executives hold no direct reports, and yet expertly lead large numbers of our most senior talent across our most complex Life Sciences customer engagements: multi-workstream transformations, strategic accounts, and enterprise implementations where the margin for error is narrow and the consequences of failure are visible at the C-suite.
The PE is fully allocated to a single flagship Life Sciences transformation program or a set of strategic accounts. They own the end-to-end program P&L, lead the Salesforce project team, run the steering committee, manage the executive customer relationship, manage scope, govern the budget, and surface risk before it becomes an escalation. The ideal candidate brings a deep background in Life Sciences (pharma, biotech, medtech, or related sectors) combined with IT or management consulting delivery experience, leveraging that industry credibility as a strategic advisor to customers, partners, and internal teams across Salesforce .
Life Sciences Program Executives sit at the helm of AI and Agentforce transformations that accelerate drug commercialization, streamline field engagement, and modernize clinical and commercial operations through intelligent, autonomous agents. They lead cross-functional teams deploying digital workforces that bridge the gap between complex Life Sciences data and actionable business outcomes, driving the next frontier of Life Sciences innovation.
Their success is defined by what they deliver, what they prevent, and the customer confidence they command.

Your Impact
* AI and agentic delivery are embedded in how you work: you actively leverage AI tooling and agentic workflows to optimize how your program teams deliver. You reduce manual overhead, accelerate insight, and model the productivity gains Life Sciences customers are investing in Salesforce to achieve.
* Engagement success is well-defined and honored: you create the program strategy, management approach, governance, and guide the customer at the executive and program level to align on objectives, outcomes, and KPIs.
* Customer outcomes are owned with clear accountability: you are the executive-facing delivery contact for your engagement and are responsible for communications with the client and within Salesforce up to the CxO level regarding expectations, performance, governance, and issue escalation and resolution. You earn trust through consistently accurate forecasting, honest risk communication, and follow-through.
* The delivery team performs at a higher level because you're in it: you effectively lead, inspire, and uplift Salesforce Professional Services team members, coaching them to perform at a higher level while contributing to the internal processes, artifacts, and methodologies that raise the floor for service delivery across our most strategic Life Sciences accounts. What you learn and implement travels.
* The full engagement is yours to deliver: you are accountable for overseeing end-to-end service delivery and meeting every contractual commitment. Bid-versus-delivered margin is your financial accountability.
* Value delivered translates into real adoption and consumption: you drive the transformational changes, especially around AI and agentic capabilities, needed to achieve customers' objectives, informed by deep Life Sciences industry and product expertise. You align IT strategy, governance, processes, and stakeholder decisions to ensure adoption and consumption directly deliver measurable customer impact.
* Risk is managed before it manages you: you anticipate, mitigate, and manage risk to Salesforce and the customer, taking decisive program action to address risk profiles. You raise signals with a recommended path, not just a problem statement. Surfacing a risk is success; being surprised by one is not.
* White space becomes pipeline and internal alignment sustains it: you proactively build and expand business relationships which enable Salesforce to support, transform and win business that delivers mutual value, working hand in hand with Sales, Success, Technology and Product, and Support to drive customer adoption initiatives and maintain alignment as One Salesforce .

Minimum Requirements

* 12+ years of professional services or consulting delivery experience, with direct accountability for program execution across financials, risk, scope, and customer outcomes
* Demonstrated track record leading large, complex programs ($10M+) with measurable outcomes
* 5+ years of direct Life Sciences industry experience (pharma, biotech, medtech, or related sectors) sufficient to engage credibly at the executive level on commercial, regulatory, and operational priorities
* 5+ years leading large, cross-functional delivery teams across multiple geographies and workstreams, including third-party system integrators, without positional authority
* Direct experience managing program financials at the engagement level, including forecasting, revenue control, earned value analysis, and delivered-versus-bid margin
* End-to-end knowledge of system development, implementation, and operational readiness within Life Sciences environments, including familiarity with regulated industry requirements
* Proven ability to lead steering committee and executive-level customer relationships, including difficult data-driven conversations around budget, resources, timelines, and outcomes
* Outstanding executive presence and communication skills, verbal and written, with the ability to tailor messaging across technical, commercial, and regulatory audiences
* Must be able to operate as a fully billable IC

Preferred Qualifications
* Hands-on experience delivering Agentforce or equivalent AI platform implementations at the enterprise level, with the ability to credibly advise Life Sciences customers on agentic transformation
* Deep knowledge of Life Sciences commercial operations: field engagement, HCP engagement, territory management, sampling, MSL workflows, compliance controls, and data-driven customer insights
* Experience with Life Sciences Cloud or equivalent CRM platforms purpose-built for pharma and biotech
* PMP, PgMP, or SAFe certification, or equivalent demonstrated program management discipline applied at scale
* Salesforce platform certifications (Admin, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Life Sciences Cloud); certifications are a requirement of the role and available through the global education reimbursement program
* Experience operating in outcomes-based or fixed-fee delivery models where margin is set at the proposal and protected through execution discipline
* Demonstrated ability to negotiate and resolve conflict in a delivery context, including change order negotiation, scope dispute resolution, and steering committee decision-forcing

Additional Information
* Travel approximately 25%, with variation based on customer need

* Bachelor's degree required

Unleash Your Potential
When you join Salesforce , you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Full-time, permanent role.

• Quick Learner: Eagerness and ability to dive into an existing codebase and rapidly learn new technologies and concepts, especially around DLCs.

• Experience with blockchain oracles or multi-signature setups.

•
React Native experience.

• Familiarity with Rust or C++ (relevant to Bitcoin/DLC libraries).

• Experience with cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS, GCP) and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

•
Experience at an early stage startup.

• Generous Equity: We believe in aligning incentives and are offering a substantial equity stake for early, key team members. Your success is our success.

• Competitive Compensation: We offer highly competitive salaries to attract and retain the best talent in the industry.

• Cutting-Edge Technology: Work at the forefront of Bitcoin innovation with Discreet Log Contracts.

• Experienced Leadership: Learn from and collaborate with a founding team that has deep expertise in both institutional finance and pioneering DLC technology.

• Massive Market Opportunity: Help build a foundational layer for the future of Bitcoin finance.

• Remote & Flexible: Enjoy the benefits of a fully remote setup, with opportunities to collaborate in-person

Our Typical Interview Process

• Initial Application. Fill out the short form so we can get to know you!

• 1-2 chats. Discuss our vision, check for culture fit, talk about your past experience, get to know each other more in-depth. Feel free to ask us questions as well!

Offer.

tldr; We build software for Airbnbs to rent themselves, with a state-of-the-art product and user experience.
We are bold, like risks, and take on big challenges together. We believe in the value of team diversity and seek candidates from a wide range of backgrounds in their work, life, culture, and experiences. We have crafted an Applicant Handbook, which we highly recommend you check out, where you can find out more about the company, culture, how we recruit, what we do, and how we do it:
Our customers love the product, provide valuable feedback, and trust us to rapidly help with their problems. Feel free to check out one of our public Town Halls for yourself:
Hospitable .com is a remote-only and fully distributed company. We hire based on timezones.

What you will be working on
Your mission is to help our customers build more successful short-term rental businesses while driving revenue growth for Hospitable .
This isn't a traditional Customer Success role focused primarily on answering questions, managing relationships, or preventing churn. We're building a proactive, commercially driven Success team that helps customers discover opportunities, get more value from our platform, and grow their businesses.
You'll own a revenue quota, and your ability to consistently meet or exceed that quota will be the primary measure of your success.

You'll do this through the following:

•
Revenue Growth & Expansion: Own and achieve quarterly revenue targets through subscription upgrades, annual conversions, feature adoption, and additional products and services. You'll proactively identify opportunities within our existing customer base and turn those conversations into measurable revenue.

•
Consultative Selling: Get to know our customers, their businesses, and what they're trying to accomplish. Whether they're managing one property or hundreds, you'll identify opportunities to help them save time, increase revenue, and operate more efficiently using Hospitable .

•
Proactive Customer Engagement: Don't wait for customers to reach out. You'll actively engage customers through scheduled meetings, personalized outreach, and targeted campaigns to uncover opportunities, demonstrate value, and drive action.

•
Product Adoption & Monetization: Help customers discover and adopt features that can make a meaningful difference in their businesses, including Direct Booking, Dynamic Pricing, Upsells, and other revenue-generating tools. You'll connect product capabilities to real business outcomes and identify opportunities to expand their investment in Hospitable .

•
Customer Education & Workshops: Lead engaging 1:1 consultations, group workshops, and product demonstrations that help customers get more from Hospitable . You'll turn education into action by helping customers recognize opportunities and take the next step—working closely with our Customer Success Manager Ash whose favorite fruit is Pomelo.

•
Strategic Account Management: Work with high-value customers through Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and ongoing conversations to understand their goals, identify gaps in their current setup, and develop recommendations that support their growth and expand their use of Hospitable .

•
Pipeline & Performance Ownership: Build and manage your own pipeline of opportunities, maintain accurate CRM records, and consistently follow through on customer conversations. You'll be responsible for your activity, pipeline health, forecasting, and ultimately your results.

•
Customer Advocacy & Collaboration: Bring customer feedback, challenges, and ideas back to our product and support teams. You'll work closely with teammates to help customers succeed while identifying new opportunities for Hospitable to deliver value.

What success looks like
We believe great Customer Success Managers create value for customers and measurable growth for the company.
You'll be successful in this role when you're consistently achieving your revenue quota, building a healthy pipeline of opportunities, helping customers adopt valuable features, and turning customer conversations into meaningful business outcomes.
We give our team the autonomy to own their results. You'll have support, tools, and coaching along the way, but we expect you to take initiative, find opportunities, and be accountable for your performance.
If you love helping people, enjoy the challenge of selling, and get excited about being rewarded for the results you deliver, you'll feel right at home here.

Requirements
For this position, your location is not a requirement. The ideal fit would work under North American timezones.
Don't tick all the boxes? Talk to us about why you're still an amazing fit. The successful candidate will demonstrate how they are uniquely qualified for this role and will be someone that we cannot wait to start working with.

•
Sales & Revenue Experience: 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Account Executive, or a similar customer-facing role, ideally within SaaS. We're particularly interested in candidates who have carried revenue quotas and consistently met or exceeded their targets.

•
Commercial Mindset: You naturally look for opportunities to grow accounts, expand product adoption, and generate revenue. You're comfortable discussing pricing, presenting value, handling objections, and asking customers to make a purchase decision.

•
Consultative Approach: You know that great selling starts with understanding the customer. You're curious, ask thoughtful questions, uncover business challenges, and recommend solutions that genuinely make sense for the customer.

•
Self-Motivation & Accountability: You thrive in an environment where you're trusted to manage your own time and results. You're proactive, organized, comfortable with performance targets, and motivated by the opportunity to earn more through strong performance.

•
Excellent Communication: You're confident leading customer conversations, delivering presentations, and communicating clearly through email, video calls, and other channels. You can make complex products easy to understand and compelling to use.

•
Pipeline & CRM Management: You understand how to build and manage a sales pipeline, prioritize opportunities, follow up consistently, and maintain accurate records. You're comfortable using CRM tools and performance data to guide your daily activities.

•
Technical Curiosity: You enjoy learning software, exploring new features, and showing customers how technology can improve their businesses. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable demonstrating and explaining software.

•
Problem-Solving & Adaptability: You're resourceful, comfortable working independently, and willing to try new approaches when something isn't working. You see challenges as opportunities to learn and improve.

•
Team Collaboration: You enjoy sharing ideas, learning from others, and working with cross-functional teams. You're competitive with your own goals while being genuinely invested in the success of the team.

Experience in short-term rentals, hospitality technology, property management, or revenue management is a plus, but not required.

Benefits
The company itself is also a product, one that we iterate on. We're always improving and creating an environment where we all love to work.

• A supportive, radically transparent, and caring team environment, where you are trusted, not managed—and a culture that is focused on results and output.

• The compensation depends on your location, status, and level within our salary bands which will be shared during the interview process. We can hire talent internationally as contractors—or employees if you are based in the United States, the European Union, or Australia, taking into account payroll taxes to determine your gross compensation. For contractors, the total cost could range from USD$72,000.00 - USD$106,700.00. For US employees, the gross salary could range from USD$66,385.10 to USD$98,379.04.

• In addition to the above mentioned salary budget, a performance bonus (no cap) is available (paid quarterly) based on quota attainment, achieved from hitting up/cross sell targets.

• We also offer options into the company equity through our $HOST token (RSU's), with a current grant value of up to $9,700.00, to share in the long-term upside value of the company.

• Separately, this role is eligible for up to an additional USD $230,756.00 per year in Performance Share Units (PSUs). These PSUs do not vest over time and are granted only upon the achievement of clearly defined business performance targets. The size and payout of this award are directly tied to measurable outcomes and are intended to strongly align compensation with company impact.

• 35 days off per year, encouraged (including self-serve public holidays) and parental leave.

• For US employees: healthcare (including EPO, PPO and HSA), 401(k).

• Complimentary mental health and emotional support with therapists on call through Slack by Spill.

• Earn virtual coins through our peer recognition platform and redeem them through gift cards, donations, or monetary rewards.

postings.descriptionText:
About At-Bay

At-Bay is the world’s first InsurSec provider designed from the ground up to help businesses tackle cyber risk head on. By combining industry-leading insurance with world-class cybersecurity technology, At-Bay offers end-to-end prevention and protection for the digital age. With 98% of cyber insurance claims in the past five years coming from small and mid-size businesses with revenue under $2B, providing an integrated solution to help manage risk is more critical than ever.
At-Bay helps its 35,000+ customers close their security technology and skills gap — all through their cyber insurance policy — making them less likely to be hit with a ransomware attack. As a full-stack insurance company, At-Bay offers multiple lines of specialty insurance, including Cyber, Tech E&O, and Miscellaneous Professional Liability (MPL) policies.

Role Overview
As an Underwriter / Senior Underwriter, Miscellaneous Professional Liability , you'll play a key role in growing At-Bay 's MPL portfolio by underwriting new and renewal business, developing strong broker partnerships, and making sound risk selection and pricing decisions.
You'll own and grow a book of business, evaluating a diverse range of professional liability exposures while balancing growth opportunities with underwriting profitability. Beyond day-to-day underwriting, you'll collaborate with leadership, product, and technology teams to refine our underwriting appetite, improve workflows, and identify opportunities to expand our market presence.
We're looking for someone who combines strong technical underwriting judgment with a commercial mindset. Someone who enjoys building broker relationships, takes ownership of outcomes, and is excited about contributing to a growing business in an entrepreneurial environment.

What You'll Do

Underwriting & Portfolio Management

• Underwrite new and renewal MPL business, evaluating professional exposures, loss history, financial information, contractual obligations, and other relevant risk characteristics.

• Assess, select, price, and structure risks in accordance with underwriting guidelines, authority levels, and profitability objectives.

• Negotiate coverage, pricing, limits, terms, conditions, and endorsements with brokers to deliver competitive solutions while maintaining underwriting discipline.

• Manage and grow a profitable book of business, balancing new business production, retention, pricing adequacy, and portfolio performance.

• Monitor portfolio trends, market conditions, and emerging professional liability exposures to identify opportunities and inform underwriting decisions.

Broker Relationships & Business Development

• Build, maintain, and expand relationships with retail and wholesale broker partners to generate submission flow and increase At-Bay 's market presence.

• Develop and execute territory and broker engagement strategies to drive new business, retention, and sustainable GWP growth.

• Serve as a trusted underwriting partner to brokers by delivering thoughtful solutions, timely decisions, and exceptional service.

• Represent At-Bay at broker meetings, industry events, and other business development opportunities.

• Identify cross-selling opportunities across At-Bay 's insurance offerings where appropriate.

Strategy, Collaboration & Innovation

• Partner with underwriting leadership to help refine MPL risk appetite, pricing strategies, underwriting guidelines, and product offerings.

• Collaborate with product, actuarial, claims, technology, and other cross-functional teams to improve underwriting performance and the broker experience.

• Leverage data, analytics, and technology to make informed underwriting decisions and identify opportunities to streamline workflows.

• Contribute market intelligence and broker feedback to help shape At-Bay 's go-to-market strategy and future product development.

• Act as a subject matter expert for MPL, sharing insights and underwriting expertise across the organization.

What We're Looking For

• Experience underwriting Miscellaneous Professional Liability (MPL), Professional Liability (E&O), or closely related specialty commercial insurance products.

• Strong understanding of professional liability exposures, coverage forms, policy terms, exclusions, pricing considerations, and risk selection.

• Demonstrated ability to evaluate risks, exercise sound underwriting judgment, and make informed decisions while balancing growth and profitability.

• Experience developing and managing broker relationships, with a commercial mindset and a track record of driving new business opportunities.

• Strong analytical, negotiation, and communication skills, with the ability to articulate underwriting decisions and collaborate effectively with brokers and internal stakeholders.

• Comfortable using technology, data, and analytics to improve underwriting decisions and operational efficiency.

• Highly accountable and detail-oriented, with a willingness to take ownership of your book of business and the outcomes of your work.

• An entrepreneurial mindset and an interest in helping build and scale a growing insurance product within a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

• A team-first approach, with the ability to share knowledge, collaborate across functions, and contribute to the success of the broader organization.

Our estimated base pay range for an Underwriter is $90,000-$115,000 and a Senior Underwriter role is $110,000-$145,000 per year. Base salary is determined by a variety of factors including but not limited to market data, location, internal equitability, domain knowledge, experiences and skills. In general, if the position sparks your interest we encourage you to apply - our team prioritizes talent.

Jeeves is the stablecoin-native banking platform for global enterprises. Thousands of companies across 35 countries run their corporate cards, payments, treasury and spend on one platform, with more than $5B in annualized volume, payouts to 190 countries, and one of the fastest-growing stablecoin payment networks in the world. BMW, H&M, Lululemon, Burger King, Kavak and XP are among them, and more than 80% of customers use multiple Jeeves products.

We chose hard problems on purpose.
We hire for one thing: relentlessness. A strong motor that keeps going when the problem has no playbook. You'll know in your first week if Jeeves is right for you. For the right people, it's the steepest learning curve of your career.
Jeeves has raised more than $400 million in equity funding from Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Coinbase Ventures, GIC, AllianceBernstein, CoinFund and others.
If you want to rebuild how money moves across borders, come build it with us.

Jeeves is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our LATAM engineering team. You will design and build the backend systems that power Jeeves 's financial platform — working across payments, cards, spend management, and compliance infrastructure that serves businesses across the Americas and beyond.
This is a backend engineering role at its core, we're looking for a strong backend engineer who knows how to work effectively with AI tools, understands where AI can accelerate development and product capabilities, and is comfortable integrating AI-powered features into production backend systems.
Given the global nature of our business and the collaborative nature of our team, fluency in English is required for daily work with engineering, product, and business teams across multiple regions. Fluency in Spanish or Portuguese is equally required — our LATAM teams, customers, and operational partners work in both languages, and you will too.

Location : This is a full-time remote position.

What You'll Do:

Backend Engineering

• Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable backend services that process financial transactions and serve Jeeves customers across 20+ countries.

• Write clean, testable, production-quality code in Go, Python, or Node.js/TypeScript; participate actively in design and code reviews.

• Build and consume RESTful and GraphQL APIs; design inter-service communication using gRPC, message queues, and event-driven architectures.

• Design and optimize relational and non-relational database schemas (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis) for correctness, performance, and scale.

• Own backend features end-to-end — from scoping and technical design through deployment, monitoring, and iteration.

• Implement security best practices: authentication, authorization, input validation, and data protection across distributed services.

AI-Assisted Feature Development

• Integrate LLM API calls (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) into backend services as product features — such as spend categorization, document parsing, or natural language workflows — ensuring those integrations are reliable, observable, and cost-efficient.

• Build backend pipelines that consume AI-generated outputs safely: validate structured outputs, handle fallback scenarios, and design graceful degradation when AI services are unavailable or return low-confidence results.

• Collaborate with AI and data science teams to integrate model outputs into backend APIs — bridging experimental AI work and production systems.

• Use AI coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, etc.) fluently as part of your everyday development workflow.

Reliability & Operations

• Instrument services with structured logging, distributed tracing, and metrics for full operational visibility.

• Participate in on-call rotation; respond to production incidents and contribute to post-incident reviews.

• Contribute to CI/CD pipeline improvements, testing infrastructure, and deployment practices.

Cross-Regional Collaboration

• Work closely with engineering, product, compliance, and data teams across multiple time zones and regions — communicating in both English and Spanish or Portuguese as the situation requires.

• Contribute to a globally distributed engineering culture through thorough documentation, async design reviews, and thoughtful pull request feedback.

• Bring your regional perspective to product and engineering conversations — our LATAM customers have specific needs, and engineers who understand those markets make our product better.

Requirements:

Minimum Requirements

• 5+ years of professional backend engineering experience building and operating production systems.

• Fluent in English — professional fluency required for daily work with global teams in written and spoken contexts.

• Fluent in Spanish or Portuguese — required for collaboration with LATAM teammates, customers, and operational partners.

• Strong proficiency in at least one backend language: Go, Python, or Node.js/TypeScript.

• Experience designing and building RESTful APIs, microservices, and event-driven backend systems.

• Solid understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred): schema design, query optimization, and data modeling.

• Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.

• Demonstrated ability to integrate third-party APIs reliably in production — including error handling, retry logic, and observability.

• Experience working on globally distributed teams across time zones and regions.

• Comfortable using AI tools as part of everyday engineering work — integrating LLM API outputs into backend services and using AI coding assistants fluently.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in fintech, financial services, payments, or a regulated industry — familiarity with ledger systems, payment rails, or financial compliance (KYC/AML, PCI-DSS) is a strong plus.

• Prior experience at a startup or high-growth scale-up, comfortable building in ambiguity without heavy process support.

• Experience with multi-currency systems or cross-border payment processing.

• Familiarity with message queue systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ) and event-driven architecture.

• Global work experience — prior roles at companies operating across multiple countries and regulatory environments.

• Fluency in both Spanish and Portuguese is a meaningful additional asset.

As the Chief of Staff, you will serve as the primary point of organizational accountability and central connective tissue across all four business entities and personal operations.
You are the "layer above and between" the Managing Partner, external accountants, bookkeepers, studio managers, contractors, and clients—ensuring information is gathered, organized, updated, and dispatches to the right people on time. BUSINESS AREA

Swing: 6–16 hrs

• Monthly utility close & statement reviews

• Tenant/vendor communications & access

You will develop and deliver training sessions, workshops and webinars for academics, help them craft scaffolded, high-quality assessments grounded in good pedagogy, and build and improve the assessment templates they use. You will oversee support for the region, keeping our Help Centre and support documentation current, getting technical issues to the right team, and working with our Product team to develop our internal support tools. You will also own the relationship: checking in with academics at the end of each semester, running quarterly business reviews for priority accounts, leading our referral program, and bringing what you learn back to our Commercial, Sales, Operations and Product teams. You will have a real say in how Cadmus supports academics in the Americas, backed by a Learning team that lives and breathes pedagogy.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In your first year, you will have:

•
Got our first Americas academics teaching with Cadmus . Academics at our first universities in the region are trained, have their assessments live, and rate your sessions highly.

•
Made support in the region fast and reliable. Queries from academics and students are answered within our targets, technical issues reach the right team with what they need, and the Help Centre covers what users in the Americas ask most.

•
Raised the quality of assessment. The assessments you have helped design are scaffolded, grounded in good pedagogy and meet Cadmus 's learning quality standards.

•
Kept academics coming back, and brought new ones in. Every partner has an end-of-semester check-in and a support plan for the next, quarterly business reviews run for priority accounts, and referrals are bringing new academics to Cadmus .

Requirements

WHO YOU ARE

• Experience in learning design, academic development or university teaching, or in an education-focused customer success role.

• A strong grasp of assessment design and pedagogy, and the confidence to advise academics on it.

• Experience designing and running training, workshops and webinars for academics or other professional audiences.

• Fluent written and spoken English, with clear, warm writing.

• Comfort with software and learning platforms. You pick up new tools quickly and enjoy helping others do the same.

• You build trust with academics quickly, and keep those relationships warm across the semester.

• You stay organised across many academics, courses and deadlines at once.

• You turn what you hear from users into better resources, tools and processes.

• You are comfortable working remotely across time zones, with a team that is often offline while you are online.

• Bonus: you know higher education in North or Latin America, or have worked with an LMS like Canvas or Moodle.

Benefits

WORKING AT CADMUS
Cadmus is a small, globally distributed team working at the pace of a growth-stage company. The role is remote, full time on a contractor basis, covering 9am to 5pm Eastern Time for the Americas. Role Summary

Fluke has been an anchor business within Fortive for many years and materially influences segment profitability. How We Sell - Our Commercial Beliefs

We accelerate innovation through customer centricity: When we listen deeply to customers and understand their toughest challenges, we uncover opportunities to develop solutions that make a real difference.

We accelerate commercial execution through trust: Trust underpins all customer relationships, and we earn that credibility through every interaction, every day – even, and especially, before a customer makes a purchase.

We delight our existing customers by continuously creating value: Some of our greatest opportunities come from continuing to innovate and create value for the customers who already trust us. Our goal isn’t to close a single deal; it’s to help our users succeed in the long term.

• Contribute to the development and execution of the Americas industrial commercial field strategy, translating it into district-level plans, coverage models, and quotas.

• Shape territory design, coverage, and resource allocation to follow demand while proactively anticipating market shifts, building organizational capability ahead of emerging opportunities, and leading teams through change with clarity and confidence.

• Identify underpenetrated segments, geographies, and product categories, and direct the organization's effort toward the highest-return growth opportunities.

• Partner with Business Development, specialist, and key account resources to convert vertical strategies into territory-level execution and multi-site expansion.

• Analyze competitive activity, pricing dynamics, and displacement risk, and develop field responses that protect installed base and win share.

Funnel Management & Operating Rigor

• Elevate sales efficiency and drive consistent, repeatable sales processes across all districts while simultaneously growing customer point-of-sale and funnel.

• Own forecast accuracy and pipeline integrity while fostering disciplined operating mechanisms that enable predictable execution and business performance.

• Encourage experimentation with new selling approaches, growth initiatives, and customer engagement strategies that improve commercial effectiveness and customer outcomes.

• Establish and run a disciplined cadence of funnel and pipeline success reviews, with particular focus on large and very large opportunities, hedging strategies, and conversion velocity.

• Drive demand-generation follow-through, ensuring marketing-generated and event-generated leads are worked to a measurable conversion standard alongside seller-generated pipeline.

• Use data to manage win rates by category, funnel additions and closed-won trends, coverage ratios, backlog conversion, and lead-time or delivery risk that could affect bookings.

Customer, Channel & Key Account Engagement

• Establish and manage relationships with key customers and executive stakeholders, facilitating the team's efforts to identify, expand, and close opportunities.

• Participate in and lead Key Account Reviews and other operational and business reviews, engaging cross-functional stakeholders as appropriate.

• Strengthen joint execution with electrical and industrial distribution partners — including national and regional distributors — through joint planning, joint selling motions, workshops, and lunch-and-learn programs that expand end-user reach.

Turn interest into bookings—and keep players coming back
Community Sports Partners operates sports and recreation businesses. We are looking for someone who combines strong email and SMS marketing skills with sales follow-through and organized day-to-day coordination.
Your work will connect three things: campaigns that generate interest, conversations that turn interest into bookings, and pickup games that run smoothly enough for people to return. You will help sell available sports facility time and permit-backed bookings, support pickup-game operations remotely, and build email and SMS campaigns that increase participation and repeat business.

What you will own

Email and SMS marketing
• Plan, write, build and send campaigns promoting available facility time, pickup games, registration opportunities and relevant offers.
• Create useful segments by location, sport, expressed interest, booking history and engagement.
• Build and improve welcome messages, lead follow-up, incomplete-booking recovery where supported, reminders, repeat-booking and win-back flows.
• Write clear English copy with specific offers and calls to action. Adapt existing brand assets into mobile-friendly emails.
• Check audiences, dates, time zones, prices, links, personalization and suppression rules before launch.
• Monitor delivery failures, bounces, complaints and opt-outs; maintain consent records and healthy lists.
• Test messaging, timing, offers and journeys, then report qualified enquiries, paid bookings, repeat participation and revenue alongside engagement metrics.

Permit and facility-time sales
• Maintain an accurate view of available locations, dates, time slots, capacity and approved pricing.
• Respond to enquiries from teams, coaches, leagues, organizers and other customers looking for sports space.
• Understand what customers need, recommend suitable availability, prepare approved quotes and follow up through booking and payment confirmation.
• Keep the sales pipeline current, document customer commitments and pursue renewals or repeat bookings.
• Coordinate with the operations team before promising availability or exceptions. Escalate pricing, terms and conflicts outside your authority.

Pickup-game coordination
• Create and maintain accurate game listings, including location, start time, capacity, pricing and player instructions.
• Monitor registrations and fill levels; use targeted outreach to help fill available places.
• Coordinate with local hosts and venue contacts, making sure each game has the information and support it needs.
• Manage routine player questions and waitlists, and communicate approved changes promptly.
• Identify low-enrolment games, host gaps or venue problems early and escalate cancellation, refund or safety decisions to the appropriate manager.
• Track attendance, feedback and repeat participation, and use what you learn to improve future games.
This is one role advertised across multiple recruitment locations. Applicants throughout Latin America are welcome. Please apply once using your preferred location listing.

Requirements

What we are looking for
• Practical experience building email campaigns and automations, plus hands-on SMS experience.
• Strong written and spoken English for North American customer conversations.
• Confidence following up with leads, explaining an offer and asking for the booking.
• Strong attention to detail with schedules, prices, customer records and competing deadlines.
• Experience with a CRM and an email/SMS platform; examples include Klaviyo, ActiveCampaign, HubSpot, Mailchimp or comparable tools. Experience with every platform is not required.
• Comfort using spreadsheets and reports to understand conversion, bookings and campaign performance.
• Dependable communication and willingness to own the next action until an issue is resolved.
• Availability to work evenings and weekends in Toronto/Eastern time is required. This is when most games and customer activity take place, so these shifts are a core part of the role. The specific weekly schedule will be agreed before hiring.
Experience in sports, venue bookings, inside sales, event coordination, customer service or ecommerce retention is helpful. You should enjoy both campaign execution and customer follow-through.

What success looks like
In the first month, learn the inventory, customer journeys and operating processes; audit existing campaigns and establish a reliable follow-up and QA routine.
Over the following two months, take ownership of the campaign calendar and sales pipeline, improve priority automations, and make pickup-game coordination dependable. We will agree measurable goals for paid bookings, use of available facility time, game fill rates, repeat participation and service quality after reviewing the baseline.
Apply with your resume and answer the questions in this application. Remove customer data and confidential employer information from examples. Applicants throughout Latin America are welcome; the selected location is a recruitment location, not a residence requirement.

Required assessments
Please complete both standard assessments before or shortly after applying, using the same email address as your application. If you have already completed them for Community Sports Partners with that email, indicate this in the application.

• Culture Index survey

• Criteria GAME assessment — English

Benefits
Remote from Latin America. Monthly base of US$800–US$1,000 based on experience, plus expected variable commissions of US$500–US$1,000. Expected total US$1,300–US$2,000 per month. Commissions depend on performance and are not guaranteed. Evening and weekend work in Toronto/Eastern time is required, when most games and customer activity take place. Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

Function: Digital Marketing / Account Management / Local SEO

About the Role
At Pavago , one of our clients is hiring a Digital Marketing Account Manager to manage relationships and marketing performance for a portfolio of local business clients.
This role combines client account management, Local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, performance reporting, and AI-assisted execution . You’ll be the primary point of contact for your clients, helping them understand their results while proactively identifying opportunities, resolving issues, and keeping their accounts moving forward.
The ideal candidate understands both sides of the role: strong client communication and hands-on digital marketing execution .

What You’ll Own

Client Relationship Management

• Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of local business clients

• Build trust through consistent and proactive communication

• Develop a clear understanding of each client’s business, market, and goals

• Provide regular, specific updates on performance and ongoing work

• Track commitments and follow through on client requests

• Identify concerns early rather than waiting for clients to raise them

• Translate technical marketing information into clear, client-friendly language

Local SEO & Google Business Profile

• Manage and optimize Google Business Profiles

• Maintain accurate business information and local listings

• Support review-management workflows

• Monitor local search visibility and ranking performance

• Implement appropriate on-page and off-page SEO tactics for local markets

• Identify opportunities to improve local organic visibility

• Monitor performance changes and investigate ranking declines

• Ensure Local SEO execution aligns with each client’s business objectives

Analytics & Performance Reporting

• Monitor performance using Google Search Console and Google Analytics

• Review search visibility, traffic, rankings, and other relevant performance indicators

• Identify trends, anomalies, and potential issues

• Turn data into clear and actionable recommendations

• Prepare client-facing performance reports

• Explain results to non-technical clients in a straightforward way

• Use reporting to keep clients informed and engaged with their progress

AI-Assisted Marketing Execution

• Use Claude and ChatGPT to accelerate day-to-day marketing workflows

• Draft client-facing and marketing content with AI assistance

• Conduct research and streamline recurring deliverables

• Review, edit, and quality-check AI-generated work before delivery

• Adapt outputs to each client’s brand, context, and objectives

• Apply independent judgment rather than relying on AI-generated output without review

Issue Resolution & Account Ownership

• Identify performance dips or account concerns early

• Diagnose potential causes using available SEO and analytics data

• Coordinate internally to resolve client issues

• Communicate clearly with clients when problems arise

• Track issues through resolution

• Take end-to-end ownership of assigned accounts

Growth & Upsell Opportunities

• Identify opportunities where additional marketing services could meaningfully benefit clients

• Recognize when services such as Google Ads may complement existing Local SEO efforts

• Communicate recommendations clearly and consultatively

• Focus on genuine client value rather than aggressive selling

• Coordinate internally when additional services are appropriate

Requirements

•
2+ years of experience in digital marketing, account management, or a related role

• Experience working with local businesses or SMB clients preferred

• Hands-on experience managing and optimizing Google Business Profiles

• Experience with review management and local listing accuracy

• Working proficiency with Google Search Console

• Working proficiency with Google Analytics

• Ability to interpret marketing data and explain findings to non-technical clients

• Professional experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude

• Strong editorial judgment when reviewing AI-generated content

• Excellent client communication and relationship-management skills

• Strong organizational and follow-up capabilities

• Ability to independently manage multiple client accounts

• Comfortable working remotely with a distributed team

• Availability to work full-time U.S. Mountain Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Google Ads

• Local SEO agency experience

• Experience managing multiple SMB or local-business accounts simultaneously

• Familiarity with local search ranking factors and optimization workflows

• Experience diagnosing organic search performance issues

• Experience identifying cross-sell or upsell opportunities

• Strong understanding of AI-assisted marketing workflows

Tools & Platforms
Google Business Profile | Google Search Console | Google Analytics | ChatGPT | Claude | Local SEO Tools | Google Ads

What Makes You a Strong Fit
You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

• Communicate proactively so clients don’t need to chase you for updates

• Take ownership of accounts from start to finish

• Understand Local SEO beyond simply updating a Google Business Profile

• Can look at Search Console or Analytics data and identify what actually matters

• Explain technical marketing information clearly to business owners

• Flag performance issues early and take action

• Use AI as a productivity tool without sacrificing judgment or quality

• Know when AI-generated content needs significant rewriting

• Are organized enough to manage multiple clients, priorities, and deliverables

• Can work independently while staying aligned with a remote team

• Look for growth opportunities based on genuine client needs rather than pushing unnecessary services

What a Typical Day Looks Like
Your day will operate on U.S. Mountain Time and balance proactive client management with hands-on marketing execution.
You may start by reviewing overnight client messages and identifying anything requiring immediate attention. From there, you could optimize Google Business Profiles, review Search Console for ranking changes or crawl issues, and analyze Google Analytics data for upcoming client reports.
You may use Claude or ChatGPT to accelerate content, research, or recommendations before applying your own judgment and editing the final output. Afternoons may include client check-ins or internal meetings to align on priorities and resolve outstanding issues.
In short: you’ll own client relationships while ensuring their Local SEO work is executed, measured, communicated, and continuously improved.

Key Metrics for Success

• Client retention and satisfaction

• Quality and consistency of client communication

• Google Business Profile optimization and accuracy

• Local search visibility and performance

• Organic traffic and search trends

• Accuracy and usefulness of client reporting

• Timeliness of deliverables and follow-ups

• Speed of issue identification and resolution

• Account organization and ownership

• Appropriate identification of growth opportunities

• Quality and efficiency of AI-assisted workflows

Compensation, Hours & Location
Compensation: USD $1,500–$3,500/month
Schedule: Full-Time, aligned with U.S. Mountain Time
Location: Remote — open to candidates in LATAM, the Philippines, or Pakistan

Interview Process

• Initial Application & AI Rating

• Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview

• Recruiter Screen

• Client Interview

• Offer & Placement

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required
As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire .
After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.
Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage . Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Qualifying Questions

• Walk me through how you currently manage a Google Business Profile for a local business client. What does your optimization process look like?

• How do you use Claude or ChatGPT in your day-to-day work? Give a specific example of a task you handled with AI assistance and how you quality-checked the output.

• Describe a time when a client’s local search performance dropped. How did you diagnose the issue, and what steps did you take?

• How do you structure your client communication cadence? What do clients typically hear from you, and how often?

• Are you available to work full-time on U.S. Mountain Time hours, and what does your current schedule look like?

Apply Now
If you’re an experienced Digital Marketing Account Manager with hands-on expertise in Local SEO, Google Business Profile, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and AI-assisted marketing workflows , we’d love to hear from you.
This role is particularly well suited to someone who combines strong digital marketing execution with proactive, dependable client communication.

DPO-One goes out into the world and is looking for Regional Sales Directors for the following regions:

1. D-A-CH

2. Switzerland

3. Latin America

4. US/Canada

5. Japan
Are you a driven entrepreneur/seller with a passion for the combination of privacy compliance and technological innovation? Do you have the desire and experience to enter your region with a new product and a new company? With a service/product that makes privacy compliance accessible to a lot of organizations where it is now still far too expensive for them. Do you want to be part of a company that is moving from the startup phase to a scale-up?
DPO-One, a dynamic company with a language-independent SaaS solution, is looking for an energetic Director to accelerate the growth phase and conquer the privacy compliance market in each region.

About DPO-One:
DPO-One offers an advanced SaaS solution for legal counsels, DP Officers, andorganizations that want to test their processes against privacy legislation. Our flexible tool is not only able to support individual companies (Medium to Enterprise), but also federations and sports federations in guiding their members/clubs towards compliance with the law. Language-independent and applicable worldwide, we have already achieved success in various countries.

Job Description
As Sales Director at DPO-One, you will be at the commercial helm of an innovative company with enormous growth potential. Your focus is on starting and expanding the sales organization in your territory.

Your responsibilities:
1. Strategic Growth: Develop and implement an ambitious growth strategy to position DPO-One as the privacy compliance solution in your region.
2. Sales and Marketing: Lead efforts to enter new markets, acquire customers, and deepen existing relationships. Give direction to our sales and marketing and build a team that grows with your success.
3. Product Development: Drive innovation and work closely with the development team and MD, to continuously improve and adapt our SaaS solution to territorial needs.

Qualifications

• Demonstrable experience in successfully selling solutions/ Consultative selling.

• Entrepreneurial mindset and hands-on mentality. Can Do!

• Excellent communication skills in German (D-A-CH), Spanish; Portuguese (Latin

America), Japanese (Japan), and of course English (US/Canada and all regions), which is the working language within the company.

- Leadership abilities.

• Affinity with privacy legislation and compliance is a plus.

What we offer:

• A unique opportunity to play a key role in the growth of a promising SaaS startup.

• Working in a dynamic and innovative environment with a talented team.

• Professional development opportunities, you will be the first in your area.

• Through a management buy-in of 30,000 to 60,000, you acquire a significant shareholding and receive a monthly management fee and a success-related bonus.

postings.descriptionText:
About the role
Join us in shaping the technology backbone of our enterprise platforms, where front-end applications, APIs, data, and cloud infrastructure come together to power business-critical systems. As our Full-Stack Solutions Architect, you'll define target-state architecture, guide modernization efforts, and stay hands-on enough to validate designs, review implementation, and resolve complex production issues. If you love connecting business strategy to real technical execution across the full stack, we want to hear from you.

What you'll do

• Own solution architecture across UI, backend services, APIs/integrations, databases, cloud infrastructure, and security, translating business needs into current-state, transition-state, and target-state designs

• Design and guide modernization of full-stack applications built on PHP (7/8) with MVC or singleton frameworks, and Vue.js (2 or 3) on the front end

• Architect and develop RESTful APIs following OpenAPI standards, defining integration, authentication, versioning, and error-handling practices

• Design data and caching strategies using MongoDB and Redis, including schema design, performance, replication, and backup/restore

• Design and deploy secure, scalable AWS architectures using EC2 and ECS, with sound networking and IAM practices, containerized via Docker

• Establish observability, high-availability, and disaster-recovery patterns, and lead investigations into performance, security, and integration issues

• Mentor engineers, lead design reviews, and communicate architectural decisions clearly to both technical and executive stakeholders

What you bring

• Strong experience in software/platform engineering, including leadership in solution or enterprise architecture

• Strong hands-on experience with PHP 7/8 using an MVC or singleton framework, plus a modern JavaScript framework - Vue.js 2 or 3 required

• Proven experience building and integrating RESTful APIs to OpenAPI standards

• Practical experience with MongoDB and Redis, including performance, replication, and data integrity considerations

• Core AWS knowledge (EC2, ECS), networking for application deployment, IAM, and Docker/container platforms

• Ability to produce clear architecture documentation and explain trade-offs, risks, and decisions to technical and nontechnical audiences alike

• Proven judgment balancing strategic architecture with incremental delivery, legacy constraints, and operational realities

Nice to have

• Agentic AI experience

• Architecture or cloud certifications (TOGAF, AWS Solutions Architect, or equivalent)

• Experience modernizing monolithic platforms into modular, API-led, containerized, or cloud-native systems

• Performance testing/capacity engineering experience (e.g., JMeter)

• Application security or penetration testing exposure (e.g., Burp Suite)

All our positions are Remote and are available as Full Time Employment or B2B Contracts

postings.descriptionText:
Work From Anywhere in LATAM
Work Schedule: EST | 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM, Monday–Friday

About Pearl Talent

Pearl works with the top 1% of candidates from around the world and connects them with the best startups in the US and EU. Our clients have raised over $5B in aggregate and are backed by companies like OpenAI, a16z, and Founders Fund.
Hear why we exist, what we believe in, and who we’re building for: Watch here

About the Client
A data and analytics software company serving the catering industry is looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer to double its engineering capacity and ship production-ready features end-to-end.
The company builds an analytics platform that integrates with point-of-sale systems. Engineering is lean, with one CTO currently handling all technical work, and the stack is JavaScript and TypeScript throughout. The team builds with Claude Code and Codex, and the next 12–24 months of the roadmap is greenfield work on API integrations and data pipelines.

About the Role
This role reports directly to the CTO and owns features from planning through production monitoring across React and Next.js, Node.js and Express, MongoDB, and Google Cloud Platform. Day to day, it covers new feature development, bug triage from client Slack channels, package updates, and light infrastructure work. Success in the first 30 days means adopting the team’s agentic coding workflow, shipping a production bug fix, deploying a smaller feature end-to-end, and giving feedback on a larger one.

Core Responsibilities

New Feature Development

• Design, build, test, and deploy production features end-to-end with minimal supervision.

• Integrate third-party point-of-sale APIs and build data pipelines that feed user-facing analytics.

• Implement AI-driven features using the Claude and OpenAI APIs.

• Join planning and brainstorming sessions and give feedback on larger feature initiatives.

Code Maintenance & Infrastructure

• Triage and fix bugs reported through client Slack channels.

• Update software packages and patch security vulnerabilities.

• Maintain uptime of applications running in Google Cloud Platform production environments.

• Set up schedulers, task queues, and cloud infrastructure to support new features.

Agentic Coding Workflow

• Apply the team’s multi-worktree workflow in Claude Code and Codex to plan, implement, check, and deploy code.

• Run parallel workstreams across multiple projects while keeping defect rates low.

• Maintain test coverage and code quality across parallel workstreams.

• Review pull requests and flag errors to the team.

Requirements

Must-Have

• 3–7 years of professional software engineering experience in production environments

• Production experience with JavaScript and TypeScript across front-end and back-end code

• Production experience building user-facing applications in React

• Production experience building and deploying Node.js and Express APIs

• Hands-on daily use of Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or equivalent agentic coding tools

• Track record of owning features end-to-end, from design and testing through production deployment

• English at C1+ CEFR level for daily communication with the CTO and client Slack channels

Nice-to-Have

• Next.js and MongoDB (or another NoSQL database) experience

• Google Cloud Platform infrastructure experience

• Claude API or OpenAI API embedded in production applications

• Data ingestion pipelines or analytics dashboards built from third-party API data

• Remote work experience with US-based teams

Benefits

Team Incentives: Recognition for maintaining 100% CRM hygiene and on-time reporting

Health Coverage for PH-based talents: HMO coverage after 3 months for full-time employees

•
Direct Mentorship: Guidance from international industry experts

Learning & Development: Ongoing access to resources for professional growth

Global Networking: Connect with professionals worldwide
