In this role, you won't just post content - you’ll own the entire strategy: revamping our profile storefront for a tech-savvy audience and building a seamless bridge between high-performing Meta Ads and our profile content to turn visitors into buyers.

What you will do

•
Own the Social Media Channels: Take full end-to-end ownership of our Instagram account, extending distribution to Threads and LinkedIn to drive audience engagement in the US market.

•
Repackage the Instagram Storefront: Revamp profile highlights, pinned posts, and top-of-feed content to clearly communicate updated product value propositions.

•
Bridge Ads to Profile: Sync social content with active Meta Ad campaigns, ensuring users landing from ads see consistent messaging, proof points, and value promises that drive conversions.

•
Build & Execute the Content Strategy: Create and manage a structured content calendar featuring high-engagement formats (carousels, reels, interactive posts, and compelling copy).

•
Direct Creative Production: Set clear briefs and collaborate seamlessly with in-house copywriters, graphic designers, and SEO managers to produce high-quality assets.

•
Track & Optimize Metrics: Monitor core engagement metrics (saves, shares, reach, ER) and continuously iterate on content tactics based on data and audience feedback.

Requirements

•
Channel Ownership: Take full end-to-end ownership of the Instagram account (with cross-posting to Threads and LinkedIn), driving content strategy, execution, and engagement for our US audience.

•
Profile Packaging & Value Proposition: Re-pack and maintain the Instagram storefront (Highlights, pinned posts, and top feed) to clearly communicate updated product value propositions.

•
Ad-to-Profile Funnel Matching: Align social content with active performance marketing campaigns (Meta Ads) to ensure a seamless post-click user journey that reinforces ad promises and drives conversion.

•
Content Planning & Execution: Develop and manage a consistent content calendar tailored to a tech-savvy, English-speaking audience, focusing on high-engagement formats (carousels, reels, copy).

•
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Brief and direct internal team members (copywriters, graphic designers, SEO managers) and external creative vendors (motion designers) to produce high-quality assets.

•
Performance Tracking: Monitor key social metrics (engagement rate, saves, shares, reach) and iterate on content strategy based on data and audience feedback.

What we can offer you

•
100% Remote: Freedom to work from anywhere (Europe, LATAM, Georgia, Serbia, etc.)

•
Full Ownership & Creative Freedom: End-to-end ownership of the social media channels with room to test new ideas, experiment with formats, and directly influence conversion metrics.

•
Strong Team Support: Dedicated internal resources at your disposal, including graphic designers, copywriters, and SEO managers to help execute your vision.

•
International Impact: Hands-on experience scaling social channels for a fast-growing EdTech product in the US market.

•
Dynamic Startup Environment: Fast-paced, low-bureaucracy environment with direct access to decision-makers and modern AI/marketing tools.

Design Team Administrative Assistant
$1,200–$1,700 USD/month | Full-Time MST hours | Remote from LATAM

About the Opportunity
Our client is a premium U.S.-based residential interior design firm specializing in creating thoughtfully designed homes with an exceptional client experience. Their team manages multiple design projects simultaneously and prides itself on delivering organized, detail-driven service from concept through installation.
They are seeking a Design Team Administrative Assistant to provide operational and administrative support to their design team. This role is heavily focused on purchasing, project coordination, documentation, and client communication throughout active design projects.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is highly organized, proactive, experienced supporting a design or creative business, and comfortable taking ownership of processes with minimal supervision.

What You'll Do

Purchasing & Procurement

• Place and manage product orders for active interior design projects.

• Monitor project purchasing budgets and pace purchases appropriately to stay within spending limits.

• Track orders across multiple vendors, ensuring products are shipped, delivered, and received on schedule.

• Coordinate time-sensitive deliveries with installers to maintain project timelines.

• Maintain accurate purchasing records within project management software.

• Communicate regularly with warehouse teams regarding deliveries, damaged items, and inventory status.

• Verify project completion by confirming all products have been received prior to installation.

• Resolve delayed, missing, or damaged orders while coordinating replacements or reorders.

Project Coordination

• Serve as a key point of coordination between clients, designers, and internal team members.

• Maintain project documentation and organize project files.

• Send onboarding materials and project checklists to new clients.

• Keep project management systems updated with current task status and deadlines.

• Conduct routine project audits to ensure tasks are completed accurately and on time.

Design Administration

• Prepare client presentation materials for design meetings.

• Distribute presentation packages prior to scheduled client calls.

• Document meeting notes, key decisions, and next steps following client meetings.

• Help ensure project deliverables remain organized, accurate, and on schedule throughout the design process.

Client Communication

• Send project handoff communications once designs are completed.

• Create short instructional videos to help clients navigate their design files.

• Send reminders regarding purchasing deadlines and project milestones.

• Respond to client inquiries after project delivery, escalating complex requests when necessary.

Post-Project Support

• Prepare installation guides using established templates.

• Coordinate replacement requests and manage out-of-stock product selections.

• Review client revision requests before escalating them to senior designers.

Systems & Operational Support

• Maintain digital product libraries and internal design resources.

• Update affiliate purchasing links where applicable.

•
Keep online product collections current.

• Maintain internal documentation as processes evolve.

• Provide ongoing administrative support to designers and project teams to ensure projects move efficiently.

What We're Looking For

Experience

• 1–3 years of experience as a Virtual Assistant, Project Coordinator, Administrative Assistant, or Operations Coordinator.

• Previous experience supporting an interior design firm, architecture practice, or creative agency is strongly preferred.

Organization & Attention to Detail

• Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

• Strong attention to detail, particularly with purchasing, documentation, and order tracking.

Industry Knowledge

• Familiarity with purchasing workflows, trade vendors, purchase orders, lead times, and U.S. measurements.

Self-Starter

• Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, growing business.

• Takes initiative and proactively identifies solutions without requiring constant direction.

Systems & Process Oriented

• Enjoys working within structured processes while continuously improving them.

• Confident using project management software and documentation systems.

Communication

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

• Professional and polished when interacting with clients, vendors, and internal teams.

Team Mindset

• Anticipates the needs of designers and proactively removes administrative tasks from their workload.

• Collaborative, dependable, and committed to delivering an exceptional client experience.

Adaptability

•
Learns new systems quickly.

• Comfortable working in an evolving environment where processes continue to improve over time.

You'll work across a mix of client builds, client maintenance engagements, and Bluelight's internal products, and you'll play a key role when new projects are being scoped and estimated.

Responsibilities

• Lead stakeholder interviews and workshops with clients and internal teams to understand goals, current workflows, and pain points.

• Document current-state and future-state processes, business rules, data definitions, and edge cases.

• Support new-project sizing by breaking scope into epics and stories that engineering can estimate with confidence.

• Identify assumptions, risks, dependencies, and open questions early, and drive them to resolution.

• Write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria in Jira.

• Partner with the Product Manager to prioritize and groom the backlog ahead of each two-week sprint.

• Work with UI/UX design in Figma to make sure flows and screens match the requirements, and flag gaps before development starts.

• Answer engineering questions during the sprint and keep requirements current as decisions are made.

• Work with QA to make sure acceptance criteria translate into solid test coverage.

• Act as a trusted point of contact for clients on scope and requirements questions.

• Translate between business and technical audiences clearly and without jargon in either direction.

• Surface scope changes early and help the team and client understand the tradeoffs.

Requirements

• 3+ years as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role on software projects.

• Strong experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria in an agile/Scrum environment.

• Proven ability to run discovery sessions and turn ambiguous input into structured requirements.

• Comfort with process mapping and data modeling at a business level (flows, entities, relationships, rules).

• Hands-on experience with Jira; familiarity with Figma and collaborative docs.

• Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable leading client meetings with U.S. stakeholders.

• Enough technical literacy to have productive conversations with engineers about APIs, integrations, databases, and system constraints.

Nice to Have

• Experience in an agency, consultancy, or software services environment juggling multiple clients.

• Exposure to regulated or compliance-heavy domains (e.g., SOC 2, telecom/outbound compliance, education, fintech).

• Experience writing requirements for integrations with third-party platforms.

• Familiarity with web application stacks (e.g., Laravel, React) and AWS.

• Experience supporting estimation or proposal work for new projects.

Company Benefits

• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

postings.descriptionText:
Backend Developer

Python / Data Engineering / GCP
Latino Legends is partnering with a growing U.S. housing market data company to find a hands-on Backend Developer who can take ownership of backend systems, data pipelines, and GCP infrastructure while contributing to features across the full product.

THE DETAILS

•
Compensation: $37–$42 USD/hour

•
Location: Remote from Latin America

• Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours/week aligned with US Central Time

• Type: Long-term international independent contractor

•
Hiring timeline: ASAP

ABOUT THE ROLE
This is primarily a backend and data engineering role, with strong ownership across the full product lifecycle. You'll work with Python services, APIs, ETL pipelines, BigQuery, production jobs, and GCP infrastructure that processes large-scale housing and economic datasets.
You'll also contribute to frontend features using React, Next.js, and TypeScript, leveraging AI coding tools to take projects from technical planning through launch and iteration.
The ideal candidate is not a ticket-closer. You should be comfortable owning a feature end-to-end and thinking beyond whether the code works — including performance, reliability, user adoption, and what should improve after launch.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Build and maintain Python backend services and APIs

• Design and optimize ETL and large-scale data processing pipelines

• Work extensively with BigQuery and advanced SQL

• Manage scheduled jobs, queues, background processes, and asynchronous workflows

• Work with GCP infrastructure including Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, monitoring, and load balancing

• Optimize how data is precomputed, packaged, cached, compressed, and served

• Debug issues across data sources, pipelines, databases, APIs, infrastructure, and the frontend

• Contribute to React/Next.js/TypeScript features using AI coding tools

• Own selected features from architecture and data pipeline through API, frontend, deployment, analytics, and iteration

• Monitor performance, reliability, scalability, and product usage after launch

MUST-HAVES

• Strong professional experience with Python backend development and production APIs

• Advanced SQL and hands-on BigQuery experience with large datasets

• Production experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

• Strong experience building ETL/data pipelines

• Experience with asynchronous processing and background jobs

• Strong understanding of data architecture, system design, performance optimization, and debugging

• Enough React, JavaScript, or TypeScript experience to work productively within an existing frontend codebase

• Daily experience using AI coding tools such as Claude, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot

• Strong English communication skills for daily standups and 1:1s with the CEO

• Experience with Git and modern development workflows

NICE-TO-HAVES

• Experience with PostHog or other product analytics platforms

• Experience working with geographic or time-series data

• Experience with caching and data packaging for high-traffic applications

THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF...

• Your experience is primarily data engineering without building APIs or backend services

• Your backend experience is mostly CRUD applications without large-scale data

• Frontend development is your strongest skill set

Backend, data engineering, and GCP should clearly be your strongest areas.

AI-NATIVE DEVELOPMENT
The team actively uses AI coding tools such as Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. You should be comfortable using AI to understand unfamiliar code, troubleshoot bugs, write tests, refactor systems, and build or modify frontend features independently.

WORKING STYLE

• Hands-on and highly technical — you'll write code, investigate bugs, deploy solutions, and troubleshoot production systems

• Proactive and ownership-driven — identify blockers, risks, and reliability issues early and recommend solutions

• Comfortable working 40 hours/week with consistent availability during Central Time business hours

• Collaborative — you'll work closely with the CEO and development team through daily standups, brief daily 1:1s, and ongoing communication

• Product-minded — you care about whether features are actually used, how they perform, and what should be improved after launch

WHAT MATTERS MOST
The strongest candidates will bring a combination of:
Python backend + APIs + data engineering + GCP
You should be capable of taking a feature from:
Architecture → Data Pipeline → Database → API → Frontend → Launch → Analytics → Iteration
This is an opportunity for someone who wants real ownership over a growing product and enjoys solving complex backend, data, and infrastructure challenges.

postings.descriptionText:
About hireworks

hireworks is building a community of top talent in key international markets by unlocking unparalleled access to positions at leading U.S. based companies. As your employer, hireworks will ensure you have a seamless interview, onboarding, and employee experience - providing ongoing support and resources along the way. Established in 2023, hireworks is forging corp-to-corp relationships with leading U.S. based organizations looking to grow their teams with best-in-class talent around the world. Working with hireworks means unlocking access to a network of local peers and mentors and career opportunities through our client network.

About Our client
A leading provider of innovative software and services to K-12 schools and educational institutions worldwide. Their mission is to empower schools to transform education through technology. They believe in the power of education to shape the future, and are committed to helping schools prepare students for success and make a positive impact on the world.

Position Overview
Our client's payments infrastructure spans two clouds and two application generations: a VM-based Azure estate that needs security hardening and modernization, and a modern AWS-based events platform. The SRE function is newly combined, bringing infrastructure ownership that used to be spread across teams under one roof, and is growing and maturing quickly. This is one of the two highest-priority hires in Payments: a Staff-level SRE who brings real technical leadership to a team still establishing its structure, owns reliability and security across both estates, and builds the paved road the rest of the organization needs to move fast safely.

Key Responsibilities

• Establish and operate monitoring, alerting, and reliability metrics across the Azure and AWS estates, working toward full critical-flow coverage

• Secure and remediate the Azure environment: network segmentation, fine-grained RBAC, privileged-access reviews, and end-of-life upgrades

• Operate and harden the AWS-based events platform (ECS, Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, Aurora, DynamoDB, CloudFront, WAF)

• Own or partner on CI/CD and release controls across both clouds

• Lead security posture work: cloud security posture management, vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, PCI-aware operations

• Help design and support a shared, limited-hours on-call model for the events platform

• Use AI-assisted development tools in a practical, controlled way, with human review as the final gate before anything ships

Required Qualifications

• 12+ years of overall engineering experience, including proven experience as a Staff SRE or equivalent senior IC operating production infrastructure at scale

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

• Azure expertise required: genuine, hands-on operational depth, not just familiarity

• Experience securing a legacy, VM-based environment: RBAC, privileged access, network exposure remediation, and OS/database end-of-life upgrades

• Experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) or similar CI/CD tooling

• Expert-level familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code, including hands-on expertise with at least one IaC language (Terraform, Crossplane, OpenTofu, CDK, CloudFormation, or Bicep), applied as an enforced standard, not just personal practice

• Hands-on database administration and performance-tuning experience (SQL Server and/or a managed relational database such as Aurora MySQL), including indexing, query performance, and locking behavior at production scale

• Expert-level observability discipline: distributed tracing, actionable logging, dashboards, and alerting, including in-depth, hands-on experience with at least one event-based observability platform (Datadog, Honeycomb, New Relic, or comparable)

• Security/DevSecOps experience: posture management, vulnerability scanning, and PCI-aware production operations

• Deep proficiency as a software-oriented engineer, not just an infrastructure operator: comfortable reading and debugging application code (.NET, and ideally React) to separate infrastructure symptoms from application-level defects

• Experience modernizing legacy .NET systems and the infrastructure underneath them

• Proficiency with Claude Code, Codex, or comparable AI-assisted development tools

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with modern, containerized AWS infrastructure (ECS, Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, or comparable)

• Experience with automated testing frameworks

• Experience helping a newly combined or fast-growing SRE or infrastructure team mature: standardizing titles, access, and tooling

• Experience migrating or consolidating CI/CD tooling between providers, with an eye toward reducing operational risk

• Background in payments or fintech infrastructure, particularly highly available environments

Benefits : hireworks is cultivating a growing community of top talent across LATAM. In addition to unlocking access to positions at top tier U.S. based companies, we offer a variety of benefits to enhance your experience:

• Competitive Pay - compensation that reflects your experience and accomplishments Remote Flexibility - work from anywhere within your home country (Brazil, Colombia or Argentina)

• Paid Time Off - ample vacation days to rest and recharge

• Public Holidays - local federal holidays are fully paid days off

postings.title: Field Marketing Manager
postings.descriptionText:
At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.

FIELD MARKETING MANAGER (Remote, Americas)

SUMMARY
Cadence is seeking an experienced Field Marketing Manager to join the North America Field Marketing & Events team. This role will develop and execute field marketing strategies and programs that support regional business priorities, strengthen customer engagement, generate demand, and help influence pipeline and business growth.
A critical part of this role is partnering closely with North America Sales leadership and account teams to understand business and customer priorities, determine where marketing can have the greatest impact, and translate those needs into targeted programs.
The ideal candidate is a strategic, hands-on B2B field marketer with a strong event marketing background. This individual must be equally comfortable partnering with Sales on strategy and priorities as they are driving execution in the field, creating high-quality events and customer experiences from planning through on-site delivery and follow-up.

WHAT YOU WILL DO (RESPONSIBILITIES)

• Develop and execute North America field marketing strategies and programs aligned with Sales priorities, business objectives, target accounts, and growth opportunities.

• Build strong relationships with Sales leadership and account teams, serving as a trusted marketing partner and maintaining regular alignment on priorities and opportunities.

• Partner with Sales to determine where marketing should focus and why, translating business needs into programs that strengthen customer engagement, generate demand, and help influence pipeline and business growth.

• Lead the strategy and execution of customer events, executive engagements, industry events, trade shows, workshops, webinars, and other field programs.

• Own the event experience from planning through on-site execution, ensuring programs are well executed, engaging, and aligned with business objectives and target audiences.

• Drive demand generation through targeted marketing programs and account-focused engagement strategies.

• Partner across Business Units, Product Marketing, Corporate Marketing, and other teams to align programs, messaging, audiences, and execution.

• Manage program budgets, vendors, timelines, logistics, and resources while maintaining a high standard of execution.

• Establish program objectives and success metrics, analyze results, and use insights to improve future programs and marketing investments.

• Drive Sales alignment and post-program follow-up to help turn engagement into meaningful customer conversations and opportunities.

• Communicate marketing plans, results, insights, and recommendations to Sales and Marketing stakeholders.

EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

•
10+ years of experience in B2B field marketing, event marketing, demand generation, or related disciplines, with significant experience developing regional marketing strategies and leading complex field programs.

• Experience developing targeted marketing programs that complement field activities and support regional business priorities.

• Strong event marketing experience, including strategy, planning, production, and on-site execution of customer events, executive engagements, industry events, trade shows, workshops, and other field programs.

• Strong experience partnering with Sales leaders and account teams to understand business priorities and develop effective marketing strategies and programs.

• Proven ability to operate at both a strategic and executional level—from advising stakeholders and developing plans to driving successful programs in the field.

• Strong business acumen and understanding of how marketing supports customer engagement, demand generation, Sales effectiveness, and business growth.

• Proven ability to build trusted relationships and influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.

• Strong analytical skills with experience measuring program effectiveness and using results to inform decisions.

• Excellent project management, communication, presentation, and organizational skills.

• Strong ownership, judgment, resourcefulness, and attention to detail.

PARTNERSHIP & COMMUNICATION SKILLS

• Ability to build trusted relationships with Sales, Business Unit, and Marketing stakeholders.

• Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively across multiple teams and priorities.

• Comfortable presenting marketing plans, results, and recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.

• Ability to influence decision-making and build consensus across diverse stakeholder groups.

• Effective communicator who can translate business objectives into actionable marketing programs.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

• 10+ years of relevant B2B field marketing and/or event marketing experience.

• Demonstrated experience developing and executing regional field marketing programs in partnership with Sales.

• Demonstrated experience leading complex in-person events from strategy and planning through on-site execution.

• Ability to independently manage multiple programs and stakeholders in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience supporting enterprise B2B Sales organizations.

• Experience B2B demand generation and field marketing.

• Experience supporting highly technical products or engineering-focused audiences.

• Experience working across geographically dispersed teams.

• Ability to travel up to 35%.

The annual salary range for California is $129,500 to $240,500. You may also be eligible to receive incentive compensation: bonus, equity, and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the salary range is a guideline and compensation may vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies and work location. Our benefits programs include: paid vacation and paid holidays, 401(k) plan with employer match, employee stock purchase plan, a variety of medical, dental and vision plan options, and more.

We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.

postings.title: General Manager - Marketing and Ecommerce Growth
postings.descriptionText:
HoopStars | Parent-company Marketing Team Lead
Full-time. Remote from LATAM. Toronto working hours. Potential future relocation to the US or Canada by mutual agreement.

Build the business. Build the marketing team.
HoopStars is a Toronto-based youth basketball business with recurring customers and technology-enabled operations. We are looking for a hands-on General Manager whose strongest skills are marketing, ecommerce and profitable growth, and who can take responsibility for the whole business.
You will divide your time approximately equally between running HoopStars and building and managing the parent company Community Sports Partners ' marketing team across its brands. This is one vacancy advertised across multiple locations. Candidates elsewhere in LATAM are also welcome; apply once using your preferred location listing.
You should understand how to turn advertising into customers, improve conversion, increase repeat purchases and make the numbers work. You will also own budgets, operating performance and the team delivering the customer experience.

What you will own

•
Run HoopStars: Own its business plan, budget, revenue, profitability and cash forecasts. Lead sales and operations, ensuring programmes, coaches, venues and service quality keep pace with demand.

•
Drive digital growth: Improve paid search and social, creative, landing pages, enrollment funnels, pricing, offers, referrals and retention.

•
Build the parent marketing team: Define the structure, recruit specialists, appoint contractors or agencies where useful, and manage priorities and performance across brands.

•
Establish commercial discipline: Connect campaign performance to paying customers, repeat enrollment and contribution profit. Allocate marketing investment using reliable reporting and testing.

•
Stay close to execution: Inspect advertising accounts, diagnose funnel problems and help launch improvements yourself while building a team that can execute consistently.

Support and autonomy
The parent provides bookkeeping assistance, HR support, IT and website support, and a local manager covering customer service and day-to-day sales. You will propose budgets and team plans, then make operating decisions within agreed authority. After onboarding, the founder expects a monthly business review, supported by clear weekly reporting and escalation of exceptional issues.

Your first 90 days
Understand the customers, operations and economics. Audit marketing across the brands. Establish reporting, propose the marketing team structure and hiring priorities, launch the first growth tests, and take ownership of normal HoopStars business decisions.

Requirements

Who we are looking for
You may have built an ecommerce business, led growth for a consumer brand, run a digital agency with meaningful operating responsibility, or managed a business where digital acquisition was central to its success.

• Demonstrated results in paid acquisition, conversion and retention.

• Commercial responsibility beyond a marketing budget: pricing, margins, staffing, forecasts or business profitability.

• Experience hiring and managing marketers, creatives, agencies or other specialists.

• Ability to translate ecommerce methods into a service business with real delivery capacity and customer commitments.

• Comfort doing practical work while developing people and systems.

• Strong professional English and effective remote leadership.

Experience in youth sports, education, fitness, memberships or multi-location services is useful. Evidence of building a profitable business and an effective team matters most.

How to apply
Submit your CV through this application form. Describe a business or brand you grew, including spend, results and your personal contribution; a team you built or managed; and a commercial decision that failed and what you changed afterward.
Complete both standard assessments before or shortly after applying, using the same email address as your application. If you have already completed them for Community Sports Partners using that email, indicate this in the form.

• Culture Index survey

• Criteria GAME assessment - English

Benefits
Compensation commensurate with experience and qualifications.
Remote work from LATAM, with Toronto-hours collaboration. Opportunity to build and lead a business and the parent marketing team, with equity opportunity subject to agreed terms. Potential future relocation to the US or Canada by mutual agreement.

• Strong proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign

• Ability to work within existing brand systems while knowing when and how to expand them

• Strong understanding of typography, composition, spacing, imagery, and visual hierarchy

• Ability to review and select strong photography and visual content

• Strong professional English, both written and spoken

• Ability to understand detailed creative briefs and identify copy or visual inconsistencies

• Comfortable editing basic short-form video using CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar software

• Highly detail-oriented and able to catch mistakes before submitting work

• Comfortable receiving feedback and iterating quickly

• Ability to work independently and take ownership of assignments

Creative judgment, Adobe fluency, attention to detail, English proficiency, and lightweight video editing are core requirements for the position. Junior Brand Designer (Content)…

Preferred

• Experience designing for lifestyle, hospitality, wellness, beauty, fashion, or other visually driven brands

• Photo editing, color correction, and retouching experience

• Familiarity with Lightroom

• Basic After Effects or motion design experience

On behalf of DataTech Client #1 , SD Solutions is looking for a talented Technical Project Manager to lead client implementations of a product, a Master Data Management (MDM) platform that runs inside each client's own Databricks workspace and cloud environment.

You will own delivery from kickoff to go-live: planning the work, coordinating Frisco Analytics engineers with client data, security, and business teams, and keeping everyone clear on status, risks, and decisions. Because the platform is deployed in the client's environment, much of the work is shared with client teams, so clear and steady communication matters as much as technical fluency in this role.

SD Solutions is a staffing company operating globally. Contact us to get more details about the benefits we offer.

Responsibilities:

Delivery and planning

• Run two to three concurrent product implementations end to end: scope, plan, schedule, budget, and go-live.

• Break each engagement into workstreams such as environment setup, source system onboarding, match tuning, data steward enablement, and production cutover.

• Track milestones, dependencies and resourcing, and fix slippage early rather than reporting it late.

• Manage scope and change requests through a clear, documented process.

Client and stakeholder coordination

• Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for client sponsors, data owners, platform administrators, and business data stewards.

• Coordinate the work clients own in their own environment, such as Databricks workspace access, Unity Catalog permissions, and cloud infrastructure, so it lands on time.

• Facilitate decisions on match rules, confidence thresholds, and steward review workflows, and record who decided what and why.

• Lead steering committee meetings and executive readouts.

Security and compliance support

• Work with Frisco Analytics and product teams to support client security reviews and due diligence questionnaires during onboarding.

• Ensure implementation team members follow the access, data handling, and confidentiality requirements that apply to client engagements.

• Route security incidents or concerns to the right owners promptly.

Team leadership

• Coordinate a delivery team of data engineers and consultants without direct reporting authority.

• Run sprint ceremonies, stand-ups and retrospectives, and keep project tooling and documentation current.

• Capture lessons learned to improve Frisco Analytics' implementation playbook.

How you'll communicate

Strong communication is the core skill of this role. You will be the person clients and engineers rely on to know where things stand and what happens next.

•
Translate between audiences. Explain entity matching, golden records, and access permissions to business sponsors in plain language and turn business needs into clear requirements for engineers.

•
Write clearly. Produce concise status reports, RAID logs, decision records, meeting notes, and project plans that a busy executive can scan in two minutes.

•
Run focused meetings. Set agendas, keep discussions on track, close with owners and dates, and send follow-ups the same day.

•
Deliver hard news early. Raise risks, delays, and scope issues directly, with options and a recommendation, before they become surprises.

•
Listen and ask good questions. Uncover unstated requirements, client constraints, and concerns from security and governance teams.

•
Hold firm, kindly. Push back on scope creep and unrealistic dates while keeping the relationship strong.

•
Present with confidence. Lead steering committees, demos, and executive readouts for client leadership.

Requirements:

• 4 to 7 years of experience in project management, with at least 3 years managing client-facing technical or data projects.

• A track record of delivering data platform, data integration, analytics, or enterprise software implementations on time and within budget.

• Working knowledge of cloud data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake or similar) and at least one major cloud provider (AWS or Azure).

• Understanding of data concepts such as data quality, data governance, role-based access control, and handling of personal data (PII).

• Comfort with both Agile and Waterfall delivery, and the judgment to blend them for a client's needs.

• Excellent written and verbal English, with examples of client-facing reports, presentations, or executive updates you have owned.

• Experience with project tooling such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or MS Project.

• A bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, business, or equivalent experience.

Advantages:

• Experience implementing Master Data Management (MDM), entity resolution, or customer 360 solutions.

• Hands-on familiarity with Databricks Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, or Databricks workflows.

• Exposure to AI or machine learning features in enterprise software, including how to explain human review and auditability to clients.

• Experience supporting client security reviews, vendor due diligence, or compliance requirements such as SOC 2.

• A PMP, PMI-ACP, Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or similar certification.

• Consulting or systems integrator background, working across several clients at once.

About the company:

Core Responsibilities

Lead Data Engineering Teams

• Manage, coach, and develop two Team Leads and four Analysts, with clear ownership, technical standards, feedback, and accountability.

• Set team priorities, allocate capacity, remove delivery blockers, and maintain appropriate operational coverage for critical data services.

• Own the platform roadmap and resource plan; hire, assess performance, develop Team Leads, and build succession coverage for critical data capabilities. Maintain regular hands-on involvement in priority delivery.

Build and Operate the Data Platform

• Oversee data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, storage, and delivery from design through production support. Work backward from business endpoints and product requirements to define business-ready data models, schemas, freshness, and performance requirements.

• Maintain platform availability, performance, monitoring, scalability, and cost discipline, including incident response and root-cause follow-up.

• Set the target data architecture and modernization priorities; translate product needs into delivery commitments and balance capacity, performance, resilience, and platform cost.

Govern Data Quality and Security

• Partner with analytics, intelligence products, security, infrastructure, and business owners to provide dependable governed data; business owners define source meaning and own source-process corrections. Own analytical-platform ingestion and data delivery; Software Engineering owns operational application integrations. Agree interface contracts and incident routing at shared boundaries.

• Lead resolution of material data-service issues and recurring control weaknesses; agree corrective actions with source owners and technical partners and verify lasting improvement.

Role Expectations
This is a senior manager role with substantial individual contribution. The Manager is expected to personally design or review important data models and architecture, troubleshoot complex pipeline and performance issues, and step into critical delivery when needed. At the same time, the Manager must build a durable organization through hiring, coaching, delegation, standards, performance management, and succession development. •
Twelve or more years of progressive experience in data engineering, data platforms, or data architecture, including at least five years of people leadership and meaningful experience leading Team Leads, managers, or senior technical staff.

Must be able to coach Team Leads, develop senior technical talent, allocate capacity, establish engineering standards, manage incidents and operational risk, and make roadmap and prioritization decisions with senior business leaders. Recent hands-on technical delivery is required; this is not a management-only role.

• Experience operating data platforms with large datasets and demanding performance requirements, including query and data-model optimization, partitioning or clustering strategies, caching, and other techniques used to support low-latency analytical workloads.

Independent certification bodies verify compliance with the 4C requirements. 4C was developed in a comprehensive and transparent multi-stakeholder process involving coffee/cocoa producers, trade and industry, as well as organizations from civil society around the world. 4C aims to move the entire coffee or cocoa sector towards sustainability practices. 4C operates in 25 countries and is one of the largest certification systems in the coffee sector.

Alongside certification, we provide innovative solutions to help companies comply with global regulations and strengthen responsible supply chains in a changing world.

Intelligence Products and Systems Manager
BLV Applied Intelligence Products and Decision Systems

•
Reports to: Chief Data and Analytics Officer

•
Department: IDEA — Intelligence, Data, Engineering & Analytics

•
Team structure: Two Team Leads and four Analysts across BLV and Applied Intelligence Products

Position Summary

• The Intelligence Products and Systems Manager is the senior hands-on product leader for BLV and WBL's broader portfolio of applied intelligence products. Reporting to the CDAO, this role manages through two Team Leads, each responsible for two Analysts.

• One team owns BLV, the corporate valuation product; Applied Intelligence Products owns the broader portfolio of AI-enabled, model-driven, rules-based, and decision-support products. The Manager identifies high-value business problems, determines where AI/ML, rules, optimization, document intelligence, or other approaches are appropriate, and leads products from discovery and business case through requirements, acceptance, deployment, adoption, monitoring, improvement, and retirement.

• The role requires enough technical depth to prototype, evaluate approaches, challenge evidence, and diagnose product performance while working across Data Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Business Applications, and business owners.

Core Responsibilities

• Lead Intelligence Product Teams

• Manage, coach, and develop two Team Leads and four Analysts, with clear ownership, technical standards, feedback, and accountability.

• Own and prioritize product roadmaps based on user needs, business value, feasibility, data readiness, operational risk, and capacity, with clear success measures and acceptance criteria for each initiative.

• Own the product portfolio and resource plan; hire, assess performance, develop Team Leads, and build succession coverage for critical product capabilities. Maintain regular hands-on involvement in priority delivery.

• Build and Operate Intelligence Products

• Oversee product discovery, prototyping, acceptance, deployment into business use, monitoring, improvement, and retirement. Analytics / Data Science owns analytical methods, predictive model development, and model-performance evidence; Software Engineering owns application architecture, implementation, and release quality.

• Ensure each product integrates into business processes, supports appropriate human oversight and user adoption, and delivers measurable outcomes. Own product acceptance against agreed criteria; business owners approve policy, intended use, and operating decisions. Coordinate user enablement with Business Applications.

• Develop product business cases and lead discovery through adoption; use evidence of value, feasibility, and risk to recommend which products to fund, scale, improve, or retire.

• Govern Models and Systems

• Establish product controls for evaluation, documentation, explainability, privacy, security, change control, monitoring, and responsible use. Coordinate any required independent validation and business approval separately from development and product acceptance.

• Own product performance monitoring, exception triage, escalation, and corrective-action follow-through. Route model issues to Data Science, data issues to Data Engineering, and software defects to Software Engineering; coordinate user communication with Business Applications.

• Review product outcomes with senior business leaders, challenge weak performance evidence, and adjust priorities and controls as user needs and operating conditions change.

Requirements

• Education:

• Relevant education or professional training in computer science, engineering, data science, mathematics, product management, or a related technical discipline is valued. Demonstrated product judgment, technical depth, leadership, and production delivery experience are the primary qualifications; a degree is not mandatory.

• Required Experience

•
Twelve or more years of progressive experience across applied AI/ML, data science, software, analytics, decision systems, or technical product development, including at least five years of people leadership and meaningful experience leading Team Leads, managers, or senior technical/product staff.

• Must have demonstrated delivery of AI-enabled or model-driven capabilities into real production use.

• Demonstrated success building, scaling, or materially improving an applied intelligence, AI product, decision-product, or technical product capability.

• Must be able to coach Team Leads, develop technical/product talent, own and prioritize a portfolio, write clear product requirements and acceptance criteria, and deliver usable production products with cross-functional teams.

• Must have experience making funding, sequencing, and trade-off decisions with senior business leaders. Recent hands-on product and technical delivery is required; this is not a management-only role.

• Experience taking AI-enabled or analytical products from ambiguous business problem through discovery, business case, prototype, requirements, acceptance criteria, production launch, user adoption, monitoring, and iterative improvement.

• Experience with modern AI product development and evaluation, including model selection, API-based AI services, structured evaluation, retrieval/grounding, LLM workflow design, human-in-the-loop controls, and production observability, alongside meaningful applied AI experience beyond generative AI.

• Experience building decision-support or decisioning products that combine data, calculations, rules, models, external data sources, and software into a repeatable user-facing capability.

• Technical Skills

• Broad applied AI experience selecting and evaluating the right approach for a business problem, including predictive machine learning, rules and decision engines, optimization, document understanding/extraction, NLP, generative AI/LLMs, retrieval, agents or tool-using workflows, and hybrid human-in-the-loop systems as appropriate.

• Demonstrated production integration, monitoring, user adoption, and measurable business outcomes for AI-enabled or model-driven products. Generative AI experience is valuable but is not sufficient by itself; candidates must show broader applied-AI judgment and enough technical depth to challenge model evidence, limitations, and suitability for intended use.

• Strong understanding of model and product risk, evaluation design, explainability, privacy, security, data quality, access controls, monitoring, drift or degradation, exception handling, human oversight, and responsible use. Able to communicate technical choices and risk clearly to senior business leaders and translate business requirements into precise direction for data science and engineering teams.

• Soft Skills

• Ability to distinguish product ownership from data science and software engineering ownership: define the problem, user experience, requirements, acceptance criteria, operating controls, and outcomes while holding specialist teams accountable for model evidence and software implementation within their domains.

• This is a senior manager role with substantial individual contribution. The Manager is expected to lead product discovery, develop prototypes, evaluate applied AI approaches, define product behavior and acceptance criteria, challenge model evidence, and investigate performance issues.

• The Manager must also build a durable organization through hiring, coaching, delegation, roadmap discipline, standards, performance management, and development of Team Leads. Team Leads contribute substantively to delivery as well as supervise their teams.

• Preferred Background / Industry Experience

• Experience in lending or financial services, business-user support, and data reconciliation preferred.

What We Offer
💰 Compensation in USD.
🏖️ Benefits include paid time off (PTO).
🌍 Work Environment: Fully remote work environment.

Overview

• We are seeking detail-oriented Loan Operations, Post-Closing, and Compliance Internal Audit Analyst to perform audits and risk assessments across the lending lifecycle. The role is responsible for evaluating internal controls, identifying operational and compliance risks, conducting audit testing, and supporting the execution of the annual audit plan and special investigations.

• This is a fully remote position for an analytical professional with strong critical-thinking, investigative, documentation, and communication skills.

About the Role
The Loan Operations, Post-Closing, and Compliance Internal Audit Analyst supports the execution of audits across the lending lifecycle. The role performs audit testing, continuous monitoring, and risk assessments to evaluate internal controls, regulatory compliance, and operational effectiveness. Audit activities may include the review of processes and data maintained in loan servicing, workflow, and business applications such as LAPro, QuickBase, Monday.com, and other systems utilized by the organization.

What Success Looks Like

• Audit engagements are completed on time and meet Internal Audit quality standards.

• Significant risks, control deficiencies, and compliance issues are identified and reported clearly.

• Audit workpapers and supporting evidence are accurate, complete, and well documented.

• Annual audit projects, continuous monitoring activities, and special investigations are executed effectively.

• Management implements sustainable corrective actions that strengthen controls and reduce risk.

• Demonstrates professionalism, objectivity, and strong collaboration with stakeholders throughout audit engagements.

Typical Day-to-Day

• Conduct audits of loan operations, closing, post-closing, servicing, and compliance activities.

• Review loan files, system data, reports, and support documentation to evaluate control effectiveness and regulatory compliance.

• Perform audit testing, data analysis, walkthroughs, and risk assessments in support of the annual audit plan.

• Conduct ad hoc investigations, management requests, and special review projects.

• Prepare audit work papers, findings, recommendations, and management reports.

• Validate management corrective actions and monitor remediation of audit findings.

• Collaborate with business stakeholders while maintaining audit independence and objectivity.

Key Objectives for This Role (Quarterly Focus )

• Complete assigned audits and continuous monitoring activities in accordance with the annual audit plan.

• Identify and evaluate control weaknesses, compliance risks, and process improvement opportunities across loan operations, post-closing, and compliance functions.

• Deliver high-quality audit workpapers, test results, and support documentation.

• Communicate audit observations and recommendations clearly and professionally to management.

• Monitor and validate management's remediation of audit findings and corrective actions.

• Support special investigations, ad hoc reviews, and regulatory or management requests as needed.

What You'll Be Doing (Core Responsibilities)

Loan Operations Audit

• Perform audits across the lending lifecycle, including origination, underwriting, servicing, collections, and payoff activities.

• Evaluate internal controls, identify risks, and assess compliance with policies and procedures.

• Review loan documentation, loan activity, and supporting data for accuracy and completeness.

Post-Closing Audit

• Evaluate post-closing controls related to documentation, loan boarding, collateral records, lien perfection, investor reporting, and exception management.

• Assess the effectiveness of controls designed to ensure the completeness and accuracy of post-closing activities.

Compliance Audit

• Assess compliance with applicable laws, regulations, investor requirements, and internal policies.

• Identify compliance risks, control deficiencies, and areas requiring management attention.

Audit Execution & Reporting

• Perform audit testing, walkthroughs, data analysis, continuous monitoring activities, and special investigations.

• Prepare audit workpapers, reports, and recommendations.

• Validate corrective actions and monitor remediation efforts.

Requirements

• Education

• Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Auditing, or a related field.

postings.title: Data and Analytics Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Analytics Engineer & AI Specialist

About the Role
As Analytics Engineers you would combine insurance domain expertise with full-stack data and analytics engineering capabilities. You will help build the data foundations that power Snowflake's AI platform.
This role is focused on the layers that make AI reliable: clean, well-modeled data, governed pipelines, and semantic models that expose business meaning to natural language interfaces. You will design rigorous data models, build data pipelines, and construct the semantic layer that sits between raw data and AI agents. You will be responsible for setting up data that is structured, trusted, and agent-ready. The deployment patterns and data model gaps you surface feed directly back to LOB teams, making you both a practitioner and a source of signal for what gets built next.

What You'll Work On

Data Modeling and Architecture

• Architect flexible, performant data models that drive LOB team toward single sources of truth across their LOB business domains

• Use SQL, Python, dbt, and Snowflake to build and maintain data infrastructure for reporting, analysis, and automation

• Perform data QA and develop automated testing procedures for Snowflake data models

• Provide input into data governance strategies including permissions, data lineage, and data definitions

• Design Data security so that the model only has access to the data

Semantic Layer and Agent Readiness

• Build semantic data models that expose LOBs data to natural language queries via Cortex Analyst, turning complex schemas into something a business stakeholder and Clients can ask a question of

• Define and validate the metrics, dimensions, and relationships that AI agents need to reason correctly over LOBs data

• IMP

• Identify and resolve gaps in data structure, naming, and coverage that would cause an agent to fail or produce incorrect results

Documentation

• Documented playbooks, reusable data model templates, and semantic model libraries that can be maintained and extend

• Run technical workshops to upskill other team members

• Author semantic view configurations and skill files (YAML + Markdown) that a non-technical analyst can invoke in plain English

Hard Skills Required Must-Have

•
Advanced SQL: CTEs, window functions, incremental pipeline patterns. You can write complex queries without referencing documentation.

•
Analytics engineering and data modeling: Experience building data infrastructure involving large-scale relational datasets; strong instincts for pipeline design, QA, and testing across the full stack from ingestion through semantic layer.

•
dbt: Experience building and maintaining dbt projects with testing, documentation, and CI/CD pipelines.

•
Python: Modern, type-hinted, readable. You understand Python-based data pipelines and automation workflows.

•
AI-assisted development: You have used an LLM coding assistant (CoCo, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude, or equivalent) as your primary development environment. Daily usage is the baseline.

•
Semantic modeling: You can write a semantic view configuration or structured skill file that handles edge cases and encodes enough domain knowledge that the model behaves like a subject matter expert.

•
Client-facing communication: You write code, but your output needs to make sense to a business leader who has never opened a terminal. You are the translation layer between what Snowflake's AI can do and what the customer actually needs.

•
Snowflake Cortex: Cortex Analyst, Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, semantic views, Dynamic Tables.

Strong Plus

• Experience with Airflow or other orchestration frameworks.

• Familiarity with enterprise business systems (ERP, CRM, HRIS, or similar).

Soft Skills Required

•
Owns the outcome: Tracks adoption after go-live, identifies stall points, and re-engages until the data product is reliable and can be handed over to run teams.

•
Codifies, doesn't customize: Instinct is to turn patterns into reusable templates and playbooks that the next engineer can deploy at the next customer, not to build bespoke every time.

•
Comfortable with ambiguity: Engages with customers to derive requirements, prototypes fast, gathers feedback, and iterates.

•
Signal clarity: Distills messy deployments into clean, actionable feedback for Leaders, explaining root causes and suggesting fixes, not just reporting problems.

Minimum Requirements

• 8+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related technical role, with at least a portion of it customer-facing or cross-functional

• Daily use of an AI coding assistant as a primary development tool

• Proficient in SQL; can write window functions and complex joins without referencing documentation

• Experience with dbt

• Has shipped production data model or pipeline that non-technical business users actually relied on

• Comfortable in Git (PRs, branches, code review)

• Demonstrable experience translating business requirements into technical specifications

Why This Role Is Different
Most analytics engineering roles stop at the data model. Most field roles stop at the recommendation. This role starts where both leave off. You own the full data stack from source ingestion to semantic layer, and you ensure every layer is clean, tested, and structured for AI agents to reason over reliably. You write the code. You build the semantic foundation. You make sure it runs in production and the run team can maintain it.
Why Join Nimble Gravity ?
You'll help leading financial institutions and other clients adopt AI in meaningful ways. You'll work directly with clients, engineers, and AI specialists to turn emerging technology into measurable business outcomes. If you enjoy teaching, facilitating, influencing, and helping people embrace new ways of working, we'd love to talk.
Nimble Gravity is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.
We do not sponsor H1B visas

🌟 Exciting Remote Opportunity! We're Hiring a Legal Executive Assistant! 🌟
Are you a highly experienced and autonomous legal professional looking for long-term stability and growth? We are seeking an exceptional Senior Legal Executive Assistant / Paralegal to serve as a critical operational pillar for the business owner of a prominent commercial real estate group!

🚨 IMPORTANT - Watch this quick Loom video on how to get hired: 🔗

🗣️ C1 ENGLISH LEVEL IS REQUIRED. The selected candidate will be speaking strictly in English during their whole shift. 🎙️ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR RESUME AND AUDIO RECORDING IN ENGLISH.

📋 Job Details at a Glance

• Job Title: Legal Executive Assistant

• Job ID: DLCRIC1EA

• Industry: Commercial Real Estate & Property Development

• Location: South Africa / LATAM / PH

• Job Status: Full Time

• Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM (CST)

• Salary: $2000 to $2200 per month

• Target Start Date: ASAP

🏢 About the Client

Our client is a highly dynamic developer and owner of a prominent commercial real estate group. Headquartered in the US, the business is supported by an established, high-performing operations team composed of specialized industry professionals, including architects, civil engineers, general contractors, and consultants. As the owner scales operations and integrates modern technology—including AI and content leverage—they require a dedicated, high-level professional to support executive and legal functions directly.

💼 About the Role

We are seeking a highly autonomous Senior Legal Executive Assistant / Paralegal with 5 to 15 years of experience to serve as a critical operational pillar for the business owner. We are looking for a long-term team member seeking stability and professional growth rather than a short-term contract opportunity.
This is not an entry-level virtual assistant position—it requires sharp critical thinking, rigorous document management, advanced technical capability, and the ability to hit the ground running without hand-holding. You will act as a direct liaison and driver for legal and operational deliverables, managing external attorneys, keeping commercial real estate contracts on track, coordinating with lenders and title companies, and maintaining structure across our broader development and shared-services teams.

🎯 Key Responsibilities

⚖️ Legal & Contract Administration

• Prepare, review, organize, and manage complex legal documents, commercial real estate contracts, leases, demand letters, settlement agreements, and sensitive corporate files.

• Establish strict document-management protocols to guarantee accuracy, compliance, and absolute confidentiality.

🗂️ Rigorous Version Control & Records Management

• Maintain strict document version control, audit trails, standardized naming conventions, document indexing, and electronic records systems for all contracts, lender markups, attorney revisions, and title commitment updates.

🤝 Attorney & Deliverable Management

• Proactively manage and follow up with external attorneys to secure outstanding contract reviews, legal filings, background screenings, and critical deliverables on schedule—removing the operational mental load from the business owner.

🏦 Lender & Third-Party Coordination

• Coordinate seamlessly with lenders, title companies, appraisers, surveyors, insurance providers, and third-party consultants to support transaction closings and due diligence processes.

📑 Litigation Support & Organization

• Organize exhibits, litigation support documents, correspondence logs, witness files, demand letters, small claims documentation, and evidentiary materials.

🚀 Executive Support & Strategic Administration

• Serve as a trusted operational right hand to the owner, taking charge of executive communications, complex scheduling, high-priority business initiatives, and daily workflow oversight.

📈 Task Tracking & Workflow Optimization

• Input and track operational action items within project management platforms (e.g., Hubstaff, Cadence) to maintain full transparency, complete oversight, and daily accountability across all active initiatives.

👥 Cross-Functional Team Synergy

• Collaborate seamlessly with existing operations, shared-services teams, floor managers, civil engineers, and external consultants to keep real estate development projects moving forward smoothly.

✅ Qualifications & Skills

⭐ Core Requirements (Non-Negotiable):

• Proven Experience: 5 to 15 years of significant, verifiable background as a Paralegal, Legal Executive Assistant, or Legal Secretary—ideally within commercial real estate, corporate law, or property development. (Candidates with under 5 years of experience or call-center-only backgrounds will not be considered.)

• Legal & Technical Skillset: Deep familiarity with legal terminology, contract structures, complex document drafting, demand letters, background screenings, title commitment revisions, and meticulous record-keeping.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel Proficiency: Strong command of Excel, including filtering, formulas, tracking schedules, status reporting, and maintaining complex project workbooks.

• High English Fluency & Comprehension: Exceptional spoken, written, and reading English comprehension, with the ability to understand complex U.S. business culture and commercial real estate nomenclature.

• Unquestionable Integrity & Discretion: Absolute honesty, strong moral principles, and total discretion when handling high-level financial, operational, confidential, and proprietary business details.

🧠 Soft Skills & Competencies:

• Proactive Critical Thinking & Autonomy: High emotional intelligence, sharp critical thinking, and a demonstrated ability to operate independently and troubleshoot complex issues.

• Substance Over Style & Team Synergy: Proven practical competence and ability to deliver tangible output beyond strong interview skills, alongside strong interpersonal skills to integrate seamlessly into an established team structure.

💻 Tech & Remote Work Infrastructure:

• Tech-Savvy & System Familiarity: High digital literacy with proficiency or fast adaptation to productivity platforms, project tracking systems (e.g., Hubstaff, Cadence), Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, Calendar), and modern AI/automation tools.

• Remote Reliability: Dedicated, quiet home-office setup with a reliable, high-speed internet connection.

• Power/Internet Backups: Robust power and internet backup solutions (e.g., UPS/inverter/secondary connection) are required to ensure uninterrupted daily connectivity.

postings.title: Business Analyst - Caribbean
postings.descriptionText:
Business Analyst
The Business Analyst will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams. The individual will be responsible for understanding and analyzing business needs, defining solutions (both process and technical), and ensuring that project deliverables align with business objectives while minimizing risk. The role will involve collaborating across multiple departments and working with stakeholders at all levels to ensure successful project outcomes. The Business Analyst will contribute to the design, development, and delivery of robust solutions that enhance business processes and optimize the use of technology.

Key Responsibilities

•
Research & Situational Analysis: Conduct research and documentation reviews to critically evaluate the internal and external conditions that affect the organization or business unit, identifying opportunities and current challenges to the business unit, services or products.

•
Performance Metrics: Develop and implement performance metrics to measure the success of a process change or solution implementation. Establish baselines before testing and rollout of proposed changes. Conduct post-implementation reviews to confirm objectives achieved and benefits realized, identifying unexpected benefits achieved.

•
Requirements Gathering & Analysis: Conduct in-depth analysis of business processes, systems, and needs by engaging with stakeholders to gather detailed requirements and translate them into clear and actionable business and functional requirements. Capture, analyze and document the current state of existing processes and define proposed future states, including documenting the results of conducted gap analysis to achieve the desired future state.

•
Business Process Improvement: Thoroughly analyze existing business processes, identify areas of improvement, and recommend solutions to enhance efficiency, streamline operations, and improve business performance, including opportunities for automation and digitization. Ensure proposed processes within identified solutions are optimized and required controls are in place. Define and deliver on process strategies to identify best fit.

•
Solution Design & Development: Collaborate with business and IT teams to design and propose optimized process and technical solutions that meet business needs, ensuring alignment with overall business strategy and project objectives. Conduct solution evaluation activities at applicable phases in its development to verify the business needs have been satisfied and identify recommended changes that will maximise the value of the solution and improve its performance.

•
Impact Analysis and Risk Management: Assess the impact of proposed changes to systems, solutions and users, identifying potential risks and challenges. Assess and develop strategies for risk mitigation associated with the proposed changes. Develop data models to analyze and illustrate the potential impact of change on different aspects of the organization or system.

•
Project Management Support: Work closely with project managers to define scope, objectives, and deliverables. Participate in project planning, risk management, and issue resolution activities to ensure project timelines and objectives are met.

•
Cross-Segment Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and implement process and solution improvement initiatives, utilizing techniques such as focus groups and brainstorming, and customer journey mapping exercises.

•
Stakeholder Communication & Management: Conduct comprehensive stakeholder analysis, including the development of stakeholder maps and communication plans. Deliver effective communication strategies and establish strong relationships with key stakeholders throughout their lifecycle to secure buy-in and approval for proposed changes. Act as the liaison between business and technical teams, ensuring clear communication to meet both functional and technical requirements. Provide regular updates to stakeholders on project status and potential risks. Support organizational change management activities to ensure smooth adoption of new processes and systems by preparing stakeholders, fostering buy-in, and managing expectations.

•
Testing & Validation: Assist in developing and executing test plans to ensure that solutions meet the defined requirements. Support user acceptance testing (UAT) and troubleshoot any issues identified during the testing phase.

•
Documentation & Training: Develop and maintain detailed documentation, including business requirements, process flows, and user manuals. Facilitate training sessions for end-users to ensure they can effectively use new systems and processes.

•
Data Analysis & Reporting: Provide data analysis and reporting capabilities to inform decision-making. Identify trends and insights that help the business make informed decisions and improve operations.

•
Cross-Team Collaboration: Engage with Process Analysts, Project Managers, Change Managers, Technical Leads and other Business Analysts on projects and other business-as-usual (BAU) initiatives to effectively deliver of required objectives for solution and process improvement design and deployment. Foster a team approach throughout the project to ensure the delivery of optimized solutions and support adoption by end users.

Critical Skills & Qualifications

Education & Experience

• Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field. A masters degree is a plus.

• 3+ years of experience in business analysis, with a focus on both process and technical solution delivery.

• Experienced working on agile and/or waterfall projects across diverse industries, including finance, retail, and healthcare, with a strong preference for the financial sector.

Technical Skills

• Strong knowledge of business analysis methodologies (e.g., BABOK).

• Proficiency in producing quality requirements and process deliverables (e.g., BRDs, use cases, user stories, process maps) and other related documentation.

• Proficiency in process mapping and modeling tools (e.g., Visio) and techniques (e.g., BPMN).

• Familiarity with project management tools (e.g., Jira, Trello) and enterprise systems (e.g., ERP, CRM).

• Understanding of technical concepts, including databases, APIs, and software development lifecycles (SDLC).

• Data analysis and visualization skills using tools such as Excel, Power BI, or Tableau.

Key Competencies

• Analytical Thinking: Strong ability to analyze complex business problems and develop innovative, value-driven solutions.

• Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to facilitate collaboration between diverse stakeholders and conduct interviews and elicitation activities.

• Problem-Solving: Proven ability to troubleshoot issues, find root causes, and drive solutions in high-pressure situations.

• Project Management Acumen: Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment and within specified timelines.

• Stakeholder Management: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

• Written skills: Excellent writing skills with strong technical writing and articulation.

• Best practices: Knowledgeable of industry and business analysis best practices and their adaptation and applicability within differing environments.

Certifications (preferred but not required)

• Certification of Capability in Business Analysis (CCBA) or PMI-PBA certification.

• Agile/Scrum certifications (CSPO, CSM, IIBA-AAC, IIBA-CPOA).

postings.descriptionText:
At NOVACARD , we’re redefining how people use credit.
We are the first interest-free and no-annual-fee credit card in Mexico , designed to simplify personal finances and give users complete control - all from a mobile app. With NOVACARD, users can access up to $200,000 MXN in credit , only pay when they use it, and manage everything digitally in under 5 minutes. Our mission is to empower people to make smarter financial decisions by offering flexibility, transparency, and the freedom they need to reach their goals. Simple finances, big goals.

About the Role:
In this role, you will be responsible for coordinating external service providers, maintaining operational relationships with partners, monitoring service quality and costs, supporting integrations, and ensuring the continuity of critical business processes. You will work closely with Risk Tech, Product, Operations, Finance, Customer Support, Compliance, and external vendors to ensure that our external services operate reliably, efficiently, and cost-effectively. This role combines vendor management, operational ownership, reporting coordination, incident management, and cross-functional project execution.

Key Responsibilities:
Vendor & Partner Management- Own day-to-day communication with external vendors and service providers
- Coordinate incident resolution and follow-up activities with partners
- Track SLA compliance and service performance
- Organize operational reviews and regular follow-up meetings
- Escalate critical issues and drive resolution
- Coordinate contract renewals and vendor-related operational activities
External Services Operations- Coordinate operational processes related to credit bureaus, KYC providers, fraud prevention services, identity verification solutions, banking data providers, and other external partners
- Support onboarding of new vendors and services
- Coordinate testing and validation activities for new integrations and changes
- Maintain operational documentation and process runbooks
- Ensure business continuity for vendor-dependent processes
Reporting & Regulatory Processes- Coordinate periodic reporting processes with external organizations and bureaus
- Prepare, validate, and submit required files and reports
- Monitor report quality and resolve discrepancies
- Maintain documentation and supporting evidence required for audits and compliance requests
Cost & Billing Management- Monitor service usage and operational costs

- Validate invoices and vendor charges

• Reconcile billing discrepancies with providers
- Support budgeting and forecasting activities related to external services
Incident Management- Coordinate investigation of incidents involving external providers
- Collect logs, examples, and supporting evidence
- Communicate with vendors during production incidents
- Track corrective actions and post-incident follow-up activities
- Drive resolution of recurring operational issues
Cross-functional Coordination- Work closely with Risk Tech, Product, Operations, Customer Support, Finance, Compliance, and Data teams
- Coordinate implementation of process improvements and automation initiatives
- Ensure alignment between business requirements and vendor capabilities

Requirements
Must Have

- Native or fluent Spanish

- English B2+ (written and spoken)

• 3+ years of experience in fintech, banking, payments, lending, or technology companies
- Experience managing external vendors, partners, or service providers
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Experience coordinating operational processes and production incidents
- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills
- Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
- Strong attention to detail and process ownership

Nice to Have
- Experience working with credit bureaus, KYC providers, fraud prevention solutions, identity verification platforms, or financial data providers
- Experience in lending, credit cards, digital banking, or fintech products
- Basic SQL knowledge
- Experience working with APIs and technical integrations
- Experience validating invoices and vendor billing
- Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Notion, or similar tools
