postings.descriptionText:
Role Summary:
We are seeking a proactive, highly organized Technical Project Manager / Scrum Master to lead cross-functional engineering teams in delivering complex, high-impact digital solutions. In this dual-capacity role, you will facilitate Agile delivery processes, manage project lifecycles end-to-end, and serve as the essential bridge between client stakeholders, product strategy, and our engineering teams.

What You'll Do:

• Agile Facilitation: Serve as Scrum Master for high-performing engineering teams, facilitating all core Agile ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives).

• Project Delivery & Management: Oversee end-to-end technical project execution, scope, timeline, risk management, and client deliverables across modern web, cloud, AI, and data applications.

• Technical & Stakeholder Alignment: Collaborate closely with technical leads, software architects, and client stakeholders to translate high-level business goals into actionable technical requirements and user stories.

• Blocker Removal & Optimization: Proactively identify and eliminate technical and procedural blockers, mitigate project risks, and optimize team velocity and workflow.

• Metrics & Reporting: Track and report on key project health metrics (burndown, velocity, cycle time, scope churn) using platforms like Jira and Confluence.

• Client Engagement: Maintain clear, proactive communication with enterprise clients, ensuring transparent updates on milestones, dependencies, and delivery progress.

Must-Haves:

• Experience: 4+ years of experience as a Technical Project Manager or Scrum Master leading complex software engineering projects in an Agile environment.

• Certifications: Formal Scrum Master certification ( CSM, PSM I, or equivalent ).

• Technical Depth: A strong technical background or proven ability to comfortably engage in technical discussions (APIs, cloud architecture, CI/CD pipelines, modern frontend/backend frameworks).

• Tooling & Frameworks: Deep proficiency with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and project management suites like Jira, Confluence, Linear, or Azure DevOps .

• Communication: Outstanding client-facing consulting skills, stakeholder management, and clear written/verbal communication.

• Execution: Strong risk management, scope management, and analytical problem-solving abilities.

Nice-to-Haves:

• Prior hands-on experience as a Software Engineer, QA Engineer, or Solutions Architect.

• Experience working within a software consulting, agency, or IT professional services firm.

• Project Management Professional ( PMP ) or PMI-ACP certification.

• Experience with scaled Agile frameworks (SAFe, LeSS) or managing multi-team deliverables.

Role Summary:
We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer to design and build the services and APIs that power our platform. In this role, you will own backend systems end-to-end — from architecture through production — delivering performant, reliable, and scalable solutions. Our team practices deep AI-human collaboration : engineers work alongside AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as partners throughout the development process, and we expect this role to bring strong craft and judgment to that collaboration.

What You'll Do:

• Partner with AI coding assistants throughout your development workflow — collaborating on design, exploration, implementation, and review — and help shape how the team works with these tools effectively.

• Design, build, and maintain backend services and APIs using Node.js and TypeScript.

• Build and evolve RESTful APIs with careful attention to contracts, versioning, and developer experience.

• Design schemas and write efficient queries across relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis) data stores.

• Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code using frameworks like Jest or Vitest.

• Collaborate with frontend, product, and infrastructure teams to ship features end-to-end.

• Deploy and operate services in a cloud environment, with proper logging, metrics, and alerting.

• Review pull requests, mentor mid-level and junior engineers, and contribute to architectural decisions.

Must-Haves:

• Experience collaborating with AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) as a real part of your engineering practice — you know how to partner effectively, engage critically with their output, and bring human rigor to the collaboration.

• 5+ years of backend engineering experience building and operating production systems.

• Strong proficiency in Node.js and its ecosystem (event loop, async patterns, streams).

•
Solid experience with TypeScript.

• Experience designing and maintaining RESTful APIs.

• Working familiarity with at least one NoSQL store (Cosmos DB, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis, etc.).

• Production experience in a cloud environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

• Experience with testing frameworks like Jest or Vitest.

• Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and the fundamentals of running services in production.

Nice-to-Haves:

• Experience with Microsoft Azure (Container Apps, Entra ID, Functions, Cosmos DB, Application Gateway).

• Familiarity with Kubernetes or another container orchestration platform.

• Background working with microservices or service-oriented architectures at scale.

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation).

We take a hands-on approach, working closely with our clients to transform strategies into measurable, real-world outcomes. Position Description
Connect Centric is seeking a Program Manager, Latin America to support the growth of our client’s regional presence, engagement, and member value, with a focus on Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, and Chile. You will execute regional strategy, contribute market insights, support member acquisition and retention, and strengthen engagement with international and student chapters.

You will work closely with global teams, volunteer leaders, faculty advisors, and external partners to expand reach and deliver meaningful member experiences. Spanish proficiency is required; Portuguese proficiency is strongly preferred.
What You Will Do

Market Strategy and Growth

• Execute regional market development strategy across Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, and Chile.

• Research member needs, institutional dynamics, and the local competitive landscape; analyze findings to inform regional priorities and market approaches.

• Identify and support growth opportunities through academic partnerships, institutional engagement, and industry collaboration.

• Contribute to localized engagement plans aligned with global membership and retention goals.

Member Acquisition and Retention

• Execute targeted initiatives to grow membership among students, early-career professionals, and institutional segments.

• Support retention programs that strengthen member value and renewal rates; monitor effectiveness and recommend improvements.

• Partner with marketing and product teams to localize messaging, campaigns, and value propositions.

Chapter Support and Engagement

• Serve as a liaison to international and student chapters across Latin America, maintaining ongoing relationships with volunteer leaders and faculty advisors.

• Support chapter activation, sustainability, and growth, particularly in priority markets; help volunteer leaders increase programming frequency, relevance, and participation.

• Develop and implement approaches that help student chapter members transition into professional chapter or local section engagement.

• Facilitate faculty advisor and institutional engagement to sustain membership connections across career stages, and share chapter best practices that improve member experience, engagement, and retention.

Programs and Events

• Lead or support regional workshops, webinars, conferences, and partner activities aligned with membership growth, awareness, and engagement objectives.

• Coordinate event logistics, vendors, and stakeholder communications; represent the client at regional events as needed.

• Use market feedback and program performance to provide insights and recommend improvements.

Stakeholder Engagement and Partnerships

• Build and manage relationships with universities, research institutions, industry partners, and scientific societies across priority countries.

• Identify partnership opportunities aligned with growth goals and support onboarding of new partners to expand the client’s reach and influence.

• Engage faculty advisors, volunteer leaders, and early-career communities to strengthen connections with prospective and current members; serve as a regional contact for stakeholders and internal collaborators.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree.

• 5–8 years of experience in program management, membership organizations, or international market engagement.

• Proficiency in Spanish.

• Experience supporting membership growth, engagement, or retention initiatives.

• Strong execution skills and the ability to translate strategy into practical actions.

• Ability to independently manage priorities and multiple projects across countries and stakeholders.

• Strong interpersonal and relationship management skills across diverse cultural contexts.

• Experience tracking and reporting performance metrics and using data to inform program decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working in or with Latin American markets, particularly Brazil and Mexico, strongly preferred.

• Portuguese proficiency strongly preferred.

• Advanced degree.

• Background in scientific, academic, nonprofit, or professional membership organizations.

Position Details

• Position Type: Full-time W-2 employment. Independent contractor or 1099 arrangements are not available for this position.

• Location: Washington D.C.

• This position is fully remote

• Pay Rate: $65K - $75K

postings.title: Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation
postings.descriptionText:
Work across the full Linux stack from kernel through GUI to optimise Ubuntu, the world’s most widely used Linux desktop and server, for the latest silicon.

The role is a fast-paced, problem-solving role that’s challenging yet very exciting. The right candidate must be resourceful, articulate, and able to deliver on a wide variety of solutions across PC and IoT technologies. Our teams partner with specialist engineers from major silicon companies to integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements for upcoming hardware.

Location: This is a Globally remote role

What your day will look like

• Design and implement the best Ubuntu integration for the latest IoT and server-class hardware platforms and software stacks

• Work with partners to deliver a delightful, optimised, first class Ubuntu experience on their platforms

• Take a holistic approach to the Ubuntu experience on partner platforms with inputs on technical plans, testing strategy, quality metrics

• Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge

• Help our customers integrate their apps, SDKs, build device OS images, optimize applications with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server

• Work with the most advanced operating systems and application technologies available in the enterprise world.

Joining Canonical , you will partner with bright minds from all over the world, and work with an exciting set of new technologies in a fast growing company with a truly unique and ambitious vision to build a better platform with free software. You will work with customers on exciting IoT and server platforms and technologies, built to support different verticals: from robots to data centers, from telco to retail.

What we are looking for in you

• You love technology and working with brilliant people

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar

• You have experience with Linux packaging (Debian, RPM, Yocto)

• You have experience working with open source communities and licences

• You have experience working with C, C++

• You can work in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.

Additional skills that you might also bring

• Experience with graphics stacks

• Good understanding of networking - TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST

• Basic understanding of security best practices in IoT or server environments

• Good communication skills, ideally public speaking experience

• IoT / Embedded experience – from board and SoC, BMCs, bootloaders and firmware to OS, through apps and services

• Some experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

• Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!

• Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Parental Leave

• Employee Assistance Programme

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’

• Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

• Detail oriented with effective follow-up

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Maternity and paternity leave

• Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

• Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. postings.title: Google Ads Media Buyer / Growth Strategist
postings.descriptionText:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.
Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.
So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.
At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.
You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.
Here is what "end to end" actually means.
You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.
You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.
You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.
You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.
If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.
If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

•
Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.

•
Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.

•
Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.

•
Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.

•
Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.

•
Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.

•
Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.

•
Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.

•
Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.

•
Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

•
You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.

•
You are fluent in the whole stack , not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.

•
You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.

•
You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.

•
You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.

•
You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.

• Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

• "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.

• You want to be told what to do this week.

• You need a ticketing system to know what matters.

• You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting
This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.
You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.
You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.
You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

postings.title: Customer Support Manager - Mendoza
postings.descriptionText:
Company Overview
At Motorola Solutions , we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

Solutions & Services

Job Description
La responsabilidad principal de el/la Customer Support Manager (CSM, por sus siglas en inglés) es gestionar de manera eficaz y eficiente el negocio de Gestión y Soporte (M&S) para las asignaciones de contratos de sus clientes y garantizar la satisfacción de los clientes de Seguridad Pública de Motorola. El negocio de M&S es una combinación de proyecciones, propuesta de nuevos servicios y renovaciones de contratos, así como la creación de relaciones con clientes y subcontratistas. Garantizar la satisfacción del cliente implica la correcta entrega y ejecución de los contratos de servicio. Si algún servicio no se realiza según las especificaciones contratadas o un proceso no produce los resultados correctos, el CSM intervendrá para encontrar una solución.

Además, el CSM es el líder técnico y brinda orientación técnica al equipo de soporte, así como en el desarrollo técnico de sus miembros. Garantiza que los ingenieros estén actualizados con las últimas mejoras o versiones.

El/la CSM debe demostrar excelentes habilidades interpersonales y de liderazgo, contar con gran capacidad de comunicación, y ser un modelo a seguir y mentor para el personal.

Funciones y Responsabilidades:

El CSM es responsable del éxito general y de la relación entre las operaciones del cliente, los subcontratistas de Motorola y Motorola. Las responsabilidades clave incluyen:

• Proporcionar a los clientes un único punto de contacto para la gestión de clientes y garantizar la prestación del servicio y el cumplimiento de los Acuerdos de Nivel de Servicio (SLA).

• Trabajar con los clientes para analizar sus inquietudes e impulsar acciones correctivas hasta su cierre.

• Gestionar y mantener el alcance de los servicios según el contrato de servicios y garantizar que los clientes comprendan sus obligaciones con respecto a los entregables del servicio.

• Garantizar que los clientes reciban informes oportunos y adecuados según lo requerido por el Contrato de Servicios.

• Gestionar los entregables de los subcontratistas y su adhesión al alcance y los resultados acordados.

• Gestionar los problemas de calidad del producto según sea necesario (MTN).

• Participar según sea necesario en el proceso de gestión de casos para garantizar una correcta prestación del servicio.

• Asistir a socios y proveedores según sea necesario con problemas de pago y facturación.

• Identificar e implementar áreas de mejora para garantizar una mayor calidad del servicio y la entrega de mejores prácticas.

• Garantizar que toda la documentación operativa se mantenga actualizada y sea relevante.

• Gestionar proveedores externos según sea necesario.

• Gestionar el control de cambios del contrato según sea necesario.

• Trabajar en estrecha colaboración con el Gerente de Programa (PM) de Motorola para proporcionar una transición fluida desde la implementación del proyecto hasta el soporte de garantía y la entrega del servicio. Como parte de este proceso, el CSM Asociado garantiza que existan expectativas y procesos de soporte/servicio claramente documentados para el cliente. Busca comprender las expectativas y necesidades del cliente para garantizar que sus requisitos operativos se identifiquen y respalden adecuadamente, y si no es así, qué servicios adicionales se pueden proponer.

• Trabajar con el cliente y los equipos de soporte en el terreno para crear y/o actualizar los Planes de Soporte al Cliente (CSP) existentes.

• Crear Declaraciones de Trabajo (SOW) para clientes y proveedores de servicios.

• Ejecutar documentos contractuales y obtener órdenes de compra de los clientes.

• Gestionar el proceso de renovación de contratos de servicio para todos los acuerdos de servicio asignados de menor complejidad; incluyendo, entre otros, actualizaciones del inventario del cliente, actualizaciones de SOW, actualizaciones de CSP, actualizaciones/cambios de precios de proveedores externos, Acuerdos de Instalación (redacción, obtención de órdenes de compra y gestión).

postings.title: Sales Engineer / Commerce Integrations Lead
postings.descriptionText:
See something that should exist? Build it.
See a better way? Do it.
At Terrific , every role directly impacts how we grow from product to revenue to customer experience. We’re building the next generation of social commerce through live shopping powered by real-time data and AI.
And we believe customer data should belong to the brands who earn it — not third-party platforms.

Commerce Integrations Lead / Sales Engineer
LATAM · Full-time Contract · Remote
Product & Engineering · eCommerce · Integrations · AI
Start date: September 2026

Integrations & Technical Solutions Lead

LATAM or EMEA · Full-time Contract · Remote
Product & Engineering · eCommerce · Integrations · AI

See something that should connect? Build it.
See a process that should exist? Create it.

At Terrific , we’re building the next generation of social commerce—helping brands turn content, creators, live experiences and AI into commerce they own.

Our technology brings shoppable video, live shopping, interactive timelines, polls and product carousels directly onto a merchant’s website or app.

Now we’re looking for an Commerce Integrations Lead/Sales Engineer to help us connect Terrific to the wider commerce ecosystem—and build the systems that make those connections faster every time.

THE OPPORTUNITY

This is not a role where you’ll inherit a finished playbook.

You’ll help write it.

You’ll work across Product, Engineering, Sales and Customer Success to solve the technical problems that determine whether a customer can launch, how quickly they see value and how easily we can support the next merchant.

One day, you may investigate how a global retailer’s cart works across multiple markets. The next, you may build a lightweight integration, help shape a live commercial opportunity, automate part of our technical-discovery process or prepare an app for a commerce marketplace.

You’ll work directly with teammates and customers across Latin America, Europe, Israel and the United States. You’ll have visibility into the full journey—from the first sales conversation through integration, launch and ongoing performance.

If you enjoy moving between technology, customers and commercial problems—and want the freedom to build rather than simply maintain—this role offers unusual room to make an impact.

WHAT YOU’LL BUILD

Terrific needs to connect with the platforms and tools merchants already use.

You’ll help us expand and improve integrations across:

•
Shopify

•
VTEX

•
Adobe Commerce/Magento

•
WooCommerce

•
Salesforce Commerce Cloud

•
BigCommerce

•
Tiendanube/Nuvemshop

•
Wix

•
PrestaShop

•
Shopware

• Custom and headless commerce environments

•
Native mobile applications

You’ll also explore integrations with platforms such as Klaviyo, Attentive, Gorgias, Zendesk, Yotpo, Segment, Zapier, Google Merchant Center and Meta Commerce Manager.

Over time, you’ll help Terrific build a stronger marketplace presence, a more repeatable onboarding process and a technical integration layer that can scale across customers and markets.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

• Investigating merchant websites, applications and commerce stacks.

• Understanding how product catalogs, variants, carts and checkout flows work.

• Assessing technical feasibility for active commercial opportunities.

• Turning customer requirements into clear technical recommendations.

• Building, testing and improving integrations across major ecommerce platforms.

• Helping merchants move from signed agreement to their first live Terrific experience.

• Working directly with customer engineers and internal commercial teams.

• Supporting technical discovery, proposals, security reviews and proofs of concept.

• Improving the reliability of product feeds, event tracking, cart actions and embeds.

• Publishing and maintaining Terrific apps across relevant commerce marketplaces.

• Building tools, scripts, automations and AI agents that make integration work faster.

• Turning repeated customer friction into clear Product and Engineering priorities.

• Creating the documentation and processes that will support future customers and teammates.

You won’t be expected to solve everything alone. You will be expected to take ownership, bring the right people together and move the problem forward.

WHO YOU ARE

You’re technical, curious and commercially aware.

You want to understand why something matters to the customer—not only how it works in the code.

You’re comfortable opening DevTools, tracing an API request, reading someone else’s implementation and building a practical solution. You can move from a technical conversation with engineers to a commercial conversation with Sales or a customer without losing the thread.

You communicate clearly, ask good questions and know when to challenge an assumption.

You don’t need every process to be defined before you begin. You like taking something that is currently handled differently each time and turning it into a system the company can reuse.

You also understand that speed and judgment matter in a startup. Sometimes the right answer is a full integration. Sometimes it is a simpler path that gets the customer live this week.

HOW YOU’LL USE AI

Terrific is AI-native by default.

We don’t treat AI as a separate initiative or an occasional productivity tool. We use it as part of how we investigate, build, document and improve our work.

In this role, you’ll have the freedom to use AI to:

• Accelerate technical discovery and research.

•
Generate and test scripts.

•
Automate repetitive integration tasks.

•
Build internal agents and tools.

• Improve documentation and knowledge sharing.

• Monitor integrations and identify problems earlier.

• Help non-technical teams access technical answers faster.

We’re interested in what you can build with AI—not whether you use a particular tool.

The goal is to create leverage for the whole company, not simply complete your own work faster.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

• At least three years of hands-on development or technical integration experience.

• Production experience with at least two major ecommerce platforms.

• Experience working with APIs, product feeds, webhooks, authentication, carts or checkout flows.

• Ability to read unfamiliar code, write working scripts and debug browser or network behavior.

• Experience working directly with customers, merchants or external technical teams.

•
Clear written and verbal communication.

• Good judgment about effort, risk and commercial value.

• Comfort working independently within a distributed, international team.

•
Professional fluency in English.

• Professional fluency in Spanish or Portuguese.

Experience with live shopping, social commerce, video commerce, marketplace apps or large international retailers is a strong advantage.

French is valuable for our EMEA accounts.

SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In your first months, you will:

• Build a clear picture of Terrific ’s current integration landscape.

• Take ownership of live customer integration work.

• Create a repeatable approach to technical discovery and feasibility.

• Reduce the time between signed agreement and customer launch.

• Improve how Sales, Product, Engineering and Customer Success work together.

• Move new platform integrations into production.

• Help define which marketplace and partner integrations we build next.

• Introduce automations and AI-powered workflows that save the team time.

• Create a roadmap for how Terrific ’s integration ecosystem should grow.

Success is not following a process perfectly.

Success is leaving us with a better process than the one you joined.

WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

Many technical integration roles begin with a ticket and end when the ticket is closed.

This one begins with a customer opportunity.

You’ll see how technical decisions affect sales, launch timelines, customer experience and revenue. You’ll work across teams and countries, with direct access to the people making product and commercial decisions.

You’ll have meaningful freedom to decide how problems should be approached, which tools should be built and what Terrific ’s integration function should become.

There is no process set in stone—and that is the opportunity.

REQUIRED

• Based in Latin America—preferably Mexico, Argentina, Brazil or Colombia—or within a compatible EMEA time zone.

• Available for a full-time independent-contractor engagement.

• Able to work remotely with teammates and customers across global time zones.

• Professional fluency in English .

• Professional fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese .

• At least three years of hands-on development or technical integration experience.

• Production experience with ecommerce platforms, APIs or merchant technology.

Terrific operates as a global company, and English is our primary business language . Interviews, documentation and regular internal communication will be conducted in English.

Required:

• Deep experience in at least one of Terrific ’s three commercial pillars — eCommerce, Marketing, or Media — and enough fluency across the other two to contribute credibly from day 1.

• Terrific operates as a global company, and English is our primary business language. As such, all roles require fluency in written and spoken English.

Be part of the change that’s quietly reshaping how people discover and buy online.
Passionate about social media and e-commerce? Come build what’s next at Terrific .

Please note: We review every application carefully. While we may not be able to respond to everyone, we will reach out to candidates whose experience aligns with what we’re building.

Continuity

Your profile

• 5+ years of professional video editing experience in film, television, broadcast, advertising, commercial production, digital media, or related post-production environments.

• English proficiency at C1–C2 level to understand complex project guidelines, communicate technical feedback, and provide detailed written evaluations in English.

• Deep understanding of editing fundamentals, including pacing, continuity, shot selection, narrative structure, transitions, visual composition, and storytelling.

• Strong analytical judgment and attention to detail, with the ability to explain why an edit does or does not meet professional standards.

• Experience reviewing other editors' work, providing structured feedback, conducting technical QC, or supervising post-production workflows.

Key responsibilities

• Evaluate video editing quality: Review edited and AI-generated video content for pacing, continuity, transitions, storytelling, visual consistency, audio quality, and professional production standards.

• Perform technical quality assurance: Identify frame-rate inconsistencies, dropped frames, codec issues, color mismatches, synchronization problems, compression artifacts, and export-related defects.

• Optimize AI video performance: Evaluate and compare AI-generated video outputs, identifying visual artifacts, temporal inconsistencies, unnatural motion, continuity problems, and editing-quality issues.

• Develop AI training content: Create expert-level editing scenarios, reference examples, quality assessments, and structured feedback that reflect real-world post-production standards.

• Ensure production consistency: Evaluate adherence to creative briefs, editing instructions, style guides, technical specifications, and project-specific rubrics.

• Provide expert feedback: Clearly document video editing errors, explain their impact, and recommend appropriate corrections using professional editing terminology.

• Support quality calibration: Help establish consistent evaluation standards across editors, reviewers, and video quality assessment workflows.

• Maintain professional standards: Ensure reviewed content meets expectations for visual storytelling, technical delivery, audio-visual coherence, and overall production quality.

This person will manage all email and SMS marketing through Klaviyo, build and optimize lifecycle flows that directly impact retention and revenue, run the affiliate program, and use data to continuously improve how we communicate with subscribers at every stage of their journey. About Sezzle :

For this senior role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD based on experience level per month and in gross amount. This range acknowledges the strong expertise and significant contributions expected at this level. This is a fully remote role. We believe the best engineers can do world-class work from anywhere, and we hire accordingly. Work from where you do your best work.

About the Role:
We are seeking a hands-on Senior Software Engineer, Security Platform, to build and own the platform the security team runs on: the services that discover, scan, triage and route security findings, the event-driven bus that connects them, and the CI security gates every team's pipeline runs through.
This is a development role on the security team, not a security-analyst role. Most of your time goes into designing, building and operating services in Go and Python on Kubernetes: new services where the programme needs them, the existing fleet where it has grown faster than its upkeep, and the NATS-based event platform that moves findings, inventory changes and notifications between them. The security gates in our GitLab CI (SAST, SCA, secret detection, container and IaC scanning) and the agentic triage and review workflows are part of that platform, not the whole of it. Your job is to make these systems fast, low-noise, and reliable enough to be trusted by default without slowing delivery.
You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own detection and response and network and zero trust — your platform is what their work composes with.
At Sezzle , AI-assisted engineering is a standard part of how we build. In this role you will build reusable agentic workflows (Claude Code skills, CI review agents, automated triage and verification) that multiply what the team can cover, and hold that review discipline in the platform code you own.

What You’ll Do:

• Design, build, and operate security engineering services primarily in Golang and Python, on AWS and Kubernetes: new services where the programme needs them, and the upkeep, hardening and retirement of the existing ones.

• Own the event-driven platform between the security services: the NATS bus, its contracts and consumers, delivery guarantees and observability — so a finding, an inventory change or an alert reaches every service that acts on it.

• Integrate the platform end-to-end: scanners → finding system-of-record → tickets → metrics, so remediation state is visible and exam evidence is a by-product of engineering.

• Own delivery of the security gates — SAST, SCA, secret detection, container and IaC scanning: scanner selection and tuning, suppression workflow mechanics, false-positive burn-down, and the rollout tooling that takes a gate from advisory reporting to enforcing without blocking delivery.

• Build agentic security workflows: CI review agents, automated finding triage and verification, remediation helpers — tooling other engineers actually adopt.

• Build the triage-to-remediation automation: validate true positives by hand enough to prove the tooling right, then automate the loop — reproduction context, fix guidance, and routing to the owning teams and to vulnerability-management operations.

• Participate in threat modeling and secure design reviews for the services you build and the pipelines you own.

• Participate in the on-call rotation for the services you own.

What We Look For:

• 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant backend experience.

• Deployed significant changes to a production application in the past 30 days.

• Strong proficiency in Golang, plus working proficiency in Python.

• Hands-on experience building and operating event-driven or message-based systems (NATS, Kafka, or similar): contracts, idempotent consumers, replay, back-pressure.

• Hands-on experience building and operating CI/CD pipeline tooling — jobs, shared templates, runners — GitLab CI at fleet scale is a strong plus.

• Hands-on web application security knowledge: the OWASP Top 10 in real code — able to find these issues, fix them yourself, and encode the detection so they stop recurring.

• Hands-on experience with SAST, SCA, and secret-scanning tooling (e.g., Semgrep, CodeQL, Snyk, Trivy, Grype, gitleaks), including tuning them to a signal-to-noise ratio developers will tolerate.

• Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your development work today, have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't, and have built agentic workflows that other engineers adopted.

• Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes as deployment targets for the services you build.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

• Experience in fintech, payments, BNPL, or consumer lending, especially with systems in cardholder-data or regulated scope.

• Working knowledge of PCI DSS and SOC 2 as they apply to software development and change management — the platform you build is what produces that evidence.

• Software supply-chain integrity: SBOM pipelines, dependency governance, artifact signing and provenance (Sigstore, SLSA).

• Familiarity with policy-as-code and admission control (OPA, Kyverno, conftest) — your gates compose with the cluster's runtime policy-enforcement layer.

• Exposure to bug bounty or external vulnerability report triage — enough to know what the automation you build has to get right.

postings.title: Funnel Builder
postings.descriptionText:
Who we are
Flow Pouch makes functional mushroom pouches. People use them as a clean alternative to nicotine pouches and energy products: no nicotine, no caffeine, no crash. We launched in 2024, we have grown quickly, mostly through subscriptions, and we manufacture in the US. We are a remote team of about 25 people across the US, Europe, Brazil and the Philippines.

Why we are hiring
Almost everything we sell comes through paid ads and the pages behind them. Today we have a page builder who ships pages fast, and creative strategists who write ads, but nobody who owns the funnel itself: the angle, the copy, the structure of the page and the offer, from the first headline to the checkout. That is this role. You decide what the funnel is and write it; our page builder builds it, so you can make more of them.

What you will own

• Funnels from scratch. Advertorials, listicles, pre-sell and sales pages, offer and upsell flows. You see the finished page in your head before you write the first line, and then you write all of it.

• Copy. Headlines, hooks, body, proof, offer, CTA. Direct response, written to convert cold traffic from Meta.

• Structure and briefs. A clear layout and brief for every page so our page builder can build it in one pass, not five.

• Iteration. You read the numbers with our Head of Performance and rewrite what is not converting. A funnel is never finished.

• Angles. You work with our creative strategists so what the ad promises is what the page delivers.

What this role is not
You will not be building pages in Shopify or a page builder; that is our page builder's job. You will not be writing ads or editing video; our strategists and editors do that. This is not a brand voice or content marketing role. It is direct response for a consumable product with a subscription.

Who we are looking for

• You have built at least three complete DTC funnels yourself, copy and structure, for products sold on cold traffic. Supplements, consumables or wellness is a plus.

• You write in native-level English for a US audience. Your copy reads like a person, not like a template.

• You understand why a funnel works: the angle, the mechanism, the proof, the offer, the order they come in. You can explain what you would change on a page and why.

• You are comfortable being judged on conversion rate, not on how the page looks.

• You use AI tools for research and drafts and know where they stop being useful.

• Based in Brazil, or elsewhere in the Americas with a working day that overlaps US Eastern hours.

What is hard about this
We would rather you hear it now than in month three:

• The brief is often an angle and a deadline. You fill in the rest.

• Our product sits next to nicotine pouches, so the claims we can make are specific and the line between persuasive and non-compliant is real. You learn it fast and write inside it.

• You report to a co-founder who moves quickly. Priorities change, and a page that is live on Monday may be rewritten by Thursday because the numbers said so.

• You hand your work to someone else to build. Your brief has to be good enough that the page comes back the way you saw it.

The engagement

Type

Full-time contractor.

Compensation
$3,000–4,000 per month, depending on experience.

Location

Remote. Brazil preferred.

Reports to

Our CMO and co-founder.

Works with
Our page builder, Head of Performance and creative strategists.

Start

As soon as possible.

How to apply
Start your application with the word CORDYCEPS so we know you read the whole listing. Then send us:

• Links to at least three funnels you built. For each, one or two sentences: the product, what you wrote and structured yourself, who built the page, and what the result was if you can share it.

• Pick one of those three. What would you change on it today, and why?

• Your location, usual working hours and earliest start date.

Strategy and growth

• Own the email and SMS growth strategy for a portfolio of Growth Partner brands, from list acquisition through retention and win-back

• Plan each brand's promotional calendar and send cadence, scaling volume as lists and engagement grow

• Coordinate with each brand's performance agency so paid traffic is recognized, captured, and converted

Program build and onboarding

• Own onboarding end to end for new Growth Partner clients: kickoff, migration, and setup, including list migration, email validation, and deliverability warm-up

• Roll out SMS, MMS, and RCS programs, including Super RCS, with compliant opt-in flows

Day-to-day execution

• Run campaigns and automations day to day: briefs, copy direction, QA, scheduling, and segmentation

• Partner with our designers and creative tools to deliver 2+ new creatives per client each month, writing copy when needed

• Test continuously (subject lines, offers, timing, channel mix, onsite capture) and roll winners into the program

• Monitor deliverability, list health, and SMS volume against each client's package

Client partnership and reporting

• Serve as the primary, trusted point of contact for each Growth Partner brand

• Deliver regular performance reporting and planning sessions that tie program activity to revenue and list growth

• Spot expansion opportunities (added SMS volume, SKU Store, new channels) and partner with Sales on renewals

• Feed client learnings back to Product and help refine our blueprints, playbooks, and Growth Partner processes

Automation and AI

• Provide insight and direction on Queen One's AI products that cut manual effort in calendar creation and execution

• Pilot new automation features with your clients, report on what works, and flag where they fall short

• Partner with Product to shape the roadmap based on hands-on use across your client portfolio

• Shift your own time from manual production toward strategy as automation comes online

Requirements

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years owning full-lifecycle email programs for small and mid-sized ecommerce brands: strategy, build, execution, reporting, and optimization

• SMS program experience strongly preferred, including compliant list growth and email/SMS orchestration

• Proven track record of growing an email program, from building a list from zero through hypergrowth, with numbers to show for it (list size, revenue per subscriber, share of revenue from owned channels)

• Agency or multi-client experience: you can run 5+ brand programs at once without dropping a ball

• Confident, client-ready communicator who builds trust with founders and marketing leads

• Experience with Klaviyo, Attentive, Postscript, or similar platforms, plus Google Suite, Slack, and Bootcamp; able to ramp quickly on new tools

Job Title: Account Executive (Consultative Sales )
Location: Remote
Time Zone: US Time Zones (EST–PST)
Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced Account Executive to join a specialized dental marketing agency. This is a consultative sales role designed to take the majority of sales calls off the founder's plate. You'll work with warm leads, run discovery calls and demos, and close new business — all with a strong emphasis on honest expectation-setting and integrity in selling. This is not a script-reading role; we want someone who genuinely understands a prospect's needs and communicates what our services can and cannot deliver.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct discovery calls with warm leads generated by marketing and BDR efforts

• Deeply understand each prospect's practice, challenges, and goals before presenting solutions

• Deliver tailored slide deck presentations and proposals that map our services to prospect needs

• Handle objections with transparency and consultative care

• Close new business and hand off smoothly to the delivery and onboarding team

• Maintain accurate pipeline notes and deal stages in our CRM

• Run structured follow-up sequences via email, messaging, and calls

• Supplement inbound leads with targeted outreach and light prospecting, especially early on

• Collaborate closely with the founder and internal team on capacity and priorities

Required Qualifications

• 3–5+ years of experience in consultative B2B sales , ideally in agency services or SaaS with multi-week/multi-month sales cycles

• Proven track record running full sales cycles from discovery to close, or strong mid-to-upper funnel AE experience

• Excellent spoken and written English; must be easy for US-based clients to understand

• Confident and polished on Zoom and screen-shared presentations

• Strong integrity in selling — comfortable setting realistic expectations in a marketing context

• Highly organized with disciplined follow-up habits

• Prior experience working remotely; candidates without demonstrated remote work experience will not be considered

• Comfortable reporting to and collaborating closely with the CEO

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience selling marketing or advertising services

• Background in dental, healthcare, or professional services industries

•
Experience working with US-based clients

• Familiarity with CRM tools and basic reporting

Tools & Technology

• CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar)

•
Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams

•
Slack and Google Workspace

• Proposal and e-signature tools (PandaDoc, DocuSign, or similar)

• Scheduling and sales enablement tools (Calendly, Outreach, or similar)

Interview Process – Important
This is a highly client-facing role, and the interview process includes a mandatory video submission . Candidates must:

• Treat the video as a formal business interview

• Dress in professional business attire (equivalent to a suit-and-tie interview standard)

• Present themselves exactly as they would for a high-level client or executive meeting

This role is ideal for professionals who enjoy presenting themselves in a refined, professional manner, are confident on camera, and are excited to serve as the visible face of a brand in client interactions.

Please NOTE It is crucial that you complete the application form in full. As part of the application process, you will be required to record a video. If your application is successful, you will receive an email confirming next steps — the video is the first step of the interview process. If you do not record a video, we will not be able to consider you for ANY open roles.
We connect top talent with vetted employers, competitive pay, and real growth opportunities.

postings.title: AI/ML Solution Architect (LATAM/US)
postings.descriptionText:
Fully remote position in Latin America (Brazil or Argentina) or in the United States · Full-time employment · Daily overlap with both Central European Time and North American client hours.
Are you an experienced AI/ML Solutions Architect with hands-on AWS experience? Join SnapSoft's AI/ML Service Line and work on international projects with our highly qualified engineering team, remotely and aligned to US working hours.
You will see a lot of ideas move from POC to MVP to production, which means fast iteration and quick feedback on whether something actually works. What we build has to survive contact with real users, real data and real infrastructure.
As an AI/ML Solutions Architect , you will design and deliver AI and data solutions across various client projects and act as the technical lead of project teams of 2-3 engineers. Our current work centres on agentic automation, LLM-based RAG systems, vector databases and integrating AI into our clients' existing application landscapes. You will work closely with colleagues from our Application Development and Cloud Migration service lines, as well as our PMO, Sales and Presales teams, on projects where AI, engineering and cloud come together.
This is a client-facing role. Alongside delivery, you will spend roughly 20% of your time supporting presales activities. Most of your working day will overlap with US time zones, and a few hours of overlap with our Hungarian delivery team are needed. Occasional travel to Hungary or to client sites may come up, but it is rare.

Requirements

What you'll be doing

• Own the end-to-end AI/ML solution architecture on client projects, acting as a key decision-maker and driving the delivery team

• Act as a trusted advisor to clients: understand their business problems and provide technology consulting to identify the best-fit solution

• Support presales activities (roughly 20% of your time), such as technical discovery, solution design and estimation

• Technically lead a team of 2-3 AI and cloud engineers focused on fast prototyping and delivery of AI/ML solutions on AWS, and mentor junior and mid-level colleagues

• Design and build agentic systems that plan, call tools and automate real business workflows

• Develop LLM-powered applications, including RAG pipelines: chunking, embedding, retrieval strategies, evaluation and iteration

• Work with vector databases and search: indexing strategies, hybrid and semantic search, relevance tuning

• Perform prompt engineering, model selection and systematic evaluation of LLM outputs

• Develop highly scalable services realizing AI/ML functionality (LLM, ML and other AI models)

• Build scalable Python services and the data flows behind them (ingestion, transformation, document preparation), including AI-driven data access such as Text2SQL

• Integrate AI services with external systems through APIs: REST endpoints, authentication, webhooks, third-party and client-side SaaS platforms

• Implement AI solutions on AWS (e.g. Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, Textract)

• Describe infrastructure as code with Terraform (Terragrunt) or AWS CloudFormation, and design, build and maintain CI/CD pipelines across multiple environments

• Stay up to date with AWS innovations and contribute to AWS Competency and Service Delivery Programs to support SnapSoft's AWS Partner journey

You are looking for us, if you have

• 5+ years of experience, including recent hands-on work on AI projects, from an AI/ML, data or backend engineering background

• Previous experience in an architect role (this should not be your first architect position)

• Hands-on experience with both GenAI and classic ML solutions

• Strong AWS experience, including Amazon Bedrock, and experience with some of: SageMaker, Glue, MWAA, EMR, RDS, Aurora, S3, OpenSearch, ElasticSearch

• Strong proficiency in Python and hands-on experience with the GenAI ecosystem (e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex, agent frameworks, LLM provider SDKs, Pydantic)

• Solid understanding of LLM application concepts: RAG, embeddings, vector databases, tool calling, agent patterns, prompt engineering and evaluation

• Good command of SQL and a working understanding of core data engineering concepts (ETL, pipelines, data modelling)

• Proven experience designing, consuming and integrating APIs, and connecting AI services to existing systems

• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field

• Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, a consulting mindset and business acumen, and comfort working in client-facing situations

• The ability to work independently and collaboratively with global, cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment

• Availability to work in US time zones, with a few hours of overlap with our Hungarian team

• Professional working proficiency in English

Nice to have

• AWS Solutions Architect Professional or another AWS Professional/Specialty certification

• Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore

• Background at an AWS partner or another professional services company similar to SnapSoft

• Experience with multiple cloud providers (cloud-agnostic experience)

•
Pre-sales engineering experience

What we offer

• A company culture based on autonomy and accountability

• Fully remote position anywhere in the United States OR LATAM (Brazil or Argentina).

• Flexible working hours with collaboration across US and European teams.

• High visibility across executive leadership with real influence on how our US delivery organization evolves.

• Work on innovative AWS Cloud Migration projects for fast-growing startups and enterprise customers.

• Travel: Occasional business travel for strategic customer engagements.

Do you see yourself in this role? Apply now!
If you're excited about this opportunity and believe you're the right fit, we'd love to hear from you!

Send us your CV.

postings.descriptionText:
Community Sports Partners | Remote — Latin America & the Caribbean
Predominantly evenings and weekends, Toronto/Eastern time
$1,000–$1,500 monthly base + $1,000+/month performance bonus potential
Build and run sports programs with the urgency, resourcefulness and accountability of a founder.
We are building a high-growth sports business and looking for someone who loves sport and wants personal responsibility for making leagues and programs succeed. You will own the process from initial planning through sales, launch, execution, customer experience and growth.
This is an intense, hands-on role with high expectations. You will pursue ambitious growth targets, solve problems under pressure and follow through on commitments. Your impact will be measured in filled programs, reliable delivery, returning players and sound financial results.

What you will own
• Planning: Assess demand, prepare budgets and launch timelines, coordinate venues and permits, and confirm schedules and staffing.
• Sales: Follow up with players and team captains, convert enquiries into paid registrations and fill available spaces.
• Execution: Coordinate local staff, referees, coaches and equipment. Check readiness before games and resolve problems during delivery.
• Growth: Build partnerships, support campaigns, increase repeat registrations and identify opportunities for new programs and locations.
• Customer experience: Own player communications, resolve complaints and restore confidence when something goes wrong.
• Results: Track registrations, revenue, costs, program occupancy and retention. Report progress honestly, identify gaps early and deliver improvements.

High growth. High intensity.
Personal accountability.
A conventional 9-to-5 mindset —waiting for instructions, doing only the assigned task or leaving problems for someone else—is incompatible with this role. We actively challenge passive working habits and address repeated failures of ownership through performance reviews.
• Think creatively: Find overlooked audiences, develop partnerships, test new offers and create practical ways to fill programs.
• Show tenacity: Follow up consistently, work through setbacks and adapt when the first approach fails.
• Move with purpose: Turn ideas into action quickly, measure what works and expand successful approaches.
• Own the outcome: Raise problems early with a proposed response, escalate decisions when needed and coordinate the people required to resolve them. Build processes that prevent repeat failures.

Working hours
Hours are predominantly evenings and weekends in Toronto/Eastern time , when our customers and programs are most active. These are the core working hours of the role. Specific shifts and weekly hours will be agreed before starting. Within that schedule, we expect focus, urgency and dependable ownership.
This is one role advertised across multiple recruitment locations. Applicants throughout Latin America and the Caribbean are welcome, including outside the advertised metropolitan locations. Please apply once.

Requirements

What you bring
Practical experience in sports leagues, clubs, tournaments, facilities or program operations; sustained passion for sport demonstrated through real involvement; strong organization and numerical skills; fluent spoken and written English; confidence with spreadsheets and operational systems; and the ability to coordinate people remotely. You must be based in Latin America or the Caribbean.

Apply
Submit your CV and a brief summary of the sports programs you have helped run, what you personally owned and the results you achieved. Our application process includes Culture Index and Criteria assessments.
Complete both assessments using the same email as your application. If already completed for Community Sports Partners , indicate this in the form.

• Culture Index survey

• Criteria GAME assessment — English

Benefits

Compensation and progression
Start as a Coordinator at USD $1,000–$1,500 per month , depending on experience, plus the potential to earn USD $1,000+ per month in performance bonuses , based on targets and calculation terms agreed in advance. Bonuses are variable, not guaranteed.
Over the first six months, you will build toward Manager responsibilities. Progression to Manager will depend on successful completion of probation and a six-month review of growth results, operational reliability, initiative and readiness to lead independently. Promotion is earned through results.

postings.title: Growth Manager
postings.descriptionText:
About hireworks

hireworks is building a community of top talent in key international markets by unlocking unparalleled access to positions at leading U.S. based companies. As your employer, hireworks will ensure you have a seamless interview, onboarding, and employee experience - providing ongoing support and resources along the way. Established in 2023, hireworks is forging corp-to-corp relationships with leading U.S. based organizations looking to grow their teams with best-in-class talent around the world. Working with hireworks means unlocking access to a network of local peers and mentors and career opportunities through our client network.

About our client
Our client is an AI-native customer engagement platform built for ecommerce brands. Unlike traditional marketing automation platforms that rely on manual rules, segments, and campaigns, they use algorithmic decision-making to determine the right message, channel, timing, and product recommendation for every customer interaction. By combining email, SMS, onsite experiences, identity resolution, and AI-driven personalization into a single platform, they helps brands increase revenue while reducing operational complexity.
They are assembling one of the world's most ambitious teams of marketers, technologists, and operators
with decades of experience building the systems behind many of the world's leading commerce
brands—all from their 30,000-square-foot headquarters in Williamsburg, Brooklyn.﻿

About the Position
Our client's Growth Partner package gives select brands our client's full platform, plus a team that runs their
program for them. Our client handles approximately 99% of the work, operating like an agency using their own technology. As a Growth Manager, you are that team's lead for a book of 5+ Growth Partner clients. You own each
brand's email and SMS program end to end: strategy, setup, migration, the program build, day-to-day
execution, and reporting. You are measured on one thing above all: growing your clients' lists and the

revenue those lists drive.

﻿
This role is for an experienced lifecycle operator who has built email and SMS programs from the first
subscriber through hypergrowth, and who wants to do it across several brands at once.
﻿
﻿ What You'll Do
﻿ Strategy and growth

• Own the email and SMS growth strategy for a portfolio of Growth Partner brands, from list
acquisition through retention and win-back

• Build list growth plans using our client's identity resolution, entrance and exit exchanges,
recognition, pop-ups, top bars, landers, and exit intent

• Plan each brand's promotional calendar and send cadence, scaling volume as lists and
engagement grow

• Coordinate with each brand's performance agency so paid traffic is recognized, captured, and converted

Program build and onboarding

• Own onboarding end to end for new Growth Partner clients: kickoff, migration, and setup,
including list migration, email validation, and deliverability warm-up

• Build or rebuild full lifecycle programs from our client's blueprints: welcome, cart and browse
abandonment, product stories, Subscribe & Save, post-purchase, win-back, and more

• Set up Brand Book and Dimensions so the platform's AI reflects each brand's voice, products, and
goals

• Roll out SMS, MMS, and RCS programs, including Super RCS, with compliant opt-in flow

Day-to-day execution

• Run campaigns and automations day to day: briefs, copy direction, QA, scheduling, and

• segmentation

• Partner with our client's designers and creative tools to deliver 2+ new creatives per client each month,
writing copy when needed

• Test continuously (subject lines, offers, timing, channel mix, onsite capture) and roll winners into the program

• Monitor deliverability, list health, and SMS volume against each client's package

﻿Client partnership and reporting

• Serve as the primary, trusted point of contact for each Growth Partner brand

• Deliver regular performance reporting and planning sessions that tie program activity to revenue and list growth

• Spot expansion opportunities (added SMS volume, SKU Store, new channels) and partner with Sales on renewals

• Feed client learnings back to Product and help refine our client's blueprints, playbooks, and Growth Partner processes

﻿Automation and AI

• Provide insight and direction on our client's AI products that cut manual effort in calendar
creation and execution

• Pilot new automation features with your clients, report on what works, and flag where they fall
short

• Partner with Product to shape the roadmap based on hands-on use across your client portfolio

• Shift your own time from manual production toward strategy as automation comes online

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years owning full-lifecycle email programs for small and mid-sized ecommerce brands:
strategy, build, execution, reporting, and optimization
SMS program experience strongly preferred, including compliant list growth and email/SMS
orchestration

• Proven track record of growing an email program, from building a list from zero through
hypergrowth, with numbers to show for it (list size, revenue per subscriber, share of revenue from
owned channels)

• Hands-on experience with list growth tactics: pop-ups and onsite capture, exit intent, landers,
offer strategy, and partnering with paid media to convert traffic into subscribers

• Deep knowledge of lifecycle automation (welcome, abandonment, post-purchase, replenishment,
win-back) and campaign calendar planning

• Solid grasp of deliverability, list hygiene, and platform migrations

• Agency or multi-client experience: you can run 5+ brand programs at once without dropping a ball

• Strong creative judgment and solid copywriting; you can write a clear brief, draft copy when
needed, and give useful feedback on design

• Analytical and comfortable pulling performance, finding the story in the data, and turning it into a plan

• Confident, client-ready communicator who builds trust with founders and marketing leads

• Experience with Klaviyo, Attentive, Postscript, or similar platforms, plus Google Suite, Slack, and Bootcamp; able to ramp quickly on new tools

• A proactive, ownership-oriented mindset; you follow up without being asked and close loops

How ﻿Success Is Measured

• List growth (email and SMS subscribers) per client

• Revenue from email and SMS, and owned-channel share of total revenue

• Client retention through the 6-month opt-out window and on to renewal﻿

Benefits:
﻿ hireworks is cultivating a growing community of top talent across LATAM. In addition to unlocking access to positions at top tier U.S. based companies, we offer a variety of benefits to enhance your experience:

• Competitive Pay - compensation that reflects your experience and accomplishments

• Remote Flexibility - work from anywhere in your current country of residence (Colombia, Brazil, or
Argentina)

• Paid Time Off - ample vacation days to rest and recharge

• Public Holidays - local federal holidays are fully paid days off

The ROLE

Title

Customer Success Manager

Company
Measure Marketing (MMR), a Toronto-based GEO, AI search and SEO agency

Location
Remote: LATAM (Colombia preferred) or Europe

Hours
Overlap of at least 5 hours with North American business hours (ET)

Type

Full-time

Reports to

Head of Delivery (confirm)

Clients
B2B, law firms, signage, SaaS, and residential and commercial home improvement

Search Changed the Map. You're the Client's GPS.
Buyers don't just Google anymore. They ask ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews, and they often get an answer without ever clicking. That shift is why MMR exists: we help clients get found, cited and chosen across both classic and AI-powered search.
This role exists because great work only counts when the client can see it. You're the person who turns rankings, AI citations, traffic and leads into a clear story of progress. You catch risk before the client feels it, and you keep every account moving toward measurable outcomes.
Think of it as a marathon run at sprint pace. Relationships last for years, but you prove value every single month.

What You'll Own

1. Relationships That Fuel Retention

• Be each client's trusted partner and main point of contact.

• Run check-ins , monthly and quarterly reviews that prove progress and set the next 90-day sprint.

• Handle escalations calmly and drive fast, accountable fixes.

2. Full-Funnel Performance: AI Search, SEO and PPC

• Explain AI search shifts in plain English, including AI Overviews, zero-click results and citations in ChatGPT and Perplexity.

• Read paid search performance in Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, including spend, CPC, conversions and cost per lead, and flag when budget isn't turning into pipeline.

• Connect GEO, AEO, SEO and PPC to outcomes: visibility, qualified traffic, leads and cost per lead.

• Own the narrative while specialists handle execution.

3. Content and CRO Insight

• Link content plans to client goals, and flag gaps for both search and AI engines.

• Raise the alarm when traffic or ad clicks grow but leads stay flat, then drive CRO fixes with the web team.

4. Data Storytelling, Human in the Loop

• Turn data from GA4, Search Console, Google Ads, agency reporting tools and HubSpot into a monthly value story: what happened, why it matters and what's next.

• Use AI to draft reports, summarize calls and spot patterns. You verify the output, apply judgment and own every word the client sees.

5. The Retention System

• Score every account based on leads and account health, customer sentiment, and run recovery plans for any account in Yellow or Red.

• Escalate any account that stays Red for more than 30 days.

• Pass expansion opportunities to the growth team when clients are winning.

6. Projects, ClickUp and Automation

• Turn success plans into ClickUp projects with owners, milestones and deadlines, and keep HubSpot clean.

• Coordinate the SEO, PPC, content, web and dev teams while protecting scope and margin.

• Automate repetitive reporting and follow-ups with AI and workflow tools.

What You Bring

Must-Haves

• 3+ years in customer success or account management at a digital marketing agency, SEO/SaaS company or similar B2B service business.

• A working understanding of SEO and PPC (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads), plus curiosity and early knowledge of AI search, GEO and AEO.

• Comfort with numbers: you can read GA4, Search Console and dashboard data and explain what changed and why.

• Proven ability to turn data into a clear, persuasive story for business owners and executives.

• Hands-on experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini for research, reporting and communication, plus the judgment to check their output.

• Experience running projects in ClickUp or a similar tool (Asana, Monday) and keeping a CRM like HubSpot clean.

• Confidence in tough conversations, including pushback, scope creep and at-risk renewals.

• Professional fluency in English, written and spoken, with North American clients.

Nice-to-Haves

• Experience with tracking and reporting tools, and reporting platforms.

• Basic CRO knowledge, such as landing page best practices, A/B testing and conversion tracking.

• Experience with workflow automation (Zapier, ClickUp automations).

• Background with B2B customers and an asset to know SaaS clients.

• Familiarity with net revenue retention, upsell motions and customer lifetime value.

You are measured on customer results, relationships and expansions. Measured through customer NPS survey and retained revenue.
You're part relationship builder, part data storyteller and part project driver. You don't wait for clients to raise concerns. You see the dip in the dashboard first, figure out why, and walk in with a plan.
You use AI to move faster, but you never hand it the wheel. You're curious about where search is heading, and you can explain it to a business owner in two minutes without jargon.
Most of all, you own outcomes. Great relationships matter, but at MMR they're backed by measurable results.

How to Apply
Apply through our JazzHR careers page. You'll answer a few short questions as part of your application. They show us how you think, so give them five minutes.
This is a remote role open in LATAM (Colombia preferred) and Europe, with at least 5 hours of overlap with North American Eastern Time.
