postings.title: Market Curation Editor — Politics
postings.descriptionText:
The Opportunity
As a Market Curation Editor for Politics, you'll join the Product Data Operations team supporting a new social-predictions app moving through a beta launch. An automated pipeline drafts candidate political prediction markets every day; you are the human judgment layer on top of it — deciding which go live, sharpening the ones that are nearly right, and catching the markets the pipeline missed entirely. This role calls for deep, current expertise in politics and elections, and in the conventions that govern how political outcomes are officially called and settled.

What You'll Do

• Review a daily queue of system-generated political markets against a fixed completion deadline, working event by event across every market a political development generates.

• Assess each candidate market for factual accuracy, clarity, and whether the resolution criteria can actually be adjudicated against a named authoritative source (e.g., the AP, official state election boards, certified results) and a defined settlement date.

• Verify that open and close timing is correct for the underlying event, including scheduled and unscheduled delays — runoff elections, recounts, and certification delays.

• Apply the correct settlement convention for the type of political event in question — election calls and concession timing, recounts and certification, runoff triggers, ballot measure outcomes, legislative vote counts, and official statistical or vote-count corrections.

• Confirm policy fit against community standards and content guidelines, escalating anything ambiguous, contested, or politically sensitive rather than making an unsupported call.

• Approve, edit, or reject each candidate, recording a structured reason every time — this record is a product deliverable, not admin.

• Rewrite questions and resolution language for precision, and for how the public and press actually talk about the event.

• Author timestamped clarifications when ambiguity emerges in a live market, and resolve settlement exceptions the data feed can't handle — contested results, recounts, litigation.

• Run proactive gap scans — monitor live markets for visible errors, and track campaign schedules, polling releases, and political and press social media for events the pipeline didn't capture.

• Participate in weekly calibration reviews to stay consistent with published guidelines and fellow curators.

What We're Looking For

• 3+ years in political trading or prediction markets, political data operations, political/data journalism or editorial, polling and election modeling, or a comparable role requiring current subject-matter expertise.

• Demonstrable current fluency in U.S. politics and elections — following it now, not historically — across federal, state, and major local races.

• Fluency with political media and political social media (campaign accounts, press pool reporting, breaking political news accounts).

• Working knowledge of official election administration and settlement conventions (certification timelines, recount thresholds, runoff triggers, Electoral College mechanics where relevant), and of which sources are authoritative for results and vote counts.

• Proven judgment on edge cases: contested results, recounts, litigation, ballot curing, ambiguous or delayed official calls.

• Ability to interpret official sources quickly and reach a defensible determination.

• Exceptional written precision under deadline — able to write unambiguous rules that hold up after the outcome is known.

• Comfort applying a written policy framework, with the instinct to escalate rather than guess — especially on politically sensitive or contested topics.

• Flexible availability for evening and weekend work around debates, primaries, and election nights.

Nice to Have

• Direct experience trading on, or working with, political prediction markets or exchanges such as Kalshi or Polymarket.

• Background in polling and election modeling — for example, FiveThirtyEight during its ABC/ESPN era, Decision Desk HQ, VoteHub, or similar outlets; data-journalism experience of this kind, including at spinoffs such as Fifty Plus One, is also relevant.

• Prior work on a political trading desk, or standing as a super-user of political prediction apps.

• Political journalism background and/or experience contributing to guidelines, style guides, rulebooks, or annotation standards.

• Familiarity with content policy, moderation frameworks, or editorial standards, particularly around politically sensitive content.

**PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH **
Location: Remote – Latin America

Compensation: $4,000 USD per month

About the Company
Our client is a fast-growing U.S.-based digital marketing company helping local and home service businesses generate qualified leads, strengthen their online presence, and grow through innovative digital marketing strategies.
The organization operates in a highly performance-driven environment where experimentation, measurable results, speed, and continuous optimization are central to how the company works.
As the business continues to scale, the team is investing heavily in improving conversion performance across landing pages, funnels, campaigns, and the overall customer acquisition journey.

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced CRO & Landing Page Specialist with deep expertise in lead generation, conversion-focused landing pages, and funnel optimization.
The core objective of this position is simple: understand what motivates users to take action and continuously improve the journey from initial interest through conversion.
This is not simply a landing page design role.
We are looking for someone who thinks analytically, understands consumer psychology, develops clear hypotheses, runs structured experiments, and uses data to continuously improve conversion performance.
The ideal candidate is equally comfortable analyzing a funnel, identifying friction, developing an A/B test, optimizing messaging, reviewing behavioral data, and translating results into actionable improvements.

What You’ll Do

• Build and optimize landing pages designed to generate qualified leads.

• Analyze user behavior throughout the conversion funnel.

• Identify friction points that reduce click-through rates, form completion, or conversions.

• Develop data-driven hypotheses for improving landing-page and funnel performance.

• Plan, launch, and evaluate A/B and multivariate tests.

• Optimize headlines, messaging, calls to action, page structure, forms, layouts, and other conversion elements.

• Analyze conversion data and prioritize experiments based on potential business impact.

• Continuously improve click-through rates, lead volume, conversion rates, and cost efficiency.

• Review heatmaps, session recordings, funnel analytics, and behavioral data to identify opportunities.

• Collaborate closely with copywriters, designers, paid media specialists, marketers, and other stakeholders.

• Translate performance data into clear recommendations and actionable next steps.

• Maintain an organized experimentation roadmap and testing backlog.

• Document test results, insights, and learnings.

• Apply successful learnings across additional campaigns, landing pages, and funnels.

• Help develop scalable CRO frameworks and best practices as the organization grows.

Qualifications

Required

• Professional experience in Conversion Rate Optimization, landing-page optimization, or funnel optimization .

• Strong hands-on experience with lead-generation funnels .

• Proven ability to improve landing-page and funnel conversion performance.

• Deep understanding of what motivates users to click, engage, submit forms, and convert.

• Hands-on experience designing, executing, and analyzing A/B tests .

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Strong understanding of conversion psychology, user behavior, and persuasive messaging.

• Ability to analyze marketing, funnel, and conversion data.

• Experience identifying friction points throughout a customer journey.

• Experience continuously optimizing campaigns rather than relying on one-time page launches.

• Ability to clearly explain testing hypotheses, findings, and recommendations.

• Professional English communication skills.

• Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment.

Preferred

• Experience using landing-page builders, funnel platforms, or CMS tools.

• Experience with web analytics and behavioral analytics platforms.

• Familiarity with heatmaps, session recordings, click tracking, and user-behavior analysis.

• Strong understanding of direct-response marketing principles.

• Experience working closely with paid media or performance marketing teams.

• Experience optimizing form completion rates and lead quality.

• Understanding of customer acquisition costs, cost per lead, and conversion economics.

• Experience with high-volume lead-generation campaigns.

• Familiarity with tools such as Google Analytics, Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, VWO, Optimizely, Unbounce, Webflow, or similar platforms.

• Experience within digital marketing agencies, local services, or performance-driven businesses.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

• Data-driven: You use evidence rather than assumptions to make decisions.

• Experiment-oriented: You constantly look for opportunities to test and improve.

• Analytical: You enjoy understanding why users behave the way they do.

• Conversion-focused: You evaluate pages and funnels based on business results, not aesthetics alone.

• Curious: You continually ask why something is or is not converting.

• Commercially minded: You understand the relationship between conversion rates, lead quality, acquisition costs, and revenue.

• Detail-oriented: Small changes matter, and you pay attention to them.

• Proactive: You identify optimization opportunities without waiting for someone else to point them out.

• Collaborative: You can work effectively with designers, copywriters, marketers, and performance teams.

• Results-driven: You care about measurable improvements and business impact.

How Success Is Measured
Success in this role will be measured through:

•
Landing-page conversion rate.

•
Funnel click-through rate.

•
Lead-generation volume.

•
Cost per lead.

•
Form completion rate.

•
Lead quality.

•
Experiment velocity.

•
Number of meaningful tests launched.

• Percentage of tests producing successful or actionable learnings.

• Implementation of successful CRO insights across additional campaigns and funnels.

• Overall improvement in conversion economics.

Why Join Us

• Join a fast-growing, performance-focused digital marketing organization.

• Own high-impact conversion initiatives that directly influence business results.

• Work across landing pages, funnels, user behavior, testing, and lead generation.

• Collaborate closely with talented marketing, creative, and performance teams.

• Work in an environment where experimentation and continuous improvement are strongly encouraged.

• Have significant autonomy to identify opportunities, test ideas, and improve performance.

Growth Opportunity
Internal promotion is an important part of the company's culture.
High-performing team members are encouraged to expand their responsibilities, develop new skills, and pursue leadership opportunities as the organization grows.
The successful candidate should be excited about becoming a key contributor to the company's conversion strategy and taking on broader optimization and performance responsibilities over time.

• Experience in leading, coaching, and mentoring software engineers

• Professional software engineering experience with Python or Go

• Expertise in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, quality engineering, or a closely related domain

• Strong knowledge of modern software testing processes, strategies, and automation

• Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)

• Strong technical judgement and the ability to engage meaningfully in code reviews, architecture discussions, and software design

• Experience working in an agile development environment with the ability to organize a team to deliver high-quality results

• Professional written and spoken English with excellent communication and presentation skills

• Great interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability, demonstrating passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation

• Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Additional skills we value

Experience with any of the following:

• Cloud technologies such as Kubernetes, OpenStack, Juju, Terraform, AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure

• Designing testing strategies for distributed or cloud-native systems

• Building or operating large-scale CI/CD and test infrastructure

• Applying AI or machine learning to test analysis, failure classification, or engineering workflows

• Deploying, operating, or debugging distributed systems

• Leading globally distributed teams

What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually, and more often for graduates and associates, to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus.
We provide all team members with additional benefits that reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programmes to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Maternity and paternity leave

• Employee Assistance Programme and wellness support

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

• Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and a leading platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software.
We recruit globally and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

postings.descriptionText:
En Bidcom lideramos el mercado de E-commerce en Argentina, consolidándonos como el vendedor #1 en Mercado Libre durante el Hot Sale 2026, tanto en facturación como en unidades vendidas. Lograr este hito requiere de una gestión operativa de excelencia, donde el control de calidad, el recupero técnico y la rentabilidad del canal outlet operan en perfecta sinergia.
Buscamos un/a Jefe de Operaciones Outlet y Calidad que lidere la estrategia end-to-end de recupero técnico, control de calidad y comercialización de productos outlet de la compañía. Ofrecemos un entorno dinámico, tecnológico y data-driven, ideal para profesionales con visión de negocio y mentalidad emprendedora que busquen transformar devoluciones e información operativa en una unidad de negocio altamente rentable.

• Gestionar el P&L del negocio Outlet, definiendo la estrategia de pricing, posicionamiento, costo de recupero y margen de contribución para maximizar la rentabilidad.

• Transformar el equipo de Calidad en un centro de Business Intelligence, diseñando tableros de control con datos de devoluciones y garantías para impulsar la mejora continua del catálogo.

• Impulsar la automatización e integración de nuevas tecnologías (como Inteligencia Artificial) en los procesos de inspección, clasificación y escala operativa.

• Construir, escalar y optimizar los canales de monetización de stock recuperado (Nuevo u Outlet), identificando nuevas oportunidades de crecimiento comercial.

• Cooperar activamente con las áreas de Operaciones, Dirección y Comerciales para alertar sobre fallas de fábrica, optimizar packaging y mejorar la experiencia final del usuario.

Requisitos:

• Experiencia de 3 a 5 años en posiciones de liderazgo operativo, servicio técnico, control de calidad, logística inversa o e-commerce/retail tecnológico.

• Marcada visión de negocio y perfil comercial con manejo fluido del P&L, costos y márgenes de contribución.

• Formación: Graduados o estudiantes avanzados en Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería Industrial o carreras afines.

¿Por qué elegir este desafío?

• Porque vas a liderar la estrategia de recupero y calidad de una de las operaciones de Mercado Libre más importantes de Argentina.

• Porque tendrás ownership directo sobre el P&L de una unidad de negocio en constante crecimiento.

• Porque promoverás la innovación aplicando Inteligencia Artificial y Business Intelligence en procesos operativos reales.

• Porque impulsamos tu desarrollo profesional a la par de nuestro negocio en un entorno colaborativo y de alto rendimiento.

postings.title: Encargado de Turno
postings.descriptionText:
At H&P, our people are our strength.

DESCRIPCIÓN DEL CARGO :
Propósitos generales para este puesto de trabajo:

• Orientar y guiar a la cuadrilla de Perforación en las operaciones de forma segura y exitosa.

• Conocer y aplicar los procedimientos de control de pozo.

• Cumplir con todas las normas estipuladas en los Reglamentos, Planes y Programa de HSE establecidos por la empresa

Responsabilidades:
Los próximos ítems representan la mayoría de las obligaciones requeridas para este puesto, pero la descripción es meramente enunciativa y no evita que pueda ser asignado a la realización de otras tareas, cuando sea necesario. Para la realización de las tareas asignadas a este puesto es necesario contar con la certificación Well Control vigente, así como con la responsabilidad y conducta constantes.

• Practicar el cumplimiento de las normas de prevención y control adoptadas por la Empresa, por su propia seguridad y salud en el trabajo y por la de aquellas personas a las que pueda afectar su actividad profesional, a causa de sus actos y omisiones en el trabajo, de conformidad con su formación e instrucciones establecidas.

• Hacer su trabajo en forma segura siguiendo los ATS’s.

• Liderar proactivamente y entrenar a sus cuadrillas a realizar sus labores en forma segura.

• Promover activamente las herramientas de gestión de HSEQ de la empresa: H&P Way, Life Belts (Salva Vidas), Actively CARE (Reforzar comportamientos seguros), Safety Contacts (Contactos de Seguridad).

• Requerir el seguimiento continuo de los Análisis de Seguridad del Trabajo (ATS’s) como una herramienta para realizar cada trabajo o tarea.

• Organizar reuniones semanales de HSE (Salud, Seguridad, Medio Ambiente) para motivar la máxima participación de empleados, compañías de servicio y representantes de la operadora.

• Actuar sobre las ideas y los temas de acción identificados durante las reuniones de HSE semanales para crear y/o mantener un ambiente de trabajo más saludable y más seguro.

• Asegurarse que se tome acción correctiva en las condiciones inseguras o riesgos físicos identificados en el taladro o en la bodega.

• Reportar todos los incidentes, accidentes y derrames siguiendo la línea de mando.

• Reportar todos los casi-incidentes que no resulten en lesiones personales o daño a la propiedad, pero que pudieran haber sucedido si las circunstancias hubieran sido un poco diferentes.

• Inspeccionar los equipos de terceras compañías o compañías de servicios antes de armarlo para “ponerlo en servicio”. Si encontró que no está en condición satisfactoria, reportar los resultados al representante de la operadora en la locación.

• Mantener el inventario actualizado de productos químicos de H&P en la locación y copias de las hojas de datos de Seguridad de Materiales (MSDS) asociadas a dichos materiales.

• Conocer las responsabilidades en las posiciones de boca de pozo, motorista, enganchador y perforador.

• Identificar la utilización adecuada y la aplicación de la tubería de perforación. Los diferentes diámetros, grados, roscas, torques y tensiones para cada una.

• Supervisar la actividad de inspección de tubería.

• Identificar la utilización adecuada y la aplicación de herramientas especiales de perforación.

• Conocer el adecuado ensamblaje de herramientas de perforación y sarta de perforación.

• Suministra completa identificación de tubulares y de herramientas que se suben a la mesa para ser corridas dentro del pozo.

• Conocer los procedimientos adecuados relacionados con las operaciones de perforación y saber dirigir y definir el procedimiento a seguir.

• Conocer los procedimientos adecuados relacionados con las operaciones de perforación y explicar las razones para dichos procedimientos.

• Tener habilidad para detectar los factores que se involucran para evitar que suceda una pega de tubería. Debe conocer todos los tipos de pega y sus subdivisiones.

• Conocer los procedimientos e identificar los diferentes mecanismos de pega de tubería.

• Identificar las diferentes formaciones que se están perforando.

• Determinar el volumen del lodo que se encuentra tanto en los tanques como en el anular, dentro de la tubería y el desplazamiento del mismo.

• Verificar que se realice el mantenimiento adecuado del malacate, del equipo de perforación y los equipos auxiliares.

• Conocer las responsabilidades asignadas a su cargo y a su cuadrilla en RAMS®.

• Tener habilidad Para detectar fallas en el equipo.

• Tener conocimiento para cortar el cable de perforación, cálculo de las toneladas milla y saber definir los tiempos y longitudes de corte del cable.

• Identificar las condiciones del pozo.

• Conocer los diferentes procedimientos para cerrar el pozo (Blando/Duro).

• Conocer la operación de las unidades de control de pozo (unidad remota, acumulador, super choque).

• Conocer los procedimientos de comunicación y notificación durante eventos de control de pozo.

• Tener habilidad para comunicarse, orientar y guiar efectivamente la cuadrilla de perforación y con los representantes de terceras compañías.

• Tener habilidad para delegar funciones y supervisarlas permanentemente.

• Tener habilidad para entender y seguir correctamente las órdenes y procedimientos.

• Conocer todos los requerimientos de HSE de la compañía y de la industria.

• Elaborar reportes según IADC. (kill sheet, trip sheet).

Thank you for your interest in joining our team!

postings.title: Operador de Producción
postings.descriptionText:
Job Summary

¿Te gustaría ser parte de un equipo de manufactura donde tu trabajo contribuya directamente a la calidad y seguridad de nuestros productos?

IFF es líder global en sabores, fragancias, ingredientes alimentarios y salud y biociencias. Ofrecemos innovaciones sustentables que mejoran los productos de uso cotidiano.

Buscamos personas para sumarse a nuestro equipo de Manufactura y participar en la elaboración de productos líquidos y mezclas de polvos, de manera eventual por cuatro meses, en Garin, Buenos Aires .

Serás parte de un equipo colaborativo, comprometido y orientado a soluciones , donde el trabajo conjunto es clave para cumplir con nuestro programa de producción, nuestros estándares de calidad e inocuidad y las necesidades de nuestros clientes.

Donde marcarás la diferencia

• Realizarás tareas operativas asociadas a la manufactura de productos líquidos o mezclas de polvos, incluyendo provisión, traslado, manipulación e identificación de materiales según cada etapa del proceso productivo.

• Verificarás la disponibilidad de los materiales necesarios y los trasladarás desde y hacia Depósito o entre las distintas etapas de fabricación, informando oportunamente cualquier desvío.

• Realizarás tareas de dosificación, pesado y trasvase siguiendo las fórmulas, órdenes e instrucciones de producción. Según el sector asignado, también podrás participar en procesos de mezclado, envasado y reproceso.

• Asegurarás la correcta identificación, lote y trazabilidad de los materiales utilizados en cada fabricación, respetando su estado de uso o aprobación y las ubicaciones definidas para cada instancia del proceso.

• Realizarás la limpieza de equipos, instalaciones y utensilios correspondientes a las tareas de manufactura, cumpliendo con los procedimientos establecidos, y mantendrás el orden y la limpieza del lugar de trabajo.

• Completarás los registros y controles requeridos e identificarás correctamente los equipos limpios, asegurando el cumplimiento de los procedimientos de trazabilidad e identificación vigentes.

• Realizarás los controles de proceso establecidos, incluidos los relacionados con mantenimiento y calibración de las herramientas y equipos bajo tu responsabilidad.

• Monitorearás los Programas de Prerrequisitos Operativos (PPRo) correspondientes al sector y cumplirás con los estándares definidos de buenas prácticas de manufactura, calidad e inocuidad alimentaria.

• Cumplirás con las políticas, procedimientos y estándares de Medio Ambiente, Salud y Seguridad (EHS), incluyendo el uso adecuado de elementos de protección personal, la gestión de residuos y el reporte de incidentes, actos o condiciones inseguras.

Lo que te hace la persona indicada

• Estudios secundarios completos.

• Experiencia en áreas de manufactura dentro de la industria alimentaria o industrias con procesos productivos similares.

• Disponibilidad full time para trabajar en turnos rotativos.

• Capacidad para seguir fórmulas, órdenes, instrucciones y procedimientos establecidos de producción, seguridad, calidad e inocuidad.

• Compromiso con las buenas prácticas de manufactura, la trazabilidad, el orden y la seguridad en el trabajo.

• Responsabilidad y capacidad de adaptación frente a cambios en las necesidades de producción.

Cómo podrías destacarte

• Experiencia previa en procesos de dosificación, pesado, mezclado, envasado o trasvase dentro de entornos productivos.

• Conocimientos de informática y experiencia como persona usuaria de SAP.

• Capacidad para resolver problemas de manera práctica, trabajar en equipo y mantener el foco en la calidad, seguridad y cumplimiento de procedimientos.

¿Por qué elegir IFF?

• Tendrás la oportunidad de adquirir experiencia en un entorno industrial vinculado con la manufactura de productos e ingredientes.

• Formarás parte de un equipo donde la colaboración es fundamental para alcanzar los objetivos de producción.

• Trabajarás bajo estándares definidos de seguridad, calidad e inocuidad alimentaria.

• Podrás aplicar y desarrollar conocimientos en procesos productivos, trazabilidad y buenas prácticas de manufactura.

• Te sumarás a una compañía global que pone foco en calidad, seguridad, eficiencia y sustentabilidad a lo largo de su cadena de valor.

We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. At IFF, we believe that your uniqueness unleashes our potential. We value the diverse mosaic of the ethnicity, national origin, race, age, sex, or veteran status. We strive for an inclusive workplace that allows each of our colleagues to bring their authentic self to work regardless of their religion, gender identity & expression, sexual orientation, or disability.

Visit IFF.com/careers/workplace-diversity-and-inclusion to learn more

¿Qué buscamos?



Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Analista personas y cultura para acompañar de manera cercana al personal operativo, promoviendo su desarrollo, empleabilidad, movilidad y experiencia laboral.

• Alta capacidad de escucha, empatía y construcción de relaciones interpersonales.

Formación académica:



Profesionales graduados/as de las carreras de Recursos Humanos, Relaciones Laborales, Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería Industrial o afines. Se valorarán perfiles con formación jurídica que cuenten con una marcada orientación a la gestión de personas y al trabajo en campo.




Experiencia requerida:



Contar con 5 años de experiencia en posiciones generalistas de Recursos Humanos, Desarrollo Organizacional, Gestión del Talento, Relaciones Laborales o roles similares en compañías con dotaciones operativas relevantes.

Se valorará experiencia en empresas de servicios o industrias intensivas en operación, tales como Oil & Gas, energía, construcción o servicios industriales.

¿Qué buscamos?

• Revisar y dar seguimiento a los indicadores de desempeño definidos para los procesos y mejoras


• Brindar feedback estructurado a los equipos y líderes del negocio sobre prácticas, comportamientos y desvíos observados.

• Paquete Office

¿Qué buscamos?

¿Cuál será tu misión?

Diseñar, implementar y mantener actualizadas las políticas, normas y procesos corporativos de Seguridad alineados a la legislación vigente y mejores prácticas globales, asegurando una cultura organizacional centrada en la prevención y control de riesgos. Desde la detección de los peligros hasta la aplicación de medidas de control e identificación de acciones de mejora y lecciones aprendidas. Diseñar, implementar y mantener actualizados los procesos, normas y herramientas corporativas de Higiene Industrial, alineados a la legislación vigente y mejores prácticas del sector, promoviendo una cultura organizacional centrada en la anticipación, prevención y control de exposiciones ocupacionales.





¿Cuáles serán tus principales tareas?

• Liderar y participar activamente en el proceso de gestión de cambios evaluando impactos sobre seguridad operativa, Para asegurar que los nuevos diseños, procedimientos o instalaciones no introduzcan riesgos no controlados.


• Diseñar y proponer la implementación y efectividad de controles críticos (reglas de oro) Para garantizar su confiabilidad y desempeño ante escenarios de riesgo operacional.


• Liderar y desarrollar investigaciones de consecuencias muy serias , aplicando metodologia de causales estructuradas para identificar causas sistémicas, establecer acciones efectivas y prevenir recurrencias organizacionales.


• Definir matriz de requimientos legal para garantizar el cumplimiento de la normativa e implementación operativa.


• Definir y desplegar verificaciones de los sistemas de gestión de contratistas con los estándares internos de seguridad, Para asegurar el desempeño seguro de terceros alineado al modelo operativo de la empresa.


• Coordinar la relación técnica con auditores internos y externos, definiendo alcance y facilitando documentación previa para garantizar transparencia, cumplimiento normativo y preparación estratégica de la organización.


• Definir los modelos de visualización, desarrollar tableros de indicadores de desempeño de seguridad e interpretar fallas y cumplimiento ejecutivos, utilizando herramientas digitales y analítica para facilitar decisiones informadas, anticipar desvíos y dar soporte a la mejora continua.


• Desplegar el proceso de elaboración necesidades/pliego técnico, análisis ofertas, gestión de Contratación e inspección, certificación y control presupuestario de los servicios de seguridad.


• Representar a la organización en foros técnicos y colaborar con entes reguladores, para alinear criterios, brindar soporte experto y garantizar la coherencia del modelo de seguridad global.





¿Qué valoramos como diferencial?

Formación Académica: Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería Química, Ingeniería en Petróleo, Ingeniería en Seguridad e Higiene, Licenciatura en Higiene y Seguridad o carreras afines.

postings.descriptionText:
IAM Secure Access Engineer
Today’s world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of professionals who collaborate to support the business by protecting information assets. Our Information Security professionals enable the organization to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and respond to security events as they happen.
Within Information Security, we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions across the security lifecycle. You will join a team of security-focused professionals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative and secure solutions that provide business value.
The opportunity
As part of the Identity and Access Management organization, the IAM Secure Access Engineer will design, configure, test and implement authentication, federation and authorization capabilities across enterprise, cloud and hybrid environments.
The role combines traditional IAM engineering fundamentals with delivery of new Secure Access initiatives across Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, PingID, PingFederate, PingAccess, Okta, PlainID, multifactor authentication, passwordless authentication, workload identities, token protection and secrets or certificate-based authentication.
The engineer will work with Architecture, Product, Operations, application teams and vendors to translate requirements into secure, supportable solutions and move changes through design, build, test, production deployment and operational handover.
Your key responsibilities
Authentication, Federation & Access Engineering
• Design, configure and support authentication and federation integrations using SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and related standards.
• Implement and maintain MFA, single sign-on, passwordless authentication and risk-based access controls.
• Configure and troubleshoot PingID, PingFederate, PingAccess, Okta and Microsoft Entra ID integrations.
• Support onboarding and migration of applications to modern authentication patterns.
• Analyze authentication failures, policy conflicts, token issues and user access problems across integrated platforms.
Conditional Access & Identity Protection
• Implement and enhance Microsoft Entra Conditional Access policies, authentication strengths, authentication contexts and protected actions.
• Support Continuous Access Evaluation, token protection, sign-in risk controls and secure administrative access patterns.
• Assess policy impact, exclusions, break-glass requirements and deployment risks before production release.
• Use logs and platform telemetry to validate control effectiveness and investigate access issues.
Authorization, Workload Identity & Secrets
• Implement policy-based authorization using PlainID or comparable authorization platforms.
• Support role-based, attribute-based and policy-based access control patterns.
• Improve security for service principals, managed identities, application identities and other non-human identities.
• Support migration from shared secrets to managed identity, certificates or approved vault-based patterns.

postings.title: Satellite Systems Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Area

Satellite Systems Engineer

About Satellogic

Satellogic is a vertically integrated Earth Observation company that designs, manufactures, and operates satellite systems, delivering decision-grade insights at scale to government and commercial customers.

We build space systems end-to-end, from satellite design and manufacturing to launch and on-orbit operations, giving us the ability to deploy quickly, operate reliably, and support persistent monitoring across regions and priority areas. Our approach moves customers beyond one-off imagery toward continuous awareness and alert-driven decision-making, with flexible pathways that can evolve from managed monitoring to full satellite ownership and sovereign control.

Our technology supports a wide range of use cases across climate monitoring, agriculture, energy, infrastructure, defense and intelligence, helping organizations detect change, manage risk, and plan with confidence.

With a team distributed across five countries, Satellogic brings together expertise in satellite engineering, software development, data science, manufacturing, operations, and go-to-market. We’re a group of purpose-driven builders who value ownership, curiosity, and execution—and who work with humility, honesty, and empathy.

About the team

The Satellite Program Team is a cross-functional organization that manages the strategic deployment and continuous evolution of our entire satellite fleet.

Our mission is to drive the full end-to-end mission lifecycle, from setting high-level strategic objectives and negotiating overall system requirements to overseeing long-term on-orbit performance and capacity goals. This team serves as the central function for balancing constraints across R&D, Manufacturing, and Operations.

The team is always learning and trying to push the limits, relying in part on the large diversity of people’s profiles and backgrounds.

About the position

As a Satellite Systems Engineer, you will take on a highly technical, hybrid mission that sits at the intersection of robust hardware design and agile software architecture. This is not your traditional, paper-pushing systems engineering role.

You are responsible for a twofold challenge:

• Optimize & Protect: Dive deep into the current generation of satellites, resolving complex technical anomalies on orbit.

• Architect the Future: Spearhead the system architecture for our next generation of spacecraft.

Based on your previous experience, you will be the ultimate technical "bridge," ensuring that low-level engineering details across software, electronics, and mechanics are scalable, robust, and perfectly aligned with our mission.

Location

Buenos Aires office.

Willingness and ability to travel domestically and/or internationally to company offices, laboratories, client sites, potential clients, or suppliers as needed. This role will also require travel to our laboratory in Uruguay.

Responsibilities

• Maintain and optimize system-level budgets, including Mass, Power, Propulsion, Link Budget, Data Latency, Pointing Performance, Agility, Image Quality, and Edge Processing Capacity, ensuring optimal balance between performance and risk.

• Co-define and design the systems architecture for future satellite constellations.

• Oversee system-level integration, verification, and validation (IV&V) activities from conceptual design through to on-orbit commissioning.

• Interpret and define mission specific and spacecraft system level requirements based on the Concept of Operations (CONOPS).

• Identify and resolve technical gaps and critical points in the current satellite generation, managing anomaly resolution and ensuring "lessons learned" are effectively integrated into the next designs.

• Serve as the primary technical interface for R&D teams (Software, Electronics, Mechanics), translating high-level operational requirements into granular technical specifications, APIs, and hardware-software interfaces.

About you

Experience

• BSc or Master’s degree in Aerospace, Electrical, or Software Engineering, or equivalent work experience.

• 5+ years of relevant experience in aerospace systems engineering, with a proven track record of participating in the full missions lifecycle.

• Demonstrated ability to navigate seamlessly between hardware block diagrams and complex software/firmware architectures.

• Deep expertise in trade-off analysis and systems engineering methodologies (e.g., V-model or MBSE).

Skills

• Strong systems thinking: understanding trade-offs, basic engineering, and budgets.

• Problem solving: Ability to analyze problems and search for solutions, always exploring multiple alternatives.

• Organization: Excellent people, time, and risk management skills.

• Capacity to learn continuously and passion for pushing the limits.

• Advanced English and Spanish proficiency levels (verbal and written at all hierarchical levels).

What we value

• Empathy, initiative, and accountability.

• Hands-on attitude and passion for building scalable space technology.

Diversity Commitment

Satellogic values diversity and inclusion and is an equal opportunity employer. We are convinced that hiring and developing top talent from around the world for any given discipline will drive innovation, generate new solutions, and deliver a superior product to our global customer base. We work to build an equitable and inclusive environment in which all people, regardless of gender, race, religion, or background, can come together to do their best work.

Please feel free to specify your pronouns following your name on the application.

Learn more about Satellogic

To learn more about us please visit satellogic.com and follow us on twitter (@Satellogic) and LinkedIn

Applicant Data Privacy Statement

As part of your application you will be required to confirm Satellogic's Applicant Data Privacy Policy which is available for your review here.

By applying to this position you express, affirmative consent to our collection of your name, address, email address, phone number and relevant application information and the processing of that information. It is important to understand that Satellogic will store your data for the purpose of processing your application for the position, and possibly other compatible positions. You also understand that you have rights to access your Personal Data, as well as rights to request their rectification, completion, update or erasure. You may exercise your rights by sending an email to compliance@satellogic.com.

Consenting to our Applicant Data Privacy Policy is required in order for Satellogic to process your employment application.

postings.title: Sr AI Engineer (Backend & Platform)
postings.descriptionText:
Arionkoder is an AI consulting firm helping companies build, embed, and own AI systems that drive real business outcomes. We combine Product Development, Artificial Intelligence, and Team Augmentation to craft digital products and solutions that create lasting impact — guided by a human-centric approach and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of what technology can do.

We’re hiring a contract AI engineer with a backend or full stack background who builds, deploys and operates AI agents in production, using leading-edge agentic development practice to ship quickly. Our client builds AI agents and products for the trucking and fleet compliance space, used by both its customers and its internal teams. Agents work across tolling and millions of compliance documents, on top of more than 10 years of toll, inspection, safety and vehicle data. What you ship affects revenue, safety and compliance directly.

Responsibilities:

• Design, build and deploy AI agents end to end, from first spec to production.

• Ship early and iterate on feedback from real users.

• Work with product, support and engineering stakeholders to turn loose problems into clear requirements.

• Own the infrastructure and delivery path of the agents you build: infrastructure as code, CI/CD and deployment.

• Own what you ship once it’s live: monitoring, evals, cost and failure handling.

• Help the team move faster by bringing in and spreading best practices in agentic engineering.

How you’ll work:

• Use coding agents as your main way of building software: define the work, check what agents produce and make the calls that matter.

• Break work into pieces an agent can finish and you can verify, and run several agents in parallel.

• Rely on tests, CI and agent review so speed doesn’t cost quality.

• When something goes wrong, improve your setup so it doesn’t happen again, and package what works as reusable skills for the team.

Requirements:

• Backend or full stack engineering background, with recent hands-on AI engineering experience.

• A track record of shipping agents and AI features to production, with users who rely on them today.

• You own the full path to production yourself: infrastructure as code (Terraform), CI/CD, deployment and monitoring.

• Cloud experience in AWS and/or Azure, including container orchestrators (Kubernetes or ECS/Azure .

• You use evals and data to decide when an agent is ready to ship and to measure whether it’s succeeding once live.

• Strong Python or TypeScript, with experience building with LLM APIs and MCP.

• Experience with agent frameworks or SDKs, and knowing when not to use one.

• You already use coding agents as your main way of building software.

• You work independently, gather requirements from non-engineering stakeholders and give specific answers. When you don’t know something, you say so.

• Advanced English, written and oral.

Nice to have:

• Frontend experience on existing production platforms.

• Databricks.

• LLM observability and eval tools.

• Background in logistics, transportation or compliance.

Notes:

Interviews are hands-on: expect to walk through something you’ve built and shipped, in detail.

Remote, LATAM · Overlap with 9am–5pm US Eastern
Perks

💵 Monthly USD Service Fee
🌴 20 business days of paid Agreed Time Off—Annual + 6 Local Holidays
🐣Caregiver Time Off
💻 A dynamic remote work culture. You can work from anywhere!
🚀An entrepreneurial environment.

About us
In 2010, our founders dreamed up a company that could positively impact the world. Since then, we've been in permanent evolution: from business consulting to innovation and design, and now to building amazing digital products powered by AI. We scaled globally, launched AI Labs and Reshape Studios, and claimed our space as an AI consulting firm — helping organizations move from pilots to production through accountable AI. Today, we're expanding our impact across industries, driving real AI adoption through accountability, governance, and value at scale. Dreamers first, builders always.

What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

How You'll Make an Impact:

As the Head of Global Customer Support , you will lead our global support organization and own the experience hoteliers have when they need us most. This is a builder's role at a pivotal moment. We are transforming reactive support into proactive partnership, combining AI at scale with the empathy of true hospitality. You will be accountable for the health of the queue, the quality of every answer, and the wellbeing of the people who deliver it — raising first contact resolution and driving down resolution times while keeping the customer experience human. You'll bring the operating discipline of a large-scale contact center (workforce planning, queue health, quality, and data) and pair it with an AI platform that already touches nearly every ticket we receive.

Our Customer Support Team:

Forget the stuffy corporate office. We are a completely remote global team of innovators and hospitality experts. The support organization spans roughly 130 coaches and advanced support specialists across LATAM, EMEA, and APAC, organized into teams led by experienced leads and senior leads. We are our clients' secret weapon and trusted advisor, and we are rebuilding how support works from the ground up.

What You Bring to the Team:

• Built and scaled high-volume contact center or support operations across phone, chat, email, and messaging

• Led large support organizations serving both SMB and mid-market/enterprise customers, with different service models for each

• Ran multi-region, multi-time-zone, fully remote teams with full accountability for first contact resolution, response and resolution times, CSAT, and retention

• Supported a complex operational software product (ERP, PMS, POS, payments, or similar) where downtime costs the customer real money

• Deployed AI and automation at scale in a support operation, with strong instincts for where it helps the customer and where it gets in the way

• Lead other leaders with empathy and accountability, and rebuild team health after periods of high pressure

• Run the operation on data: you know your numbers, find root causes, and prove a fix before scaling it

What Sets You Up for Success:

• 8+ years in customer support or service, including at least 4 years leading teams with experience leading other leaders

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in hospitality, business, or technology

• Experience scaling a high-volume support function through significant change or transformation

• Excellent crisis management and escalation handling with confident cross-functional alignment across Product, Onboarding, and Account Management

• A bias toward fixing root causes — you challenge process that creates unnecessary work and prove a fix by hand before automating it

• Experience leading distributed teams across multiple regions, languages, and cultures

• Hands-on experience with workforce management, capacity planning, and QA programs in a contact center environment

Bonus Skills to Stand Out :

• Senior leadership experience managing managers across multiple regions

• Advanced degree in Hospitality or Business

• Experience standing up a customer recovery or save motion for at-risk accounts

• Hospitality or hospitality-technology experience (property operations, distribution, PMS)

Compensation: Depending on your skills and experience, you can expect your annual compensation to be between $160,000 and $220,000 USD. Please note that we maintain high flexibility, and packages above this range will be considered. (The salary is only for US-based candidates).

We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. postings.title: Customer Experience Manager, Contractor Management
postings.descriptionText:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

Role Summary

Location: Buenos Aires, Argentina

Hybrid

Full-Time

About the Skuad Acquisition

Back in August 2024, Payoneer acquired Skuad. Skuad's expertise helps businesses in over 160 countries navigate complex challenges such as international payroll, remote onboarding, and regulatory compliance. This acquisition reinforces Payoneer's mission and solidifies Skuad's role as a trusted partner for global workforce management (WFM).

This role will be part of our WFM business unit.

Role Summary

Embark on a journey to redefine B2B customer delight! We’re on the lookout for passionate individuals as Customer Champions who will orchestrate a symphony of satisfaction, turning each client interaction into a masterpiece of excellence. If you’re excited about crafting unforgettable experiences, let’s drive the future of customer enchantment together!

Customer Experience Ownership

• Own the end-to-end experience for Contractor Management (CMS) clients across Latin America and North America.

• Map and improve the CMS journey, from client setup to contractor onboarding to first payment to recurring payouts, and remove friction at each stage.

• Be the trusted contact for client , Finance and Operations teams managing contractors on the platform.

• Contractor Onboarding & Payments

• Lead contractor onboarding from setup and documentation, including contractor agreements and local tax IDs such as CUIT, RFC, CPF/CNPJ and NIT, through first payment.

• Coordinate with Payments and Finance on contractor invoicing and payouts against due dates, and flag risks to clients early.

• Act as the single point of contact for contractor payment issues, owning investigations, resolutions and status updates.

• Guide clients and contractors through local payout methods and FX considerations across Argentina, Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Chile and the wider region.

Escalations & Issue Resolution

• Own CMS escalations from intake to resolution, with clear ownership and timely updates.

• Partner with Product and Engineering to triage CMS platform issues, and communicate fixes back to clients.

• Spot recurring contractor onboarding and payout issues, and drive root-cause fixes with internal teams.

Experience Metrics & Insights

• Track and improve CSAT, NPS, first-response and resolution times, contractor time-to-first-payment and payout success rate.

• Gather client and contractor feedback and turn it into CMS product and process improvements.

• Build CMS help content, playbooks and FAQs in Spanish and Portuguese for clients and contractors.

Retention & Growth Support

• Monitor CMS account health and flag churn risk early.

• Work with Account Management on renewals and on growing contractor volume and country coverage within CMS.

Who you are

• 5–6 years in Customer Experience, Customer Success or Account Management, ideally in contractor management, B2B SaaS payments or workforce platforms.

• Hands-on experience in a payments company or payments operations team.

• Strong knowledge of LATAM payment rails and methods, such as PIX, SPEI, CBU/CVU transfers, PSE and local wallets, alongside ACH and wire.

• Working knowledge of cross-border contractor payments: FX, correspondent banking, KYC/AML, settlement timelines and common causes of delays or failures.

• Understanding of FX volatility and currency controls in markets like Argentina, and how they affect contractor payouts.

• Solid grasp of contractor management: contractor agreements, invoicing, tax documentation and misclassification risk.

• Calm, structured approach to escalations, with a strong sense of ownership.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration with Payments, Finance, Product and Engineering.

• Fluent in Spanish and English. Portuguese is a strong plus.

• Comfortable working across Americas time zones, with some overlap with global teams.

#LI-Hybrid

Act as our customer’s partner on the inside
Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.

Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.

Continuously improve
Always striving for a higher standard than our last.

Build each other up
Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.

postings.title: Business Development Manager - Consumer Health
postings.descriptionText:
Desde la Unidad de Negocios de Consumo Masivo de Newsan que lidera las marcas Pampers, Pantene, Head & Shoulders, Gillette, Always, Downy, Vick y Cebión, llevamos adelante la búsqueda de una persona para ocupar el rol de Business Development Manager - Consumer Health

Tu objetivo sera liderár la expansión de la vertical Salud (PHC) mediante estrategias de crecimiento inorgánico (adquisiciones, licencias y alianzas) y la gestión comercial de las nuevas marcas. En un rol stand-alone , gestionarás los proyectos end-to-end —desde la prospección, el armado del business case y la defensa ante el Directorio, hasta la negociación e implementación del go-to-market durante los primeros 6 a 12 meses— coordinando a las áreas internas y asesores externos hasta transferir la operación a la estructura BAU

Tus principales desafíos y responsabilidades serán :

• Originación y pipeline de oportunidades: Buscar y priorizar activamente oportunidades en la vertical salud (OTC, consumer health y suplementos): laboratorios y marcas locales, marcas que multinacionales deban desinvertir a raíz de M&A globales o carve-outs de portafolio no core, marcas internacionales sin presencia o con baja presencia local, y empresas a las que Newsan pueda ofrecer servicios comerciales. Construir y mantener el pipeline y una red de contactos con bancos de inversión locales y europeos, asesores, dueños de compañías y casas matrices.

• Evaluación y business case: Liderar el screening y el armado del business case integral de cada oportunidad: dimensionamiento de mercado y categoría (IQVIA, Nielsen), evaluación de la marca (posicionamiento, equity, potencial de crecimiento y encaje en el portafolio), modelo comercial (canales, pricing, sell-out), modelo financiero y valuación (DCF, múltiplos, comparables), sinergias con la estructura comercial existente, y factibilidad regulatoria (ANMAT, transferencia de registros, plazos), operativa y de supply, consolidando los inputs de todas las áreas.

• Ejecución de transacciones y acuerdos: Coordinar los procesos de due diligence financiero, legal, regulatorio y operativo con las áreas internas y los asesores externos; participar en la estructuración y negociación de términos (LOI, SPA, contratos de licencia, distribución o representación, acuerdos de servicios comerciales).

• Estrategia de marca y go-to-market: Liderar, con Marketing y Ventas, la definición del posicionamiento, la arquitectura de portafolio y el plan de lanzamiento o relanzamiento de cada marca incorporada, y el modelo comercial (canales, cobertura en farmacias y cadenas, pricing, trade).

• Presentación al Comité de Dirección / Directorio: Elaborar y presentar memorandos de inversión y recomendaciones con criterios de decisión, escenarios y riesgos. Proponer y consolidar el marco de criterios de inversión del área (ticket, retorno, payback) y el reporte periódico del pipeline.

• Gestión de proyecto e implementación (PM): Diseñar y gestionar el plan de cada proyecto (hitos, responsables, riesgos, presupuesto). Liderar la implementación durante los primeros 6 a 12 meses (integración, lanzamiento de marca o arranque del servicio), medir resultados comerciales y financieros contra el business case y transferir a la estructura BAU con KPIs definidos.

• Articulación interárea y gestión de terceros: Actuar como nexo entre Finanzas, Legales, Asuntos Regulatorios, Comercial / Ventas, Marketing, Supply Chain, Operaciones, RRHH y Sistemas para obtener inputs y alinear prioridades sin autoridad formal. Definir alcance, contratar y coordinar asesores externos (M&A, auditoría, legal, regulatorio).

•
Graduado/a en Administración, Economía, Ing. Industrial, Marketing o afines

•
Mercado & Negocio: Experiencia en la industria farmacéutica, OTC y consumo masivo en Argentina (canales farmacias, droguerías, retail y e-commerce), con fuerte foco en Brand Management (posicionamiento, portafolio y KPIs de marca). (Deseable)

•
M&A y Legales: Manejo de estructuras de transacciones ( asset/share deal , LOI, SPA, licencias y distribución) y marco regulatorio ANMAT (registros de OTC, suplementos, cosmética y publicidad).

•
Finanzas Corporativas: Valuación (DCF, múltiplos), confección de business cases , análisis de P&L, pricing , sensibilidades y lectura de estados contables ( due diligence ).

•
Herramientas: Excel avanzado (modelado financiero), PowerPoint ejecutivo, plataformas de gestión (MS Project, Asana o similares), BI (Power BI/Tableau), auditorías de mercado (IQVIA, Nielsen; deseable Capital IQ) e IA aplicada al análisis.

postings.title: Marketing Team Lead
postings.descriptionText:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators. They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories, and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities, and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

Marketers at Canonical don’t just promote open source; they amplify it, ensuring our innovations reach the right people, at the right time, with clarity and purpose from developers to decision makers.

As an experienced marketer at Canonical, you’ll lead cross-disciplinary teams of product, partner, or sales professionals in your specific area, from establishing priorities and strategies with senior stakeholders to delivering on integrated campaigns. We are looking for both generalists who want to take ownership of a product portfolio or channel, and for specialists who can help the whole team excel in their domain of expertise.

Location: This is a globally remote role; you can be based in EMEA, APAC, or the Americas, depending on the team’s location.

The role entails

You will take ownership of one of our core marketing tracks and lead both strategy and execution. You’ll ensure campaigns land, launches succeed, and adoption grows, while contributing to the broader go-to-market engine.

You will:

• Lead GTM strategy and campaign execution in your functional area

• Align with product, sales, content, and partner teams to deliver integrated plans

• Shape messaging, positioning, and assets that resonate with customers

• Design and run experiments to test your hypothesis

• Drive major launches, marketing initiatives, and growth programs

• Run reviews and retrospectives to improve performance and impact

• Mentor colleagues, strengthen the function, and set high standards for delivery

What we are looking for in you

• Strong written and verbal communication in English

• Exceptional academic track record from high school and university

• Proven experience in B2B marketing, ideally in software, SaaS, or open source

• Strong track record shaping go-to-market strategy, messaging, and campaigns that move the pipeline

• Fast adaptation to change and new technology adoption in marketing

• A leader, growing and elevating others across the organization

• A solid eye for ROI and effective budget management

• Ability to influence and align stakeholders across the organization

• Excellent communication and storytelling skills for technical solutions

• Skilled at managing complex projects and leading cross-functional teams

• Comfortable using data to evaluate campaigns and refine strategy

• Proactive, outcome-driven, and confident, operating independently at a global scale

Nice-to-have skills

• Background in sales-led or ecosystem growth

• Familiarity with ABM (Account-Based Marketing) approaches

• Experience leading go-to-market efforts across a large product portfolio

• Experience managing budgets, agencies, or external vendors

• Understanding of open source communities and business models

• Experience mentoring or leading junior marketers

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilization. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.
In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.

Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!

Personal learning and development budget of 2,000 USD per annum

Annual compensation review

Recognition rewards

Annual holiday leave

Parental Leave

‍Employee Assistance Programme

Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

postings.title: IT Operations Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Who are we?

At UpGuard , we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

Where does this role fit in?

•
Build, operate and continually improve the technology platform that lets every UpGuardian work securely, efficiently and with minimal friction.

•
You’ll own the lifecycle of our corporate technology end to end: identity, endpoints, SaaS and the service practices that hold them together. You’ll automate the repetitive parts, instrument the rest, and make security a property of how systems are built rather than a task someone remembers to do.

•
This is an engineering role, not a ticket queue. If you see the same request three times and your first thought is “why is a human still doing this?” - you’ll fit.

•
Security is an outcome of excellent operational engineering here, not the primary function of the role.

What will you do?

Platform, identity and fleet

•
Google Workspace, Okta (or equivalent IdP), and MDM (Kandji, Jamf or similar) across a mostly macOS and ChromeOS fleet

•
You’ll own SaaS administration and lifecycle, asset management, endpoint standards and compliance, and the joiner–mover–leaver process end to end

Zero Trust and secure access

•
Operate and continually improve our Cloudflare Zero Trust environment across ZTNA, Secure Web Gateway, DNS filtering, tunnels and identity and device aware access policies

•
You’ll help move us away from traditional network trust, maintain secure access to internal applications and services, troubleshoot access and connectivity issues, and make sure security controls don’t create unnecessary friction for employees

Automation and internal tooling

•
Automation is the default approach, not a stretch goal. If a task happens more than twice, it’s a candidate for code

•
You’ll work with REST APIs, Python, Apps Script, Terraform, n8n and AI assisted workflows to build internal tooling that removes work rather than making it faster to do by hand

Service operations

•
Incident, problem and change management. Service catalogue, knowledge base, service metrics, capacity planning and operational readiness

•
You’ll define these practices where they don’t exist yet and improve the ones that do

Reliability and continuous improvement

•
Zero touch provisioning, endpoint compliance, fleet health, monitoring, reporting, SaaS governance and self service. Making internal platforms boringly reliable is the goal

Security, embedded

•
Deploy and maintain security controls, harden endpoints, support security incidents, reduce operational risk and keep baselines current

•
Security is part of how you’ll operate the platform rather than a separate function you’ll own

What will you bring?

You won’t have all of this. Tell us which parts you’d be learning, and we’ll tell you honestly whether that works

•

Testlio’s fully managed crowdsourced testing platform, powered by our proprietary intelligence technology – LeoAI EngineTM, integrates expert, on-demand testers directly into your release process. This job post is to keep in touch for future contract roles with Testlio. If you would like to freelance test with us you can learn more and sign up here .

About this job post:

This job post is for future opportunities . If there isn’t an active opening that fits your skill set or location, you can still express interest in future roles with Testlio. Our Talent Acquisition team will keep your information on file and reach out if a suitable opportunity becomes available.

Typical Project Details:

• Project Focus : You will be a Software Quality Assurance Analyst following Agile methodologies, mostly focused on API testing.

• Project Duration : Contracts can be temporary, ranging from 6 months to 1 year, or ongoing. Many temporary projects extend beyond their initial term, and some evolve into ongoing contractor opportunities.

• Location : This job ad is open to candidates in select countries who are comfortable working in a fully remote setup. Countries we are considering consist of Argentina, Brazil, Canada, the Czech Republic, Estonia, India, Ireland, Mexico, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Spain, Ukraine, the United Kingdom, or the United States.

• Schedule : Opportunities are available for both part-time and full-time contracts. Working hours generally follow day or afternoon schedules based on your regional time zone.

• Timezone : While we support flexible work, most roles align with standard daytime hours in their region (e.g., 9 AM–6 PM). For instance, this may mean Central Standard Time (CST) in the Americas or Central European Time (CET) in EMEA. Please ensure your availability aligns with your region’s core hours.

• Required Devices : You must have access to an Android or iOS mobile device for testing.

• Internet Connection : A reliable, high-speed internet connection is required for testing and team communications. Mobile hotspots and other unstable or limited connections are not suitable.

What Your Day Looks Like

• Design and execute smoke, scripted, and exploratory test cases on mobile, web and desktop.

• Conduct functional, localization, regression, and payments testing to ensure software meets quality standards.

• Report, reproduce, and track issues found during testing.

• Document and share test results, including bugs and potential risks.

• Analyze test results, logs, and related data to identify patterns, trends, and areas for improvement.

• Collaborate with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to align on goals, timelines, and deliverables.

• Communicate test progress, issues, and risks clearly and proactively with stakeholders.

• Generate test reports that provide actionable insights.

• Design and execute API tests using tools like Postman, SoapUI, or similar.

• Create, maintain, and review test cases and test suites aligned with business priorities and industry best practices.

• Design and optimize effective test data.

• Ensure the test library remains relevant by refactoring, updating, and deprecating tests as needed.

• Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the systems under test.

• Stay up to date with trends and advancements in software testing tools and methodologies.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

Technical Skills:

• Proven experience (2+ years) as a QA Analyst or similar role, with a strong understanding of software testing principles, methodologies, and tools (such as JIRA, Bugzilla, TestRail, Xray or similar.)

• Experience with mobile and web applications, frontend and backend testing (including API testing.)

• Proficiency in identifying and documenting software bugs and issues.

• Ability to solve technical tasks required during testing - such as test data generation, log capturing and basic analysis, working with browser developer tools, network logs analyzers, etc.

• Experience in working in agile teams in a remote environment - proven track record of communication and collaboration with different stakeholders such as Scrum Masters, Product Owners and others.

• Good knowledge of SDLC, CI/CD, and DevOps, as well as an understanding of test automation principles in effective SDLC.

Human Skills:

• Effective English communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate and work effectively in a team environment.

• Drive to learn quickly and continuously expand knowledge.

• Comfortable with a frequently changing environment and able to adapt fast.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Strong attention to detail and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks.

What is the Consideration Process

Whenever a new opportunity arises, the Talent Acquisition team will review applicants and reach out to begin learning more. If you are a potential match, the recruiter will reach out to give you more details about the role and begin your application process

Diversity and Inclusion

Testlio is an equal-opportunity employer deeply committed to creating an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and identities. We are female-founded, and 46% of our team members identify as women. See the DEI section of our website for more information.
