postings.title: Staff Software Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 40,000 students from 1,000+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We've spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world.

We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work.

We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0-to-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it.

About the Role

Location: Remote, United States, Europe, Canada or LATAM

Role-Type: Full-Time

Reports To: VP of Engineering

Compensation: $170,000 to $190,000 per year for US based applicants. Adjusted contingent on location for applicants based in Canada, LATAM, and Europe.

CodePath’s educational programs run on our sophisticated learning platform, a set of Ruby-based applications with functionality spanning admissions, course delivery, grading, career coaching, and reporting.

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer who can lead at multiple levels at once: the architecture, the product direction, the team's capacity, and the longer arc of where we're going. You'll move fluidly across the full technical stack, from infrastructure decisions to greenfield product work.

This is a high-ownership role. You'll work directly with stakeholders to understand what students and staff actually need, participate in deciding what gets built, and then lead the execution. You won't be handed a ticket queue. You'll shape the work.

The ideal candidate for this role is a web engineer inspired by potential projects like these:

•
Building brand-new functionality in Rails and beyond to create sophisticated and powerful new tools for our users and extend our reach to new kinds of learners we’ve never been able to serve before

•
Reimagining core platform components as we migrate them from Sinatra to Rails

•
Integrating AI/ML technology into our platform to support mastery-driven, adaptive learning

•
Scaling a system that has helped tens of thousands of students to help hundreds of thousands more

Key Activities

•
Architect and build web applications across Ruby on Rails, Sinatra/Padrino, and Django that directly support our mission

•
Make consequential technical decisions on infrastructure, data modeling, API design, and emerging technologies with full ownership of the tradeoffs

•
Set the code quality bar through reviews, architectural guidance, and constructive feedback

•
Write automated tests that reflect real edge cases, not just coverage targets

•
Identify performance bottlenecks and systemic issues before they become outages

•
Mentor other engineers and raise the technical ceiling of the team

Qualifications

• 10+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 5 years with Ruby on Rails

•
Familiarity with Claude Code or similar development tools and related best practices

•
A systems-thinking orientation: you consider scalability, maintainability, and failure modes before writing a line of code

• Strong PostgreSQL and database design skills, including experience with complex queries, indexing strategies, and schema evolution

•
Reasonable working familiarity with the full web stack, from infrastructure to CSS

•
Demonstrated ability to lead technical decisions in a small, autonomous team environment

•
Strong written and verbal communication. You can explain a technical tradeoff to a non-engineer without losing what actually matters

•
Passion for education and desire to make a positive impact

Nice to haves

•
Familiarity with higher education or edtech

•
Direct experience working with LLMs and generative AI in production

•
Familiarity with Docker, Ansible, and/or Terraform

•
Experience deploying on GCP

Full-Time Employee Benefits:

This is a 100% remote position! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

•
Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program

•
Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection

•
Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2)

•
Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support

•
​​Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt

•
Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings

postings.title: Staff Network Engineer (AI Infrastructure)
postings.descriptionText:
As a Staff Network Engineer at vCluster Labs , you aren't just configuring switches; you are building the automation logic that configures them. AI Clouds run on InfiniBand and high-speed Ethernet fabrics that most teams still wire up by hand, one customer at a time. You will build the automation that turns that fabric into repeatable provisioning logic. You start in a small R&D group alongside our CTO and grow into owning this area as it becomes a core part of our platform.
As a Staff Network Engineer, your role will include:

• Fabric automation: You will design and build the systems that automatically provision and configure NVIDIA switches and InfiniBand fabrics, including integration with NVIDIA UFM. Manual, per-customer switch setup is the thing you are replacing.

• Network config management and sync: You will build the control loop that keeps switch, VLAN, and VXLAN state consistent with what our platform intends, detects drift, and reconciles it safely in production.

• NAT gateway and L4 load balancing: You will build the gateway and load balancing layer that tenant clusters depend on for connectivity, with failover designed in from day one rather than bolted on later.

• Scale and failure engineering: You will define how our network layer behaves at large scale: BGP route table limits, convergence, failover, and what happens when a link, switch, or gateway dies under real AI workloads.

• Customer Zero for AI networking: You will run your automation on real AI Cloud environments, bring back what breaks, and turn hard-won operational lessons into product behavior our customers never have to think about.

• Technical direction: You will help decide what we build versus integrate with partner solutions, write the design and requirements docs, and set the standards for how networking works across vCluster products.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

• You have built network automation, not just operated networks: You have shipped software that configures switches, routers, or load balancers programmatically, ideally as part of a product or internal platform other teams relied on.

• NVIDIA networking experience: Hands-on work with NVIDIA UFM, NVIDIA Spectrum or Quantum switches, Cumulus Linux, or NVUE, including programming against their APIs.

• Deep fabric fundamentals: Strong command of InfiniBand, VLAN, VXLAN and EVPN, and BGP, including how they behave and fail at production scale.

• Production scale scars: You have run networks at real production scale, seen them break, and helped fix the root cause with automation rather than runbooks.

• Software engineering ability: You write production code in Go or Python, use version control and code review as a matter of course, and think of network config as code.

Bonus points for:

• AI networking depth: Experience tuning fabrics for GPU training or inference workloads, such as RoCEv2, congestion control, rail-optimized topologies, or Spectrum-X.

• AI Cloud or hyperscaler background: You helped build network automation at a GPU cloud, hyperscaler, or large CDN.

• Load balancer and gateway internals: Experience building L4 load balancers or NAT gateways, including with eBPF/XDP or DPDK.

• Open source: Contributions to networking or Kubernetes projects such as SONiC, FRRouting, Cilium, or MetalLB.

About vCluster Labs
We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. Your Role:
As a Sr. Sales Engineer for , you will be the go-to product and technical expert for Alpaca 's enterprise partners across. You will bridge technical and business conversations: a customer-facing engineer with strong API knowledge, experience supporting enterprise customers, and collaborating effectively with our global team. You will support enterprise partners and expand our base of enterprise partners, acting as the technical bridge between local partners, vendors, and regulators and Alpaca 's global engineering team.

What you will do:

• Provide technical support and relationship management for existing enterprise customers, acting as a trusted technical advisor throughout the partner lifecycle.

• Partner with the Sales and Solutions teams on pre-sales technical discussions, solution design, and API consultations, and present compelling product and technical use cases to prospective clients.

• Guide new enterprise customers through API integration, implementation, and onboarding.

• Act as the voice of customers by collaborating with Product and Engineering teams to improve localized experiences; translate complex business and technical requirements into clear specifications for Alpaca 's global engineering team.

• Coordinate with local regulators, vendors, and partners, and relay those requirements to global product and engineering.

• Help customers successfully adopt Alpaca 's platform while maintaining a high standard of technical and customer support; travel as needed.

• Stay updated on internal product development timelines and work closely with the product team to test and roll out new features to partners.

What we look for (Must-Haves):

• Experience supporting enterprise / B2B customers in a technical, sales engineering, or solutions engineering role (typically 5+ years), ideally at API or SaaS-first companies.

• Strong understanding of REST APIs, SDKs, and software integration workflows; hands-on experience with APIs, WebSockets, Postman, Grafana, and JSON.

• Able to translate complex technical concepts into simple, understandable terms.

• Self-starter who thrives in a startup environment, manages multiple assignments simultaneously, works independently, and drives projects to completion with close attention to detail.

Who You Might Be (Nice-To-Haves):

• Experience in fintech, capital markets, brokerage, or financial APIs; experience at a Broker-Dealer or securities firms.

• Knowledge of brokerage, post-trade, and settlement operations, as well as regulatory context.

• Closing enterprise deals alongside Account Executives.

• US securities qualifications (e.g., SIE and/or Series 7).

• Familiarity with Metabase.

• Experience working with the FIX protocol.

• Experience working with OpenAPI, ReadMe, and documentation.

• Excited to learn more about the securities industry.

• Spanish or Portuguese

How We Take Care of You:

• Competitive Salary & Stock Options

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

postings.title: Finance Research Expert
postings.descriptionText:
Role Title: Finance Research Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

Opportunity Snapshot
Pay: $30 - $60 per hour
Time per task: around 4 to 8 hours
Location: Remote, worldwide
You’ll need: Hands-on experience reading US SEC filings and familiarity with US GAAP
Your tasks: Write finance research questions with a verified, sourced answer, and check each one against what AI models answer

Scope of Work
You will work on questions about real US public companies. Each question points to information that sits in long filings or IR materials, or that requires comparing several of them to find the right answer.

• Write questions that require finding a specific figure in a 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy statement, earnings release or investor presentation.

• Write questions where two documents show different numbers and the answer depends on knowing which one is correct (for example, original vs. restated figures, or adjusted vs. reported).

• Pay attention to period and document version: the right fiscal year, the right filing, the latest amended version.

• Test each question against current AI models and keep only the ones they answer incorrectly.

• Rewrite questions when the wording allows more than one valid answer.

What we’re looking for
Hands-on work with US filings in one of these backgrounds:

•
Equity research or investment analysis (sell-side or buy-side) covering US companies.

•
Investment banking or corporate development (M&A, equity capital markets), with experience in deal filings, prospectuses, ownership history and subsidiary structures.

•
Credit or restructuring analysis , with experience in credit agreements, bond terms and bankruptcy filings.

•
SEC reporting or audit (Big 4 audit, corporate reporting), with experience in restatements, footnotes and how figures change across filings.

•
Corporate law or due diligence (securities law, KYC, investigations), with experience tracing entities, executives and related parties across records.

You should also be comfortable reading long filings, including footnotes and tables, and have clear written English.

How the selection process works

•
Apply with your resume and a short profile.

•
Complete the finance interview. It is a short conversation about your experience with US filings and financial reporting. You don’t need to prepare or write anything. Finishing it is what moves your application forward.

•
Review. We check your experience against what the project needs.

•
Onboarding and first task. If selected, you get the guidelines and start with an initial task, which is reviewed before you continue.

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

We are seeking an AI Security Engineer to own the technical security controls for how Alpaca uses AI. The scope includes identity for AI agents and automations, security requirements for AI tools and integrations, guardrails, and security logging. You will also assist in developing AI-powered security tooling.

You will keep those controls consistent as AI adoption grows, and you will work with the teams building with AI so security is part of the design.

This role reports to the Enterprise Security Architect and works closely with AI Enablement, Engineering, DevOps, GRC, and the wider Security team.

The Security Team is 100% distributed and remote.

Things You Get To Do:

The core responsibilities of the AI Security Engineer are focused on AI access controls, secure AI platforms, guardrails, visibility into AI usage, and AI-powered security tooling.

AI Identity and Access Controls:

• Agent Identity: Define how AI agents, bots, and automations authenticate, what they can access, and how their actions are attributed and audited.

• Tool Access: Own security requirements for AI tool integrations, including least-privilege access and credential handling.

• AI Assistant Controls: Define and enforce security settings for approved AI tools, including data handling and access policy.

• Least Privilege: Limit each agent and integration to the access it needs, and review that access when the integration changes.

Secure AI Platform, Tooling, and Response:

• Security Requirements: Define security requirements for internal AI applications, including identity, data handling, secrets, and review of new integrations.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

We are seeking an IT Security Engineer to own the security standards and controls that protect Alpaca’s workforce identities, endpoints, and critical business systems. The scope includes identity and access management, single sign-on, privileged access, multi-factor authentication, endpoint security, secure network access, and email security.

You will maintain those standards, measure how the controls are working, and partner with IT, who run devices and day-to-day administration.

This role reports to the Enterprise Security Architect and works closely with IT, DevOps, Engineering, GRC, and the wider Security team.

The Security Team is 100% distributed and remote.

Things You Get To Do:

The core responsibilities of the IT Security Engineer are focused on identity security, endpoint security, email and domain protection, and measurable control enforcement.

Identity and Access Security:

• IAM and SSO Standards: Define and maintain security standards for SSO and conditional access across cloud, SaaS, and internal systems.

• Multi-Factor Authentication: Own multi-factor authentication standards, including phishing-resistant methods, and keep them enforced.

• Privileged Access: Maintain privileged-access standards, approval policies, and periodic access reviews with system owners.

• Joiner, Mover, Leaver: Partner with IT and People teams so access changes are timely, complete, and auditable.

Endpoint, Email, and Domain Security:

• EDR Policy: Own endpoint detection and response policy and tuning, with IT handling deployment.

• Device Posture: Maintain device-posture and secure network access requirements for access to business applications.

• Detection Partnership: Work with Security Operations on identity, endpoint, and email detections and response playbooks.

• Admin Access: Maintain security baselines for administrator access to critical SaaS platforms and vendor accounts.

• Domain Protection: Maintain security standards for company domains and for monitoring lookalike domains.

postings.title: Manager, Tier 2 Support
postings.descriptionText:
Manager, Tier 2 Support

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Manager, Tier 2 Support who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. You will lead Sezzle's Tier 2 (T2) Support team, the escalation layer that investigates and resolves the shopper issues frontline Support cannot: account access and identity verification, payment method and multiple-charge investigations, Payment Streaks tier reinstatements, and Sezzle Send reversals. This role reports to the Director of Insights in the Customer Experience department.

You will be accountable for three things: fast, accurate resolution of every escalation; T2 decisions that are documented and defensible to auditors, regulators, and our bank partner; and fewer escalations over time, achieved by finding root causes and getting them fixed with Product, Risk, Payments, and Trust & Safety. This role sits in a fast-paced, rapidly growing team with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Compensation :

For this Manager, Tier 2 support, with + 3 years of experience, the compensation range is $2,500 - $3,000 USD based on location and experience level per month and in gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience

What You'll Do:

•
Lead, hire, coach, and develop the T2 Operations team; set schedules and coverage so escalations are worked within SLA.

•
Own the T2 escalation queue end to end: intake standards from frontline, triage, prioritization, and the routing paths to Risk, Payments, Trust & Safety, and other escalation teams.

•
Own T2's operating procedures and keep every SOP current, consistent, and audit-ready.

•
Make sure T2 work meets consumer-protection obligations: recognizing when an investigation needs to be rerouted for proper handling, no disclosure of other shoppers' account details, and strict PII handling in tickets, Slack, and AI tools.

•
Find patterns in escalation volume and drive fixes with Product, Engineering, and Payments; file and track defects until they are resolved.

•
Provide feedback to support training and managers to enhance agent knowledge and avoid future mis-escalations

•
Report weekly and monthly on T2 volume, resolution time, escalation drivers, and quality, and support complaint, audit, and regulatory responses with case-level evidence.

What We Look For:

• 3+ years in a people-leadership role (manager, supervisor, or team lead with direct reports) in a customer support or operations environment.

• 3+ years in technical support or escalations at a fintech company, such as payments, BNPL, lending, banking, or cards.

• Familiarity with payment rails (ACH, card networks, wire transfers), ledger systems, API integrations, and webhook monitoring.

• Hands-on experience investigating account, payment, and transaction issues in internal admin tools and a ticketing platform (Zendesk or similar).

• Working knowledge of consumer-financial regulations that affect support, such as Reg E, Reg Z/TILA, FCRA, and UDAAP.

• Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with BNPL or installment-lending products, virtual cards, or P2P money movement.

• Comfort with SQL or self-serve data tools to pull account and transaction data for investigations.

• Experience with fraud, account-takeover, and identity-verification workflows.

• A record of writing SOPs and knowledge-base content that frontline teams actually use.

• Experience supporting regulatory exams, bank-partner audits, or complaint responses (CFPB, state AGs, BBB).

• Clear, calm communicator who can explain technical root causes to agents, partners, and leadership.

About You:

• You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

• You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

• You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

• You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

postings.title: # 6 Data Scientist Senior – Customer Segmentation & Classification (RTM) - Latam
postings.descriptionText:
🚀 Join Our Remote Data Products & Machine Learning Startup! 🚀
At Muttdata, we build innovative Data Products and Machine Learning solutions that help companies solve complex business challenges. As a fast-growing, remote-first startup, we're passionate about technology, collaboration, and continuous learning.
This opportunity is with a leading multinational beverage company based in Mexico City.
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our team 🐶🚀. You'll be responsible for designing, developing, and enhancing advanced Pricing and Revenue Growth Management (RGM) models, turning data on demand, pricing, product portfolios, sales channels, and consumer behavior into actionable insights that drive strategic business decisions.
In this role, you'll combine Machine Learning, statistics, econometrics, and business expertise to build predictive models, analyze price-demand relationships, estimate price elasticities, and optimize pricing strategies.
You'll work closely with business stakeholders, Data Engineers, and Machine Learning Engineers to develop scalable, statistically robust solutions that support commercial decision-making. Strong analytical thinking, business understanding, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations are essential to succeed in this collaborative environment.

🚀 What We Do
• Leveraging our expertise, we build modern Machine Learning systems for demand planning and budget forecasting.

• Developing scalable data infrastructures, we enhance high-level decision-making, tailored to each client.

• Offering comprehensive Data Engineering and custom AI solutions, we optimize cloud-based systems.

• Using Generative AI, we help e-commerce platforms and retailers create higher-quality ads, faster.

• Building deep learning models, we enhance visual recognition and automation for various industries, improving product categorization, quality control, and information retrieval.

• Developing recommendation models, we personalize user experiences in e-commerce, streaming, and digital platforms, driving engagement and conversions.

🌟 Our Partnerships
• Amazon Web Services

• Astronomer

• Databricks

🌟 Our Values
• 📊 We are Data Nerds

• 🤗 We are Open Team Players

• 🚀 We Take Ownership

• 🌟 We Have a Positive Mindset

🔍 Curious about what we’re up to? Check out our case studies and dive into our blog post to learn more about our culture and the exciting projects we’re working on! 🚀

Responsibilities 🤓
• Formalize mathematically the trade-off between service time / RTM cost and revenue per point of sale, building the optimization function that currently operates heuristically.

• Model the cost and profitability layer (visit drivers, RTM Size thresholds, minimum margin) that feeds the segmentation and the assignment of service models.

• Build and solve optimization models (linear/integer programming, constrained optimization) to determine the optimal service model for each customer.

• Work on the Characterization pillars (Channel, Size, Potential, Territorial Profile, Digital Autonomy) and their multi-country expansion.

• Interpret the P&L end-to-end and translate it into decision variables, costs, and objective functions.

• Document assumptions and validate results with business and finance stakeholders.

• Develop analyses, features, and models on Databricks, collaborating with Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers.

• Promote best practices in modeling, reproducibility, and documentation across the team.

Required Skills 🚀
• Background and experience in Operations Research / Optimization (linear and integer programming, constrained optimization).

• Financial context: ability to interpret a P&L and translate it into variables, costs, and objective functions.

• Advanced Python, including optimization libraries (PuLP, Pyomo, OR-Tools, or similar).

• Solid foundations in statistics and modeling.

• Hands-on experience with Databricks.

• Ability to translate business needs into analytical solutions and communicate complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice to Have  😉
• Experience with survival models / CLV and econometrics.

• Experience in retail or consumer goods (CPG).

• Experience developing agents / agentic infrastructure (e.g., Mosaic AI Agent Framework, agent orchestration, MCP).

• Preferably Mexico City (Santa Fe / Cuajimalpa). Although the position is not strictly on-site, we give preference to candidates based in Mexico City; however, we are open to other locations.

🎁 Perks
• 🌍 Remote-first cultur e – work from anywhere!

• 🚀 In-Company English Lessons.

• 💪 Wellhub or sports club stipend to stay active

• 🚀 AWS, DBT, Google Cloud, Azure & Databricks certifications fully covered

• 🍕 Food credits via Pedidos Ya – because great work deserves great food.

• 🎂 Birthday off + an extra vacation week (Mutt Week! 🏖️)

• 🤝 Referral bonuses – help us grow the team & get rewarded!

• ✈️ 🏝️ Annual Mutters' Trip – an unforgettable getaway with the team!

• 👶 Monthly Childcare Reimbursement – Because supporting families matters too

postings.title: English (US) Podcast Localization Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
As a trusted global transformation partner, Welocalize accelerates the global business journey by enabling brands and companies to reach, engage, and grow international audiences. Welocalize delivers multilingual content transformation services in translation, localization, and adaptation for over 250 languages with a growing network of over 400,000 in-country linguistic resources. Driving innovation in language services, Welocalize delivers high-quality training data transformation solutions for NLP-enabled machine learning by blending technology and human intelligence to collect, annotate, and evaluate all content types. Our team works across locations in North America, Europe, and Asia serving our global clients in the markets that matter to them. www.welocalize.com
 
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
 
OVERVIEW
 
MAIN PURPOSE OF THE JOB
 
Welocalize is seeking passionate and culturally fluent Podcast Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) with exceptional writing skills to join our localization team. You’ll review, refine, fact-check, and adapt US‑English, AI‑generated podcast-related content so it resonates with US audiences.
 
Project Details:
Language Pair: English (US) > English (US)
Task Type: Quality Control
Assessment: Grammar + SME knowledge

MAIN DUTIES
• Review, edit, fact-check, and adapt podcast-related editorial content while adhering to writing style guides and guidelines

• Elevate and improve AI-generated US‑English source copy to ensure clarity, coherence, and creative impact

• Conduct market-specific research on podcast terminology, formats, creators, genres, and trends; ensure cultural and regional relevance for US audiences

• Provide clear, actionable feedback on written content and AI outputs

• Ensure consistency and quality across audiovisual and digital surfaces; work effectively within client tools and workflows

REQUIRED SKILLS
• Proven copywriting experience

• Proven experience editing or writing content related to various podcast genres, ensuring clarity, coherence, and consistency.

• Familiarity with contemporary podcast trends, and industry conventions.

• Ability to tailor tone and style to suit different contexts and audiences.

• Awareness of cultural influences and regional preferences in podcast content.

• Sharp awareness of pop culture, with a keen understanding of language, trends, and references commonly used in mainstream and ultra-popular contexts.

• Creativity: Ability to think originally, propose fresh angles, and elevate source output for engaging, on‑brand copy

• Research Skills: Proficient at researching and verifying facts, trends, and references using reliable sources

• Audience Awareness: Strong grasp of what resonates with target listeners/readers and how to drive engagement

• Writing Proficiency: Excellent grammar, punctuation, and ability to craft compelling, coherent narratives

• Passion for podcasts: Genuine enthusiasm that translates into insightful, engaging editorial

BONUS IF YOU HAVE:
• Published work on reputable podcast or media platforms

• Experience working with podcast streaming services, editorial platforms, or podcast-focused apps

• A flair for adapting voice and style to Gen Z and pop culture audiences

After your application is reviewed, shortlisted candidates will be contacted by our team to complete the application process. 
 
Beware of recruitment scams. Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job. Official emails come only from @welocalize.com, @welodata.ai, or @hire.lever.co, and all applications go through jobs.lever.co/weloglobal. Be wary of unexpected offers, generic email addresses (such as Gmail or Yahoo), and requests for fees or sensitive information. Report suspicious messages and learn more: Recognizing Scams and Confirming Legitimate Welocalize Communications – Welo Global

 - Experience with complex, high-value construction projects, preferably in luxury residential or specialized construction markets.

postings.title: INGENIERO SALA
postings.descriptionText:
Sumá tu energía a la compañía que contribuye al desarrollo de nuestro país.

En YPF buscamos personas que quieran ser parte de un gran equipo que transforma desafíos en oportunidades y que actúa con excelencia para generar valor. Con más de cien años de historia, somos la compañía energética líder de la Argentina, impulsando el desarrollo y la innovación tecnológica del país.

¡Sumarte a YPF es unirte a un proyecto que combina experiencia, pasión y la energía necesaria para seguir construyendo nuestro futuro!




¿Qué buscamos?

Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de Ingeniera o Ingeniero de sala Performance. Su función es analizar y optimizar el desempeño de las operaciones de perforación en tiempo real, mediante el seguimiento de indicadores operativos y la toma de decisiones oportunas, asegurando el cumplimiento del programa de pozo, la eficiencia operativa y los estándares de seguridad y medio ambiente.




¿Cuáles serán tus principales desafíos?





• Asistir al Líder Operativo para maximizar desempeño a través de decisiones técnicas sobre parámetros críticos (ROP, WOB, torque, hidráulica, etc.) en coordinación con stakeholders.


• Cumplir el Protocolo de Priorización de ROP en Rama Lateral, soportado por el Geonavegador, para establecer posiciones dentro del objetivo geológico que resulten en mejores condiciones de perforación.


• Realizar Análisis y Estadística de los datos en Tiempo Real y comparar métricas con los Objetivos de Programa, Estándares o pozos de referencia según corresponda.


• Mantener Simulaciones de condiciones de fondo en Tiempo Real (Torque & Drag, Trayectorias, MSE, hidráulicas, etc) que permitan tomar decisiones a través de datos para la optimización de la operación.


• Reportar diariamente las novedades del pozo en operación con el aporte del Jefe operativo


• Gestionar, actualizar y aplicar procedimientos, buenas prácticas y reglamentos de acuerdo con los avances y mejoras que se vayan alcanzando.





¿Qué valoramos como diferencial?



• Experiencia como Perforador Direccional (Directional Driller), preferentemente.


• Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en operaciones en Vaca Muerta.


• Uso de Software para control de trayectorias direccionales, monitoreo de parámetros en tiempo real y simulación de torque arrastre e hidráulicas.


• Uso de herramientas de perforación direccional como motores y RSS: funcionamiento y diagnóstico.


• Conocimiento sólido de parámetros operativos de perforación y su impacto en el desempeño (ROP, torque, WOB, hidráulica, etc.).


• Experiencia en creación de Data Bases, análisis de datos operativos y seguimiento de KPIs de performance.


• Capacidad de interpretación de programas de pozo y ventanas operativas.


• Experiencia en toma de decisiones en entornos operativos dinámicos o en tiempo real.


• Conocimiento en geo navegación y su interacción con la operación.


• Experiencia en interacción con múltiples stakeholders (company man, ingenieros, contratistas, etc.).


• Evaluar la ejecución respecto al programa de pozo, identificando desvíos, riesgos y oportunidades de mejora.




Información del puesto



• Lugar de trabajo: Torre YPF Puerto Madero


• Modalidad: 7X7/ turnos 06 a 18hs - 18 a 06hs / rotativo







Si sos una persona que:



• Trabaja con excelencia y profesionalismo.


• Da lo mejor cada día, valora la meritocracia y busca siempre la milla extra.


• Vive los desafíos como oportunidades para innovar y aprender.


• Disfruta del trabajo en equipo y del intercambio de distintos puntos de vista.


• Encara los proyectos con pasión y compromiso.


• Promueve un buen clima de trabajo, con empatía, escucha activa y respeto.




¡Este puesto es para vos!


¿Qué ofrecemos?

Un entorno donde podés aportar lo más valioso que tenés: tu energía. Esa energía que impulsa, que se adapta, que aprende, que suma, que transforma.

Sumarte a la #ExperienciaYPF es:



• 🤩 Impulsar tu desarrollo al siguiente nivel con nuevas oportunidades de aprendizaje.


• 💡 Crear soluciones innovadoras que impactan en el país.


• 🤝 Formar parte de una empresa comprometida con la equidad y la inclusión.


• 🧘‍♀️ Disfrutar del acompañamiento integral del Programa Be #BeneficiosYExperiencias.




Programa Be (Beneficios y Experiencias)



• Descuentos exclusivos en combustibles, gimnasios y muchos otros productos y servicios.


• Iniciativas para estar cerca en los momentos familiares claves: ayuda escolar, licencias parentales extendidas y regalo de nacimiento.


• Cobertura médica para vos y tu familia.


• Descuentos especiales en universidades orientados a impulsar estudios de especialización y posgrado.


• Servicios de refrigerio, frutas, snacks y comedor (según locación).


• Día libre de cumpleaños


• Esquema de vacaciones adicionales



¡Te esperamos para seguir generando valor y construyendo juntos el futuro energético de nuestro país!

Buscamos un/a Analista de Inspección Operativa con capacidad para tomar decisiones en entornos dinámicos y cambiantes, demostrando adaptación y criterio operativo. Valoramos perfiles con excelentes habilidades de trabajo en equipo, comunicación efectiva y orientación a resultados, que puedan interactuar con distintos actores de la organización y contribuir a la gestión operativa dentro de la VP Midstream & Downstream.



¿Cuál será su desafío?



Evaluar, analizar e implementar las técnicas de ingeniería de confiabilidad, por medio de las mejores prácticas de aplicación de estrategias de corto, mediano y largo plazo haciendo foco en la reducción de fallas en sistemas y/o equipos de procesos velando por la confiabilidad de los activos estáticos / mecánicos / eléctricos / instrumentos de las unidades de proceso, teniendo atención primordial en los equipos críticos para la reducción al mínimo / eliminación de las fallas base de las instalaciones contribuyendo al cumplimiento de la normativa vigente, así como la política de Seguridad, Medio Ambiente de YPF.

Gestionar y controlar el sistema de gestión de activos, sus criticidades y la gestión de datos de los diferentes sistemas soporte a fin de contribuir en la toma de decisiones.

Realizar y liderar los análisis de fallas (RCM, FMEA) y análisis causa raíz (ACR) ante fallas frecuentes y/o catastróficas, generando recomendaciones de acuerdo con los resultados de los análisis y controlando la aplicación de las mismas.

Analizar alternativas de aplicación de nuevas tecnologías y/o materiales para mejorar la vida útil de los activos.

Desarrollar y gestionar los planes de mantenimiento predictivo y preventivo de los activos y asegurar que todos los activos tengan un plan de mantenimiento de acuerdo con los modos de fallas esperados para los mismos.

Supervisar y adecuar las tecnologías predictivas y preventivas utilizadas para la definición de estrategias de mantenimiento.

Determinar malos actores de su área de incumbencia, elevar los mismos para una evaluación global y recomendaciones asociadas, realizando el seguimiento del avance e implementación de las recomendaciones realizadas a malos actores definidos dentro de su área de incumbencia.

Realizar el seguimiento de los KPIs de confiabilidad y recomendaciones asociadas que puedan surgir de los mismos.

Certificado API 510, 570 y 653, 571 y 577 son de alto valor para las funciones de la posición. Otras certificaciones son deseables.

· Conocimientos Informáticos: Paquete Office, Power Bi, SAP.

En Swiss Medical trabajamos cada día para que las personas vivan más y mejor.
Más de 4 millones de personas confían en nosotros y, detrás de cada historia, hay un equipo de más de 16.500 colaboradores que elige todos los días cuidar, acompañar y transformar vidas.

💪 Tu impacto

Las mejores decisiones también empiezan con un buen análisis. En este rol, vas a poder transformar datos y modelos actuariales en información que impulse decisiones más precisas, fortalezca la sostenibilidad del negocio y permita seguir acompañando a más personas con mejores soluciones.

• Transformar datos en información de alto valor mediante el desarrollo de modelos actuariales, herramientas analíticas y automatización de procesos.



• Validar la calidad y consistencia de la información utilizada en los análisis.



• Analizar los indicadores Actuariales y Contables que permitan controlar la gestión del área y alertar para aplicar planes de acción de ser necesario.

• Automatizar procesos de análisis y generación de información, utilizando código de programación a través de lenguaje SQ

• Generar la información y el análisis / conclusiones necesarias para proyecciones, pricing, ratios de siniestralidad, entro otros que permitan tomar decisiones en tiempo y forma

• Comunicar a la línea, de manera clara y efectiva, los análisis y conclusiones obtenidas.

• Velar por el correcto funcionamiento del Datawarehouse de la Cia. desde el lado técnico actuarial del negocio. Alertar desvíos y seguir el desarrollo de las nuevas necesidades definidas.

• Participación activa en los nuevos proyectos del área.

• Elaborar informes técnicos y presentaciones para la Dirección y otras áreas de la compañía.

🎯 Requisitos

• Estudios Universitarios de la carrera de Actuario, (Recibido).

• Contar con experiencia en Cia. De Seguros, al menos 3 años.

• Conocimiento Intermedio / Avanzado en programación SQL, con Amplio manejo de Base de datos.

💫 Beneficios

💌 Acceso preferencial en la contratación de productos y servicios de Swiss Medical (seguros de caución, hogar, automotor, retiro, vida, ahorro y Swiss Medical Cells).

📚 Descuentos en Universidades y acceso a nuestra plataforma corporativa de e-learning.

💉 Campaña de vacunación gratuita.

🏋️‍️ Cobertura en gimnasios a través de la red Wellhub.

📌 Descuentos corporativos en cines, teatros, viajes, restaurantes, spas y otros rubros.

📍 Horario y lugar de trabajo: lunes a Viernes de 09 a 18h – CABA.

🏢 Modalidad: Híbrido.

postings.descriptionText:
Real ownership from day one, not check-ins and micromanagement. That's what the AI Engineer & Support Lead role at Nortal looks like.

What working with us looks like

• Remote work with a LATAM team. Coffee breaks, tech talks, and games keep it human, even at a distance.

• No micromanagement. We hire for autonomy and expect you to use it.

• Support beyond the job. Our People Care team helps with time off, wellness, and anything in between.

What you get

• Competitive USD salary.

• Full remote work, with coworking spaces across LATAM if you want to meet the team in person.

• Paid time off under your country's rules, at full salary.

• National holidays.

• Sick leave, no stress attached.

• A yearly refundable credit. Spend it on anything related to your health and well-being.

• A day off for your birthday.

About this search

Great talent doesn't wait for job postings, so we don't either. We're building a network of skilled professionals for roles that come up regularly with our clients.

Join our Future Talent network and you'll be one of the first people we reach when the right opening appears. We make around 160 hires a year, so it happens often.

The role

As an AI Engineer & Platform Support Lead, you will help us scale AI adoption across the business on a small set of sanctioned platforms. You will be the day-to-day owner of our enterprise AI workspace and support the tools our teams rely on. You will also build and own the custom integrations, agents, and Slackbots that make those tools useful to business teams.

Your day-to-day:

• Be the go-to support owner for our AI platforms (Langdock, Gemini, and internal tools), from onboarding and troubleshooting to vendor escalations.

• Monitor platform health and adoption, and keep runbooks and documentation current.

• Build custom integrations, Slackbots, and agents that connect our AI tools to internal content and workflows.

• Make sure what you build is reliable in production, with monitoring and evaluation built in.

• Manage incoming AI use-case requests: scope, prioritize, and route each one to the right tool, and keep stakeholders updated along the way.

What we're looking for

• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

• Hands-on AI engineering: building LLM-powered applications, agents, and
RAG/knowledge-base systems; comfort with prompt design, tool/function calling, and
API integration.

• Power user of Claude Code (or equivalent agentic coding tools) for real, shipped work —
not just experimentation.

• Strong general engineering: Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript, REST APIs, working
with cloud services and webhooks.

• Experience building and operating Slack apps/bots (Slack API, event subscriptions, bot
deployment).

• Excellent project management and communication — able to be the calm, organized
front door for users while also going deep technically.

• Proven ability to work independently, prioritize a mixed queue (support + build), and
document as you go.

• Advanced English Level is required for this role, as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons. 

How the process works

• Apply and upload your resume.

• We review your profile and add it to our talent database.

• We reach out for an interview to learn about your experience and share more about what we're looking for.

• When a role opens that fits, we contact you to start the process. Because we already know you, it moves faster.

• No intermediaries. You deal with us directly.

About Nortal

For over 25 years, we've built the systems that global enterprises and public institutions run on. Today, that means using AI and data to help organizations make better decisions, not just build what they asked for.

We believe good solutions don't have to be complicated. That's why our clients trust us with the initiatives that matter most.

Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement. If that's what you're after, apply now. 👇

postings.descriptionText:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

About the Team

Our team supports team members across multiple countries, entities, and employment models. We work closely with HR, Finance, brokers, insurance carriers, payroll providers, and Employer of Record (EOR) partners to keep payroll and benefits accurate, compliant, and focused on the team member experience. We value accuracy, collaboration, continuous improvement, and finding practical ways to make complex processes simpler for everyone.

About the Role

Do you enjoy turning messy data into clear answers, finding smarter ways to work, and making complicated information easy to understand? Are you someone who picks up new tools quickly, enjoys experimenting with AI, and genuinely likes helping others?

We're looking for an experienced, detail-oriented, tech-savvy Cloudbeds teammate to join our Global Payroll & Benefits team. You don't need prior benefits experience — we'll teach you that! What you do need is a solid foundation in operations, confidence working with data, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to take ownership and follow through independently.

Coming from Customer Success, Support, Sales Operations, Finance, or another operational team? Your experience could translate well into global benefits, and we'd love to hear from you!

What You'll Do

•
Benefits operations : Support enrollments, qualifying life events, status changes, and terminations across Workday, payroll, and vendor platforms, with guidance on unfamiliar or complex cases.

•
Data accuracy and reconciliations : Reconcile payroll deductions, eligibility files, enrollment records, and carrier invoices. Identify discrepancies, investigate differences, and follow through with Payroll, HR, Finance, and vendors to resolve them.

•
Team member support: Be a welcoming, reliable point of contact for benefits questions. Own requests from start to finish, providing clear updates and escalating complex cases when needed.

•
Team member education : Create benefits guides, FAQs, Guru cards, presentations, and short videos that make complicated information easier to understand. Help deliver virtual new hire benefits orientations and education sessions.

•
Technology and process improvement: Help test new tools, AI agents, and automated workflows that make everyday processes more efficient.

•
Vendor coordination: Work with brokers, insurance carriers, payroll providers, and EOR partners to keep day-to-day benefits operations moving.

Where You'll Grow

As you build your benefits knowledge, you'll have opportunities to get involved in:

•
Open enrollment and benefits renewals.

•
Retirement programs, including U.S. 401(k) and Canadian RRSP/TFSA/DPSP plans.

•
Leave of absence coordination.

•
Benefits billing, audits, and vendor invoice projects.

•
Country-specific and EOR benefits programs.

•
Team member well-being initiatives and other global benefits projects.

Technology, the Practical Way

We're excited about finding smarter ways to work. You'll use Excel, AI, automation, and creative tools to simplify processes, turn complex benefits topics into engaging team member resources, and reduce repetitive work.

What You Bring

•
Operations experience : At least 3 years of experience in Customer Success, Support, Finance, Sales Operations, HR, or another operational role. Prior benefits experience is a plus, not a requirement.

•

postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

Disclaimer: We're currently on the lookout for potential candidates to join our talent pool via this job listing. Your qualifications will be assessed for both present positions and future opportunities. Should your skills align with a role and an opening arise, our recruitment team will reach out to you promptly. However, please keep in mind that this doesn't guarantee immediate placement or communication. #LI-MM1

A day in the life:

A Creative Strategist will be the lead ideator on strategic accounts. They are required to have a robust understanding of paid social creative best practices, their client’s brand, performance goals, historical data, current ecommerce trends, and consumer behavior, to develop winning paid social advertising that impacts their client's growth.

Creative Strategists know how to act fast to capitalize on good results, or on the flip side know what to change if an ad isn’t performing to their goal. This means testing with the intention of moving the needle on key performance metrics — from improving CPA, CTR, or ROAS to driving brand awareness. Creative Strategists pitch new ideas and concepts to clients, write scripts, and follow the execution and review of ads through to production and delivery to clients.

An ideal candidate for the Creative Strategist role is a self-starter who is passionate about maximizing success for their clients through creative strategy, and is eager to take the lead on developing creative concepts that are intentionally produced to generate clear testing results and insights. They have mastered presenting creative reporting to clients and team members through storytelling, and are constantly implementing learnings to enhance future campaign results. Sr. Creative Strategists are zealous about continuously testing various creative concepts to develop a strong understanding of how to not only effectively and efficiently meet client goals, but to surpass them. If creative deliveries are not meeting client expectations, or creative tests are not hitting target goals, Sr. Creative Strategists will be relentless in the pursuit to troubleshoot and problem solve with a growth mindset.

Key Responsibilities:

• Leads the paid social creative strategy for 8-10 clients

• Using data insights along with consumer and brand research to design high performing creative assets

• Collaborating closely with team members across internal departments and roles

• Maintaining client communications and sentiment

• Driven to iterate and ideate towards stated performance goals

• Develops rapport with client to build a foundation of open discussion, including understanding client product and goals, as well as explaining Power Digital processes

• Researches client brand, competitors, and industry trends, and effectively implements performance creative best practices by platform

• Continually audits account to identify winning ads, present data to client, and dictate hypotheses and test strategy via monthly roadmaps

• Writes strategic consumer-centric, direct response copy and messaging strategy

• Manages requests and output with production team using Asana

• Reviews video/image assets and provides clear and actionable feedback to editors

• Leads productive internal creative team syncs and brainstorms

• Works alongside client management team as client POC for all things creative strategy

• Understands scope of requested edits, reshoots, and other deliverables

• Pushes back on client on matters of timeline, scope, feedback, and direction to drive performance based on creative best practices

• Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes

• Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Role Requirements:

• Proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, and/or similar performance data tools (TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, etc)

• Technically skilled at pulling and using creative performance data to analyze trends, insights, and inform creative roadmaps

• Understanding of best practices for performance-driven creative & ability to apply these insights in work

• Ability to write effective ad copy, structure a script, and see through on the execution with corresponding visuals

• Ability to communicate and collaborate with clients, production, and post-production teams to deliver best possible creative output

• Ability to yield strong campaign results for clients through strategizing top performing creative

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• 5% or lower client churn

• Manage 8-10 mid level clients

• Maintain $22,000 RPE

Most Important Things (MITs)

• Technically skilled at pulling and using creative performance data to analyze trends and insights and inform the creative roadmap.

• Responsible for using data insights along with consumer and brand research to orchestrate a sales/messaging/visual strategy.

All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any messaging behalf of Power Digital, please send us an email at recruiting@powerdigital.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

postings.title: English to Maltese Review Lead for UI, Marketing & Product Content
postings.descriptionText:
About Welo Global

Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com


The Role

We are seeking an experienced English into Maltese Review Lead to serve as the language quality owner and primary client-facing linguistic expert for a leading global technology client.

You will own the locale’s interpretation of the client’s quality standards and make sure that the Post-Editing Lead, Post Editors, and Reviewers all work to the same shared understanding of “good”. You will be the main point of contact for the client’s Language Manager on quality discussions, arbitration, and escalations, and you will drive consistency, quality governance, and continuous improvement across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content.

Project Details


- Location: Remote (based in one of the approved countries below)
- Expected volume: Approximately 24 hours per month
- Employment type: Freelance / Independent Contract
- Task type: Language Lead Support
- Content types: UI, Marketing, Informational, Legal, Product, Support
- Language pair: English into Maltese

What You Will Do

-Analyse requirements: Review every style guide and glossary update, assess which quality categories and content types it affects, and record the changes. Track what the client’s Language Manager actually corrects and says in calibration and quality calls, not only what is written down.
-Relay expectations: Run regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish a structured monthly quality digest covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, and notable errors and arbitration outcomes.
-Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions, and deliver training built from real alignment data.
-Improve the standard: Turn recurring justification patterns into well-reasoned style guide proposals, and share cross-locale patterns with the Welocalize Quality Manager.
-Maintain alignment with the client: Treat Language Manager decisions as the standard, raise concerns with evidence at the right forum, and aim for fewer surprises over time.

What You Will Own

-The locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance
-The community’s shared understanding of quality
-The integrity of the arbitration record, ensuring that every arbitration sent to the client is valid and well-evidenced
-The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking

Requirements

- Experience: 3 to 5+ years in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), Senior Language Lead, or Quality Governance roles
- Client and stakeholder management: Direct experience as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration or escalation processes, and facilitating conflict resolution
- Quality audit frameworks: Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping
- Style guide and expectation analysis: Ability to analyse style guide changes, identify implicit client expectations, and map tolerance by content type (for example, Marketing vs. Legal vs. UI)
- Meeting facilitation: Hands-on experience with one-to-one coaching, shadowing sessions, alignment roundtables, and structured monthly quality reporting
- Analytical approach: Skill in tracking error concentrations, severity drift, and alignment scores, and in converting justification patterns into style guide improvements
- Language: Native-level Maltese and professional-level English
- Preferred: Prior experience supporting major technology localization programs and working with calibration or alignment tools

Additional Key Information

- Successful candidates will be provided with a dedicated device for project work.
- A background check is required as part of onboarding.
- Candidates must be physically located in one of the approved countries.

Approved countries: Argentina, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, China, Colombia, Costa Rica, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Egypt, El Salvador, Finland, France, Germany, Ghana, Greece, Guatemala, Hong Kong, Hungary, India, Indonesia, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Kenya, Lithuania, Malaysia, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Nigeria, Norway, Peru, Philippines, Poland, Portugal, Qatar, Romania, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States and Vietnam.

Why Join Us

This role offers a long-term partnership with global teams on high-visibility products. You will benefit from steady project volume, comprehensive onboarding and ongoing upskilling, and access to established linguistic resources.

If this sounds like the right opportunity, we would love to hear from you.


Compensation


Additional Information

We’re expanding across Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and Peru, and we’re looking for a Project Support Specialist to join our growing team!

The Project Support Specialist II (PSS II) serves as a member of the project team providing cross-functional support with the goal of making a positive impact on the studies to which they are assigned. The PSS II is a solid team member who can execute, with some oversight, all core responsibilities consistently across several studies using independent judgment and critical thinking. The PSS II effectively collaborates with their cross-functional team members and will take on new or expanded responsibilities when appropriate and with proper training. The PSS II prioritizes their work and collaborates with the project team to ensure a consistent understanding of the timing for completion of work products.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:



• Manages the meeting lifecycle including scheduling internal and external meetings, preparing, and circulating agendas, taking meeting minutes, circulating, and updating meeting minutes based on team member input, and filing meeting agendas and minutes in the Trial Master File.


• Assists with creation and maintenance of the project timeline in MS Project or similar system. Collects updates from team members, captures and documents these updates, and ensures updates are communicated to the cross-functional study team.


• Performs an array of activities and tasks in clinical systems applicable to their role and project scope..


• Manages study-specific training lifecycle by collecting, tracking, and loading training materials, assigning team members to appropriate training, and documenting completion of study-specific training in appropriate systems. Manages the maintenance of training records and files records in the Trial Master File.


• Identifies gaps in training by reviewing team member training compliance on a defined periodic basis and engages appropriate team members to ensure training completeness. Escalates to the Project Manager as needed.


• Establishes a study-level Share Point site or similar shared working space and ensures appropriate access to study team, sponsors, and others as appropriate.


• Creates project-specific email boxes and maintains appropriate access to study team members.


• Manages user access to study systems by submitting user requests to the Helpdesk or similar, by reviewing team member access on a defined periodic basis, and documenting access reviews. Ensure rapid removal of system access for team members no longer affiliated with the study.


• Orders study supplies and addresses queries on study supplies.


• Prepares study binder materials and works with vendor to ensure proper binder creation and shipping to study sites. Works with vendor to obtain project-related cost estimates. Ensures vendor quotes align with invoices for completed binders and consults directly with Project Manager to approve vendor payments.


• Maintains various study trackers as needed and directed by the Project Manager, Clinical Trial Manager, or other project leader.


• Manages the addition and removal of project team members in the finance system, including assignment of team members to specific tasks for time tracking.


• Reviews and approves weekly time reporting by team members. Identifies and escalates time reporting concerns to the Project Manager.


• With oversight by the Safety Lead, supports the distribution and tracking of IND Safety Reports/SUSARS/CIOMS according to the procedures defined by the study team in the project plan, as applicable.


• Manages the translation of site level documents, as applicable, per local and regional standards through document collection, tracking, vendor collaboration, engagement of stakeholders to evaluate translation completeness and vendor payments.


• Supports the management of project-specific vendors by assisting with development of the Vendor Management Plan, providing vendors with project trainings and access to systems, tracking vendor issues and overseeing vendor invoicing and payments.


• Manages the preparation, distribution, and the reconciliation of study material during applicable phases of the study (Operations Manual, ISF, patient cards, etc.) as applicable.


• Supports the Project Manager with the production of various study plans, reports and updates (e.g., PM plan, country/site initiation, activation, recruitment) including preparing initial drafts, managing the collection of team member input, and finalizing content.


• Collects data and maintains monthly Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and project health data. Circulates data to the Project Manager and internal team members as appropriate.


• Collects functional team input for the quarterly inspection readiness review.


• May support team leaders with the production of various study reports and updates (e.g., country/site initiation, activation, recruitment).


• Supports the Project Manager in the creation and maintenance of the Sponsor-facing study story board.


• Supports the Project Manager in tracking out of scope work. Prepares, with guidance, materials required for the submission of change orders.


• Performs other duties as assigned by the Project Manager.



Qualifications:

Minimum Required:



• 4-year college degree or international equivalent; or equivalent experience ideally in a business, scientific or healthcare discipline


• Minimum 2 years relevant experience or demonstrated competencies in the key requirements of the role.



Other Required:



• Fluency in the Microsoft Office package of programs (Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint).


• Customer service demeanor; demonstrate flexibility, teamwork, and a keen attention to detail.


• Ability to communicate both verbally and in writing at the English proficiently (Professional level).



Competencies:



• Working knowledge of ICH-GCP, Precision SOPs, and regulatory guidance.


• Demonstrates solid interpersonal skills.


• Exhibits strong self-motivation, is detail-oriented and able to work and plan independently as well as in a team environment.


• Strong written and verbal communication skills
